利用36个具有精确三维速度的最高质量宽双星样本探测低加速度引力异常

Detection of Gravitational Anomaly at Low Acceleration from a Highest-quality Sample of 36 Wide Binaries with Accurate 3D Velocities

K. -H. Chae, B. -C. Lee, X. Hernandez, V. G. Orlov, D. Lim, D. A. Turnshek, Y. -W. Lee · astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ex, hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们旨在利用孤立宽双星的三维运动，在低加速度范围 (10^-11,10^-9) m s^-2 精确测量引力。Gaia DR3 对一个系统的三维相对位移和速度（r,v）的四个天空平面分量给出精确测量，但视线方向（径向）分离和速度 v_r 精度不高。基于新观测和公共数据库/文献，我们汇编了36个邻近（距离<150 pc）且处于低加速度区、具有相对准确 v_r 的宽双星样本。利用 Gaia ruwe 参数、颜色-星等图、径向速度多历元观测、斑点干涉后续观测以及要求 Hipparcos-Gaia 自行一致等多种观测诊断，未探测到的恒星伴星等运动学污染得到较好控制。对于 Γ ≡ log10 sqrt(γ)，其中 γ ≡ G/G_N（G 是推广牛顿常数 G_N 的参数），我们发现在 <10^-9.1 m s^-2 时 Γ=0.102_{-0.021}^{+0.028}（<10^-9.5 m s^-2 时 0.132_{-0.027}^{+0.035}），给出引力增强因子 γ=1.60_{-0.14}^{+0.24}，从而排除牛顿引力。这一强异常主要由两个系统主导（HD 189739、HD 189760 和 TYC 259-236-1、TYC 259-906-1 的对），它们的 3D 相对速度超过估计的牛顿逃逸速度。若去掉它们，在 <10^-9.1、<10^-9.5、<10^-10.1 m s^-2 时分别得到 Γ=0.042_{-0.024}^{+0.027}、0.057_{-0.031}^{+0.035}、0.085_{-0.045}^{+0.059}。未来对更大样本进行径向速度监测和斑点干涉成像将有助于改进当前结果。

English: We set out to accurately measure gravity in the low-acceleration range $(10^{-11},10^{-9})\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$ from 3D motions of isolated wide binary stars. Gaia DR3 provides precise measurements of the four sky-plane components of the 3D relative displacement and velocity ($\mathbf{r}, \mathbf{v}$) for a system, but not comparably precise line-of-sight (radial) separation and velocity $v_{r}$. Based on our new observations and the public databases/publications, we assemble a sample of 36 nearby (distance $<150$pc) wide binaries in the low-acceleration regime with relatively accurate values of $v_r$. Kinematic contaminants such as undetected stellar companions are well under control using various observational diagnostics such as Gaia's {\tt ruwe} parameter, the color-magnitude diagram, multi-epoch observations of radial velocities, Speckle interferometric follow-up observations, and requiring Hipparcos-Gaia proper motion consistency. For $\Gamma \equiv \log_{10}\sqrt{\gamma}$ with $\gamma \equiv G/G_{\rm N}$ (where $G$ is a parameter generalizing Newton's constant $G_{\rm N}$), we find $\Gamma=0.102_{-0.021}^{+0.028}$ for $<10^{-9.1}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$ ($0.132_{-0.027}^{+0.035}$ for $<10^{-9.5}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$) giving a gravity boost factor of $\gamma=1.60_{-0.14}^{+0.24}$, which rules out Newton. This strong anomaly is dominated by two systems (the pairs of HD 189739, HD 189760, and TYC 259-236-1, TYC 259-906-1) that have 3D relative velocities exceeding their estimated Newtonian escape velocities. Without them, we have $\Gamma=0.042_{-0.024}^{+0.027}$ for $<10^{-9.1}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$, $0.057_{-0.031}^{+0.035}$ for $<10^{-9.5}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$, and $0.085_{-0.045}^{+0.059}$ for $<10^{-10.1}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$. Future radial velocity monitoring and Speckle interferometric imaging for larger samples will be useful to refine the present result.

一句话导读：基于36个低加速度宽双星的三维运动，报告牛顿引力被排除的引力增强信号，但结果受两个系统主导。

相关度：low — 该文属于观测引力/低加速度牛顿引力检验，不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或全息方法。

重新审视 AdS_3 中的谱流

Spectral flow in AdS$\mathbf{_3}$ revisited

Nathan McStay, Ronald Reid-Edwards, Sean Seet · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们重新审视一个旧想法：WZW 模型中的谱流可以与世界面上的某些 G-丛相关联。由此引入一种计算群 G、能级 k 的 WZW 模型中谱流顶点算子关联函数的新方法，即系统计算线缺陷网络的贡献。针对与 AdS_3 弦论相关的 G=SL(2,R) 情形，我们证明树级一般 n 点谱流顶点算子函数可重写为 n 个未谱流顶点算子与一个退化插入的 (n+1) 点函数。这可解释为瞬子背景中的未谱流 n 点函数。此外，我们猜想该 (n+1) 点函数可改写为未谱流算子的 n 点函数，并给出证据。我们证明对于特定选择并确定的空间坐标，该 (n+1) 点函数满足与未谱流 n 点函数相同的全局时空共形不变性约束。我们验证结果与文献中的 bootstrap 结果一致。这朝着完全求解 SL(2,R) WZW 模型迈出下一步。

English: We revisit an old idea that spectral flow in WZW models can be associated with certain $G$-bundles over a worldsheet. This allows us to introduce a novel method for computing correlators of spectrally-flowed vertex operators in WZW models with group $G$ and level $k$, by systematically computing the contribution from a network of line defects. Specialising to the case of $G=SL(2, \mathbb{R})$, as is relevant to AdS$_3$ string theory, we demonstrate that generic $n$-point functions of spectrally-flowed vertex operators at tree level can be rewritten in terms of an $(n+1)$-point function of $n$ unflowed vertex operators and one degenerate insertion. This is to be interpreted as an unflowed $n$-point function in an instanton background. Moreover, we conjecture that this $(n+1)$-point function can be recast as an $n$-point function of unflowed operators and we provide evidence for this. We demonstrate that the $(n+1)$-point function satisfies the same constraints from global spacetime conformal invariance as does an unflowed $n$-point function for a specific choice of spacetime coordinates that we determine. We verify that our results agree with bootstrap results in the literature. This provides the next step towards fully solving the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW model.

一句话导读：用 G-丛与线缺陷网络重算 SL(2,R) WZW 谱流顶点关联函数，并化为含退化插入的未谱流多点函数。

相关度：low — 论文属于 AdS_3 弦论与 SL(2,R) WZW 模型的基础技术研究，与列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等重点支线没有直接交集，因此相关性偏低。

非库仑 Q-上同调与量子提升

Non-Coulomb $Q$-cohomology and quantum lifting

Tanay Kibe, Sam van Leuven, Kayleigh Mathieson · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们研究四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中经典 Q-上同调类的量子提升。正交理论中规范微子双线性 S=Tr(λ+λ-) 的某些幂给出非库仑单调量：在 Cartan 限制下消失的多引力子类。对于 SO(7)，我们识别 S^4 为已知提升单调量类的超共形后代，解释其非库仑性质。我们显式构造 S^4 的一个偶然提升伙伴，相反它在库仑分支可见。该构造为在高秩寻找更高幂的类似伙伴提供策略。主要结果建立经典规范群族多迹扇区中量子提升的限制。我们证明超荷的一圈修正 Q1 湮灭经典上同调中的每个单调量类，而每个 [Q1] 像具有消失的 Cartan 限制。因此每个非零一圈配对有偶然源和非库仑靶，库仑单调量在有限秩此阶存活。在 BMN 扇区，我们的结果意味着非库仑单调量也在一圈存活。关键一步表明，用标量判别式足够高次幂修饰任何经典类会得到多引力子类，或当原类非库仑时在上同调中为零。我们将这种湮灭解释为部分无毛性质。

English: We study quantum lifting of classical $Q$-cohomology classes in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory. Certain powers of the gaugino bilinear $\mathcal{S}=\text{Tr}(\lambda_+\lambda_-)$ in orthogonal theories provide non-Coulomb monotones: multi-graviton classes that vanish upon Cartan restriction. For $SO(7)$, we identify $\mathcal S^4$ as a superconformal descendant of a known lifted monotone class, explaining the latter's non-Coulomb character. We explicitly construct a fortuitous lifting partner for $\mathcal S^4$ that is, by contrast, visible on the Coulomb branch. This construction provides a strategy for finding analogous partners for higher powers at higher ranks. Our main result establishes restrictions on quantum lifting in the multi-trace sector of the classical gauge-group families. We show that the one-loop correction $Q_1$ to the supercharge annihilates every monotone class in classical cohomology, while every $[Q_1]$ image has vanishing Cartan restriction. Thus every non-zero one-loop pairing has a fortuitous source and a non-Coulomb target, and Coulomb monotones survive at this order at finite rank. In the BMN sector, our results imply that non-Coulomb monotones also survive at one loop. A crucial step shows that dressing any classical class by a sufficiently high power of a scalar discriminant yields a multi-graviton class, or zero in cohomology when the original class is non-Coulomb. We interpret this annihilation as a partial no-hair property.

一句话导读：研究 N=4 SYM 中非库仑 Q-上同调类的量子提升及多迹扇区限制。

动量分馏微态几何上的随机波混沌

Random wave chaos on momentum-fractionated microstate geometries

Vladan Djuki\'c, Mihailo \v{C}ubrovi\'c · hep-th, gr-qc, nlin.CD · v2 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们研究了动量分馏在D1-D5理论光滑三荷超引力解（特别是动量分馏superstrata）上混沌发展中的作用。我们通过零测地线和波的动力学探测混沌。在分馏背景上，测地线和波都表现出均匀强混沌（大的混沌海，且与Berry随机波假设近乎完美一致）。相反，在单模（非分馏）superstrata上，测地线和波更接近可分离（尽管仍然混沌）。我们讨论这种二分法可能与如下预期有关：单调BPS态比偶然BPS态更不混沌。最后，我们解释为何我们的混沌探针对于微态几何有意义，尽管它们在黑洞极限下变得平凡。

English: We study the role of momentum fractionation in the development of chaos on smooth 3-charge supergravity solutions of D1-D5 theory, specifically momentum-fractionated superstrata. We probe the chaos through the dynamics of null geodesics and waves. On fractionated backgrounds, both geodesics and waves show uniformly strong chaos (large chaotic sea and near-perfect agreement with the Berry random wave hypothesis). In contrast, geodesics and waves on single-mode (non-fractionated) superstrata are closer to separability (although still chaotic). We discuss a possibility that such dichotomy can be related to the expectation that monotone BPS states are less chaotic than fortuitous ones. Finally, we explain why our chaos probes are meaningful for microstate geometries even though they become trivial in the black hole limit.

一句话导读：在D1-D5动量分馏微态几何中，零测地线与波均显示强混沌并符合Berry随机波假设，而非分馏superstrata更接近可分离。

相关度：medium — 论文属于全息黑洞微态几何与经典几何上的混沌/波动力学，和“经典引力/广义相对论”标签有间接关联；但不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜等具体支线。

有限 G_N 下反弹奇点的命运

Fate of Bouncing Singularities at Finite $G_N$

Zohar Komargodski · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：热两点函数的引力近似可能出现与到达黑洞奇点的轨迹相关的复时间奇点。我们证明在有限 G_N 下相应奇点不存在；方法是将共形场论的解析性质推广到第二叶（以及万有覆盖）。我们还用有限部分和以及一类在两个热几何粘合而成的非平凡拓扑流形上的配分函数，对假定奇点处关联子振幅给出两个上界。最后讨论对黑洞奇点的可能含义。

English: The gravity approximation to a thermal two-point function can develop a complex-time singularity associated with a trajectory that reaches the black-hole singularity. We show that the corresponding singularity is absent at finite $G_N$. This is done by extending Conformal Field Theory analyticity properties to the second sheet (and to the universal cover). We also put two different upper bounds on the amplitude of the correlator at the would-be singularity, by certain finite partial sums, and by a certain partition function on a manifold with nontrivial topology, where two thermal geometries are glued. We discuss the possible implications for the black hole singularity.

一句话导读：利用 CFT 解析性证明有限 G_N 下热两点函数的引力复时间奇点消失，并讨论其对黑洞奇点的含义。

引力中的耗散流体力学作用量与视界对称性

Dissipative hydrodynamic actions and horizon symmetries in gravity

Mike Blake, Arpit Das, Richard A. Davison · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们在Schwinger-Keldysh形式下给出一个方法，用来计算描述AdS4引力对偶的全息量子场论中大规模热应力张量动力学的耗散作用量。该方案在热平衡态微扰的二次阶有效。该作用量的流体力学自由度在引力中实现为黑洞视界与Crossley-Glorioso-Liu围道两个渐近边界之间的相对微分同胚。我们显式计算到一阶导数的作用量，并确认它正确再现已知的流体力学格林函数。我们的方案需要为度规选择视界边界条件。我们研究保持这些条件的视界对称性，以及它们与被认为导致多体量子混沌的流体力学对称性之间的关系。

English: We give a prescription to compute a dissipative action describing the large-scale thermal stress tensor dynamics of a holographic quantum field theory dual to AdS$_4$ gravity, in the context of the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism. Our prescription is valid to quadratic order in perturbations about the thermal equilibrium state. The hydrodynamical degrees of freedom of this action are realised in gravity as relative diffeomorphisms between the black hole horizon and the two asymptotic boundaries of the Crossley-Glorioso-Liu contour. We explicitly compute the action to first order in derivatives, and confirm it correctly reproduces the known hydrodynamic Green's functions. Our prescription requires a choice of horizon boundary conditions for the metric. We study the horizon symmetries that preserve these, and their relation to conjectured hydrodynamic symmetries responsible for many-body quantum chaos.

一句话导读：在Schwinger-Keldysh框架下从AdS4黑洞视界相对微分同胚构造耗散流体力学作用量，并研究视界对称性与量子混沌流体力学对称性的联系。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

论全息散射的充分条件

On sufficient conditions for holographic scattering

Caroline Lima, Sabrina Pasterski, Chris Waddell · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：全息对偶表明，体空间中的散射可以由边界上的纠缠介导。May、Penington 与 Sorce 的连接楔定理（CWT）给出了一个具体例子，其中体散射蕴含某些边界区域之间的关联，但其逆命题并不成立。我们考察 Leutheusser 与 Liu 最近提出的、带逆命题的 CWT 推广方案。我们证明了正向命题：若 CFT 的“输入”区域对（以及同样地“输出”区域对）处于纠缠楔连通相，则某个特定的体子区域（“输入”与“输出”纠缠楔的交集）非空。随后我们建立了一个具有逆命题的修正版本，并指出了更强猜想的反例。

English: Holography implies scattering in the bulk can be mediated by entanglement on the boundary. The connected wedge theorem (CWT) of May, Penington, and Sorce is a concrete example where bulk scattering implies correlation between certain boundary regions. However the converse does not hold. We investigate a recent proposal of Leutheusser and Liu for a generalization of the CWT with converse. We prove the forward direction: having pairs of CFT ``input'' (and likewise ``output'') regions in a phase with connected entanglement wedge implies that a particular bulk subregion (the intersection of ``input'' and ``output'' entanglement wedges) is non-empty. We then establish a modified version of the proposal which has a converse, and identify counter-examples to the stronger conjecture.

一句话导读：研究全息散射与边界纠缠楔连通性之间的充分条件，证明 Leutheusser-Liu 方案的正向命题并给出带逆命题的修正版本。

相关度：medium — 论文讨论 AdS/CFT 中纠缠楔与全息散射的充分条件，属于全息基础与量子信息方向，但不直接对应所列重点研究支线。

重访宇称破坏标量-张量理论：直至 d=4 的完备基与哈密顿分析

Parity-violating scalar-tensor theory revisited: complete basis up to $d=4$ and Hamiltonian analysis

Yun-Chuan Zhang, Yu-Min Hu, Xian Gao · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们构造了宇称破坏的一般协变标量-张量（GST）与空间协变引力（SCG）单项式在导数阶 d=4 以内的完备基。包含所有导数划分后，每种描述包含 1 个 d=3 和 13 个 d=4 线性独立单项式。在拉格朗日量层面，我们找到六个分部积分关系，将多项式型拉格朗日量约化为具有一般系数函数的 1 个 d=3 和 7 个 d=4 单项式的组合。我们推导了两个基之间的对应关系，保留一般系数与全导数项，并确立它们在分部积分下的独立性。在七个 d=4 SCG 单项式中，五个既不含 lapse 速度也不含外曲率的时间导数。对于剩余两个单项式，我们以标准 Einstein-Hilbert 动能项和依赖 lapse 的势能进行哈密顿约束分析。在所考虑的正则分支上，lapse 速度项传播四个自由度（DOF），而外曲率速度项无论单独存在还是与 lapse 速度项同时存在，都传播六个自由度。这些结果为在该框架内构造直至 d=4、具有三个自由度的宇称破坏标量-张量理论提供了完备基；其中宇称破坏拉格朗日量由六个 GST 多项式张成：一个 d=3 和五个 d=4 多项式。

English: We construct complete bases of parity-violating generally covariant scalar-tensor (GST) and spatially covariant gravity (SCG) monomials up to derivative grade $d=4$. Including all derivative partitions, each description contains one $d=3$ and thirteen $d=4$ linearly independent monomials. At the level of Lagrangians, we find six integration-by-parts relations that reduce polynomial-type Lagrangians to combinations of one $d=3$ and seven $d=4$ monomials with general coefficient functions. We derive the correspondence between the two bases, retaining general coefficients and total derivatives, and establish their independence under integrations by parts. Among the seven $d=4$ SCG monomials, five contain neither the lapse velocity nor the time derivative of the extrinsic curvature. For the two remaining monomials, we perform a Hamiltonian constraint analysis with a standard Einstein-Hilbert kinetic term and a lapse-dependent potential. On the regular branches considered, the lapse-velocity term propagates four degrees of freedom (DOFs), while the extrinsic-curvature-velocity term propagates six DOFs, whether present alone or together with the lapse-velocity term. These results provide a complete basis for constructing parity-violating scalar-tensor theories with three DOFs up to $d=4$ within this setting, with the parity-violating Lagrangian spanned by six GST polynomials: one $d=3$ and five $d=4$ polynomials.

一句话导读：系统构造宇称破坏标量-张量/空间协变引力直至 d=4 的完备单项式基，并通过哈密顿约束分析给出含 lapse 速度和外曲率速度项的传播自由度。

相关度：high — 论文直接属于经典引力/修改引力支线：构造宇称破坏标量-张量理论完备基并做哈密顿约束与自由度分析，不涉及全息。

ISCO 的轨道曲率

An Orbital Curvature for ISCOs

Poulami Mukherjee, Chandrasekhar Bhamidipati, Sudipta Mukherji · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：基于黑洞时空中测地线方程相图的圆轨道是不动点这一事实，作者构建了一种轨道几何，用以刻画轨道的稳定性结构。该构造以轨道能量、角动量和角速度为状态空间变量，并用响应函数描述圆轨道如何响应黑洞背景和角运动的变化。相应的标量曲率可对圆轨道族中的特定点（包括最内稳定圆轨道 ISCO）提供几何诊断，并在 ISCO 处变为奇异。跨越 ISCO 时，相关轨道响应函数从稳定圆轨道支到不稳定圆轨道支改变符号，并通常在边际稳定处消失。作者在渐近平直四维 Schwarzschild 黑洞和五维 Schwarzschild-AdS 时空中展示了该框架。四维情形中 ISCO 与能量响应部分的退化相关，而五维 AdS 情形中则通过角向响应检测到 ISCO。AdS 例子还在与黑洞背景最低温度重合的点处出现另一个曲率奇点。结果表明，轨道响应几何为刻画圆轨道稳定性和 ISCO 临界性提供了统一的几何框架。

English: Building on the fact that circular orbits are the fixed points of the phase portraits arising from the geodesic equations on a black hole spacetime, we develop a general orbital geometry, which captures the stability structure of orbits. The construction uses the orbital energy, angular momentum and angular velocity as state space variables, with response functions encoding how the circular orbits react to changes in the black hole background and in their angular motion. The associated scalar curvature provides a geometric diagnostic of certain distinguished points of the circular orbit family, including, the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), where it becomes singular. Across the ISCO, the relevant orbital response functions change sign as the system passes from the stable to the unstable circular orbit branch, and typically vanish at marginal stability. We illustrate the framework for Schwarzschild black holes in asymptotically flat four dimensions, and five dimensional Schwarzschild AdS spacetimes. In the four-dimensional case, the ISCO is associated with a degeneration of the energy response sector, while in the five dimensional AdS case it is detected through the angular response. The AdS example also exhibits a separate curvature singularity at a point which coincides with the minimum temperature of the black hole background. These results show that the orbital response geometry provides a unified geometric framework for characterizing the stability of circular orbits and criticality of ISCOs.

一句话导读：作者用轨道能量、角动量和角速度构造响应几何，以曲率奇点诊断黑洞圆轨道稳定性和 ISCO。

English: When matter collapses at the threshold of black hole formation spacetime typically has an emergent continuous or discrete symmetry, depending on the matter content. For the Einstein-Klein-Gordon model in any finite dimension D>3 the associated critical spacetime solutions exhibit discrete self-similarity, characterized by the echoing period Delta. Combining analytical and numerical results with dimensions up to D=200 we predict Delta remains finite at infinite dimension D, contrary to a recent conjecture. We find the fit Delta=1.6439+10.37/D-O(1/D^2) and provide an explicit large-D model.

中文摘要：偶极玻色子星由两个标量场团块组成，二者通过引力吸引与标量排斥之间的平衡维持静态平衡；排斥源于分别作为两个团块源的谐振变化复标量场之间存在 π 相位差。我们数值构造了这些构型的序列，并在有效单体（EOB）形式下将其解析描述为两个玻色子星的束缚态。我们将此前为两个玻色子星散射导出的 EOB 势映射为依赖能量的类 Schwarzschild 径向势。我们发现，基于 EOB 的系统结合能解析预言与数值结果吻合得很好；对于不存在静态平衡的临界引力耦合，解析预言也与数值结果一致。

English: Dipolar boson stars consist of two scalar-field lumps held in static equilibrium by the balance between gravitational attraction and scalar repulsion. The repulsion stems from a $\pi$ phase difference between the harmonically varying complex scalar field sourcing each lump. We construct sequences of these configurations numerically and describe them analytically as bound states of two boson stars within the effective-one-body (EOB) formalism. We map the EOB potential previously derived for the scattering of two boson stars onto an energy-dependent Schwarzschild-like radial potential. We find that the EOB-based analytical prediction for the binding energy of the system agrees remarkably well with the numerical values. The analytical prediction for the critical gravitational coupling beyond which no static equilibrium exists is also consistent with the numerical results.

English: We report a novel solution of three-dimensional Galilean Anti-de Sitter gravity. The theory can be formulated as a topological gauge theory invariant under the doubly extended Newton-Hooke group in three dimensions. The solution possesses four conserved charges: energy, angular momentum, spin and rest mass. Interestingly, the magnitude of the spin turns out to bounded from above by the rest mass. The solution exhibits the thermal properties that define a black hole configuration in terms of its gauge theoretical description. Temperature, angular velocity and other chemical potentials are obtained from suitable regularity conditions associated with the topology of the Euclidean continuation of the solution. At zero temperature, an extreme configuration is shown to emerge provided the bound between the spin and the rest mass saturates.

中文摘要：我们研究 M2-膜的横向几何能否刻画其三球配分函数中指数小的效应。我们将“M2-膜可观测量由横向 Calabi-Yau 四维流形上的等变拓扑弦编码”的 proposal 推广到非常数映射；核心对象是 CY4 规范线性 sigma 模型的圆盘配分函数，即等变体积的量子推广。经 Gamma 函数归一化和 Mellin 变换后，在具有合适费米气体描述的示例中，它重现完整的领头 WKB 巨势，包括与该描述相容的 R-荷和质量形变。特别地，该变换即使在无紧致曲线的 C^4 中也恢复膜瞬子级数。对于有紧致曲线的分解 CY4 锥，匹配需要对经典介子约束做量子修正。我们建立 ABJM、ADHM 及一组代表性带味 M2-膜 quiver 理论中带修饰圆盘配分函数与经典谱迹的精确等式。在可建立匹配的形变轨迹之外，同一构造给出膜瞬子扇区的几何预言，尚待检验。

English: Can the geometry transverse to M2-branes capture effects that are exponentially small in their three-sphere ($S^3$) partition function? We investigate this question by extending beyond constant maps the proposal that M2-brane observables are encoded by equivariant topological strings on the transverse Calabi-Yau fourfold (CY$_4$). Our central object is the disk partition function of the CY$_4$ gauged linear sigma model, a quantum generalization of the equivariant volume. After a Gamma-function normalization and a Mellin transform, it reproduces the complete leading WKB grand potential in the examples admitting a suitable Fermi-gas description, including the R-charge and mass deformations compatible with that description. In particular, the transform recovers membrane-instanton series even for $\mathbb{C}^4$, which has no compact curves. For resolved CY$_4$ cones with compact curves, the match requires a quantum refinement of the classical mesonic constraint. We establish the exact equalities of the corresponding dressed disk partition functions with the classical spectral traces for ABJM, ADHM and a representative set of flavored M2-brane quiver theories. Away from the deformation loci where this match can be established, the same construction yields geometric predictions for the membrane-instanton sector that remain to be tested.

English: We construct an action similar to the Henneaux-Teitelboim action on a six dimensional Lorentzian manifold where the time direction is chosen to be lightlike and generated by a conformal lightlike Killing vector $U$. We show that such an action exists only if there is another commuting light-like conformal Killing vector $V$ with properties that can be realized by the Dirac currents of two conformal Killing spinors. We extend the action to the $(1,0)$ supersymmetric tensor multiplet.

带电 AdS$_3$ 黑膜作为边缘形变的二维 CFT

Charged AdS$_{3}$ black branes as marginally deformed two-dimensional CFTs

Suting Zhao, Gabriel Arenas-Henriquez, Yizhou Lu, Hamed Adami, Ren\'e Meyer · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们研究边界关联函数如何编码 AdS$_3$ 黑膜重正化欧几里得作用量对电荷的依赖。在三维 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中，Maxwell 场具有对数渐近行为，并局域对偶于无质量赝标量。在正则系综中，电荷密度固定对偶边缘算符的空间线性源的斜率。固定温度下，由于反射对称性 $\Phi\to-\Phi$，经典作用量在电荷密度上为偶函数，其电荷展开系数由 Catalan 数支配。我们围绕中性黑膜计算了二次和四次项，分别来自连通关联函数。标量两点函数及其源的平移对称性决定物质 Weyl 反常，并固定电荷展开中二次项的对数温度依赖。在四次阶，连通四点函数来自树级引力子交换。将其与线性源积分，并对积分整体尺度引入红外截断，可重现单位长度作用量的四次系数。在每一更高阶，相应的 Catalan 系数预测所有连通树级 Witten 图积分之和。

English: We study how boundary correlation functions encode the charge dependence of the renormalised Euclidean action of an AdS$_3$ black brane. In three-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell theory, the Maxwell field has logarithmic asymptotics and is locally dual to a massless pseudoscalar. In the canonical ensemble, the charge density fixes the slope of a spatially linear source for the dual marginal operator. At fixed temperature, the classical action is even in the charge density due to reflection symmetry $\Phi\to-\Phi$, and its charge expansion coefficients are governed by Catalan numbers. We compute the quadratic and quartic terms from connected correlation functions around the neutral brane. The scalar two-point function and the shift symmetry of its source determine the matter Weyl anomaly, which fixes the logarithmic temperature dependence of the quadratic term in the charge expansion. At quartic order, the connected four-point function comes from tree-level graviton exchange. Integrating it against the linear source, with an infrared cutoff on the overall scale of the integral, reproduces the quartic coefficient of the action per unit length. At each higher order, the corresponding Catalan coefficient predicts the integrated sum of all connected tree-level Witten diagrams.

一句话导读：在 AdS$_3$ Einstein-Maxwell 黑膜背景下，用边界关联函数和树级 Witten 图计算重正化作用量的电荷展开，并联系二维 CFT 的边缘形变与 Weyl 反常。

中文摘要：纠缠熵是现代理论物理的核心，但在具有非平凡时间依赖的相互作用理论中计算仍具挑战。本论文利用AdS/CFT对应研究强耦合量子场论中纠缠熵的实时动力学。首先考察具有非均匀sine-square变形的二维共形场论中的纠缠熵演化，论证SSD哈密顿量驱动的非传统时间演化可视为时空叶层的变化，并在对偶三维体时空中产生新视界；全息纠缠熵计算与CFT结果在可比较情形下一致。随后研究一般混沌量子多体系统中的纠缠动力学，在晚时和大区域极限下采用有效纠缠膜描述；在二维CFT中简并膜张力可重现若干熵动力学结果，而高维情形为非简并张力。利用全息，我们表明二维CFT中反射熵需要膜描述中额外自由度；并展示当CFT经历相关变形时出现常规非简并张力，其对偶为带标量毛的平面BTZ黑洞及内部Kasner宇宙。随后建立高维反射熵动力学的膜有效理论，并将其用于研究多分纠缠信号的时间演化，发现scrambling动力学产生结构丰富的多分纠缠。

English: Entanglement entropy (EE) is central to modern theoretical physics, yet its calculation in interacting theories with nontrivial time dependence remains challenging. In this thesis, we investigate the real-time dynamics of EE in strongly coupled quantum field theories (QFTs) using the Anti-de Sitter/Conformal Field Theory (AdS/CFT) correspondence. We first examine EE evolution in an exactly solvable two-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT) with an inhomogeneous sine-square deformation (SSD). We argue that the unconventional time evolution driven by the SSD Hamiltonian can be viewed as a change in spacetime foliation, producing new horizons in the dual three-dimensional bulk. Holographic EE calculations agree with CFT results in all comparable cases. We then study entanglement dynamics in generic chaotic quantum many-body systems. In the limit of late time and large regions, these dynamics are believed to admit an effective entanglement membrane description. In 2d CFTs, a degenerate membrane tension reproduces several entropy dynamics results, unlike the non-degenerate tension in higher dimensions. Using holography, we show that capturing reflected entropy in 2d CFT requires an additional degree of freedom in the membrane description. We further show that a conventional non-degenerate tension emerges when the CFT undergoes a relevant deformation, holographically dual to a planar Banados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black hole with scalar hair and an interior Kasner universe. We then develop a membrane effective theory for reflected entropy dynamics in higher dimensions. Finally, we apply the membrane theories for reflected entropy to study the time evolution of multipartite entanglement signals. We found that scrambling dynamics generate multipartite entanglement with rich structures.

来自全息的矩阵理论 II：超越计数

Matrix Theory from Holography II: Beyond Counting

Shota Komatsu, Eunwoo Lee, Chintan Patel · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：作为先前在 AdS/CFT 中实现 M 理论矩阵理论工作的扩展，本文提出并检验一种三重对偶：三维 N=4 ADHM 理论的大电荷扇区、BMN 矩阵模型，以及最大超对称 pp 波上的光锥紧致化 M 理论。在适当的三重标度极限下，ADHM 理论的超共形指标变为 BMN 模型的大正则指标，磁通扇区对应模糊球真空。本文进一步利用超对称局域化证明拓扑子扇区的关联函数也相匹配，包括其对 BMN 耦合的非平凡依赖；在每个磁通扇区中，局域化测度和算符插入都可与相应 BMN 真空精确匹配。结果还指向 ADHM 理论中的磁单极冒泡与 BMN 模型瞬子之间的更深联系：对于极小磁荷，ADHM 关联函数直接映到平凡 BMN 真空的拓扑关联函数；对于非极小荷，磁单极冒泡产生额外屏蔽扇区，其相对权重重现 BMN 瞬子的经典作用量。镜像对称提供另一视角，将磁单极算符映到镜像项链理论中 Higgs 分支的“绕转”算符。最后讨论 IIB 对应：四维 Z_K orbifold quiver 理论的大电荷扇区、pp 波上 IIB 弦论的 DLCQ，以及 R_t×T^2 上一级质量变形 ABJM 理论；初步检验显示 orbifold 理论的超共形指标重现质量变形 ABJM 理论的真空简并。

English: Extending our earlier realization of Matrix Theory for M-theory within AdS/CFT, we propose and test a new triality among a large-charge sector of three-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ ADHM theory, the BMN matrix model, and lightlike-compactified M-theory on the maximally supersymmetric pp-wave. In an appropriate triple-scaling limit, the superconformal index of ADHM theory becomes the grand-canonical index of the BMN model, with magnetic-flux sectors corresponding to fuzzy-sphere vacua. But the real interest of this new setup is that we can go beyond counting states. Using supersymmetric localization, we show that correlation functions in topological subsectors agree as well, including their nontrivial dependence on the BMN coupling. In each magnetic-flux sector, both the localization measure and the operator insertions can be matched precisely with those of the corresponding BMN vacuum. Our results also point to a deeper connection between monopole bubbling in ADHM theory and instantons in the BMN model. For minuscule monopole charges, ADHM correlators map directly to topological correlators in the trivial BMN vacuum. For non-minuscule charges, monopole bubbling produces additional screened sectors, whose relative weights reproduce the classical actions of BMN instantons. Mirror symmetry offers another perspective on this structure, mapping the monopole operators to Higgs-branch ``winding" operators in the mirror necklace theory. Finally, we discuss a type IIB counterpart, connecting a large-charge sector of four-dimensional $\mathbb Z_K$-orbifold quiver theories, the DLCQ of type IIB string theory on the pp-wave, and level-one mass-deformed ABJM theory on $\mathbb R_t\times T^2$. As a first test, we show that the superconformal index of the orbifold theory reproduces the vacuum degeneracy of the mass-deformed ABJM theory.

English: The field of gravitational-wave data analysis heavily relies on Bayes factors to make astrophysical statements about detected signals. This is true on an event level, for example when discussing the potential detection of orbital precession or eccentricity, as well as on a population level. For the latter, a main limiting factor is the growing bias resulting from accumulating per-event uncertainties related to stochastic sampling. In both cases, the computational cost of calculating Bayes factors severely limits the astrophysical usefulness of the results: Though Bayes factors robustly quantify the data's preference towards one model, one cannot generally determine how likely an equally large value is to arise under the null hypothesis. This paper applies evidence networks, amortized neural estimators which can infer Bayes factors after learning the distinguishability between two datasets, to the aforementioned problems. This makes it possible to construct empirical Bayes factor distributions under different signal assumptions, providing a calibration between observation and discovery significance. Using simulated Gaussian noise, we apply this method to a search for orbital precession in gravitational-wave data and achieve compatible results to current state-of-the-art approaches that require stochastic sampling. We further show that high precision of the achieved results leads to recovering injected isotropic-spin population fractions without discernible bias for populations of up to $10^4$ events on a simplified example. More generally, because the method does not require explicit likelihood evaluations, this lays a clear path towards a likelihood-free framework that does not rely on the assumption of Gaussian and stationary noise.

We compute the photon spheres, shadows, weak and strong lensing observables, and caustic structures for both models. We then compared the obtained values of the shadow diameters with the EHT data, using $\chi^2$ statistics. English: Universal relations among macroscopic properties of neutron stars provide a powerful framework to probe their internal structures while minimizing uncertainties associated with the equation of state (EoS). Although such relations have been extensively studied for uniformly rotating stars, their extension to differentially rotating and strongly magnetized configurations is relatively less explored. We systematically investigate equilibrium configurations for a wide range of EoSs, rotation profiles, and magnetic field strengths with XNS numerical simulation code. For sequences with fixed angular momentum, we analyze the dependence of normalized moment of inertia on compactness. We establish a generalized quasi-universal relation between the moment of inertia and compactness that remains remarkably insensitive to the underlying EoS across uniformly rotating, differentially rotating, and strongly magnetized toroidal configurations. For sequences with fixed angular momentum, the normalized moment of inertia exhibits a quasi-universal dependence on compactness, with deviations primarily due to magnetic field strength and degree of differential rotation. We derive analytic expressions for these dependencies, enabling a unified phenomenological model applicable over a wide range of stellar configurations. As astrophysical applications, we quantify the systematic bias in magnetar luminosity estimates and the rotational kinetic energy of post-merger remnant of GW170817. These results extend quasi-universal relations beyond the standard assumptions of uniform rotation and weak magnetization, providing a robust framework for interpreting observations of highly magnetized and differentially rotating neutron stars, and enabling more reliable constraints on their astrophysical properties.

中文摘要：星系中心是极其复杂的环境，主要由超大质量黑洞（SMBH）以及核星团（NSC）和分子气体等不对称质量分布组成，这些组分形成盘或晕。它们共同施加引力场，并与SMBH自旋的相对论修正相结合，产生强非线性动力学和混沌轨道。我们使用多极展开势对该区域建模，其中中心致密天体由 Artemova-Björnsson-Novikov 伪牛顿势表示，该势模拟类Kerr黑洞的自旋依赖。周围晕被建模为轴对称壳层状质量分布，并展开到偶极阶以引入不对称性。先前工作多用Poincaré截面、SALI等混沌指标量化BH自旋和偶极矩引起的混沌。本研究引入稳定性分析和Newton-Raphson收敛域，以提供系统动力学的全局图景。固定点附近的稳定性分析可更深入理解局部行为，而收敛域显示对初始条件的敏感性并揭示分形边界。结果表明BH自旋显著重塑平衡态景观；依其大小，它可增强晕不对称性引起的混沌，也可简化相空间。这些结果增进我们对相对论自旋效应和多极矩如何共同影响星系中心粒子运动的理解。

English: Galactic centres are extremely complex environments, consisting primarily of a supermassive black hole (SMBH) surrounded by asymmetric mass distributions such as nuclear star clusters (NSC) and molecular gas, which form disks or halos. Together these components exert a gravitational field which, combined with relativistic corrections from the spin of the SMBH, generates strongly nonlinear dynamics and chaotic orbits. We model this region using a multipolar expansion potential, in which the central compact object is represented by the Artemova-Bj\"ornsson-Novikov pseudo-Newtonian potential, which mimics the spin dependence of a Kerr-like BH. The surrounding halo is modelled as an axisymmetric, shell-like mass distribution expanded to dipole order to induce asymmetry. Previous works have mostly quantified the chaos caused by the BH spin and dipole moment using Poincar\'e sections, SALI and other chaos indicators. In this study, we incorporate stability analysis and Newton-Raphson basins of convergence to provide a global view of the dynamics of the system. Stability analysis around fixed points gives deeper insight into the local behaviour, while basins of convergence show sensitivity to initial conditions and reveal fractal boundaries. Our results show that the BH spin substantially reshapes the equilibrium landscape. Depending on its magnitude, it can either intensify the chaos induced by the halo asymmetry or simplify the phase space. These results improve our understanding of how relativistic spin effects and multipole moments collectively affect particle motion in galactic centres.

English: We present realistic eccentricity distributions for extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) forming via the two-body relaxation channel in nuclear star clusters, tracking their evolution up to the final plunge onto the central Schwarzschild massive black hole (MBH). We find that EMRIs can retain significant eccentricities at plunge, with a distribution peaking at $e_\mathrm{pl} \approx0.2$, and a considerable fraction reaching much higher values. In particular, up to $20\%$ of the forming EMRIs feature $e_\mathrm{pl} > 0.5$ for central MBH masses $M_\bullet$ in the range $10^5 \mathrm{M_\odot} \leq M_\bullet \leq 10^6 \mathrm{M_\odot}$, partially due to EMRIs forming at large semi-major axes and "cliffhanger EMRI", usually neglected in literature. This highlights the importance of accounting for eccentricity in waveform modeling and detection strategies for future space-based gravitational wave observatories such as the upcoming Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). Furthermore, we find that the numerical fluxes in energy and angular momentum currently implemented in the FastEMRIWaveforms (FEW) package may not adequately sample the full parameter space relevant to low-mass MBHs ($M_\bullet < 10^6 \mathrm{M_\odot}$), potentially limiting its predictive power in that regime. Specifically, for $M_\bullet=10^5 \mathrm{M_\odot}$ we find that about $75\%$ ($50 \%$) of EMRIs at 2 years (6 months) from plunge fall outside the currently available flux parameter space. Our findings motivate the development of extended flux grids and improved interpolation schemes to enable accurate modeling of EMRIs across a broader range of system parameters.

中文摘要：我们研究平面无质量标量波被一族高维正则黑洞散射；该族黑洞处于广义相对论耦合非线性电动力学中，并在任意维统一Bardeen和Hayward模型。标量场是中性测试场并在体时空中传播；在几何光学极限下，其光线为时空的零测地线，因此背景几何的不稳定圆零测地线控制散射。我们结合零测地线的经典散射、推广到D维的glory近似以及D=5,6,7的分波分析。结果表明，在固定频率下，波截面在前向按θ^{-4}发散（任意维），系数由质量确定；更陡的经典规律θ^{-(D-2)^{2}/(D-3)}只在较大角度和较高频率出现。电荷参数减小临界和glory碰撞参数并展宽glory条纹；在高维中，glory图样条纹更少更宽，后向强度更弱。对于本文匹配的构型，后向强度和低频吸收提供最清晰的差异，而中高频谱接近。

English: We study the scattering of planar massless scalar waves by the family of higher-dimensional regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics, which unifies the Bardeen and Hayward models in any dimension. The scalar field is a neutral test field that propagates in the bulk, and in the geometric-optics limit, its rays are the null geodesics of the spacetime, so that the unstable circular null geodesics of the background geometry control the scattering. We combine the classical scattering of null geodesics, the glory approximation, which we generalize to $D$ dimensions, and the partial-wave analysis in $D=5,6,7$. We show that at a fixed frequency, the wave cross section diverges in the forward direction as $\theta^{-4}$ in any dimension, with a coefficient fixed by the mass, while the steeper classical law $\theta^{-(D-2)^{2}/(D-3)}$ appears only at larger angles and higher frequencies. The charge parameter decreases the critical and the glory impact parameters and widens the glory fringes, and in higher dimensions, the glory pattern has fewer and wider fringes and a weaker backward intensity. For the matched configurations studied here, backward intensity and low-frequency absorption provide the clearest differences, while the intermediate-to-high-frequency spectra are close.

Moving beyond these idealized examples, we investigate a realistic acoustic source based on stochastic bubble nucleation and growth, proving that the connected contribution becomes subleading during subsequent linear acoustic propagation, although cosmic expansion limits this suppression. When Can Pulsar Timing Distinguish a Propagation Mass from a Weak Longitudinal Background?

Kun Zhou, Jin Li · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：弱纵向背景可以模仿引力波传播质量的角响应。本文利用NANOGrav 15年计时数据构造压缩高斯实验来量化这一歧义。在虚警概率10^{-3}下，若允许无质量背景中存在弱纵向分量，则在20脉冲星子阵列中对指定源的最优拒绝功率至少损失16.29个百分点；将阵列扩展到40颗脉冲星可在相同背景水平下至少恢复7.62个百分点。在另一个低背景实验中，作者在零质量和正质量下允许相同的连续纵向振幅范围；在该范围及三种注入背景水平下，一个检验能以至少97.38%的功率拒绝零质量，对应两个相差1.08%的质量之一；而将错误指派限制在另一质量处的10^{-3}时，识别任一质量的功率至多为1.584%。因此，截止频率可在其频率格内位置被分辨之前被识别。

English: A weak longitudinal background can imitate the angular response of a gravitational-wave propagation mass. We quantify this ambiguity in a compressed Gaussian experiment constructed from the NANOGrav 15-year timing data. At a false-alarm probability of $10^{-3}$, allowing a weak longitudinal component in a massless background costs at least 16.29 percentage points of optimal rejection power for a specified source in a 20-pulsar subarray. Expanding the array to 40 pulsars at the same background level recovers at least 7.62 points. In a separate low-background experiment, we allow the same continuous range of longitudinal amplitudes at zero and positive mass. Across that range and three injected background levels, one test rejects zero mass with at least 97.38\% power at either of two masses separated by 1.08\%. With false assignment limited to $10^{-3}$ at the other mass, the power to identify either mass is at most 1.584\%. A cutoff can thus be identifiable before its position within a frequency cell can be resolved.

一句话导读：该文量化了脉冲星计时数据中弱纵向背景对引力波传播质量识别的混淆，并给出区分所需功率与阵列规模条件。

Rational Orbits and Gravitational-Wave Signatures around a Horndeski Black Hole

Wei Gao, Xiaoyan Zhu, Wenbin Lin, Siming Liu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们研究具有次级标量毛、由有效压强参数 p_eff 表征的静态 Horndeski 黑洞的赤道面类时测地线及相关的引力波（GW）辐射。利用理性轨道分类 (z,w,v)，我们分析了最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）、边际束缚轨道（MBO）以及周期性束缚轨道。我们发现，增大 p_eff 会系统性地将轨道半径向外移动，并改变理性参数 q。在试验粒子近似和四极近似下，我们估计了光度距离 D_L=8000 pc 处极端质量比旋近（EMRI）系统的引力波信号。特征应变在 mHz 频段达到约 10^-18，部分重叠于 LISA 的标称灵敏度范围。这些结果表明，Horndeski 修正会系统性地改变强场轨道动力学和引力波谱，为偏离广义相对论的现象学探测提供了途径。

English: We study equatorial timelike geodesics and associated gravitational-wave (GW) emission for a static Horndeski black hole with secondary scalar hair, characterized by an effective pressure parameter $p_{\mathrm{eff}}$. Using the rational-orbit taxonomy $(z,w,v)$, we analyze the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), marginally bound orbit (MBO), and periodic bound orbits. We find that increasing $p_{\mathrm{eff}}$ systematically shifts orbital radii outward and modifies the rational parameter $q$. Within the test-particle and quadrupole approximations, we estimate GW signals from an extreme mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) system at a luminosity distance of $D_L=8000\,\mathrm{pc}$. The characteristic strains reach $\sim10^{-18}$ in the mHz band, partially overlapping the nominal LISA sensitivity range. These results demonstrate that Horndeski corrections systematically alter strong-field orbital dynamics and GW spectra, offering a phenomenological probe of deviations from general relativity.

谐和规范下广义相对论的代数表示

Algebraic representation of General Relativity in harmonic gauge

Jaume de Haro · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：提出谐和规范下广义相对论的自包含坐标-矩阵表述，在4×4实矩阵代数中给出无指标的引力场方程。通过定义升号/降号同构算子、度规伴随和矩阵值导数向量，将Ricci张量改写为以Laplace-Beltrami算子为主的代数矩阵结构；Einstein场方程自然成为度规矩阵的非线性波动方程，并给出引力能量-动量赝张量的无指标矩阵表示。文章导出该赝张量与经典Landau-Lifshitz能量-动量复形的显式代数关系，并将局域守恒律写成矩阵散度形式。最后通过弱场线性化引力、谐和时间下Friedmann宇宙学动力学的精确推导，以及Newton规范和谐和规范下线性标量宇宙学扰动的完整表述，说明该矩阵形式的应用范围。

English: We present a self-contained coordinate-matrix formulation of General Relativity in the harmonic gauge, providing a compact, index-free representation of the gravitational field equations within the algebra of $4\times 4$ real matrices $M_4$. By defining musical isomorphism operators ($\sharp, \flat$), metric adjoints ($\dagger$), and matrix-valued derivative vectors ($\bm{\mathcal{B}}, \bm{\mathcal{C}}, \bm{\mathcal{D}}^\sharp$), the Ricci tensor is recast into an algebraic matrix structure dominated by the Laplace--Beltrami operator $\Box_{\mathrm{LB}} \coloneqq \operatorname{tr}(\mathcal{G}^\sharp \partial^2)$, where $\partial^2 \coloneqq \bm{\partial}\bm{\partial}^T$ represents the matrix Hessian operator of second partial derivatives. Within this setting, Einstein's field equations naturally take the form of a non-linear wave equation for the metric matrix $\mathcal{G}$, giving rise to an index-free matrix representation of the gravitational energy-momentum pseudotensor $\bar{\mathcal{T}}$. We derive the explicit algebraic relation connecting $\bar{\mathcal{T}}$ with the classical Landau--Lifshitz energy-momentum complex $\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{LL}}$, and express the associated local conservation law in a simple matrix divergence form, $\bm{\partial}^T \left((-g)(\mathcal{T}^{\sharp} + \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{LL}}^{\sharp})\right) = \bm{0}^T$. Finally, we illustrate the scope and applicability of the matrix formalism through three physical applications: weak-field linearized gravity, the exact derivation of Friedmann cosmological dynamics in harmonic time, and the complete formulation of linear scalar cosmological perturbations in both the Newtonian and harmonic gauges.

一句话导读：用4×4矩阵代数在谐和规范下重写广义相对论场方程，并应用于弱场与宇宙学扰动。

对称远平行引力及其扩展的动力学与宇宙学视角

Dynamical and Cosmological Perspectives on Symmetric Teleparallel Gravity and its Extensions

Pooja Vishwakarma · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：本论文研究修改引力理论中宇宙晚期加速膨胀问题，重点讨论对称远平行引力及其扩展，包括 f(Q)、f(Q,B) 和 f(Q,φ) 引力。论文采用动力学系统分析、稳定性技术和 Noether 对称性方法，考察宇宙学临界点的存在性与稳定性、背景演化以及线性宇宙学扰动，以理解宇宙演化的不同阶段。研究还评估观测约束和大爆炸核合成在判断修改引力模型可行性中的作用。Noether 对称性的应用为识别可行的函数形式和推导精确宇宙学解提供了系统方法。总体而言，论文考察了修改远平行引力作为描述观测到的宇宙加速膨胀的替代框架的理论与宇宙学可行性。

English: This thesis investigates the late-time accelerated expansion of the Universe within modified gravity theories, with particular emphasis on symmetric teleparallel gravity and its extensions, including $f(Q)$, $f(Q, B)$, and $f(Q, \phi)$ gravity. It explores the cosmological dynamics of these theories using dynamical systems analysis, stability techniques, and the Noether symmetry approach. The study examines the existence and stability of cosmological critical points, background evolution, and linear cosmological perturbations to understand the different phases of cosmic evolution. It also investigates the role of observational constraints and Big Bang nucleosynthesis in assessing the viability of modified gravity models. Furthermore, the application of Noether symmetries provides a systematic approach to identifying viable functional forms and deriving exact cosmological solutions. Overall, this thesis examines the theoretical and cosmological viability of modified teleparallel gravity as an alternative framework for describing the observed accelerated expansion of the Universe.

一句话导读：该论文用动力学系统、稳定性分析和 Noether 对称性研究 f(Q) 等对称远平行修改引力模型的晚期加速膨胀及宇宙学可行性。

通过完全扰动连接条件研究薄壳虫洞、de Sitter 引力星和 Anti-de Sitter 引力星的潮汐 Love 数

Tidal Love Numbers of Thin-Shell Wormholes, de Sitter Gravastars, and Anti-de Sitter Gravastars via Full Perturbed Junction Conditions

Gerui Chen, Yu Tian, Hongbao Zhang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：本文利用最近导出的完整扰动连接条件，重新研究若干类奇异致密天体的潮汐 Love 数。作者考察四个代表性薄壳模型：虫洞、零表面能密度的 de Sitter 引力星、一般 de Sitter 引力星以及 Anti-de Sitter 引力星。此前基于简化匹配条件的研究曾提出，超致密奇异天体的 TLNs 在黑洞极限下对数消失，并猜测这种对数依赖是普适特征。本文表明，在施加完整扰动连接条件后，该对数行为并不普适：所有模型的奇宇称 TLNs 在黑洞极限下呈多项式标度，而偶宇称部分则依模型同时出现对数和多项式行为；TLNs 的符号也可能与先前结果定性不同。结果表明 ECOs 的潮汐响应强烈受扰动匹配条件影响，先前猜测的普适对数标度并不可取。

English: In this work, we revisit the tidal Love numbers (TLNs) of several classes of exotic compact objects (ECOs) using the recently derived full perturbed junction conditions. We investigate four representative thin-shell models: wormholes, de Sitter gravastars with zero surface energy density, general de Sitter gravastars, and anti-de Sitter gravastars. Previous studies of wormholes and de Sitter gravastars with zero surface energy density, based on simplified matching conditions, suggested that the TLNs of ultracompact ECOs vanish logarithmically in the black-hole (BH) limit, leading to the conjecture that this logarithmic dependence is a generic feature of ultracompact exotic objects. We show that this logarithmic behavior is not universal once the full perturbed junction conditions are imposed. In particular, the odd-parity TLNs exhibit polynomial scaling in the BH limit for all the models considered, while the even-parity sector displays both logarithmic and polynomial behaviors depending on the model. We also find that the signs of the TLNs can differ qualitatively from previous results, especially in the odd-parity sector. Our results demonstrate that the tidal response of ECOs is strongly affected by the perturbed matching conditions and that the previously conjectured universal logarithmic scaling near the BH limit is not generic.

一句话导读：完整扰动连接条件表明，薄壳虫洞与 dS/AdS 引力星的潮汐 Love 数在黑洞极限下并非普适对数标度。

校准至数值相对论的前旋双黑洞并合波形 Transformer 模型

A Transformer model for precessing binary black-hole merger waveforms calibrated to numerical relativity

Jameson Dong · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们提出一个 Transformer 模型，用于前旋双黑洞以并合为中心产生的引力波波形。给定质量比和两个三维自旋矢量，该网络预测在 $[-1100,80]M$（$M$ 为双星总质量）上直到 $\ell=4$ 的全部 21 个带符号自旋加权球谐应变模式的三次 B 样条系数，并施加双星交换和赤道反射等变性，从而给出时间上 $C^4$ 的波形并支持精确自动微分。该模型先在来自 SXS 和 RIT 目录的数值相对论波形以及合成的 NRSur7dq4、SEOBNRv5PHM 和微扰波形上预训练，并在 SXS 应变数据上微调。在 176 个留出的 SXS 波形（165 个物理系统）上，它达到平均平衡均方根应变误差 0.023，以及在 $120\,M_\odot$ 下平均探测器失配 0.059%。

English: We present a Transformer model for merger-centered gravitational waveforms from precessing binary black holes. Given the mass ratio and two three-dimensional spin vectors, the network predicts quintic B-spline coefficients for all 21 signed spin-weighted spherical-harmonic strain modes through $\ell=4$ on $[-1100,80]M$ ($M$ being the total binary mass), enforcing binary-exchange and equatorial-reflection equivariance and yielding $C^4$ waveforms in time with exact automatic differentiation. The model is pretrained on numerical-relativity (NR) waveforms from the SXS and RIT catalogues together with synthetic NRSur7dq4, SEOBNRv5PHM, and perturbative waveforms, and fine-tuned on SXS strain data. On 176 held-out SXS waveforms (165 physical systems), it achieves a mean balanced root-mean-square strain error of $0.023$ and a mean detector mismatch at $120\,M_\odot$ of $0.059\%$.

一句话导读：提出并校准一个 Transformer 波形代理模型，用于前旋双黑洞并合引力波，在留出 SXS 数据上取得低应变误差和探测器失配。

非对易Kazakov-Solodukhin引力真空星

Noncommutative Kazakov-Solodukhin Gravastar

A. T. N. Silva, M. A. Anacleto, Ali \"Ovg\"un, L. Casarini · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：我们构建了一个薄壳引力真空星，内部为de Sitter，外部为现象学度规，结合Lorentzian非对易启发质量分布与未展开的Kazakov--Solodukhin形变。在有效Einstein描述下，推导表面应力，评估壳层能量条件，并用单一外部度规计算透明壳层测地线。相关含视界族满足径向压强热力学恒等式与面积熵。对于该引力真空星，前三个穿透可见性边界随KS尺度增大向内移动，而外部光子轨道和临界碰撞参数向外移动。有限观测者背光计算重现Schwarzschild--de Sitter基准，并追踪当壳层越过光子轨道时可见性边界的合并。我们还计算了正面、光学薄发射层的红移加权强度。核心透射后的额外盘穿越产生内像结构，其亮度依赖径向发射轮廓。在领头逆半径阶，两个形变尺度通过一个系数进入，产生精确几何参数简并。我们证明下一逆半径项打破该简并：临界碰撞参数和对数强偏折系数提供两个尺度的独立局域信息。对等领头系数参数对的全度规计算分辨此分裂并量化高阶展开精度。

English: We construct a thin-shell gravastar with a de Sitter interior and a phenomenological exterior combining a Lorentzian noncommutative-inspired mass distribution with the unexpanded Kazakov--Solodukhin deformation. Within an effective Einstein description, we derive the surface stresses, evaluate the shell energy conditions, and compute transparent-shell geodesics using a single exterior metric. The associated horizon-bearing family satisfies a radial-pressure thermodynamic identity with area entropy. For the gravastar, the first three penetrating visibility boundaries move inward with increasing KS scale, while the exterior photon orbit and critical impact parameter move outward. A finite-observer backlighting calculation reproduces the Schwarzschild--de Sitter benchmark and tracks the merger of visibility boundaries as the shell moves beyond the photon orbit. We also compute the redshift-weighted intensity of a face-on, optically thin emitting layer. Additional disk crossings after core transmission produce inner image structure whose brightness depends on the radial emission profile. At leading inverse-radius order, both deformation scales enter through one coefficient, producing an exact geometric parameter degeneracy. We show that the next inverse-radius term breaks this degeneracy: the critical impact parameter and logarithmic strong-deflection coefficient provide independent local information about the two scales. Full-metric calculations for equal-leading-coefficient parameter pairs resolve this splitting and quantify the accuracy of the higher-order expansion.

一句话导读：构建非对易KS薄壳引力真空星并研究其热力学、光子轨道、强偏折与参数简并。

在Goldilocks先验下对GW170817和GW190425的再分析

Reanalysis of GW170817 and GW190425 under the Goldilocks Prior

Sanika Khadkikar, B. S. Sathyaprakash · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：双中子星并合的引力波编码了宇宙中密度最高物质的性质，但要准确提取这些性质，需要控制推断框架引入的偏差。新近发展的Goldilocks先验纳入了大量候选物态方程所预言的关联，并依据预期探测器灵敏度将这些关联展宽。我们将该框架应用于GW170817和GW190425，发现推断出的组分潮汐形变与标准分析存在显著差异。对于GW170817，我们推断两颗中子星都比此前报道的更易发生潮汐形变，其中较轻星体最概然值相对于均匀先验分析从Λ2≃215增至Λ2≃443，接近翻倍。对于GW190425，Goldilocks先验大幅缩小了允许的潮汐形变范围。我们通过两种互补的分层方法将得到的事件似然传播到致密物质物态方程：强参数化的谱表示和更广泛的半参数高斯过程集合。对于GW170817，尽管对单个中子星性质的推断存在显著差异，两种先验处理仍给出相容的物态方程约束。然而对于GW190425，即使去除源层面先验后，物态方程约束的差异仍超出数值散布，表明先验选择会影响低信噪比事件的似然恢复。由于GW170817在推断中占主导，联合物态方程约束总体仍基本不变。

English: Gravitational waves from binary neutron star mergers encode the properties of the densest matter in the universe, but recovering them accurately requires controlling biases introduced by the inference framework. The recently developed Goldilocks Prior incorporates correlations predicted by a large ensemble of candidate equations of state and broadens them according to the expected detector sensitivity. We apply this framework to GW170817 and GW190425 and find that the inferred component tidal deformabilities differ substantially from standard analyses. For GW170817, we infer both neutron stars to be more tidally deformable than previously reported, with the most probable value for the lighter star nearly doubling from $\Lambda_2\simeq215$ to $\Lambda_2\simeq443$ relative to the uniform-prior analysis. For GW190425, the Goldilocks Prior considerably reduces the range of allowed tidal deformabilities. We propagate the resulting event likelihoods to the dense matter equation of state using two complementary hierarchical methods, a strongly parametrized spectral representation and a broader semi-parametric Gaussian-process ensemble. For GW170817, both prior treatments yield consistent EoS constraints despite substantial differences in the inferred properties of the individual neutron stars. For GW190425, however, the EoS constraints differ beyond numerical scatter even after removing the source-level priors, showing that prior choice affects likelihood recovery for low-SNR events. The joint EoS constraints nevertheless remain largely unchanged because GW170817 dominates the inference.

一句话导读：采用Goldilocks先验重新分析GW170817与GW190425，发现潮汐形变推断显著变化，但联合物态方程约束主要由GW170817主导。

The Goldilocks Prior: Physically Consistent Inference of Neutron Star Properties from Gravitational Wave Observations

Sanika Khadkikar, B. S. Sathyaprakash · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：中子星并合的引力波观测为了解中子星内部提供了独特窗口，可探测从微观核相互作用到宏观结构（包括最大质量，超过该质量后遗迹坍缩为黑洞）的致密物质。准确推断这些性质至关重要，因为许多天体物理、核物理和多信使研究依赖引力波约束。从引力波估计中子星性质的研究常采用忽略参数间关联、或不一致处理潮汐自由度的先验，导致推断的中子星性质出现偏差。我们提出一种新的物理信息先验——Goldilocks Prior，它由广泛半参数状态方程集合提供信息，考虑啁啾质量、质量比和两个潮汐形变参数之间的联合关联，并针对探测器灵敏度定制。使用涵盖对称与非对称质量、自旋与非自旋系统以及一系列信噪比的若干模拟双中子星并合，我们表明相对于均匀先验和先前提出的EoS信息先验，Goldilocks Prior一致地减小推断潮汐后验中的偏差。该框架为中子星参数估计提供了稳健、系统的方法，使当前和未来引力波观测的推断更可靠。

English: Gravitational wave observations of neutron star mergers provide a unique window into the interiors of neutron stars, probing dense matter from microscopic nuclear interactions to the macroscopic structure, including their maximum mass, beyond which the remnant collapses to a black hole. Accurate inference of these properties is crucial, as many astrophysical, nuclear, and multimessenger studies rely on gravitational wave constraints. Studies on estimating neutron-star properties from gravitational waves often employ priors that neglect correlations between parameters, or treat tidal degrees of freedom inconsistently, leading to biases in inferred neutron-star properties. We introduce a novel physically informed prior, Goldilocks Prior, that is informed by a broad, semi-parametric ensemble of equations of state, accounts for the joint correlations among the chirp mass, mass ratio, and both tidal deformability parameters, and is tailored to detector sensitivity. Using several mock binary neutron star merger simulations spanning symmetric and asymmetric masses, spinning and non-spinning systems, and a range of signal-to-noise ratios, we show that Goldilocks Prior consistently reduces biases in the inferred tidal posteriors relative to uniform and previously proposed EoS-informed priors. This framework provides a robust, systematic approach for neutron star parameter estimation, enabling more reliable inference for both current and future gravitational wave observations.

一句话导读：提出一种由状态方程集合信息驱动、考虑参数关联的Goldilocks先验，用于减少中子星并合引力波参数推断中的潮汐偏差。

用轨道频率检验 Kerr 假设：来自类空奇点与黑洞反弹的启示

Testing the Kerr hypothesis with orbital frequencies: lessons from spacelike singularities and black bounces

Hooman Neshat, Stefano Liberati · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：静止黑洞的内视界存在经典与半经典不稳定性，暗示 Kerr 内部应被修改。量子反作用可能把曲率推至普朗克尺度并形成类空奇点，也可能在较低曲率处停止增长而得到规则黑洞反弹。本文分别用带类空奇点的 Gürses–Gürsey 几何和旋转 Simpson–Visser 黑洞反弹研究这两种可能性的现象学。两种几何都可通过校准或恒等匹配复现具有相同 ADM 质量和角动量的 Kerr 黑洞的光环与 ISCO 频率。作者发现，在视界外，零向与类时收敛条件被违反：Gürses–Gürsey 几何中违反区域延伸至光环外有限半径，而旋转 Simpson–Visser 时空中则处处违反。此外，二者的基本标量准正规模偏离 Kerr，最明显在阻尼：Gürses–Gürsey 几何中阻尼增强，旋转 Simpson–Visser 中阻尼减弱。因此，在有限观测量集合上与 Kerr 一致不足以确立致密天体的 Kerr 性质，需要互补的观测检验。

English: The inner horizon of stationary black holes is subject to classical and semiclassical instabilities, suggesting that the Kerr interior should be modified. Quantum backreaction may drive the curvature to the Planck scale, producing a spacelike singularity, or halt its growth at lower curvatures, leading to a regular black bounce. We investigate the phenomenology of these two possibilities using, respectively, a G\"urses--G\"ursey geometry with a spacelike singularity and the rotating Simpson--Visser black bounce. Both geometries reproduce the light ring and ISCO frequencies of a Kerr black hole with the same ADM mass and angular momentum, by calibration in the first case and identically in the second. We find that the null and timelike convergence conditions are violated outside the horizon, up to a finite radius beyond the light ring in the G\"urses--G\"ursey geometry and everywhere in the rotating Simpson--Visser spacetime. Moreover, their fundamental scalar quasinormal modes deviate from those of Kerr, most markedly in the damping, which is enhanced in the G\"urses--G\"ursey geometry and reduced in the rotating Simpson--Visser one. Thus, agreement with Kerr in a limited set of observables is not sufficient to establish the Kerr nature of a compact object, motivating complementary observational tests.

一句话导读：比较带类空奇点的 Gürses–Gürsey 几何与旋转 Simpson–Visser 黑洞反弹在光环/ISCO 频率和标量 QNM 上与 Kerr 的异同，说明有限观测量符合 Kerr 不足以确认其 Kerr 本质。

引力波推断中校准不确定性的解析边缘化及其在黑洞铃宕中的应用

Analytic Marginalization Over Calibration Uncertainties in Gravitational Wave Inference and Application to Black Hole Ringdown

David Dzingeleski, Aaron Zimmerman · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-11-06

中文摘要：引力波探测器校准的不确定性是引力波推断中的系统误差来源之一。本文用时域基样条把标准的频域校准边缘化方法推广到时域，并使边缘化可解析进行。作者将该方法用于黑洞铃宕的时域分析，特别是目前信噪比最高的两个事件 GW250114 和 GW250207。对 GW250114，在边缘化事件时刻的小校准不确定性后，仍发现双铃宕模式的强证据。对 GW250207，LIGO-Hanford 的校准不确定，需做校准边缘化才能联合两台 LIGO 探测器做相干分析；纳入校准效应后，铃宕阶段推断的残余质量与自旋同全信号推断一致。尽管 GW250207 信噪比很高，未发现第二模式的证据，因此铃宕阶段对相对论偏离的约束并不强。

English: The uncertain calibration of gravitational wave detectors is one source of systematic error in gravitational wave inference. While generally small, this uncertainty can be accounted for by modeling and marginalizing over calibration corrections. In this work we extend the standard frequency-domain approach to calibration marginalization to the time domain using basis splines, in such a way that the marginalization is analytic. We apply this method to the time-domain analysis of black hole ringdown, in particular the two highest signal-to-noise events detected so far, GW250114 and GW250207. For GW250114 we continue to find strong evidence for two ringdown modes, after marginalizing over the small calibration uncertainty at the time of the event. For GW250207, the calibration of the LIGO-Hanford detector was uncertain, and calibration marginalization is required for a coherent analysis using both LIGO detectors. We find that when calibration effects are included the remnant mass and spins inferred during ringdown agree with inferences from the full signal. Despite the high signal-to-noise of GW250207, we find no evidence for the presence of a second mode in the ringdown, and as a result deviations from relativity during ringdown are not well constrained.

一句话导读：将时域B样条校准修正的解析边缘化用于黑洞铃宕分析，并应用于GW250114和GW250207。

旋转使矢量化黑洞过充电

Rotation overcharges vectorized black holes

Shengjun Guo, Guangzai Ye, Peng Liu · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：带电黑洞存在上限：极值性限制了给定质量和自旋所能支撑的电荷。此前矢量化毛发只会降低这一上限。在 Einstein--Maxwell--Vector (EMV) 模型中，无质量矢量场非最小耦合到电磁不变量，球对称的矢量化 Reissner--Nordström 黑洞严格欠充电：矢量毛发以电荷为代价。该上限是矢量场的性质还是仅由球对称造成仍未知，因为球对称也隐藏了毛发的质量：其 Komar 质量恒为零，精确关系 M_V=2Ω_H J_V 退化为 0=0。旋转同时解除这两个退化。我们构造该模型的旋转解（此设定下首次），发现毛发质量不是自由参数，而是旋转响应的二阶不变量，由 M_V=2Ω_H J_V 固定。在耦合阈值以上，上限被突破：存在域越过极端 Kerr--Newman 界限，达到 q=Q/M>1，q^2+χ^2 最高 1.84，而在 α=5 时最大电荷仍低于该界限。阴影是毛发显现之处。在 (q,χ)=(0.9947,0.10) 接近极值界限时，毛发贡献 8.30% 的椭率，而电荷贡献 0.44%、旋转贡献 0.06%——19 倍，充电 Kerr 黑洞无法模仿；在过充电解 (q,χ)=(1.2527,0.10) 总椭率达 25.6%。该支是否无鬼仍开放，但现有 no-go 判据不能定论：它们假设的背景和色散关系在此不成立。

English: A charged black hole has a ceiling: extremality bounds the charge that a given mass and spin can support. Vector hair has so far only lowered it. In the Einstein--Maxwell--Vector (EMV) model, where a massless vector field couples nonminimally to the electromagnetic invariant, the spherically symmetric vectorized Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes are strictly undercharged: vector hair is paid for in charge. Whether this ceiling is a property of the vector field or merely of spherical symmetry has remained open, because spherical symmetry hides the hair's mass as well: its Komar mass vanishes identically and the exact identity $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$ degenerates to $0=0$. Rotation lifts both degeneracies at once. We construct the rotating solutions of the model, the first in this setting, and find that the hair's mass is not a free parameter but a second-order invariant of the rotational response, fixed by $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$. Above a coupling threshold the ceiling gives way: the domain of existence crosses the extremal Kerr--Newman bound, reaching $q=Q/M>1$ with $q^2+\chi^2$ up to $1.84$, while at $\alpha=5$ the maximum charge stays below it. The shadow is where the hair becomes visible. At $(q,\chi)=(0.9947,0.10)$, near the extremal bound, the hair contributes an ellipticity of $8.30\%$, against $0.44\%$ from the charge and $0.06\%$ from rotation --- a factor of $19$ that charging a Kerr black hole cannot mimic; at the overcharged solution $(q,\chi)=(1.2527,0.10)$ the total ellipticity reaches $25.6\%$. Whether the branch is ghost-free remains open, but the existing no-go criteria do not settle it: they assume a background and a dispersion relation that do not hold here.

一句话导读：构造 EMV 模型的旋转矢量化黑洞解，发现旋转可解除球对称退化并使黑洞越过 Kerr-Newman 极值界限，毛发在阴影椭率中显著显现。

黑洞的灰体因子

Grey-body factors of black holes

Roman Konoplya, Alexander Zhidenko · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：灰体因子描述场通过黑洞或其他致密天体产生的有效势时的频率相关透射。它们把 Hawking 辐射的理想热谱转换为观测者测得的谱，决定吸收与散射截面，并提供与准正模互补的实频观测量。本综述对黑洞物理及相关系统中的灰体因子给出统一阐述：我们建立渐近平直、de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 时空中的散射问题，讨论透射系数、吸收截面、Hawking 辐射与 ringdown 之间的联系；回顾计算方法并综述近期进展，包括灰体因子与准正模的对应、有效势形变下的稳定性、虫洞透射与超辐射，以及修改引力理论中的行为。最后，我们讨论灰体因子在规范/引力对偶中的出现，其中体中的吸收概率与边界理论中的关联函数和输运系数相关。

English: Grey-body factors describe the frequency-dependent transmission of fields through the effective potential generated by a black hole or another compact object. They convert the idealized thermal spectrum of Hawking radiation into the spectrum measured by an observer, determine absorption and scattering cross sections, and provide real-frequency observables complementary to quasinormal modes. In this review, we present a unified account of grey-body factors in black-hole physics and related systems. We formulate the scattering problem for asymptotically flat, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter spacetimes, and discuss the connections between transmission coefficients, absorption cross sections, Hawking radiation, and ringdown. We also review methods for their computation and survey recent developments, including the correspondence between grey-body factors and quasinormal modes, their stability under deformations of the effective potential, wormhole transmission and superradiance, and their behavior in modified theories of gravity. Finally, we discuss the appearance of grey-body factors in gauge/gravity duality, where absorption probabilities in the bulk are related to correlation functions and transport coefficients in the boundary theory.

一句话导读：综述黑洞灰体因子：散射与吸收、Hawking 谱、与 QNM 的联系，以及在规范/引力对偶中的出现。

宇宙学可行的非多项式准拓扑引力：显式模型、ΛCDM 极限与观测约束

Cosmologically viable non-polynomial quasi-topological gravity: explicit models, $\Lambda$CDM limit and observational constraints

Emmanuel N. Saridakis · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们研究非多项式准拓扑引力（NPQTG）中一个现象学相关子类的宇宙学含义，其中背景动力学由哈勃参数的单一函数编码。该框架提供了广义相对论的一个最小且理论自洽的扩展，纳入高阶曲率效应，同时保持场方程为二阶并避免高阶导数不稳定性。我们首先建立宇宙学可行性的普遍条件并构造显式实现，包括多项式、四次、幂律和非多项式模型，展示不同函数形式如何导致不同的膨胀历史。聚焦四次和幂律情形，我们研究其晚期宇宙演化，表明它们具有物质主导时期随后暗能量主导时期，并产生几何起源的有效暗能量部分，其状态方程具有可处于 quintessence 或 phantom 区域的动力学行为。随后我们用 Ia 型超新星、宇宙钟和重子声学振荡的观测数据，通过贝叶斯 MCMC 分析检验这些模型。我们发现两个模型与所考虑数据完全兼容，并以与 ΛCDM 相当的拟合质量重现晚期膨胀历史，尽管当前观测并未给出偏离 concordance 情景的统计显著证据。结果表明，NPQTG 为描述具有动力学暗能量的晚期宇宙加速提供了一个简单有效的框架，同时保持理论自洽性和观测可行性。

English: We investigate the cosmological implications of a phenomenologically relevant subclass of non-polynomial quasi-topological gravity (NPQTG), in which the background dynamics is encoded in a single function of the Hubble parameter. This framework provides a minimal and theoretically consistent extension of general relativity, incorporating higher-curvature effects while preserving second-order field equations and avoiding higher-derivative instabilities. We first establish the general conditions for cosmological viability and construct explicit realizations, including polynomial, quartic, power-law and non-polynomial models, demonstrating how different functional forms lead to distinct expansion histories. Focusing on the quartic and power-law cases, we investigate their late-time cosmological evolution, showing that they exhibit a matter-dominated epoch followed by a dark-energy-dominated epoch, and give rise to an effective dark-energy sector of geometric origin, with dynamical equation-of-state behavior that can lie in the quintessence or phantom regime. We then confront the models with observational data from Type Ia Supernovae, Cosmic Chronometers, and Baryon Acoustic Oscillations, using a Bayesian MCMC analysis. We find that both models are fully compatible with the considered data and reproduce the late-time expansion history with a quality of fit comparable to that of $\Lambda$CDM, although the current observations do not provide statistically significant evidence for a departure from the concordance scenario. Our results demonstrate that NPQTG offers a simple and efficient framework for describing late-time cosmic acceleration with dynamical dark energy, while maintaining theoretical consistency and observational viability.

一句话导读：研究非多项式准拓扑引力的宇宙学可行模型，并用超新星、宇宙钟和 BAO 数据约束其晚期加速膨胀。

利用脉冲星计时数据四极矩相关性估计引力波到达方向

Direction-of-arrival estimation of a gravitational wave by correlations between quadrupole moments of pulsar timing data

Taichi Ueyama, Hodaka Tamura, Hideki Asada · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：本文研究能否从脉冲星计时阵列观测中估计引力波信号的到达方向。作者针对由主导孤立源（如超大质量黑洞双星）产生的引力波，在各项同性随机背景之上，考虑脉冲星计时数据的四极矩，并讨论四极矩之间的相关性作为匹配滤波技术的可能替代方案，其中考虑了全天脉冲星对之间的相关性。这些相关性表现为一个秩为3的三维无迹矩阵，可与引力波的投影张量紧密联系。作者据此证明，该秩3矩阵无需模板库或先验高斯噪声假设即可估计引力波到达方向。文中采用天球平均代替脉冲星平均，并使用Voronoi镶嵌对天空非均匀脉冲星分布做面积加权平均。鉴于未来平方公里阵列的预期，文章还考察了到达方向估计误差。

English: Can we estimate the direction of arrival (DOA) of a gravitational wave (GW) signal from pulsar timing array observations? The present paper addresses the inverse problem, for which we consider quadrupole moments of pulsar timing data due to GWs from a dominant isolated source such as a binary of supermassive black holes over an isotropic stochastic background. Correlations between the quadrupole moments are discussed as a possible alternative to the matched filtering technique, where the correlations between pulsar pairs over the full sky are taken into account. The correlations turn out to be in the form of a three-dimensional traceless matrix with rank 3 that can be closely related with a projection tensor for the GW. Thereby, we demonstrate that the rank-3 matrix allows to estimate the DOA of the GW without assuming a template bank nor a priori Gaussian noise. A mean over the celestial sphere is adopted instead of the pulsar averaging. A weighted average is used for a non-uniform distribution of pulsars on the sky, for which the Voronoi tessellation is employed to numerically calculate an area-weighted mean. In expectation of the forthcoming Square Kilometre Array, DOA estimation errors are also examined.

一句话导读：提出用脉冲星计时数据四极矩相关性估计引力波到达方向的无模板方法。

利用扰乱动力学的双向隐形传态：一种实用协议

Bidirectional teleportation using scrambling dynamics: a practical protocol

Amit Vikram, Edwin Chaparro, Muhammad Miskeen Khan, Andrew Lucas, Chris Akers, Ana Maria Rey · quant-ph, cond-mat.stat-mech, hep-th, nlin.CD, physics.atom-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们证明，量子信息扰乱能够使系统在缺乏通用局域控制的情况下，于集体自由度之间实现通用 SWAP 门。我们的协议将一种与黑洞信息悖论相关的 Hayden-Preskill 型恢复方案与量子隐形传态结合，并让二者平行且反向运行，从而仅通过全局相互作用实现量子态的双向交换。该方法清晰区分了信息扩散、纠缠和混沌在实现相干态传输与恢复中的作用。我们提出利用 Dicke 模型进行实验实现，该模型可在光学腔和囚禁离子平台中实现，突显了全息术在设计实用量子门方面的效用。

English: We show that quantum information scrambling can enable a generic SWAP gate between collective degrees of freedom in systems without universal local control. Our protocol combines a Hayden-Preskill type recovery scheme, associated with the black hole information paradox, with quantum teleportation and runs them in parallel and in opposite directions, enabling bidirectional exchange of quantum states through global interactions alone. This approach cleanly distinguishes the roles of information spreading, entanglement, and chaos for enabling both coherent state transfer and recovery. We propose an experimental realization using the Dicke model, which can be realized in optical cavity and trapped-ion platforms, highlighting the utility of holography in designing practical quantum gates.

We further address the issue of the branch cut singularity of the quasi-local energy and propose a UV completion of the model in which the Brown-York charge is extended beyond the black hole horizon. English: The Lanczos recursion maps operator growth onto the motion of a wave function on a semi-infinite chain, and for linearly growing Lanczos coefficients the deep region of the chain behaves like the near-horizon region of a black hole. We develop this correspondence in the time domain and determine how far it extends. For $b_n\simeq\alpha n$ the Krylov evolution is chiral transport in $\ln n$, which coincides with infalling waves near the horizon of an AdS$_2$ black hole when the Krylov depth is identified with the blueshift of an infalling particle; this fixes $\alpha=\pi T$, while staggered configurations of the chain carry the outgoing chirality. Smooth subleading Lanczos data therefore cannot encode the bulk mass locally. The obstruction persists for the BTZ black hole, for which we obtain the Lanczos coefficients in closed form.

Pablo Bueno, Robie A. Hennigar, Matteo G. Marrone, \'Angel J. Murcia · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们研究涉及无限塔多项式密度的准拓扑引力理论及其正则真空黑洞解的一般性质。我们证明，每个正质量正则真空解必然具有 de Sitter 核心，而 Minkowski 与 anti-de Sitter 核心被排除。关于视界结构，我们证明渐近平直和渐近 anti-de Sitter 正则黑洞总存在极端构型。我们发现视界数量没有上限，且可出现任意高简并度的视界。这些结果可推广到球对称背景上具有二阶方程的更一般引力理论。最后，我们刻画允许正则黑洞的准拓扑理论空间，证明其可缩（特别地道路连通且单连通），且正则性在高阶耦合的适当小变形下稳定。在 Spanier 意义下，该空间自然是一个可缩的准拓扑空间。此外，我们证明任何由任意高但有限曲率阶耦合定义的理论都可补全为产生正则黑洞解的理论，同时保持相同低阶耦合。这些结果表明正则解出现在广泛准拓扑引力中，不要求耦合精细调节。

English: We investigate general properties of quasi-topological theories of gravity involving infinite towers of polynomial densities and of their regular vacuum black hole solutions. We show that every positive-mass regular vacuum solution necessarily possesses a de Sitter core, while Minkowski and anti-de Sitter cores are excluded. Regarding the horizon structure, we prove that asymptotically flat and anti-de Sitter regular black holes always admit extremal configurations. We find that there is no upper bound on the number of horizons and that horizons of arbitrarily high degeneracy can arise. These results extend to more general theories of gravity with second-order equations on spherically symmetric backgrounds. Finally, we characterize the space of quasi-topological theories admitting regular black holes, showing that it is contractible (in particular, path-connected and simply connected) and that regularity is stable under suitably small deformations of the higher-order couplings. In the sense of Spanier, this space is naturally a contractible \emph{quasi-topological} space. Additionally, we prove that any theory defined by a set of couplings up to any arbitrarily high, but finite, curvature order can be completed into a theory yielding regular black hole solutions, while preserving the same set of lower-order couplings. These results show that regular solutions arise in a broad class of quasi-topological gravities and do not require fine-tuning of the couplings.

一句话导读：证明准拓扑引力中正则真空黑洞必有 de Sitter 核心、视界数量无上限，且允许正则黑洞的耦合空间可缩，无需精细调节。

相关度：high — 论文聚焦高阶经典引力理论中的正则黑洞与视界结构，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息。

The Start Time of Ringdown

Adrien Kuntz · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们确定点粒子落入 Schwarzschild 黑洞时准正规模式求和的收敛性。虽然动力学振幅模型在粒子越过反弹半径后能重现波形，但常数振幅求和仅在开始时间 t_S 之后收敛；该时间对应粒子到达中心奇点的超前时间。对于从 ISCO 落入的情形，t_S 约在 22 模峰值之后 9.4M。t_S 之后，动力学振幅模型与常数振幅模型等价；我们的分析还意味着，任何“直接波”在 t_S 之后都必须退化为晚期尾。

English: We determine the convergence of quasi-normal modes sums for a point-particle plunging into a Schwarzschild black hole. While a dynamical amplitude model reproduces the waveform after the particle crosses the bounce radius, a constant amplitude sum converges only after the start time $t_S$, which corresponds to the advanced time at which the particle hits the central singularity. For a plunge from the ISCO, $t_S \simeq 9.4 M$ after the peak of the $22$ mode. After $t_S$, dynamical and constant amplitudes models are equivalent; our analysis also implies that any "direct wave" must reduce to the late-time tail after $t_S$.

一句话导读：确定点粒子落入 Schwarzschild 黑洞时 QNM 求和开始收敛的 ringdown 起始时间，并讨论直接波与晚期尾的关系。

Form Factors in AdS from the Worldsheet

Luis F. Alday, Cl\'ement Virally, Xinan Zhou · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：本文研究描述闭弦与 D-膜散射的 AdS 形状因子。假设这些形状因子具有以多重多对数函数表示的世界面积分表示，作者通过将其极点结构与 CFT 数据匹配，确定其在平直空间极限附近的领头曲率修正。重点讨论 4d N=4 SYM 中两个缺陷例子：对偶于 D1 膜的 1/2-BPS 't Hooft 环，以及对偶于 D3 膜的一对巨引力子。对于 't Hooft 环，世界面 bootstrap 完全固定形状因子，结果通过超对称局域化的非平凡检验。对于巨引力子，bootstrap 最初留下五个自由系数，其中一个可由局域化固定；若改为要求该阶缺陷道中不出现新算符，则可固定全部五个系数，并重现局域化约束。在此额外假设下，作者得到唯一的 D3-膜形状因子，并以超对称局域化作为独立检验。

English: We study AdS form factors describing closed strings scattering off D-branes. Assuming that these form factors admit worldsheet integral representations in terms of multiple polylogarithms, we determine their leading curvature corrections around the flat-space limit by matching their pole structure to CFT data. We focus on two examples of defects in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM: a $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS 't Hooft loop, dual to a D1 brane, and a pair of giant gravitons, dual to a D3 brane. For the 't Hooft loop, the worldsheet bootstrap completely fixes the form factor, and the result passes nontrivial checks from supersymmetric localization. For the giant gravitons, the bootstrap initially leaves five free coefficients, one of which can be fixed using localization. Remarkably, imposing instead that no new operators appear in the defect channel at this order fixes all five coefficients and reproduces the localization constraint. Under this additional assumption, we therefore obtain a unique D3-brane form factor, with supersymmetric localization providing an independent check.

一句话导读：利用世界面 bootstrap 与 CFT 极点数据匹配，确定 't Hooft 环和巨引力子缺陷的 AdS 形状因子及领头曲率修正。

中文摘要：我们在有限 R 荷密度下构造强耦合 N=4 超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的空间调制相。通过在三维环面紧化和不等背景荷，隔离出一个不稳定的电荷密度模。其静态阈值在 STU 模型中催生条纹黑膜的非线性分支。条纹态在相同能量和守恒荷下比均匀态具有更高熵。它们连续连接到均匀分支，熵超出从调制振幅的四阶开始。这些解为电荷输运不稳定性的候选终点。

English: We construct spatially modulated phases of strongly coupled $\mathcal N=4$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory at finite $R$-charge density. Compactification on a three-torus and unequal background charges isolate an unstable charge-density mode. Its static threshold seeds a nonlinear branch of striped black branes in the STU model. The striped states have higher entropy than homogeneous states with the same energy and conserved charges. They connect continuously to the homogeneous branch, with an entropy excess that begins at fourth order in the modulation amplitude. These solutions provide a candidate endpoint of the charge-transport instability.

一个动力学 Einstein-Proca-dilaton 全息模型与奇特杂化介子共振

A dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton holographic model and exotic hybrid meson resonances

Bruno Toniato, David Dudal, Hudson Almeida, Roldao da Rocha · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：本文为奇特 J^{PC}=1^{-+} 杂化介子构建了一个完全动力学的 Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) 全息模型，其中包含对偶于杂化流的大质量矢量场在体中的背反。求解耦合的 EPD 系统可得到自洽的引力背景以及杂化共振的质量谱。软墙极限重现线性 Regge 行为，而引入背反会带来定量移动，并改善与实验候选态的一致性。有限温度情形通过研究黑洞热力学和跨越退禁闭相变的谱函数来处理，并将 Hawking-Page 温度固定为 T_c ~ 150 MeV。与非背反的 AdS/QCD 模型不同，动力学背景预测杂化态在退禁闭起始附近就已强烈受到抑制。这些结果表明，引力背反对奇特杂化介子的真空谱学和介质内性质都有可测量的影响，强调了在 AdS/QCD 中采用动力学自洽方法的相关性。

English: A fully dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) holographic model is developed for the exotic $J^{PC}=1^{-+}$ hybrid meson, incorporating the backreaction of the massive vector field dual to the hybrid current in the bulk. Solving the coupled EPD system yields a self-consistent gravitational background and the mass spectrum of hybrid resonances. While the soft-wall limit reproduces linear Regge behavior, the inclusion of backreaction yields quantitative shifts that improve agreement with experimental candidates. The finite-temperature regime is approached by studying black hole thermodynamics and spectral functions across the confinement-deconfinement transition, fixing the Hawking-Page temperature to $T_c \sim 150 \, \mathrm{MeV}$. Unlike non-backreacted AdS/QCD models, the dynamical background predicts a strong suppression of hybrid states already near the onset of deconfinement. These results demonstrate that gravitational backreaction has measurable consequences for both vacuum spectroscopy and in-medium properties of exotic hybrid mesons, emphasizing the relevance of a dynamical self-consistent approach in AdS/QCD.

一句话导读：构建含背反的动力学 EPD 全息模型，计算奇特杂化介子谱并研究退禁闭相变附近的抑制。

再访 AdS$_3$ 中的谱流

Spectral flow in AdS$\mathbf{_3}$ revisited

Nathan McStay, Ronald Reid-Edwards, Sean Seet · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们重新审视一个旧想法：WZW 模型中的谱流可以与世界面上的某些 $G$-丛相关联。这使我们能够引入一种新方法，通过系统计算线缺陷网络的贡献，来计算群 $G$、能级 $k$ 的 WZW 模型中谱流顶点算符的关联函数。专门针对与 AdS$_3$ 弦论相关的 $G=SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ 情形，我们证明树级一般 $n$ 点谱流顶点算符函数可以重写为 $n$ 个未流顶点算符与一个退化插入的 $(n+1)$ 点函数。这应解释为瞬子背景中的未流 $n$ 点函数。此外，我们猜想该 $(n+1)$ 点函数可以改写为未流算符的 $n$ 点函数，并给出证据。我们证明，对于我们所确定的特定时空坐标选择，该 $(n+1)$ 点函数满足与未流 $n$ 点函数相同的全局时空共形不变性约束。我们验证结果与文献中的 bootstrap 结果一致。这为完全求解 $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW 模型提供了下一步。

English: We revisit an old idea that spectral flow in WZW models can be associated with certain $G$-bundles over a worldsheet. This allows us to introduce a novel method for computing correlators of spectrally-flowed vertex operators in WZW models with group $G$ and level $k$, by systematically computing the contribution from a network of line defects. Specialising to the case of $G=SL(2, \mathbb{R})$, as is relevant to AdS$_3$ string theory, we demonstrate that generic $n$-point functions of spectrally-flowed vertex operators at tree level can be rewritten in terms of an $(n+1)$-point function of $n$ unflowed vertex operators and one degenerate insertion. This is to be interpreted as an unflowed $n$-point function in an instanton background. Moreover, we conjecture that this $(n+1)$-point function can be recast as an $n$-point function of unflowed operators and we provide evidence for this. We demonstrate that the $(n+1)$-point function satisfies the same constraints from global spacetime conformal invariance as does an unflowed $n$-point function for a specific choice of spacetime coordinates that we determine. We verify that our results agree with bootstrap results in the literature. This provides the next step towards fully solving the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW model.

一句话导读：用线缺陷网络和瞬子背景重算 AdS$_3$ 弦论中 $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW 谱流顶点算符关联函数，并推进该模型求解。
