共形引力中的部分无质量凝聚体与回归型NUT/Bolt相变

Partially Massless Condensates and Reentrant NUT/Bolt Phase Transitions in Conformal Gravity

Crist\'obal Corral, Felipe Diaz, Borja Diez, Eleftherios Papantonopoulos, Per Sundell · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们研究具有弱化AdS边界条件的非爱因斯坦Bach平坦Taub-NUT/Bolt瞬子。具体而言，Fefferman--Graham展开中的次领头阶系数非零，并在对偶共形场论中激发部分无质量响应。与爱因斯坦情形一样，这些瞬子的全息应力张量表示具有涡度的完美流体。引人注目的是，我们识别出一个非爱因斯坦Taub-Bolt分支，它在零源下支持非零的部分无质量响应，同时保持压扁共形边界的完整对称性。额外的全息自由度丰富了热力学相结构，使传统NUT/Bolt相变消失或让位于回归型相变。我们进一步表明，非爱因斯坦Bolt可以具有负的热力学体积，并证明在规则Bach平坦NUT背景上共形耦合试探标量不存在负模。

English: We study non-Einstein Bach-flat Taub-NUT/Bolt instantons with weakened AdS boundary conditions. In particular, the next-to-leading-order coefficient in the Fefferman--Graham expansion is nonvanishing, and it sources the partially massless response in the dual conformal field theory. As in the Einstein case, the holographic stress tensor of these instantons represents a perfect fluid with vorticity. Remarkably, we identify a non-Einstein Taub-Bolt branch supporting a nonvanishing partially massless response at zero source, while preserving the full symmetry of the squashed conformal boundary. The additional holographic degrees of freedom enrich the thermodynamic phase structure, allowing the conventional NUT/Bolt transition to disappear or give way to reentrant transitions. We further show that non-Einstein Bolts can possess negative thermodynamic volume and establish the absence of negative modes of a conformally coupled probe scalar on regular Bach-flat NUT backgrounds.

一句话导读：研究弱AdS边界下非爱因斯坦Bach平坦Taub-NUT/Bolt瞬子，发现部分无质量响应及NUT/Bolt相变的重入/消失与负热力学体积。

五维四电荷 AdS 黑洞在 STU-W^2U 规范超引力中的复相图与热力学超临界性

Complex phase diagram and thermodynamic supercriticality of five-dimensional four-charge AdS black holes in $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity

Di Wu, Xiao-Dan Zhu · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：本文研究五维 STU-W^2U 规范超引力中静态四电荷反德西特（AdS）黑洞的复相结构与热力学超临界性，并固定四个物理电荷。发现类 Van der Waals 的一阶小/大黑洞相变终止于临界点。通过对固定电荷热力学关系进行解析延拓，我们追踪两个实 spinodal 奇点穿过临界性进入超临界区后成为复共轭对。相应的 spinodal 温度呈现特征性的 3/2 近临界标度，将亚临界温度劈裂与超临界复温度的虚部联系起来。我们构建了相应的复相图，并从复 spinodal 的实温度投影中识别出一条 Widom 型交叉线；随着压强增大，该线逐渐偏离实热容极大值轨迹。在更高压强下，实热容极值最终合并并消失，而复 spinodal 奇点仍然存在。这些结果通过复奇点结构揭示了临界相变与超临界热力学之间的连续联系，并为多电荷超引力黑洞的热力学相行为提供了进一步认识。

English: In this paper, we investigate the complex phase structure and thermodynamic supercriticality of static four-charge anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes in five-dimensional $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity, with all four physical electric charges held fixed. A Van der Waals-like first-order small/large black hole phase transition is found to terminate at a critical point. By analytically continuing the fixed-charge thermodynamic relations, we trace the two real spinodal singularities through criticality into a complex-conjugate pair in the supercritical region. The corresponding spinodal temperatures exhibit the characteristic $3/2$ near-critical scaling, connecting the subcritical temperature splitting with the imaginary parts of the supercritical complex temperatures. We construct the associated complex phase diagram and identify a Widom-type crossover line from the real-temperature projection of the complex spinodals. This line progressively deviates from the locus of real heat-capacity maxima as the pressure increases. At higher pressures, the real heat-capacity extrema eventually merge and disappear, while the complex spinodal singularities persist. Together, these results reveal a continuous connection between critical phase transitions and supercritical thermodynamics through complex singularity structures, providing further insight into the thermodynamic phase behavior of multicharge supergravity black holes.

一句话导读：固定电荷的五维四电荷 AdS 黑洞中，小/大黑洞相变的临界点可通过复 spinodal 奇点连续延伸到超临界热力学。

零动量下精确热关联函数与黑洞奇点

Exact thermal correlators at vanishing momenta and the black hole singularity

Kaustubh Singhi · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们研究对偶于AdS黑膜的全息CFT中标量主场的热两点和三点函数。三点函数来自体中标量场的立方相互作用。在外部动量消失时，树级结果可写成闭式，并且对算符维度精确。我们通过在二维CFT中直接计算重现了这些结果。它们的大维度展开包含次领头指数项，这些项编码从视界到黑洞奇点的径向固有时。这些结果为早先针对更高点热关联函数的WKB和鞍点预言提供了精确检验，确认了固有时特征，同时修正了预言的渐近形式。

English: We study thermal two- and three-point functions of scalar primaries in holographic CFTs dual to AdS black branes. The three-point function arises from a cubic scalar interaction in the bulk. At vanishing external momenta, the tree-level results can be written in closed form and are exact in the operator dimensions. We reproduce them through direct CFT calculations in two dimensions. Their large-dimension expansions contain subleading exponential terms encoding the radial proper time from the horizon to the black hole singularity. These results provide an exact test of earlier WKB and saddle-point predictions for higher-point thermal correlators, confirming the proper-time signature while correcting the predicted asymptotic form.

Realistic neutron stars in the constant-Q branch of f(Q) gravity

Debadri Bhattacharjee, Pradip Kumar Chattopadhyay, P. H. R. S. Moraes · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：本文研究对称远平行引力中由非度规标量Q传递引力相互作用时的中子星流体静力学平衡与整体结构。作者在度规-仿射表述下采用f(Q)引力的正则常Q分支（Q=Q_*），该分支在恒星中心保持正则性，同时通过f(Q_*)及其导数保留非线性函数形式的影响。文章提出三种新的非线性f(Q)扩展：(i) Born-Infeld启发模型，(ii) Hu-Sawicki类比模型，(iii) Tsujikawa启发模型。结合最先进的现实统一状态方程GPPVA(DD2)与SLy4，数值求解修改后的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，并用Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov判据评估恒星稳定性。Born-Infeld与Hu-Sawicki类比模型在控制参数增大时平滑恢复广义相对论极限，其对低质量天体（M<2.0M⊙）给出的半径与X射线双星及GW170817观测约束相符；但其最大质量分别被限制在2.43M⊙（DD2）和2.06M⊙（SLy4）以下。相反，Tsujikawa启发模型显著硬化有效引力耦合，可容纳最高约3.36M⊙的致密天体，并为GW190814中2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08}M⊙的次天体提供可行物理起源，但代价是过高预测典型低质量中子星的半径。这些对比行为表明常Q框架内最大质量与半径约束之间存在关键现象学互补性，并凸显多信使观测在约束非线性非度规引力中的作用。

English: We investigate the hydrostatic equilibrium and global structure of neutron stars within symmetric teleparallel gravity, where gravitational interactions are mediated by the non-metricity scalar $Q$. Working within the metric-affine formulation, we adopt the regular, constant-$Q$ branch ($Q = Q_*$) of $f(Q)$ gravity, which preserves regularity at the stellar centre while maintaining explicit dependence on the non-linear functional form through $f(Q_*)$ and its derivatives. We propose three novel non-linear $f(Q)$ extensions: (i) a Born-Infeld-inspired model, (ii) a Hu--Sawicki analogue, and (iii) a Tsujikawa-inspired model. Incorporating state-of-the-art realistic unified equations of state, namely GPPVA(DD2) and SLy4, we numerically solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations and evaluate stellar stability via the Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov criterion. The Born-Infeld and Hu-Sawicki analogues smoothly recover the general relativistic limit as their control parameters increase, predicting stellar radii for low-mass objects ($M < 2.0\,M_\odot$) that match observational constraints from X-ray binaries and GW170817; however, their maximum masses remain capped below $2.43\,M_\odot$ (DD2) and $2.06\,M_\odot$ (SLy4). Conversely, the Tsujikawa-inspired model significantly stiffens the effective gravitational coupling, accommodating massive compact objects up to $\sim 3.36\,M_\odot$ and offering a viable physical origin for the $2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08}\,M_\odot$ secondary object in GW190814, albeit at the expense of overpredicting radii for typical low-mass neutron stars. These contrasting behaviours demonstrate a key phenomenological complementarity between maximum mass and radius bounds within the constant-$Q$ framework, highlighting the utility of multimessenger observations in constraining non-linear non-metricity gravity.

一句话导读：在f(Q)引力常Q分支中，用三种非线性模型和真实状态方程计算中子星结构，显示最大质量与半径约束之间的互补性。

广义Palatini Chern-Simons中的引力波双折射

Gravitational Wave Birefringence in generalized Palatini Chern Simons

Jose Perdiguero, Macarena Lagos · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：引力波在宇宙学传播中，当宇称对称性破缺时可出现振幅和相位偏振畸变，即宇宙学双折射。本文研究f(R)引力与动力学Chern-Simons项耦合模型中的引力波双折射现象，分别在度规和Palatini形式下分析。背景层面该模型可导致动力学暗能量；对于引力波传播，Palatini形式预言振幅和速度双折射，而度规形式只预言振幅双折射。双折射效应可被f(R)相互作用压低或增强，取决于f(R)具体形式。选取Hu-Sawicki、指数型和双曲型三个拟合宇宙学数据的f(R)模型，发现相对于f(R)=R，双折射在Palatini形式下增强1–10%，在度规形式下最高增强约2倍。还将当前引力波双折射限制转化为对dCS耦合的约束。最后表明该模型中双折射效应随源红移呈多项式增长，不同于当前文献唯象模型中通常假设的线性距离标度。

English: The cosmological propagation of gravitational waves (GWs) can exhibit amplitude and phase polarization distortions when parity symmetry is broken, a phenomenon known as cosmological birefringence. In this paper, we investigate the phenomenology of GW birefringence in a gravitational model $f(R)$ coupled to a dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) term, analyzed in the metric and Palatini formalisms. At the background level, this model can lead to dynamical dark energy, while for GW propagation we find that the Palatini formalism predicts both amplitude and velocity birefringence, whereas the metric formalism predicts amplitude birefringence only. We also find that the birefringence effects can either be suppressed or enhanced by the $f(R)$ interactions, depending on the specific form of $f(R)$. Considering three common $f(R)$ models (Hu-Sawicki, Exponential, and Hyperbolic gravity) fit to recent cosmological data, we find that birefringence is enhanced relative to the $f(R) = R$ case, by $1-10\%$ in the Palatini formalism and up to a factor of 2 in the metric formalism. We also translate current GW birefringence constraints to bounds on the dCS coupling within our model. Finally, we show that in our model the birefringence effect grows polynomially with source redshift, in contrast to the linear-distance scaling commonly assumed in phenomenological models of GW birefringence in the current literature.

一句话导读：在f(R)+动力学Chern-Simons引力的度规/Palatini形式中，引力波双折射因f(R)修正而增强，且Palatini形式还给出速度双折射。

通用平面轨道双黑洞的高精度波形：多极有效单体模型 SEOBNRv6EHM

Accurate waveforms for generic planar-orbit binary black holes: The multipolar effective-one-body model SEOBNRv6EHM

Aldo Gamboa, Alessandra Buonanno, Lorenzo Pompili, Raffi Enficiaud, Michael Boyle, Lawrence E. Kidder, Oliver Long, Peter James Nee, Harald P. Pfeiffer, Antoni Ramos-Buades, Mark A. Scheel · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：本文提出 SEOBNRv6EHM，一个用于一般平面轨道双星的时间域多极波形模型，在有效单体（EOB）框架内构建，采用新的辐射反作用力与波形模式重求和。模型除主导 (2,2) 模式外，还给出 (2,1)、(3,3)、(3,2)、(4,4)、(4,3) 多极，覆盖旋近-并合-铃宕全过程以及动力学捕获和散射相遇。作者用 592 个准圆、319 个偏心、1 个动力学捕获和 2 个散射 SXS 数值相对论波形，以及 61 个散射角比较进行验证；准圆和小偏心率精度与前代 SEOBNRv5 相当，高偏心率下在 20-200 太阳质量范围内、偏心率至约 0.9 时波形失配低于或接近 2%，且波形生成速度快于其他先进 EOB 偏心模型 2-8 倍。

English: Accurate and computationally efficient waveform models are required to infer the parameters of compact binaries from their gravitational wave (GW) emission. Among these parameters, orbital eccentricity serves as a smoking gun for dynamical formation channels and must be accounted for to avoid systematic errors in GW analyses. Here, we present SEOBNRv6EHM, a time-domain, multipolar waveform model for binaries on generic planar orbits, calibrated to quasi-circular (QC) numerical-relativity (NR) simulations from the SXS collaboration. In addition to the dominant $(2,2)$ mode, the model provides the $(2,1)$, $(3,3)$, $(3,2)$, $(4,4)$, and $(4,3)$ multipoles for the full inspiral-merger-ringdown process of coalescing binaries, as well as for dynamical captures and scattering encounters. The model is built within the effective-one-body (EOB) framework, and it employs novel resummations of the radiation-reaction force and waveform modes. We validate its accuracy through comparisons against 592 QC, 319 eccentric, one dynamical-capture, and two scattering SXS NR waveforms, and through scattering-angle comparisons against 61 SXS NR simulations. For QC and small-eccentricity binaries, its accuracy is comparable to previous-generation SEOBNRv5 models. For highly eccentric systems, however, SEOBNRv6EHM attains unprecedented accuracy, with waveform mismatches remaining below or close to $ 2\% $ across the total mass range $ 20-200\, \mathrm{M}_\odot $ for eccentricities up to $\sim 0.9$ at 14 periastron passages before merger. Additionally, SEOBNRv6EHM achieves waveform-generation walltimes that are $ 2 - 8 $ times faster than other state-of-the-art EOB eccentric models, enabling efficient and accurate applications in GW astronomy.

一句话导读：提出并验证 SEOBNRv6EHM：面向一般平面轨道双黑洞的多极时域 EOB 波形模型，在高偏心率下精度显著提升且生成更快。

English: This paper is based on a series of talks given at the ESI program on 'Mathematical Perspectives of Gravitation Beyond the Vacuum Regime' in February 2022. It is meant to be an introduction to the field of relativistic elasticity for readers with a good base in the mathematics of General Relativity with no necessary previous of knowledge of elasticity either in the classical or relativistic domain. Despite its introductory purpose, the present work has new material, in particular related to the formal structure of the theory.

利用悬浮转子探测兆赫兹频率下的引力

Probing gravity at megahertz frequencies with levitated rotors

Matteo Fadel, Andrea Vinante · quant-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：质量之间的近场引力相互作用通常被认为是瞬时的，这一假设仅在高达1.7 kHz的频率下经过实验检验，给出的约束处于10^-5秒量级。我们提出一个可达兆赫兹频率的近场实验，其中悬浮微转子调制质量四极矩，第二个转子通过力矩测量由此产生的引力潮汐场。由于探测转子充当机械本振，兆赫兹信号被下变频到几赫兹的方便频带；并且在固定几何结构下，力矩和积分时间均不依赖于旋转速率，因此达到更高频率不会损失灵敏度。在磁悬浮NdFeB转子可实现的参数下，2 MHz信号产生2×10^-25 N·m的力矩，可在10 mK温度下不到一小时内探测到。若通过场弛豫时间来描述可能偏离瞬时引力耦合的行为，所测力矩可在10^-8秒量级上约束它，比现有界限改善三个数量级以上。作为我们分析的副产品，我们推导了作为可调高频引力波探测器运行的转子的灵敏度，发现兆赫兹频段可实现约10^-22 Hz^-1/2的噪声等效应变。

English: The near-field gravitational interaction between masses is always thought of as instantaneous, an assumption experimentally tested only up to 1.7 kHz, where measurements yield a bounds at the $10^{-5}$ s level. We propose a near-field experiment reaching up to megahertz frequencies, in which a levitated microrotor modulates a mass quadrupole and a second rotor measures the resulting gravitational tidal field as a torque. Because the detector rotor acts as a mechanical local oscillator, the megahertz signal is downconverted to a convenient band of a few hertz, and since at fixed geometry neither the torque nor the integration time depends on the rotation rate, higher frequencies are reached at no cost in sensitivity. With parameters within reach of magnetically levitated NdFeB rotors, a signal at 2 MHz yields a torque of $2\cdot 10^{-25}$ Nm, detectable in under an hour at 10 mK. Treating a possible departure from instantaneous gravitational coupling through a field relaxation time, the measured torque could constrain it at the $10^{-8}$ s level, improving on the existing bounds by more than three orders of magnitude. As a byproduct of our analysis, we derive the sensitivity of a rotor operated as a tunable high-frequency gravitational-wave detector, finding that a noise-equivalent strain around $10^{-22}$ Hz$^{-1/2}$ could be achievable in the megahertz band.

一句话导读：提出用悬浮微转子在兆赫兹频率探测近场引力潮汐力矩，以约束引力耦合瞬时性并评估高频引力波探测灵敏度。

引力波微透镜作为致密天体族群探针

Gravitational-Wave Microlensing as a Probe of Compact Object Population

Eungwang Seo, Jose Mar\'ia Ezquiaga, Martin Hendry · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, physics.data-an · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：从恒星质量到中等质量（约 1–10^5 M⊙）的致密天体丰度仍受到很弱约束，尤其是原初黑洞和暗物质子晕等几乎不发射电磁辐射的族群。引力波微透镜通过引力波信号上的波光学效应，为探测这些族群提供了互补途径，并对天体物理与宇宙学推断具有重要意义。我们发展了一个分层贝叶斯框架，从一组微透镜引力波事件中推断微透镜的族群性质，约束幂律透镜质量函数斜率 α_ML、透镜数密度 n_0 以及致密透镜占暗物质的比例 f_DM。使用从真实双黑洞族群抽取的模拟微透镜引力波信号，我们发现约 100 个探测到的微透镜事件能够约束 α_ML 和 n_0，但二者之间仍存在简并。对于低质量主导的透镜族群（α_ML=2）且 n_0=10^6 Mpc^-3，在 O4 灵敏度下三年观测可得到约 130 个可探测微透镜事件，并恢复注入的暗物质比例 f_DM≃1.2×10^-4，90% 可信区间为 7.3×10^-5≲f_DM≲1.8×10^-4。

English: The abundance of compact objects ranging from stellar to intermediate masses ($\sim 1 - 10^{5}M_{\odot}$) remains poorly constrained, particularly for populations such as primordial black holes and dark matter subhalos that emit little or no electromagnetic radiation. Gravitational-wave (GW) microlensing provides a complementary way to probe these populations through wave-optics effects imprinted on the GW signals, with implications for astrophysical and cosmological inference. We develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework to infer the population properties of microlenses from an ensemble of microlensed GW events, constraining the slope of the power-law lens mass function ($\alpha_{\rm ML}$), the lens number density ($n_0$), and the fraction of dark matter in compact lenses ($f_{\rm DM}$). Using simulated microlensed GW signals drawn from a realistic binary black hole population, we find that $\sim 100$ detected microlensed events are able to constrain both $\alpha_{\rm ML}$ and $n_0$, although a degeneracy between the two remains. For a low-mass-dominated lens population ($\alpha_{\rm ML}=2$) with $n_0=10^6~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-3}$, a three-year observation at the O4 sensitivity yields $\sim 130$ detectable microlensed events and recovers the injected dark-matter fraction, $f_{\rm DM}\simeq 1.2 \times 10^{-4}$, with a 90% credible interval of $7.3 \times 10^{-5} \lesssim f_{\rm DM} \lesssim 1.8 \times 10^{-4}$.

一句话导读：用分层贝叶斯框架从模拟引力波微透镜事件推断致密透镜族群参数。

旋转相对论恒星的無监督神经算子：高保真物态方程推断与大规模脉冲星自旋演化

Unsupervised Neural Operators for Rotating Relativistic Stars: High-Fidelity Equation of State Inference and Pulsar Spin Evolution at Scale

Anarya Ray · astro-ph.HE, cs.AI, cs.LG, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：观测到的毫秒周期旋转中子星群体是基础物理的重要探针。质量-半径测量可约束简并核物质中约束较差的性质，而高保真群体合成把中子星形成与双星演化中的未知量同大型射电计时巡天联系起来。然而，求解描述旋转中子星内部的轴对称广义相对论流体静力平衡的高度耦合偏微分方程计算成本很高，重复的结构计算难以承受。非旋转计算或近似旋转修正可能使物态方程推断产生偏差，并限制群体合成追踪前身星演化历史和传播物态方程不确定性的保真度。本文开发物理信息神经算子，能以高精度和可忽略的计算成本求解轴对称问题。该求解器在完全无监督的设置下训练，训练目标仅由偏微分方程提供，并以可忽略的精度损失实现 10^3 倍加速。这些求解器使可扩展的物态方程推断能够自洽考虑旋转，并支持双星演化期间重复的恒星结构计算，从而使考虑旋转结构和物态方程不确定性的自旋预测在计算上可用于群体合成。

English: Observed populations of rotating neutron stars~(NSs) with millisecond-order periods are powerful probes of fundamental physics. Mass-radius measurements inform poorly constrained properties of degenerate nuclear matter, whereas high-fidelity population synthesis connects unknowns in NS formation and binary evolution to large radio-timing surveys. However, repeated structure calculations are prohibitive due to the computational cost of solving the highly coupled partial differential equations of axisymmetric general relativistic hydrostatic equilibrium that govern rotating NS interiors. Non-rotating calculations or approximate rotational corrections can bias equation of state inference and limit the fidelity of population synthesis in tracing the evolutionary history of progenitors and propagating equation of state uncertainties. In this \textit{Letter}, we develop physics-informed neural operators that can solve the axisymmetric problem with high accuracy and negligible computational cost. \textit{Our solvers are trained in a fully unsupervised setting, with the training objective informed solely by the partial differential equations, and achieve a $10^3\times$ speed-up with negligible accuracy loss}. These solvers enable scalable EoS inference that self-consistently accounts for rotation and repeated stellar-structure calculations during binary evolution, making spin predictions that account for rotational structure and EoS uncertainties computationally accessible to population synthesis.

一句话导读：用无监督物理信息神经算子快速求解旋转中子星的轴对称广义相对论平衡结构，以实现可扩展的物态方程推断和脉冲星自旋演化预测。

纯度规Horndeski理论中的轴向黑洞微扰

Axial black hole perturbations in purely-metric Horndeski theories

H\'elo\"ise Delaporte, Hugo Roussille · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-05

中文摘要：我们研究纯度规Horndeski理论中静态球对称曲率化黑洞解的轴向（奇宇称）微扰。首先回顾具有二阶运动方程和额外传播标量自由度（纯引力性）的纯度规引力理论的构造。然后重新审视在这些理论的一个子类中，在Schwarzschild解附近标量场快子不稳定性下形成新分支毛发黑洞解的机制。由于非零Ricci曲率增长，并类比黑洞标量化，该形成机制被称为曲率化。接着我们将一阶方法应用于轴向微扰动力学，发现它等价于广义相对论中的轴向微扰在一个不同有效度规中演化。我们显式给出该有效度规（用背景和拉格朗日函数表示），并表明它与曲率化黑洞背景度规具有相同因果结构。转向微扰的类Schrödinger表述，我们分析散射势并得出曲率化黑洞的轴向微扰线性稳定。最后，通过显式计算四极ℓ=2的基本准正模及前五个泛音确认这些结果。

English: We study axial (odd-parity) perturbations about static and spherically-symmetric curvaturised black hole solutions of purely-metric Horndeski theories. We first review the construction of purely-metric theories of gravity with second-order equations of motion and an additional propagating scalar degree of freedom which is purely gravitational. We then revisit the formation, in a subclass of these theories, of a new branch of hairy black hole solutions under tachyonic instabilities of the scalar field near the Schwarzschild solution. Because a non-zero Ricci curvature grows and by analogy with black hole scalarisation, the latter black hole formation mechanism is dubbed \emph{curvaturisation}. We then apply the first-order approach to the dynamics of axial perturbations and find that it is equivalent to that of axial perturbations in general relativity evolving in a distinct effective metric. We explicitly provide that effective metric in terms of the background and the Lagrangian functions, and show that it shares the same causality structure as the background metric of curvaturised black holes. By turning to the Schr\"odinger-like formulation of the perturbations, we analyse the scattering potential and conclude that the axial perturbations of curvaturised black holes are linearly stable. English: We investigate gravitational waves from extreme mass ratio inspirals in an axisymmetric Finslerian extension of the Schwarzschild spacetime. Its angular component is described by a two-dimensional Randers space, with the Schwarzschild limit recovered at Finslerian parameter $\epsilon = 0$. This structure breaks spherical symmetry, causing generic orbits to undergo orbital plane precession. Using multipolar radiation reaction and adiabatic orbital averaging, we derive the leading order Finslerian corrections to the energy, axial angular momentum, and total angular momentum fluxes. These corrections enter at Newtonian order and take different forms. We then incorporate these corrections into a higher-order Schwarzschild hybrid flux model to evolve the orbital elements and construct waveforms at mass quadrupole order using the numerical kludge method. The Finslerian corrections affect both the conservative orbital dynamics and the dissipative inspiral, producing cumulative phase shifts relative to the Schwarzschild waveform. For a Schwarzschild injection, the Fisher matrix analysis yields a marginalized $1\sigma$ uncertainty of $\sigma_\epsilon \simeq 1.26 \times 10^{-6}$. These results show the potential of space-based gravitational wave detectors to probe the axisymmetric Finslerian extension of the Schwarzschild spacetime.

English: Cosmic strings are one-dimensional topological defects formed during phase transitions in the early universe. Using full numerical relativity simulations, we observe that the string core undergoes topological inflation and that its boundary moves inwards superluminally, which causally disconnects the core from the outer universe. Between the core and the asymptotic regions, a nearly matter-dominated decelerating region originates sourced by the oscillating string fields. This region is bounded by a local maximum (''belly'') and local minimum (''throat'') of the circumferential radius, while the throat recedes outwards at about 10% the speed of light. Furthermore, a gravitational wavefront is emitted from the string, characterizing the light cone of the string formation. Even behind the wavefront, the exterior region no longer exhibits a ''conical'' structure. 中文摘要：本文有两个目的。首先，我们用Raychaudhuri方程研究弦T-对偶黑洞的测地线完备性，针对任意比能ε的径向有质量粒子。精确固有时求积显示三类观测者：超临界观测者经焦散面在有限固有时到达正则中心并穿过；临界观测者（ε=1）仅渐近接近中心，具有有限膨胀；亚临界观测者在折焦散面处被反射。由于lapse解析且关于r为偶函数，测地线可规则穿过中心，三类在规定最大延拓上均完备。因此发散膨胀标志同余的焦散而非测地线终点，与Schwarzschild时空相反。其次，径向Maxwell光线同样完备但只形成一类，因为无质量光线不携带能标。我们提出将黑洞核心本身建模为超导体，London响应μ^2=4πκρ归因于已有源。带真空能偏移的对称破缺势在中心精确再现de Sitter核心及其光子质量，并在内核心近似再现；由于没有静态标量理论能在更外侧再现各向异性源，完整径向响应仍是现象学的。所得Hamiltonian光线在重参数化意义下沿μ^2g_{\mu\nu}的类时测地线，并再现三类，由中心质量μ0分隔，而核心的密度梯度在中心附近增加散焦贡献。我们还区分Hamiltonian完备性与共形度量的完备性。

English: The purpose of this article is twofold. First, we study the geodesic completeness of the string T-duality black hole with the Raychaudhuri equation, for radial massive particles of arbitrary specific energy $\varepsilon$. Exact proper-time quadratures reveal three classes of observers: supercritical observers reach the regular centre in finite proper time through a caustic and pass through it, critical observers ($\varepsilon=1$) approach it only asymptotically with finite expansion, and subcritical observers are reflected at a fold caustic. Because the lapse is analytic and even in $r$, geodesics continue regularly through the centre, and all three classes are complete on the stipulated maximal extension. A diverging expansion therefore signals a caustic of the congruence rather than an endpoint of the geodesics, in contrast with Schwarzschild spacetime. Second, radial Maxwell rays are likewise complete but form a single class, since a massless ray carries no energy scale. We propose to model the black-hole core itself as a superconductor, with London response $\mu^2=4\pi\kappa\rho$ attributed to the existing source. A symmetry-breaking potential with a vacuum-energy offset reproduces the de Sitter core and its photon mass exactly at the centre and approximately in the inner core; since no static scalar theory reproduces the anisotropic source further out, the full radial response remains phenomenological. The resulting Hamiltonian rays follow timelike geodesics of $\mu^2g_{\mu\nu}$ up to reparametrisation and reproduce the three classes, separated by the central mass $\mu_0$, while the density gradient of the core adds a defocusing contribution near the centre. We also distinguish Hamiltonian completeness from completeness of the conformal metric.

We adopt the parametrized quasinormal mode formalism for nonrotating black holes to study coupled perturbations in modified gravity theories in order to understand how the interaction with additional fields affects the quasinormal mode frequencies and their amplitudes. We compute the quasinormal mode spectrum of the coupled system in the frequency domain using direct integration and a matrix-valued continued-fraction method. We then compare the results with time-domain evolutions, where we extract the mode frequencies and amplitudes using the Prony method as well as least-squares fitting. In the weak-coupling regime, the scaling of the amplitudes associated with the gravitational-led and secondary-led modes can be understood perturbatively. The excitation of additional families of ringdown modes can become significant even when the frequency shifts remain moderate. We use our numerical time evolutions to provide ready-to-use coefficients for the mode amplitudes for representative initial data configurations. We work out specific examples, including dynamical Chern-Simons gravity and the special near-resonant case of coupled perturbations between the polar and axial quasinormal modes. Our theory-agnostic characterization of coupled systems should be useful to quantify systematic effects in black hole spectroscopy with next-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

广义相对论中的非定常虫洞与物质源重构

Non-Stationary Wormholes and Matter Source Reconstruction in General Relativity

G. Alencar, T. M. Crispim, R. D\'{a}rlla, R. R. Landim · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究嵌入演化宇宙学背景中的广义相对论非定常虫洞几何。我们采用类似 Simpson-Visser 的方法对 (n+1) 维 FLRW 度规的时间坐标进行正则化，并结合均匀 Cuscuton 场，构造标度因子在原本初始奇点处保持有限且非零的宇宙学背景。随后考虑两种具体的动力学虫洞几何：四维缺陷虫洞和拓扑荷 Perry-Mann 型虫洞。我们表明，前者可由势为零的正则标量场支撑，而后者需要 mimetic 物质部门来支撑其空间结构，两种情形下均由 Cuscuton 控制宇宙学演化。我们进一步将分析推广到可分离的非定常时空，并导出强烈约束可容许物质源的标度条件。特别是，对于最小耦合标量场和非线性电动力学场，该条件消除了静态重构方案中存在的函数自由度。我们表明，在此框架内，无法在同时满足所需光滑性和反射对称性条件的情况下获得正则、渐近平坦的虫洞几何。我们的结果既说明了在正则宇宙学背景中构造特定非定常虫洞的可能性，也说明了将此类构造推广到任意空间几何时出现的限制。

English: We investigate non-stationary wormhole geometries in General Relativity embedded in evolving cosmological backgrounds. We employ a Simpson-Visser-like regularization of the temporal coordinate of the $(n+1)$-dimensional FLRW metric, together with a homogeneous Cuscuton field, to construct cosmological backgrounds in which the scale factor remains finite and non-zero at the would-be initial singularity. We then consider two specific dynamical wormhole geometries: the four-dimensional defect wormhole and the topologically charged Perry-Mann type wormhole. We show that the former can be supported by a canonical scalar field with vanishing potential, while the latter requires a mimetic matter sector to support its spatial structure, with the Cuscuton governing the cosmological evolution in both cases. We subsequently generalize the analysis to a separable non-stationary spacetime and derive a scaling condition that strongly constrains the admissible matter sources. In particular, for minimally coupled scalar and nonlinear electrodynamics fields, this condition removes the functional freedom available in static reconstruction schemes. We show that, within this framework, regular, asymptotically flat wormhole geometries cannot be obtained while simultaneously satisfying the required smoothness and reflection symmetry conditions. Our results illustrate both the possibility of constructing specific non-stationary wormholes in regular cosmological backgrounds and the restrictions that arise when attempting to generalize such constructions to arbitrary spatial geometries.

无终之循环：具有动力学耦合熵机制的 ekpyrotic 膜世界反弹

Cycles Without End: An Ekpyrotic Braneworld Bounce with a Kinetically Coupled Entropic Mechanism

Rikpratik Sengupta · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：循环宇宙学用永恒平滑的 turnaround 序列取代暴胀的单次创生事件，但历史上三大障碍一直阻碍其发展：奇异反弹、单场 ekpyrotic 收缩普遍具有的蓝 tilt，以及 Tolman 指出熵产生应使后续循环无限变长变大。我们在一个显式模型中解决这三者。一个具有类时额外维的 Randall-Sundrum 膜在不违反零能量条件的情况下正则化反弹，单个标量场的势把宇宙从 thawing 暗能量平台经过变号 turnaround 带入 BKL-safe 的 ekpyrotic 收缩并返回。我们证明，膜 Friedmann 方程内部的修正以及直线双场轨迹，都无法使谱指数摆脱普遍 ekpyrotic 结果 n_s≈3。随后我们构建能够做到这一点的最小完成：一个动力学耦合的熵场，遵循 Ijjas、Lehners 和 Steinhardt 的一般机制；其耦合陡度对该模型的 ekpyrotic 势具有闭式的精确标度不变值，只需百分级偏移即可匹配测得 tilt n_s=0.9649。这固定了局域非高斯性 f_NL≈-0.02 和张量标量比 r≈7.6×10^-26。匹配观测幅度把转化耦合和膜张力固定为不显眼的值 λ≈5.7×10^-3、ρ_c^{1/4}=10^13 GeV。最后，由于膜构造是空间平坦的，Tolman 的熵论证在这里不限制循环数目：我们推导出每个循环需要 N_DE∼70-80 个 e-folds 的加速膨胀，以在下次收缩前把产生的熵稀释回可忽略密度。

English: Cyclic cosmologies replace inflation's single creation event with an eternal sequence of smooth turnarounds, but three problems have historically stood in their way: singular bounces, the blue tilt generic to single-field ekpyrotic contraction, and Tolman's observation that entropy production should make successive cycles longer and larger without bound. We resolve all three within one explicit model. A Randall-Sundrum brane with a timelike extra dimension regularizes the bounce without violating the null energy condition, and a single scalar field's potential carries the universe from a thawing dark-energy plateau through a sign-changing turnaround into a BKL-safe ekpyrotic contraction and back. We show that no correction internal to the brane's Friedmann equation, and no straight two-field trajectory, can rescue the spectral index from the generic ekpyrotic result $n_s\approx3$. We then build the minimal completion that can: a kinetically coupled entropy field, following the general mechanism of Ijjas, Lehners, and Steinhardt, whose coupling steepness has a closed-form, exact-scale-invariance value for this model's ekpyrotic potential, with only a percent-level offset needed to match the measured tilt $n_s=0.9649$. This fixes the local non-Gaussianity ($f_{\rm NL}\approx-0.02$) and tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r\approx7.6\times10^{-26}$). Matching the observed amplitude fixes the conversion coupling and brane tension to unremarkable values ($\lambda\approx5.7\times10^{-3}$, $\rho_c^{1/4}=10^{13}\,$GeV). Finally, because the brane construction is spatially flat, Tolman's entropy argument does not bound the number of cycles here: we derive $N_{\rm DE}\sim70$-80 e-folds of accelerated expansion needed each cycle to dilute the entropy produced back to a negligible density before the next contraction.

超视界气泡产生的引力波

Gravitational waves from super-Hubble bubbles

Pulkit S. Ghoderao, Arttu Rajantie, Dani\`ele Steer · astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：本文考虑宇宙学一阶相变：真空气泡在暴胀期间成核，但直到宇宙进入辐射主导时期才碰撞并渗流。若碰撞发生在暴胀结束后不久，气泡尺度可远大于哈勃长度。这对气泡碰撞产生的引力波有两个重要影响：峰值频率由共动气泡半径决定，可远低于暴胀结束时碰撞典型的 MHz 频率；在相同碰撞开始时间下，相比哈勃尺度及更小气泡，引力波振幅显著增强。因此，超哈勃气泡在暴胀结束后不久产生的引力波可落入 LIGO、NANOGrav、LISA 及未来引力波实验的可观测频率和振幅范围；作者用简单示意模型展示了这一点。

English: We consider a cosmological first-order phase transition in which bubbles of true vacuum nucleate during inflation but do not collide and percolate until the Universe has entered the radiation-dominated era. If the collisions take place soon after the end of inflation, the size of these bubbles can be significantly greater than the Hubble length. This has two important consequences for the gravitational waves produced by the bubble collisions: First, as the peak frequency is determined by the comoving bubble radius, it can be well below the MHz frequencies typical for bubble collisions at the end of inflation. Second, when comparing collisions beginning at the same time, the amplitude of the gravitational waves is greatly enhanced relative to Hubble-sized and smaller bubbles. Together, these two effects mean that gravitational waves produced by super-Hubble bubbles soon after the end of inflation can be within the observable frequency and amplitude ranges of LIGO and NANOGrav, as well as LISA and other future gravitational wave experiments. We demonstrate this with a simple illustrative model.

一句话导读：暴胀期间成核的超视界真空气泡在暴胀后碰撞可产生增强且低频的引力波，可能落入 LIGO/NANOGrav/LISA 观测范围。

具有完美流体吸积的球对称黑洞的奇宇称铃宕引力波

Odd-parity ringdown gravitational waves of a spherically symmetric black hole with perfect fluid accretion

Rikuto Ohashi, Yasutaka Koga, Hiroyuki Nakano, Kota Ogasawara, Chul-Moon Yoo · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：黑洞铃宕波是强场引力的干净探针，但真实黑洞周围可能存在的物质分布会使背景时空动力学化，并使铃宕频率随时间变化。我们研究一个通过稀薄、稳态、球对称完美流体吸积而增长的 Schwarzschild 黑洞的奇宇称铃宕。在吸积率一阶近似下，我们在该动力学背景上直接于时域计算铃宕波形。由于奇宇称物质扰动与度规扰动解耦，波模可由吸积背景上的纯张量模描述。特别地，频率虚部与实部之比同时消去黑洞增长引起的长期变化和红移因子，因此其相对 Schwarzschild 值的偏离纯粹反映周围环境。频率的时间依赖则反映吸积率，并允许定义与之相关的第二个观测量。我们认为跨多个模式测量这些观测量可为限制黑洞周围环境提供重要信息。

English: The ringdown waves from a black hole offer a clean probe of strong-field gravity, but a matter distribution that may be present around a realistic black hole renders the background spacetime dynamical and the ringdown frequencies time-dependent. We study the odd-parity ringdown of a Schwarzschild black hole that grows through the dilute, steady, spherically symmetric accretion of a perfect fluid. Working to first order in the accretion rate, we compute the ringdown waveform directly in the time domain on this dynamical background. Since the odd-parity matter perturbation decouples from the metric perturbation, the wave mode can be described by a purely tensorial mode on the accreting background. In particular, the ratio of the imaginary to the real part of the frequency cancels both the secular variation caused by the growth of the black hole and the redshift factor, so that its deviation from the Schwarzschild value purely reflects the surrounding environment. The time dependence of the frequency, on the other hand, reflects the accretion rate and allows us to define a second observable tied to it. We argue that measuring these observables across multiple modes may provide significant information to constrain the surrounding environment of the black hole.

一句话导读：在完美流体吸积的动态 Schwarzschild 背景上计算奇宇称铃宕，并提出对环境与吸积率敏感的可观测量。

双荷 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的微扰动力学与相对论效应

Perturbative dynamics and relativistic effects of a dyonic Kalb-Ramond black hole

A. A. Ara\'ujo Filho · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究由 Lorentz 破坏反对称张量背景产生的双荷 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的微扰动力学、潮汐效应和相对论频移。几何由质量 M、电荷 Q、磁荷 p 和 Lorentz 破坏参数 ℓ 控制，双荷部分通过有效组合 P_ℓ^2=Q^2/(1-ℓ)^2+p^2/(1-2ℓ) 进入。首先分析自由下落与静态观测者之间径向信号交换的引力多普勒效应，显示双荷使红移减弱、频率比趋近于 1。随后在自由下落系中计算径向和角向潮汐力，并确定拉伸与压缩模式反转的特征半径。对零测地线还计算了引力时间延迟，表明电磁扇区相对于参考构型减小延迟。在微扰部分，研究无质量标量、矢量、旋量试探场以及一个有效轴度量模型，计算六阶 WKB 谱，并用渐近迭代法独立校验部分模式。在固定质量和电荷下，增大 Lorentz 破坏参数会提高原时间坐标中列出的振荡频率和阻尼率；其解释考虑了时间归一化和有效参数变化。独立比较支持所检验的高多极基本模式。时间域演化显示阻尼铃宕后接幂律尾，其指数通过包含有限时间修正和数值敏感性检查的拟合估计。

English: We investigate perturbative dynamics, tidal effects, and relativistic frequency shifts in a dyonic Kalb-Ramond black hole generated by a Lorentz-violating antisymmetric tensor background. The geometry is controlled by the mass $M$, the electric charge $Q$, the magnetic charge $p$, and the Lorentz-violating parameter $\ell$, with the dyonic sector entering through the effective combination $P_{\ell}^{2}=Q^{2}/(1-\ell)^{2}+p^{2}/(1-2\ell)$. First, we analyze the gravitational Doppler effect for radial signal exchange between freely falling and static observers, showing how the dyonic charges weaken the redshift by shifting the frequency ratio toward unity. We then compute the radial and angular tidal forces in a freely falling frame and determine the characteristic radii at which the usual stretching and compression patterns are reversed. The gravitational time delay is also evaluated for null trajectories, showing that the electric and magnetic sectors reduce the delay relative to the reference configuration. In the perturbative sector, we study massless scalar, vector, and spinor test fields together with an effective axial metric model, computing sixth-order WKB spectra and independently checking selected modes using the asymptotic iteration method. At fixed mass and charges, increasing the Lorentz-violating parameter raises the tabulated oscillation frequencies and damping rates in the original time coordinate; their interpretation accounts for time normalization and changes in effective parameters. The independent comparisons support the tested higher-multipole fundamental modes. Time-domain evolutions exhibit damped ringdown followed by power-law tails, whose exponents are estimated through fits incorporating finite time corrections and numerical sensitivity checks.

Kruglov 非线性电动力学中的光子传播与黑洞成像

Photon propagation and black hole imaging in Kruglov nonlinear electrodynamics

H. S. Ramadhan, M. F. Fauzi, D. A. Witjaksana, A. Sulaksono · gr-qc, hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：非线性电动力学（NLED）通过有效光学几何修改光子传播，使光学现象偏离仅由背景时空度规预言的結果。本文重新审视推广 Born–Infeld 电动力学的 Kruglov 模型，并通过直接数值积分研究有效几何中的零测地线，而不依赖强场解析近似。我们分析由此产生的光子球、引力透镜、黑洞阴影和薄吸积盘图像，以及它们对参数 q 的依赖。对于足够小的正 q，有效角向度规出现极点，在事件视界外产生稳定光子轨道，并局部反转光子轨迹的方位角演化，形成类似但不源于参考系拖曳的独特弯曲模式。相反，负 q 引入有效修正因子的零点，作为光子轨迹的转向点，阻止光子进入背景度规变为复数的区域。它会在光线偏折、阴影半径、光子环形态和相对论像中产生可测量变化。特别是，较小的正 q 产生更薄的光子环和更大的阴影半径，而负 q 通常导致更宽的光子环和更小的阴影。与当前事件视界望远镜对 Sgr A* 的约束比较表明，Kruglov 参数空间的相当一部分仍与现有观测相容。

English: Nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) modifies photon propagation through an effective optical geometry, allowing optical phenomena to deviate from those predicted solely by the underlying spacetime metric. In this work, we revisit the Kruglov model, which generalizes Born--Infeld electrodynamics, and investigate the corresponding null geodesics in theeffective geometry through direct numerical integration, without relying on strong-field analytical approximations. We analyze the resulting photon spheres, gravitational lensing, black-hole shadows, and thin accretion-disk images, together with their dependence on the parameter $q$. For sufficiently small positive $q$, the effective angular metric develops a pole that generates stable photon orbits outside the event horizon and locally reverses the azimuthal evolution of photon trajectories, producing a distinctive bending pattern that resembles, although does not originate from, frame dragging. Conversely, negative $q$ introduces a zero of the effective correction factor, which acts as a turning point for photon trajectories and prevents them from entering the region where the background metric becomes complex. It produces measurable changes in light deflection, shadow radius, photon-ring morphology, and relativistic images. In particular, smaller positive values of $q$ produce thinner photon rings and enlarged shadow radii, whereas negative values generally lead to broader photon rings and smaller shadows. Comparison with the current Event Horizon Telescope constraints on Sgr~A* shows that a substantial region of the Kruglov parameter space remains compatible with present observations.

引力波背景中原始各向异性的普适性

Universality of Primordial Anisotropies in Gravitational Wave Background

Boyuan Jiang, Ryo Saito, Ying-li Zhang · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究随机引力波背景（SGWB）中原始各向异性的一般结构。许多产生原始SGWB各向异性的机制，包括化石效应和传播效应，尽管物理起源不同，却表现出相似的多极依赖，暗示存在共同的底层结构。为刻画这一结构，我们引入一个模型无关的框架——宇宙学形状因子（CFF），用于描述长波扰动如何调制短尺度SGWB统计。在这大类机制中，我们证明SGWB各向异性允许的角度和偏振结构由统计各向同性、局域性以及长波扰动的基本性质等一般原理普适地决定。与这些普适结构相对，振幅和频率依赖等观测量保留了关于起源的信息。我们的结果为原始SGWB各向异性提供了统一且有效的描述，阐明了哪些方面是普适的、哪些是模型依赖的，从而为解释未来引力波观测提供了理论基础。

English: We investigate the general structure of primordial anisotropies in the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB). Many mechanisms generating primordial SGWB anisotropies, including fossil and propagation effects, exhibit similar multipole dependences despite their distinct physical origins, implying the presence of a common underlying structure. To characterize this structure, we introduce a model-independent framework, the Cosmological Form Factor (CFF), that describes how long-wavelength perturbations modulate short-scale SGWB statistics. Within this broad class of mechanisms, we show that the allowed angular and polarization structures of SGWB anisotropies are universally determined by general principles, including statistical isotropy, locality, and the basic properties of long-wavelength perturbations. In contrast to these universal structures, observables such as amplitudes and frequency dependence retain information about the origin. Our results provide a unified and effective description of primordial SGWB anisotropies, clarifying which aspects are universal and which are model dependent, and therefore offer a theoretical foundation for interpreting future gravitational-wave observations.

一句话导读：提出模型无关的宇宙学形状因子框架，揭示原始随机引力波背景各向异性的角度与偏振结构具有普适性。

N=2* 的新解析 Janus 与 S^4 解

New analytic Janus and $S^4$ solutions for $\mathcal{N}=2^*$

Fridrik Freyr Gautason · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们构造了一个三参数族的正则解析超引力解，它们对偶于 (a) 四球面上的 N=2* 规范理论，以及 (b) N=4 SYM 中具有或没有打开 N=2* 质量的 U(1)^2 不变 Janus 界面。为此，我们采用一个五维超引力模型耦合六个标量，该模型来自 IIB 型超引力在 S^5 上的某个一致截断。这些弯曲畴壁解具有隐藏的运动积分，从而允许解析处理。我们将解的三个参数与场论源和 vev 联系起来，并展示解的正则性如何限制其范围。我们简要讨论针对我们这族 Janus 解，对场论拉格朗日量一点函数的全息计算。

English: We construct a three-parameter family of regular analytic supergravity solutions which are dual to (a) the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ gauge theory on the four-sphere, and (b) $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$-invariant Janus interfaces in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with or without the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ mass turned on. To this end we employ a five-dimensional supergravity model coupled to six scalars which arises as a certain consistent truncation of type IIB supergravity on $S^5$. The curved domain wall solutions feature a hidden integral of motion which allows for their analytic treatment. We relate the three parameters of the solution to field theory sources and vevs and show how regularity of the solutions restricts their range. We briefly discuss the holographic evaluation of the one-point function of the field theory Lagrangian for our family of Janus solutions.

一句话导读：在五维超引力中构造三参数解析 Janus 与 S^4 解，并联系对偶场论源/vev 与全息一点函数。

相关度：medium — 直接涉及 AdS/CFT 中的 Janus 界面/弯曲畴壁解及全息字典，命中‘畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀’重点标签，并属于经典超引力解构造；但不涉及超流超导、QNM 或探针膜等支线。

论量子统计关系与协变相空间哈密顿量

On the quantum statistical relation and the covariant phase space Hamiltonian

Jos\'e Luis V. Cerdeira, Tom\'as Ort\'in · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们展示如何在部分场具有规范自由度的理论中构造协变相空间哈密顿量。为保证变分原理适定以及给定边界条件下作用量的精确规范不变性而加入作用量的边界项，在该构造中至关重要。这些相同要素对于在Gibbons和Hawking的欧几里得量子引力方法框架中使用作用量也至关重要；我们展示，用具有这些性质的拉格朗日量构造的在壳作用量可以表示为协变相空间哈密顿量。我们使用该方案计算了若干理论的哈密顿量，其中一个具有Chern-Simons项，并证明在黑洞背景下，该哈密顿量直接给出量子统计关系，包括与非引力荷和化学势相关的项，符合预期。

English: We show how the covariant phase space Hamiltonian can be constructed in theories in which some of the fields have gauge freedoms. The addition to the action of boundary terms that guarantee the well-posedness of a variational principle and its exact gauge invariance for the prescribed boundary conditions turn out to be essential in this construction. The same ingredients are essential in the use of the action in the framework of Gibbons and Hawking's Euclidean approach to Quantum Gravity and we show how the on-shell action constructed with a Lagrangian with those properties can be expressed in terms of the covariant phase space Hamiltonian. We compute the Hamiltonian of several theories, one of which has Chern--Simons terms, using our prescription and show that, in black-hole backgrounds, the Hamiltonian gives directly the quantum statistical relation including terms related to non-gravitational charges and chemical potentials, as expected.

一句话导读：构建带规范自由度的协变相空间哈密顿量，并证明在黑洞背景下可直接给出含非引力荷与化学势的量子统计关系。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力/黑洞热力学与协变相空间形式，非全息研究；与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关。

确定性超图 SYK：无需无序平均的 melonic 主导与最大混沌

Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging

Shiroman Prakash · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们证明，Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型的主导 melonic 结构可由单个稀疏 Majorana 哈密顿量实现，而无需无序平均。在我们的确定性超图 SYK 模型 (hSYK) 中，N 个 Majorana 费米子通过 O(dN) 个具有均匀耦合的项相互作用，这些项排列在一个固定的 q-均匀、d-正则超图上。若该超图是线性的、短圈很少且为谱扩展子，则在大 d 下，两点函数逐点满足 melonic Schwinger-Dyson 方程。因此主导热力学与 SYK 相同，并且在 1/d 领头阶，除 Schwarzian 外的所有双局域涨落都有能隙。四点梯形图分解为以格点邻接算符本征值标记的 scrambling 模式。在强耦合下，均匀模式具有最大混沌性，而非均匀模式仅当其本征值超过 1/(q-1) 时才增长。对 N≤24 的单实例进行精确对角化，与 melonic 两点函数和热力学的符合程度高于同尺寸的稠密 SYK，显示 Wigner-Dyson 能级统计，并重现了 out-of-time-order 关联函数所预言的模式结构。数值上，随机线性超图通常满足这些条件，且当 d>q 时还能避免涌现对称性。该模型是量子模拟的自然候选。

English: We show that the leading melonic structure of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model can be realized by a single sparse Majorana Hamiltonian, without disorder averaging. In our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK), $N$ Majorana fermions interact through $O(dN)$ terms with uniform couplings, arranged on a fixed $q$-uniform, $d$-regular hypergraph. If the hypergraph is linear, has few short cycles, and is a spectral expander, then at large $d$ the two-point function obeys the melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation site by site. The leading thermodynamics are therefore those of SYK, and at leading order in $1/d$ every bilocal fluctuation other than the Schwarzian is gapped. The four-point ladder splits into scrambling modes labeled by eigenvalues of the site adjacency operator. At strong coupling, the uniform mode is maximally chaotic, and a non-uniform mode grows only if its eigenvalue exceeds $1/(q-1)$. Exact diagonalization of single instances with $N\le24$ agrees with the melonic two-point function and thermodynamics more closely than dense SYK of the same size, shows Wigner-Dyson level statistics, and reproduces the predicted mode structure of out-of-time-order correlators. Numerically, random linear hypergraphs typically satisfy these conditions, and for $d>q$ also avoid emergent symmetries. The model is a natural candidate for quantum simulation.

一句话导读：提出确定性超图 SYK：单一稀疏 Majorana 哈密顿量在无需无序平均下实现 melonic 主导、SYK 热力学与最大混沌。

相关度：medium — 属于 SYK/JT 全息与量子混沌方向，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM 或探针膜等重点支线。

冻结沼泽：弱引力猜想的Krylov复杂度诊断

Freezing Swampland: A Krylov Complexity Diagnostic for the Weak Gravity Conjecture

Amin Faraji Astaneh, Reza Ghomi Shurkaie · hep-th, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：本文从量子信息角度，用Krylov展布复杂度研究弱引力猜想。对于全息对偶于AdS Reissner-Nordström黑洞的带电热场双态，作者指出黑洞侧的极端极限伴随Krylov展布的有效冻结：回归振幅变为纯相位，相应的Krylov展布被抑制。引入带电物质并考虑视界附近的Schwinger对产生后，一旦打开允许的放电通道，冻结行为被解除，动力学重新变得非平庸。作者据此提出，可用基于复杂度的诊断来刻画弱引力猜想的一个特征性物理后果：存在可介导放电的超极端带电态；并指出沼泽计划、黑洞物理与量子信息理论之间的联系。

English: We propose a quantum-information-theoretic perspective on the Weak Gravity Conjecture through the behavior of Krylov spread complexity. For a charged thermofield double state holographically dual to an AdS Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole, we show that the extremal limit on the black-hole side is accompanied by an effective freezing of Krylov spreading. In this regime, the return amplitude becomes effectively a pure phase, and the corresponding Krylov spread is suppressed. We then incorporate charged matter and study the effect of Schwinger pair production in the near-horizon region. Within this semiclassical near-extremal analysis, the frozen behavior is lifted once an allowed discharge channel is opened, and the dynamics become nontrivial again. This suggests a possible complexity-based diagnostic of a characteristic physical consequence of the Weak Gravity Conjecture: the availability of a superextremal charged state that can mediate discharge. More broadly, our results point to a connection between the swampland program, black-hole physics, and quantum information theory.

一句话导读：用Krylov展布复杂度在AdS带电黑洞与Schwinger放电中为弱引力猜想提供量子信息诊断。

相关度：low — 论文属于AdS/CFT黑洞与量子信息/复杂度交叉的弱引力猜想研究，与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜及经典引力等具体支线没有直接重合；仅共享一般全息与黑洞背景。

改进全息QCD模型中质子的引力形状因子

Gravitational form factors of the proton in the improved holographic QCD model

Antti Hippel\"ainen, Niko Jokela, Matti J\"arvinen · hep-th, hep-ph · v4 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们使用改进的全息QCD模型计算质子引力形状因子的胶子贡献，其中质子在体时空中由Dirac费米子描述。模型参数由格点和现象学输入限制，从而给出引力形状因子的估计并与其他方法比较。利用提取的形状因子，我们分析质子的力学性质，包括压强和剪切分布，并估计质子力学半径约0.63 fm、质量半径约0.65 fm，与其他非微扰研究比较。

English: We compute the gluonic contribution to the gravitational form factors of the proton using the improved holographic QCD model, in which the proton is described in terms of bulk Dirac fermions. Model parameters are constrained using lattice and phenomenological input, allowing us to obtain estimates for the gravitational form factors and to compare them with results from other approaches. Using the extracted form factors, we analyze mechanical properties of the proton, including pressure and shear distributions. We obtain estimates for the mechanical and mass radii of the proton, $\rho_{\text{mech}} \approx 0.63$ fm, $\rho_{\text{mass}} \approx 0.65$ fm, and compare these values with radius estimates from other nonperturbative studies.

一句话导读：用改进全息QCD与体Dirac费米子计算质子胶子引力形状因子并提取力学半径。

渐近超尺度破坏几何中各向异性全息超流体的解析方法

Analytic approaches to anisotropic holographic superfluids in asymptotically hyperscaling violation geometry

Gitae Kim, Yeong Seok Choi, Jae-Hyuk Oh · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究各向异性全息超流，并在全息对偶流体系统中超流/正常流体相变出现的临界点附近找到解析解。此前的工作在5维Einstein-SU(2) Yang-Mills系统中得到了此类解析解，且其背景渐近为AdS5。本文进一步在3维和4维Einstein-Scalar-U(1)×SU(2) Yang-Mills系统中得到临界点附近的解析解，其背景渐近为超尺度破坏几何。我们还得到对背景几何的首阶背反应，清楚显示了体几何的空间各向异性。为探究时空性质，我们计算全息纠缠熵，并确认超流/正常流体相变必须在临界点发生。

English: We explore anisotropic holographic superfluidity and find analytic solutions near critical point where superfluid/normalfluid phase transition appears in a holographic dual fluid system. In arXiv:hep-th/1109.4592, the authors obtained such an analytic solution in 5-dimensional Einstein-SU(2)Yang-Mills system, and it is asymptotically AdS$_5$. What is more in this note is that we get analytic solutions near the critical point in 3- and 4- dimensional Einstein-Scalar-U(1)$\times$SU(2)Yang-Mills systems, which become asymptotically hyperscaling violation geometry. We also get leading order back reactions to the background geometry, which clearly shows spatial anisotropy of the bulk geometry. To explore the properties of the spacetime, we compute holographic entanglement entropy and confirm that the superfluid/normalfluid phase transition must occur at the critical point.

一句话导读：在渐近超尺度破坏几何的3/4维Einstein-Scalar-U(1)×SU(2)规范引力模型中解析构造各向异性全息超流临界解，并通过背反应与全息纠缠熵验证相变。

去禁闭仅限于最重中子星：味修饰接触相互作用产生的奇异夸克物质

Deconfinement Confined to the Heaviest Neutron Stars: Strange Quark Matter from a Flavor-Dressed Contact Interaction

Aftab Ahmad, Noreen Akhter, Alfredo Raya · hep-ph, hep-th, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究由 u、d、s 夸克描述的电中性、β平衡冷夸克物质，采用保持对称性的接触相互作用，其参数由真空确定。矢量排斥作为标量耦合的比例 0<η<3/2 变化，并给出有效耦合有无味修饰时的结果。纯夸克物质在该模型中不自束缚；没有 η 能使星体达到两倍太阳质量同时满足 GW170817 的潮汐约束；最重位形的质量来自组分夸克包层。随后我们用拟合 GM1 饱和性质的相对论平均场强子相构建混合星，采用 Maxwell 和 Gibbs 构造以及去禁闭袋移。将去禁闭与手征恢复相联系并要求压强连续，可给出该移的上界。在此界内，夸克物质仅在 η<1/2、密度不低于约 4n0、且星体质量在 2.2–2.35 Msun 时出现在稳定星内，稳定质量窗口至多 0.02 Msun。纯夸克星变重所需的矢量强度会阻止混合星中的去禁闭。因此中等质量星的半径和潮汐形变仅由强子 EoS 决定；使用较软的 SLy4 EoS 时，转变移到最大质量位形本身。

English: We study cold, electrically neutral, beta-equilibrated quark matter with u, d, and s quarks described by a symmetry-preserving contact interaction whose parameters are fixed in vacuum. The vector repulsion is varied as a fraction 0 < eta < 3/2 of the scalar coupling, and results are given with and without the flavor dressing of the effective coupling. Pure quark matter is not self-bound in this model, and no value of eta produces a star that reaches two solar masses while satisfying the tidal constraint from GW170817; the heaviest configurations owe their mass to an envelope of constituent quarks. We then construct hybrid stars with a relativistic mean-field hadronic phase fitted to GM1 saturation properties, using both Maxwell and Gibbs constructions and a deconfinement bag shift. Tying deconfinement to chiral restoration and requiring a continuous pressure yields an upper bound on this shift. Within that bound, quark matter appears inside stable stars only for eta < 1/2, never below about 4 n0, and only in stars between 2.2 and 2.35Msun, over a stable mass window of at most 0.02Msun. The vector strength that pure quark stars need to become massive prevents deconfinement in hybrid stars. Radii and tidal deformabilities of intermediate-mass stars are therefore set by the hadronic EoS alone; with the softer SLy4 EoS the transition moves to the maximum-mass configuration itself.

一句话导读：该文用真空定参的味修饰接触相互作用和混合星模型，发现去禁闭夸克物质只能出现在约 2.2–2.35 太阳质量的最重稳定中子星内部。

超越衍射积分的引力波透镜：固有时方法与束缚透镜

Gravitational-wave lensing beyond the diffraction integral: proper-time methods and the bound lens

Ginevra Braga, Raul Jimenez · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：引力波波长可与透镜的史瓦西半径相当，且探测器记录相位，因此透镜效应需要波光学描述。标准工具衍射积分来自静态弱场中标量波的粒子路径积分，并依赖程函（单向）、傍轴和薄透镜近似。本文自足地说明固有时（世界线）表示如何克服这些步骤：辅助固有时使波动方程精确成为一阶，频率作为 1/ħ，因此几何光学以及傍轴薄透镜路径下的衍射积分可由精确积分驻定性得到。对点质量，Duru-Kleinert 规范与 Kustaanheimo-Stiefel 映射给出精确传播子；对远处观测者，DK 时间与纤维角变为透镜平面的半径与方位角，结果给出点透镜放大因子，其偏移由超额路径设定，而几何光学要求 w≫1 与 wy≫1。这种一致反映的是库仑势而非近似：精确程函条件在透镜附近和大角度失效，单向步骤是非相对论极限。随后处理束缚透镜，即引力波源绕透镜运行，它发出背散射回声并在透镜延迟期间运动。其精确时域信号使每条世界线有自己的推迟时间与多普勒因子，因此没有单一放大因子能描述它。在衍射区，仅 Shapiro 相位会遗漏其后的全部透镜效应；在 w=0.3 的合附近，几何光学遗漏 46-100%；傍轴几何在远侧失效；沿轨道的静态放大因子在合附近误差约为 (1-2) wM/R，在其他地方误差为回声振幅。

English: Gravitational waves (GWs) can have wavelengths comparable to the Schwarzschild radius of their lenses, and detectors record their phase, so lensing requires wave optics. Its standard tool, the diffraction integral, follows from the particle path integral of a scalar wave on a static weak field, under the eikonal (one-way) and paraxial approximations, plus the thin-lens limit. We give a self-contained account of how the proper-time (worldline) representation overcomes these steps. An auxiliary proper time makes the wave equation exactly first order, with frequency as $1/\hbar$, so geometric optics and, for paraxial thin-lens paths, the diffraction integral follow from stationarity of an exact integral. For a point mass, the Duru-Kleinert (DK) gauge and Kustaanheimo-Stiefel map give the exact propagator; for a distant observer the DK time and fibre angle become the radius and azimuth of a lens plane, the result is the point-lens amplification factor with the offset set by the excess path, and geometric optics requires $w\gg1$ and $wy\gg1$. This agreement reflects the Coulomb potential, not the approximations: the exact eikonal condition, $\varepsilon_E\simeq\bar\lambda/d+GM/c^2d+\mathcal O(\sin^2\theta/2)$, fails near the lens and at large angles, and the one-way step is a non-relativistic limit. We then treat the bound lens, a GW source orbiting its lens, which emits a backscattered echo and moves during the lensing delays. Its exact time-domain signal gives each worldline its own retarded time and Doppler factor, so no single amplification factor describes it. In the diffraction regime the Shapiro phase alone misses all lensing beyond it, geometric optics misses 46-100% of it near conjunction at $w=0.3$, the paraxial geometry fails on the far side, and the static amplification factor along the orbit errs by $\approx(1-2)\,wM/R$ near conjunction and by the echo amplitude elsewhere.

一句话导读：论文用固有时/世界线方法系统处理超越衍射积分的引力波波光学透镜，并分析源绕透镜运动的束缚透镜时域信号。

Mixed-Order Parity-Violating Corrections to Rotating Black Holes in Combined Scalar Gauss-Bonnet and Dynamical Chern-Simons Gravity

Abhishek Rout, Brett Altschul · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们构造了联合标量 Gauss-Bonnet 与动力学 Chern-Simons 有效理论中旋转黑洞的领头混合阶 O(ζ_GB ζ_CS) 形变，即宇称偶与宇称奇修正同时起作用的扇区。利用耦合混合标量与度规方程的伪谱解，我们在固定质量和角动量、自旋范围 0.1≤a≤0.9 内计算了视界与赤道测地线可观测量——视界角速度、表面引力、面积和 Wald 熵；最内稳定圆轨道与光子环半径；以及 ringdown 的光子环 eikonal 估计——在该范围内解数值收敛，且对于足够小的无量纲耦合微扰展开受控。我们验证了精确的 Kerr 与 Schwarzschild 极限，复现了可获得的纯扇区基准，并量化了谱、残差与提取不确定性。混合解满足场方程的每一个分量，包括构造中未施加的那个分量，其 Wald 熵满足第一定律到约 10^5 分之一。在该 EFT 截断内，混合系数表现出与各单独扇区定性不同的自旋依赖。四个视界量以及若干轨道和 eikonal 量随自旋改变符号。ringdown 结果是领头光子环 eikonal 估计；完整的耦合有限 ℓ 微扰计算留待未来工作。

English: We construct the leading mixed-order $\mathcal{O}(\zeta_{\rm GB}\zeta_{\rm CS})$ deformation of rotating black holes in a combined scalar Gauss-Bonnet and dynamical Chern-Simons effective theory, the sector in which the parity-even and parity-odd corrections act simultaneously. Using a pseudospectral solution of the coupled mixed scalar and metric equations, we compute horizon and equatorial-geodesic observables--the horizon angular velocity, surface gravity, area, and Wald entropy; the innermost stable circular orbit and photon-ring radii; and photon-ring eikonal estimates of the ringdown--at fixed mass and angular momentum over the spin range $0.1\le a\le0.9$, where the solution is numerically convergent and the perturbative expansion is controlled for sufficiently small dimensionless couplings. We verify the exact Kerr and Schwarzschild limits, reproduce available pure-sector benchmarks, and quantify spectral, residual, and extraction uncertainties. The mixed solution satisfies every component of the field equations, including the one that is not imposed in its construction, and its Wald entropy satisfies the first law to about one part in $10^{5}$. The mixed coefficients exhibit spin dependence qualitatively distinct from the individual sectors within this EFT truncation. All four horizon quantities, and several orbital and eikonal ones, change sign as functions of spin. The ringdown results are leading photon-ring eikonal estimates; a full coupled finite-$\ell$ perturbation calculation is left to future work.

一句话导读：构造并数值求解标量 Gauss-Bonnet 与动力学 Chern-Simons 联合理论中旋转黑洞的混合阶形变，计算视界、测地线与 eikonal ringdown 可观测量。

旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中的粒子动力学：与Kerr-Newman的解析对应

Particle dynamics in rotating charged Bumblebee black holes: An analytical correspondence with Kerr-Newman

Deyou Chen, Chuang Yang · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：本文在缓慢旋转带电Einstein-Bumblebee黑洞时空中，建立无自旋与自旋测试粒子赤道动力学与有效Kerr-Newman时空之间的解析对应。对于自旋粒子，该对应在Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon框架下通过适当的参数匹配建立。作者表明，对应圆轨道具有相同的半径和坐标角速度，而其径向动力学与局部不稳定率表现出依赖Lorentz破坏的标度行为。尽管如此，该对应并不意味着完全动力学等价，因为轨道轨迹和每方位角周期的径向扰动增长通常不同。这些结果通过区分参数匹配下保持不变与受Lorentz破坏径向形变修改的动力学性质，界定了有效Kerr-Newman对应的适用范围与局限。

English: In this paper, we establish an analytical correspondence between the equatorial dynamics of spinless and spinning test particles in a slowly rotating charged Einstein--Bumblebee black hole spacetime and those in an effective Kerr--Newman spacetime. For spinning particles, the correspondence is established within the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon framework under appropriate parameter matching. We show that corresponding circular orbits have identical radii and coordinate angular velocities, while their radial dynamics and local instability rates exhibit a Lorentz-violation-dependent scaling. Nevertheless, the correspondence does not imply complete dynamical equivalence, as orbital trajectories and radial perturbation growth over an azimuthal period generally differ. These results delineate the scope and limitations of the effective Kerr--Newman correspondence by distinguishing the dynamical properties preserved under parameter matching from those modified by the Lorentz-violating radial deformation.

一句话导读：在缓慢旋转带电Einstein-Bumblebee黑洞中，通过参数匹配建立无自旋与自旋测试粒子赤道动力学与有效Kerr-Newman的解析对应，并指出其适用范围与局限。

Yukawa-SYK 模型的实时闭系统与开系统刻画

Closed- and open-system characterization of the Yukawa-SYK model in real time

Alex Windey, Christian H. Johansen, Philipp Hauke, Andrea Legramandi · cond-mat.str-el, hep-th, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：无准粒子的强关联物质与多体物理、量子混沌和量子引力密切相关，并推动其在桌面实验中实现。该文研究 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) 模型，其中玻色子与费米子通过随机全连接耦合相互作用，使玻色子无需精细调节即可趋于临界。作者使用 Schwinger-Keldysh 形式在实时中求解模型，将闭系统和开系统纳入统一框架，并在两种情形下考虑热稳态以刻画相图。除已知的共形区和杂质 (SYK$_2$) 区外，他们识别出新的高温区：费米子由近似裸玻色子驱动，其动力学可由含时随机跃迁的二次模型描述。所有区域中，玻色子的费米子软化受仅由 Yukawa 耦合和温度决定的“临界性预算”限制。将玻色子与热环境耦合会诱导质量移动，改变区域边界并耗尽临界性预算，从而给出与自调节临界性相容的温度和耗散率上界。作者还引入由两点函数构造的标记，可区分所有识别出的区域、在线性响应中可及且无需拟合共形指数，并用量子 Fisher 信息给出有耗散和无耗散情形下的上界。

English: Strongly correlated matter without quasiparticles is central to many-body physics, quantum chaos, and quantum gravity, motivating a considerable effort toward its realization in tabletop experiments. Two challenges remain: laboratory platforms are open systems, so conformal behavior must survive dissipation, and it must be identified through measurable quantities. We address both challenges in the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) model, in which bosons and fermions interact as in, e.g., light-matter systems, but through random all-to-all couplings that drive the boson to criticality without fine tuning. Solving the model in real time using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we treat closed and open systems within a unified framework and, in both cases, consider a thermal steady state to map their phase diagrams. In addition to the known conformal and impurity (or SYK$_2$) regimes, we identify novel high-temperature regimes in which the fermions are driven by an essentially bare boson and show that their dynamics is captured by a quadratic model with time-dependent random hopping. Across all regimes, the fermionic softening of the boson is bounded by a ``criticality budget'' determined only by the Yukawa coupling and the temperature. Coupling the boson with a thermal environment induces a mass shift that deforms the boundaries between different regimes and exhausts the criticality budget, thus imposing a bound on temperature and dissipation rate compatible with self-tuned criticality. We further introduce a set of markers built from the two-point functions that separate all identified regimes, are accessible in linear response, and require no fit of the conformal exponents. We complement them with the quantum Fisher information, deriving upper bounds with and without dissipation. These results may help characterize holographic quantum matter beyond the closed setting.

一句话导读：该文用实时 Schwinger-Keldysh 方法统一刻画闭系统与开系统中的 Yukawa-SYK 模型，发现新高温区、临界性预算及可测量的两点函数标记。

相关度：medium — 论文属于 SYK/AdS2 与全息量子物质相关方向，涉及临界性、开放系统和量子信息量；但核心是 YSYK 模型的实时开闭系统相图与两点函数标记，不直接对应用户列出的全息超导、畴壁/孤子、QNM 或探针膜等重点支线。

超紧凑星对平面波包散射产生的晚期回声

Late-time echoes from planar wave-packet scattering by an ultracompact star

Shanshan Deng, Jian-hua He · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们采用时域多极模求和方法，模拟入射平面标量波在超紧凑、无视界、常密度星时空中的传播与散射。通过重建相干叠加的时域波形，我们将该星的动力学响应与 Schwarzschild 黑洞进行比较。我们发现，由于波在外部不稳定光子球附近发生散射，早期响应与黑洞铃宕高度相似。相反，晚期信号发展出一系列延迟回声，这些回声源于波在内部稳定光环附近的捕获以及随后通过外部势垒的泄漏。虽然单个多极呈现规则回声，但其相干叠加会引起干涉，产生轮廓不规则的复杂波形，不过这些波形仍保留一种潜在的时间组织，即峰间隔交替变化。最后，作为概念验证，我们使用假定的应变归一化进行信噪比分析，表明这些微弱的晚期信号可以被第三代引力波探测器分辨。

English: We simulate the propagation and scattering of an incident plane scalar wave in the spacetime of an ultracompact, horizonless constant-density star using a time-domain multipole mode-sum method. By reconstructing the coherently superposed time-domain waveforms, we compare the star's dynamical response with that of a Schwarzschild black hole. We find that the early-time response closely mimics a black-hole ringdown due to wave scattering near the exterior unstable photon sphere. Conversely, the late-time signal develops a sequence of delayed echoes originating from wave trapping near the interior stable light ring and subsequent leakage through the exterior potential barrier. While individual multipoles exhibit regular echoes, their coherent superposition induces interference, producing complex waveforms with irregular profiles that nonetheless retain an underlying temporal organization with alternating peak separations. Finally, as a proof of concept, we perform a signal-to-noise ratio analysis using an assumed strain normalization, demonstrating that these weak, late-time signatures can be resolved by third-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

一句话导读：时域模拟表明，无视界超紧凑星在早期呈现黑洞式铃宕，晚期出现由内部稳定光环捕获并泄漏形成的延迟回声，并评估了其第三代引力波探测器可探测性。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究超紧凑星的波散射、黑洞铃宕式早期响应与晚期引力波回声；不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或全息凝聚态等主题。

大质量 Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中的双黑洞并合

Binary black hole mergers in massive Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity

Harry L. H. Shum, Llibert Arest\'e Sal\'o, Miguel Bezares, Thomas P. Sotiriou · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究具有线性 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合函数的大质量 Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (EsGB) 引力中的全非线性双黑洞并合。由于 EsGB 引力尚无成熟的初值求解器，我们证明无质量标量场常用的变通方案会导致受困的 junk radiation，并在有质量理论中污染晚期动力学。我们提出通过适当修改模拟早期运动方程来抑制此类 junk radiation，从而能够研究黑洞并合过程中的标量场动力学。随后对标量和张量模式 ringdown 的频率内容进行初步分析。特别地，四极标量模式呈现丰富的 ringdown 结构：早期由自旋-2“污染”频率主导，晚期形态主要由标量质量频率决定。

English: We study fully non-linear binary black hole mergers in massive Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (EsGB) gravity with a linear Gauss-Bonnet coupling function. In the absence of a well-developed initial data solver for EsGB gravity, we demonstrate that the conventional workaround solution for massless scalar fields results in confined junk radiation that contaminates late-time dynamics in the massive theory. We propose a solution to this problem by suitably modifying the equations of motion at the early stages of the simulation to tame such junk radiation, thereby allowing us to study the dynamics of the scalar field during the process of a black hole merger. This is followed by a preliminary analysis of the frequency content in the ringdown of the scalar and tensor modes. In particular, the quadrupole scalar mode exhibits a rich ringdown structure: while it is dominated by the spin-2 ``contamination'' frequency in the early stages, its late time morphology becomes primarily determined by the scalar mass frequency.

一句话导读：在 massive EsGB 引力中实现全非线性双黑洞并合模拟，并分析标量与张量 ringdown 的频率结构。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论中的双黑洞并合与 ringdown/QNM，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶。

带弱电毛发的带电黑洞

Electrically charged black holes with electroweak hair

Etevaldo dos Santos Costa Filho · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：本文在爱因斯坦引力耦合弱电理论玻色子部分的框架下构造带电黑洞，聚焦静态、球对称且渐近平直的解，并将弱混合角固定为标准模型值。视界正则性给出带电矢量频率与视界电磁势之间的共振条件，对应带电超辐射阈值。微扰分析进一步表明，非极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞不支持满足该条件的正则、指数局域、球对称弱电云，因此毛发解不能从该电真空族分叉产生。数值研究还揭示出两个看似不连通的玻色星族；在所探索的参数空间内，毛发黑洞与强引力的一族相连。

English: We construct electrically charged black holes in Einstein's gravity coupled to the bosonic sector of the electroweak theory, focusing on static, spherically symmetric and asymptotically flat solutions, with the weak mixing angle fixed to its Standard Model value. Horizon regularity imposes a resonance condition relating the charged-vector frequency to the electromagnetic potential at the horizon, corresponding to the threshold of charged superradiance. A perturbative analysis further shows that nonextremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes do not support regular, exponentially localized, spherically symmetric electroweak clouds satisfying such condition. Thus, the hairy solutions cannot emerge via a bifurcation from this electrovacuum family. Moreover, our numerical investigation reveals two apparently disconnected families of bosonic stars. Within the explored parameter space, the hairy black holes are connected to the strongly gravitating one.

一句话导读：在爱因斯坦-弱电理论中构造带电黑洞毛发，并分析其视界共振条件、与 Reissner-Nordström 解及玻色星族的联系。

Kerr 时空中的反弹与 QNM 收敛

Bouncing and QNM convergence in Kerr

Paolo Arnaudo, Benjamin Withers · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们表明，Kerr 时空中推迟格林函数的 QNM 表示的收敛区域由复时间反弹奇点决定，这与我们此前对 Schwarzschild 情形的工作一致。Kerr 与 Schwarzschild 的主要区别在于存在两个不同的 QNM 族——长球（prolate）与扁球（oblate）——它们具有不同的收敛区域。我们给出了 Boyer-Lindquist 坐标下反弹半径及相应收敛区域的显式解析公式。我们还对 Reissner-Nordström 时空中的收敛性作了分析。

English: We show that the convergence region of the QNM representation of the retarded Green's function of the Kerr spacetime is set by complex-time bouncing singularities, as in our previous work for the Schwarzschild case. The main difference between Kerr and Schwarzschild is that there are two distinct QNM families, prolate and oblate, which have different convergence regions. We provide explicit analytical formulae for the bounce radii and corresponding convergence regions in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates. We also provide an analysis of convergence in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om spacetime.

一句话导读：Kerr 时空中 QNM 表示推迟格林函数的收敛区域由复时间反弹奇点决定，并给出长球/扁球两族 QNM 的反弹半径与收敛域解析公式。

磁荷AdS黑洞的有效光学几何与全息相结构

Effective Optical Geometry and Holographic Phase Structure of a Magnetic AdS Black Hole

Mohammad Ali S. Afshar, Mohammad Reza Alipour, Saeed Noori Gashti, Jafar Sadeghi · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：我们研究四维非线性电动力学中磁荷AdS黑洞的圆形零测地线轨道、热力学拓扑以及全息热力学描述。利用Duan的phi映射构造对背景轨道结构进行分类，并与非常规电磁特性进行比较。后者定义了一个带有额外径向因子的有效光学度规，该因子修改轨道条件并显式引入对AdS半径的依赖。对于四个代表性构型，五个孤立轨道的局部指数保持不变，但其半径最多偏移5.187%。当使用总质量时，背景质量阈值在sigma=1/4附近平滑变化，而固定m0参数化在该处奇异。中心正则性要求sigma>1且m0=0。热力学分析将局部稳定性指数与平衡共存分开：稳定的Gibbs自由能分支仅在依赖模型的参数区间内相交。边界正则系综表现出与平均场指数一致的临界行为，所考察的大正则系综存在Hawking-Page交叉。在混合系综中，自由能分支具有有限端点不连续性，但采样的竞争态不满足完整的局部稳定性判据。

English: We study circular null orbits, thermodynamic topology, and the holographic thermodynamic description of a four-dimensional magnetically charged AdS black hole in nonlinear electrodynamics. The background orbit structure is classified using Duan s phi-mapping construction and compared with the extraordinary electromagnetic characteristics. The latter defines an effective optical metric with an additional radial factor that modifies the orbit condition and introduces explicit dependence on the AdS radius. For four representative configurations, the local indices of the five isolated orbits are unchanged while their radii shift by up to 5.187 %. The background mass thresholds vary smoothly across sigma = 1/4 when the total mass is used, whereas the fixed-m0 parametrization is singular there. Regularity at the center requires sigma > 1 and m0 = 0. The thermodynamic analysis separates local stability indices from equilibrium coexistence: stable Gibbs-free-energy branches cross only in model-dependent parameter intervals. The boundary canonical ensemble exhibits critical behavior consistent with mean-field exponents, and the examined grand-canonical ensemble has a Hawking-Page crossing. In the mixed ensemble, the free-energy branches have a finite endpoint discontinuity, but the sampled competing states do not satisfy the full local-stability criterion

一句话导读：研究磁荷AdS黑洞的有效光学轨道与热力学相结构，区分局部稳定性与共存，并讨论不同系综中的临界和Hawking-Page行为。

远平行引力中规范不变的非普适标量耦合

Gauge-invariant non-universal scalar couplings in teleparallel gravity

Giovanni Otalora, Rudranil Roy · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：本文构建了一个规范不变的远平行引力框架：在其中，引力扇区保持为广义相对论的远平行等价形式，而标量场的引力耦合普适性被放宽。非普适相互作用被编码在标量扇区的四足场中，其与普适平移规范势的耦合由一个依赖场值的引力荷控制。Stückelberg 补全保持了局部平移规范不变性；作者推导了引力、标量场与 Stückelberg 方程，以及反对称约束和一致性关系。作为首个应用，研究了均匀各向同性宇宙学，其中 Stückelberg 约束给出控制非普适耦合演化的首次积分。在 kination 主导区域，渐近恢复标准刚性流体行为；在势主导区域，加速膨胀需要势主导之外的额外条件。作者找到了非普适性偏离被动力学压低的相容膨胀解，包括趋近幂律暴胀或渐近 de Sitter 膨胀的例子。加入普适耦合的理想流体和常数标量势后，得到一个晚期解，其背景 Friedmann 方程含有次主导的类物质贡献，并具有渐近 de Sitter 极限。

English: We develop a gauge-invariant teleparallel framework in which the universality of the gravitational coupling is relaxed for a scalar field, while the gravitational sector retains the form of the teleparallel equivalent of General Relativity. The non-universal interaction is encoded in a scalar-sector tetrad whose coupling to the universal translational gauge potential is controlled by a field-dependent gravitational charge. A St\"uckelberg completion preserves local translational gauge invariance, and we derive the gravitational, scalar-field, and St\"uckelberg equations, together with the antisymmetric constraint and their consistency relations. As a first application, we investigate homogeneous and isotropic cosmology, where the St\"uckelberg constraint provides a first integral governing the evolution of the non-universal coupling. In the kination-dominated regime, the standard stiff-fluid behavior is recovered asymptotically, whereas in the potential-dominated regime, accelerated expansion requires additional conditions beyond potential domination. We identify compatible expanding solutions in which departures from universality are dynamically suppressed, including examples approaching power-law inflation or asymptotically de Sitter expansion. Including a universally coupled perfect fluid and a constant scalar potential, we obtain a late-time solution exhibiting a subdominant matter-like contribution to the background Friedmann equation and an asymptotic de Sitter limit. These results provide a gauge-theoretic realization of non-universal scalar couplings and highlight their potential implications for early- and late-time cosmology.

English: This is the first of several papers devoted to the classification of coisotropy-one homogeneous spacetimes. It is the first step in extending the classification of spatially isotropic homogeneous spacetimes of kinematical Lie groups to the much vaster context of homogeneous spacetimes that are not spatially isotropic; that is, where the rotations no longer act transitively on the space of directions in each tangent space. In this first paper we classify (up to isomorphisms preserving the rotational subalgebra) a class of the relevant transitive Lie algebras, the so-called (3,2)-kinematical Lie algebras, for the coisotropy-one case in spatial dimension at least 4. As a by-product of this classification, we classify two-dimensional real representations of Bianchi Lie algebras up to a suitable notion of equivalence.

English: We study how an effective Gauss--Bonnet deformation of the thermal geometry changes the competition between the conducting Weyl-semimetal and insulating flavour phases of the probe D3/D7 model. Thus the geometric deformation changes both which phase is favored and how the Weyl-semimetal phase conducts.

L. Andrianopoli, J. Zanelli · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：Weyl 变换是度规的局域重标度 g_{\mu\nu}(x)\to \Omega^2(x)g_{\mu\nu}(x)，预期是极高能下的自然对称性并在低能自发破缺。在 Cartan 一阶引力表述中，这对应局域标架（vielbein）按 e^a(x)\to \Omega(x)e^a(x) 缩放。该构造中 Lorentz 联络一形式场 \omega^a{}_b 独立于 e^a，且 Lorentz 变换与伸缩对易，因此 \omega 与 R(\omega) 必须 Weyl 不变；而在二阶度规形式中 Ricci 张量作非齐次变换，这造成两种在零挠率极限应等价的表述之间的张力。本文考虑挠率的作用来化解该谜题，并借此阐明物质场与引力的共形耦合。

English: Weyl transformations, --local rescalings in which the metric transforms as $g_{\mu\nu}(x)\longrightarrow \Omega^2(x)\, g_{\mu \nu}(x)$--, are expected to be a symmetry of nature at extremely high energy, that should be (spontaneously) broken at low energy. In Cartan's first order formulation of gravity this translates into the condition that the local frames (vielbein) scale as $e^a(x) \longrightarrow \Omega(x) e^a(x)$. In this construction, the Lorentz connection one-form fields $\omega^a{}_b$ are independent from $e^a$, and since Lorentz transformations and dilatations commute, $\omega$ and $R(\omega)$ must be Weyl invariant, while in the second order metric formalism the Ricci tensor undergoes a non-homogeneous transformation. This generates a tension between the two formulations, which should be equivalent in the vanishing torsion limit. Here we show how the puzzle can be resolved taking into account the role of torsion. This also sheds some light on the conformal coupling of matter fields to gravity.

中文摘要：近极端黑洞由少量软模控制，计数这些模式决定熵中 log T 的系数。我们研究真正的六导数相互作用是否改变该计数，在七维三阶 Lovelock 引力中工作，这是三次 Lovelock 项具有动力学的最简单情形。多重度保持不变，但朴素计数失效。在固定电荷下 Maxwell 模被冻结，S^5 的十五个转动模作为量子转子，只在高于尺度 K_J^{-1} 时开启。因此 log T 的系数从最低温的 3/2 跑到该尺度以上的 9，永不达到朴素高斯值 19/2。我们从带电慢转解计算转动惯量 K_J，发现 Lovelock 耦合移动交叉但不改变多重度。只有大 AdS 黑洞有宽窗口，使完整转动贡献与经典熵竞争。加入探针带电标量，我们推导三次耦合中近视界 Schwinger 阈值的解析表达式。其大 AdS 极限告诉我们宽转动交叉窗口何时能与带电标量 Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) 束缚违反的缺失共存。

English: Near-extremal black holes are controlled by a small set of soft modes, and counting these modes fixes the coefficient of $\log T$ in the entropy. We ask whether genuine six-derivative interactions change that count, working in seven-dimensional third-order Lovelock gravity, the simplest setting where the cubic Lovelock term is dynamical. The multiplicities stay the same, but the naive count fails. At fixed charge the Maxwell mode is frozen out, and the fifteen rotational modes of the $S^5$ act as a quantum rotor that only switches on above the scale $K_J^{-1}$. As a result, the coefficient of $\log T$ runs from $3/2$ at the lowest temperatures to $9$ above that scale, and never reaches the naive Gaussian value $19/2$. We compute the moment of inertia $K_J$ from the charged slow-rotation solution and find that the Lovelock couplings move the crossover without changing the multiplicities. Only large AdS black holes have a wide window in which the full rotational contribution competes with the classical entropy. Adding a probe charged scalar, we derive an analytic near-horizon Schwinger threshold in the cubic coupling. Its large-AdS limit tells us when the broad rotational crossover window can coexist with the absence of a charged-scalar Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound violation.

一句话导读：在七维三次 Lovelock 近极端黑洞中，log T 熵系数因 S^5 转动软模在 K_J^{-1} 以上开启而从 3/2 过渡到 9，Lovelock 耦合移动该交叉但不改变软模多重度。

A Ghost-Free dS/AdS Correspondence in $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

Omer Guleryuz · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-04

中文摘要：翻转标量势符号会交换 de Sitter 与 anti-de Sitter 真空，并通过畴壁/宇宙学对应把平坦畴壁映射为平坦 FLRW 宇宙学，但其超对称版本在宇宙学侧存在鬼。本文表明，这种逐点对应可在两个普通、无鬼且超对称自发破缺的四维 N=1 超引力之间实现。在单一超共形 Kähler 锥内，对 nilpotent goldstino Kähler 度规作穿过平坦极限 V=0 的 Z2 反射，可逐点反转 V↔-V，同时保持可见 Kähler 度规、超势和幺正规范费米子拉氏量不变。配对真空满足 H=1/L、m^2_dS=-m^2_AdS、共形权重相等、m_{3/2}>H，并且恰好在 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界给出的 0≤m^2_dS≤9/4 H^2 窗口内同时稳定。应用于弦紧致化和宇宙学时，该对应将过抬升与欠抬升的 anti-D3-brane 真空配对，把 de Sitter swampland 猜想限制到 goldstino（anti-brane）扇区，并把慢滚暴胀映射为满足全息 c-theorem 的健康 AdS 畴壁。

English: Reversing the sign of the scalar potential exchanges de Sitter and anti-de Sitter vacua and, through the domain-wall/cosmology correspondence, maps flat domain walls onto flat FLRW cosmologies, but its supersymmetric version has ghosts on the cosmological side. We show that this pointwise correspondence is realized between two ordinary, ghost-free four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravities with spontaneously broken supersymmetry. Within a single superconformal K\"ahler cone, a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ reflection of the nilpotent goldstino K\"ahler metric through the flat limit $V=0$ reverses $V\leftrightarrow-V$ pointwise while preserving the visible K\"ahler metric, the superpotential, and the unitary-gauge fermion Lagrangian. The paired vacua obey a sharp dictionary with $H=1/L$, $m^2_{\rm dS}=-m^2_{\rm AdS}$, equal conformal weights, and $m_{3/2}>H$, and are simultaneously stable precisely within the window $0\le m^2_{\rm dS}\le\frac94H^2$ set by the Breitenlohner--Freedman bound. Applied to string compactifications and cosmology, this correspondence pairs over-uplifted with under-uplifted anti-D3-brane vacua, confines the de Sitter swampland conjecture to the goldstino (anti-brane) sector, and maps slow-roll inflation onto a healthy AdS domain wall obeying the holographic $c$-theorem.

一句话导读：在 N=1 超引力中实现无鬼、逐点的 dS/AdS 真空对应，并联系畴壁/宇宙学与 swampland。

相关度：medium — 论文直接讨论 dS/AdS 对应、AdS 畴壁和全息 c-theorem，属于全息/引力理论核心；同时涉及 anti-D3-brane 与 swampland，但与用户列出的超流超导、探针膜、QNM 等具体支线不直接重合，故相关性定为中等。
