利用IndIGO-D分赫兹引力波观测致密双星旋进探测暗扇区

Probing dark sector with decihertz gravitational wave observations of compact binary inspirals in IndIGO-D

Divya Tahelyani, Abhishek Sharma, Anand S. Sengupta, Arpan Bhattacharyya · gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：本文研究分赫兹引力波观测致密双星旋进探测原子暗物质（aDM）及其通过超轻有质量暗光子相互作用的潜力。考虑中子星吸积带暗Abelian有质量矢量媒介子电荷的暗物质，从而在致密天体间产生额外长程Yukawa相互作用及相应偶极辐射。在此框架下，引力波波形获得由Yukawa耦合强度α、偶极辐射参数γ和媒介子质量相关参数μ刻画的特征修正，包括领头-1后牛顿阶偶极贡献和有限媒介子质量效应。作者将aDM修正与现有广义相对论参数化检验相联系，并对含修正双星旋进的模拟双中子星（BNS）和中子星-黑洞（NSBH）系统，在拟议天基分赫兹探测器IndIGO-D中做贝叶斯参数估计。对于类似GW170817、取接近当前观测上限的非零aDM耦合的BNS，在暗扇区贡献可探测的条件下，暗光子静止能量可被推断到O(10^-20)eV的90%可信度不确定度。对较弱暗扇区相互作用（α≲O(10^-8)），当Yukawa耦合和偶极辐射贡献均可忽略时媒介子质量仍不受约束；但若偶极辐射贡献足够强，即使Yukawa耦合可忽略也可测量。结果表明未来分赫兹引力波天文台可作为检验暗扇区物理和通过精确引力波测量探测致密双星中暗物质相互作用的强有力实验室。

English: We investigate the potential of decihertz gravitational-wave (GW) observations of compact-binary inspirals to probe atomic dark matter (aDM) and its interactions through an ultralight massive dark photon. We consider a scenario in which neutron stars accumulate DM charged under a dark Abelian massive vector mediator, leading to an additional long-range Yukawa interaction between compact objects and associated dipolar radiation. In this framework, the GW waveform acquires characteristic corrections parameterized by the Yukawa coupling strength $\alpha$, the dipole-radiation parameter $\gamma$, and a parameter related to the mediator mass $\mu$. These corrections include a leading $-1$ post-Newtonian dipole contribution and finite-mediator-mass effects. We relate the aDM corrections to existing parameterized tests of general relativity and perform Bayesian parameter-estimation analyses for simulated binary neutron star (BNS) and neutron star-black hole (NSBH) systems incorporating the modified binary inspiral in a proposed space-based decihertz detector, named IndIGO-D. For a GW170817-like BNS with nonzero aDM couplings chosen near current observational bounds, we find that the dark-photon rest energy can be inferred with a $90\%$ credible uncertainty of $O(10^{-20})\,\mathrm{eV}$, conditional on a detectable dark-sector contribution. Analyses with weaker dark-sector interactions $(\alpha \lesssim O(10^{-8}))$ show that the mediator mass remains unconstrained when both the Yukawa coupling and dipole-radiation contribution are negligible, but can be measured even for a negligible Yukawa coupling if the dipole-radiation contribution is sufficiently strong. Our results demonstrate that future decihertz GW observatories can serve as powerful laboratories for testing dark-sector physics and probing dark matter interactions in compact binaries through precision GW measurements.

一句话导读：评估IndIGO-D分赫兹引力波观测对原子暗物质及超轻暗光子相互作用的探测能力。

More Eccentric, Not Always Less Detectable: High Mass Holds Its Ground, Low Mass Loses Reach

Elwin K. Y. Li, Juno C. L. Chan, Alvin K. Y. Li, Otto A. Hannuksela · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：偏心致密双星并合产生的引力波追踪双星动力学形成过程，但大多数探测所依赖的匹配滤波搜索使用准圆轨道模板。量化任何灵敏度损失对于评估种群完备性和专用偏心模板库的必要性至关重要。我们给出首个系统的 GstLAL 搜索研究，覆盖直到 e_15Hz=0.99 的偏心率，以及啁啾质量、质量比、倾角和排列自旋的广泛范围。使用 TEOBResumS-Dalí 波形，我们注入偏心信号并测量恢复的信噪比、信号一致性统计量、虚警率、敏感体积和距离。对于高质量双星（Mc ≳ 30 Msun），敏感距离几乎与偏心率无关，表明更大的偏心率不一定降低搜索灵敏度。相反，对于低质量双星，在 e_15Hz≈0.75 附近敏感距离下降最多约50%。尽管鉴于其较低的准圆灵敏度，探测范围的绝对损失不大，但这一相对下降超过了 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 合作第二次和第三次观测运行之间敏感距离的增加，并与先前的低质量研究一致。我们还发现，固定源参数下的波形匹配会显著高估搜索灵敏度损失，这意味着流水线的信号一致性检验及其模板库上的最大化缓解了大部分预测的灵敏度损失。这凸显了需要端到端注入活动来确定偏心双星的可探测性。

English: Gravitational waves from eccentric compact binary coalescences trace dynamical binary formation, but matched-filtering searches responsible for most detections rely on quasicircular templates. Quantifying any sensitivity loss is crucial for assessing population completeness and the need for dedicated eccentric template banks. We present the first systematic GstLAL search study spanning eccentricities up to $e_{\rm 15Hz}=0.99$ and broad ranges of chirp mass, mass ratio, inclination, and aligned spin. Using TEOBResumS-Dal\'i waveforms, we inject eccentric signals and measure recovered signal-to-noise ratio, signal-consistency statistics, false-alarm rate, and sensitive volume and distance. For high-mass binaries ($\mathcal{M}_c\gtrsim30\,M_\odot$), sensitive distance is nearly independent of eccentricity, demonstrating that greater eccentricity does not necessarily reduce search sensitivity. In contrast, for low-mass binaries, sensitive distance falls by up to $\sim50\%$ near $e_{\rm 15Hz}\approx0.75$. Although the absolute loss in reach is modest given their low quasicircular sensitivity, this relative reduction exceeds the increase in sensitive distance between the second and third observing runs of the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA collaboration and is consistent with previous low-mass studies. We also find that waveform matches at fixed source parameters substantially overpredict search sensitivity loss, meaning that the pipeline's signal-consistency test and maximization over its template bank mitigate much of the predicted sensitivity loss. This highlights the need for end-to-end injection campaigns to establish the detectability of eccentric binaries.

一句话导读：GstLAL 注入研究显示偏心致密双星搜索灵敏度损失依赖质量：高质量几乎不受偏心率影响，低质量在中等高偏心时敏感距离可降约50%。

Global and asymptotic properties of self-gravitating nonlinear sigma models

Oleksandr S. Stashko, Valery I. Zhdanov, Mark P. Hertzberg · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：本文对广义相对论及其 D 维推广中静态、球对称、渐近平直解的整体和渐近性质进行了解析研究，其中包含由一般非线性 sigma 模型描述的多重最小耦合标量场。假设目标空间为完备黎曼流形，且标量势非负并满足适当的增长条件，我们证明解在每个有限非零半径处保持正则，并可向内延拓至中心的裸奇点。特别地，这排除了有限半径球壳上的奇点。我们进一步证明所有解在中心奇点附近表现出普适的渐近行为。最后，我们证明这些时空至多拥有一个光子球；若存在，该光子球必然不稳定。

English: We present an analytical study of the global and asymptotic properties of static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat solutions in general relativity and its \(D\)-dimensional generalization with multiple minimally coupled scalar fields described by a general nonlinear sigma model. Assuming a complete Riemannian target space and a non-negative scalar potential satisfying suitable growth conditions, we prove that solutions remain regular at every finite nonzero radius and can be extended inward to a naked singularity at the center. In particular, this excludes singularities on spherical shells at finite radius. We further show that all solutions exhibit universal asymptotic behavior near the central singularity. Finally, we demonstrate that these spacetimes can possess at most one photon sphere, which, if present, is necessarily unstable.

Effects of Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld Gravity on Black Hole Accretion

Merce Guerrero, Razieh Ranjbar · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：黑洞为强场引力检验提供了独特场所。本文研究修改引力如何改变超大质量黑洞周围平流主导吸积流（ADAF）的结构。吸积盘的引力场由 Palatini 形式 Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld（EiBI）引力中导出的类 Paczyński-Wiita 势描述。作者针对该势求解类 ADAF 方程，并与标准 Paczyński-Wiita 势得到的径向剖面比较。最大差异出现在气体密度：EiBI 情形在内区高几个数量级，并在大半径处趋同于标准结果。EiBI 引力中比角动量和温度较低，径向速度主要在较大半径处不同，且对 s=-1 与 +1 两支解均如此。角速度和盘厚比 H/r 仅轻微变化。结果表明，EiBI 引力可在强场区修改热吸积流的密度结构，并可能提供观测判别。

English: Black holes offer a unique setting to test gravity in the strong-field regime, where deviations from General Relativity are expected to be most pronounced. We study how modified gravity changes the structure of an advection-dominated accretion flow (ADAF) around a supermassive black hole. The gravitational field governing the disc is described by a Paczy\'{n}ski--Wiita-like potential derived in Eddington-inspired Born--Infeld (EiBI) gravity, formulated \textit{\`a la} Palatini. We solve the ADAF-like equations for this potential and compare the radial profiles of the flow with those obtained for the standard Paczy\'{n}ski--Wiita potential. The largest difference appears in the gas density, which is several orders of magnitude higher in the EiBI case near the inner region and converges to the standard result at large radii. The specific angular momentum and temperature are lower in EiBI gravity, while the radial velocity differs mainly at large radii for both solution branches, $ s=-1$ and $+1$. The angular velocity and the disk aspect ratio $H/r$ change only slightly. These results show that EiBI gravity can modify the density structure of hot accretion flows in the strong-field regime, potentially providing observational discriminators.

一句话导读：研究 EiBI 引力修正的类 Paczyński-Wiita 势对超大质量黑洞 ADAF 结构的影响，发现内区气体密度显著升高并可能作为观测判别。

指数电动力学中磁黑洞产生的薄壳虫洞

Thin-shell wormholes from magnetic black holes in exponential electrodynamics

Jonathan A. Rebou\c{c}as, Edson Otoniel, Muhammad Israr Aslam, Francisco S. N. Lobo · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：透明磁虫洞可以共享黑洞外部，而其支撑物质控制喉部的响应。我们由指数非线性电动力学的磁黑洞构造对称薄壳，并推导其平衡应力与线性径向稳定性判据。将种子限制在零裸质量磁分支上，会使电荷与耦合沿固定质量族相联系。在抽样情形中，标定后的线性正压壳不稳定，而变幻影和变Chaplygin律允许局部稳定的径向扇区。显式半径依赖增强幻影恢复项；Chaplygin响应抵消发散的逆lapse贡献，并允许在接近非极端种子视界处存在稳定扇区。表面密度保持为负，尽管内部区间满足切向零能条件和内禀强能条件。在种子光子球处，两种变律共享精确的稳定化阈值。即使固有壳能量趋于零，完整的径向平均零能条件仍为负。数值零测地线成像采用独立、最小耦合的光和透明连接，天体源和旋转薄盘截断在最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）。对于观察者一侧的盘发射，在给定ISCO截断且喉部位于种子光子球下方时，倾斜图像与种子黑洞图像重合。喉部高于该球时会移除部分返回贡献，同时保留大部分明亮主结构。照亮相反外部会增加内盘弧，但中心暗区仍可存在，因为盘并未照亮所有透射方向。图像简并性共同取决于保留的零测地线轨迹和发射支撑，而非仅取决于视界的存在。

English: Transparent magnetic wormholes can share a black hole exterior while their supporting matter controls the response of the throat. We construct symmetric thin shells from the magnetic black hole of exponential nonlinear electrodynamics and derive their equilibrium stresses and linear radial stability criterion. Restricting the seed to its zero-bare-mass magnetic branch ties the charge and coupling along the fixed-mass family. In sampled cases, calibrated linear barotropic shells are unstable, whereas variable phantom and variable Chaplygin laws admit locally stable radial sectors. Explicit radius dependence strengthens the phantom restoring term; the Chaplygin response cancels the divergent inverse lapse contribution and permits stable sectors close to a non-extremal seed horizon. The surface density remains negative, although an inner interval satisfies the tangential null and intrinsic strong energy conditions. At the seed photon sphere, the two variable laws share an exact stabilization threshold. The complete radial averaged null energy remains negative even when the proper shell energy tends to zero. Numerical null geodesic imaging uses independent, minimally coupled light and transparent junctions, with celestial sources and rotating thin disks truncated at the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). For observer-side disk emission with the prescribed ISCO truncation and a throat below the seed photon sphere, inclined images coincide with the seed black hole image. A throat above that sphere removes selected returning contributions while preserving much of the bright primary structure. Illuminating the opposite exterior adds inner disk arcs, but a central dark region can survive because the disk does not illuminate every transmitted direction. Image degeneracy depends jointly on the retained null trajectories and the emitting support, rather than on the presence of a horizon alone.

一句话导读：构造指数电动力学磁黑洞薄壳虫洞，分析径向稳定性、能量条件与零测地线成像简并。

Mimetic Euler-Heisenberg 理论中黑洞的引力透镜特征

Gravitational Lensing Signatures of a Black Hole in Mimetic Euler-Heisenberg theory

Nashiba Parbin · gr-qc, astro-ph.GA · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：本文在弱场极限下研究 mimetic Euler-Heisenberg 理论中带电黑洞的引力透镜现象。文章在渐近平直时空中，假定观测者与光源均位于距透镜有限距离处，利用 Gauss-Bonnet 定理计算光线偏折角；并由偏折角解析导出爱因斯坦环半径，简要讨论 Euler-Heisenberg 参数与电荷参数对爱因斯坦环半径的影响。文章还探讨该黑洞弱引力极限下透镜效应的观测意义，分析放大率与畸变参数，并简要讨论引力透镜导致的光传播时间延迟。研究表明该黑洞的模型参数对引力透镜特征具有显著影响。

English: The present study delves into the gravitational lensing phenomena in the weak field limit of a charged black hole in the mimetic Euler-Heisenberg theory. The deflection angle of light is computed for the specified asymptotically flat spacetime assuming that the observer and the light source are both located at finite distances from the lens using the Gauss-Bonnet theorem. Additionally, the Einstein ring radius is analytically derived as a direct implementation of the deflection angle. The relevant influence of the Euler-Heisenberg parameter and the charge parameter on the Einstein ring radius is briefly discussed. We also investigate the observational implications of lensing in the weak gravitational limit of the black hole. The magnification and distortion parameter are also analyzed in this manuscript. Furthermore, the time delay of light due to gravitational lensing is also briefly discussed. Our study reveals the significant influence of the model parameters of the specified black hole on the gravitational lensing signatures.

一句话导读：在弱场极限下计算 mimetic Euler-Heisenberg 带电黑洞的偏折角、爱因斯坦环、放大率、畸变与时间延迟，并分析模型参数对透镜特征的影响。

带对数修正的带电黑洞的大质量标量准正规模与准束缚态

Massive Scalar Quasinormal Modes and Quasibound States of Charged Black Holes with Logarithmic corrections

Prosenjit Paul, Rickmoy Samanta · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：我们研究黑洞度规中的长程变形如何影响中性最小耦合大质量标量场的振荡、囚禁和衰减。选取由非线性电动力学产生的 Reissner-Nordström (RN) 黑洞的对数变形；它是 Einstein 引力的精确解并具有有限完备化。同一几何也出现在一个唯象完美流体暗物质模型中。在此设置下，我们分析描述弛豫的准正规模 (QNMs) 和描述具有小视界吸收的囚禁模式的准束缚态 (QBSs)。首先表明小标量质量将势垒向外移、抬高并降低其曲率；一阶 WKB 因而预言在任意固定有限多极和泛音下阻尼更弱。然后比较六阶 WKB、全局匹配、适配对数几何的广义 Leaver 方法和时域演化。所有方法在其有效范围内给出一致的 QNM 估计；全局匹配与 Leaver 对 QBS 也高度一致。利用一个参考囚禁态做进一步解析估计，表明局部 Padé 近似给出的结合能误差约 0.04%，而领头 Gamow 隧穿低估阻尼约 25%。在所采样的 QBS 中，增加标量质量或非线性耦合会增强结合，但通过更大的视界吸收缩短寿命。最后，使用适当的视界正则化和共同的复径向围道，我们用合适的相对论双线性框架证明了一对独立计算的 QNM-QBS 的正交性。

English: We study how long-range deformations in a black-hole metric affect the oscillation, trapping, and decay of a neutral, minimally coupled massive scalar field. We choose a logarithmic deformation of Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics. It provides an exact solution of Einstein gravity and admits a finite completion. The same geometry also arises in a phenomenological perfect-fluid dark-matter model. In this setup, we analyze both quasinormal modes (QNMs), which describe relaxation, and quasibound states (QBSs), which describe trapped modes with small horizon absorption. We first show that a small scalar mass moves the potential barrier outward, raises it, and reduces its curvature. First-order WKB then predicts weaker damping at every fixed finite multipole and overtone. We then compare several approaches, namely sixth-order WKB, global matching, a generalized Leaver method (adapted to the logarithmic geometry) and time-domain evolution. All methods yield consistent QNM estimates within their ranges of validity. Global matching and Leaver also agree closely for QBSs. Further analytic estimates with a reference trapped state show that a local Pad\'e approximation gives a binding-energy error of about $0.04\%$, while leading Gamow tunnelling underestimates damping by about $25\%$. Across the sampled QBSs, increasing the scalar mass or nonlinear coupling strengthens binding but shortens the lifetime through greater horizon absorption. Finally, using an appropriate horizon regularization and a common complex radial contour, we demonstrate orthogonality of an independently computed QNM-QBS pair using a suitable relativistic bilinear framework.

一句话导读：研究对数修正 RN 黑洞中大质量标量场的 QNM/QBS，比较多种计算方法并给出正交性结果。

Vector modes in Type 3 New GR

Alexey Golovnev · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v4 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：作者此前给出了任意 New GR 模型在线性弱引力极限下的完整自由度计数，并推广到线性宇宙学扰动及强耦合问题。近期有工作声称遗漏了动力学模式，但其作者未分析运动方程，而是分析二次拉格朗日密度。本文以 Type 3 New GR 的矢量模这一最基本情形为例，指出其错误在于将约束方程代入拉格朗日量，从而导致误判这些模式为动力学模式。

English: Some time ago, we published the full count of degrees of freedom in the linearised weak gravity limit of arbitrary New GR models. We did it by considering the linear weak gravity equations and presented a thorough analysis with no ambiguity left. A bit later, we generalised it to linear cosmological perturbations and discussed the strong coupling issues that appear already at this level. Recently, there were claims that some dynamical modes had been missed in our work. However, the authors of the new claims did not look at the equations of motion and analysed the quadratic Lagrangian densities instead. In this paper, I take one of the most elementary cases, namely the vector modes in New GR of Type 3, and show what was their mistake that had led them to claiming that those were dynamical. The main message: Do not substitute constraint equations into a Lagrangian.

一句话导读：澄清 Type 3 New GR 线性矢量模并非动力学：将约束方程代入拉格朗日量导致误判。

五阶后牛顿阶的黑洞动力学

Black Hole Dynamics at Fifth Post-Newtonian Order

Rafael A. Porto, Massimiliano M. Riva · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：利用[2409.05860]中的世界线作用量，我们导出了五阶后牛顿（5PN）阶的速度偶宇称总（相对）冲量、散射角和时间延迟，包括 O(G^5ν^2) 与 O(G^6ν^2) 的辐射反作用和遗传贡献。我们引入类各向同性描述，并结合相应的能量和角动量损失，由散射数据确定系统演化。该框架为仅用散射可观测量无歧义刻画二体动力学开辟道路。沿用[2409.05860]，我们用费曼 i0^+ prescription 分离出保守部分。该部分包含“尾式”和“记忆式”贡献，后者在时间上非局域并由双主值积分描述。由于相应(in-in)作用量的局域时间性质，我们建立了一套与费曼 prescription 一致且保留完整局域动力学的系统程序。这给出了5PN阶保守（各向同性）哈密顿量的普适贡献，并作为副产品在与 Tutti-Frutti 框架一致的意义下确定了有效单体系数 {dbar_{5loc}, a_{6loc}}。为完整起见，我们分析了近期后闵可夫斯基计算中引入的“γ-3” prescription。将其纳入我们的形式后，在重叠适用范围内发现完全一致。相反，费曼 prescription 在 O(G^5ν^2) 给出符号相反的（局域）类记忆贡献。我们还发现，在 O(G^6ν^2) 进行类似的 γ-3 重路由将不符合“所有 π^2 项仅来自势区域”的猜想，而费曼表述保持这一预期。

English: Using the worldline action in [2409.05860], we derive the total even-in-velocity (relative) impulse, scattering angle, and time delay at fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) order, including radiation-reaction and hereditary contributions at ${\cal O}(G^5\nu^2)$ and ${\cal O}(G^6\nu^2)$. We introduce an isotropic-like description which, together with the associated losses of energy and angular momentum, fixes the evolution of the system from scattering data. This framework opens the door to an unambiguous characterization of the underlying two-body dynamics solely in terms of scattering observables. Following [2409.05860], we isolate a conservative component using Feynman's $i0^+$ prescription. This sector contains both "tail-like" and "memory-like" contributions, the latter being nonlocal in time and described by a double Principal-Value integral. Owing to the local-in-time character of the corresponding (in-in) action, we establish a systematic procedure that is consistent with Feynman's prescription while preserving the complete local dynamics. This provides a universal contribution to the conservative (isotropic) Hamiltonian at 5PN order and, as a byproduct, also fixes the value of the Effective One Body coefficients $\{{\bar d}_{5{\rm loc}}, a_{6{\rm loc}}\}$ consistently with the Tutti-Frutti framework. For completeness, we analyse the "$\gamma\text{-}3$" prescription introduced in recent post-Minkowskian computations. When implemented in our formalism, we find exact agreement over the overlapping regime of validity. In contrast, Feynman's prescription yields a (local) memory-like contribution with the opposite sign at ${\cal O}(G^5\nu^2)$. English: Thermal two-point functions of holographic CFTs can probe the black hole singularity. When a bouncing geodesic exists, the correlator at leading order in $1/N$ develops a singularity $G(t, \vec{x}=0) \propto (t_c-t)^{-2\Delta+b_t}$, where $\Delta$ is the scaling dimension of the operator. We show that the additional exponent $b_t$ is determined by the Kasner exponents near the singularity. From the wave reflected off the singularity, which gives an exponentially small term in the large-frequency retarded correlator, we derive the formula $b_t=(d-1) \max \left( \frac{p_i-p_t}{1-p_t}, \frac{1}{2} \right)$ for planar black branes in AdS$_{d+1}$, where $p_t$ and $p_i$ are the Kasner exponents of the time and spatial directions. We compare our formula with the numerical values of \v{C}eplak and Valach. It reproduces the relation that they proposed for a special class of black branes. For more general black branes, where no formula had been found, our formula agrees with most of their numerical data and fits them much better than the extension of their relation. We also give predictions for $b_t$ in theories where the Kasner exponents are known, but $b_t$ has not been computed.

English: We study the boundary preparation of strong Mpemba states in a probe Abelian Higgs model on a fixed AdS black brane. Different drives ending at the same charge density can prepare states with different slow mode amplitudes and relaxation behavior. Full nonlinear evolution confirms that cubic compensation reduces the residual slow amplitude from $O(\epsilon^3)$ to $O(\epsilon^5)$. For a representative protocol at final density $\rho_f=3$ and $\epsilon=0.05$, cubic compensation suppresses the slow amplitude by a factor of about $600$ relative to the linear prescription. Cubic compensation extends the period of fast relaxation without changing the final quasinormal mode spectrum. Further nonlinear tuning suppresses the residual slow amplitude to the level of numerical resolution. The excess free energy of the prepared states can exceed that of a weakly driven reference at release and fall below it during subsequent relaxation. Three pulses also suppress a second slow channel over the resolved time window and reveal interference between faster modes. 中文摘要：重整化群（RG）是从统计力学到量子场论的核心概念，但其方案在文献中差异很大。我们将 Wilsonian RG 表述为一般（包括有限维）量子系统的量子通道，结合粗粒化与等距重标度，其 Kraus 表示对纯输入给出纯条件轨迹，平均后恢复混态流。随后，我们在不假设张量积分分解的情况下发展代数推广：保留的低能代数由单粒子谱构造，粗粒化是到该代数的条件期望。将该通道的 Cesàro 均值等同于到固定态的资源销毁映射，建立 RG 的资源理论，并给出无需变分优化的相对熵单调量。对于零温极限下的热态，所得单位时空体积的 Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori 度规与 Zamolodchikov 度规成正比，在二维红外不动点附近直接将资源密度与 c-c_IR 联系起来。我们还引入粗粒化的相对熵以度量被丢弃的紫外信息，证明其沿逐次粗粒化的单调性，并在整体 AdS3 中全息评估它。

English: Renormalization group (RG) is a core concept from statistical mechanics to quantum field theory, yet its schemes differ widely across literature. We formulate Wilsonian RG for generic, including finite-dimensional, quantum systems as a quantum channel combining coarse graining with isometric rescaling, whose Kraus representation yields pure conditional trajectories for pure inputs and recovers mixed-state flows upon averaging. We then develop an algebraic extension without assuming tensor-product factorization: the retained low-energy algebra is constructed from the one-particle spectrum, and coarse graining is a conditional expectation onto it. Identifying the channel's Ces\`aro mean with a resource-destroying map onto fixed states establishes a resource theory of RG and yields a relative-entropy monotone without variational optimization. For thermal states in the zero-temperature limit, the resulting Bogoliubov--Kubo--Mori metric per unit spacetime volume is proportional to the Zamolodchikov metric, directly relating the resource density to $c-c_{\rm IR}$ near a two-dimensional IR fixed point. We also introduce the relative entropy of coarse graining to measure discarded UV information, prove its monotonicity along successive coarse grainings, and evaluate it holographically in global $\mathrm{AdS}_3$.

We investigate two prescriptions, namely a Hubble-proportional rate and an inverse-Hubble running model, deriving their cosmological dynamics and effective geometric dark-energy description. The first admits an exact analytical solution and is related to quadratic running-vacuum cosmologies, while the second approaches standard matter dilution at early times and allows reversals in the direction of energy exchange. Interestingly, the reconstructed geometric dark energy can exhibit quintessence-like and phantom-like behavior, including smooth crossings of the phantom divide, without introducing a phantom field or superacceleration. A unified dynamical-system analysis reveals distinct matter-era critical configurations and a continuous family of de Sitter solutions that are transversely attracting under suitable conditions. Confronting both models with Pantheon+ Type Ia supernovae, cosmic chronometers, and DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations, we find a mild preference for positive present-day matter non-conservation. The Akaike information criterion slightly favors the thermogravity scenarios, whereas the Bayesian information criterion favors the simpler $\Lambda$CDM model. Thus, running thermocosmology provides a viable framework for nontrivial effective dark-energy dynamics.

弱耦合与强耦合下周期驱动系统中流体力学吸引子的系统研究

A systematic study of hydrodynamic attractors in periodically driven systems at weak and strong couplings

Aleksas Mazeliauskas, Toshali Mitra, S\"oren Schlichting, Simon Schneider, Louis Nwakile Onwuka, Martin Vrdoljak · hep-ph, hep-th, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：本文研究沿一个空间方向周期膨胀和收缩的共形系统中的平衡化与流体力学响应。作者使用强耦合全息（AdS/CFT）、弱耦合动理学理论（弛豫时间近似、标量 φ^4 理论以及 QCD 有效动理学中的 Yang--Mills 部分）和流体力学（Navier--Stokes、MIS 与 rBRSSS），在变化振幅 A 和频率 ω 下研究剪切响应，并同时进行线性响应的解析计算与数值计算。研究发现，在线性层面 A≪1 时，周期驱动系统趋近一个循环吸引子，该吸引子一般不同于 Navier--Stokes 行为；该吸引子在动理学理论之间具有普适性，并可由 MIS 理论准确描述：慢驱动 ωτπ≪1 时趋近 Navier--Stokes 极限，快驱动时剪切应力饱和到非相互作用（自由流）值。在强耦合全息系统中，周期驱动会激发非流体力学准正规模，在趋近循环吸引子时产生特征振铃，这与动理学理论中的纯指数趋近不同；该差异源于两类理论不同的非流体力学谱。此外，与动理学理论不同，全息响应对二阶流体力学的曲率项敏感。在更长时间尺度上，正比于驱动振幅平方的非线性粘性加热会升高温度，从而降低 ωτπ（因为 τπ∼1/T），导致循环吸引子缓慢漂移，并最终在极晚时间趋近 Navier--Stokes 流体力学。

English: We study equilibration and hydrodynamic response in conformal systems undergoing periodic expansion and contraction along one spatial direction. Using strongly coupled holography (AdS/CFT), weakly coupled kinetic theories (relaxation-time approximation, scalar $\phi^4$ theory and the Yang--Mills sector of QCD effective kinetic theory) and hydrodynamics (Navier--Stokes, M\"uller--Israel--Stewart (MIS) and rBRSSS), we investigate the shear response to a periodic drive of varying amplitude $A$ and frequency $\omega$, both analytically in linear response and numerically. We find that, at the linear level, $A\ll 1$, periodically driven systems approach a cyclic attractor that in general differs from Navier--Stokes behaviour. This attractor is universal among kinetic theories and accurately described by MIS theory: for slow driving, $\omega \tau_\pi \ll 1$, where $\tau_\pi$ is the shear relaxation time, it approaches the Navier--Stokes limit, whereas for fast driving the shear stress saturates at its non-interacting (free-streaming) value. In strongly coupled holographic systems, the periodic drive excites non-hydrodynamic quasinormal modes, which produce a characteristic ringing in the approach to the cyclic attractor, in contrast to the purely exponential approach found in kinetic theories. This difference is a direct consequence of the distinct non-hydrodynamic spectra of the two classes of theories. Moreover, unlike in kinetic theory, the holographic response is sensitive to the curvature terms of second-order hydrodynamics. Over longer times, non-linear viscous heating, which is quadratic in the drive amplitude, raises the temperature and thereby lowers $\omega\tau_\pi$, since $\tau_\pi\sim 1/T$. This induces a slow drift of the cyclic attractor, which eventually converges towards Navier--Stokes hydrodynamics at asymptotically late times.

Yan Peng, Guohua Liu · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：我们研究四维一般静态球对称黑洞周围最小轨道周期的界。对于所有具有事件视界、渐近平坦且视界外能量密度非负的静态球对称黑洞，我们证明 T_min ≤ 6√3 π M。该界是尖锐的，并由 Schwarzschild 解饱和。下界需要对外部物质附加条件：在切向压强条件 p_τ ≥ (κ/2)ρ（κ>1）对所有 r ≥ r_g 成立时，其中 r_g 是 T(r) 取得全局最小值的最大半径，我们证明 T_min ≥ c(κ)M，其中 c(κ)=6√3π(κ−1)√(κ+2)/κ^{3/2}。总之，两个界适用于同一几何类，区别仅在于对物质的要求：非负能量密度足以给出上界，而下界需在附加切向压强条件下建立。

English: We investigate bounds on the minimum orbital period around four-dimensional general static spherical black holes. For all static spherically symmetric black holes with an event horizon, asymptotic flatness and non-negative energy density outside the horizon, we prove $T_{\min}\leq 6\sqrt{3}\,\pi M$. The bound is sharp and is saturated by the Schwarzschild solution. The lower bound requires an additional condition on the exterior matter: under the tangential pressure condition $p_{\tau}\geq(\kappa/2)\rho$ with $\kappa>1$, imposed for all $r\geq r_{g}$, where $r_{g}$ is the largest radius at which $T(r)$ attains its global minimum, we prove $T_{\min}\geq c(\kappa)M$ with $c(\kappa)=6\sqrt{3}\pi(\kappa-1)\sqrt{\kappa+2}/\kappa^{3/2}$. In summary, both bounds apply to the same geometric class and differ only in what they demand of the matter: non-negative energy density suffices for the upper bound, while the lower bound is established under the additional tangential pressure condition.

中文摘要：Kerr黑洞上的大质量自旋-2场通常满足耦合偏微分方程。我们证明，通过作用于场的五个分量、其旋度及线性化Weyl张量的两个对易角向算符，这些方程可以分离。联合角向本征函数固定五个偏振的相对剖面，并留下一个二阶径向方程。分离常数满足由角向算符本身导出的代数关系。该构造通过径向传输恒等式消除Teukolsky型方程的障碍，然后用首次积分消去额外径向解。它为Kerr上的大质量自旋-2场，等价地也为Kerr黑洞弦的Kaluza-Klein扰动，提供了常微分方程。

English: Massive spin-2 fields on the Kerr black hole generally obey coupled partial differential equations. We show that these equations separate through two commuting angular operators acting on five components of the field, its curl and its linearised Weyl tensor. A joint angular eigenfunction fixes the relative profiles of the five polarisations and leaves one second-order radial equation. The separation constants satisfy an algebraic relation that follows from the angular operators themselves. The construction removes the obstruction to a Teukolsky-type equation by a radial transport identity, then eliminates the additional radial solution through a first integral. It provides ordinary differential equations for massive spin-2 fields on Kerr, and, equivalently, for Kaluza-Klein perturbations of the Kerr black string.

Filippo Cutrona, Alberto Salvio · hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：具有辐射质量产生和辐射对称破缺的理论会导致一阶相变，并在过冷持续足够久时产生引力波以及原初黑洞。本文研究在辐射对称破缺情景下发生的过冷一阶相变中引力的作用。我们采用模型无关方法，该方法在某个可显式确定、且给定模型后即可计算的量足够小时有效。若忽略引力时一阶相变无法完成，时空曲率最终会变得重要。我们还纳入具有零质量量纲系数的非最小耦合对一阶相变的影响；取决于这些非最小耦合，引力可以扩大或缩小相变得以完成的参数空间区域。随后我们给出引力的作用在一阶相变中可由当前和未来引力波探测器检验的可观测后果，并探讨脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景由辐射对称破缺情景下的一阶相变产生的可能性。我们还估计了当充当序参量的场被困在假真空中时所经过的e-folds数，这为宇宙学提供了重要信息。

English: Theories with radiative mass generation and radiative symmetry breaking (RSB) lead to first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) and the production of gravitational waves (GWs) as well as primordial black holes if supercooling lasts long enough. Here we investigate the role of gravity in supercooled FOPTs that occur in the RSB scenario. We use a model-independent approach that is valid when a quantity (which we explicitly determine and is computable once the model is specified) is small enough. Eventually, the curvature of spacetime becomes relevant if the FOPT does not complete in the case in which gravity is ignored. We also include the effect on the FOPT of the non-minimal couplings with coefficients of zero mass dimension. Depending on such non-minimal couplings, gravity can enhance or reduce the region of parameter space where the phase transition completes. Observable consequences of the role of gravity on the FOPT that can be probed by current and future GW detectors are then worked out and we explore the possibility that the background of GWs detected by pulsar timing arrays is produced by FOPTs in the RSB scenario. We also estimate the number of e-folds that elapse when the field playing the role of the order parameter is trapped in the false vacuum, which provides important information for cosmology.

极端视界对度规扰动的放大

Amplification of metric perturbations by extremal horizons

Samuel E. Gralla, Sepehr Salamat · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：通常情况下，落入黑洞的观察者在穿过视界时不会感到任何特殊之处。本文发现一个有趣的例外：在极端 Kerr-Newman（KN）时空的大部分参数范围内，随视界共转的扰动在视界附近被增强，使得落入的观察者在进入黑洞时经历异常大的潮汐形变。当黑洞外部存在持续源，且该源本身共转或在相关频率 ω=mΩ_H（m 为方位角数，Ω_H 为视界频率）处具有离散 Fourier 支撑时，就会产生这类扰动。在精确共转时，增强在形式上为无穷大；我们使用近共转模式来保持微扰论可控。其物理本质是极端极限下离散自相似性的出现，复标度权重形式为 -1/2±iα（α 为实数）。这类似于黑洞 Meissner 效应，区别在于近视界场被增强而非屏蔽。我们数值计算了极端 KN 黑洞耦合 gravitoelectromagnetic（GEM）扰动的标度指数，并表明复指数出现在 Q<Q_*、Q_*≈.93M 的参数范围内。这些指数还预言了 KN 时空的一般 GEM 扰动在视界上和视界外的衰减与增长率（Aretakis 效应）。共转扰动的增强可视为一种驱动 Aretakis 不稳定性。

English: Under normal circumstances, an observer falling into a black hole feels nothing special upon crossing the horizon. In this paper we find an intriguing exception: For most of the parameter range of the extremal Kerr-Newman (KN) spacetime, horizon co-rotating perturbations are enhanced near the horizon, such that an infalling observer experiences an anomalously large tidal deformation as they enter the black hole. Such perturbations arise when there is a persistent source outside the black hole that is either co-rotating itself or has discrete Fourier support at the associated frequencies $\omega=m\Omega_H$ (where $m$ is the azimuthal number and $\Omega_H$ is the horizon frequency). The enhancement is formally infinite at precise co-rotation, and we work with a nearly co-rotating mode to keep perturbation theory under control. The underlying physics is the emergence of discrete self-similarity in the extremal limit, with complex scaling weights of the form $-1/2\pm i\alpha$ for real $\alpha$. It is analogous to the black hole Meissner effect, except that the near-horizon field is enhanced rather than screened. We numerically calculate the scaling exponents for coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GEM) perturbations of extremal KN black holes and show that the complex exponents arise in the parameter range $Q < Q_*$ with $Q_*\approx.93M$. These exponents also predict the decay and growth rates (Aretakis effect) of generic GEM perturbations of the KN spacetime, both on and off the horizon. The enhancement of co-rotating perturbations can be viewed as a driven Aretakis instability.

中文摘要：我们在广义相对论有效场论中计算致密双星在六阶后牛顿（6PN）阶的非线性远区动力学。我们推导了因果 prescription 与保守 prescription 下一般多极源完整的 O(G^2) 远区作用量。除已知的 tails 与 failed tails 外，它还包含由辐射波的非线性记忆产生的五个新扇区。在散射轨道上，它们含有一个由角动量平衡固定的、时间非局域的边界项。同一构造给出辐射波形，其能量与角动量通量平衡作用量的损失。对于双星，6PN 动力学还需要低阶扇区的 PN 修正、迭代辐射反作用，以及复合源曲率中的二次耦合；我们通过将引力 Compton 振幅与组成成分的相应振幅匹配来确定该耦合系数。我们计算了两辐射贡献对总散射角在第四、第五和第六 post-Minkowskian（PM）阶的贡献，以及对保守角在 4PM 和 5PM 阶的贡献，并保留到 6PN 的整数-PN 项。对于保守角，我们给出 local 与 gamma-3 两种 prescription。结合 tail 与已知势贡献，我们的结果重现了保守和总 4PM 角以及保守 5PM 角的第二自 force 部分。计入耗散 tail 后，我们重现了通过 5PN 的总 5PM 角，并确定了其新的 6PN 系数。在 6PM 阶，两辐射贡献对总角的贡献将已知的 5PN 结果推广到 6PN。

English: We compute the nonlinear far-zone dynamics of compact binaries at the sixth post-Newtonian (6PN) order in the effective field theory of general relativity. We derive the complete $\mathcal{O}(G^2)$ far-zone action of a generic multipolar source in both the causal and the conservative prescriptions. Besides the known tails and failed tails, it contains five new sectors generated by the nonlinear memory of the emitted waves. On scattering orbits, they contain a boundary term, nonlocal in time, fixed by the balance of angular momentum. The same construction yields the emitted waveforms, whose energy and angular-momentum fluxes balance the losses of the action. For the binary, the 6PN dynamics also requires PN corrections to the lower-order sectors, the iterated radiation reaction, and a coupling quadratic in the curvature of the composite source, whose coefficient we fix by matching the gravitational Compton amplitude to that of the constituents. We compute the two-radiation contributions to the total scattering angle at fourth, fifth and sixth post-Minkowskian (PM) order and to the conservative angle at 4PM and 5PM, retaining the integer-PN terms through 6PN. For the conservative angle, we give both the local and $\gamma$-3 prescriptions. Combined with the tail and the known potential contributions, our results reproduce the conservative and total 4PM angles and the second-self-force part of the conservative 5PM angle. Including the dissipative tail, we recover the total 5PM angle through 5PN and determine its new 6PN coefficient. At 6PM, the two-radiation contribution to the total angle extends the known 5PN result to 6PN.

中文摘要：研究全局 AdS4 中带动力学标量物质的线性化引力重构，基于固定边界度规和非平凡可归一化数据的真空 Einstein 扰动。外部标量源制备激发态并修正全息 Ward 恒等式，随后演化可在无边界驱动下进行。将体物质源响应与真空扰动分离，推导出含 Einstein 约束所要求物质修正的电四极主方程。还验证柱形边界积分逐模重现 Regge-Wheeler 主模场，但不将其等同于完整全局 Fefferman-Graham 重构。对弱相互作用标量（在平直空间极限下无质量），从推迟引力演化中提取 Bondi shear 和 news。所得超平移记忆与出射能量重分布及边界功的四极矩数值一致。在有序平直空间极限下，后续边界控制不改变首个事件波形，尽管在有限 AdS 半径下会抵消残余引力模式。

English: We study linearized gravitational reconstruction in global AdS$_4$ with dynamical scalar matter, building on vacuum Einstein perturbations with fixed boundary metric and nontrivial normalizable data. External scalar sources prepare an excited state and modify the holographic Ward identities, while subsequent evolution can proceed without boundary driving. Separating the bulk matter-sourced response from vacuum perturbations, we derive an electric quadrupole master equation with the matter-dependent corrections required by the Einstein constraints. We also verify that a cylindrical boundary integral reproduces the Regge--Wheeler master field mode by mode, without identifying it with the full global Fefferman--Graham reconstruction. For weakly interacting scalars that become massless in the flat-space limit, we extract the Bondi shear and news from retarded gravitational evolution. The resulting supertranslation memory agrees numerically with the outgoing energy redistribution and the quadrupole moment of the boundary work. In the ordered flat-space limit, later boundary controls leave the first event's waveform unchanged, despite cancelling residual gravitational modes at finite AdS radius.

一句话导读：在 AdS4 线性化引力中由标量源制备激发态，并在平直空间极限下提取 Bondi shear/news 与超平移引力记忆。

AdS/CFT 平直极限中的希尔伯特空间 II. 无质量粒子

Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. II. Massless particles

Kevin Nguyen · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：承接本系列第一部分（其中描述了大质量散射态的出现），本文展示固定维度 Δ 和任意整数自旋 s 的共形群幺正最低权表示 D(Δ,s) 如何收缩为无质量 Poincaré 粒子表示。这需要将 Inönü–Wigner 收缩 so(2,3)→iso(1,3) 与无穷大 boost 结合，此时无质量散射态自然以 Carrollian 基出现。对于 Δ>s+1，D(Δ,s) 收缩为所有自旋 s'≤s 的无质量粒子的直和。在幺正界，低自旋态变为零范数态，因此 D(s+1,s) 收缩为携带两个最大螺旋度 J=±s 的单一无质量粒子表示。两种情形下，内积在一次与螺旋度无关的重标度后收敛到 Poincaré 不变内积，因此整个收缩过程保持幺正性。

English: Building on Part I of this series, where we described the emergence of massive scattering states, we demonstrate how unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group with fixed dimension $\Delta$ and arbitrary integer spin $s$ contract to massless Poincar\'e particle representations. This requires combining the In\"on\"u--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$ with an infinite boost, in which case massless scattering states naturally emerge in a carrollian basis. For $\Delta>s+1$, we find that $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ contracts to the direct sum of massless particles of all spins $s'\leq s$. At the unitarity bound, lower-spin states become null so that $\mathcal D(s+1,s)$ contracts to a single massless particle representation carrying the two maximal helicities $J=\pm s$. In both cases, the inner product converges to the Poincar\'e-invariant one after a single helicity-independent rescaling, so that unitarity is preserved throughout the contraction.

一句话导读：通过 so(2,3)→iso(1,3) 收缩与无穷 boost，证明共形群最低权表示在 AdS/CFT 平直极限中给出无质量 Poincaré 粒子并保持幺正性。

脐点观测站

Umbilic Observatories

Dionysios Anninos, Ra\'ul Arias, Dami\'an A Galante · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：本文研究四维广义相对论中最简单的脐点边界例子——嵌入四维 Minkowski 时空的三维 de Sitter 超曲面上的引力动力学。脐点面的诱导度规与外曲率成比例。我们考虑在类时超曲面上施加共形边界条件和 Dirichlet 边界条件两种情形。两种情形下均未发现虚频率随角动量增长的线性模式。共形边界条件除体激发外还允许一个动力学边界自由度；脐点性质使边界 Weyl 模式与体动力学线性解耦，从而得到线性稳定的动力学。相反，Dirichlet 问题没有边界模式。因此脐点超曲面可能为在存在类时边界时定义引力动力学提供更好的起点。分析中还将结构与渐近 Minkowski 时空的空间无穷及其更有限的实现进行类比。

English: We study gravitational dynamics for the simplest example of an umbilic boundary in four-dimensional general relativity --- a three-dimensional de Sitter hypersurface embedded in a four-dimensional Minkowski world. Generally speaking, an umbilic surface has the property that its induced metric is proportional to its extrinsic curvature. We consider the case of both conformal boundary conditions, as well as Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed at the timelike hypersurface. For both cases, we find that there are no linearised modes whose imaginary frequency grows with angular momentum. The conformal boundary conditions allow for a dynamical boundary degree of freedom, in addition to the bulk excitations. The umbilic property linearly decouples the boundary Weyl mode from the bulk dynamics, yielding linearly stable dynamics. In contrast, the Dirichlet problem has no boundary mode. The umbilic hypersurfaces may thus constitute an improved starting point for defining gravitational dynamics in the presence of a timelike boundary. Throughout our analysis, we draw parallels to the structure of spatial infinity for asymptotically Minkowski spacetimes and a more finite realisation thereof.

一句话导读：研究四维 Minkowski 中嵌入的三维 dS 脐点边界上的线性引力动力学与边界条件稳定性。

AdS黑洞的共形边界与光子球

Conformal boundaries and the photon sphere of AdS black holes

Ra\'ul Arias, Valentino Di Pierro, Silvia Georgescu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：本文研究具有有限类时边界、并满足共形边界条件的四维Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞的线性化引力扰动。这些边界条件固定诱导度规的共形类与平均曲率，同时允许边界Weyl模涨落。光子球在此问题中具有特殊地位：位于该半径的静态边界是全脐的，标量问题可精确分离为独立的体扇区与边界扇区。作者证明，对于二阶及更高阶球谐，不存在指数增长的标量与矢量模式；并确定当边界趋近全脐时，大角动量不稳定性如何被抑制。在视界附近，他们恢复了通用的Rindler谱，包括声学与剪切激发。随后数值追踪这些流体模式随边界向外移动的演化，发现它们趋近渐近AdS4边界处的标准引力拟正规模。对于大黑洞，这些渐近端点对应对偶三维共形场论中的声学与剪切极点。文章还研究了AdS4黑膜扰动，并在没有中间全脐边界的情况下发现流体模式的类似延拓。

English: We study linearized gravitational perturbations of four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with finite timelike boundaries subject to conformal boundary conditions. These fix the conformal class of the induced metric and the mean curvature, while allowing the boundary Weyl mode to fluctuate. The photon sphere plays a distinguished role in this problem: a static boundary at this radius is totally umbilic, and the scalar problem separates exactly into independent bulk and boundary sectors. We prove the absence of exponentially growing scalar and vector modes for spherical harmonics of degree two and higher. We determine how large angular momentum instabilities are suppressed as the boundary approaches umbilicity. Near the horizon, we recover the universal Rindler spectrum, including sound and shear excitations. We numerically follow these fluid modes as the boundary is moved outwards and find that they approach standard gravitational quasinormal modes at the asymptotic AdS$_4$ boundary. For large black holes, these asymptotic endpoints correspond to the sound and shear poles of the dual three-dimensional conformal field theory. We also study perturbations of the AdS$_4$ black brane, where we find an analogous continuation of the fluid modes in the absence of an intermediate umbilic boundary.

一句话导读：研究有限共形边界下Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞的线性引力扰动，揭示光子球全脐边界、稳定性、Rindler流体模式与对偶CFT声学/剪切极点之间的联系。

AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$中的巨引力子与环面箭图规范理论的超共形指数

Giant Gravitons in AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$ and the Superconformal Index of Toric Quiver Gauge Theories

Evan Deddo, Sabarenath Jayaprakash, James T. Liu, Leopoldo A. Pando Zayas · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-02

中文摘要：我们通过在IIB型背景AdS$_5\times SE_5$中量子化探针D3膜，导出巨引力子对超共形指数的贡献。对于$SE_5=T^{1,1}$和$Y^{p,q}$，我们确定最大巨引力子的标量、矢量与费米子涨落，并提取其BPS谱。所得单字母指数与对偶环面箭图规范理论的巨引力子展开预言一致。这些结果表明，有限$N$超对称计数函数中的单巨引力子项可直接由量子化D3膜自由度恢复，并指向巨引力子展开在超引力侧具有普适的世界体起源。我们将结果视为一种内禀引力框架（类似开-闭-开三元性）的一步，用于处理通常外包给对偶场论的超对称微观态计数问题。

English: We derive giant-graviton contributions to superconformal indices by quantizing probe D3-branes in type IIB backgrounds $\mathrm{AdS}_{5}\times SE_{5}$. For $SE_{5}=T^{1,1}$ and $Y^{p,q}$, we determine the scalar, vector, and fermionic fluctuations of maximal giant gravitons and extract their BPS spectra. The resulting single-letter indices agree with those predicted by the giant-graviton expansions of the dual toric quiver gauge theories. These results show that the single-giant terms in finite-$N$ supersymmetric counting functions can be recovered directly from quantized D3-brane degrees of freedom and point toward a universal worldvolume origin of giant-graviton expansions directly on the supergravity side. We view the results as a step in an intrinsically gravitational framework, much like the open-closed-open triality, for addressing supersymmetric microstate-counting problems that are conventionally outsourced to the dual field theory.

一句话导读：量子化AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$中的探针D3膜，从超引力侧直接重现巨引力子对环面箭图规范理论超共形指数的单巨引力子贡献。

基于天体物理启发质量函数的多代黑洞种群分析

Multi-Generational Black Hole Population Analysis with an Astrophysically Informed Mass Function

Yannick Ulrich, Djuna Croon, Jeremy Sakstein, Samuel McDermott · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们利用由脉动对不稳定性超新星（PPISN）大质量恒星模拟得到的参数化质量函数，分析LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA GWTC-3目录中的黑洞种群统计。该形式可将黑洞质量函数分解为不同天体物理形成通道的并合子种群，从而分别推断恒星坍缩形成的黑洞和先前并合形成的黑洞性质。应用该形式，我们发现该模型以9.7±0.1的Bayes因子比powerlaw+peak模型更好地拟合数据；测得黑洞质量隙上边缘下界为M_BHMG=84.05_{-12.88}^{+17.19} M_sun，表明其他模型探测到的35 M_sun高斯峰并非与该质量隙前预期的PPISN堆积相关。结合自旋，我们发现恒星遗迹黑洞的归一化自旋接近零，而高代黑洞自旋趋于较大值。最后，我们将质量函数与谱警笛方法结合测量哈勃常数，得到H0=36.19_{-10.91}^{17.50} km/s/Mpc，并讨论该低值的可能解释。结果表明，天体物理启发的质量函数可促进对引力波目录数据的解释，以提供黑洞形成和宇宙学信息。

English: We analyze the population statistics of black holes in the LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA GWTC-3 catalog using a parametric mass function derived from simulations of massive stars experiencing pulsational pair-instability supernovae (PPISN). Our formalism enables us to separate the black hole mass function into sub-populations corresponding to mergers between objects formed via different astrophysical pathways, allowing us to infer the properties of black holes formed from stellar collapse and black holes formed via prior mergers separately. Applying this formalism, we find that this model fits the data better than the powerlaw+peak model with Bayes factor $ 9.7\pm0.1$. We measure the location of the lower edge of the upper black hole mass gap to be $M_{\rm BHMG}=84.05_{-12.88}^{+17.19}{\rm M}_{\odot}$, providing evidence that the $35{\rm M}_{\odot}$ Gaussian peak detected in the data using other models is not associated with the PPISN pile-up predicted to precede this gap. Incorporating spin, we find that the normalized spins of stellar remnant black holes are close to zero while those of higher generation black holes tend to larger values. All of these results are in accordance with the predictions of stellar structure theory and black hole merger scenarios. Finally, we combine our mass function with the spectral siren method for measuring the Hubble constant to find $H_0=36.19_{-10.91}^{17.50}$ km/s/Mpc and discuss potential explanations of this low value. Our results demonstrate how astrophysically-informed mass functions can facilitate the interpretation of gravitational wave catalog data to provide information about black hole formation and cosmology. Future data releases will improve the precision of our measurements.

一句话导读：用PPISN启发的参数化质量函数分解GWTC-3黑洞并合种群，并联合自旋与谱警笛约束形成通道和H0。

五维旋转黑洞周围带电粒子的引力波信号与周期轨道：与Kerr黑洞比较

Gravitational-Wave Signatures and Periodic Orbits of Charged Particles Around a Five-Dimensional Rotating Black Hole: Comparison with the Kerr Black Hole

Bahromjon Shokirov, Tursunali Xamidov, Chen Zhou, Sanjar Shaymatov, Chengxun Yuan · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：研究五维旋转Myers-Perry黑洞赤道面带电粒子在均匀磁场中的周期轨道，以及极端质量比旋进中发出的引力波，并与均匀磁场中的Kerr黑洞比较。发现带电粒子在五维黑洞中束缚更弱，ISCO能量接近1（0.95--0.99，Kerr为0.78--0.94），势井深度小几倍，周期轨道更靠近分界线。磁场可使方位频率小于径向频率，并在远离黑洞处产生环圈。用数值kludge方法计算10M⊙致密天体绕10^6M⊙黑洞的波形；同磁场下五维信号周期更长、频率更低、振幅小约18%。磁场参数βM=0.02时最强谱线为7.9 mHz，Kerr为9.9 mHz。辐射反作用估计表明周期轨道在外磁场下存活不到一小时到几天；LISA信噪比为7--31，Kerr约为15--54。

English: We study periodic orbits of charged particles in the equatorial plane of a five-dimensional ($D=5$) rotating Myers--Perry black hole (BH) immersed in a uniform magnetic field, and the gravitational waves emitted by these orbits in an extreme mass-ratio inspiral. All results are compared with the Kerr BH in the uniform magnetic field. We find that a charged particle is much more weakly bound to the $D=5$ dimensional BH, i.e. its energy at the innermost stable circular orbit is close to unity, $0.95$--$0.99$, compared with $0.78$--$0.94$ for the Kerr BH, and the depth of the potential well is several times smaller. As a result, the periodic orbits of the $D=5$ dimensional BH lie much closer to the separatrix. The magnetic field can make the azimuthal frequency of the orbit smaller than the radial one and produces loops in the orbits far from the BH. Using the numerical kludge method, we compute the gravitational waveforms for a compact object of $10M_\odot$ orbiting a BH of $10^6M_\odot$. At the same magnetic field, the $D=5$ dimensional signal has a longer period, lower frequencies, and an amplitude smaller by about $18\%$. We show that for the magnetic parameter $\beta M=0.02$ the strongest spectral line is at $7.9$\,mHz, compared with $9.9$\,mHz for the Kerr BH. An estimate of the radiation reaction shows that the periodic orbits survive from less than an hour to a few days in the presence of an external magnetic field. Over these lifetimes, the signal-to-noise ratio for LISA is $7$--$31$ for the rotating BH in $D=5$ dimensions, compared to the Kerr BH where it is about $15$--$54$.

一句话导读：比较五维Myers-Perry黑洞与Kerr黑洞中带电粒子周期轨道及EMRI引力波，磁场下五维信号频率更低、振幅更小、LISA信噪比更低。

标量-张量引力中具有反德西特核心的规则磁黑洞：轴向稳定性与径向不稳定性

Regular magnetic black holes with anti-de Sitter cores in scalar-tensor gravity: axial stability and radial instability

Rustam Ibadov, Najibullokhon Shukurullokhon · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们在爱因斯坦框架的标量-张量引力中构造静态、渐近平坦的规则黑洞，源为与磁非线性电动力学耦合的正则标量场。通过给定密度与标量剖面，重构度规、标量-光子耦合和势。规则性要求质量函数在中心消失，从而固定ADM质量，并要求密度的中心 r^2 增长由标量梯度能补偿。解具有由负势支持的反德西特核心和近Reissner-Nordström外部；无鬼条件将磁荷限制在一个区间，该区间在有限核心深度处收缩为零。轴向扰动化为对称双通道主方程，其正定势保证模式稳定性；谱方法与时间域得到的准正规模频率一致。相反，径向扰动不稳定：重构势在渐近真空附近表现为 V∝-φ^5，标量在视界外变为快子，且每个无鬼黑洞都有一个增长的单极模，ΓM≈0.14–0.28。中心附近出现角拉普拉斯不稳定性；对黑洞它可能完全位于内视界内，而无视界解会将其暴露，因此被排除。

English: We construct static, asymptotically flat regular black holes in Einstein-frame scalar--tensor gravity, sourced by a canonical scalar coupled to magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics. Prescribing the density and scalar profiles, we reconstruct the metric, the scalar--photon coupling and the potential. Regularity requires the mass function to vanish at the centre, which fixes the ADM mass, and the central $r^2$ growth of the density to be compensated by the gradient energy of the scalar. The solutions have an anti-de Sitter core supported by a negative potential and a nearly Reissner--Nordstr\"om exterior; absence of ghosts restricts the magnetic charge to an interval that shrinks to zero at a finite core depth. Axial perturbations reduce to a symmetric two-channel master system whose positive-definite potential guarantees mode stability; spectral and time-domain quasinormal frequencies agree. Radial perturbations, by contrast, are unstable: the reconstructed potential behaves as $V\propto-\varphi^5$ near the asymptotic vacuum, the scalar becomes tachyonic outside the horizon, and every ghost-free black hole has a growing monopole mode with $\Gamma M\approx0.14$--$0.28$. An angular Laplacian instability develops near the centre; for black holes it may lie entirely within the inner horizon, while horizonless solutions leave it uncovered and are therefore excluded.

一句话导读：构造标量-张量引力中的规则磁黑洞并发现轴向稳定但径向/单极不稳定。

Dyonic Simpson Visser black-bounce spacetime surrounded by an exotic Einstein cluster in general relativity

Pedro Ca\~nate, Joseph Sultana, Demosthenes Kazanas · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文给出带电场和磁场电荷的双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹时空，它是广义相对论与 Maxwell 电动力学以及径向压为零的各向异性流体耦合的精确解。作者假设该各向异性流体为爱因斯坦星团，由沿圆轨道运动的致密粒子系统构成，只产生切向压而径向压为零。结果表明，电磁 Simpson-Visser 度规（给出正则黑洞时空）可由爱因斯坦星团（提供维持黑洞反弹喉部张开所需的奇异物质）与 Maxwell 电磁场共同作为源，得到爱因斯坦场方程的精确解。

English: In this work, we present the Simpson-Visser black-bounce (SV-BB) spacetime with both electric and magnetic charges (the dyonic SV-BB) as an exact solution of general relativity coupled to Maxwell electrodynamics and an anisotropic fluid with vanishing radial pressure. We assume the anisotropic fluid represents an Einstein cluster, which consists of a dense system of particles moving in circular orbits that generate only tangential pressure and zero radial pressure. We show that the electromagnetic SV-BB metric, which provides a regular black hole spacetime, can be obtained as an exact solution to the Einstein field equations sourced by a combination of an Einstein cluster (which is responsible for providing the exotic matter required to keep a black-bounce throat open) and an electromagnetic field in the framework of Maxwell electrodynamics.

引力作用的远平行重正化

Teleparallel Renormalization of Gravitational Action

Martin Kr\v{s}\v{s}\'ak, Michal Stano · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们研究广义相对论远平行等效中的引力作用量。在该形式中，自旋联络通过表面项对作用量作出贡献，并且当被适当选择时，它通过有效充当抵消项而使作用量正规化。我们以 Schwarzschild 时空为例，解决了这一程序中的若干表观歧义。我们表明，体作用量与准局域作用量之间的表观差异源于与时空奇点相关的贡献，并且准局域作用量与广义相对论中得到的标准结果一致。我们进一步澄清了标架选择在确定相应自旋联络中的作用，表明适当的对角标架与正则标架给出相同的欧氏作用量，而只有适当的对角标架在 Wheeler--DeWitt patch 上重现预期的 Lorentzian 作用量。最后，我们确立了该重整化方案的唯一性，并表明对挠率张量施加适当的衰减行为可以消除剩余的歧义并唯一地固定欧氏作用量。

English: We study the gravitational action in the teleparallel equivalent of general relativity, where the spin connection contributes to the action through a surface term and, when chosen appropriately, regularizes the action by effectively playing the role of a counterterm. We resolve several apparent ambiguities in this procedure using the Schwarzschild spacetime as an example. We show that the apparent discrepancy between bulk and quasilocal actions originates from contributions associated with spacetime singularities, and that the quasilocal action agrees with the standard results obtained in general relativity. We further clarify the role of the tetrad choice in determining the corresponding spin connection, showing that the proper diagonal and canonical frames give the same Euclidean action, while only the proper diagonal frame reproduces the expected Lorentzian action on the Wheeler--DeWitt patch. Finally, we establish the uniqueness of the regularization scheme and show that imposing an appropriate fall-off behavior of the torsion tensor removes the remaining ambiguity and fixes the Euclidean action uniquely.

渐近de Sitter正则黑洞的标量扰动与强宇宙监督

Scalar perturbations and strong cosmic censorship for an asymptotically de Sitter regular black hole

Hang Liu, Hong Guo · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究正则ABGB-dS黑洞时空中标量扰动的准正规模（QNM）以及强宇宙监督（SCC）。主要动机是澄清消除中心奇点的黑洞核心正则化是否也会改变与柯西视界相关的SCC命运。首先研究标量QNM频率对标的量质量和黑洞参数的依赖。对于角量子数l=0，小标量质量可给出纯虚的慢衰减模式；质量足够大时变为复频率，称为dS-like模式。黑洞电荷和宇宙学常数对QNM谱的影响在定性上相反。随后考察无质量和有质量标量扰动下的SCC。无质量情形QNM谱可组织为光子球、dS和近极端族；与RN-dS相比，ABGB-dS中SCC一般更易被破坏，但足够大宇宙学常数会反转此趋势。有质量标量不恢复SCC，反而可通过使系统进入β>1区域增强破坏。最后讨论正则黑洞时空中SCC破坏的可能含义。

English: We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of scalar perturbations and strong cosmic censorship (SCC) in regular Ay\'on-Beato-Garc\'ia-Bronnikov-de Sitter (ABGB-dS) black hole spacetime. The main motivation of this work is to clarify whether the regularization of black hole core, which removes the central singularity, can also change the fate of SCC connected to the Cauchy horizon. We first study the dependence of the scalar QNM frequency (QNF) on the scalar mass and black hole parameters. For angular number $l=0$, a small scalar mass can give rise to a slowly decaying mode which is purely imaginary, while it will become complex for large enough scalar mass and we call it dS-like mode. We also find that the black hole charge and cosmological constant affect the QNM spectrum in qualitatively opposite ways. We then examine SCC under massless and massive scalar perturbations. For massless perturbations, the QNMs spectrum can be organized into photon sphere (PS), de Sitter (dS) and near-extremal (NE) families. Compared with the SCC in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter (RN-dS) case, SCC is generally more easily violated in the ABGB-dS spacetime, although this tendency is reversed for sufficiently large cosmological constant. For massive scalar perturbations, we find that the scalar mass does not restore SCC. Instead, it can enhance the violation by driving the system into the regime $\beta>1$. At last, we discuss what we may expect from the violation of SCC in a regular black hole spacetime.

一句话导读：研究ABGB-dS正则黑洞标量QNM及SCC，发现正则化通常使SCC更易破坏，有质量标量也不恢复SCC。

八极矩与广义相对论中自由落体的非普适性

Octupole moments and the non-universality of free-fall in general relativity

Abraham I. Harte, Paul Ramond · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：广义相对论中的延展物体不一定沿测地线运动，而可能经历依赖于角动量、四极矩、八极矩及更高阶多极矩的加速度。由于不同物体的多极矩演化方式可能不同，即使初始数据相同，不同物体也可能下落不同。本文研究八极矩如何导致自由落体的非普适性。我们首先证明，在任意真空时空中，只有八极矩的无迹分量能影响物体运动，因此40个八极矩分量中至少有16个与运动定律解耦。我们还给出无迹八极矩的两种分解：一种用类时标架矢量，另一种用零标架。将这些分解应用于静态牛顿时空以及完全相对论性的Petrov D型真空时空（如Kerr时空）中的运动。在牛顿时空中，质量矩具有通常的牛顿效应；动量矩则决定物体的隐藏动量，即动量与速度之间的失准。在Petrov D型时空中，我们证明某些在四极矩下不可能的力矩在八极矩下通常是可能的。因此，八极矩可以产生与四极矩定性不同的效应。

English: Extended bodies in general relativity do not necessarily fall along geodesics. Instead, a body can experience accelerations that depend on its angular momentum, as well as on its quadrupole, octupole, and higher-order moments. Moreover, due to the fact that one object's multipole moments can evolve differently from those of another, different bodies can fall differently---even with identical initial data. This paper examines how octupole moments contribute to the non-universality of free-fall in general relativity. We begin by showing that in arbitrary vacuum spacetimes, only the trace-free component of an octupole moment can affect an object's motion. It follows that at least 16 out of 40 octupole components decouple from the laws of motion. We also obtain two decompositions for trace-free octupole moments, one in terms of a timelike frame vector and the other in terms of a null tetrad. These decompositions are applied to motion both in static Newtonian spacetimes and in fully-relativistic vacuum spacetimes that are of Petrov type D (such as Kerr). In Newtonian spacetimes, the mass moments are shown to have their ordinary Newtonian effects. The momentum moments instead determine a body's hidden momentum---the misalignment between its momentum and its velocity. In Petrov type D spacetimes, we show that some torques that are impossible with quadrupole moments are generically possible with octupole moments. Octupole moments can thus have qualitatively-different effects from quadrupole moments.

一句话导读：论文分析八极矩对广义相对论中延展物体自由落体非普适性的贡献，并给出无迹八极矩的分解及其在牛顿与Petrov D型时空中的应用。

EMRIs中暗物质与吸积盘环境效应的偏心率调制相位简并及可区分性

Eccentricity-Modulated Phase Degeneracy and Distinguishability between Dark Matter and Accretion Disk Environmental Effects in EMRIs

Tian-Hao Wu, Shu-Jun Rong · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）是探测大质量黑洞周围弱环境效应的敏感探针，因为这些效应可累积为可观测的引力波相位偏移。本文研究偏心EMRI波形中暗物质晕与吸积盘之间的相位简并。我们用NFW和Beta晕模型描述暗物质环境，并用薄α盘模型描述吸积盘。其可区分性通过依赖偏心率的相位诊断量和LISA波段的残余信噪比来量化。结果表明，暗物质导致的退相位仅微弱依赖初始偏心率e0，而吸积盘导致的退相位随e0增大而受到强烈抑制。可区分时间对初始偏心率呈现平滑且弱非单调的依赖，但更强烈地受环境强度控制。对于本文考虑的基准系统，暗物质与吸积盘的波形差异可被LISA探测，且e0可作为观测时长之外的辅助诊断量。

English: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are sensitive probes of weak environmental effects around massive black holes, since such effects can accumulate into observable gravitational-wave phase shifts. In this work, we study the phase degeneracy between dark matter halos and accretion disks in eccentric EMRI waveforms. We model the dark matter (DM) environment with NFW and Beta halo profiles, and describe the disk using a thin $\alpha$-disk model. Their distinguishability is quantified through eccentricity-dependent phase diagnostics and the residual signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in the LISA band. Our results show that DM-induced dephasing depends only weakly on the initial eccentricity $e_0$, whereas disk-induced dephasing is strongly suppressed as $e_0$ increases. The distinguishability time exhibits a smooth and weakly non-monotonic dependence on the initial eccentricity, while being more strongly controlled by the environmental strength. For the benchmark systems considered here, the DM--disk waveform difference can be detectable by LISA, and $e_0$ can serve as an auxiliary diagnostic in addition to the observation duration.

一句话导读：研究偏心EMRI波形中暗物质晕与吸积盘环境效应的相位简并，并评估LISA对其可区分性。

引力波穿过暗物质晕传播的波动光学效应

Wave Optics Effects from Gravitational Wave Propagation Through Dark Matter Halos

Annamalai P. Shanmugaraj, Roland Haas, Erik Schnetter, Sofie Marie Koksbang · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：引力波传播通常用几何光学近似研究，但当引力波穿过尺度与其波长相近的结构时该近似失效。本文提出一种数值演化方案，在弱场和强场情形下让线性化平面引力波穿过静态球对称天体物理结构，并针对高斯、NFW 和 Burkert 势演化包含全部 10 个分量的完整 Einstein 方程。模拟表明，引力波散射不仅依赖透镜质量，也强烈依赖透镜的引力势分布。重要结果包括：穿过高斯密度分布时，无论强场还是弱场，引力波都不沿零测地线传播；在 Burkert 势的强场情形中，波离开结构时其凸性发生翻转。作者还与线性标量波预言比较，发现波位于中心势内时精确引力波模式与标量波预言相差量级为一，而穿过结构后差异降至仅百分之几。尽管效应较小，未来引力波探测器和脉冲星计时阵列可能对其敏感，从而有助约束暗物质尖峰或晕的结构。

English: Gravitational wave (GW) propagation is usually studied under the geometric optics approximation. However, when GWs propagate through structures of sizes similar to their wavelength, this approximation breaks down. To study this situation, we present a scheme for numerically evolving linearised plane GWs through stationary, spherical astrophysical structures in both weak and strong gravity regimes. Our simulations evolve the full Einstein equations (with all 10 components) for Gaussian, NFW and Burkert potentials. Our simulations show that the scattering of the GWs depends not only on the mass of the lens but also strongly on the gravitational potential distribution of the lens. Among our most important results, we find that the GWs do not propagate along null geodesics when propagating through the Gaussian density, neither in the strong nor weak gravity setting. Another significant finding is that in the strong gravity case of the Burkert potential, the convexity of the wave is flipped when leaving the structure. We compare our results with the linearized scalar wave predictions and find that the difference between these and the exact GW modes are of order one when the wave is inside the central potential. However, the difference reduces to only a few percent when the wave has passed through the structure. Although these effects are small, future GW detectors and Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) could be sensitive to these signals which could thus potentially help in constraining the structure of dark matter spikes or halos.

一句话导读：数值演化完整线性化 Einstein 方程，研究引力波穿过球形暗物质晕势时偏离几何光学的波动光学效应。

非保守共形Killing引力：暗扇区与曲率和物质的耦合

Non conservative conformal Killing gravity: coupling the dark sector with curvature and matter

Salvatore Capozziello, Carlo Alberto Mantica, Luca Guido Molinari · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文考虑具有非保守能量动量张量的 Harada 引力，它是 Rastall 引力的推广。场方程写成 Einstein 方程形式，其源项除无散度的共形 Killing 张量外，还包含一个与度规成正比、线性依赖于标量曲率和能量动量张量迹的张量；这些项可作为暗扇区的自然候选，并导致暗扇区与物质内容耦合。该场方程是 Rastall 引力的共形 Killing 推广，并包含幺模引力。在 FRW 背景下，CMB 限制参数使暗扇区只与能量动量张量的迹耦合。文中给出暗扇区张量的显式形式，给出 Friedmann 方程和连续性方程，并进行标准宇宙学分析。尘埃物质与暗流体的能量动量张量之和守恒，尘埃能量密度随尺度因子按指数 -3/(1+tau) 演化，并受到与暗流体耦合 tau 的修正。

English: The so called Harada gravity with non conserved energy-momentum tensor is here taken into account. It includes Rastall gravity as a special case. The field equations are written as Einstein equations where the source is supplemented by a divergence-free conformal Killing tensor and a tensor proportional to the metric, linear in the scalar curvature and the trace of the energy-momentum tensor. These terms can be natural candidates for dark sector and give rise to a coupling of the dark sector with the matter content. The field equations are the conformal Killing extension of Rastall gravity, and include Unimodular gravity. In a Friedmann-Robertson-Walker background, the Cosmic Microwave Background restricts parameters so that the dark sector only couples with the trace of the energy-momentum tensor. The explicit form of the tensor for the dark sector is found, and the Friedmann and continuity equations are presented, with a standard cosmological analysis. The sum of energy-momentum tensors of dust matter and of dark fluid is conserved, and the dust energy density evolves with the scale function with exponent -3/(1+tau), modified by the coupling tau with the dark fluid.

一句话导读：在非保守共形Killing引力/Rastall推广框架下构建暗扇区与曲率、物质迹耦合的FRW宇宙学模型。

扰动 de Sitter 膜世界中纯虚准正规模中实部的涌现

Real Part Emergence in Purely Imaginary Quasinormal Modes in Perturbed de Sitter Braneworlds

Hai-Long Jia, Wen-Di Guo, Yun-Tao Gu, Yu-Xiao Liu · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：对于具有无穷额外维的膜世界，特征谱稳定性分析对理解其动力学性质至关重要；本文研究具有非紧致额外维的厚 de Sitter 膜世界的引力准正规模（QNM）谱稳定性，其未扰动背景支持局域化引力子零模和一列纯虚 QNM。我们首先重构翘曲因子和张量有效势对体标量场光滑双 kink 形变的响应，然后引入超势形变以参数化由此产生的双势垒结构；形变后的频域谱发展出具有非零实部的 QNM 对，并且对于所研究的代表性参数族，弱形变已能产生复分支，尽管在部分参数范围内最弱阻尼极点仍为纯虚。在时域中，QNM 主导通道显示瞬态阻尼振荡阶段，而原势演化在模拟区间的晚期由零模部分主导。这些结果将双势垒几何识别为出射、非自伴谱更普遍敏感性在特定模型中的实现，建立了振荡 QNM 印记的稳健模型级机制，并为未来源到探测器分析提供无量纲基准；定量探测器可探测性和宇宙学参数推断需要超出本文的源、响应和噪声建模。

English: For braneworlds with infinite extra dimensions, an analysis of the stability of the characteristic spectrum is essential for understanding their dynamical properties; in this study, we investigate the stability of the gravitational quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectrum of a thick de Sitter braneworld with a noncompact extra dimension, where the unperturbed background supports a localized graviton zero mode and a tower of purely imaginary QNMs. We first reconstruct the response of the warp factor and tensor effective potential to a smooth double-kink deformation of the bulk scalar field, and then introduce a superpotential deformation that parametrizes the resulting double-barrier structure; the deformed frequency-domain spectrum develops QNM pairs with nonzero real parts, and for the representative family studied here, a weak deformation can already generate a complex branch, although the least-damped pole remains purely imaginary in part of the parameter range. In the time domain, the QNM-dominated channel exhibits a transient damped oscillatory stage, whereas the original-potential evolution becomes dominated by the zero-mode sector at late times over the simulated interval. These results identify the double-barrier geometry as the model-specific realization of a more general sensitivity of outgoing, non-self-adjoint spectra, establish a robust model-level mechanism for oscillatory QNM imprints, and provide a dimensionless benchmark for future source-to-detector analyses, while quantitative detector detectability and cosmological-parameter inference require source, response, and noise modeling beyond the present analysis.

一句话导读：研究厚 dS 膜世界在双 kink/双势垒形变下，原本纯虚的引力 QNM 谱如何产生非零实部，并在时域出现瞬态阻尼振荡。

Gravitational wave polarization modes and stability analysis in Weyl geometry gravity

Yu-Zhi Fan, Xiao-Bin Lai, Yu-Qi Dong, Yu-Xiao Liu · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文在Minkowski背景下研究Weyl几何引力中的引力波偏振模式与稳定性。结果表明：张量扇区包含两个以光速传播的标准模式；矢量扇区虽有动力学扰动，但不产生偏振模式；标量扇区则表现为呼吸模式与纵向模式的混合，对应单一标量自由度。该标量模式的传播解会出现超光速传播和本征振幅衰减，二者均由背景Weyl规范场驱动。文章进一步讨论该标量模式的可探测性，并发现张量与矢量扇区无鬼模和Laplacian不稳定性，而标量扇区存在鬼不稳定性。

English: We investigate the gravitational wave polarization modes and stability in Weyl geometry gravity within a Minkowski background. Our results indicate that the tensor sector consists of two standard modes propagating at the speed of light. Although the vector sector possesses a dynamical perturbation, it generates no polarization modes. The scalar sector, in contrast, features a mixture mode of breathing and longitudinal modes associated with a single scalar degree of freedom. The propagating solutions of this scalar mode exhibit superluminal propagation and can undergo intrinsic amplitude decay, both of which are driven by the background Weyl gauge field. We further discuss the observational detectability of this scalar mode. Our stability analysis reveals that, while the tensor and vector sectors are free from ghost and Laplacian instabilities, the scalar sector suffers from a ghost instability. These findings clarify the unique gravitational wave propagation characteristics in Weyl geometry gravity and provide theoretical foundations for testing the theory through future multi-messenger observations.

一句话导读：分析Weyl几何引力中引力波偏振模式及稳定性，发现标量混合模式可超光速且存在鬼不稳定性。

周期轨道引力波中量子修正黑洞的印记

Signatures of Quantum-Corrected Black Holes in Gravitational Waves from Periodic Orbits

Fazlay Ahmed, Qiang Wu, Sushant G Ghosh, Tao Zhu · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究由圈量子引力 holonomy 修正的 Schwarzschild 时空中，试验质量在束缚周期轨道上产生的引力辐射。度规含量子修正参数 q_c，改变径向标度但保持渐近平直性和经典视界半径。束缚测地线用 (z,w,v) 三个整数标记的 zoom-whirl 表示系统分类。数值框架结合精确测地线运动与适用于极端质量比旋进的四极近似来计算引力波波形。结果表明，量子修正导致相位移动、振幅变化以及波形谐波结构的改变，且 zoom 数越大特征越复杂。相应频谱和特征应变峰值位于毫赫兹波段，落在 LISA、太极、天琴等空间探测器的灵敏度范围内；对特定轨道配置和 q_c 值，特征应变超过预期探测器噪声，表明可能可观测。结果说明周期轨道引力波可作为强场区量子修正黑洞时空的敏感探针。

English: Focusing on a Schwarzschild spacetime modified by loop quantum gravity (LQG) holonomy corrections, this work explores the gravitational radiation produced by test masses in bound periodic configurations. The underlying geometry incorporates a quantum-correction parameter $q_c$ that alters the radial metric scaling while maintaining both asymptotic flatness and the classical horizon radius. The bound geodesics are systematically classified using the zoom--whirl representation labelled by three integers $(z,w,v)$. Gravitational waveforms are computed within a numerical framework that combines exact geodesic motion with the quadrupole approximation, which is suitable for extreme mass ratio inspirals. We demonstrate that the quantum corrections lead to distinct phase shifts, amplitude variations, and modifications to the harmonic structure of the waveforms, with increasingly complex features for orbits with larger zoom numbers. The corresponding frequency spectra and characteristic strain peak, which fall within the millihertz band, are within the sensitivity ranges of space-based detectors such as LISA, Taiji, and TianQin. For specific orbital configurations and values of the quantum-correction parameter, the characteristic strain exceeds the projected detector noise, indicating potential observability. Our results demonstrate that gravitational waves from periodic orbits provide a sensitive probe of quantum-corrected black hole spacetimes in the strong-field regime.

共形标量-张量引力理论中的马赫波效应

A Machian wave effect in conformal, scalar-tensor gravitational theory

Jos\'e Rodal · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：Woodward 的同时能量密度恒等式在物理光速恒定且固有密度非零时被精确施加，会固定势并排除其推导中使用的独立势导数；若作背景解释，则需要该推导省略的扰动项。在广义相对论中，从精确 Landau-Lifshitz 方程分离出的二阶时间导数属于引力算子，不提供额外的物质质量源。在 Woodward 与 Fearn 的 Hoyle-Narlikar 推导中，线性二阶时间导数从 time-time 分量中抵消；协变迹抵消了 Fearn 对角求和中保留的平方梯度项。其推进估计在机械功率、动量传递和本构量纲方面还有进一步错误。力学分析保留阻尼、复谐响应以及耗散能量与熵平衡。对于光滑且严格为正的标量，在可容许 Weyl 变换、普适物质耦合以及一致映射的物质、驱动和边界数据下，完整的连续共形 HN 作用量变为 Einstein 作用量。在这些假设下，对于同一物理物质模型，相对于相应 Einstein 结果的额外测量力恒为零。相容的全局源积分与吸收体条件会限制容许解并保持该等式。Woodward 与 Fearn 的质量涨落和推进公式不能由所述 GR 或连续共形 HN 方程推出；在所述假设下，其额外标量推进力在局部连续区中被排除。

English: Woodward's simultaneous energy-density identities, imposed exactly with a constant physical speed of light and nonzero proper density, fix the potential and exclude the independent potential derivatives used in his derivation. A background interpretation instead requires the perturbation terms omitted by that derivation. In general relativity (GR), the second time derivative isolated from the exact Landau-Lifshitz equations belongs to the gravitational operator and supplies no additional material mass source. In the Hoyle-Narlikar (HN) derivation of Woodward and Fearn, the linear second time derivative cancels from the time-time component; the covariant trace cancels the squared-gradient terms retained in Fearn's diagonal sum. Their propulsion estimates contain further errors in mechanical power, momentum transfer and constitutive dimensions. The mechanical analysis retains damping, complex harmonic response and the dissipative energy and entropy balances. For a smooth strictly positive scalar, an admissible Weyl transformation, universal material coupling and consistently mapped matter, driving and boundary data, the complete continuum conformal HN action becomes the Einstein action. Under these hypotheses, the additional measured force relative to the corresponding Einstein result is identically zero for the same physical matter model. Compatible global source-integral and absorber conditions restrict the admitted solutions and preserve this equality. Woodward and Fearn's mass-fluctuation and propulsion formulas do not follow from the stated GR or continuum conformal HN equations. Their additional scalar propulsion force is excluded in the local continuum sector under the stated hypotheses.

一句话导读：论文论证在给定共形标量-张量/HN 与 GR 框架及假设下，Woodward-Fearn 的额外质量涨落与标量推进力不能成立。

从天体物理符合事件探测引力波透镜的误报率：基于模型无关技术GLANCE的洞见

False Alarm Rates in Detecting Gravitational Wave Lensing from Astrophysical Coincidences: Insights with Model-Independent Technique GLANCE

Aniruddha Chakraborty, Suvodip Mukherjee · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE · v4 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：引力波经过源与观测者之间的致密天体系统时会发生透镜效应，这是广义相对论的必然结果，可产生天区定位误差重叠的多个引力波事件。然而，探测器噪声和天体物理不确定性使确认此类现象具有挑战性。本文研究将一对未透镜引力波事件错误分类为透镜事件的天体物理不确定性及相应误报率，并使用模型无关 pipeline GLANCE 对模拟的双黑洞并合族群进行检验。结果显示，在透镜信噪比阈值为 1.5 时，约 0.01% 的事件对可被误分类为透镜事件，且出现在约 1000 天或更长的时间延迟处。文中给出了 GLANCE 在当前 LIGO 灵敏度下可置信探测透镜引力波对的质量、延迟时间和放大率参数空间中的误报率分布，并指出该技术未来可用于理解下一代引力波探测器的透镜误报率。

English: Lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) due to intervening massive astrophysical systems between the source and the observer is an inevitable consequence of the general theory of relativity, which can produce multiple GW events with overlapping sky localization error. However, the confirmed detection of such a unique astrophysical phenomenon is challenging due to several sources of contamination, ranging from detector noise to astrophysical uncertainties. Robust model-independent search techniques that can mitigate noise contamination have been developed in the past. In this study, we explore the astrophysical uncertainty associated with incorrectly classifying a pair of unlensed GW events as a lensed pair and the associated false alarm rate (FAR) depending on the GW source properties. To understand the effect of unlensed astrophysical GW sources in producing false lensing detections, we perform a model-independent test using the pipeline GLANCE on a simulated population of merging binary black holes (BBHs). We find that $\sim$ 0.01\% of the pair of events can be falsely classified as lensed with a lensing threshold signal-to-noise ratio of 1.5, appearing at a time delay between the pair of events of $\sim$ 1000 days or more. We show the FAR distribution for the parameter space of the GW source masses, delay time, and lensing magnification parameter over which the model-independent technique GLANCE can confidently detect lensed GW pair with the current LIGO detector sensitivity. In the future, this technique will be useful in understanding the lensing FAR for next-generation GW detectors, which can observe more GW sources.

一句话导读：用模型无关方法GLANCE模拟双黑洞并合族群，评估引力波透镜探测中由天体物理符合事件导致的误报率及其参数依赖。

在庞加莱规范与度规远平行引力理论中使用规范协变李导数

Using Gauge Covariant Lie Derivatives in Poincar\'{e} Gauge and Metric Teleparallel Theories of Gravity

R. J. van den Hoogen, H. Forance, L. Taylor, M. Lawton · gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文提出一种确定Riemann-Cartan几何在给定连续对称群下协架和自旋联络初始拟设的方法。假设度规在特定对称群下不变，将规范协变李导数作用于度规及相应正交协架，可确定反对称补偿矩阵；再对自旋联络取该李导数并求解，得到与所选协架相容的自旋联络。该方法适用于包括非平凡迷向子群在内的任意Riemann-Cartan对称几何，并以球对称、平面对称、局部旋转对称Bianchi III型、Gödel、de Sitter和anti-de Sitter等几何为例说明；还求解零曲率约束以得到相应度规远平行几何的自旋联络，并给出部分情形下得到适当标架的Lorentz变换。该工作为庞加莱规范与度规远平行引力理论的进一步研究提供运动学框架。

English: A procedure to determine the initial ansatz for the co-frame and spin connection characterizing a Riemann-Cartan geometry respecting a given group of continuous symmetries is illustrated. Assuming invariance of the metric under a particular group of symmetries, this gauge covariant Lie derivative when applied to the metric and associated orthonormal co-frame determines the values of an antisymmetric compensating matrix. The gauge covariant Lie derivative of the spin connection depends on this matrix, which when solved yields the spin connection compatible with the chosen co-frame. The procedure is straightforward and can be employed for any Riemann-Cartan geometry having symmetries including those with a non-trivial isotropy subgroup. Here we illustrate the procedure with numerous examples, including, spherically symmetric, plane symmetric, locally rotationally symmetric Bianchi type III, G\"{o}del, de Sitter and anti-de Sitter geometries. Further, we have also solved the zero curvature constraint to obtain the resulting spin connection for the corresponding metric teleparallel geometry having this same symmetry group. We complete this investigation by including the Lorentz transformation that yields the proper frame for some of these metric teleparallel geometries. This investigation provides a kinematical framework useful for the further study of Poincar\'{e} Gauge and metric teleparallel theories of gravity.

一句话导读：提出用规范协变李导数系统构造对称Riemann-Cartan几何的协架与自旋联络，并应用于庞加莱规范/度规远平行引力。

de Sitter 膜世界的准正规模铃宕

Quasinormal Ringing of de Sitter Braneworlds

Hai-Long Jia, Wen-Di Guo, Yu-Xiao Liu, Qin Tan · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：与 Poincaré 膜世界相比，de Sitter（dS）膜世界更接近当前宇宙，其宇宙学常数很小但非零；为探索 dS 膜场景中的准正规模铃宕性质，我们研究薄和厚 dS 膜构型中的引力扰动。对扰动方程的分析表明，沿额外维的有效势呈 Pöschl-Teller 势形状，在无穷远处渐近趋于常数值（质量间隙），尤其该质量间隙可被降低。解析计算进一步表明，除零模外，引力扰动在晚期具有一系列离散的、纯虚的准正规模，意味着这些扰动随时间无振荡衰减；解析结果还表明，膜结构主要决定准正规模谱的分布，同时保持准正规模频率的纯虚性质。随后，我们通过数值演化扰动方程进一步模拟引力波信号，得到的晚期结果与解析预言一致。有趣的是，这些准正规模携带膜上宇宙学常数的信息，这为 dS 膜场景中的宇宙学研究提供了潜在新途径。

English: Compared with the Poincar\'e braneworld, the de Sitter (dS) braneworld aligns more closely with the present universe characterized by a small but finite cosmological constant; to explore the quasinormal ringing properties within the dS brane scenario, we investigate gravitational perturbations in both thin and thick dS brane configurations. Analysis of the perturbation equations reveals that the effective potential along the extra dimension exhibits the shape of a P\"oschl-Teller potential, asymptotically approaching a constant value (mass gap) at infinity, and in particular this mass gap can be reduced. Analytical calculations further indicate that the gravitational perturbations, apart from the zero mode, possess a series of discrete, purely imaginary quasinormal modes in the late stages, implying that these perturbations decay without oscillation over time; the analytical findings also demonstrate that the brane structure primarily determines the distribution of the quasinormal spectrum while preserving the purely imaginary nature of the quasinormal frequencies. Subsequently, we further simulate the gravitational wave signal by numerically evolving the perturbation equations, which yields late-stage results consistent with the analytical predictions. Interestingly, these quasinormal modes carry information about the cosmological constant on the brane, which provides a potential new pathway for the study of cosmology in the dS brane scenario.

一句话导读：该文解析和数值研究了薄/厚 dS 膜中引力扰动的准正规模，发现除零模外为纯虚频率并携带膜上宇宙学常数信息。
