双曲黑洞交会中的自作用力

Self-force in hyperbolic black hole encounters

Oliver Long · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：自作用力方法可用于计算两体双曲交会的散射角，按质量比（假定很小）逐阶展开，而不依赖弱场近似。这反过来可帮助构建广义相对论双星动力学的精确描述，例如有效单体描述或其他方法。现有自作用力方法在很大程度上针对束缚的旋进轨道。这里我们导出对散射角的一阶保守自作用力修正，展示其与近期后闵可夫斯基结果一致，并发展一种可有效处理散射轨道的（数值）自作用力计算技术。在该方法中，度规扰动由满足（逐模式）某个非齐次 Teukolsky 方程的 Hertz 势重构。该表述的关键要素是 Hertz 势（的多极模式）沿小天体轨道世界线必须满足的跳跃条件。我们给出 Schwarzschild 时空中任意测地轨道这些跳跃的闭式表达式。为开始发展数值基础设施，开发了 Schwarzschild 背景上的标量场演化代码（1+1D）。随后计算了散射角的保守标量自作用力修正结果。我们继续构建 Schwarzschild 背景上的 Teukolsky 演化代码。由于 Teukolsky 方程在视界和零无穷处的非物理齐次解被数值误差激发，这会产生数值不稳定解。可通过变量变换到类 Regge-Wheeler 场来解决。然后我们给出该方法在 Schwarzschild 中圆轨道和散射轨道上的完整数值实现。

English: Self-force methods can be applied in calculations of the scatter angle in two-body hyperbolic encounters, working order by order in the mass ratio (assumed small) but with no recourse to a weak-field approximation. This, in turn, can inform ongoing efforts to construct an accurate description of the general-relativistic binary dynamics via an effective-one-body description or other approaches. Existing self-force methods are to a large extent specialised to bound, inspiral orbits. Here we derive the first-order conservative self-force correction to the scattering angle, show its agreement with recent post-Minkowsian results, and develop a technique for (numerical) self-force calculations that can efficiently tackle scatter orbits. In the method, the metric perturbation is reconstructed from a Hertz potential that satisfies (mode-by-mode) a certain inhomogeneous version of the Teukolsky equation. The crucial ingredient in this formulation are certain jump conditions that the (multipole modes of the) Hertz potential must satisfy along the worldline of the small body's orbit. We present a closed-form expression for these jumps, for an arbitrary geodesic orbit in Schwarzschild spacetime. To begin developing the numerical infrastructure, a scalar-field evolution code on a Schwarzschild background (in 1+1D) is developed. Following this, results for the conservative scalar self-force corrections to the scatter angle are calculated. We continue by constructing a Teukolsky evolution code on a Schwarzschild background. This produces numerically unstable solutions due to unphysical homogeneous solutions of the Teukolsky equation at the horizon and null infinity being seeded by numerical error. This can be resolved by a change of variables to a Regge-Wheeler-like field. We then present a full numerical implementation of this method for circular and scatter orbits in Schwarzschild.

一句话导读：本文给出 Schwarzschild 时空中双曲散射轨道的一阶保守自作用力修正，并发展基于 Hertz 势与 Teukolsky 演化的数值方法。

双曲散射的时域度规重构

Time-domain metric reconstruction for hyperbolic scattering

Oliver Long, Leor Barack · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v5 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：自力方法可用于计算两体双曲相遇中的散射角，按质量比（假定很小）逐阶展开，但不依赖弱场近似。这反过来可为通过有效单体描述及其他半解析方法构建广义相对论双体动力学的精确模型提供信息。现有自力方法在很大程度上专门针对束缚的旋进轨道。本文发展一种可高效处理散射轨道的（数值）自力计算技术。该方法基于从满足 Teukolsky 方程的类标量 Hertz 势进行度规微扰的时域重构，此前该思路仅用于束缚轨道。该表述的关键要素是 Hertz 势（的每个多极模式）沿轨道必须满足的若干跳跃条件，在问题的 1+1 维多极约化中。我们给出了 Schwarzschild 时空中任意测地轨道的这些跳跃的闭式表达式，并给出散射轨道的完整数值实现。本文侧重方法发展，仅计算到 Hertz 势；自力及其对散射轨道物理效应的计算将留待后续工作。

English: Self-force methods can be applied in calculations of the scatter angle in two-body hyperbolic encounters, working order by order in the mass ratio (assumed small) but with no recourse to a weak-field approximation. This, in turn, can inform ongoing efforts to construct an accurate model of the general-relativistic binary dynamics via an effective-one-body description and other semi-analytical approaches. Existing self-force methods are to a large extent specialised to bound, inspiral orbits. Here we develop a technique for (numerical) self-force calculations that can efficiently tackle scatter orbits. The method is based on a time-domain reconstruction of the metric perturbation from a scalar-like Hertz potential that satisfies the Teukolsky equation, an idea pursued so far only for bound orbits. The crucial ingredient in this formulation are certain jump conditions that (each multipole mode of) the Hertz potential must satisfy along the orbit, in a 1+1-dimensional multipole reduction of the problem. We obtain a closed-form expression for these jumps, for an arbitrary geodesic orbit in Schwarzschild spacetime, and present a full numerical implementation for a scatter orbit. In this paper we focus on method development, and go only as far as calculating the Hertz potential; a calculation of the self-force and its physical effects on the scatter orbit will be the subject of forthcoming work.

一句话导读：发展 Schwarzschild 时空中双曲散射轨道的时域自力度规重构方法，给出 Hertz 势跳跃条件与数值实现。

Twinor Theory: Field Equations from $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$ Spin-Tractors: A Twin to Twistor Theory Modelled on $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$

Chen-Hsu Chien · math-ph, gr-qc, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：Twinor 理论被表述为 twistor 理论的一个基于时空的对应物，使用以复化 $(A)dS_4$ 为模型的全纯约化 Cartan 几何。基本自旋-牵引子丛定义 Dirac twinors，其对称幂定义 ladder twinors，其极端 Lorentz 分量定义手征 twinors。一般 twinor 场方程为 $D\mathbf Y=\mathbf J$。其相邻缩并和混合散度受源关系约束；对其完全对称投影不再施加额外方程。在平直无挠 Lorentz 背景上，带质量归一化源和消失的额外缩并源、以及消失的混合散度，相邻方程重现大质量 Dirac--Fierz--Pauli 系统；无质量手征实现给出零静止质量方程。在固定质量归一化下，给出正实质量平方的实在性条件是在粒子尺度上的反 de Sitter 实在性条件，与宇宙学尺度和背景曲率无关。因此质量耦合相位在量子化之前已存在于经典联络中。非线性引力通过完整伴随曲率表述，能动张量和自旋流指定 Einstein--Cartan 动力学而无需作用量。伴随 Bianchi 恒等式约束源相容性，而 BGG 型序列组织无挠无穷小形变。物质相互作用通过耦合联络和缩并源关系进入，曲率相容性由 $D\mathbf J=\mathcal F_D\mathbf Y$ 记录。两种手征性都保留，并且相互作用高自旋场的额外相容性要求与底层丛构造相区分。

English: Twinor theory is formulated as a spacetime-based counterpart to twistor theory using holomorphic reductive Cartan geometry modelled on complexified $(A)dS_4$. The fundamental spin-tractor bundle defines Dirac twinors, its symmetric powers define ladder twinors, and their extremal Lorentz components define chiral twinors. The general \textit{twinor field equation} is $D\mathbf Y=\mathbf J$. Its adjacent contractions and mixed divergence are constrained by source relations; no additional equation is imposed on its completely symmetric projection. On a flat torsion-free Lorentzian background, the adjacent equations with the mass-normalization source and vanishing additional contracted sources, together with vanishing mixed divergence, reproduce the massive \textit{Dirac--Fierz--Pauli system}; the massless chiral realization gives the zero-rest-mass equations. Within the fixed mass normalization, the reality condition yielding a positive real mass squared is the \textit{anti-de Sitter reality condition} on the particle scale, independently of the cosmological scale and background curvature. The mass-coupling phase is therefore present in the classical connection before quantization. Nonlinear gravity is formulated through the full adjoint curvature, with energy--momentum and spin currents specifying Einstein--Cartan dynamics without requiring an action. The adjoint Bianchi identity constrains source compatibility, while a BGG-type sequence organizes torsion-free infinitesimal deformations. Matter interactions enter through the coupled connection and contracted source relations, with curvature compatibility recorded by $D\mathbf J=\mathcal F_D\mathbf Y$. Both chiralities are retained, and the additional consistency requirements for interacting higher-spin fields are distinguished from the underlying bundle construction.

RAKI：用于广义相对论磁流体力学的高阶替代有限差分方法

RAKI: High-Order Alternative Finite Differences for General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamics

Rahime Matur, Beyhan Karakas, Ian Hawke, Nils Andersson · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph, physics.comp-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：双中子星（BNS）与黑洞—中子星并合是最重要的多信使源之一。观测这些事件有助于理解并合期间及之后磁场放大的效率、磁星与喷流的形成等未解决问题。准确模拟磁场演化对当前广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟仍是挑战。本文提出 RAKI（Relativistic Astrophysics Code Implementation of the Alternative Finite Difference Approach for GRMHD），这是首个使用高阶替代有限差分方法、采用自适应阶 WENO（AFD-WENO-AO）重构以及完全非交错、节点中心矢量势形式来模拟 BNS 并合的 GRMHD 代码。该代码在光滑测试问题中达到最高九阶收敛，同时能准确捕捉间断。在磁化 Tolman—Oppenheimer—Volkoff（TOV）星测试中，RAKI 在约 2 ms 内保留了初始最大磁场强度的 99.2%，在相同分辨率下磁场损失比参考 GRMHD 代码低一个量级。在 BNS 并合模拟中，五阶 AFD-WENO-AO 重构使磁化和非磁化模型中的引力波相位均达到约三阶收敛。即使在使用移动细化区域的 BNS 并合过程中，离散无磁单极约束也在非交错网格上保持到机器精度。这些结果确立了 RAKI 作为高阶、非交错 GRMHD 框架的地位，可用于准确模拟中子星并合中的磁场演化及其对多信使天体物理的影响。

English: Binary neutron star (BNS) and black hole--neutron star mergers are among the most important multimessenger sources. Observations of these events could provide valuable insights into several unresolved phenomena, ranging from the efficiency of magnetic field amplification during and after mergers to the formation of magnetars and jets. Understanding these phenomena requires accurate modelling of magnetic field evolution, which remains a challenge for state-of-the-art general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) simulations. In this work, we present \texttt{RAKI} (Relativistic Astrophysics Code Implementation of the Alternative Finite Difference Approach for GRMHD), the first GRMHD code to simulate BNS mergers using high-order alternative finite-difference methods with adaptive-order WENO (AFD-WENO-AO) reconstruction and a fully non-staggered, node-centred vector-potential formulation. The code achieves up to ninth-order convergence in smooth test problems while accurately capturing discontinuities. In magnetised Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff (TOV) star tests, \texttt{RAKI} retains $99.2$ per cent of the initial maximum magnetic field strength over ${\sim}2$ ms, exhibiting an order of magnitude less magnetic field loss than a reference GRMHD code at the same resolution. In BNS merger simulations, fifth-order AFD-WENO-AO reconstruction yields approximately third-order convergence of the gravitational-wave phase in both magnetised and unmagnetised models. The discrete no-monopole constraint is preserved to machine precision without staggered grids, even during BNS mergers with moving refinement regions. These results establish \texttt{RAKI} as a high-order, non-staggered GRMHD framework for accurate modelling of magnetic field evolution in neutron star mergers and its implications for multimessenger astrophysics.

一句话导读：RAKI 是首个面向双中子星并合的高阶非交错 GRMHD 代码，采用 AFD-WENO-AO 重构并显著改善磁场保持与引力波相位收敛。

在Advanced LIGO第四次观测运行中使用有效单体波形搜寻偏心中子星-黑洞双星

Search for Eccentric Neutron Star-Black Hole Binaries in Advanced LIGO's Fourth Observing Run using Effective-One-Body Waveforms

Aleyna Aky\"uz, Keisi Kacanja, Rahul Dhurkunde, Alexander H. Nitz · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：在紧凑双星并合中观测到轨道偏心率将为动力学形成环境提供直接特征。此前针对偏心中子星-黑洞（NSBH）双星的匹配滤波搜寻受计算限制，只能使用简化波形模型，这些模型包含长期退相位但忽略拱线进动和轨道间谐波。纳入这些物理特征可使对0.2≤e20≤0.28系统的敏感搜寻体积增加约25%至30%。我们提出一种快速匹配滤波搜寻方法，使直接使用时间域有效单体波形在计算上可行。通过多频带分解和高频比率滤波，我们的流程将计算成本降低约20倍。这允许使用包含8860万个有效单体模板的模板库搜寻O4a和O4b的Advanced LIGO数据，该模板库比此前的偏心分析大十五倍。我们回收了已知的低质量并合GW230518_125908和GW230529_181500，其参数与零偏心率一致。未发现新的具有轨道偏心率（e20≥0.05）的引力波事件，我们在搜寻空间内对偏心NSBH系统的本地并合率密度给出90%可信上限R90%≤7.5-57 Gpc^-3 yr^-1，比此前观测界限改善最多约4倍。在GW200105_162426的参数处，这一非探测给出上限R90%≤12.1 Gpc^-3 yr^-1。或者，若将GW200105_162426视为偏心探测，则O4中缺乏后续探测将该种群的推断本地并合率密度更新为R=6.6^{+6.3}_{-3.8} Gpc^-3 yr^-1。

English: The observation of orbital eccentricity in compact binary coalescences would provide a direct signature of dynamical formation environments. Previous matched-filter searches for eccentric neutron star-black hole (NSBH) binaries have been severely limited by computational constraints, necessitating the use of simplified waveform models that capture secular dephasing but omit apsidal precession and inter-orbit harmonics. Including these physical features increases the sensitive search volume for systems with $0.2 \le e_{20} \le 0.28$ by $\sim 25\%$ to $30\%$. We present a rapid matched-filter search methodology that makes the direct use of time-domain effective-one-body waveforms computationally feasible. By multibanding and high-frequency ratio-filtering, our pipeline achieves a $\sim 20\times$ reduction in computational cost. This allows a bank of 88.6 million effective-one-body templates, fifteen times larger than prior eccentric analyses, to search O4a and O4b Advanced LIGO data. We recover the known low-mass mergers GW230518_125908 and GW230529_181500 with parameters consistent with zero eccentricity. Finding no new gravitational-wave events with orbital eccentricity ($e_{20} \ge 0.05$), we place $90\%$ credible upper limits on the local merger rate density of eccentric NSBH systems across the search space of $\mathcal{R}_{90\%} \le 7.5\text{-}57\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, up to a factor of $\sim 4$ improvement over previous observational bounds. At the parameters of GW200105_162426, this non-detection establishes an upper limit of $\mathcal{R}_{90\%} \le 12.1\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. Alternatively, if GW200105_162426 is treated as an eccentric detection, the lack of subsequent detections in O4 updates the inferred local merger rate density of this population to $\mathcal{R} = 6.6^{+6.3}_{-3.8}\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$.

一句话导读：该工作开发快速有效单体匹配滤波流程，在Advanced LIGO O4数据中搜寻偏心NSBH双星，未发现新偏心事件并给出并合率上限。

考虑将数值相对论代理模型用于活动星系核通道并合动力学

Considering Numerical Relativity Surrogate Models for AGN Channel Merger Dynamics

Shawn Ray, Keefe Mitman, Vera Delfavero, Emily McPike, Jake Postiglione, Harrison E. Cook, Kaila Nathaniel, Nicolas Posner, Barry McKernan, K. E. Saavik Ford, Richard O'Shaughnessy · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：双黑洞并合目前由 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA（LVK）引力波探测器观测到。其中一部分并合可能起源于活动星系核（AGN），但驱动 AGN 通道并合的动力学过程细节仍不清楚。McFACTS（Monte Carlo For AGN Channel Testing and Simulation）是一个开源公共软件，用于模拟 AGN 通道中双黑洞的形成与演化，并可配置 AGN 和核星团（NSC）参数。在 McFACTS 中，双黑洞并合通过气体阻力和动力学相互作用演化，忽略了可能影响并合遗迹性质的相对论效应。本文展示在 McFACTS 中将旋近中的双黑洞交给数值相对论（NR）代理模型处理的效果，该模型能更准确地预测并合遗迹的质量、自旋和反冲速度。与计算并合及遗迹性质的简单解析方法相比，NR 代理模型在预测遗迹自旋方面显著更准确，从而改进有效自旋 χ_eff 和进动自旋 χ_p 的计算以及反冲踢速度；这些参数对更高代双黑洞并合尤其重要。结果表明，NR 代理模型显著改变遗迹自旋和踢速度的分布，并表明未来研究中应谨慎使用替代方法。我们还概述了一些计算效率高且能再现许多 NR 代理模型结果的简单模型。

English: Binary black hole mergers (BBH) are currently observed by the gravitational-wave detectors LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA (LVK). A fraction of these mergers are likely to originate in active galactic nuclei (AGN), but the details of the dynamical processes driving AGN channel mergers remain poorly understood. Monte Carlo For AGN Channel Testing and Simulation (McFACTS) is an open-source, public software used to simulate AGN channel BBH formation and evolution with configurable options for exploring various AGN and Nuclear Star Cluster (NSC) parameter options. Within McFACTS, BBH mergers evolve through gas drag and dynamical interactions, ignoring relativistic effects which can influence merger remnant properties. Here we demonstrate in McFACTS the effect of handing off inspiralling BBH to a numerical relativity (NR) surrogate model, which more accurately predicts the masses, spins, and kick velocities of merger remnants. Compared to a simple analytic approach to calculating merger and remnant properties the NR surrogate model is significantly more accurate at predicting remnant spins, which improve $\chi_{eff}$ and $\chi_{p}$ calculations, and recoil kicks, parameters especially important for higher generation BBH mergers. Our findings show the NR surrogate significantly changes distributions of remnant spins and kick velocities, as well as showing that alternative methods should be used cautiously in future studies. We also outline some simple models which are computationally efficient and can reproduce much of the NR surrogate model results.

一句话导读：该文在 AGN 通道双黑洞并合模拟中引入数值相对论代理模型，以更准确预测并合遗迹的质量、自旋和反冲速度。

红移空间星系团-星系互相关作为宇宙尺度引力探针

The Redshift-Space Cluster-Galaxy Cross-Correlation as a Probe of Gravity on Cosmic Scales

Nicole Marcelina Gountanis, David H. Weinberg, Andr\'es N. Salcedo, Claire Lamman · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：在宇宙学尺度检验广义相对论需要直接敏感于引力动力学的探针。我们给出Fisher矩阵预报，评估DESI亮星系巡天（BGS）通过星系团下落速度场、以红移空间星系团-星系互相关函数ξ^s_cg(r_p,r_π)为主要观测量，能多好地限制对GR的偏离。我们基于AbacusSummit N体模拟构造模拟星表，星系采用HOD模型，星系团选择采用对数正态质量-可观测量关系。我们用单一乘性因子F_G参数化对GR的偏离，该因子相对于GR预言重新标度晕下落速度。在边缘化HOD、质量-可观测量和宇宙学参数后，发现DESI BGS在z~0.3可将F_G限制到σ(F_G)=0.033。该精度足以以≳4σ区分代表性f(R)和Galileon引力模型与GR。最强限制是F_G与星系团质量-可观测量关系散射之间的退化，而与任何单个HOD参数没有强退化。完全知道星系-晕连接可将限制改善到σ(F_G)≈0.015，将星系自相关函数加入数据向量可恢复部分改善。同一数据向量给出紧宇宙学参数限制σ(Ω_m)=0.010和σ(σ_8)=0.010，仅与F_G中等相关。这些结果表明DESI BGS星系团-星系相关在准线性尺度检验引力的潜力，补充现有修改引力探针和弱透镜星系团质量轮廓。

English: Testing General Relativity (GR) on cosmological scales requires probes that are directly sensitive to gravitational dynamics. We present a Fisher matrix forecast of how well the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Bright Galaxy Survey (BGS) can constrain departures from GR through the cluster infall velocity field, using the redshift-space cluster-galaxy cross-correlation function $\xi^{\rm s}_{\rm cg}(r_p, r_\pi)$ as the primary observable. We construct mock catalogs from the AbacusSummit N-body simulations, using a Halo Occupation Distribution (HOD) model for galaxies and a log-normal mass-observable relation for cluster selection. We parameterize departures from GR with a single multiplicative factor $F_{\rm G}$ that rescales halo infall velocities relative to the GR prediction. Marginalizing over the HOD, mass-observable, and cosmological parameters, we find that DESI BGS can constrain $F_{\rm G}$ to $\sigma(F_{\rm G}) = 0.033$ at $z \sim 0.3$. This precision is sufficient to distinguish representative $f(R)$ and Galileon gravity models from GR at $\gtrsim 4\sigma$. The strongest limitation is a degeneracy between $F_{\rm G}$ and the scatter in the cluster mass-observable relation, while the constraint shows no strong degeneracy with any individual HOD parameter. Perfect knowledge of the galaxy-halo connection would improve the constraint to $\sigma(F_{\rm G}) \approx 0.015$, and including the galaxy autocorrelation function in the data vector could recover part of this improvement. The same data vector yields tight constraints on the cosmological parameters, $\sigma(\Omega_m) = 0.010$ and $\sigma(\sigma_8) = 0.010$, only moderately correlated with $F_{\rm G}$. These results demonstrate the potential of DESI BGS cluster-galaxy correlations to test gravity on quasi-linear scales, complementary to existing modified gravity probes and to weak-lensing cluster mass profiles.

观测银河系中心未见的引力波旋近源

Seeing Unseen Gravitational Wave Inspirals at the Galactic Center

Pau Amaro Seoane, Qimin Song, Shao-Dong Zhao, Kostas Tzanavaris, Reinhard Genzel, Frank Eisenhauer, Thomas Ott, Stefan Gillessen, Guillaume Bourdarot, Diogo C. Ribeiro, Matteo Sadun Bordoni, Simran Joharle, Felix Mang, Andreas Burkert, Jorge Cuadra, Diego Calder\'on, Re'em Sari · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：银河系中心预计存在大量极大质量比旋近（X-MRI），并向超大质量黑洞迁移。作者提出利用X-MRI对高偏心率S星S301施加的长期引力矩进行观测。该方法本质上受周围恒星级黑洞 cusp 随机性的限制：S301穿过这种颗粒状介质时会经历离散引力遭遇。标准轨道拟合流程默认背景势平滑，会把随机轨迹中的离散速度不连续平均成连续长期漂移，从而引入模仿X-MRI进动信号系统偏差，使传统质量估计失效。为解决这一简并，作者采用小波变换模极大值方法刻画轨道运动的局部Hölder正则性，将恒星级黑洞遭遇造成的奇异不连续与X-MRI分布的连续力矩分离，从而即使在瞬时加速度低于仪器噪声阈值时也能探测。分析表明，S301对内部X-MRI族群高度敏感，同时对外部cusp的长期影响动力学退耦。结合精密天体测量与径向速度投影，作者确定最少两个X-MRI可在五到九年的时间尺度内被探测，从而能在空间引力波探测器发射前约束未见的轨道器族群。

English: The Galactic Center is expected to host a population of extremely large mass-ratio inspirals (X-MRIs) migrating toward the supermassive black hole. We propose an observational approach utilizing the secular gravitational torque exerted by X-MRIs on the highly eccentric S-star S301. This approach is intrinsically limited by the stochastic nature of the surrounding stellar-mass black hole cusp. As S301 propagates through this granular medium, it experiences discrete gravitational encounters. Standard orbital fitting procedures inherently assume a smooth background potential; applying them to stochastic trajectories averages these discrete velocity discontinuities into a continuous secular drift. This introduces a systematic bias that mimics the X-MRI precession signal, invalidating traditional mass estimation techniques. To resolve this degeneracy, we implement a methodology based on the Wavelet Transform Modulus Maxima method to characterize the local H\"older regularity of the orbital motion. This model isolates the singular discontinuities induced by stellar-mass black hole encounters from the continuous torque of the X-MRI distribution, allowing for detection even when instantaneous accelerations are below the instrumental noise threshold. We demonstrate analytically that S301 is highly sensitive to the interior X-MRI population while remaining dynamically decoupled from the secular influence of the exterior cusp. Combining precision astrometry and radial velocity projections, we establish that a minimal population of two X-MRIs is detectable within a five to nine-year timeframe, allowing us to constrain the presence of an unseen orbiter population prior to the launch of space-based gravitational wave detectors.

中文摘要：本文针对静态、互易、等臂等边星座中的任意有限延迟时间延迟干涉（TDI）通道，建立各向异性重叠约化函数（ORF）的统一解析框架。构造结合激光噪声消除的多项式约束、星座对称性与方向投影积分。可容许通道模的自由基将通道生成与角度积分分离；两类基本角度核生成所有通道对强度ORF。通道代数与引力波极化无关，强度核约化适用于张量、矢量、呼吸和纵向扇区。文中以张量多极展开为例，并在任意固定有限角阶保留完整传播效应，给出至ℓ=5的显式例子。预准备频率批次、共享多精度表达式及可去延迟点处的局部展开提供稳定计算。基准测试中，解析实现在匹配误差容限下比优化天空积分快约50至5000倍；独立多精度天空积分也验证了测试情形下低至10^{-100}的混合误差目标。所得核与生成规则可为各向异性多通道背景模型提供可复用输入。

English: We establish a unified analytic framework for anisotropic overlap reduction functions (ORFs) of arbitrary finite-delay time-delay interferometry (TDI) channels in a static, reciprocal, equal-arm equilateral constellation. The construction combines the polynomial constraints for laser-noise cancellation, constellation symmetries, and directional-projection integration. A free basis of the admissible channel module separates channel generation from angular integration; two families of elementary angular kernels then generate all channel-pair intensity ORFs. The channel algebra is independent of gravitational-wave polarization, and the intensity-kernel reduction applies to tensor, vector, breathing, and longitudinal sectors. Tensor multipoles illustrate the framework here. Complete propagation effects are retained at arbitrary fixed finite angular order, with explicit examples through $\ell=5$. Prepared frequency batches, shared multiprecision expressions, and local expansions at removable delay points provide stable evaluation. In the prepared-batch benchmark, the analytic implementation is approximately 50 to 5000 times faster than optimized sky quadrature at matched error tolerances. Independent multiprecision sky integrations also validate prescribed mixed error targets down to $10^{-100}$ in the tested cases. The resulting kernels and generation rules supply reusable inputs for anisotropic multichannel background models.

中文摘要：引力观测会以两种方式使物质性质无法确定：不同状态可以有相同的总源，不同时空历史可以保留相同的观测。我们通过性质层面的可识别性判据在广义相对论中组织这些反问题，并应用于恒星和黑洞候选体。两个理想无质量气体说明等源模糊性：它们的温度相差因子 (8/29)^{1/4}，熵不同而应力-能量张量相同。另一个因果流体例子从相同源和几何数据出发但本构响应不同；两个模型的曲率历史在固有时线性阶分开，标度因子在三次阶分开。对于黑洞候选体，相关区分在于稳态外部参数、扰动通量和组分历史。该框架提供一个检验保留数据是否识别物质性质的方法，区分瞬时源相等、历史范围源相等和观测投影。

English: Gravitational observations can leave material properties undetermined in two different ways: distinct states can have the same total source, and distinct spacetime histories can have the same retained observations. We organize these inverse problems in general relativity through a property-level identifiability criterion, with applications to stars and black hole candidates. Two ideal massless gases illustrate equal-source ambiguity: their temperatures differ by a factor of $(8/29)^{1/4}$ and their entropies differ while their stress-energy tensors agree. A separate causal-fluid example starts with identical sources and geometric data but different constitutive responses; the two models' curvature histories separate at linear order in proper time and their scale factors at cubic order. For black hole candidates, the relevant distinction is between stationary exterior parameters, perturbing fluxes and constituent history. The framework provides a test for whether retained data identify a material property, separating instantaneous source equality, history-wide source equality and observational projection.

Patricia McMillin, Giuseppe Ficarra, Carlos O. Lousto, Richard O'Shaughnessy · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们使用第五版 RIT 双黑洞波形目录中包含的 2000 多个完整数值相对论模拟，通过快速迭代拟合算法（RIFT）对引力波事件 GW190521 和 GW231123 进行贝叶斯参数估计。我们重新审视了此前被认为在进入 20 Hz 探测器频带时可能具有大偏心率的 GW190521，并确认了这一发现：最高似然来自同时具有偏心率和自旋进动的波形，给出 e20 = 0.207_{-0.147}^{+0.192} 和 χ1,⊥ = 0.717_{-0.406}^{+0.194}。将同一模拟池应用于 GW231123，我们同样发现偏好自旋进动，在 20 Hz 时 χ1,⊥ = 0.678_{-0.462}^{+0.218}，但此事件在 10 Hz 和 20 Hz 处偏心率可忽略，分别为 e10 = 0.097_{-0.073}^{+0.124} 和 e20 = 0.056_{-0.045}^{+0.059}。作为比较，两个事件也仅使用非进动（偏心与准圆）模拟进行分析，每种情况下似然都更低。这些结果表明，我们的方法能够区分当前引力波信号中偏心率与自旋进动的影响。被单独选出的最高峰值似然 NR 模拟给出并合后最终黑洞的反冲速度估计：GW190521 为 3965 km/s，GW231123 为 2059 km/s。

English: We use the more than 2000 full numerical-relativity simulations included in the fifth release of the RIT binary-black-hole waveform catalog to perform Bayesian parameter estimation, via the rapid iterative fitting algorithm (RIFT), for the gravitational-wave events GW190521 and GW231123. We revisit GW190521, which has previously been identified as potentially possessing large eccentricity upon entering the detector band at $20~\mathrm{Hz}$, and confirm this finding: the highest likelihood is obtained from waveforms that are simultaneously eccentric and spin-precessing, yielding $e_{20} =0.207_{-0.147}^{+0.192}$ and $\chi_{1,\perp}=0.717_{-0.406}^{+0.194}$. Applying the same simulation pool to GW231123, we likewise find a preference for spin precession where at 20 Hz $\chi_{1,\perp}=0.678_{-0.462}^{+0.218}$, but in this case with negligible eccentricity at both $10~\mathrm{Hz}$ and $20~\mathrm{Hz}$, with $e_{10}=0.097_{-0.073}^{+0.124}$ and $e_{20}=0.056_{-0.045}^{+0.059}$. For comparison, both events are also analyzed using exclusively non-precessing (eccentric and quasi-circular) simulations, which yield lower likelihoods in each case. These results indicate that our approach is capable of discriminating between the effects of eccentricity and spin precession in current gravitational-wave signals. The singled out top peak likelihood NR simulations give estimates of the recoil velocities of the merged final holes of 3965km/s for GW190521, and of 2059km/s for GW231123.

五维带电AdS黑洞的光子环与质量无关可观测量

Photon Rings and Mass-Independent Observables of a Five-Dimensional Charged AdS Black Hole

Amrillokhon Mamatkhonov, Javokhir Sharipov, Tursunali Xamidov, Chen Zhou, Sanjar Shaymatov, Chengxun Yuan · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究五维带电AdS黑洞的光学性质。利用零测地线方程确定事件视界、光子球半径和临界碰撞参数，发现它们均随电荷增加而减小，而光子球半径不依赖AdS半径。为避免对质量标度和AdS时空中观察者依赖的阴影表观尺寸的依赖，作者引入两个质量无关的几何可观测量：子环指数γ以及临界碰撞参数与最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）直接像的临界碰撞参数之比。作者给出γ的闭式表达式，证明其与AdS半径无关且满足2π/√3<γ≤π√2，高于四维Schwarzschild和Reissner–Nordström黑洞的相应值。基于无噪声模拟数据和5%示例性分数不确定度的MCMC预测，无量纲AdS半径可被限制到16–19%的相对不确定度，而电荷仅在所考虑的近极端基准模型中可与零区分；在此假设下，子环指数与四维Schwarzschild黑洞有3.4–5.9σ的高斯分离。

English: We investigate the optical properties of a five-dimensional charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole. Using the null geodesic equations, we determine the event horizon and photon sphere radii and the critical impact parameter, showing that all decrease with increasing charge, while the photon sphere radius remains independent of the AdS radius. To avoid dependence on the mass scale and the observer-dependent apparent size of the shadow in an AdS spacetime, we introduce two mass-independent geometric observables: the subring exponent $\gamma$ and the ratio of the critical impact parameter to that of the direct image of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). We derive $\gamma$ in closed form and show that it is independent of the AdS radius and satisfies $2\pi/\sqrt{3}<\gamma\leq\pi\sqrt{2}$, above the values for four-dimensional Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes. Using a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) forecast based on noiseless mock data with illustrative fractional uncertainties of $5\%$, we find that the dimensionless AdS radius can be constrained with a relative uncertainty of $16$--$19\%$, whereas the charge can be distinguished from zero only for the near-extremal fiducial model considered. Under these assumptions, the subring exponent provides a Gaussian separation of $3.4$--$5.9\sigma$ from the four-dimensional Schwarzschild black hole.

Inverse Gertsenshte\v{i}n-Zel'dovich Effect in Time-Independent Electromagnetic Field

Rajendra Prasad Bhatt, Rudraksh Verma, R. Prasad, Sudipta Sarkar · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：逆Gertsenshtein-Zel'dovich效应描述引力波在背景电磁场中转化为电磁波。本文针对空间变化且不随时间变化的背景电磁场，建立计算引力波通过时感生电场和磁场分量的通用形式，并适用于引力波的全部六种偏振模式。作者用恒定与空间变化电磁场等例子说明其适用性，并研究引力波穿过中子星和磁星等天体磁场时产生的电磁信号。该效应连接引力波与电磁波这两种多信使天文学信使，可能用于高频引力波探测器设计和高能天体电磁信号研究。

English: The inverse Gertsenshte\v{i}n-Zel'dovich effect describes the conversion of gravitational waves into electromagnetic waves in the presence of a background electromagnetic field. This effect has primarily been studied for constant background electromagnetic fields. In this work, we develop a general formalism for calculating the components of the electric and magnetic fields induced by the passage of a gravitational wave through a spatially varying, time-independent background electromagnetic field. The formalism accommodates all six possible polarization modes of gravitational waves. We illustrate its applicability through several examples, including gravitational waves propagating through constant and spatially varying electromagnetic fields. We further investigate the electromagnetic signals generated by the passage of gravitational waves through astrophysical magnetic fields, particularly those associated with neutron stars and magnetars. By connecting gravitational waves and electromagnetic waves--two essential messengers of multi-messenger astronomy--the inverse Gertsenshte\v{i}n-Zel'dovich effect offers a promising framework for both gravitational-wave detection and astrophysical observations. The formalism developed here may therefore find applications in the design of high-frequency gravitational-wave detectors and in the investigation of high-energy astrophysical electromagnetic signals.

Auclair Pierre, Gharib Chams, Steer Dani\`ele · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们对宇宙弦尖点的引力波（GW）发射进行了深入分析，超越了 Damour 和 Vilenkin 的开创性工作。我们识别出据我们所知文献中尚未描述的两个特征：第一，尖点在任意给定频率下的引力波发射并不集中在一个锥体内，而是在天空中描绘出钻石状形状。第二，发射在尖点速度方向上并非最大，而是在两个略微偏移的方向上最大。我们详细解释这些效应，并用简化例子说明。然后，我们研究两种总体辐射功率增强的极限情形：当钻石在某一特定方向上被拉伸时，以及当尖点处高阶导数消失时。我们统计估计这些效应在一族奇次谐波环中的重要性。

English: We carry an in-depth analysis of the gravitational wave (GW) emission of cosmic string cusps, going beyond the seminal work of Damour and Vilenkin. We identify two features that, to the best of our knowledge, have not been described in the literature: first the GWs emission from a cusp, at any given frequency, is not concentrated inside a cone but instead draws a diamond-like shape in the sky. Second, the emission is not maximal in the direction of the cusp velocity, but in two slightly offset directions. We explain these effects in detail, and illustrate them with simplified examples. Then, we study two limiting cases for which the overall radiated power is enhanced: when the diamond is stretched in a particular direction, and when higher order derivatives vanish at the cusp. We statistically estimate the importance of these effects in a population of odd-harmonic loops.

Self-Bound Anisotropic Stars in $\mathcal{R}+\alpha\mathcal{R}^2$ Gravity with a Hayward Exterior: Junction Conditions and NICER Constraints

Furqan Nazeer, Tooba Feroze · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：修改引力中的解析致密星模型通常沿用广义相对论的连接条件，并用特定恒星模型导出的半径来固定常数。本文避免这两种做法。我们研究 F(R)=R+αR^2 引力，采用嵌入类一（Karmarkar 条件）的 Durgapal-Bannerji 内解和 Hayward 外部。由于没有 Birkhoff 定理，外部是一种假设；我们用 Hayward 度规（通过长度 ℓ 对 Schwarzschild 作形变）来衡量其影响。二次 F(R) 引力的连接条件以 M、R 和 ℓ 的闭合形式固定所有常数；压强条件 p_r(R)=0 被外曲率迹的连续性替代。Ricci 标量在表面发生跳变，因此存在负表面能密度的薄壳、引力双层以及小的径向应力。为使该应力低于中心压强的 1%，需要 α≲0.2 km^2 且 ℓ≲0.3M。内部表现为自束缚星。单一表面能密度 ρ_s=(1.37±0.16)ρ_0 可重现 PSR J0740+6620、J0437-4715、J0030+0451 和 J0614-3329；对于 α=0.1 km^2，模型预言的 R_1.4=11.5 km，最大质量为 2.9 M_⊙。由于 ℓ 仅以 (ℓ/M)^2(M/R)^3 阶进入表面观测量，结果可延续到 Schwarzschild 外部。若改用食 X 射线脉冲星的奇异星半径来校准，则给出 R_1.4≈9 km，而当前数据排除这一结果。

English: Analytic compact-star models in modified gravity usually borrow the junction conditions of general relativity and fix their constants with radii derived for a particular stellar model. Here we avoid both. We study $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})=\mathcal{R}+\alpha\mathcal{R}^{2}$ gravity with a Durgapal-Bannerji interior of embedding class one (Karmarkar condition) and a Hayward exterior. Without Birkhoff's theorem, the exterior is an assumption, and we measure its effect with the Hayward metric, which deforms Schwarzschild by a length $\ell$. The junction conditions of quadratic $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})$ gravity fix all constants in closed form in terms of $M$, $R$ and $\ell$. The condition $p_r(R)=0$ is replaced by continuity of the trace of the extrinsic curvature. The Ricci scalar jumps at the surface, so there is a thin shell with negative surface energy density for $\alpha>0$, a gravitational double layer, and a small radial stress. For this stress to be below 1% of the central pressure we need $\alpha\lesssim0.2$ km$^{2}$ and $\ell\lesssim0.3M$. The interior behaves as a self-bound star. A single surface energy density, $\rho_s=(1.37\pm0.16)\rho_0$, reproduces PSR J0740+6620, J0437-4715, J0030+0451 and J0614-3329, and for $\alpha=0.1$ km$^{2}$ the model predicts $R_{1.4}=11.5$ km and a maximum mass of $2.9 M_\odot$. Because $\ell$ enters surface observables only at order $(\ell/M)^{2}(M/R)^{3}$, the results carry over to a Schwarzschild exterior. Calibrating instead with strange-star radii of eclipsing X-ray pulsars gives $R_{1.4}\approx9$ km, which current data rule out.

一句话导读：在 R+αR^2 引力中用完整连接条件匹配 Durgapal-Bannerji 内解与 Hayward 外部，并给出致密星质量半径及 NICER 约束。

利用轨道动力学寻找引力波：GUEST任务与微赫兹引力波波段

Looking for gravitational waves with orbital dynamics: GUEST mission and the $\mu$Hz band of Gravitational Waves

Diego Blas · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：通过探测尚未探索的频段为引力波天空“增添色彩”，有可能揭示宇宙中新奇且意想不到的现象。位于脉冲星计时阵列与LISA之间的微赫兹波段是特别有吸引力的目标：如果脉冲星计时阵列最近发现的信号由一类引力波源产生，那么该信号的延伸应存在于这一波段；该波段也可能包含来自早期宇宙、原初黑洞或暗物质的信号。在这些会议论文集中，我们回顾了引力束缚系统的轨道如何作为微赫兹引力波和超轻暗物质的共振探测器。随后我们介绍GUEST（Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking），这是最近向ESA F级征集提交的一项任务概念，由两个覆盖回反射器的密集无源球体组成，置于高偏心地球轨道，并由全球激光测距网络跟踪。

English: `Adding colour'' to the gravitational-wave sky by probing unexplored frequency bands has the potential to unveil new and unexpected phenomena in the Universe. The microhertz band, between pulsar timing arrays and LISA, is a particularly attractive target: it should host the extension of the signal recently found by pulsar timing arrays (if it is generated by a family of sources of gravitational waves), and it may harbour signals from the early Universe, primordial black holes or dark matter. In these proceedings, we review how the orbits of gravitationally bound systems act as resonant detectors of microhertz gravitational waves and ultra-light dark matter. We then describe GUEST (Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking), a mission concept recently proposed to the ESA F-class call, consisting of two dense passive spheres covered with retroreflectors, placed in highly eccentric Earth orbits and tracked by a global laser-ranging network.

一句话导读：综述利用引力束缚系统轨道作为微赫兹引力波与超轻暗物质共振探测器，并介绍GUEST卫星激光测距任务概念。

近极端 Kerr 黑洞视界剪切中的准正规模激发

Quasinormal Mode Excitation in the Horizon Shear of Near-Extremal Kerr Black Holes

Brennen Black · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：近极端 Kerr 黑洞受到偏心极端质量比旋进扰动后，其视界剪切在近星点通过后出现低振幅、高频振荡（wiggles）。此前工作无法将 wiggle 频率与轨道联系起来，并认为它们不可能是准正规模（QNM）。我们证明这些振荡属于阻尼模分支的 Kerr QNM，即当自旋趋于极端时衰减率仍保持有限的模式。对于 p=3M、e=0.85 的赤道顺行轨道以及 a/M=0.999 到 0.99999 的自旋范围，对时域剪切的拟合识别出基频 (ℓ,m)=(2,1) 和 (3,2) 模式分别为占主导和第一亚主导激发。分别拟合每个多极得到频率在 Kerr 值的两个标准差以内，并提供基频 (3,1)、(4,1) 和 (4,2) 模式被激发的证据，尽管这些模式在全信号中不可分辨。我们进一步论证，驱动剪切的潮汐场中也必然存在同样的 wiggles。对于 ℓ≤4，未发现 m=0 或 m=ℓ 多极中存在 QNM 激发的证据。

English: The horizon shear of a near-extremal Kerr black hole perturbed by an eccentric extreme mass ratio inspiral shows low amplitude, high frequency oscillations (''wiggles") after periapsis passage. Previous works are unable to tie the frequency of the wiggles to the orbit, and argue they cannot be quasinormal modes (QNMs). We show that they are Kerr QNMs belonging to the damped-mode branch --- that is, modes whose decay rate stays finite as the spin approaches extremality. For an equatorial prograde orbit with $p = 3M$ and $e = 0.85$ and spins ranging from $a/M = 0.999$ to $a/M = 0.99999$, fits to the time-domain shear identify the fundamental $(\ell,m) = (2,1)$ and $(3,2)$ modes as the dominant and first subdominant excitations. Fitting each multipole separately gives frequencies to within two standard deviations of the Kerr values and provides evidence for the excitation of the fundamental $(3,1)$, $(4,1)$ and $(4,2)$ modes, though these are not resolvable in the full signal. We further argue that the same wiggles must be present in the tidal field that drives the shear. For $\ell \leq 4$ we find no evidence of QNM excitation in the $m = 0$ or the $m = \ell$ multipoles.

一句话导读：证明近极端 Kerr 黑洞视界剪切中的高频 wiggles 是阻尼分支 Kerr 准正规模，并识别主导多极激发。

Hernquist 晕中缓慢旋转黑洞的准正模：红移与角动量

Quasinormal Modes of Slowly Rotating Black Holes in Hernquist Halos: Redshift and Angular Momentum

Xing-Hui Feng, Bo Wang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究嵌入 Hernquist 晕中的黑洞的轴向准正模。采用一个已有的解析静态几何，其内部真空腔延伸至 4M_BH，并在转动一阶下求解框架拖曳。对质量比 ε=M_BH/M_halo=0.1 和 0.01、晕致密度 C=M_halo/a0 在 10^-4 到 0.3 范围内，计算基频和一阶泛音分支。腔体几何给出局部 Kerr 估计：红移重标真空频率，视界角动量决定转动分裂，均匀框架拖曳给出实频移。零自旋时，腔体红移重现复的 ℓ=2 频率，基频与一阶泛音的相对残差分别低于 0.04% 和 0.31%；其弱致密度首项行为 1-C 解释了稀薄晕中弱质量比依赖，较大致密度下精确红移解释了两种质量比序列的大部分差异。固定总角动量时，局部角动量消失的晕与坐标角速度消失的晕在实自旋系数上呈现相反的致密度趋势；在 C=0.3 时，两者对两个质量比的实基频自旋系数分别相差约 38% 和 54%。固定视界角动量后，这些差异对两个泛音均降至 1% 以下，表明角动量分配解释了大部分构型依赖。

English: We investigate axial quasinormal modes of black holes embedded in Hernquist halos, using an established analytic static geometry with an inner vacuum cavity extending to $4M_{\mathrm{BH}}$ and solving for frame dragging to first order in rotation. We compute the fundamental and first overtone branches for mass ratios $\epsilon\equiv M_{\mathrm{BH}}/M_{\mathrm{halo}}$ of $0.1$ and $0.01$, and halo compactness $\mathcal C\equiv M_{\mathrm{halo}}/a_0$ in the range $10^{-4}\leq\mathcal C\leq0.3$. The cavity geometry gives a local Kerr estimate in which redshift rescales the vacuum frequencies, horizon angular momentum sets the rotational splitting, and uniform frame dragging adds a real frequency shift. At zero spin, the cavity redshift reproduces the complex $\ell=2$ frequencies with relative residuals below $0.04\%$ for the fundamental and $0.31\%$ for the first overtone. Its leading weak compactness behavior, $1-\mathcal C$, explains the weak mass ratio dependence in dilute halos; at larger compactness, the exact redshift accounts for most of the separation between the two mass ratio sequences. At fixed total angular momentum, halos with vanishing local angular momentum and those with vanishing coordinate angular velocity exhibit opposite compactness trends in the real spin coefficient. At $\mathcal C=0.3$, their real fundamental mode spin coefficients differ by approximately $38\%$ and $54\%$ for the two mass ratios. Fixing the horizon angular momentum reduces these differences below $1\%$ for both overtones, showing that angular momentum partition accounts for most of the configuration dependence.

一句话导读：在 Hernquist 晕和内部真空腔的静态几何中，一阶转动与框架拖曳分析表明红移和角动量分配主导准正模频率及自旋分裂。

具有两个张量自由度的空间协变引力中的标量诱导引力波

Scalar-induced gravitational waves in spatially covariant gravity with two tensorial degrees of freedom

Jia-Xi Feng, Yang Yu, Yan-Heng Yu, Xian Gao, Qing-Guo Huang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究最小耦合到 k-essence 标量场的、具有两个张量自由度的空间协变引力模型中的标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）。在辐射主导时期所考虑的参数选择下，张量二次作用与广义相对论（GR）一致。我们推导了有限 σ≡C2 N̄ 以及大 |σ| 极限下的标量转移函数，并构造了 SIGWs 的源函数。进一步考察了一个立方外曲率相互作用，它修改 SIGWs 源函数而不影响背景或二次作用。我们针对单色和对数正态原初曲率功率谱计算了 SIGWs 的分数能量密度。发现在所研究的正 σ 值下，相对于 σ→∞ 极限的结果，有限 σ 效应会在较宽尺度范围内压低谱；在该极限下，立方相互作用会压低小波数处的谱并增强较大波数处的谱。这些结果表明，即使张量二次作用与 GR 相同，修改后的标量动力学和非线性相互作用也能改变 SIGWs 的分数能量密度。

English: We study scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) in a spatially covariant gravity model with two tensorial degrees of freedom, minimally coupled to a $k$-essence scalar field. For the parameter choice considered during radiation domination, the quadratic tensor action coincides with that of general relativity (GR). We derive the scalar transfer functions at finite $\sigma\equiv C_2\bar N$ and in the large-$|\sigma|$ limit. We then construct the source function of SIGWs. We further examine a cubic extrinsic-curvature interaction that modifies the source function of SIGWs without affecting the background or quadratic actions. We calculate the fractional energy density of SIGWs for monochromatic and log-normal primordial curvature power spectra. We find that, for the positive values of $\sigma$ studied, finite-$\sigma$ effects suppress the spectrum over a broad range of scales relative to the result in the $\sigma \rightarrow \infty$ limit. In this limit, the cubic interaction suppresses the spectrum at small wavenumbers and enhances it at larger wavenumbers. These results show that modified scalar dynamics and non-linear interactions can alter the fractional energy density of SIGWs even when the quadratic tensor action is identical to that of GR.

一句话导读：在张量二次作用与 GR 相同的空间协变引力中，标量动力学和立方非线性相互作用仍可改变标量诱导引力波的能量密度谱。

Li-Baker 高频引力波探测器中高斯光束不完美引起的能量通量噪声

Energy-flux noise induced by imperfections of the Gaussian beam in the Li-Baker HFGW detector

Lin-Lin Yang, Hao Yu, Pan-Pan Wang, Jin Li, Cheng-Gang Shao · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究 Li-Baker 高频引力波探测器中由高斯光束不完美引起的能量通量噪声。作者用高阶拉盖尔-高斯光束对不完美建模，解析推导共极化和交叉极化 LG_nl 模的噪声信号比，发现高阶共极化 LG 光束在最佳探测平面上不产生切向能量通量噪声，而高阶交叉极化 LG 光束会引入不可忽略噪声；在代表性参数下，单个高阶交叉极化模通常需满足 σ_nl<10^-46，LG_01 模要求最严，为 σ_01<6.0×10^-49；蒙特卡洛模拟表明多个高阶交叉极化模的总功率分数需低于 10^-49。文章据此建议使用偏振滤波器仅保留共极化分量以抑制噪声并保持信号。

English: This paper investigates the energy-flux noise induced by imperfections of the Gaussian beam (GB) in the Li-Baker high-frequency gravitational wave (HFGW) detector. Modeling these imperfections with higher-order Laguerre-Gaussian (LG) beams, we analytically derive the resulting noise-to-signal ratio for both co- and cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ modes. It is found that higher-order co-polarized LG beams generate no tangential energy-flux noise at the optimal detection plane ($\phi=\pi/2$ or $3\pi/2$), whereas higher-order cross-polarized LG beams introduce non-negligible noise. Specifically, for an individual higher-order cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ mode under our representative parameters, maintaining the noise-to-signal ratio below unity typically requires the power fraction to satisfy $\sigma_{nl}<10^{-46}$, with the $\mathrm{LG}_{01}$ mode imposing the most stringent constraint of $\sigma_{01}<6.0\times10^{-49}$. Monte Carlo simulations suggest that the total power fraction $\sigma_{\mathrm{total}}$ of multiple higher-order cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ modes needs to remain below $10^{-49}$. Consequently, we propose employing a polarization filter to retain only the co-polarized component of the GB adopted in the practical experiment, thereby suppressing the noise while preserving signal integrity. These results provide theoretical guidance for noise control in the Li-Baker HFGW detector.

一句话导读：分析 Li-Baker 高频引力波探测器中高阶 LG 光束不完美导致的能量通量噪声，并建议偏振滤波抑制交叉极化噪声。

Kerr黑洞对引力波的引力透镜效应

Gravitational lensing of gravitational waves by a Kerr black hole

Jian-hua He · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文采用(1+1)维时域模式求和方法模拟Kerr黑洞对引力波的引力透镜效应。为实现高效显式时间演化，作者使用局部双曲层叶状化并结合静态场重定义，在扩展的均匀乌龟坐标网格上保证有界特征速度。入射引力波初值通过将平面波Weyl张量投影到Kinnersley四元组构造；借助局部自旋二价旋转和Wigner D矩阵变换，该框架可处理任意入射角与偏振角下的理想波包及真实双星并合信号。为准确解析透镜化波形，演化包含68,000个耦合(j,m)模式。结果表明，Kerr黑洞表现为衍射受限的厚透镜，将引力波聚焦成前向光束。对理想波包，主即时脉冲呈现与自旋无关的横向高斯分布，而随后的透镜化尾波对黑洞自旋敏感。对双星并合信号，强场透镜化显著改变并合后的铃宕；但Kerr与Schwarzschild背景下的透镜化旋进和并合阶段几乎相同，在不同倾角和偏振下波形失配低于2.2×10^-5。这些发现表明，无自旋Schwarzschild模型可作为准确且计算经济的替代模型，用于当前地面探测器搜寻强场透镜化特征。

English: We simulate the gravitational lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) by a Kerr black hole using a $(1+1)$-dimensional time-domain mode-sum approach. To enable efficient explicit time evolution, we implement a localized hyperboloidal foliation combined with a static field redefinition, ensuring bounded characteristic speeds across an extended, uniform tortoise-coordinate grid. Incident GW initial data are constructed by projecting a plane-wave Weyl tensor onto the Kinnersley tetrad. Through local spin-dyad rotations and Wigner $D$-matrix transformations, our framework accommodates both idealized wave packets and realistic binary coalescence signals at arbitrary incidence and polarization angles. To accurately resolve the lensed waveforms, we evolve over $68,000$ coupled $(j,m)$ modes. Our results reveal that a Kerr black hole acts as a diffraction-limited thick lens, focusing GWs into a forward beam. For idealized wave packets, the primary prompt pulse exhibits a spin-independent transverse Gaussian profile, whereas the subsequent lensing coda is sensitive to the black hole's spin. For binary coalescence signals, strong-field lensing substantially modifies the post-merger ringdown. However, the lensed inspiral and merger phases in Kerr and Schwarzschild backgrounds are virtually identical, yielding waveform mismatches below $2.2\times10^{-5}$ across various inclinations and polarizations. These findings demonstrate that non-spinning Schwarzschild models provide an accurate and computationally economical surrogate to search for strong-field lensing signatures with current ground-based detectors.

一句话导读：数值模拟表明Kerr黑洞对引力波的强场透镜化主要改变并合后铃宕，而旋进与并合阶段可用Schwarzschild背景高精度替代。

Type-D黑洞的完整准正规模。II. 极端Kerr黑洞

Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. II. Extremal Kerr black holes

Changkai Chen, Xiaohua Zhang, Zhoujian Cao, Jiliang Jing · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文发展双合流Heun（HeunD）方法，将完整准正规模谱构造推广到极端Kerr黑洞。通过匹配视界入射与无穷远出射径向解并施加角向正则性，直接在极端情形获得频率，而非从非极端自旋外推。对引力扰动，在常规与非常规Riemann叶上得到扩展谱，包括跨频率分支割线解析延拓揭示的额外QNM。自旋延拓将极端模与完整Schwarzschild谱（含非常规分支）联系起来，并首次表明m<0的非常规Class I序列在极端极限下趋近负超辐射界且阻尼消失；同时识别出夹杂在零阻尼序列中的有限阻尼模，说明单一泛音截断无法描述向极端性的过渡。独立散射振幅计算验证代表性频率及叶指派，围道计数在有界频率域内确立谱完备性；超辐射界附近的均匀匹配进一步区分临界累积与孤立极端QNM并解析Riemann叶结构。结果将极端Kerr纳入黑洞QNM谱的统一处理，并揭示Schwarzschild模族在极端极限下如何重组。

English: We develop a double-confluent Heun (HeunD) method that extends our construction of complete quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra to extremal Kerr black holes. Matching the horizon-ingoing and infinity-outgoing radial solutions together with angular regularity yields the frequencies directly at extremality, without extrapolation from nonextremal spins. For gravitational perturbations, we obtain an expanded spectrum on both conventional and unconventional Riemann sheets, including additional QNMs revealed by analytic continuation across frequency branch cuts. Continuation in spin connects the extremal modes to our complete Schwarzschild spectrum, including its unconventional branches. We show for the first time that unconventional Class I sequences with $m<0$, continued from unconventional Schwarzschild modes, approach negative superradiant bounds with vanishing damping in the extremal limit. We also identify finite-damping modes interspersed among sequences approaching zero damping, showing that a single overtone cutoff cannot describe the transition to extremality. Independent scattering-amplitude calculations verify representative frequencies and their sheet assignments, while a contour count establishes spectral completeness within a bounded frequency domain. Uniform matching near the superradiant bound further distinguishes critical accumulation from isolated extremal QNMs and resolves the associated Riemann-sheet structure. These results bring extremal Kerr into our unified treatment of black-hole QNM spectra and reveal how the Schwarzschild mode families reorganize in the extremal limit.

一句话导读：用HeunD方法直接构造极端Kerr黑洞完整QNM谱并揭示其与Schwarzschild模族的联系。

Kerr黑洞铃宕中的早期尾

Early-time tails in Kerr black hole ringdown

Ansh Gupta, Naritaka Oshita · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：黑洞铃宕通常被建模为QNM的叠加，但格林函数的分支割会产生非振荡尾巴，可能污染早期铃宕分析。本文在线性微扰理论下，量化局域高斯波包被质量为M的Kerr黑洞散射时的分支割贡献。将铃宕起始定义为QNM与分支割贡献共同重构波形的最早时刻，并评估分支割振幅相对于QNM振幅的大小。对于特征频率ω0~1/M的波包，在铃宕起始时分支割振幅通常约为QNM振幅的10%，对自旋仅呈弱依赖。进一步发现，在与源卷积之前的尾巴波形几乎与自旋无关；因此相对振幅的自旋依赖主要来自QNM的激发。结果表明，分支割贡献可能影响黑洞谱学的精度，尤其是在铃宕起始附近。

English: Black hole ringdowns are modelled as a superposition of quasinormal modes (QNMs), although the branch cut of the Green's function produces a nonoscillatory tail that may contaminate early-time ringdown analyses. Within linear perturbation theory, we quantify this branch-cut contribution for the scattering of localised Gaussian wave packets by a Kerr black hole with mass $M$. Defining the onset of ringdown as the earliest time at which the QNM and branch-cut contributions reconstruct the waveform, we evaluate the branch-cut amplitude relative to the QNM amplitude. For wave packets with a characteristic frequency $\omega_0\sim 1/M$, the branch-cut amplitude is typically of order $10\%$ of the QNM amplitude at ringdown onset with only a mild dependence on spin. We further find that the tail waveform before convolving with a source is almost independent of spin. The spin dependence of the relative amplitude therefore resides primarily in the excitation of the QNMs. Our results suggest that the branch-cut contribution may affect the accuracy of black hole spectroscopy, particularly near the onset of ringdown.

用下一代引力波探测器探测标量极化：探测器几何与源倾角的作用

Probing Scalar Polarization with Next-Generation Gravitational-Wave Detectors: The Roles of Detector Geometry and Source Inclination

Sk Md Adil Imam, Macarena Lagos · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：致密双星的引力波观测可直接检验引力是否具有广义相对论两种张量模式之外的极化。我们开展预报，评估未来多信使事件对标量极化的约束能力。通过双中子星注入，我们在PPE形式下预报对三个修改引力参数的限制：α（张量振幅）、α_B（标量振幅）和β（张量与标量相位）。与O5 LIGO-Virgo网络相比，Cosmic Explorer（CE）和Einstein Telescope（ET）各自将每个参数收紧1–2个数量级；ET的三角形几何对GW170817类及另一个代表性双中子星的标量模式振幅α_B给出持续约2倍于2×CE的改进。我们表明，若天区位置和光度距离由电磁观测已知，对轨道倾角ι加入基于电磁的先验，相对于各向同性倾角先验，可将GW170817类事件的α_B约束收窄约56倍。我们还评估电磁倾角先验以及中子星状态方程假设如何影响对标量振幅α_B的推断。总体而言，这些结果表明，探测器几何和良好定位的电磁外部信息都是未来十年标量极化检验的重要杠杆，与网络原始灵敏度并列。

English: Gravitational-wave observations of compact binaries offer a direct way to test whether gravity admits polarizations beyond the two tensor modes of general relativity. We perform a forecast to assess how well future multi-messenger events will constrain the presence of scalar polarizations in gravitational waves. Performing binary neutron star injections, we forecast next-generation constraints on three modified gravity parameters in the PPE formalism: $\alpha$ (tensor amplitude), $\alpha_B$ (scalar amplitude) and $\beta$ (tensor and scalar phase). Cosmic Explorer (CE) and Einstein Telescope (ET) each tighten every parameter by 1--2 orders of magnitude over an O5 LIGO-Virgo network, with ET's triangular geometry giving a persistent $\approx2\times$ improvement over 2$\times$CE on the scalar-mode amplitude $\alpha_B$ in both a GW170817-like and a second, representative BNS. We show that, if the sky position and luminosity distance are known from EM observations, adding an EM-based prior on the orbital inclination $\iota$ narrows the $\alpha_B$ constraint by $\approx56\times$ relative to an isotropic inclination prior, for a GW170817-like event. We also assess how EM inclination priors as well as assumptions on the neutron star equation of state may affect the inference on the scalar amplitude $\alpha_B$. Overall, these results indicate that detector geometry and the availability of well-placed EM external information are both important levers --- alongside raw network sensitivity --- for next decade scalar-polarization tests.

一句话导读：预报表明下一代引力波网络可显著收紧标量极化参数，且探测器几何与电磁倾角先验是关键杠杆。

f(R) 引力的广义相对论极限

The General-Relativistic Limit of f(R) Gravity

Philippe G. LeFloch, Yue Ma · gr-qc, math.AP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们针对接近 Minkowski 时空的小的、渐近欧氏的、良准备的 Cauchy 数据，建立 f(R) 引力与无质量标量场耦合时的广义相对论极限。我们证明全局存在性与未来因果测地完备性，并证明当一族可容许的修正拉格朗日量 f(R) 趋近 Einstein-Hilbert 拉格朗日量 R 时，度规、物质场和重标度有效场具有一致估计。物理度规、共角度规和物质场在整个未来时空上一致收敛到极限的 Einstein-无质量标量场发展，并连同有限多个空间和时间导数一起收敛。有效场由物理标量曲率的非线性重参数化定义，它收敛到极限 Einstein 发展的标量曲率。主要分析困难在于有效场质量趋于无穷，而其演化方程变为代数迹关系。小场振幅可以与高频振荡和相对较大的导数共存，其二次贡献必须被一致控制。我们使用欧氏-双曲叶理方法和适配的波坐标，分析一个非线性项不满足经典零条件的拟线性波-Klein-Gordon系统。我们结合振荡估计、加权内部与外部能量，以及关于偏离 Einstein 迹关系的传播估计。紧致区域上的定量收敛与一致时空衰减给出全局收敛。

English: We establish the general-relativistic limit of f(R) gravity coupled to a massless scalar field for small, asymptotically Euclidean, well-prepared Cauchy data near Minkowski spacetime. We prove global existence and future causal geodesic completeness, with uniform estimates for the metric, matter, and rescaled effective field as an admissible family of modified Lagrangians f(R) approaches the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian R. The physical and conformal metrics and the matter field converge to the limiting Einstein-massless-scalar development, uniformly on the entire future spacetime, together with finitely many space and time derivatives. The effective field, defined by a nonlinear reparametrization of the physical scalar curvature, converges to the scalar curvature of the limiting Einstein development. The main analytical difficulty is that the effective-field mass tends to infinity, while its evolution equation becomes an algebraic trace relation. Small field amplitudes may coexist with high-frequency oscillations and comparatively large derivatives, whose quadratic contributions must be controlled uniformly. Using the Euclidean-hyperboloidal foliation method and adapted wave coordinates, we analyze a quasilinear wave-Klein-Gordon system whose nonlinearities do not satisfy the classical null condition. We combine oscillatory estimates, weighted interior and exterior energies, and propagation estimates for the discrepancy from the Einstein trace relation. Quantitative convergence on compact regions and uniform spacetime decay yield global convergence.

一句话导读：该文严格证明 f(R) 引力在小渐近欧氏初值下收敛到 Einstein-无质量标量场系统，并给出全局存在性、测地完备性与一致收敛。

统一随机与确定性信号：间歇性双黑洞背景的实用搜索

Unifying stochastic and deterministic signals: a practical search for the intermittent binary black-hole background

Tore Boybeyi, Vuk Mandic, Joseph Romano · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：过去十年，Advanced LIGO、Advanced Virgo 和 KAGRA 已探测到近 400 个致密双星并合，其中大多数是恒星级双黑洞并合。然而，宇宙中大多数并合在当前灵敏度下太弱，无法被单独探测。由于双黑洞并合在频带内的时间远短于连续并合之间的平均时间，这些亚阈值事件形成了间歇性引力波背景。该背景必然存在，但当前的随机或确定性搜索尚未探测到它。本文提出一种快速且准确的基于似然的搜索，将标准的模型无关交叉相关搜索与完全确定性的模板搜索统一在单个似然中。该搜索基于截断似然比，对单个并合的外禀参数完全边缘化，并将两个探测器的数据表示为近似充分统计量的展开。这些统计量是数据的高阶交叉矩，由几何因子加权，这些因子推广了交叉相关搜索中使用的标准重叠约化函数。我们表明，关于双黑洞并合种群的几乎所有贝叶斯证据和信息都来自单个并合引起的频率 bin 之间的相关性，并体现在高阶广义重叠约化函数中。因此，任何不考虑这些频率间相关性的似然函数都必然次优。我们在一年模拟 Advanced LIGO 数据上验证了该搜索，发现结合已探测和未分辨并合信息的目录知情分析可以推断双黑洞并合种群红移分布的峰值。

English: Over the past decade, the Advanced LIGO, Advanced Virgo, and KAGRA detectors have detected nearly 400 compact binary mergers, most of which are stellar-mass binary black-hole (BBH) mergers. Nevertheless, most mergers in the Universe are too weak to be individually detected at current sensitivity levels. Since a BBH merger in band is much shorter than the average time between successive mergers, the population of these subthreshold events gives rise to an intermittent background of gravitational waves (GWs). This GW background is guaranteed to exist, but it has not yet been detected with current stochastic or deterministic searches. Here we propose a fast and accurate likelihood-based search for this background, which unifies the standard model-agnostic cross-correlation search and a fully deterministic, template-based search in a single likelihood. Our search is based on a truncated likelihood ratio, which is fully marginalized over the extrinsic parameters of the individual mergers, and which represents the data in two detectors as an expansion in terms of approximate sufficient statistics. These statistics are higher-order cross-moments of the data, weighted by geometrical factors that generalize the standard overlap reduction function (ORF) used in cross-correlation searches. We show that almost all the Bayesian evidence and information on the BBH merger population comes from correlations between frequency bins induced by individual mergers and is captured in the higher-order generalized ORFs. Consequently, any likelihood function that does not take these inter-frequency correlations into account is necessarily suboptimal. We validate our search on one year of simulated Advanced LIGO data, and find that a catalog-informed analysis, which uses information from both the detected and unresolved mergers, can infer the peak of the redshift distribution of the population of BBH mergers.

一句话导读：提出一种统一的基于似然的搜索方法，将随机交叉相关搜索与确定性模板搜索结合，用于探测亚阈值双黑洞并合形成的间歇性引力波背景。

为非高斯引力波背景构造似然函数

Constructing likelihoods for a non-Gaussian gravitational-wave background

Tore Boybeyi, Vuk Mandic, Joseph Romano · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：恒星质量致密双星产生的随机引力波背景由有限个并合事件组成，因此是非高斯的。本文用多探测器数据的特征函数重新表述这类天体物理背景的数据分析问题，并表明现有搜索是该框架的不同极限情形；同时说明可通过特征函数的不同近似构造新的搜索，为设计合适的近似充分统计量提供具体途径。文章还用该形式分析一个可精确求解的玩具模型作为示例。

English: The stochastic gravitational-wave background from stellar-mass compact binaries is non-Gaussian since it is made up of a finite number of individual mergers. Over the years, several methods have been developed to search for this background beyond the standard cross-correlation statistic. We reformulate the data analysis problem for such astrophysical backgrounds in terms of the characteristic function of the data in multiple detectors, and show that the existing searches arise as different limiting cases. We also show that new searches can be constructed through different approximations of the characteristic function, which gives a concrete way to engineer suitable approximate sufficient statistics. To illustrate this framework in the context of a simple example, we use the formalism proposed here to analyze an exactly solvable toy model.

一句话导读：用多探测器特征函数统一非高斯随机引力波背景的似然与搜索框架。

动态Chern-Simons引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞轴向准正规模的等谱性破缺

Isospectrality breaking in the axial quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity

Abhishek Rout · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究动态Chern-Simons（dCS）引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的奇宇称扰动。尽管dCS作用量因ϑ *RR是两个赝标量之积而具有宇称不变性，赝标量扰动具有奇宇称，在线性阶只进入轴向扇区，从而破除广义相对论中的轴向—极向等谱性。作者从线性化场方程直接导出有限电荷下赝标量与轴向引力、电磁扰动之间的耦合。两个方向都由径向核(Mr-Q^2)Δ/r^8支配；在非零电荷下，赝标量耦合到Ψ+χΨ_e，其中χ=2Q/[r√((l-1)(l+2))]。在对Einstein-Maxwell扇区对角化后，他们用外复标度法计算光子球模的分支分辨准正规模频移，用Frobenius打靶法计算近极值零阻尼模。对Schwarzschild l=2基模得到β δω=-0.7733-0.3946 i（单位M=α=1）。非共振时，引力主导频移在Q=0按ζ l^3标度，但在固定非零电荷和大l时按ζ l^2/Q标度。电磁主导分支在Q_c=2M√(l(l+1)+1)/[l(l+1)+2]处与赝标量模精确简并，此时破缺为O(√ζ)，l=2时M|Δω|≈2.4√ζ，且频移在Q_c两侧变号。近极值时，光子球频移保持有限，而非简并的引力主导基模零阻尼模受到抑制，l=2时δω/ω≈6.0×10^3 ζ(1-Q^2/M^2)。

English: We study odd-parity perturbations of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity. The dCS action is parity invariant because $\vartheta\,{}^{*}RR$ is the product of two pseudoscalars; nevertheless, the pseudoscalar perturbation has odd parity and enters only the axial sector at linear order and so lifts the axial--polar isospectrality of general relativity. We derive the finite-charge couplings between the pseudoscalar and the axial gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations directly from the linearized field equations. Both directions are governed by the radial kernel $(Mr-Q^2)\Delta/r^8$, and at nonzero charge the pseudoscalar couples to $\Psi+\chi\Psi_e$, with $\chi=2Q/[r\sqrt{(l-1)(l+2)}]$. After diagonalizing the Einstein--Maxwell sector, we compute branch-resolved quasinormal-mode shifts with exterior complex scaling for the photon-sphere modes and Frobenius shooting for the near-extremal zero-damping modes. For the Schwarzschild $l=2$ fundamental mode we obtain $\beta\,\delta\omega=-0.7733-0.3946\,i$ (units $M=\alpha=1$). Off resonance, the gravitational-led shift scales as $\zeta\,l^3$ at $Q=0$ but as $\zeta\,l^2/Q$ at fixed nonzero charge and large $l$. The electromagnetic-led branch becomes exactly degenerate with the pseudoscalar mode at $Q_c=2M\sqrt{l(l+1)+1}/[l(l+1)+2]$, where the pseudoscalar potential coincides with the polar partner of the electromagnetic-led potential; there the breaking is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt\zeta)$, $M|\Delta\omega|\simeq2.4\sqrt\zeta$ for $l=2$, and the shift reverses sign across $Q_c$. Near extremality the photon-sphere shifts remain finite, whereas the non-degenerate fundamental gravitational-led zero-damping mode is suppressed, $\delta\omega/\omega\simeq6.0\times10^{3}\,\zeta\,(1-Q^2/M^2)$ for $l=2$.

带挠率的旋量引力场与物质-反物质不对称

Gravitational field of spinors with torsion and matter$-$antimatter asymmetry

Nikodem Pop{\l}awski · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文从弯曲时空中自由 Dirac 粒子的轨道角动量与自旋角动量守恒出发，要求仿射联络具有反对称部分，即挠率张量，从而把广义相对论推广为 Einstein-Cartan 引力。在带挠率时空中，Dirac 方程成为旋量波函数的非线性三次方程；在电荷共轭下，非线性项相对于质量项变号，因此 Dirac 旋量与其电荷共轭满足不同的场方程。作者用旋量联络形式推导了中心对称带挠率引力场中球对称旋量的 Dirac 方程，确定了该旋量的能量-动量张量，并表明挠率对物质粒子能量贡献为负、对反物质粒子为正；因此费米子基态能量低于相应反费米子基态。作者还导出了该旋量的 Einstein-Cartan-Dirac 方程，指出存在表现出物质-反物质能量不对称的类粒子孤子解。

English: The conservation law for the orbital plus spin angular momentum of a free Dirac particle in curved spacetime requires that the affine connection has the antisymmetric part: the torsion tensor, which extends general relativity to the Einstein$-$Cartan theory of gravity. In spacetime with torsion, the Dirac equation becomes a nonlinear, cubic equation in the spinor wave function. Under charge conjugation, the nonlinear term changes sign relative to the mass term. A Dirac spinor and its charge conjugate therefore satisfy different field equations. We use the spinor connection formalism to derive the Dirac equation for a spherical spinor in its centrally symmetric gravitational field with torsion. We determine the energy$-$momentum tensor for this spinor and show that the energy contribution from torsion is negative for matter particles and positive for antimatter particles. Consequently, the ground state of a fermion has a lower energy than the ground state of the corresponding antifermion. We also derive the Einstein$-$Cartan$-$Dirac equations for this spinor; they indicate the existence of particle-like soliton solutions exhibiting matter$-$antimatter energy asymmetry.

English: General Relativity predicts that black holes lack an internal structure and that their tidal Love numbers vanish. Then, during a binary inspiral, their tidal deformation could transfer orbital energy to the UCO, increasing the orbital period and leaving an observable imprint on the phase of the emitted gravitational waves. As we discussed previously, the effect is enhanced if one binary companion is resonantly excited. Here we use the point-particle effective field theory framework to calculate this enhancement. We consider circular orbits and focus on excitations of the internal electric quadrupole, modelling the UCO spectrum as a harmonic oscillator spectrum. However, our methods could be straightforwardly extended to more complicated situations. Integrating out the internal quadrupole induces a series of time-dependent finite-size operators with specific numerical coefficients, which we calculate. We find that the static electric quadrupole Love number $k_2$ is negative, and that all finite-size terms are proportional to $k_2$. We further show that resonant excitation induces a leading 2.5 Post-Newtonian term, compared with the 5 Post-Newtonian term in the time-independent case. Our results confirm the expectation that resonant excitation during a binary inspiral offers one of the best ways to detect whether astrophysical black holes can undergo tidal deformation and, if they do, learn about their internal excitation spectrum.

English: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) provide a powerful probe of strong-field gravity. Using residual-controlled continuation and symmetric finite differences, validated by a Kerr continued-fraction benchmark and an independent radial spectral method, we compute the linear frequency response. Axisymmetric modes provide an exact Kerr null test. For the corotating modes studied, the real-frequency response is positive and increases with spin. At $a/M=0.9$, the two methods reveal a roughly $2\%$ angular correction to the real response, while the imaginary response is nonmonotonic and highly sensitive to angular projection due to internal cancellation. These results highlight the distinct rotational signatures of Lorentz violation in black-hole ringdown.

English: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource that gives rise to correlations with no classical counterpart in strongly correlated fermionic systems. However, its characterization in mixed quantum states remains challenging. Established entanglement diagnostics, such as logarithmic negativity, are computationally demanding in interacting systems, and their evaluation by exact diagonalization is restricted to small system sizes. Meanwhile, conventional R\'enyi proxies, including twisted and untwisted R\'enyi negativities, can be positive even for separable states. In this work, we introduce a family of \textit{relative R\'enyi negativities} that serve as entanglement witnesses. By relating fermionic partial time reversal to the size superoperator, we establish a path-integral representation for these R\'enyi negativities, enabling their evaluation in thermal states of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model and its generalizations via a large-$N$ expansion. Applying this method, we investigate entanglement in both the original SYK model and the Maldacena-Qi coupled SYK model. We identify a special class of relative R\'enyi negativities which serve as plausible proxies for logarithmic negativity and uncover first-order entanglement transitions that are invisible to simple observables. These results highlight the utility of relative R\'enyi negativities as probes of mixed-state entanglement in strongly correlated fermionic systems and suggest the existence of a new class of transitions where these negativities serve as free energies.

中文摘要：我们提出了一族新的 Ricci 平坦转动度规，称为 Solution II，它通过将真正的 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (G-KBR) 黑洞去磁化得到。它与此前由 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) 黑洞去磁化得到的 Solution I 一起，给出两族以 B 标记的 Kerr 黑洞 Ricci 平坦形变。我们研究其整体结构、热力学、各种极限以及这些极限之间的局域联系。我们还研究 Einstein-Maxwell 与 Kaluza-Klein 理论中的重磁化，发现为得到物理上可接受的解，Ernst 变换需辅以适当的 trombone 重标度。

English: We present a new family of Ricci-flat rotating metrics, which we refer to as Solution II, obtained by demagnetizing the genuine Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (G-KBR) black hole. Together with Solution I, which was previously obtained by demagnetizing the Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) black hole, this gives two families of Ricci-flat deformations of the Kerr black hole, each labeled by $B$. We study the global structures, thermodynamics, various limits, and the local connections among these limits. We also study the remagnetizations in both Einstein-Maxwell and Kaluza-Klein theories, and find that, to yield a physically acceptable solution, the Ernst transformation should be augmented by an appropriate trombone rescaling.

一句话导读：通过去磁化 KBR/G-KBR 构造两族 Ricci 平坦 Kerr 形变黑洞，并讨论其热力学及 Einstein-Maxwell/Kaluza-Klein 重磁化。

来自大统一理论的磁荷黑洞

Magnetically Charged Black Holes from Grand Unified Theory

Tanmay Vachaspati, Anja Wachowitz · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：粒子物理的大统一模型不可避免地产生磁单极子。通常模型还会包含一个弱破缺的离散对称性，导致形成偏置畴壁，这些畴壁在宇宙学中只存活有限时期。对于离散对称性破缺参数的一定范围，畴壁可以坍缩形成质量轻于约1 kg的磁荷极端黑洞，但由于霍金蒸发和单极子的Schwinger对产生，预计它们不会存活到今天。如果该参数更小，黑洞可能是天体物理尺度的，质量大于10^15 g，并具有亚极端磁荷：Q约10^8（对于我们的典型参数选择）。残余磁单极子的宇宙学能量密度取决于离散对称性破缺参数；对于足够小的参数值，磁单极子密度可以满足所有观测约束。

English: Grand Unified models of particle physics inevitably give rise to magnetic monopoles. Often the model will also contain a weakly broken discrete symmetry that leads to the formation of biased domain walls that survive for a limited period in cosmology. For a range of the discrete symmetry breaking parameter, domain walls can collapse to form magnetically charged extremal black holes lighter than $\simeq 1\, {\rm kg}$ but these are not expected to survive until the present epoch due to Hawking evaporation and Schwinger pair production of monopoles. If the parameter is smaller still, the black holes may be astrophysical, with mass greater than $10^{15}\, {\rm g}$ and with sub-extremal magnetic charge: $Q \simeq 10^8$ (for our canonical choice of parameters). The cosmological energy density in residual magnetic monopoles depends on the discrete symmetry breaking parameter and for sufficiently small values of the parameter, the magnetic monopole density can satisfy all observational constraints.

一句话导读：大统一理论中的偏置畴壁坍缩可产生磁荷黑洞，并给出残余磁单极子密度与观测约束的关系。

Kerr-Newman-NUT 时空中的双视界扇区热力学与 NUT 双毛

Two-horizon sector thermodynamics and NUT bi-hair in Kerr-Newman-NUT spacetimes

Di Wu, Robert B. Mann, Shuang-Qing Wu · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：仅靠第一定律一致性不能确定 NUT 带电时空的黑洞状态空间，因为若干不等价的宏观表述都可给出一致的热力学。我们通过将内、外视界熵和逆温度组织为和（Σ）与差（Δ）扇区，为带电 Kerr-Newman-NUT 族建立双视界扇区诊断。带电转动几何对无电荷 Taub-NUT 扇区结果给出更严格检验，因为质量 M、普通电荷 Q、普通角动量 J、NUT 荷 N 以及 NUT 次级毛 J_N=MN 都进入同一双视界热力学。对于本文定义并检验的物理锚定最小齐次状态空间，我们发现清晰的扇区分隔：Σ 扇区由类荷变量 Q 和 N 闭合，而 Δ 扇区还需类转动变量 J 和 J_N。消除 J_N 或 N 的自然约化无法再现由扇区温度固定的第一定律系数，其 Bekenstein-Smarr 关系也不能按指定标度权重闭合。在该类中，电荷与普通转动不能吸收 NUT 次级响应，带电转动族支持 NUT 双毛组织：N 具有类荷扇区角色，而 J_N=MN 是类转动的热力学次级毛。后者在齐次状态方程中离壳定义，不是新度规参数或渐近守恒荷。

English: First law consistency alone does not determine the black hole state space of NUT-charged spacetimes, because several inequivalent macroscopic formulations can yield consistent thermodynamics. We develop a two-horizon sector diagnostic for the electrically charged Kerr-Newman-NUT family by organizing the inner- and outer-horizon entropies and inverse temperatures into sum ($\Sigma$) and difference ($\Delta$) sectors. The charged rotating geometry gives a more stringent test of the uncharged Taub-NUT sector result, since the mass $M$, ordinary electric charge $Q$, ordinary angular momentum $J$, NUT charge $N$, and the NUT secondary hair $J_N=MN$ all enter the same two-horizon thermodynamics. For the physically anchored minimal homogeneous state spaces defined and tested here, we find a clear sector separation: the $\Sigma$ sector closes with the charge-like variables $Q$ and $N$, whereas the $\Delta$ sector additionally requires the rotation-like variables $J$ and $J_N$. Natural reductions that eliminate either $J_N$ or $N$ fail to reproduce the first law coefficient fixed by the sector temperature, and their associated Bekenstein-Smarr relations do not close with the assigned scaling weights. Within this class, electric charge and ordinary rotation therefore do not absorb the NUT secondary response, and the charged rotating family supports the NUT bi-hair organization: $N$ has a charge-like sector role, while $J_N=MN$ is a rotation-like thermodynamic secondary hair. The latter is defined off shell in the homogeneous equation of state, not as a new metric parameter or asymptotic conserved charge.

一句话导读：通过双视界 Σ/Δ 扇区诊断表明 Kerr-Newman-NUT 黑洞热力学支持 N 与 J_N=MN 的 NUT 双毛结构。

Kerr黑洞中直接波的理论研究：面向铃宕分析的极点劈裂方法

Theoretical Aspects of Direct Waves in Kerr Black Holes: Pole-Splitting Method for Ringdown Analysis

Nao Nakamoto, Naritaka Oshita, Hiroki Takeda · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-ph, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们发展了极端质量比情形下粒子坠入Kerr黑洞所产生直接波（DW）的理论描述。DW由反映粒子轨道运动（包括在能层内运动）的源驱动复频率ω_G刻画，因此有望成为探测Kerr黑洞丰富结构的探针。我们表明，准正模（QNM）极点部分对DW的贡献是动力学QNM激发的一部分。我们还表明，在轨迹、齐次径向解和完整点粒子源的相容近视界展开的每一阶，表观视界模极点都会相消。该结果假设点粒子在视界附近沿测地线运动，并保留了粒子经过能层表面或势垒附近时出现瞬态DW的可能性。为在模拟坠入波形中研究这一可能性，我们发展了一种极点劈裂方法，将传递函数分解为QNM极点部分和非极点部分。所得的波形分解避免了QNM滤波引入的依赖频率的时间平移（群延迟）。对于坠入中等和快速旋转Kerr黑洞的准圆轨道情形，非极点波形的频率和衰减率在有限时间区间内与我们的理论预言定性一致。这些结果支持将DW用作探测黑洞周围能层和引力红移效应的潜在工具。

English: We develop a theoretical description of direct waves (DWs) from a particle plunging into a Kerr black hole in the extreme-mass-ratio regime. A DW is characterized by a source-driven complex frequency $\omega_{\rm G}$ that reflects the particle's orbital motion, including motion inside the ergoregion. Hence, it is expected to be a probe of rich structures of Kerr black holes. We show that the contribution of the quasinormal-mode (QNM) pole sector to the DW is part of dynamical QNM excitation. We also show that the apparent horizon-mode poles cancel at every order of a consistent near-horizon expansion of the trajectory, homogeneous radial solution, and complete point-particle source. This result assumes that the point particle follows a geodesic near the horizon and leaves open the possibility of a transient DW while the particle passes near the ergosurface or the vicinity of the potential barrier. To investigate this possibility in simulated plunge waveforms, we develop a pole-splitting method that decomposes the transfer function into QNM-pole and non-pole parts. The resulting waveform decomposition avoids the frequency-dependent time shift (group delay) introduced by the QNM filtering. For quasi-circular plunges into moderately and rapidly rotating Kerr black holes, the frequency and decay rate of the non-pole waveform show qualitative agreement with our theoretical prediction over finite time intervals. These results support the potential use of DWs as probes of the ergoregion and gravitational redshift effect around black holes.

一句话导读：该文建立Kerr黑洞极端质量比坠入直接波的理论框架，并提出极点劈裂方法分离QNM极点与非极点波形，用于铃宕分析。

静态多极 Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet 黑洞

Static multipolar Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet black holes

Burkhard Kleihaus, Jutta Kunz · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们在带二次耦合函数的 Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中构造并分析静态多极黑洞。矢量化解在离散的 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合值处从 Schwarzschild 黑洞分岔，这些值由 Schwarzschild 背景上的微扰本征值问题得到，并以角多极数 ℓ 标记。我们限于基本径向分支。电 sector 包含已知的球对称 ℓ=0 分支以及 ℓ>0 的轴对称分支，这些电分支延伸到更大的耦合值。磁 sector 具有一系列轴对称分支，包括此前发现的 ℓ=0 磁偶极分支；磁分支只存在于有限的耦合区间内，并终止于临界解。远离分岔点时，非线性会生成额外多极，但偶 ℓ 与奇 ℓ 矩仍然分离。

English: We construct and analyze static multipolar black holes in Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet theory with a quadratic coupling function. The vectorized solutions bifurcate from the Schwarzschild black hole at discrete values of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, obtained from a perturbative eigenvalue problem on the Schwarzschild background and labelled by the angular multipole number $\ell$. We restrict to the fundamental radial branches. The electric sector contains the known spherically symmetric $\ell=0$ branch as well as axisymmetric branches with $\ell>0$. These electric branches extend to larger values of the coupling. The magnetic sector features a sequence of axisymmetric branches, including the previously found magnetic dipole branch at $\ell=0$. The magnetic branches instead exist only on finite intervals of the coupling, ending at critical solutions. Away from the bifurcation point, nonlinearities generate additional multipoles, but even-$\ell$ and odd-$\ell$ moments remain separated.

一句话导读：该文在 Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中构造静态多极黑洞，并刻画电、磁矢量化解的分岔结构及其有限耦合区间行为。

旋转带电量子修正黑洞的谐振荡与轨道形态

Harmonic oscillation and orbital morphology for spinning charged quantum corrected black hole

Rameez Khalid, Muhammad Yasir, Shahid Qaisar, Faisal Javed · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文在旋转带电 Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton 量子修正黑洞时空中研究测试粒子的动力学，分析自旋参数 a、量子修正参数 b 和电荷参数 Q 对有效势与有效力的影响，以确定强引力场中圆轨道的稳定性和结构。文章计算径向、垂直和角向振荡频率以及近星点进动和 Lense-Thirring 进动频率，并讨论这些修正对圆轨道位置、稳定性及粒子运动频谱的影响。

English: This study investigates the dynamical behavior of particle's test around a spinning charged Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMd) quantum corrected black hole (QCBH) by examining the effects of spinning parameter $a$, quantum correction parameter $b$, and charge parameter $Q$. Using EMd spacetime geometry, we analyze the effective potential and effective force to determine the stability and structure of the circular orbits in a strong gravitational field. Furthermore, we calculate the oscillation frequencies radial $(\Omega_r)$, vertical $(\Omega_\theta)$, and angular $(\Omega_\phi)$, as well as the corresponding Periapsis and Lense-Thirring precession frequencies. The spin parameter primarily determines the spinning properties of spacetime, while the quantum correction and charge particle introduce additional biases to Kerr-Newman geometry, particularly near the event horizon. These corrections alter the position and stability of the circular orbits, and the spectrum effectively associates with particle's motion. The results provide a comprehensive description of the orbital dynamics of spinning EMd QCBH through future high-precision astrophysical observations.

一句话导读：研究旋转带电 Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton 量子修正黑洞周围测试粒子的有效势、圆轨道稳定性及振荡与进动频率。

中文摘要：我们考虑嵌入变质量暗物质晕中的黑洞解，并研究由暗物质诱导的标量化。我们推导了标量暗物质耦合所需的条件，使正则束缚态标量云能够存在。我们发现这类位形仅当耦合取量子化值时存在，该量子化值由晕的内禀参数决定（对 Hernquist 晕，约化为紧致度的倒数）。该工作为暗物质现象学与黑洞周围标量化之间提供了新联系。

Shadow, Emission, and Strong-Field Lensing of Dilatonic Black Holes

Kuantay Boshkayev, Ainur Urazalina, Aidana Kurmanbek, Manas Khassanov, Daniya Utepova · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们研究静态球对称、类双荷膨胀子黑洞的阴影与强场光学性质。我们得到光子球半径、临界碰撞参数和阴影半径，并分析它们随电荷 Q 与膨胀子耦合参数 a 的变化。结果表明，增大这些参数会减小光子球半径和阴影半径，从而导致更小的视阴影。我们将预测的角直径与 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的观测数据进行比较。我们明确显示 Sgr A* 数据不能约束模型参数，而 M87* 的结果依赖于所采用的恒星动力学与气体动力学质量估计。我们还用几何光学近似估计高频能量发射率，并推导出主导的 Bozza 系数 ar{a}，该系数刻画强场区域偏折角的对数行为。最后讨论所得结果的 astrophysical implications。

English: We study the shadow and strong-field optical properties of a static, spherically symmetric dyon-like dilatonic black hole. The photon sphere radius, critical impact parameter, and shadow radius are obtained and analyzed in terms of the charge $Q$ and the dilatonic coupling parameter $a$. We show that increasing these parameters decreases the photon sphere and shadow radii, leading to a smaller apparent shadow. The predicted angular diameter is compared with the observational data for M87$^{*}$ and SgrA$^{*}$. We explicitly show that the Sgr A* data do not constrain the model parameters, whereas the results for M87* depend on the adopted mass estimates from stellar and gas dynamics. We also estimate the high-frequency energy emission rate in the geometric-optics approximation and derive the leading Bozza coefficient $\bar{a}$, which characterizes the logarithmic behavior of the deflection angle in the strong-field regime. Astrophysical implication of the obtained outcomes are discussed.

Kei-ichiro Kubota, Hayato Motohashi · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, cond-mat.stat-mech, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：Kerr准正规模在代数特殊频率附近表现出异常行为，包括表观分叉、消失以及与Schwarzschild极限的非光滑连接，这数十年来一直令人困惑。通过追踪格林函数构建块在不同黎曼面上的极点与零点，我们表明分叉是由伴随共振激发的避免交叉引起的，而消失则是由松原模零点抵消准正规模极点导致的极点跳过引起的。这解决了这些长期异常现象的物理起源。

English: Kerr quasinormal modes near algebraically special frequencies exhibit anomalous behavior, including apparent bifurcation, disappearance, and a nonsmooth connection to the Schwarzschild limit, which has remained puzzling for decades. Tracking poles and zeros of Green-function building blocks across different Riemann sheets, we show that the bifurcation is due to an avoided crossing accompanied by resonant excitation, while the disappearance is due to pole skipping caused by cancellation of a quasinormal-mode pole by a Matsubara-mode zero. This resolves the physical origin of these long-standing anomalies.
