超越准正规模：黑洞扰动的完整模式分解

Beyond quasinormal modes: a complete mode decomposition of black hole perturbations

Paolo Arnaudo, Javier Carballo, Benjamin Withers · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：作者证明黑洞时空的推迟格林函数可以在全时空写成收敛的模式和。晚期由准正规模求和收敛，早期由 Matsubara（欧几里得）模式求和收敛；两个区域由一个从黑洞势散射出的光锥分隔。Matsubara 求和是早期区域对应欧几里得热圆周上的傅里叶级数。文章以 Pöschl-Teller、BTZ 和 Schwarzschild 为例展示结果。对 Schwarzschild，作者在 Λ→0+ 时把分支割贡献写成 de Sitter 准正规模的收敛求和，并利用近期关于 Heun 连接问题的精确解。每种情形都通过研究留数求和的渐近行为解析证明收敛，并给出数值演示。

English: We show that retarded Green's functions of black hole spacetimes can be expressed as a convergent mode sum everywhere in spacetime. At late times a quasinormal mode sum converges, while at early times a Matsubara (or, Euclidean) mode sum converges. The two regions are separated by a lightcone which scatters from the black hole potential. The Matsubara sum is a Fourier series on the Euclidean thermal circle associated to the early time region. Jeffrey Opreij, David Skinner, Hangzhi Wang · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们提出了一个完全定义在零无穷上的理论，用于描述闵可夫斯基体时空中的杨-米尔斯理论。该模型的动力学场是体规范场的特征数据，其作用量将电支卡罗尔动能项与天体球上连接不同点的MHV型非局域相互作用结合起来。我们明确展示该理论如何恢复杨-米尔斯的所有MHV和NMHV树级振幅，并概述如何通过其费曼图展开得到任意树级振幅。我们得到的NMHV振幅详细表达式似乎是新的。

English: We provide a theory defined purely on null infinity that describes Yang-Mills in the Minkowski space bulk. The dynamical field of our model is the characteristic data of the bulk gauge field, and the action combines an electric branch Carrollian kinetic term with non-local interactions of MHV type that link different points on the celestial sphere. We explicitly show how this theory recovers all MHV and NMHV tree amplitudes in Yang-Mills, and outline how arbitrary tree amplitudes may be obtained from its Feynman diagram expansion. The detailed expression we find for the NMHV amplitude appears to be new.

矩阵量子力学伴随扇区的Regge轨迹

Regge trajectories from the adjoint sector of Matrix Quantum Mechanics

Igor R. Klebanov, Henry W. Lin, Pavel Meshcheriakov · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们重新审视一个厄米矩阵的SU(N)对称量子力学的大N极限；其单态扇区可通过自由费米子精确求解。当费米能级接近势的极大值时，出现对应于二维弦理论的临界行为。通过数值和半经典近似求解Marchesini-Onofri方程，我们在伴随扇区发现新现象：在临界点，谱由Regge轨迹支配，能量本征值按 Δ^2 ∼ n/α' 增长。在对偶二维弦理论中，我们将这些态解释为“短”折叠开弦的振荡激发。至次领头修正，这种Regge行为基本是普适的，且不依赖于趋近临界时所选的具体势。稍微偏离临界点，高激发态转变为延伸至Liouville方向的“长弦”。

English: We reexamine the large $N$ limit of SU$(N)$ symmetric quantum mechanics of a Hermitian matrix whose singlet sector is well known to be exactly solvable via free fermions. When the Fermi level approaches a maximum of the potential, there is critical behavior corresponding to string theory in two dimensions. We uncover new phenomena in the adjoint sector by solving the Marchesini-Onofri equation both numerically and analytically using semiclassical approximations: at criticality, the spectrum is governed by Regge trajectories with energy eigenvalues growing according to $\Delta^2 \sim n/ \alpha'$. In the dual 2D string theory, we interpret these states as oscillatory excitations of a ``short'' folded open string. Up to sub-leading corrections, this Regge behavior is essentially universal and is insensitive to the particular potential we choose to approach criticality. Slightly away from criticality, the highly excited states transition into ``long strings'' that extend far into the Liouville direction.

中文摘要：天球振幅是相对于共形维数的多重 Mellin 变换。对于足够高维时空 D 中任意多重数 n 的无质量态，我们完成所有 Mellin 积分，并在天球空间中得到一个 associahedron 描述。该描述将树级天球 φ^3 振幅表示为与此正几何相联系的典范形式。这给出了天球振幅基于底层边界几何的几何解释。我们对 D 维 Mellin 积分的统一处理也为来自不同体理论的天球振幅提供了统一描述。

English: Celestial amplitudes are multiple Mellin transforms w.r.t. conformal dimensions. This yields a geometric interpretation of celestial amplitudes in terms of the underlying boundary geometry. Our universal treatment of Mellin integrals in $D$ dimensions also provides a unified description of celestial amplitudes arising from different bulk theories.

中文摘要：本文指出，在 post-Minkowskian (PM) 区域用合适运动学变量表示时，双体系统的引力可观测量对两个散射物体质量 m1、m2 呈简单多项式依赖；结合粒子交换对称性，可由探针极限 m1≫m2 重构领头和次领头 PM 波形。作为应用，作者计算了探针极限波形至 10PN，并据此推导质心系中一般质量波形至 5PN，使用了基于振幅的波形被积函数与 tail 公式。

English: Gravitational observables for binary systems exhibit a simple polynomial dependence on the masses $m_1$, $m_2$ of the two scattering objects when they are written in terms of the appropriate kinematic variables in the post-Minkowskian (PM) regime. As an application, focusing on their re-expansion in the small-velocity or post-Newtonian (PN) regime, we calculate the probe-limit waveforms up to 10PN, and then exploit this observation to deduce from them the waveforms for generic masses in the center-of-mass frame up to 5PN. 婴儿宇宙安然无恙，且 CFT 知晓此事：论闭合宇宙的全息描述

The Baby Universe is Fine and the CFT Knows It: On Holography for Closed Universes

Stefano Antonini, Pratik Rath, Martin Sasieta, Brian Swingle, Alejandro Vilar L\'opez · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：大爆炸/大挤压型闭合宇宙可以在 AdS/CFT 中实现，尽管它们没有渐近 AdS 边界。当体纠缠足够多时，闭合宇宙的体希尔伯特空间可由 CFT 全息编码。本文澄清这种编码与观察者克隆提议的关系，并反驳近期关于此类空间中半经典物理失效的论证。在无体纠缠极限下，全息编码失效。常被提及的闭合宇宙希尔伯特空间的一维性，反映了外部 CFT 希尔伯特空间访问闭合宇宙量子信息的局限，类似于完全孤立量子实验室外观察者所受的限制。作者主张，CFT 在该情形下仍决定闭合宇宙的物理性质，并说明如何用闭合宇宙中的末态投影解释这一关系；给出了末态波函数与 CFT 数据之间的字典；提出了在给定初始或末态投影下宇宙时间箭头出现的模型；最后表明，无投影的闭合宇宙中传统 EFT 可作为末态的最大无知描述被恢复，该 EFT 编码于 CFT 数据中并可通过粗粒化可观测量探测，且给出一个此类可观测量的例子。

English: Big bang/big crunch closed universes can be realized in AdS/CFT, even though they lack asymptotically AdS boundaries. With enough bulk entanglement, the bulk Hilbert space of a closed universe can be holographically encoded in the CFT. We clarify the relation of this encoding to observer-clone proposals and refute recent arguments about the breakdown of semiclassical physics in such spaces. In the limit of no bulk entanglement, the holographic encoding breaks down. The oft-cited one-dimensional nature of the closed universe Hilbert space represents the limitation of the external (CFT) Hilbert space to access the quantum information in the closed universe, similar to the limitations imposed on observers outside a perfectly isolated quantum lab. We advocate that the CFT nevertheless continues to determine the physical properties of the closed universe in this regime, showing how to interpret this relationship in terms of a final state projection in the closed universe. We provide a dictionary between the final state wavefunction and CFT data. We propose a model of the emergence of an arrow of time in the universe with a given initial or final state projection. Finally, we show that the conventional EFT in the closed universe, without any projection, can be recovered as a maximally ignorant description of the final state. This conventional EFT is encoded in CFT data, and it can be probed by computing coarse-grained observables. We provide an example of one such observable. Taken together, these results amount to a clean bill of health for baby universes born of AdS/CFT.

一句话导读：论文论证 AdS/CFT 可全息描述具有足够体纠缠的闭合婴儿宇宙，并在无纠缠极限下用末态投影和 CFT 字典解释其半经典 EFT。

边缘捕获阈值处对数喉的引力波回声与灰体截断

Gravitational-Wave Echoes and Greybody Cutoff from Logarithmic Throats at a Marginal-Trapping Threshold

Jahed Abedi · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：当静态球对称位形接近边缘捕获阈值时，会形成长喉。当 F=1-2m/r 的非退化极小值趋近于零，F≃Δ+β(r-R_M)^2 时，喉的固有长度按 -lnΔ/√β 增长，而局部曲率保持有限。我们研究轴向引力波在该喉的有效模型中的传播，其中 lapse 参数化为 N∝F^{s/2}。对于 s>0，喉充当角动量势垒后的腔，波以回声形式返回，回声间隔为 T_echo≃2Λ+δ∝Δ^{-s/2}，其中 Λ 是喉的光学长度，δ 不依赖 Δ。我们研究四维、物质支撑的准黑洞，其中正则中心封顶近 AdS2 喉；这些位形为带帽微态几何中的封顶喉提供了简化模型。该模型中的回声延迟由喉底附近红移的倒数控制，类似带帽微态几何；这不同于薄壳 gravastar 和 wormhole，后者的延迟仅随到拟视界距离对数增长。时域演化在 Δ 的三个数量级范围内确认了 Δ^{-s/2} 标度；对于 s=0，喉成为势垒的一部分，不出现独立回声。势垒还对反射谱施加灰体截断 1-Γ≃e^{-(ω-f)/T}，其中 T 由势垒曲率固定，不依赖其背后任何视界的表面引力。在该模型中，无论内部包含视界还是反射喉，初始信号相同；但在无视界情形下，透射波会作为回声返回，恢复全反射谱的高频部分。

English: When a static, spherically symmetric configuration is brought close to a marginal-trapping threshold, it develops a long throat. As the nondegenerate minimum of $F=1-2m/r$ approaches zero, $F\simeq\Delta+\beta(r-R_M)^2$, the proper length across the throat grows as $-\ln\Delta/\sqrt\beta$, even though the local curvature stays finite. We study how axial gravitational waves propagate in an effective model of this throat, in which the lapse is parametrized as $N\propto F^{s/2}$. For $s>0$ the throat acts as a cavity behind the angular-momentum barrier, and waves come back out as echoes spaced by $T_{\rm echo}\simeq2\Lambda+\delta\propto\Delta^{-s/2}$, where $\Lambda$ is the optical length of the throat and $\delta$ does not depend on $\Delta$. We study four-dimensional, matter-supported quasi-black holes in which a regular centre caps the near-AdS$_2$ throat. These configurations provide a simplified model for investigating capped throats in horizonless microstate geometries. The echo delay in this model is controlled by the inverse redshift near the bottom of the throat, as in capped microstate geometries. This differs from thin-shell gravastars and wormholes, where the delay grows only logarithmically with the distance to the would-be horizon. Time-domain evolutions confirm the $\Delta^{-s/2}$ scaling over three decades in $\Delta$; for $s=0$ the throat becomes part of the barrier and no distinct echo appears. The barrier also imposes a greybody cutoff on the reflected spectrum, $1-\Gamma\simeq e^{-(\omega-f)/T}$, where $T$ is fixed by the curvature of the barrier and does not depend on the surface gravity of any horizon behind it. In this model, the prompt signal is the same whether the interior contains a horizon or a reflecting throat. In the horizonless case, however, the transmitted wave returns as echoes, restoring the high-frequency part of the full reflected spectrum.

一句话导读：在边缘捕获阈值附近的长喉模型中，轴向引力波产生间隔按 Δ^{-s/2} 增长的回声，并受与势垒曲率相关的灰体截断。

准正规模相遇：Kerr–Newman 例外点附近的赝谱

Quasinormal-mode encounters: Pseudospectra near Kerr--Newman exceptional points

Kyriakos Destounis · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：例外点（EPs）是准正规模频率及其本征矢合并的点，可显著增强黑洞准正规模的谱不稳定性。本文利用赝谱和条件数研究 Kerr–Newman 时空中中性无质量标量场及耦合引力电磁（GE）扰动的这一行为。对标量场，沿 (ℓ,m)=(1,1) 椭球分支并由应力能量张量导出能量范数；对 GE 扰动，采用具有正辐射能的四场耦合系统。在选定的近 EP 背景上，紧邻模式对中两个模式的条件数超过同一背景下作为对比的另外两个更阻尼模式。沿匹配的 GE 参数路径，频率劈裂遵循平方根律，条件数随到 EP 距离的平方根倒数增长。赝谱等高线分辨了从单模式敏感性到模式对集体响应的转变。在本文考虑的离散化问题和能量范数内，这些结果量化了 EP 附近谱不稳定性的放大，并为研究其对黑洞铃宕的贡献提供基础。

English: Exceptional points (EPs), at which two quasinormal frequencies and their eigenvectors coalesce, can strongly enhance the spectral instability of black hole quasinormal modes. We investigate this behavior in Kerr--Newman spacetimes through pseudospectra and condition numbers for neutral massless scalar fields and coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GE) perturbations. For the scalar field, we follow the $(\ell,m)=(1,1)$ spheroidal branch and derive the energy norm from the stress-energy tensor. For GE perturbations, we use a coupled four-field system equipped with a positive radiative energy. At the selected near-EP backgrounds, the condition numbers of both modes in the close pair exceed those of the two more-damped modes shown for comparison at the same background. Along a matched GE parameter path, the frequency splitting follows a square-root law and the condition numbers grow as the inverse square root of the distance to the EP. The pseudospectral contours resolve the transition from individual-mode sensitivity to the collective response of the pair. Within the discretized problems and energy norms considered here, these results quantify the amplification of spectral instability near EPs and provide a basis for studying their contribution to black-hole ringdown.

一句话导读：用赝谱与条件数量化 Kerr–Newman 黑洞近例外点处准正规模的谱不稳定性放大。

重粒子有效理论：从在壳形式到引力康普顿振幅

Heavy-Particle Effective Theory: from On-Shell Formalism to Gravitational Compton Amplitudes

Yong-Kang Li, Yi-Ning Wang, Jiang-Hao Yu · hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文通过在时间类参考速度 v^μ 的 SU(2) 小群上投影旋量-螺旋度变量，构造在壳重粒子有效理论（HPET）振幅。保留速度投影旋量的大分量和小分量可得到中间的速度投影振幅，并可在按重粒子质量倒数展开前施加重参数化不变性。积掉小分量后，得到按重粒子幂次计数组织的 HPET 振幅，并与固定阶的局域算符直接对应。作者确定了任意自旋 S 的两个等质量粒子与螺旋度 h 的软无质量玻色子耦合的三点速度投影振幅。四点引力康普顿振幅可由速度投影三点振幅构造性获得，并展开为 HPET 振幅；在次领头阶之前没有伪极点。作为引力应用，文中表明投影的引力最小耦合可复现直至 2S 阶的 Kerr 自旋诱导多极，并发现树级弹性引力散射和引力康普顿振幅的经典极限与文献一致，差别仅在因子化无法确定的接触项。

English: We formulate on-shell heavy-particle effective theory (HPET) amplitudes by projecting the spinor-helicity variables onto the $SU(2)$ little group of a timelike reference velocity $v^{\mu}$. Retaining both large and small components of the velocity-projected spinors gives an intermediate velocity-projected amplitudes in which reparameterization invariance can be imposed before expanding in the inverse heavy-particle mass. Integrating out the small component then yields HPET amplitudes organized by heavy-particle power counting, with a direct correspondence to local operators at fixed order. We determine the three-point velocity-projected amplitudes for two equal-mass particles of arbitrary spin $S$ coupled to a soft massless boson of helicity $h$. Four-point gravitational Compton amplitudes can be constructively obtained using velocity-projected three-point amplitudes, and expanded into HPET amplitudes which is free of spurious poles up to sub-leading order. As a gravitational application, we show that the projected gravitational minimal coupling reproduces the Kerr spin-induced multipoles up to order $2S$, and find the classical limits of the tree-level elastic gravitational scattering and gravitational Compton amplitudes agreed with the literature up to contact terms undetermined by factorization.

一句话导读：建立速度投影的在壳重粒子有效理论，并用于生成无伪极点的引力康普顿振幅及复现 Kerr 多极与经典散射极限。

旋转使矢量毛发型黑洞过充电

Rotation overcharges vectorized black holes

Shengjun Guo, Guangzai Ye, Peng Liu · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：带电黑洞存在上限：极端性界限制约了给定质量和自旋所能承载的电荷。矢量毛发迄今只会降低这一上限。在 Einstein-Maxwell-Vector（EMV）模型中，无质量矢量场与电磁不变量非最小耦合，球对称的矢量化 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞严格处于欠充电状态：矢量毛发以电荷为代价。球对称是否掩盖了毛发质量的问题一直悬而未决，因为其 Komar 质量恒为零，恒等式 M_V=2Ω_HJ_V 退化为 0=0。旋转同时解除这两个简并。我们构造了该模型的旋转解（这是此设定下的首次），发现毛发质量并非自由参数，而是旋转响应的二阶不变量，由 M_V=2Ω_HJ_V 固定。超过耦合阈值后上限被突破：存在域越过极端 Kerr-Newman 边界，达到 q=Q/M>1，且 q²+χ² 最高可达 1.84；而在 α=5 时最大电荷仍低于该边界。阴影是毛发变得可见之处。在接近极端边界的 (q,χ)=(0.9947,0.10) 处，毛发贡献 8.30% 的椭率，电荷贡献 0.44%、旋转贡献 0.06%——因子 19 的差异无法通过给 Kerr 黑洞充电来模仿；在过充电解 (q,χ)=(1.2527,0.10) 处总椭率达到 25.6%。该分支是否无鬼仍然开放，但现有 no-go 判据无法定论：它们假设的背景和色散关系在此并不成立。

English: A charged black hole has a ceiling: extremality bounds the charge that a given mass and spin can support. Vector hair has so far only lowered it. In the Einstein--Maxwell--Vector (EMV) model, where a massless vector field couples nonminimally to the electromagnetic invariant, the spherically symmetric vectorized Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes are strictly undercharged: vector hair is paid for in charge. Whether this ceiling is a property of the vector field or merely of spherical symmetry has remained open, because spherical symmetry hides the hair's mass as well: its Komar mass vanishes identically and the exact identity $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$ degenerates to $0=0$. Rotation lifts both degeneracies at once. We construct the rotating solutions of the model, the first in this setting, and find that the hair's mass is not a free parameter but a second-order invariant of the rotational response, fixed by $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$. Above a coupling threshold the ceiling gives way: the domain of existence crosses the extremal Kerr--Newman bound, reaching $q=Q/M>1$ with $q^2+\chi^2$ up to $1.84$, while at $\alpha=5$ the maximum charge stays below it. The shadow is where the hair becomes visible. At $(q,\chi)=(0.9947,0.10)$, near the extremal bound, the hair contributes an ellipticity of $8.30\%$, against $0.44\%$ from the charge and $0.06\%$ from rotation --- a factor of $19$ that charging a Kerr black hole cannot mimic; at the overcharged solution $(q,\chi)=(1.2527,0.10)$ the total ellipticity reaches $25.6\%$. Whether the branch is ghost-free remains open, but the existing no-go criteria do not settle it: they assume a background and a dispersion relation that do not hold here.

中文摘要：宇宙弦和宇宙超弦可能形成于早期宇宙。在一类特定模型中，这些缺陷的张力随时间变化：或者弦本身由演化的模量场构成，或者它们直接与演化的标量场耦合，从而产生有效的时变弦张力。本文认真对待这种时间依赖的可能性，研究其演化的现象学后果，并与传统的固定张力情形比较。具体地，针对五种由不同可能张力演化形式所激发的时变模型，我们评估它们的引力波贡献以及对宇宙微波背景的影响。通过对这些模型进行MCMC分析，我们发现当前脉冲星计时阵列与干涉仪数据之间的频率范围内确实存在有趣的引力波谱特征，但这些特征并非这些弦所独有，因此用当前数据很难确定下来。不过，我们确实发现具有演化张力的宇宙弦与其他受青睐的模型一样能很好地拟合引力波数据。

English: Cosmic strings and cosmic superstrings could have formed in the early universe. In a particular class of models, the tension associated with these defects is time dependent, either because the strings themselves are composed of evolving moduli fields, or because they are directly coupled to evolving scalar fields leading to an effective time dependence in the string tension. Here we take seriously the possibility of this time dependence and investigate the phenomenological consequences of such an evolution, comparing the results to the more traditional case of a fixed time independent tension. In particular, for five different time varying models, motivated by different possible forms of evolution of the string tension, we evaluate their Gravitational Wave (GW) contributions as well as their impact on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB). Performing an MCMC analysis of the models we find there are indeed interesting spectral signatures in the GW emission at frequencies between the current PTA and interferometer data, but the signatures are not unique to these strings, making them hard to pin down using current data. However, we do find cosmic strings with evolving tension fit the GW data as well as other favoured models.

English: We formulate the static, spherically symmetric vacuum equations of power-law metric $f(R)$ gravity as a covariant autonomous system using the $(1+1+2)$ formalism. 中文摘要：超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHBs）被认为是大质量星系并合的预期产物，但在近邻星系中识别双星仍然困难。我们将 IllustrisTNG 模拟的大质量星系组装历史与半解析核心挖空模型结合，把可观测的核心星系性质与 z=0 时宿主一个束缚 SMBHB 的概率联系起来。我们 (i) 使用观测驱动的星系恒星质量函数构建核心星系族群，(ii) 通过动力学摩擦、恒星硬化与引力波辐射模拟双星演化，(iii) 用五个可观测预测量进行逻辑回归：恒星质量亏损、恒星质量、中心密度、中心速度弥散和有效半径。所得模型在模拟系统上表现良好，达到 pseudo-R^2=0.51±0.03、准确率 0.95±0.01、精确率 0.92±0.03、召回率 0.82±0.04。未并合双星通常很致密，分离度峰值约 0.3 pc，但只有约 0.3% 在脉冲星计时阵列波段辐射。将模型应用于观测到的核心星系，我们识别出八个近邻星系比不更可能宿主 SMBHB。在这八个宿主候选者中，我们指出 Messier 86 (NGC 4406) 是一个特别可能的例子，它也曾通过独立方法被类似识别，因此值得未来跟进。

English: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) are expected products of massive galaxy mergers, but identifying binaries in nearby galaxies remains challenging. We combine simulated massive-galaxy assembly histories from IllustrisTNG with a semi-analytic core-scouring model to connect observable core galaxy properties to the probability of hosting a bound SMBHB at z=0. We (i) construct a core galaxy population using an observationally motivated galaxy stellar mass function, (ii) model binary evolution through dynamical friction, stellar hardening, and gravitational-wave emission, and (iii) perform logistic regressions with five observable predictors: stellar mass deficit, stellar mass, central density, central velocity dispersion, and effective radius. The resulting models perform well on simulated systems, achieving a pseudo-$R^2$ of $0.51\pm0.03$, accuracy $0.95\pm0.01$, precision $0.92\pm0.03$, and recall $0.82\pm0.04$. Uncoalesced binaries are typically compact, with separations peaking near 0.3 pc, though only $\sim0.3\%$ emit in the pulsar timing array band. Applying the model to observed core galaxies, we identify eight nearby galaxies more likely than not to host SMBHBs. Of those eight host candidates, we note Messier 86 (NGC 4406) as a particularly likely example that was similarly identified using independent means and therefore warrants future follow-up.

English: We develop a systematic method to compute the high overtone expansion of Kerr quasinormal modes on normal angular branches to arbitrary order. We first obtain the expansion of the angular eigenvalue at large frequencies by a simple polynomial recursion. Using this result in an alternative form of the radial Teukolsky equation, we find that all the WKB corrections are defined on a fixed genus-one spectral curve, and that the quantum periods at the second and higher orders are expressed in terms of only two elliptic periods. This allows us to determine the expansion coefficients order by order. We confirm that the truncated expansions reproduce quasinormal frequencies obtained by solving the angular and radial equations directly, for scalar, electromagnetic and gravitational fields. We also compare the scalar results with the exact WKB analysis of extremal Kerr black holes.

中文摘要：本文研究了在最大能量提取最优条件下，Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger（GMGHS）黑洞中的重复电性彭罗斯过程。与 Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞不同，GMGHS 黑洞中入射粒子的有效势曲线在迭代过程中保持不变。迭代终止条件由两方面决定：逃逸条件要求粒子 0 能够克服有效势峰并逃逸至无穷远，且该条件与黑洞电荷无关；负能粒子 1 的存在条件要求黑洞电荷足够大，这表明重复过程不能将 GMGHS 黑洞的电荷完全消耗至零。数值模拟显示，能量提取的投资回报率可以超过 100%，但能量利用效率不超过 50%，且大部分可提取能量转化为黑洞不可约质量的增加。此外，较小的衰变半径和粒子 1 电荷-质量比绝对值较大可以提高能量提取的投资回报率和能量利用效率；入射粒子的比能越大，能量提取的投资回报率越小，而能量利用效率保持不变；对于初始非极端黑洞，随着初始电荷增加，能量提取的投资回报率单调增加，而能量利用效率先增加后减小。迭代结束后，黑洞仍保留可提取能量，电荷和质量均未消失。

English: This paper studies the repetitive electric Penrose process in the Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GMGHS) black hole under the optimal condition for maximum energy extraction. Unlike the Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) black hole, the effective potential curve of the incident particle in the GMGHS black hole remains unchanged during the iterations. The iteration termination conditions are determined by two aspects: the escape condition requires that particle 0 can overcome the effective potential peak and escape to infinity, and this condition is independent of the black hole charge; the existence condition for negative-energy particle 1 requires the black hole charge to be sufficiently large, indicating that the repetitive process cannot completely consume the charge of the GMGHS black hole to zero. Numerical simulations show that the return on investment of energy extraction can exceed $100\%$, but the energy utilization efficiency does not exceed $50\%$, and most of the extractable energy is converted into an increase in the irreducible mass of the black hole. In addition, a smaller decay radius and a larger absolute value of the charge-to-mass ratio of particle 1 can improve the return on investment and energy utilization efficiency of energy extraction; the larger the specific energy of the incident particle, the smaller the return on investment of energy extraction, while the energy utilization efficiency remains unchanged; for an initially non-extremal black hole, as the initial charge increases, the return on investment of energy extraction increases monotonically, while the energy utilization efficiency first increases and then decreases. After the iterations end, the black hole still retains extractable energy, and neither the charge nor the mass vanishes.

中文摘要：本文在具有曲率、挠率和非度规性的四维度规-仿射时空中建立广义狄拉克方程。旋量联络在Clifford代数cl(1,3)的完整基上展开，包含八个复耦合常数；要求狄拉克方程的直接协变化与相应对称化拉格朗日量变分一致，会给出八个实一致性条件，将独立实参数由十六个减少到八个。在静态各向同性对称远平行扇区中，哈密顿量相对于弯曲空间狄拉克内积的形式厄米性再现了对非度规性和标架耦合的限制。标架相关项引入标量和赝标量质量贡献，即使在Minkowski时空中也存在。对于具有常数系数的单个自由狄拉克场，这些贡献给出一个有效质量 m_eff=sqrt((m-4b_3)^2+16b_4^2)，以及可由常数手征场重定义消除的手征相位；因此即使原始质量参数为零，也可能存在非零有效质量。文中还推导了广义旋量曲率的Clifford分解，并表明当仿射曲率、挠率和非度规性全为零时该旋量曲率仍可非零。当m=0时，组合b_3^2+b_4^2同时决定有效质量平方和残余旋量曲率，从而在这些贡献之间建立代数联系。

English: We formulate a generalized Dirac equation in four-dimensional metric-affine spacetimes with curvature, torsion, and non-metricity. The spinor connection is expanded over the complete basis of the Clifford algebra $cl(1,3)$ and contains eight complex coupling constants. Requiring agreement between direct covariantization of the Dirac equation and variation of the corresponding symmetrized Lagrangian imposes eight real consistency conditions, reducing the number of independent real parameters from sixteen to eight. In the static isotropic symmetric teleparallel sector, formal Hermiticity of the Hamiltonian with respect to the curved-space Dirac inner product reproduces the corresponding restrictions on the non-metricity and coframe couplings. The coframe-dependent terms introduce scalar and pseudoscalar mass contributions that persist in Minkowski spacetime. For a single free Dirac field with constant coefficients, they yield one effective mass, $m_{\mathrm{eff}}=\sqrt{(m-4b_3)^2+16b_4^2}$, and a chiral phase removable by a constant chiral field redefinition. A nonzero effective mass is therefore possible even when the original mass parameter vanishes. We also derive the Clifford decomposition of the generalized spinor curvature and show that it can remain nonzero when affine curvature, torsion, and non-metricity all vanish. When $m=0$, the combination $b_3^2+b_4^2$ determines both the effective mass squared and the surviving spinor curvature, establishing an algebraic link between these contributions.

Thermodynamics of Swirling Black Holes and Kerr-Taub-NUT

Ernesto Frodden, Diego Hidalgo, Francisco Manzano · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们为最近发现的 Kerr 涡旋（KS）黑洞和加速 Kerr 涡旋（AKS）黑洞解建立了黑洞热力学第一定律。我们也重新审视了 Kerr-Taub-NUT（KTN）时空的第一定律。受 Noether 关于整体对称性产生守恒律的原始洞见引导，我们采用并调整表面电荷方法，在 KS 和 KTN 黑洞轴线上存在类弦缺陷（锥形奇点）的情况下计算相关荷（质量和角动量）。我们以准局域方式获得有限积分荷，而不依赖这些时空特有的非平坦渐近区域。随后，我们在不引入与对称性无关的独立弦项的情况下建立第一定律。对于 KS 和 KTN，起到黑洞熵作用的量不同于简单的四分之一视界面积几何规则。这种不匹配出现的原因是我们保留了与守恒律相关的第一定律荷。这表明标准公式可能不能被天真地用于具有类弦缺陷的黑洞；它们具有不同的拓扑，并提示需要新的几何框架。与之形成鲜明对比的是，对于 AKS 时空——它可以在奇点外被正则化且没有类弦缺陷——我们发现其荷与具有通常四分之一面积熵的第一定律一致。我们先使用 Christodoulou-Ruffini 公式确定质量，然后检验其与表面电荷方法所得结果的一致性。

English: We establish the first law of black hole thermodynamics for the recently discovered Kerr swirling (KS) and accelerated Kerr swirling (AKS) black hole solutions. We also revisit the first law for the Kerr-Taub-NUT (KTN) spacetime. Guided by Noether's original insight that global symmetries give rise to conservation laws, we employ and adapt the surface charge method for computing the associated charges (mass and angular momentum) in the presence of spacetime string-like defects (conical singularities) along the axes of both KS and KTN black holes. We obtain finite integrated charges in a quasi-local manner, without relying on the non-flat asymptotic regions characteristic of these spacetimes. We then establish a first law without introducing independent stringy terms unrelated to symmetries. For both KS and KTN, the quantities that play the role of the black hole entropy differ from the simple geometrical rule of one-fourth of the horizon area. This mismatch arises because we keep first-law charges associated with conservation laws. It indicates that standard formulas may not be naively used for black holes with string-like defects; they have a different topology and suggest the need for a new geometrical framework. In stark contrast, for the AKS spacetime, which can be regularized outside the singularity and lacks string-like defects, we find that the charges are consistent with a first law having the usual one-fourth of the area entropy. We first determine the mass using the Christodoulou-Ruffini formula and then check its agreement with the result obtained from the surface charge method.

一句话导读：用表面电荷法为 KS、AKS 与 KTN 黑洞建立热力学第一定律，并指出类弦缺陷导致熵偏离面积四分之一规则。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究经典黑洞时空的热力学第一定律、表面电荷与广义相对论解，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

七维超引力中的局域化

Localization in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity

Florian Gaar, Mich\`ele Levi · hep-th, math-ph, math.DG, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：七维超引力通过其最高维超对称 AdS 真空为强耦合六维超共形理论提供全息描述。本文把相对等变局域化推广到七维最大 Cartan 规范超引力（所有规范场均活跃），用场强表述欧氏作用量和 Killing 旋量方程，并构造适应旋量实条件从辛-Majorana 到 Majorana 变化的双线性系统。在非零规范活跃旋量分支上，同一复背景上的 Majorana 共轭将独立且 R 荷相反的旋量配对；一个代数规范修正和两个代数双线性投影足以把等荷扇区推广到独立 Cartan 荷，且该重组也适用于 Lorentz 理论。大质量 3-形式自对偶固定四阶反常类，并由 Abel 矩映射确定高形式不动点数据。在填充的单一不动点处局域化无需延拓解即可恢复一般超对称 AdS7 黑洞作用量；作者证明联合超对称 Killing 流与 R 对称作用下的规范协变 Killing 旋量不变性，导出线性化学势约束；对约束熵泛函取极值并要求实正静止熵，可在欧氏分析中得到非线性电荷关系，等价于已知球对称黑洞族的 Lorentz 视界极端性。

English: Seven-dimensional supergravity provides holographic access to strongly coupled six-dimensional superconformal theories through its highest-dimensional supersymmetric AdS vacua. Its unique spinor-bilinear geometry and massive higher-form dynamics make systematic analysis and solution-finding distinctively challenging. Relative equivariant localization can obtain supersymmetric observables in odd dimensions from fixed-point data on an auxiliary even-dimensional filling, without an explicit solution. We extend this approach to seven dimensions in maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity with all gauge fields active. We formulate the Euclidean action and Killing-spinor equations in terms of field strengths, and construct a bilinear system adapted to the change in spinor reality conditions from symplectic-Majorana to Majorana. On the non-null gauged active spinor branch, independent, oppositely R-charged spinors are paired by Majorana conjugation on the same complex background. One algebraic gauging correction and two algebraic bilinear projections suffice to extend the equal-charge sector to independent Cartan charges, and the underlying efficient reorganization also applies in the Lorentzian theory. Massive 3-form self-duality fixes the quartic anomaly class and determines the higher-form fixed-point datum from Abelian moment maps. Localization at the single fixed point of the filling recovers the general supersymmetric AdS$_7$ black-hole action, without extending the solution. We prove gauge-covariant Killing-spinor invariance under the combined supersymmetric Killing flow and R-symmetry action, deriving the linear chemical-potential constraint. Extremizing the constrained entropy functional and requiring real positive stationary entropy yields the nonlinear charge relation within the Euclidean analysis, equivalent to Lorentzian horizon extremality for the known spherical black-hole family.

一句话导读：将相对等变局域化推广到七维最大 Cartan 规范超引力，并由不动点数据恢复 AdS7 黑洞作用量与熵/极端性约束。

相关度：medium — 属于全息超引力与黑洞熵/局域化研究，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM 或 Floquet 驱动等具体支线。

超越牛顿定律的两质量间引力

Gravity between two masses beyond Newton's law

Zhengwen Liu, Xing-Bo Yuan · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：牛顿万有引力定律用反距离势描述两质量间的吸引。在爱因斯坦理论中引力本身也产生引力：每个质量通过重塑时空几何来影响另一个质量。一个多世纪后，从这种耦合几何中提取两体相互作用仍是基础性的解析难题。即使没有运动或辐射，相互作用的静态部分也包含无穷层次的场耦合，是研究引力非线性的最纯粹实验室。本文对任意质量比确定了牛顿常数九阶至十二阶的静态相互作用，并给出了超越 Schwarzschild 试探体极限的首个背反作用在引力耦合所有阶上的闭合表达式。两项进展均通过围绕静态相互作用能表述问题实现：精确的单体背景重求和了一个源的自相互作用，驻定性减少了另一个源所需的场，积分响应恒等式揭示了耦合模式间的抵消；互补展开则在有限阶上解析完整的质量依赖。这些结果弥合了无穷小试探体与可比质量之间的差距，揭示了爱因斯坦理论中隐藏的解析简洁性，并为轨道动力学建模和引力波产生提供了基本构件。

English: Newton's law of universal gravitation describes the attraction between two masses through an inverse-distance potential. In Einstein's theory gravity gravitates: each mass reshapes the spacetime geometry through which the other acts. More than a century later, extracting the two-body interaction from this coupled geometry remains a fundamental analytical challenge. Even without motion or radiation, the static sector of the interaction harbours an infinite hierarchy of field couplings: the purest laboratory for gravitational non-linearity. Here we determine the static interaction from ninth to twelfth order in Newton's constant for arbitrary mass ratios, and derive a closed expression for the first backreaction beyond the Schwarzschild test-body limit to all orders in the gravitational coupling. We achieve both advances by formulating the problem around the stationary interaction energy. An exact one-body background resums one source's self-interaction, stationarity reduces the fields required from the other, and integrated response identities reveal cancellations across the coupled modes. Complementary expansions then resolve the complete mass dependence at finite order. Together, these results bridge the gap between an infinitesimal probe and comparable masses, exposing hidden analytical simplicity within Einstein's theory and providing essential building blocks for modelling orbital dynamics and gravitational-wave generation.

一句话导读：该文在经典广义相对论框架下解析计算任意质量比两体静态引力相互作用的高阶项，并给出超越试探体极限的首个背反作用闭合表达式。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究广义相对论中的经典两体引力与高阶非线性相互作用，属于用户重点关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

有限截断下JT引力的全息对偶：经典情形

Holographic duals of JT gravity at finite cutoff: the classical case

Andreas Belaey, Thomas G. Mertens, Lorenzo Russo, Alex Tarana · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们在一阶BF表述中构造具有有限截断边界和世界尽头膜的JT引力。我们将BF模型动力学地约化为生活在边界上的一维系统，推广了此前的构造。特别是，我们获得了对每个此类边界相关相空间自由度的几何理解。我们利用这些结果探测体局域性和时空的底层结构。在该框架内，我们能够推导出有限截断下JT引力的全息Schwarzian描述在相空间中的闭合表达式。所得自由度描述有限截断曲线在AdS$_2$中的嵌入。这些系统的量子化将在配套论文中给出。

English: We formulate JT gravity with finite-cutoff boundaries and end-of-the-world branes in the first-order BF formulation. We dynamically reduce the BF model into a one-dimensional system living at the boundaries, generalizing earlier constructions. We obtain in particular a geometrical understanding of the phase space degrees of freedom associated to each of these boundaries. We leverage these results to probe bulk locality and the underlying structure of spacetime. Within our framework, we are able to derive a closed-form expression for the holographic Schwarzian description of JT gravity at finite-cutoff in phase space. The resulting degrees of freedom describe the embedding of the finite-cutoff curve in AdS$_2$. A quantization of these systems is presented in a companion paper.

一句话导读：在BF表述中构造有限截断JT引力及其边界相空间全息Schwarzian描述。

混合通量下AdS3弦椭圆形变中可积性的破坏

Breaking of integrability in elliptic deformations of AdS3 strings with mixed flux

Ian Le Meur, Fiona K. Seibold · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们在IIB型超引力中构造由NSNS与RR混合通量支撑的AdS3×S3×T4超弦的椭圆形变，并研究其可积性。NSNS部分包含Wess-Zumino项；要求理论保持8个超对称还需要一个耦合形变后AdS3与S3因子的B场。我们从两个角度探讨可积性：构造平坦Lax联络和计算树级世界面S矩阵。对一般椭圆参数和NSNS通量，我们发现非弹性2→2散射振幅，违反可积性所需的弹性。在Lax分析所确认的可积情形中，这些非弹性振幅消失，且树级S矩阵满足经典Yang-Baxter方程。特别地，添加Wess-Zumino项在有理与三角模型中保持可积性，但在椭圆形变中破坏可积性。

English: We construct elliptic deformations of the $AdS_3 \times S^3 \times T^4$ superstring supported by mixed NSNS and RR fluxes in type IIB supergravity and investigate their integrability. The NSNS sector includes a Wess-Zumino term, and imposing that the theory preserves 8 supersymmetries also requires the presence of a B-field coupling the deformed $AdS_3$ and $S^3$ factors. We explore integrability from two different perspectives: through the construction of a flat Lax connection and the computation of the tree-level worldsheet S-matrix. For generic elliptic parameters and NSNS flux, we find inelastic $2 \rightarrow 2$ amplitudes, violating the elasticity required by integrability. In the integrable cases as identified by the Lax analysis, these inelastic amplitudes vanish and the tree-level S-matrix satisfies the classical Yang-Baxter equation. In particular, the addition of a Wess-Zumino term, which preserves integrability in the rational and trigonometric models, breaks integrability for elliptic deformations.

一句话导读：构造混合通量支撑的AdS3×S3×T4弦椭圆形变，并用Lax联络与树级S矩阵表明Wess-Zumino项在椭圆情形破坏可积性。

相关度：medium — 属于AdS/CFT中的AdS3弦可积性研究，与用户列出的凝聚态、超流超导、探针膜等专题无直接重合。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

Bogomolny 点上的精确全息超流：输运、大电荷与 Rényi 熵

Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and R\'enyi entropies

Siqing Yu · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：在探针极限下，AdS5 中的 Abelian Higgs 模型是强耦合超流的标准全息模型，通常需数值求解。当标量质量饱和 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界且四次耦合取 Bogomolny 值时，其凝聚相可在每个具有最大对称空间截面的静态、不带电 AdS5 背景上以闭式给出。我们证明它是线性稳定的，正如标准量子化、非负四次耦合且无超流时任何无节点探针极限凝聚一样。在不同切片上，它回答对偶共形场论的不同问题：在平面黑膜上，它是所有 T<Tc 下的超流，超流分数严格遵循 Gorter-Casimir 双流体定律，声速和声衰减以闭式给出；在整体 AdS5 中，它描述 R×S^3 上电荷 Q 的态（可说是最低能态），并在所有 Q 下以闭式给出其标度维度（体内部为经典）；其激发包括超流有效理论不描述的塔，来自探针扇区的红外不动点；双曲切片以闭式给出计算球带电 Rényi 熵的黑洞的均匀毛发相，其凝聚在纠缠面上不消失；当由插入该处的算符源驱动时，该相在零化学势下恰好于 Rényi 指数一出现，如同中性标量情形。

English: The Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$, in the probe limit, is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. When the scalar mass saturates the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling takes the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase can be found in closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is linearly stable, as is any nodeless probe-limit condensate in the standard quantization with a nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On each slicing it answers a different question about the dual conformal field theory. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and the attenuation of sound are found in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it describes a state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$, arguably the lowest-energy one, and gives its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers that the superfluid effective theory does not describe; they come from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector. The hyperbolic slicing gives in closed form a homogeneous hairy phase of the black holes that compute the charged R\'enyi entropies of a ball. Its condensate does not vanish at the entangling surface. When sourced by operators inserted there, the phase sets in at R\'enyi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar.

一句话导读：该文给出 Bogomolny 点 AdS5 Abelian Higgs 模型的闭式全息超流解，并解析研究输运、大电荷谱与带电 Rényi 熵。

AdS硬壁模型中重子凝聚的竞争与共存

Competition and coexistence of baryonic condensates in AdS hardwall model

Akash Singh · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：冷致密QCD允许多个重子数破缺序参量，其中包括双夸克和双重子凝聚。我们使用五维AdS硬壁模型并包含完全背反作用，其中两个荷电标量（对偶于电荷q_i、维度Δ_i的算符）与共同的U(1)_B规范场耦合，来考察它们是否互相排斥还是共存。固定类双夸克算符为q_1=2、Δ_1=3时，两个算符只在Δ_2的窄窗口内同时凝聚；该窗口随q_2增大而变宽，并在两算符重合时关闭。窗口外只形成单一凝聚。该结构在禁闭与解禁闭相中都存在。在μ_B-T平面中，具有双凝聚的禁闭物质在低温下更受偏好，位于具有单凝聚的解禁闭物质的窄带之下。

English: Cold dense QCD admits several order parameters for baryon-number breaking, among them diquark and dibaryon condensates. We ask whether they exclude one another or coexist, using a five-dimensional AdS hardwall model with full backreaction in which two charged scalars, dual to operators of charges $q_i$ and dimensions $\Delta_i$, couple to a common $U(1)_B$ gauge field. With the diquark-like operator fixed at $q_1=2$, $\Delta_1=3$, both operators condense only within a narrow window of $\Delta_2$, which widens with $q_2$ and closes when the operators coincide. Outside the window, only a single condensate forms. The structure persists in both confined and deconfined phases. In the $\mu_B$-$T$ plane, confined matter with both condensates is preferred at low temperature, below a narrow band of deconfined matter with one condensate.

一句话导读：在带完全背反作用的AdS硬壁模型中，两个与共同U(1)_B耦合的荷电标量只在参数窗口内共存凝聚，并给出μ_B-T平面中的相结构。

相关度：medium — 论文直接研究多分量重子凝聚的竞争与共存及相结构，与多分量序参量和相变支线相关；但它属于全息QCD硬壁模型，并非超流超导、经典引力或非线性演化支线。

AdS 中的 N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯通量管

$\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills Flux Tube in AdS

Victor Gorbenko, Orr Sela, Brian R. Zielazienski · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究 AdS4 边界（或半空间）上 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中的超对称 Wilson 线，作为探讨全息弦与禁闭通量管之间联系的模型。边界破坏四维共形对称性并预计消除可积性，使系统更接近禁闭弦，同时保留足够超对称约束动力学。在平面极限下，我们分析弱耦合与强耦合下的缺陷谱并计算超共形指标，从而将微扰规范理论描述与长全息弦的世界面激发联系起来。这些互补视角使我们提出两区域算符之间的映射；特别地，世界面轴子在强耦合下成为两粒子态。所得图像支持从指数增长的规范理论谱到弦世界面的 Cardy 型谱的平滑插值，为研究禁闭规范理论中预期谱重组提供一个非可积超对称模型。

English: We study a supersymmetric Wilson line on the boundary of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory in AdS$_4$, or equivalently on a half-space, as a model for exploring the connection between holographic strings and confining flux tubes. The boundary breaks four-dimensional conformal symmetry and is expected to remove integrability, bringing this system closer to a confining string while preserving enough supersymmetry to constrain its dynamics. Working in the planar limit, we analyze the defect spectrum at weak and strong coupling and compute the superconformal index, thereby relating the perturbative gauge-theory description to the worldsheet excitations of a long holographic string. These complementary perspectives allow us to propose a map between operators in the two regimes, under which the worldsheet axion, in particular, becomes a two-particle state at strong coupling. The resulting picture supports a smooth interpolation from an exponentially growing gauge-theory spectrum to the Cardy-like spectrum of a string worldsheet, providing a non-integrable supersymmetric model for investigating the spectral reorganization expected in confining gauge theories.

一句话导读：用 AdS4 边界上的超对称 Wilson 线缺陷研究全息弦与禁闭通量管谱的对应与插值。

来自黑洞微扰理论的有效 Kerr-Compton 树级振幅

The Effective Kerr-Compton Tree Amplitude from Black Hole Perturbation Theory

N. Emil J. Bjerrum-Bohr, Gang Chen, Konstantinos Papadimos, Nabha Shah, Chenliang Su · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们提出一种新方法，用于在后 Minkowski 有效场论中构造引力波被 Kerr 黑洞散射的树级 Compton 振幅。该方法建立在先前需要振幅满足物理一致性的计算之上，利用黑洞微扰理论中的波散射函数来唯一确定额外的接触项。我们通过推导到自旋六阶的显式表达式来说明这一迭代过程，其中包括自旋五阶和六阶此前未知的部分。该振幅具有复杂的超越结构，并在自旋六阶出现一个领头耗散接触项。我们将结果与文献中已知结果进行核对，并从黑洞微扰理论重现了单圈尾项结果。

English: We develop a new method to construct the tree-level Compton amplitude for gravitational-wave scattering off a Kerr black hole in post-Minkowskian effective field theory. Building on previous computations that required physical consistency of the amplitude, the method uses wave scattering functions from black hole perturbation theory to uniquely determine additional contact terms. We illustrate the iterative procedure by deriving explicit expressions up to sixth order in spin, including previously unknown sectors at the fifth and sixth orders in spin. The amplitude features complex transcendental structures and a leading dissipative contact term at sixth order in spin. We verify our result against known results in the literature and reproduce the one-loop tail result from black hole perturbation theory.

一句话导读：利用黑洞微扰理论的波散射函数，逐步确定后 Minkowski EFT 中 Kerr 黑洞树级 Compton 振幅的接触项，并给出自旋六阶结果。

论高自旋理论中的函数类

On functional classes in higher-spin theory

Yu. A. Tatarenko · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：d维Vasiliev理论中关于理想的因子化，需要把高自旋代数 A 及其扭曲伴随模 A^{tw} 准确描述为特定函数空间。文章表明，若 A 在 Moyal 星积作用下封闭，且 A^{tw} 是星积 A-模并满足若干辅助条件，则可得到良定义的自由层因子化程序。可容许函数所需条件具有简单代数形式；对 A 而言，Soloviev 曾考虑过类似的函数空间。文章还讨论了所得函数类与 Vasiliev 理论中局域性问题的关系，特别指出某些非局域表达式会因 A^{tw} 的性质而发散，而自旋局域表达式则良定义。

English: The factorization over the ideal in the $d$-dimensional Vasiliev theory requires an accurate description of the higher-spin algebra $\mathcal{A}$ and its twisted adjoint module $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ as certain functional spaces. It is shown that the conditions of $\mathcal{A}$ to be closed under action of the Moyal star product, and of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ to be a star-product $\mathcal{A}$-module along with some auxiliary conditions lead to properly defined free-level factorization procedure. The conditions on admissible functions have simple algebraic form; in the case of $\mathcal{A}$ the analogous functional space has been considered by Soloviev \cite{Soloviev:2013iba}. The relation of the obtained functional classes to the locality problem in the Vasiliev theory is discussed. In particular it is observed that certain non-local expressions diverge due to properties of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ while the spin-local expressions are well-defined.

一句话导读：该文用星积封闭性与模条件刻画Vasiliev高自旋理论中的函数空间，并讨论其与自由层因子化和局域性问题的关系。

手性箭图理论的大N极限：自由能、超对称指标与算符计数

Large-$N$ limit of chiral quiver theories: free energy, supersymmetric indices and operator counting

Edoardo Colombo, Hyojoong Kim, Nakwoo Kim, Hoseob Shin · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们首次给出具有M理论对偶的手性N=2 Chern-Simons-物质理论在S^3自由能的大N鞍点方程的解析解。针对对偶于AdS4×Q^{1,1,1}/Z_k的手性箭图，我们展示矩阵模型的长程力在大N下相消，解决了与预期N^{3/2}标度之间长期存在的矛盾。所得自由能对所有试探R荷分配均与全息预言精确一致。结果可推广到S^2×S^1上的超共形指标和拓扑扭曲指标，其大N与Cardy极限由同一鞍点决定。该解与算符计数方法的预言一致，为非手性箭图之外的该猜想提供了有力证据。我们用有限N数值分析对多个R荷分配支持解析解，扩展了近期对该箭图的数值结果。

English: We find the first analytic solution to the large-$N$ saddle point equations for the $S^3$ free energy of a chiral $\mathcal N=2$ Chern-Simons-matter theory with an M-theory dual. Focusing on the chiral quiver dual to AdS$_4\times Q^{1,1,1}/\mathbb Z_{\rm k}$, we show how the long-range forces of the matrix model cancel at large $N$, resolving a long-standing tension with the expected $N^{3/2}$ scaling. The resulting free energy precisely matches the holographic prediction for all assignments of trial R-charges. Our results extend to the superconformal and topologically twisted indices on $S^2\times S^1$, whose large-$N$ and Cardy limit is determined by the same saddle. The solution agrees with the predictions of the operator counting method, giving strong evidence for this conjecture beyond non-chiral quivers. We support the analytic solution with a finite-$N$ numerical analysis for multiple assignments of R-charges, extending recent numerical results obtained for this quiver.

一句话导读：首次解析求解 AdS4×Q^{1,1,1}/Z_k 手性箭图 Chern-Simons-物质理论的大N自由能鞍点，并验证全息标度与指标/算符计数预言。

Carrollian CFT 与光前

Carrollian CFTs and the Light Front

Arjun Bagchi, Kinjal Banerjee, Sourish Banerjee, Meghaa AK · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：Carrollian 对称性在构建渐近平直时空的全息对偶中起重要作用。该构造依赖于渐近平直时空的（渐近）等距与共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构。Carroll 对称性也自然出现在光前上，作为光锥坐标下 Poincaré 代数的余维一子代数。本文基于四维 Poincaré 与三维共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构，将光前物理与 Carrollian CFT 联系起来。利用光前文献的洞见，我们构造了与有质量体散射相关联的 Carroll CFT 新表示。我们计算两点函数，并建立三维 Carroll CFT 与生活在渐近平直时空中的四维光前理论之间的映射。

English: Carrollian symmetries play an important role in building holographic duals to asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). This construction hinges on the isomorphism between the (asymptotic) isometries of AFS and the conformal Carroll algebra. Carroll symmetries also naturally arise on the lightfront, as co-dimension one subalgebras in the Poincare algebra written in lightcone coordinates. In this paper, building on the isomorphism between four dimensional (4d) Poincare and 3d conformal Carroll algebras, we make a connection between physics on the lightfront and Carrollian CFTs. Using insights from the lightfront literature, we construct new representations of Carroll CFTs that connect to massive bulk scattering. We compute two-point functions and build a map between 3d Carroll CFTs and 4d lightfront theories living in AFS.

一句话导读：基于 Poincaré 与共形 Carroll 代数同构，建立三维 Carroll CFT 与四维渐近平直时空光前理论及有质量体散射的对应。

SO(2,2) 对称性是否会在五维 Einstein-scalar 理论中导致额外的 U(1) 对称性？

Does SO(2,2) symmetry lead to an additional U(1) symmetry in 5-dimensional Einstein-scalar theories?

Saeedeh Sadeghian · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：在高于四维时，求解包含物质场的 Einstein 方程在计算上具有挑战性，而对称性的存在可简化计算。SO(2,2) 对称性出现在四维零视界面积极端黑洞的近视界几何中，也出现在更高维情形。含标量场和 Maxwell 场的 Einstein 理论中具有 SO(2,2) 对称性的解已在四维、五维及更高维被分类。对于 Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda 理论，有定理指出 SO(2,2) 对称性会导致额外的 U(1) 对称性，从而给出唯一的轴对称解。然而，存在标量场时，该对称群在五维中不足以保证解的唯一性，额外 U(1) 对称性在此前工作中仍是猜想。本文用 Lie 对称方法研究含五维标量场理论的 Einstein 方程，挑战该猜想，并找到一个同时依赖 θ 和 ψ 坐标的解作为反例。

English: Solving Einstein equations including the matter fields in dimensions higher than four is computationally challenging. However, the existence of symmetries facilitates these calculations. Among these symmetries, we can mention the SO(2,2) symmetry that arises in the near-horizon geometries of extremal black holes with vanishing horizon area in four dimensions \cite{EVH/CFT} and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2015}. Solutions of Einstein theories including scalar and Maxwell fields with SO(2,2) symmetry have been classified in four, five, and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. For the Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda theory, a theorem states that SO(2,2) symmetry leads to an additional U(1) symmetry and therefore unique axisymmetric solutions. Nevertheless, in the presence of a scalar field, this symmetry group is not large enough in five dimensions to guarantee solution uniqueness, and the additional U(1) symmetry remains a conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. Here, we study the Einstein equations of theories with a five-dimensional scalar field using the Lie symmetry method for solving partial differential equations. We challenge the conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014} and find a solution that depends on both $\theta$ and $\psi$ coordinates as a counterexample to that conjecture.

一句话导读：用 Lie 对称方法研究五维 Einstein-scalar 方程，构造依赖 θ 和 ψ 的解，作为 SO(2,2) 导致额外 U(1) 猜想的反例。

相关度：high — 论文核心是五维 Einstein-scalar 方程的经典解与 SO(2,2)/U(1) 对称性，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；摘要虽提及极端黑洞近视界与 EVH/CFT 背景，但未展开全息应用。

正交-辛规范群 N=4 SYM 理论中的界面线算子

Ortho-symplectic interface line operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM theories

Yasuyuki Hatsuda, Tadashi Okazaki · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们研究了四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中正交和辛规范群的半 BPS 界面上的线算子。对于 NS5 型界面，线算子由界面两侧规范群下的电或磁荷对标记；而对于 D5 型界面，它们由界面保持的单一规范群下的电或磁荷标记。我们提出了在 S 对偶作用下界面上的威尔逊线与涡旋线之间的对偶。作为线算子与界面结点上对偶的高度非平凡证据，我们发现对偶对的线缺陷半指数相匹配。

English: We study the line operators at the half-BPS interfaces in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theories of orthogonal and symplectic gauge groups. For the NS5-type interfaces, line operators are labeled by pairs of electric or magnetic charges under the gauge groups on either side of the interface, whereas for the D5-type interfaces they are labeled by electric or magnetic charges under the single gauge group preserved by the interface. We propose dualities between the Wilson lines and vortex lines at the interfaces under the action of S-duality. As highly non-trivial evidence of the dualities on the junctions of the line operators and the interfaces, we find matching of the line defect half-indices for the dual pairs.

一句话导读：研究 N=4 SYM 中正交/辛规范群半 BPS 界面上的线算子及其 S 对偶，通过线缺陷半指数匹配给出非平凡证据。

形变振幅体与库仑分支上的插值反常维数

Deformed Amplituhedra and Interpolating Anomalous Dimensions on the Coulomb Branch

Francesco Calisto, Subramanya Hegde, Mart\'in Lagares, Elia Mazzucchelli · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论库仑分支上的平面四点散射振幅，关注多参数的大质量运动学族。我们将 Arkani-Hamed:2023epq、Flieger:2025ekn 的形变 Amplituhedron 构造推广到由六参数嵌入空间 Gram 矩阵描述的一般外运动学。我们证明，逆 Gram 矩阵上的余正性约束控制实几何，并将两圈正则形式的分子限制在散射振幅所预期的两个平面双箱结构的张成空间内。随后我们专门研究一个三参数大质量构型，并直接在四维中用微分方程计算相关的一圈和两圈积分，得到用多重多对数表示的解析表达式。我们研究所提出的两圈振幅的多尺度红外极限，并发现直到两圈的指数化。该运动学族包含由尖点（cusp）和八边形（octagon）反常维数支配的极限，并通过 Alday:2026cpk 引入的行走（walking）反常维数在二者之间插值。我们的结果复现一圈插值，并确定了其提出的全圈拟设中的两圈系数。有趣的是，我们的结果表明，行走反常维数可能完全由尖点和八边形反常维数在所有圈阶确定。

English: We study planar four-point scattering amplitudes on the Coulomb branch of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory, focusing on multi-parameter families of massive kinematics. We extend the deformed Amplituhedron construction of \cite{Arkani-Hamed:2023epq,Flieger:2025ekn} to general external kinematics characterized by a six-parameter embedding-space Gram matrix. We show that copositivity constraints on the inverse Gram matrix control the real geometry and restrict the numerator of the two-loop canonical form to the span of the two planar double-box structures expected for the scattering amplitude. We then specialize to a three-parameter massive configuration and evaluate the relevant one- and two-loop integrals using differential equations directly in four dimensions, obtaining analytic expressions in terms of multiple polylogarithms. We investigate multiscale infrared limits of the proposed two-loop amplitude and find exponentiation through two loops. The kinematic family contains the limits governed by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions and interpolates between them through the walking anomalous dimension introduced in~\cite{Alday:2026cpk}. Our result reproduces the one-loop interpolation and fixes the two-loop coefficients in their proposed all-loop ansatz. Interestingly, our results suggest that the walking anomalous dimension may be entirely determined through all loop orders by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions.

一句话导读：推广 N=4 SYM 库仑分支上的形变 Amplituhedron，计算两圈振幅并研究 cusp、octagon 与 walking 反常维数之间的插值。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

AdS_4 中的引力重构

Gravitational Reconstruction in $AdS_{4}$

David A. Lowe, Yiru Wang, Juanyi Yang · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：我们在固定共形平坦边界度规上，从守恒无迹应力张量重构 AdS4 中的线性化引力扰动，扩展了此前实洛伦兹构造。对于在平坦共形标架中没有类空傅里叶支撑的容许数据，物理响应化为边界光锥截割上的积分。边界改进可恢复 Fefferman–Graham (FG) 规范，同时保持可归一化性和线性化 Weyl 张量。随后，我们利用实应力数据上的显式位置空间广义函数，重构具有一般类空边界动量的扰动，包括非零频率及其零频率极限。我们为可归一化扰动构造边界核，并给出重构收敛的充分条件。结果有助于研究受控平直空间极限，这些极限与 Bondi–Metzner–Sachs 对称性和天球全息相关。

English: We reconstruct linearized gravitational perturbations in $AdS_{4}$ from a conserved, traceless stress tensor on a fixed conformally flat boundary metric, extending our earlier real Lorentzian construction. For admissible data with no spacelike Fourier support in a flat conformal frame, the physical response reduces to an integral over boundary light-cone cuts. Boundary improvements restore Fefferman--Graham (FG) gauge while preserving normalizability and the linearized Weyl tensor. We then reconstruct perturbations with general spacelike boundary momentum, including nonzero frequency and its zero-frequency limit, using explicit position-space generalized functions on real stress data. Boundary kernels are constructed for normalizable perturbations and sufficient conditions are derived for the reconstruction to converge. The results motivate controlled flat-space limits relevant to Bondi--Metzner--Sachs symmetries and celestial holography.

一句话导读：从边界守恒无迹应力张量重构 AdS4 线性化引力扰动，并给出 FG 规范、边界核与收敛条件。

分数字段论中的全息与局域化

Holography and localization in fractional field theory

Gianluca Calcagni, Iv\'an Salvador-Garc\'ia · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：分数字段论是量子化引力相互作用的一个有前景框架，但非局域算符的存在使其处理困难。为缓解该问题，我们以两种方式将理论重写为局域对偶。首先，我们将 Caffarelli--Silvestre 延拓定理推广到具有多尺度动能项和非局域相互作用的自伴分数字段论，以标量场为例。后者被重新解释为非局域边界自由度，全息对偶于高维体内两个标量场的局域理论。然而，加入局域非线性势并不直接。因此我们提出另一种图像：非局域理论不延拓到高维空间，而是以引入连续质量谱为代价实现局域化。这种谱局域化可自然实现 fakeon 规定及相关的经典化程序，这些程序已用于带高阶导数和复鬼的局域理论。文中讨论了分数量子引力及其与二次量子引力的比较。

English: Fractional field theory is a promising framework wherein to quantize the gravitational interaction but the presence of nonlocal operators can make its handling difficult. With the purpose of easing this problem, we recast the theory as a local dual in two ways. First, we generalize the Caffarelli--Silvestre extension theorem to self-adjoint fractional field theories with multi-scale kinetic terms and nonlocal interactions, taking the example of a scalar field. The latter is reinterpreted as a nonlocal boundary degree of freedom holographically dual to a local theory of two scalars living in a higher-dimensional bulk. However, inclusion of a local non-linear potential is not straightforward. We therefore propose an alternative picture where the nonlocal theory is not extended to a higher-dimensional space but is localized at the price of introducing a continuum of masses. This \emph{spectral localization} allows for a natural implementation of the fakeon prescription and the related classicization procedure, already employed in local theories with higher-derivative and complex ghosts. Applications to fractional quantum gravity and its comparison with quadratic quantum gravity are discussed.

一句话导读：将非局域分数字段论通过 Caffarelli--Silvestre 延拓或谱局域化重写为局域对偶，并讨论分数量子引力与 fakeon/经典化。

五维玻色星的非相对论极限与标度不变性破缺

The Non-Relativistic Limit of Five-Dimensional Boson Stars and Scale Invariance Violation

Eduard Kim, Oleg Kondrashov, Emin Nugaev, Yakov Shnir · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：本文研究(4+1)维广义相对论中球对称玻色星的非相对论极限。在该极限下，所得牛顿理论具有精确标度不变性，导致具有固定全局U(1)电荷和零结合能的临界玻色星构型。作者指出这些性质源于恢复的标度对称性，并分析相对论与引力修正如何破坏该对称性。通过比较完整的(4+1)维Einstein-Klein-Gordon系统与Wick-Cutkosky模型，量化这些修正对能量-电荷关系和构型运动学稳定性的影响。结果表明，标度不变性的弱破缺如何解除非相对论解的简并，并决定玻色星远离临界极限时的行为。

English: We investigate the non-relativistic limit of spherically symmetric boson stars in (4+1)-dimensional general relativity (GR). In this limit, the resulting Newtonian theory exhibits an exact scale invariance, leading to a critical boson star configuration with a fixed global U(1) charge and vanishing binding energy. We identify the origin of these properties in the restored scale symmetry and analyze how relativistic and gravitational corrections break this symmetry. By comparing the full (4+1)-dimensional Einstein-Klein-Gordon system with the Wick-Cutkosky model, we quantify the effects of these corrections on the energy-charge relation and the kinematic stability of the configurations. This results in the parton propagators displaying a long-distance behavior $e^{-\Lambda_s |x|/\sqrt{2}} |x|^{-5/2 + d_a}$ where propagation is suppressed beyond distances of order $1/\Lambda_s$, as expected from confinement. This offers an intuitive interpretation of confinement as the suppression of QCD Green's functions at long distance.

Two-peak gravitational wave spectra from supercooled two-field phase transitions

Daniel Ara\'{u}jo, Jo\~ao Gon\c{c}alves, Danny Marfatia · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-30

中文摘要：研究了双场共形模型中超冷一级相变产生的引力波谱。构造三个代表性玩具模型以刻画这类模型的关键特征，给出两步相变存在的解析判据，并展示双场动力学如何产生真正的双峰引力波谱。识别了可在 LISA 和爱因斯坦望远镜观测到双峰引力波谱的参数空间区域，并作为一个示例将分析应用于一个现实的共形暗 SU(3) 模型。

English: We study the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum generated by supercooled first-order phase transitions in two-field conformal models. We construct three representative toy models that capture the essential features of these models, derive analytical criteria for the existence of two-step transitions, and show how the two-field dynamics generate a genuine two-peak GW spectrum. We identify regions of parameter space in which two-peak GW spectra are observable at LISA and the Einstein Telescope. By way of illustration, we apply our analysis to a realistic conformal dark SU(3) model.

中文摘要：奇异金属将电阻率随温度线性变化与比热 C/T 在冷却时对数上升结合在一起。我们发现，如果电子受到局域临界浴的散射，耦合会在其系数的比值 Q 中抵消，留下两个可测量数：浴弛豫有多慢（见光电子能谱或光学测量），以及临界熵中参与弛豫电流的份额。浴形成若干类别：共形浴的 Q≤4.91，正如 SYK 模型所确认；Yukawa-SYK 场为 9--15；Kondo 晶格则小得多。LSCO 在 Q≈9 处超过共形界限，指向 Yukawa-SYK 场。

English: Strange metals pair a resistivity linear in temperature with a specific heat $C/T$ rising logarithmically on cooling. We find that, if electrons scatter off a local critical bath, the coupling cancels in the ratio $Q$ of their coefficients, leaving two measurable numbers: how slowly the bath relaxes, seen in photoemission or optics, and the share of critical entropy that relaxes current. Baths form classes: $Q\le4.91$ for a conformal bath, as SYK models confirm; 9--15 for the Yukawa--SYK field; and far less for Kondo lattices. LSCO, at $Q\approx9$, exceeds the conformal bound, pointing to the Yukawa--SYK field.

English: Exceptional points (EPs) and eigenstate hysteresis, previously found in Kerr only with an auxiliary scalar field, arise intrinsically in the quasinormal-mode spectrum of Kerr-Newman black holes. Alex Kehagias, Antonio Riotto · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：致密天体的潮汐可变形性由单一频率函数——联系诱导多极矩与外加强潮的推迟格林函数——编码。因果性、实性、被动性以及正测度色散表示所需的高频条件，使该响应可重标度为上半复频率平面的全纯自映射。利用曾用于黑洞物理量子混沌界的 Schwarz-Pick 定理，我们给出潮汐响应对频率变化率的界。对于具有正潮汐谱阈值的中子星，动力学 Love 数由静态响应和携带非零潮汐谱权重的最低频率界定，理想单模模型饱和该界。对潮汐谱无隙的黑洞，动力学 Love 数是视界吸收谱的有限部分矩。在完整响应的增长假设下，该定理约束完整欧几里得响应，但不界定动力学 Love 数。

English: The tidal deformability of a compact object is encoded in a single function of frequency, the retarded Green's function relating the induced multipole to the applied tide. Causality, reality, passivity, and the high-frequency conditions required for a positive-measure dispersion representation allow this response to be rescaled into a holomorphic self-map of the upper complex frequency half-plane. Using the Schwarz-Pick theorem, already employed to derive the quantum chaos bound in black hole physics, we provide a bound on the rate of the tidal response with respect to the frequency. For a neutron star with a positive tidal spectral threshold, the dynamical Love number is bounded in terms of the static response and the lowest frequency carrying nonzero tidal spectral weight, with the ideal single-mode model saturating the bound. For a black hole, whose tidal spectrum is gapless, the dynamical Love number is a finite-part moment of the horizon absorption spectrum. Under a growth hypothesis on the complete response the theorem constrains the full Euclidean response, but it does not bound the dynamical Love number.

一句话导读：利用因果性与 Schwarz-Pick 定理给出致密天体动力学 Love 数随频率变化的界，并区分中子星与黑洞的潮汐谱情形。

紧致天体的环衰减与回声：Debye 级数与 Debye 准正模

Ringdown and echoes from compact objects: Debye series and Debye quasinormal modes

Mohamed Ould El Hadj, Sam R. Dolan · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文引入一种按散射理论中 Debye 展开精神构造的波形新级数分解，并用它分析弯曲时空中紧致、无视界天体对标量场扰动的时域响应。该 Debye 分解分离出外部直接传播、表面反射以及穿过紧致天体内部的连续透射，并以测地线轨迹给出波形的直观解释。通过分析各 Debye 项的准正模（QNM）内容，作者提出与标准 QNM 描述互补的 Debye-QNM 描述。利用该框架，作者研究标量场在两个示例性“Schwarzschild 星”紧致天体时空中的传播：类中子星模型 R>3M 与超紧致天体 R<3M。结果表明，闭式 Debye 重构与精确波形吻合良好，且即使在早期也能收敛，可准确描述包括瞬发响应在内的所有波形特征。在中子星情形，低阶 Debye 项主要描述环衰减以及与亚阈值支割线相关的非模成分；在超紧致情形，Debye 级数将波形组织为瞬发/环衰减贡献及随后一系列类回声波包。新的 Debye-QNM 展开与标准 QNM 展开具有互补的谱解释：前者识别单个传播通道中的模，后者描述作为前者重求和的集体共振。这一区别阐明了类回声结构如何由反复内部传播产生，以及极点与支割线贡献如何进入时域信号。

English: We introduce a new series decomposition of the waveform constructed in the spirit of Debye expansions in scattering theory, and we use this to analyse the time-domain response of compact, horizonless bodies to scalar-field perturbations on curved spacetimes. The Debye decomposition separates out direct exterior propagation, surface reflection, and successive transmissions through the interior of a compact body, and it provides an intuitive interpretation of the waveform in terms of geodesic trajectories. By analysing the quasinormal-mode (QNM) content of individual Debye terms, we set out a Debye-QNM description that is complementary to the standard QNM description. With this framework, we examine a scalar field propagating on two illustrative `Schwarzschild star' compact-body spacetimes: a neutron-star-like model $R>3M$ and an ultracompact object $R<3M$. We show that the closed-form Debye reconstruction matches well with the exact waveform, and that it converges even at early times, giving an accurate description of all waveform features including the prompt response. In the neutron-star case, the low-order Debye terms mainly describe the ringdown and a non-modal component associated with the sub-threshold branch cut. In the ultracompact case, the Debye series organizes the waveform into a prompt/ringdown contribution followed by a succession of echo-like wavepackets. The new Debye-QNM expansion and the standard QNM expansion have complementary spectral interpretations: the former identifies modes in individual propagation channels, whereas the latter describes collective resonances that are resummations of the former. This distinction clarifies how echo-like structures emerge from repeated interior propagation, and how pole and branch-cut contributions enter the time-domain signal.

一句话导读：提出 Debye 级数/Debye-QNM 框架，用传播通道分解紧致天体标量扰动波形并解释环衰减与回声。

Einstein引力中反向等周不等式的几何-分析证明

A geometric--analytic proof of the reverse isoperimetric inequality in Einstein gravity

Naman Kumar · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.DG, math.MP · v4 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们针对Einstein引力中紧致AdS黑洞视界，发展反向等周不等式的几何-分析证明。在固定热力学体积下，对引力作用量作York切片/雅可比变分表明，球形Schwarzschild–AdS解在一般非球形形变下是严格的局域熵最大。全局有限扩展在Sherif–Dunsby（SD）刚性定理假设内表述：紧致性与球面拓扑、所需的内禀Ricci分解 Ric_h=α e⊗e+βN 且 α≠β、由 \tilde h_{ab}=e^{2φ}h_{ab} 给出的保持内禀标量曲率的超曲面度规的恰当共形变换 \tilde R≡R[\tilde h]=R[h]≡R>0，以及负的叶层膨胀。紧致性和 S^3 拓扑已内置于所考虑的类中。在静态球对称扇区如Schwarzschild–AdS和RN–AdS中，SD Ricci形式自然实现，而对Kerr–AdS情形则是附加限制。对于 S^3 拓扑，存在正的Yamabe型共形类，Yamabe定理为其提供具有正且常标量曲率的代表。我们进一步限制到SD定理所需的保标量曲率共形变换。负叶层膨胀由引力聚焦得到。在此容许类中，非圆的Kerr–AdS视界不能使熵最大化，而固定热力学体积选择相应的圆Schwarzschild–AdS比较对象。该分析因此建立了在所声明的几何刚性类中的一般局域熵最大和有限全局结果，并识别出引力在反转通常等周问题中的作用。

English: We develop a geometric--analytic proof of the reverse isoperimetric inequality for compact AdS black hole horizons in Einstein gravity. At fixed thermodynamic volume, a York slice/Jacobi variation of the gravitational action shows that the spherical Schwarzschild--AdS solution is a strict local entropy maximum against generic non-spherical deformations. The finite global extension is formulated within the hypotheses of the Sherif--Dunsby (SD) rigidity theorem: compactness and spherical topology, the required intrinsic Ricci decomposition $\mathrm{Ric}_h=\alpha\,\mathbf e\!\otimes\!\mathbf e+\beta N$ with $\alpha\neq\beta$, a proper conformal transformation of the hypersurface metric given by $\widetilde h_{ab}=e^{2\varphi}h_{ab}$ that preserves its intrinsic scalar curvature, $\widetilde R\equiv R[\widetilde h]=R[h]\equiv R>0$, and negative sheet expansion. Compactness and $S^3$ topology are built into the class considered here. In the static spherical sector such as Schwarzschild--AdS and RN--AdS, the SD Ricci form is naturally realized while it is an additional restriction for Kerr--AdS case. For the $S^3$ topology, a positive Yamabe type conformal class exists for which the Yamabe theorem provides a representative of positive and constant scalar-curvature. We further restrict to the scalar-curvature preserving conformal transformation required by the SD theorem. The negative sheet expansion is obtained using gravitational focusing. Within this admissible class, a non-round Kerr--AdS horizon cannot maximize the entropy, while fixed thermodynamic volume selects the corresponding round Schwarzschild--AdS comparator. The analysis thus establishes a generic local entropy maximum and a finite global result within the stated geometric rigidity class, identifying the role of gravity in reversing the ordinary isoperimetric problem.

一句话导读：在Einstein引力中，对紧致AdS黑洞视界给出反向等周不等式的几何-分析证明：固定热力学体积下，球形Schwarzschild–AdS在给定刚性类中是熵最大者。

Jordan-Brans-Dicke 理论中涌现宇宙的经典与半经典稳定性

Classical and Semiclassical Stability of Emergent Universes in Jordan-Brans-Dicke Theory

Pedro Labra\~na, Juan Ortiz · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：涌现宇宙方案基于宇宙起源于过去永恒的 Einstein 静态（ES）态、随后演化至暴胀相和热大爆炸时期的假设。此类模型因给出非奇异且测地完备的宇宙历史而具有吸引力。然而，Mithani 和 Vilenkin 曾论证，即使 ES 态经典稳定，某些模型仍可存在半经典隧穿通道，导致向标度因子消失的构型发生量子衰变。本文在 Jordan-Brans-Dicke（JBD）理论背景下研究 ES 区域的经典与半经典稳定性。我们分析 minisuperspace 中 Wheeler-DeWitt 势的结构，并研究与 Hamiltonian 约束相容的代表性半经典隧穿通道。我们表明，对于 JBD 势和模型参数的适当选择，ES 构型可同时抵抗经典微扰和本文分析的特有半经典隧穿通道。结果表明，Mithani 和 Vilenkin 讨论的量子不稳定性可在参数空间的某些区域内被避免，同时保留超出本文分析范围的更一般隧穿过程的可能性。

English: The Emergent Universe scenario is based on the assumption that the universe originates from a past-eternal Einstein static (ES) state, subsequently evolving toward an inflationary phase and a hot Big Bang era. Such models are appealing as they provide nonsingular and geodesically complete cosmological histories. However, it has been argued by Mithani and Vilenkin that, even when the ES state is classically stable, certain models can admit semiclassical tunneling channels leading to quantum decay toward configurations of vanishing scale factor. In this work, we investigate the classical and semiclassical stability of the ES regime in the context of Jordan-Brans-Dicke (JBD) theory. We analyze the structure of the Wheeler-DeWitt potential in minisuperspace and study representative semiclassical tunneling channels compatible with the Hamiltonian constraint. We show that, for suitable choices of the JBD potential and model parameters, the ES configuration can be robust against both classical perturbations and the specific semiclassical tunneling channels analyzed in this work. Our results indicate that the quantum instability discussed by Mithani and Vilenkin may be avoided within certain regions of parameter space, while leaving open the possibility of more general tunneling processes beyond the scope of the present analysis.

一句话导读：在 Jordan-Brans-Dicke 理论中，适当参数下涌现宇宙的 Einstein 静态态可经典稳定并避免特定半经典隧穿衰变。

Orientifold 与可积性：$\mathbb{RP}^4$ 上的 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论

Orientifold and Integrability: $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super-Yang-Mills on $\mathbb{RP}^4$

Joao Caetano, Shota Komatsu, Paolo Soresina, Anders Wallberg · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们利用可积性、全息和超对称局域化研究平面极限下实射影空间 $\mathbb{RP}^4$ 上的 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论，并讨论其与弦论中 orientifold 的关系。我们证明，将定义 $\mathbb{RP}^4$ 的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 对合与 SU$(N)$ 规范群的电荷共轭作用结合时，$\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 的可积性仍然保持。我们通过在弱耦合下计算各子扇区中非 BPS 单迹算符的单点函数来展示这一点；这些单点函数可映射为可积自旋链中能量本征态与 crosscap 态之间的重叠。结果表现出宇称选择规则，这是可积性的标志，并以行列式之比的形式给出。基于这些结果，我们猜测一般单迹算符的闭合公式。我们进一步通过在 pp-wave 极限下构造相应的世界面 crosscap 态，提供证据表明该构造在全息上对偶于 $\text{AdS}_5\times \text{S}^5$ 中的探针 orientifold O1-平面。最后，我们使用超对称局域化，在有限 $g_{\rm YM}$ 和 $N$ 下精确计算半 BPS 算符的单点函数。该计算归结为 $\mathbb{RP}^2$ 上被电荷共轭扭曲的二维杨-米尔斯理论，并导致 Wishart-Laguerre 型矩阵积分。在平面极限下，精确结果在弱耦合规范理论结果、orientifold 的强耦合超引力预言以及 pp-wave 极限下的世界面 crosscap 之间插值。

English: We study planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory (SYM) on the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^4$ using integrability, holography and supersymmetric localization, and discuss its relation to orientifolds in string theory. We show that the integrability of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM is preserved when combining the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ involution defining $\mathbb{RP}^4$ with the action of the charge conjugation of the SU$(N)$ gauge group. We demonstrate this by calculating one-point functions of non-BPS single-trace operators in various subsectors at weak coupling, which can be mapped to overlaps between energy eigenstates and crosscap states in integrable spin chains. The results exhibit a parity selection rule, a hallmark of integrability, and are given in terms of a ratio of determinants. Building on these results, we conjecture a closed formula for general single-trace operators. We further provide evidence that this construction is holographically dual to a probe orientifold O1-plane in $\text{AdS}_5\times \text{S}^5$ by constructing the corresponding worldsheet crosscap states in the pp-wave limit. Finally, we use supersymmetric localization to compute one-point functions of half-BPS operators exactly at finite $g_{\rm YM}$ and $N$. The computation reduces to two-dimensional Yang-Mills theory on $\mathbb{RP}^2$ twisted by charge conjugation and leads to a matrix integral of a Wishart-Laguerre type. In the planar limit, the exact result interpolates between the weak-coupling gauge-theory result, the strong-coupling supergravity prediction for the orientifold, and the worldsheet crosscap in the pp-wave limit.

一句话导读：利用可积性、全息与局域化研究 $\mathbb{RP}^4$ 上 $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 的 orientifold 对偶及单点函数。

Geometry and holography of $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathrm{S}^2$: towards the field theory dual

Miroslava Mosso Rojas, Anayeli Ramirez · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文迈出识别超对称 AdS2×S2 解的超共形量子力学对偶的第一步。聚焦保持八个超荷的 Type IIB AdS2×S2×CY2×Σ 解（Σ 由 (x1,x2) 参数化），读出其膜内容：D1-D5-NS5 交叠并含 D3 与 D7 味道膜。我们提出其对偶 N=4 量子力学由 Σ 上二维格点胞元组织：沿 x2 每个区间对应一份沿 x1 的线性 quiver（对偶于该类的 U(1) 不变解），其秩由相应胞元的 D1、D5 电荷给出；中心电荷在领头阶与全息结果一致。我们证明先前构造的 massive Type IIA AdS3×S2×CY2 解的 SL(2,R) 非阿贝尔 T-对偶族属于此类，AdS3×S3×CY2 的 SL(2,R)×SU(2) 非阿贝尔 T-对偶亦属此类，并详细计算。对二者提出引入额外 D3 和 D7 膜的全局完备化。沿 x2，将色膜与额外 D3、D7 膜之间拉伸的基本弦解释为重子顶点。最后，将该提议推广到定义函数在 x1 和 x2 中可分离的解（包括 AdS2 与 S2 翘曲因子相同的解）。

English: We take a first step in identifying the superconformal quantum mechanics dual to supersymmetric AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ solutions. We focus on the Type IIB solutions of the form AdS$_2\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2\times\Sigma$ that preserve eight supercharges, with $\Sigma$ a two-dimensional space parametrised by $(x_1,x_2)$, and read off their brane content, a D1-D5-NS5 intersection with D3 and D7 flavour branes. We propose that their dual $\mathcal{N}=4$ quantum mechanics is organised over a two-dimensional lattice of cells in $\Sigma$. Namely, it consists of copies of the linear quiver along $x_1$ dual to the U(1)-invariant solutions of the class, one for each interval along $x_2$, with ranks given by the D1 and D5 charges of the corresponding cell. Its central charge agrees with the holographic one at leading order. We show that the family of SL$(2,\mathbb{R})$ non-Abelian T-duals of the AdS$_3\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2$ solutions of massive Type IIA supergravity, constructed in previous work, belongs to this class, as does the SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times$SU$(2)$ non-Abelian T-dual of AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$CY$_2$, and work both out in detail. For both we propose global completions that introduce additional D3 and D7 branes. Along $x_2$ we interpret the fundamental strings stretched between the colour branes and the additional D3 and D7 branes as baryon vertices. Finally, we extend this proposal from the non-Abelian T-duals to the solutions of the class whose defining functions factorise in $x_1$ and $x_2$, including those in which the AdS$_2$ and S$^2$ factors have the same warp factor.

一句话导读：提出超对称 AdS2×S2 Type IIB 解的对偶 N=4 量子力学格点 quiver 构造，并用非阿贝尔 T-对偶解检验。

AdS4×S7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：两圈修正

M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction

Arkady A. Tseytlin · hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文研究在 AdS4×S7/Z_k 中包裹 S^3/Z_k 的 M2 膜瞬子配分函数的两圈 T_2^{-1} 修正；该瞬子对偶于 ABJM 理论在三维球面上自由能的主导非微扰大 N 贡献。先前一圈结果与局域化预言一致。两圈计算因存在玻色和费米零模而需对集体坐标积分；集体坐标雅可比给出非平凡的 T_2^{-1} 贡献。作者发现 k>2 时，在使费米零模与量子场分离并形成独立超多重态的选取下，四阶相互作用顶点贡献被雅可比贡献抵消；在配对零模的超对称处方下，积分后抵消仍成立，故 T_2^{-1} 修正为零，与巨正则系综预言一致。k=1 时四阶顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，与 AdS3⊂AdS7×S4 情形通过形式解析延拓相关。

English: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

一句话导读：计算 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数的两圈修正，发现其 T_2^{-1} 项在 k>2 时因四阶顶点与集体坐标雅可比抵消而消失，支持 ABJM 巨正则系综局域化预言。

Wilson 塔作为体局部场

Wilson Towers as Local Bulk Fields

Vishal Gayari, Chethan Krishnan · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：2+1 维引力中的多绕数 Wilson 圈（Wilson spools）可以重现体内局部自由场的一圈配分函数。体自由场具有二次量子化 Fock 空间，AdS/CFT 对偶暗示相关联的多粒子扇区对偶于 CFT 中的 multi-trace 原初算符。本文用标准对称函数方法证明，热 AdS3 中的 Wilson spool 可改写为单绕数 Wilson 圈的求和——每个 multi-trace 原初算符对应一个。作者还表明，每个 multi-trace 原初算符的 SL(2) 后代与 AdS3 背景的边界引力子一起正确重现每个模的完整 Virasoro 特征标。在此语言中，轻插入作用于重原初算符的角色由拓扑 Verlinde 线扮演，从而给出光滑 BTZ handlebody 上一圈行列式的“微观”描述。具有可收缩热圈的环面上的空间绕数探针 Wilson 线可替换为插入在密集重 Polyakov 圈族上的 Verlinde 线，两个圈的角色交换，使空间圈变为可收缩；模 S-核的真空行充当重原初算符的（近似）密度。这加强了 arXiv:2601.18775 的论点：光滑视界代表量子态系综，每个态由一条在半经典极限下表现为奇异视界的重 Wilson 线产生。

English: Multi-winding Wilson loops (Wilson spools) in 2+1-dimensional gravity can reproduce one-loop partition functions of local free fields in the bulk. Bulk free fields have a second-quantized Fock space, and the AdS/CFT correspondence suggests that the associated multi-particle sectors are dual to multi-trace primaries in the CFT. In this note, we use standard symmetric-function methods to show that the Wilson spool in thermal AdS$_3$ can be recast as a sum over $single$-winding Wilson loops -- one for each multi-trace primary. In a companion paper to appear, we will view Wilson networks and TQFTs as the natural language of non-perturbative bulk quantum gravity. The present note illustrates how this can apply to $local$ bulk fields, and not just defects: a bulk (generalized free) field is to be viewed as a full tower of multi-trace Wilson lines. We further show that the $SL(2)$ descendants of each multi-trace primary, together with the boundary gravitons of the AdS$_3$ background, correctly reproduce the full Virasoro character of each module. In this language, the role of a light insertion on a heavy primary is played by a topological Verlinde line. This allows us to obtain a "microscopic" description of one-loop determinants on the smooth BTZ handlebody. A spatially wound probe Wilson line on a torus with a contractible $thermal$ cycle can be traded for a Verlinde line inserted on a dense family of heavy Polyakov loops -- with the roles of the two cycles exchanged, so that the $spatial$ cycle is now contractible. The vacuum row of the modular $S$-kernel acts as the (approximate) density of the heavy primaries. This reinforces the case made in arXiv:2601.18775 that a smooth horizon is a stand-in for an ensemble of quantum states, each produced by a heavy Wilson line that appears as a singular horizon in the semi-classical limit.

一句话导读：将 AdS3 中的 Wilson spool 重写为对应 multi-trace 原初算符的单绕数 Wilson 圈塔，并连接 BTZ 一圈行列式与视界微观态系综。

相关度：high — 论文直接讨论 AdS/CFT 字典中的 multi-trace 原初算符、Wilson 圈/spool、Virasoro 特征标与 BTZ 视界微观态，与全息对偶基础及 multi-trace 重点标签高度相关；但不以经典广义相对论为主要研究内容。

超越计数的偶然性：一个显式构造

Fortuity beyond counting: an explicit construction

Stefano Giusto, James Inglis, Rodolfo Russo · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们重新考虑 D1D5 CFT 中的“fortuity”机制，重点关注 K3 对称 orbifold。超越 BPS 态计数，我们微扰地研究 BPS 上同调的显式形式如何被 twist-two 形变修改。我们计算中心荷取不同值时 sector (h,j)=(1,0) 中超荷的作用，并推导 primary 态的显式表达式。利用这些信息，我们比较自由 regime 与引力 regime 中某些受保护的三点耦合。我们表明两种描述之间的一致性对 monotone 态与 fortuitous 态的识别施加了非平凡约束。特别地，我们论证，联系不同中心荷理论的映射必须且可以被定义得与定义上链复形的超荷对易。然后我们研究分析中识别的 fortuitous 态与 monotone 态之间的三点关联函数，以评估两个 sector 是否动力学解耦。我们发现两个 monotone 态与一个 fortuitous 态之间存在非零耦合的显式例子，这提供了两个 sector 动力学相连的证据。

English: We reconsider the "fortuity'' mechanism in the D1D5 CFT focusing on the K3 symmetric orbifold. Going beyond the counting of BPS states, we investigate perturbatively how the explicit form of the BPS cohomologies is modified by the twist-two deformations. We calculate the action of the supercharges in the sector $(h,j)=(1,0)$ for different values of the central charge and derive explicit expressions for the primary states. Equipped with this information, we compare some protected three-point couplings in the free and the gravity regime. We show that agreement between the two descriptions imposes non-trivial constraints on the identification of monotone and fortuitous states. In particular, we argue that the map relating theories with different values of the central charge must and can be defined so as to commute with the supercharges that define the cochain complex. We then study the three-point correlators between the fortuitous and monotone states identified in our analysis to assess whether the two sectors are dynamically decoupled. We find an explicit example of a non-vanishing coupling between two monotone and a fortuitous state, providing evidence that the two sectors are dynamically connected.

一句话导读：在 K3 对称 orbifold 的 D1D5 CFT 中显式研究 BPS 上同调在 twist-two 形变下的变化，并发现 monotone 与 fortuitous 态之间存在非零三点耦合。

相关度：low — 论文属于 D1D5 CFT/AdS3/CFT2 的 BPS 上同调与受保护三点耦合研究，不涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM 与非线性演化、冷原子/凝聚态实验启发或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜与 Floquet 驱动等重点支线；与经典引力/广义相对论也无直接关系。
