全息信号不等式的混合态推广

Mixed-state extension of the holographic signal inequality

Joydeep Naskar · hep-th, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文把此前针对三分全息纯态提出的全息信号不等式推广到混合态。采用最小推广时，按已有方案计算反射的 genuine multi-entropy，发现一类全息几何因 Markov gap 消失而违反该不等式；若在正则纯化态上计算残余信息，则可恢复不等式。最后提出一个三分全息态的新不等式猜想并给出支持证据。

English: A novel inequality involving the residual information and genuine multi-entropy was proposed in \cite{Balasubramanian:2025hxg} for tripartite holographic pure states, using which it was argued, that purely GHZ-like tripartite entanglement is not allowed in holography. In this work, we generalize this holographic signal inequality to mixed states. In a minimal extension, we compute the reflected genuine multi-entropy following \cite{Yuan:2024yfg} and find a class of holographic geometries that violate this minimally extended inequality due to a vanishing Markov gap. We can symmetrize this prescription, where instead of computing the residual information on the given mixed state $\rho_{ABC}$, we compute it on its canonical purification. The inequality is restored on the canonically purified state. Finally, we conjecture a new inequality for tripartite holographic states and give supporting evidence.

一句话导读：将三分全息纯态的信号不等式推广到混合态，并讨论最小推广的违反与正则纯化修复。

相关度：low — 主题属于全息纠缠与量子信息，与用户列出的全息超流、探针膜、经典引力等标签无直接重合。

黑洞的全息压强与体积

Holographic pressure and volume for black holes

Silvester G. A. Borsboom, Manus R. Visser · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文主张基于准局域引力热力学，为黑洞定义全息的热力学压强和体积。当黑洞被有限类时边界包围时，York 准局域第一定律包含一个与边界面积共轭的表面压力。假设该边界上存在全息对偶理论，这些几何量对应对偶热系统的压强和体积。本文聚焦静态球对称黑洞，此时这些量退化为全局热力学变量。全息体积提供了系统尺度的概念，使广延性可按标准热力学定义，并给出大系统极限。对于渐近平直情形，在正则热力学表示中，小的 Schwarzschild 黑洞是非广延的，而大黑洞在大系统极限下变为广延。类似结论适用于 Anti-de Sitter Schwarzschild 黑洞，区别在于大黑洞的准局域能量在大系统极限下也变为广延；在此极限之前，能量分解为亚广延和广延贡献，并给出广延部分作为有限体积和熵函数的显式表达。

English: We advocate for a holographic definition of thermodynamic pressure and volume for black holes based on quasi-local gravitational thermodynamics. When a black hole is enclosed by a finite timelike boundary, York's quasi-local first law includes a surface pressure conjugate to the boundary area. Assuming the existence of a holographically dual theory living on this boundary, these geometric quantities correspond to the pressure and volume of the dual thermal system. In this work we focus on static, spherically symmetric black holes, for which these quantities reduce to global thermodynamic variables. The holographic volume provides a notion of system size, allowing extensivity to be defined in standard thermodynamic terms, and it yields a definition of the large-system limit. For the asymptotically flat case, we show that, in the canonical thermodynamic representation, small Schwarzschild black holes are non-extensive, whereas large black holes become extensive in the large-system limit. A similar conclusion applies to Anti-de-Sitter Schwarzschild black holes, with the difference that the quasi-local energy of the large black hole also becomes extensive in the large-system limit. Before this limit, the energy decomposes into subextensive and extensive contributions, and we derive an explicit expression for the extensive part as a function of the finite volume and entropy.

一句话导读：基于准局域引力热力学定义黑洞的全息压强与体积，并讨论 Schwarzschild 与 AdS 黑洞的广延性。

改进全息QCD模型中质子的引力形状因子

Gravitational form factors of the proton in the improved holographic QCD model

Antti Hippel\"ainen, Niko Jokela, Matti J\"arvinen · hep-th, hep-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文使用改进全息QCD模型计算质子引力形状因子的胶子贡献，其中质子在体时空中由Dirac费米子描述。模型参数通过格点与现象学输入约束，从而给出引力形状因子的估计并与其他方法结果比较。利用得到的形状因子，作者分析质子的力学性质，包括压强与剪切分布，并估计质子的力学半径约0.63 fm、质量半径约0.65 fm，与其他非微扰研究结果进行比较。

English: We compute the gluonic contribution to the gravitational form factors of the proton using the improved holographic QCD model, in which the proton is described in terms of bulk Dirac fermions. Model parameters are constrained using lattice and phenomenological input, allowing us to obtain estimates for the gravitational form factors and to compare them with results from other approaches. Using the extracted form factors, we analyze mechanical properties of the proton, including pressure and shear distributions. We obtain estimates for the mechanical and mass radii of the proton, $\rho_{\text{mech}} \approx 0.63$ fm, $\rho_{\text{mass}} \approx 0.65$ fm, and compare these values with radius estimates from other nonperturbative studies.

一句话导读：在改进全息QCD模型中用体Dirac费米子计算质子引力形状因子及其力学半径与压强/剪切分布。

一种方法找到全部：超越爱因斯坦的解析黑洞

One Method to Find Them All: Analytic Black Holes beyond Einstein

Dongjun Li, Jierui Hu, Nicol\'as Yunes · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：旋转黑洞为检验引力提供了强有力的探针，但在真空广义相对论之外构造其几何仍然具有挑战性。我们发展了一个统一框架，从潮汐曲率和物理源出发构造Kerr的稳态、轴对称形变。作为演示，我们在耦合的领头阶、对一般亚极端自旋得到了六种高曲率相互作用的闭式解，无需慢旋转展开、数值拟合或模式分解。这些解通过了与场方程、此前逐模式构造以及视界量已知解析预言的严格检验。我们发现，相互作用的手征性组织了这些解的解析结构，这一模式很可能推广到一大类纯度规高曲率理论。我们的框架为超越爱因斯坦理论以及微扰天体物理环境中的黑洞几何开辟了一条系统途径。这些几何为利用引力波和其他观测通道（如黑洞图像和X射线光谱）进行强场检验，以及近极端黑洞的理论研究提供了基础。

English: Rotating black holes offer powerful probes of gravity, but constructing their geometries beyond vacuum general relativity remains challenging. Here we develop a unified framework for constructing stationary, axisymmetric deformations of Kerr from their tidal curvature and physical sources. As a demonstration, we obtain closed-form solutions for six higher-curvature interactions at leading order in the couplings and for generic subextremal spin, without slow-rotation expansions, numerical fitting, or mode decomposition. The solutions pass stringent checks against the field equations, previous mode-by-mode constructions, and known analytic predictions for horizon quantities. We find that the chirality of the interactions organizes the analytic structure of these solutions, a pattern that likely extends to a large class of purely metric higher-curvature theories. Our framework opens a systematic route to black-hole geometries in beyond-Einstein theories and perturbative astrophysical environments. These geometries provide a foundation for strong-field tests with gravitational waves and other observational channels, such as black-hole images and X-ray spectroscopy, as well as theoretical studies of near-extremal black holes.

一句话导读：提出统一框架，从潮汐曲率和物理源构造Kerr在超越爱因斯坦理论中的解析稳态轴对称形变，并给出六种高曲率相互作用的闭式解。

能听到奇点的缺失吗？

Can One Hear the Absence of a Singularity?

Matteo Della Rocca, Paolo Pani, Andrea P. Sanna · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：量子引力的一个核心预期是消除广义相对论所预言的曲率奇点，并可能在视界内产生正则的有效黑洞几何。我们证明，对于一大类包含若干已知解的正则黑洞，其准正规模谱在大泛音极限下与 Schwarzschild 黑洞存在不连续差异，哪怕正则化参数任意小也是如此。准正则频率的实部渐近趋于零，而不是像广义相对论以及其他预言曲率奇点黑洞的理论中通常那样趋于非零常数。因此，渐近黑洞谱保留了奇点消除的独特印记。我们通过系统建立单值性方法解析地得到这些结果，并进行了数值验证。我们将该现象解释为黑洞谱不稳定性的一种表现：对真空广义相对论的任意微小偏离会在高泛音谱中产生非微扰变化。

English: One of the central expectations of quantum gravity is the resolution of the curvature singularities predicted by General Relativity, potentially giving rise to effective black-hole geometries that are regular inside the horizon. We show that, for a very broad class of regular black holes including several known solutions, the quasinormal-mode spectrum in the large-overtone limit differs discontinuously from that of a Schwarzschild black hole, even when the regularization parameter is arbitrarily small. The real part of the quasinormal frequencies vanishes asymptotically, rather than approaching a nonzero constant, as generically occurs in General Relativity and other theories predicting black holes with curvature singularities. The asymptotic black-hole spectrum thus retains a distinctive imprint of singularity resolution. We establish these results analytically through a systematic formulation of the monodromy method and confirm them numerically. We interpret this phenomenon as a manifestation of black-hole spectral instability, whereby arbitrarily small deviations from vacuum General Relativity produce nonperturbative changes in the large-overtone spectrum.

Kei-ichi Maeda · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们利用以孤子为中心的局部惯性系，建立弯曲时空中自引力薛定谔-泊松（SP）孤子的描述。在弱场和非相对论区域，背景时空效应通过由时空曲率决定的有效潮汐势纳入SP方程。我们将该框架应用于沿Kerr黑洞赤道圆轨道测地线运动的孤子。潮汐场包含定常和含时的四极分量，诱导孤子形变及相应的质量四极矩。我们用潮汐形变率和无量纲Love数表述四极响应，并估计旋转形变孤子相关的引力辐射，对代表性孤子尺度和轨道半径计算特征应变。与计划中的空间引力波探测器代表性灵敏度曲线比较，可识别估计特征应变可能落入其灵敏度范围的参数区域。该框架为研究黑洞时空中自引力玻色子孤子的潮汐响应及其潜在引力波信号提供了系统基础。

English: We formulate a description of self-gravitating Schr\"odinger--Poisson (SP) solitons in curved spacetime using a local inertial frame centered on the soliton. In the weak-field and non-relativistic regime, the effect of the background spacetime is incorporated into the SP equations through an effective tidal potential determined by the spacetime curvature. We apply this framework to a soliton moving along a circular equatorial geodesic around a Kerr black hole. The tidal field contains stationary and time-dependent quadrupolar components, which induce a deformation of the soliton and an associated mass quadrupole moment. We formulate the quadrupolar response in terms of the tidal deformability and the dimensionless Love number. We then estimate the gravitational radiation associated with the rotating deformed soliton and evaluate the corresponding characteristic strain for representative soliton sizes and orbital radii. A comparison with representative sensitivity curves of planned space-based gravitational-wave detectors identifies parameter regimes in which the estimated characteristic strain may lie within their sensitivity ranges. Our framework provides a systematic basis for investigating the tidal response of self-gravitating bosonic solitons in black-hole spacetimes and their potential gravitational-wave signatures.

Dario Rossi, Leonardo Gualtieri, Thomas P. Sotiriou · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们提出一个超越广义相对论的半不可知黑洞双星旋进建模框架，它固定场内容而不选择特定理论。我们按后牛顿阶和 l/L 的幂展开，其中 l 是控制偏离广义相对论的特征长度尺度，L 是系统的特征长度尺度。我们关注无质量标量场与度规耦合、领头后牛顿阶的情形。考虑相互作用项和源特征量随 l/L 的标度，我们发现旋进可用少量普适参数描述。这种参数化适合从多源获得联合限制并搜寻特定场。

English: We introduce a semi-agnostic modeling framework for black hole binary inspirals beyond general relativity that fixes the field content without selecting a particular theory. We expand in the post-Newtonian order and in powers of $l/L$, where $l$ is the characteristic length-scale that controls deviations from General Relativity and $L$ is the characteristic length-scale of the system. We focus on the case of a massless scalar field coupled with the metric, at leading post-Newtonian order. Taking into account the scaling with $l/L$ of both the interaction terms and the quantities that characterise the sources, we find that the inspiral can be described in terms of a small number of universal parameters. Such a parametrisation is suitable for obtaining combined bounds from multiple sources and performing searches for specific fields.

Horndeski 宇宙学中的吸引子与初值敏感性

Attractors and initial-condition sensitivity in Horndeski cosmologies

Yulia A. Ageeva, Andrey K. Sharofeev · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们研究邻近的均匀宇宙历史是否会趋近或远离 Genesis 与收缩解。我们还确定较晚阶段标量速度的不确定性如何影响推断出的初始速度。在 Genesis 模型中，包含引力动力学可显著改变这一关系。我们发现，即使背景的微扰不稳定，均匀解也可能收敛，因此背景吸引性不足以证明宇宙解物理可行。在收缩模型中，一个幂律解吸引邻近轨迹，而另一个排斥它们。这些效应的强度取决于宇宙学状态的参数化方式。本文不考虑它们随后穿过反弹的演化。

English: We study whether nearby homogeneous cosmological histories approach or move away from the Genesis and contracting solutions. We also determine how an uncertainty in the scalar velocity at a later stage affects the inferred initial velocity. In the Genesis models, including the gravitational dynamics can substantially change this relation. We find that convergence of homogeneous solutions can occur even around backgrounds with unstable perturbations, and therefore attraction of the background is not sufficient to establish that a cosmological solution is physically viable. In the contracting model, one power-law solution attracts nearby trajectories, whereas another repels them. The strength of these effects depends on how the cosmological state is parametrized. Their evolution through the subsequent bounce is not considered here.

含物质的有迹辐射规范重构闭包：一般Kerr条件、薄壳基准与守恒环面

Closure of Traceful Radiation-Gauge Reconstruction with Matter: General Kerr Conditions, a Thin-Shell Benchmark, and a Conserved Torus

G. G. L. Nashed · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们为Kerr背景下含物质的一阶有迹辐射规范度规重构建立闭包问题。重构被分解为Weyl曲率、Ricci迹以及质量-角动量补全扇区。对于相容的初始、规范与补全数据，我们在正则Kerr区域上建立所得三角输运系统的局部存在性与唯一性，并识别闭合全局表述所需的附加条件；这不是全局存在定理。我们用两个守恒物质源检验该框架。对于围绕Schwarzschild黑洞的薄壳，Israel匹配、正则性、渐近平直性、正压物态方程和固定静质量确定了静态、轴向及领头转动扇区。ADM质量偏移为壳静质量的 √(1-2M/R) 倍，而轴向扇区确定角动量、转动惯量与内部参考系拖曳。我们还在Kerr上构造了一个常角动量的稳态流体环面，并计算其Newman--Penrose Ricci投影，表明非球对称源一般会激发耦合的Ricci扇区。薄壳提供了闭合基准，环面则说明一般Kerr源所需的额外结构。

English: We formulate the closure problem for first-order, traceful radiation-gauge metric reconstruction on a Kerr background with matter. The reconstruction is decomposed into Weyl-curvature, Ricci-trace, and mass--angular-momentum completion sectors. For compatible initial, gauge, and completion data, we establish local existence and uniqueness of the resulting triangular transport system on a regular Kerr domain, and identify the additional conditions needed for a closed global formulation. This is not a global existence theorem. We test the framework using two conserved matter sources. For a thin shell around a Schwarzschild black hole, Israel matching, regularity, asymptotic flatness, a barotropic equation of state, and fixed rest mass determine the static, axial, and leading rotational sectors. The ADM-mass shift is $\sqrt{1-2M/R}$ times the shell rest mass, while the axial sector determines the angular momentum, moment of inertia, and interior frame dragging. We also construct a stationary constant-angular-momentum fluid torus on Kerr and compute its Newman--Penrose Ricci projections, showing that nonspherical sources generally excite coupled Ricci sectors. The shell provides a closed benchmark, while the torus illustrates the additional structure required for general Kerr sources.

一句话导读：在Kerr背景上建立含物质的一阶有迹辐射规范度规重构闭包，给出局部存在唯一性、Schwarzschild薄壳基准和Kerr流体环面算例。

Sabutay Ugur, Muzaffer Adak, Ali Bagci, Caglar Pala · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文研究了广义狄拉克方程在对称远平行引力的弱、静态、球对称背景下的非相对论极限。广义旋量联络包含完整的Clifford代数基，并引入超出常规Dirac理论的非度规性耦合。作者在重合规范下采用各向同性坐标中的弱场Schwarzschild几何，推导广义Dirac哈密顿量，并连续进行Foldy--Wouthuysen变换至1/m^2阶，保留引力势及其空间导数的一阶项。所得块对角哈密顿量除动能、自旋-轨道和Darwin相互作用的预期引力对应项外，还包含由广义旋量联络产生的额外算符结构，特别是直接自旋-引力、各向异性自旋-动量-引力以及潮汐自旋-动量耦合。文章还对地球弱引力场中的电子进行量级分析以论证截断。结果表明，对称远平行背景中的广义Dirac方程会产生涉及费米子自旋、动量和引力场空间导数的新低能相互作用通道，并为唯象限制广义旋量联络中的额外耦合提供框架。

English: We investigate the non-relativistic limit of the generalized Dirac equation in a weak, static, and spherically symmetric background of symmetric teleparallel gravity. The underlying generalized spinor connection incorporates the complete Clifford-algebra basis and introduces additional couplings to the non-metricity sector beyond those of the conventional Dirac theory. Working in the coincident gauge and adopting the weak-field Schwarzschild geometry in isotropic coordinates, we derive the corresponding generalized Dirac Hamiltonian and perform successive Foldy--Wouthuysen transformations up to order $1/m^2$, retaining terms to first order in the gravitational potential and its spatial derivatives. The resulting block-diagonal Hamiltonian contains not only the expected gravitational counterparts of the kinetic, spin--orbit, and Darwin interactions, but also additional operator structures generated by the generalized spinor connection. In particular, direct spin--gravity, anisotropic spin--momentum--gravity, and tidal spin--momentum couplings arise naturally from the generalized metric-affine interaction. We further perform an order-of-magnitude analysis for an electron in the Earth's weak gravitational field to justify the adopted truncation of the inverse-mass expansion. These results demonstrate that the generalized Dirac equation in a symmetric teleparallel background gives rise to new low-energy interaction channels involving the fermion spin, momentum, and spatial derivatives of the gravitational field. The resulting effective Hamiltonian provides a framework for exploring phenomenological constraints on the additional couplings entering the generalized spinor connection.

一句话导读：在对称远平行引力的弱场球对称背景中，通过Foldy--Wouthuysen变换导出广义Dirac方程的非相对论哈密顿量，并发现新的自旋-引力耦合。

Panos Betzios · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们求解了带基本夸克的大 N 二维 QCD——'t Hooft 模型——在刚性 AdS₂ 和 dS₂ 上的版本。其等距群保持零规范 A_-=0；在仿射坐标中，曲率仅通过零线上的特殊共形生成元进入光前哈密顿量。SL(2,R) Casimir 因此给出精确的介子方程：'t Hooft 方程加上一个 Legendre 算符，其符号由曲率决定。在 AdS₂ 上，它与折叠/分段弦及光前全息背景下提出的方程相关。在手征极限下 π 介子无质量，并满足确定手征凝聚的 Gell-Mann–Oakes–Renner 关系；一旦通量管超过曲率半径，维度从 Regge 增长过渡到对数增长，而平空间可积结构仍然保留。我们还求解了一个夸克与放置在边界上的反夸克相互作用的问题：超过临界耦合后，弦将其拉回边界，产生散射相移。在 dS₂ 上，由于空间膨胀，即使 N=∞ 介子也是不稳定共振并最终解离；其宽度由 de Sitter 温度下的 Boltzmann 因子给出。

English: We solve large-$N$ two-dimensional QCD with fundamental quarks---the 't Hooft model---on rigid AdS$_2$ and dS$_2$. Their isometries preserve the null gauge $A_-=0$ and in affine coordinates the curvature enters the light-front Hamiltonian only through the special-conformal generator of the null line. The $SL(2,\mathbb{R)}$ Casimir then results in an exact meson equation: 't Hooft's equation plus a Legendre operator whose sign is determined by the curvature. On AdS$_2$ it is related to equations proposed in the context of folded/segmented strings and light-front holography. The pion is massless in the chiral limit and obeys a Gell-Mann--Oakes--Renner relation that fixes the chiral condensate, the dimensions cross over from Regge to logarithmic growth once the flux tube exceeds the curvature radius, and the flat-space integrable structure survives. We also solve the problem of a quark interacting with an antiquark placed at the boundary: beyond a critical coupling the string pulls it back to the boundary, resulting in a scattering phase. On dS$_2$ and due to the expansion of space, the mesons are unstable resonances even at $N=\infty$ and eventually dissociate. Their widths are given by Boltzmann factors at the de Sitter temperature.

一句话导读：在刚性 AdS₂/dS₂ 中求解大 N 二维 QCD，得到曲率修正的 't Hooft 介子谱与 dS₂ 中介子共振衰变。

Alba Grassi, Hewei Frederic Jia · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：动量空间热 OPE 通常给出热两点函数的高能渐近展开。本文研究全息 CFT 中该展开在无限和有限体积下的复苏结构，其对偶体几何分别为平面和球形 AdS 黑洞。微扰展开由热 OPE 的应力张量部分固定到所有阶，并可由体波方程的近边界分析计算。非微扰效应则编码远离边界的体几何信息。利用精确 WKB 分析，作者将相关 Borel 奇点的位置识别为 AdS 边界与复径向平面中若干特殊点之间的 WKB 作用量，其中在特定区域包括黑洞奇点。此外，他们识别出类时动量区域中的一个复频率腔室，在其中对高能展开做 Borel 重求和可重构完整热两点函数。进一步导出 Stokes 跳跃，以确定穿过该腔室边界时所需的非微扰贡献。

English: The momentum-space thermal OPE generically gives an asymptotic high-energy expansion of thermal two-point functions. We study the resurgent structure of this expansion in holographic CFTs at infinite and finite volume, whose dual bulk geometries are planar and spherical AdS black holes, respectively. The perturbative expansion is fixed to all orders by the stress-tensor sector of the thermal OPE and can be computed from a near-boundary analysis of the bulk wave equation. Non-perturbative effects, on the other hand, encode information about the bulk geometry away from the boundary. Using exact WKB analysis, we identify the locations of the associated Borel singularities as WKB actions between the AdS boundary and distinguished points in the complex radial plane, which include the black hole singularity in certain regimes. Furthermore, we identify a complex-frequency chamber in the timelike momentum regime where Borel resummation of the high-energy expansion reconstructs the full thermal two-point function. We further derive Stokes jumps that determine the non-perturbative contributions required upon crossing the boundary of this chamber.

Yuya Kusuki, Yin Tang · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们提出将热熵与纠缠联系起来的界，适用于幺正共形场论：四维中 f≤4π²a，三维中 f≤2.99830949… F。这里 f 是热有效作用中宇宙学常数项的无量纲系数，a 是 Euler 异常系数，F 是球面自由能。球面 Rényi 熵将四维界与共形对撞机界联系起来。我们提出一个涉及应力张量三点函数的更强猜想不等式，所有自由理论都饱和该不等式，并在弱耦合规范理论、大 N 矢量模型和全息 CFT 的可控区域建立该不等式。有限 N 数值结果提供了额外检验。这些界约束高能下态密度的 Cardy 增长。

English: We propose bounds relating thermal entropy to entanglement in unitary conformal field theories: $f\le4\pi^2a$ in four dimensions and $f\le2.99830949\ldots\,F$ in three dimensions. Here $f$ is the dimensionless coefficient of the cosmological constant term in the thermal effective action, $a$ is the Euler anomaly coefficient, and $F$ is the sphere free energy. We formulate a stronger conjectural inequality involving the stress-tensor three-point function, saturated by every free theory, and establish it in controlled regimes of weakly coupled gauge theories, large-$N$ vector models, and holographic CFTs. Finite-$N$ numerical results provide additional tests. The bounds constrain the Cardy growth of the density of states at high energy.

On the geometric origin of central charges in gravity

Lorenzo Di Giacomo, Daniele Pranzetti · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：传统上，渐近对称代数的中心扩张通过显式计算守恒荷代数来确定。我们表明，在基于 Noether 分裂的无歧义协变相空间形式中，它们反而作为内禀量出现，完全由拉格朗日量通过相关协变相空间的几何决定。我们证明两个一般的荷表示定理（Charge Representation Theorems），描述在场依赖矢量场和拉格朗日异常存在时微分同胚对称性的正则实现，分别对应 Noether 通量消失与可积的情形。两种情形下，我们导出相关中心扩张的显式表达式并建立相应的余圈恒等式。这提供了直接从理论拉格朗日表述确定中心荷的构造性算法，而无需显式计算荷代数。作为一个非平凡应用，我们考虑具有 Penrose--Brown--Henneaux 边界条件的渐近局域 AdS$_3$ 时空，恢复相应的中心扩张渐近对称代数，从而显式实现荷表示定理。

English: Central extensions of asymptotic symmetry algebras are traditionally determined through an explicit computation of the algebra of conserved charges. We show that, within an ambiguity-free covariant phase space formalism based on the Noetherian split, they instead arise as intrinsic quantities completely determined by the Lagrangian through the geometry of the associated covariant phase space. We prove two general Charge Representation Theorems describing the canonical realization of diffeomorphism symmetries in the presence of field-dependent vector fields and Lagrangian anomalies, corresponding respectively to vanishing and integrable Noetherian flux. In both cases, we derive explicit expressions for the associated central extensions and establish the corresponding cocycle identities. This provides a constructive algorithm for determining central charges directly from the Lagrangian formulation of the theory, without requiring an explicit computation of the charge algebra. As a non-trivial application, we consider asymptotically locally AdS$_3$ spacetimes with Penrose--Brown--Henneaux boundary conditions. We recover the corresponding centrally extended asymptotic symmetry algebra, providing an explicit realization of the Charge Representation Theorems.

一句话导读：用协变相空间几何从拉格朗日量直接构造引力中心荷，并在 AdS$_3$ 上恢复中心扩张渐近对称代数。

Two types of hairy black holes in the (3+1)-dimensional $O(3)$ sigma-model

Jutta Kunz, Aliaksei Mikhaliuk, Yakov Shnir · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们在具有部分负对称破缺势的引力非线性 O(3) sigma 模型中构造稳态轴对称带标量毛黑洞。结果表明，该模型支持两类定性不同的渐近平直毛发黑洞，其区别在于与相应孤子分支的联系以及标量毛的结构：I 型黑洞连接真空分支，II 型黑洞连接规则的、由 scalaron 支撑的旋转孤子。II 型黑洞的标量场结构强烈变形，标量场在对称轴上取真空值，并在近视界赤道区域趋于反真空。我们分析其全局荷、视界性质和对模型参数的依赖，并与 Kerr 黑洞比较。对于足够弱的引力耦合，分支连通性发生变化：I 型和 II 型的基本分支重连为一个连续族，而它们对应的第二分支形成另一族。与连接真空的 I 型族不同，由 scalaron 支撑的 II 型黑洞可延伸到显著更大的视界半径，同时在视界外保持非平庸的标量构型。

English: We construct stationary axially symmetric black holes with scalar hair in the gravitating nonlinear $O(3)$ sigma model with a partly negative symmetry-breaking potential. Our results show that it supports two qualitatively different types of asymptotically flat hairy black holes, distinguished by their connection to the corresponding solitonic branches and by the structure of their scalar hair; the type I black holes are connected to the vacuum branch and type II black holes are connected to regular scalaron-supported spinning solitons. The type II black holes have a strongly deformed scalar field structure, with the scalar field taking its vacuum value on the symmetry axis and approaching the anti-vacuum in the near-horizon equatorial region. We analyze their global charges, horizon properties, and dependence on the model parameters, comparing the solutions with Kerr black holes. For sufficiently weak gravitational coupling, the branch connectivity changes: the fundamental branches of types I and II reconnect to form one continuous family, while their corresponding second branches form another. We find that, in contrast to the vacuum-connected type I family, the scalaron-supported type II black holes extend to substantially larger horizon radii while preserving a nontrivial scalar configuration outside the horizon.

一句话导读：在引力 O(3) sigma 模型中构造并比较两类渐近平直毛发黑洞，揭示其与孤子分支的连通性及弱耦合下的分支重连。

AdS5×S5 与 AdS4×CP3 中 AdS2 超弦配分函数的两圈计算

On 2-loop AdS$_2$ superstring partition function in AdS$_5 \times S^5$ and AdS$_4\times CP^3$

Arkady A. Tseytlin · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文重新审视 AdS5×S5 与 AdS4×CP3 中展开在 AdS2 面附近的 GS 超弦配分函数的两圈计算，该配分函数对偶于 N=4 SYM 与 ABJM 理论中的 1/2 BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈。此前 arXiv:2601.08809 在 AdS5×S5 中使用维数正规化并发现一个紫外极点；由于维数正规化对 GS 弦存在问题，本文改用热核截断。此时局域路径积分测度的贡献（正比于 δ(0)）不能再被忽略。作者表明，它抵消了作用量中四次相互作用带来的 δ(0) 项，只留下玻色与费米模式正规化数目之差 Str E 的平方。因此结果是紫外有限的，arXiv:2601.08809 中的极点只是维数正规化的产物。若所有场都用同一抹平核正规化，则 Str E=0，两圈系数 f2 消失，这与 SYM 理论要求的 f2=3/(32π^2) 相矛盾。在 AdS4×CP3 情形中，同样的抵消留下一个正比于无质量二维费米子格林函数重合值平方的有限项，讽刺地给出 f2=3/(32π^2)，而不是局域化要求的 f2=0。该项是 arXiv:2609.14497 中 AdS4×S7/Z_k 内 AdS2×S1 M2 膜结果的能级零（弦）部分；在那里它被更高的 S1 模式抵消，而这些模式也移除了与 AdS2 超对称相冲突的无质量费米子有限质量移动。这表明 II 型弦路径积分测度应包含额外贡献，在 IIA 情形由母 M2 膜提供；在 AdS5×S5 情形中该贡献仍待确定，并可能解决与局域化之间剩余的两圈不匹配。

English: We revisit the 2-loop computation of the partition function of the GS superstring expanded near the AdS$_2$ surface in AdS$_5\times S^5$ and AdS$_4\times {\rm CP}^3$, dual to $\frac{1}{2}$ BPS circular Wilson loop in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM and ABJM theories. In arXiv:2601.08809 it was done in AdS$_5\times S^5$ using dimensional regularization and a UV pole was found. Since dimensional regularization is problematic for the GS string, here we use a heat-kernel cutoff instead. Then the contribution of the local path integral measure, proportional to $\delta(0)$, can no longer be ignored. We show that it cancels the $\delta(0)$ terms coming from the quartic interactions in the action, leaving the square of the difference ${\rm Str}\,E$ between the regularized numbers of bosonic and fermionic modes. The result is thus UV finite, the pole of arXiv:2601.08809 being an artefact of dimensional regularization. If all fields are regularized with the same smearing kernel, ${\rm Str}\,E=0$ and the 2-loop coefficient $f_2$ vanishes, in tension with $f_2=\frac{3}{32\pi^2}$ in SYM theory. In the AdS$_4\times{\rm CP}^3$ case the same cancellation leaves a finite term proportional to the square of the coincident value of the massless 2d fermion Green's function, giving, ironically, $f_2=\frac{3}{32\pi^2}$ instead of $f_2=0$ required by localization. This term is the level-zero (string) part of the result of arXiv:2609.14497 for the AdS$_2\times S^1$ M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$, where it is cancelled by the higher $S^1$ modes, which also remove a finite mass shift of the massless fermion in conflict with the AdS$_2$ supersymmetry. This suggests that the type II string path integral measure should contain an extra contribution, supplied in the IIA case by the parent M2 brane; in the AdS$_5\times S^5$ case it is still to be identified and may resolve the remaining 2-loop mismatch with localization.

一句话导读：用热核截断重算 AdS2 超弦两圈配分函数，指出维数正规化极点系假象，并讨论与局域化结果的剩余不匹配及可能缺失的路径积分测度贡献。

Another Brick in the Wall: Spectral Form Factor of Normal Modes in Horizonless Geometries

A. I. Belokon, M. \v{C}ubrovi\'c, V. {\DJ}uki\'c, V. V. Pushkarev, L. Umrikhin · hep-th, gr-qc, nlin.CD · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们计算了光滑无视界背景中探针标量波的简正模谱及其谱形状因子。首先考虑带有砖墙的 BTZ 黑洞，砖墙遮蔽近视界区域；该设置最近被提出作为有限温度半经典黑洞微态的玩具模型。在此设置中，谱形状因子是否有线性斜坡取决于砖墙构造的细节。然而我们论证，即使出现斜坡，该斜坡也不来源于与量子混沌相关的能级关联。然后我们计算一个真正微态几何（superstratum）的简正模谱，发现混沌证据，既有斜坡也有能级排斥。我们得出结论：简正模的本征值谱确实可以作为研究 fuzzball 量子动力学的工具；但砖墙模型无法捕捉这一现象。

English: We compute the normal mode spectrum and its spectral form factor for a probe scalar wave in smooth horizonless backgrounds. We first consider the BTZ black hole with a brickwall that hides the near-horizon region, which has recently been proposed as a toy model for a finite-temperature semiclassical black hole microstate. In this setup, the spectral form factor may or may not have a linear ramp, depending on the details of the brickwall construction. However, we argue that even in cases that do show a ramp, this ramp does not originate from level correlations associated with quantum chaos. Then we calculate the normal mode spectrum for a genuine microstate geometry (superstratum) and find evidence of chaos, both with a ramp and level repulsion. We conclude that the eigenvalue spectrum of normal modes can indeed serve as a tool for investigating the quantum dynamics of fuzzballs; however, the brickwall models are incapable of capturing this phenomenon.

一句话导读：在无视界背景中计算简正模谱形状因子，发现超层微态几何显示量子混沌，而砖墙模型不能。

Weam Abou Hamdan, Mart\'i Berenguer Mim\'o, Rafael Carrasco Carmona, Silvia Pla, Omkar Shetye, Tarek Anous, Paolo Benincasa, Guilherme Leite Pimentel · hep-th, cond-mat.dis-nn, cond-mat.stat-mech, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：这些讲义介绍量子自旋玻璃，特别强调其在宇宙学与全息中未解问题上的应用。围绕球面 p-spin 模型，我们对其热力学与动力学性质给出完整且自洽的分析。我们介绍复本方法，讨论复本对称解与一步复本对称破缺解，并刻画由此产生的玻璃相。随后将框架推广到量子模型，通过欧氏与实时关联函数研究慢动力学的出现以及量子关联的作用。最后，我们探讨复本对称破缺与无序等概念如何自然出现在与黑洞碎裂相关的宇宙学和全息系统中，强调自旋玻璃模型可作为研究这些现象的有用理论实验室。这些讲义基于 2025 年 7 月 21 日至 8 月 1 日 La Ricotta 暑期学校“The Disordered Universe 2025”的一系列讲座。

English: These lecture notes provide an introduction to quantum spin glasses, with a particular emphasis on their application to open problems in cosmology and holography. Focusing on the spherical $p$-spin model, we develop a complete and self-contained analysis of its thermodynamic and dynamical properties. We introduce the replica method, discuss both replica-symmetric and one-step replica symmetry-broken solutions, and characterise the resulting glassy phase. The framework is then extended to the quantum model, where we study the emergence of slow dynamics and the role of quantum correlations through Euclidean and real-time correlation functions. Finally, we explore how concepts such as replica symmetry breaking and disorder naturally arise in cosmological and holographic systems related to black hole fragmentation, highlighting spin glass models as useful theoretical laboratories for these phenomena. These notes are based on a series of lectures held during the La Ricotta Summer School: The Disordered Universe 2025 from 21 July to 1 August 2025.

一句话导读：量子自旋玻璃讲义，以球面 p-spin 模型连接复本对称破缺、慢动力学与黑洞碎裂/全息。

五阶后闵可夫斯基黑洞散射中K3最大割的Landau奇点

Landau singularity of the K3 maximal cut in black-hole scattering at fifth post-Minkowskian order

Matthew D. Schwartz · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：模拟双黑洞并合产生的引力波需要对两体问题做精确计算。黑洞散射的后闵可夫斯基展开以牛顿常数幂次展开，目前已到五阶、四圈。在此阶，当黑洞以约光速94%的速度掠过时，偏折的一部分发散。已知该发散来自K3曲面的周期，而该曲面在此速度处有一个节点。我们证明该节点位于K3最大割的积分围道上，使该速度成为该割的Landau奇点。已有工作表明，要求发散在不引入新无穷大的情况下抵消，可将记忆贡献（因波在检验质量中留下的永久位移而得名）固定到一个常数。我们以闭式推导其边界积分的主导系数。我们直接从最大割和边界极限得到这两个结果，而无需对完整四圈被积函数做分部积分约化。我们还将这些积分的K3和Calabi-Yau周期延拓到束缚轨道的能量，如同并合前的旋近阶段。

English: Modeling the gravitational waves from merging black holes requires precise calculations of the two-body problem. The post-Minkowskian expansion of black-hole scattering, in powers of Newton's constant, now stands at fifth order, four loops. At this order one part of the deflection diverges when the black holes pass at about 94 percent of the speed of light. The divergence is known to come from periods of a K3 surface, which has a node at this speed. We show that the node lies on the integration contour of the K3 maximal cut, which makes this speed a Landau singularity of the cut. Requiring the divergence to cancel, without introducing new infinities, has been shown to fix the memory contribution, named for the permanent displacement that the waves leave in test masses, up to one constant. We derive the leading coefficients of its boundary integrals in closed form. We obtain both results from maximal cuts and boundary limits, without an integration-by-parts reduction of the full four-loop integrand. We also continue the K3 and Calabi--Yau periods of these integrals to the energies of bound orbits, as in the inspiral before a merger.

一句话导读：证明五阶后闵可夫斯基黑洞散射中约94%光速处的发散对应K3最大割的Landau奇点，并闭式给出记忆项边界积分主导系数及向束缚轨道能量的周期延拓。

超对称理论中的 Hironaka 分解：一项探索

Hironaka decompositions in supersymmetric theories: an exploration

Abhijit Gadde, Rajat Raj, Shivansh Tomar · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们研究树级超对称上同调何时允许 Hironaka 分解：即用有限多个次级算符、以代数独立的玻色原初算符的多项式系数进行唯一展开。此类分解将上同调组织成具有共同无限制 dressing 的塔。对于具有 N 个标签、d≥1 种玻色子和 f 种费米子的对角模型，我们构造该分解并得到 (N!)^{d-1}2^{fN} 个次级算符。我们还证明 ABJM 理论的标量分支环在任意秩和正整数 Chern–Simons 能级下都允许 Hironaka 分解，并为 SU(2)×SU(2) Klebanov–Witten 标量环构造显式基。我们对两个 class-S 理论的 Higgs 分支也做了同样的事。然而并非所有超对称上同调都允许 Hironaka 分解。在 W=x^2y^2 的 Wess–Zumino 模型中，每个正次数标量都湮灭非零类 xy，而 x^n 对每个 n≥1 都属于上同调。这两条性质排除了以标量原初算符为基础的 Hironaka 分解。

English: We ask when tree-level supersymmetric cohomology admits a Hironaka decomposition: a unique expansion in finitely many secondary operators with polynomial coefficients in algebraically independent bosonic primaries. Such a decomposition organizes the cohomology into towers with a common set of unrestricted dressings. For diagonal models with $N$ labels, $d\geq1$ bosonic species and $f$ fermionic species, we construct this decomposition and obtain $(N!)^{d-1}2^{fN}$ secondaries. We also prove that the scalar-branch ring of ABJM theory admits a Hironaka decomposition at every rank and positive integer Chern--Simons level, and construct explicit bases for the $SU(2)\times SU(2)$ Klebanov--Witten scalar ring. We also do the same for the Higgs branches of two class-S theories. However, not all supersymmetric cohomologies admit a Hironaka decomposition. In the Wess--Zumino model with $W=x^2y^2$, every positive-degree scalar annihilates the nonzero class $xy$, while $x^n$ is in cohomology for every $n\geq 1$. These two properties rule out a Hironaka decomposition over scalar primaries.

中文摘要：从双黑洞并合产生精确波形是引力波天文学的主要工作。近年来，基于机器学习的双黑洞波形替代模型被提出，可显著加速波形生成并保持与传统波形近似模型相当的精度。本文研究自编码器作为准圆双黑洞并合引力波信号生成模型的可行性。我们提出 AESur3dq8，一种基于自编码器的新型替代波形模型，可利用适度计算资源在不到一秒内生成数百万个波形，从而快速准确地构建大型模板库。该模型在数值相对论信息驱动的替代模型 NRHybSur3dq8 上训练，并使用 SXS 双黑洞模拟目录进行微调。我们证明 AESur3dq8 生成的波形相对于数值相对论波形的失配约为 10^{-4}，并且使用这些模板进行的参数估计结果与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组对已观测引力波事件的报告完全一致。

English: The generation of accurate waveforms from binary black hole (BBH) mergers is a major effort in Gravitational-Wave Astronomy. Those offer the potential to dramatically accelerate waveform generation while maintaining accuracy competitive with that of traditional waveform approximants. In this work, we investigate the viability of autoencoders as generative models for gravitational-wave signals from quasi-circular BBH mergers. We introduce AESur3dq8, a novel surrogate waveform model based on autoencoders that enables the rapid and accurate construction of large template banks, producing millions of waveforms in under a second using modest computational resources. The model is trained on the numerical-relativity-informed surrogate NRHybSur3dq8 and subsequently fine-tuned using the SXS catalog of BBH simulations. We demonstrate that waveforms generated by AESur3dq8 achieve mismatches of order $10^{-4}$ with respect to Numerical Relativity waveforms, and that parameter estimation performed with these templates yields results fully consistent with those reported by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration for observed gravitational-wave events.

English: With the release of the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog GWTC-4.0 by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) collaboration, 218 candidate detections of gravitational waves (GWs) from compact binary coalescences (CBCs) have been reported. This milestone represents a major advancement for GW cosmology, as many methods, particularly those employing the spectral siren approach, critically depend on the number of available sources. We investigate the impact of a novel parametric model describing the full population mass spectrum of CBCs on the estimation of the Hubble constant. This model is designed to test the impact of heavy black holes in GW cosmology. We perform a joint inference of cosmological and population parameters using 142 CBCs from GWTC-4.0 with a false alarm rate smaller than 0.25 per year, using both spectral and dark siren approaches. With spectral sirens, we estimate the Hubble constant to be $H_0 = 78.8^{+19.0}_{-15.3}\,{\rm km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}}$ (68% CL), while the dark siren method yields $H_0 = 82.5^{+16.8}_{-14.3}\,{\rm km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}}$ (68% CL). We show that this improvement is linked to the presence of a new mass scale in the binary black hole mass spectrum at $63.3^{+4.8}_{-4.8}\,M_{\odot}$, which provides additional constraints on the Hubble constant. Besides providing the tightest standard-siren constraints on $H_0$, this highlights the importance of a heavy-mass feature in the black hole spectrum.

中文摘要：本文给出带电正则黑洞的一般构造，将其作为球对称下 Einstein--Maxwell 场方程推广形式的解；其中 Einstein 张量被变形为一个恒等守恒、且含引力场最高二阶导数的张量。该构造的普适性使我们能定义一般正则黑洞在带电后所满足的场方程。我们评估保证带电解正则性的条件，并表明这些条件比无电荷解的正则性条件更严格。这尤其意味着 Bardeen 黑洞和 Hayward 黑洞的带电版本会变成奇异。我们提出改进的 Bardeen 和 Hayward 度规，使其在带电时仍保持正则。结果表明，一般而言，仅将广义相对论的真空解正则化，并不足以在其他物理情形中给出正则解。我们还讨论了这些结果对构造现实正则黑洞（需考虑旋转与物质场等）的影响。

English: We present a general construction of charged regular black holes as solutions of a generalization of the Einstein--Maxwell field equations in spherical symmetry in which the Einstein tensor is deformed into an identically conserved tensor containing up to second derivatives of the gravitational field. The generality of the construction allows us to define the field equations satisfied by generic regular black holes when becoming charged. The conditions that guarantee regularity of charged solutions are evaluated and shown to be more stringent than the regularity conditions for uncharged solutions. This implies, in particular, that the charged versions of the Bardeen and Hayward black holes become singular. Improved versions of the Bardeen and Hayward metrics that remain regular when charged are proposed. Our results indicate that regularizing the vacuum solutions of general relativity is, in general, not enough to yield regular solutions in other situations of physical interest. The implications that follow for the construction of realistic regular black holes, in which aspects such as rotation and the presence of matter fields are taken into account, are discussed.

中文摘要：修改引力理论常通过引入超出广义相对论的几何结构来处理引力 sector 的未解决问题，而不诉诸额外物质场。本文受 mimetic gravity 与 Hořava–Lifshitz 引力可在经典层面实现时序保护的启发，提出一个玩具度规-仿射引力模型，其时序保护部分纯为几何。该模型破坏射影不变性，并选取一个类时、闭合的非度规性一形式；在全局精确 sector 中，该一形式定义时间函数，从而通过仿射几何实现稳定因果性。在无物质、空间平坦 FLRW 分支上（非紧切片、Λ=0、正时序 sector 密度），局部二次引力谱包含广义相对论的两个张量模式和一个标量模式；该标量具有正动能但有梯度不稳定性 c_s^2=-2，需在可行宇宙学应用前被稳定化。本文研究这一纯几何时序保护型广义相对论扩展的经典宇宙学效应与标量模式动力学。

English: Modified theories of gravity often introduce geometric structure beyond general relativity to address unresolved problems in the gravitational sector without invoking ad hoc matter fields. Mimetic gravity, for example, generates an effective cosmological dark sector by isolating the conformal mode of the metric, while Ho\v{r}ava--Lifshitz gravity attains power-counting renormalizability by endowing spacetime with a preferred dynamical foliation. Although chronology protection was not the original motivation for either theory, both can realize it classically through stable causality. This suggests that chronology protection itself may be elevated from a derived property to a guiding principle for constructing modified gravitational theories, especially if its implementation at the quantum-gravitational level leaves infrared imprints in the effective action. Motivated by this possibility, we introduce a toy metric--affine gravity model whose chronology-protecting sector is purely geometric. The model breaks projective invariance and selects a timelike, closed non-metricity one-form. In the globally exact sector, this one-form defines a time function, realizing stable causality through affine geometry. On the matter-free, spatially flat FLRW branch with non-compact slices, $\Lambda=0$, and positive chronology-sector density, the local quadratic gravitational spectrum contains the two tensor modes of GR and a single scalar mode. The scalar has positive kinetic energy but a gradient instability, $c_s^2=-2$, requiring stabilization before a viable cosmological application can be established. We investigate the classical cosmological effects and scalar-mode dynamics of this purely geometric chronology-protecting extension of general relativity.

Essentially all of these mergers would be detectable by a reference Cosmic Explorer configuration if it is operating at merger. Ground-based measurements of the high-mass population can therefore inform both LISA forecasts and the prospects for observing the same binaries through inspiral and merger.

Probing the inner disk edge of rotating neutron stars with dipole excitations in finite nuclei

P. S. Koliogiannis, N. Paar · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, nucl-ex, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：核物质状态方程同时决定快速旋转中子星的结构及其周围时空中的轨道运动。其不确定性影响最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）到达星体表面时所对应的质量和半径，这一条件定义了盘内边缘由星体表面决定还是由轨道不稳定性截断的转变。我们量化富中子核的电偶极极化率测量如何减小该转变及盘内边缘轨道性质的不确定性。我们在广义相对论下计算均匀旋转中子星，采用一族系统改变对称能的状态方程，这些方程来自密度依赖点耦合相互作用的相对论能量密度泛函。我们将全族结果与符合有限核偶极极化率测量子集的结果进行比较。偶极极化率约束将转变质量和赤道半径的散布在所考虑自转频率范围内缩小约七到十倍，并在该转变上把盘内边缘轨道频率限制在每个自转下窄于20 Hz的带内。结合测得的中子星自转，若将千赫兹准周期振荡解释为盘轨道运动，还可进一步限制质量—半径区域，从而给出独立质量估计以检验对称能约束。因此，有限核的偶极响应对旋转中子星结构及其内吸积盘轨道性质均有启示。

English: The nuclear equation of state shapes both the structure of rapidly rotating neutron stars and the orbital motion in their surrounding spacetime. Its uncertainty affects the mass and radius at which the innermost stable circular orbit reaches the stellar surface, a condition that defines the transition between disks whose inner edge is set by the surface and those truncated by orbital instability. We quantify how measurements of the electric dipole polarizability of neutron-rich nuclei reduce the uncertainty in this transition and in the orbital properties at the disk inner edge. We compute uniformly rotating neutron stars in general relativity for a family of equations of state that systematically vary the symmetry energy, derived from relativistic energy density functionals with density-dependent point-coupling interactions. We compare the results for the full family with those for the subset consistent with the measured dipole polarizabilities of finite nuclei. The dipole polarizability constraint reduces the spread in transition mass and equatorial radius by factors of about seven to ten across the spin frequencies considered. Along this transition, it also confines the orbital frequency at the disk inner edge to a band narrower than $20$~Hz at each spin. Combined with a measured neutron-star spin, a kilohertz quasi-periodic oscillation interpreted as disk orbital motion further restricts the mass--radius region, allowing an independent mass estimate to probe the symmetry-energy constraint. The dipole response of finite nuclei thus informs both the structure of rotating neutron stars and the orbital properties of their inner accretion disks.

一句话导读：有限核偶极极化率通过约束对称能，把旋转中子星ISCO触及表面转变的质量、半径和内盘轨道频率不确定性显著收窄。

Cowling 近似下轴子凝聚中子星的非径向振荡模式

Nonradial oscillation modes of axion condensed neutron stars in the Cowling approximation

Antonio G\'omez-Ba\~n\'on, Pantelis Pnigouras, Jos\'e A. Pons · hep-ph, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：在轻 QCD 轴子模型中，轴子势的有限密度修正可在中子星内部产生非零轴子场。本文延续此前对径向振荡的分析，在相对论 Cowling 近似下研究此类轴子凝聚中子星的非径向（l=2）振荡谱，并保持流体扰动与轴子扰动完全耦合且动力学演化。凝聚体以两种方式修改流体谱：改变的平衡结构使 f 模和 p 模频率最多升高约 20%，而与轴子场的动力学耦合会部分补偿这一移动，对 f 模几乎完全补偿。频率高于轴子质量的流体模式会通过轴子发射获得新的阻尼通道。对于所有支持凝聚体的位形，f 模均低于该阈值；p 模则可在短至约 10 ms 的时间尺度上被阻尼，短于其引力波阻尼时间，但在某些轴子质量下出射轴子振幅几乎消失。谱中还包含一族强阻尼的轴子主导准正规模，其虚部量级为 kHz，以及一系列类似引力原子能级的引力束缚轴子态。在传播阈值以下，束缚 p 模会与这些能级发生避免交叉，交换其流体主导与轴子主导的特征。

English: In light QCD axion models, finite-density corrections to the axion potential can source a nonvanishing axion field inside neutron stars. Extending our previous analysis of radial oscillations, we study the nonradial ($l=2$) oscillation spectrum of such axion condensed neutron stars in the relativistic Cowling approximation, keeping the fluid and axion perturbations fully coupled and dynamical. The condensate modifies the fluid spectrum in two ways: the altered equilibrium structure raises the $f$- and $p$-mode frequencies by up to $\sim20\%$, while the dynamical coupling to the axion field partially compensates this shift, almost entirely for the $f$-mode. Fluid modes with frequencies above the axion mass acquire a new damping channel through axion emission. The $f$-mode remains below this threshold for all configurations supporting a condensate, whereas the $p$-modes are damped on timescales that can be as short as $\sim10$ ms, shorter than their gravitational-wave damping times, except for certain axion masses where the outgoing axion amplitude nearly vanishes. The spectrum also contains a family of strongly damped axion-dominated quasinormal modes, with imaginary parts of order kHz, and a sequence of gravitationally bound axion states analogous to gravitational atom levels. Below the propagation threshold, the bound $p$-modes undergo avoided crossings with these levels, exchanging their fluid- and axion-dominated character.

一句话导读：研究轴子凝聚中子星在 Cowling 近似下的 l=2 非径向振荡谱，分析 f/p 模频移、轴子发射阻尼、轴子主导准正规模及避免交叉。

全部暗物质为原初黑洞：一个引力波检验

All Dark Matter as Primordial Black Holes: a Gravitational-Wave Test

A. Ianniccari, A. J. Iovino, G. Perna, D. Perrone, A. Riotto · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们提出一种检验宇宙暗物质完全由小行星质量原初黑洞组成这一假设的新方法。该方法依赖于探测球对称尖峰中积累的轻原初黑洞并合到快速旋转的超大质量天体物理黑洞上所产生的随机引力波背景。我们讨论了未来天基引力波天文台 LISA 和 DECIGO 可观测该信号的情景。

English: We propose a novel test for the hypothesis that the dark matter of the Universe is composed entirely by asteroidal-mass primordial black holes. It relies on detecting the stochastic gravitational-wave background generated by the coalescence onto rapidly spinning supermassive astrophysical black holes of the light primordial black holes accumulated in spherically symmetric spikes. We discuss the scenarios in which the signal can be observed by the future space-based gravitational-wave observatories LISA and DECIGO.

一句话导读：提出利用轻原初黑洞并合到快速旋转超大质量黑洞产生的随机引力波背景，检验全部暗物质为小行星质量原初黑洞的假设。

用引力波称量暗物质粒子

Weighing dark matter particles with gravitational waves

Rodrigo Vicente, Francisco Duque, Theophanes K. Karydas, Gianfranco Bertone · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：通常认为，当暗物质表现为无碰撞物质时，无法从其引力效应确定暗物质粒子质量。本文表明，LISA 等毫赫兹引力波天文台可观测的极端质量比旋近，在足够致密的暗物质尖峰中，能够测量超轻暗物质粒子的质量。两个黑洞之间的尺度分离使超轻暗物质能在大质量主黑洞周围形成无碰撞密度尖峰，同时在与恒星级伴星的相互作用中保留波动效应。作者将依赖波动的吸积和动力学摩擦纳入相对论旋近波形，并从模拟的 LISA 信号中联合推断暗物质粒子质量、尖峰归一化和双星参数。对于处于 LISA 族群低质量端的大质量黑洞（M∼10^5 M⊙），预测显示 10^-14–10^-11 eV 范围内的粒子质量可被测量到一个数量级以内。

English: It is commonly assumed that the mass of dark matter particles cannot be determined from their gravitational effects when dark matter behaves as collisionless matter. Here we show that extreme-mass-ratio inspirals observable by millihertz gravitational-wave observatories such as the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) could measure the mass of ultralight dark matter particles in sufficiently dense dark matter spikes. The separation of scales between the two black holes allows ultralight dark matter to form a collisionless density spike around the massive primary while retaining wave effects in its interaction with the stellar-mass companion. We incorporate wave-dependent accretion and dynamical friction into relativistic inspiral waveforms and jointly infer the dark matter particle mass, spike normalisation and binary parameters from simulated LISA signals. For massive black holes at the low-mass end of the LISA population ($M\sim 10^5 M_\odot$), our forecasts show that particle masses spanning $10^{-14}-10^{-11}\,\mathrm{eV}$ could be measured to within an order of magnitude.

一句话导读：利用 LISA 可观测的极端质量比旋近波形，结合超轻暗物质尖峰中的波动吸积与动力学摩擦，可对暗物质粒子质量给出量级约束。

类 Schwarzschild 黑洞周围周期轨道的引力波特征

Gravitational wave signatures of periodic orbits around a Schwarzschild-like black hole

Mirzabek Alloqulov, Sanjar Shaymatov, Bobomurat Ahmedov, Chengxun Yuan · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：我们研究偏离 Schwarzschild 几何如何影响大质量试验粒子的运动，以及围绕一种新改进 Schwarzschild 黑洞的周期轨迹所伴随的引力辐射。通过考察径向与方位角轨道频率的可公度性确定周期构型。对代表性轨迹，我们数值重构粒子运动，并用对称无迹质量四极矩方法计算相应的引力波偏振。通过将这些信号与 Schwarzschild 对应情形比较，我们评估修改后的时空几何如何编码在辐射中。分析表明，参数 ξ 和 γ 会对轨道构型及其相关波形产生适度改变，从而为研究该黑洞模型的动力学特征提供途径。

English: We investigate how deviations from the Schwarzschild geometry affect the motion of massive test particles and the gravitational radiation associated with their periodic trajectories around a new improved Schwarzschild black hole. Periodic configurations are determined by examining the commensurability of the radial and azimuthal orbital frequencies. For representative trajectories, we numerically reconstruct the particle motion and calculate corresponding gravitational wave polarizations using the symmetric trace-free mass-quadrupole approach. By comparing these signals with their Schwarzschild counterparts, we assess how the modified spacetime geometry is encoded in the radiation. Our analysis shows that the parameters $\xi$ and $\gamma$ produce modest changes in the orbital configurations and their associated waveforms, providing a means of investigating the dynamical signatures of this BH model.

一句话导读：研究类 Schwarzschild 黑洞时空中周期轨道及其引力波波形，并比较修改参数对轨道和辐射的影响。

弦T对偶诱导的量子正则化黑洞中的测地线动力学与潮汐力

Geodesic dynamics and tidal forces in a quantum-regularized black hole from string T-duality

G. Alencar, Micael S. Oliveira, Diego S\'aez-Chill\'on G\'omez, Marcos V. de S. Silva · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文研究由T对偶启发的中性和带电正则时空中的测地线动力学与潮汐力效应。作者分析这些解的几何性质，包括正则中心结构和视界构型，并说明T对偶标度ℓ0与电荷Q如何决定黑洞与无视界几何之间的转变。随后通过有效势研究有质量和无质量粒子运动，考察圆轨道的存在性、稳定性及其特征半径。文章进一步研究径向自由下落观测者感受到的潮汐力，关注径向和角向分量的行为、极值与符号变化，以及这些特征点相对于视界结构的位置。结果表明，T对偶正则化使中心区域潮汐力有限，并产生不同的拉伸和压缩区域，包括径向和角向同时压缩的区域，而电荷会改变这些潮汐特征的强度和位置。最后分析两组初始条件下测地线偏离矢量的演化，发现T对偶标度和电荷倾向于抑制累积的径向拉伸，而角向形变对电荷较不敏感；同时验证了相应的经典极限。

English: In this work, we investigate the geodesic dynamics and tidal force effects in neutral and electrically charged regular spacetimes inspired by T-duality. We first analyze the geometric properties of these solutions, including their regular central structure and horizon configurations, and show how the interplay between the T-duality scale $\ell_0$ and the electric charge $Q$ determines the transition between black hole and horizonless geometries. We then study the motion of massive and massless particles through the corresponding effective potentials, examining the existence and stability of circular orbits and the behavior of their characteristic radii. We further investigate the tidal forces experienced by observers in radial free fall, focusing on the behavior of the radial and angular components, their extrema and sign changes, and the location of these characteristic points relative to the horizon structure of the geometry. We show that the T-duality regularization renders the tidal forces finite in the central region and gives rise to different stretching and compression regimes, including a region of simultaneous compression in both the radial and angular directions, while the electric charge modifies the strength and location of these tidal features. Finally, we analyze the evolution of the geodesic deviation vector for two sets of initial conditions. We find that both the T-duality scale and the electric charge tend to suppress the accumulated radial stretching, whereas the angular deformation is considerably less sensitive to the charge. These results show how the quantum regularization induced by T-duality and the presence of electric charge modify the orbital dynamics and tidal response of these geometries in the strong-field regime. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the corresponding classical limits are recovered appropriately.

一句话导读：研究T对偶正则化黑洞时空中的测地线、圆轨道稳定性、潮汐力及测地线偏离，并分析T对偶标度和电荷的影响。

最小修改引力中的 Genesis 场景

Genesis in Minimally Modified Gravity

Alexander Ganz, Paul Martens, Shinji Mukohyama, Pavel Petrov · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文在 type-II 最小修改引力框架内构造 Genesis 场景。背景解在过去测地完备，并在渐近过去趋近 Minkowski；Hubble 膨胀率增长，而物质部门满足零能条件。标量扰动无鬼且无紫外梯度不稳定性，尽管声速平方 c_R^2 在有限时间段的有限红外傅里叶区域为负。数值演化（含超视界增长）在较宽参数空间给出近尺度不变、略红倾的标量谱；张量谱为蓝谱且张标比受强抑制。最后，利用渐近归一化正规的物质涨落 δχ，发现远过去固定非零动量下依赖背景的三次耦合消失，剩余的物质-引力子与引力子自相互作用受 Planck 压低。

English: We construct a Genesis scenario within the framework of a type-II minimally modified gravity. The background solution is past geodesically complete and approaches Minkowski spacetime in the asymptotic past. While the Hubble expansion rate grows, the matter sector satisfies the null-energy condition. Scalar perturbations are ghost-free and have no ultraviolet gradient instability, although the squared sound speed $c_\mathcal{R}^2$ becomes negative within a finite infrared region in the Fourier space for a finite time interval. Numerical evolution, including superhorizon growth, yields a nearly scale-invariant, slightly red-tilted scalar spectrum over a broad region of parameter space. The tensor spectrum is blue, with a strongly suppressed tensor-to-scalar ratio. Finally, using the matter fluctuation $\delta\chi$, whose asymptotic normalization is regular, we find that the background-dependent cubic couplings vanish in the far past at fixed nonzero momenta. The surviving matter--graviton and graviton self-interactions are Planck suppressed.

一句话导读：构建过去测地完备的最小修改引力 Genesis，并显示标量谱近尺度不变、张量谱蓝且张标比受抑制。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

f(Q)引力常Q分支中的真实中子星

Realistic neutron stars in the constant-Q branch of f(Q) gravity

Debadri Bhattacharjee, Pradip Kumar Chattopadhyay, P. H. R. S. Moraes · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文研究对称远平行引力中由非度规标量Q中介的中子星流体静力学平衡与整体结构。作者在度规-仿射表述下采用f(Q)引力的正则常Q分支（Q=Q_*），该分支在星体中心保持正则性，同时通过f(Q_*)及其导数保留非线性函数形式的显式依赖。文章提出三种新的非线性f(Q)扩展：(i) Born-Infeld启发模型，(ii) Hu-Sawicki类比模型，(iii) Tsujikawa启发模型。结合GPPVA(DD2)和SLy4等现实统一物态方程，数值求解修正的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，并用Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov判据评估恒星稳定性。Born-Infeld和Hu-Sawicki类比模型随控制参数增大平滑恢复广义相对论极限，对低质量天体（M<2.0 M_太阳）给出的半径与X射线双星和GW170817观测约束相符；但其最大质量仍低于2.43 M_太阳（DD2）和2.06 M_太阳（SLy4）。相反，Tsujikawa启发模型显著硬化有效引力耦合，可容纳高达约3.36 M_太阳的大质量致密天体，并为GW190814中2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08} M_太阳的次级天体提供可行物理起源，但代价是高估典型低质量中子星的半径。这些对比行为展示了常Q框架内最大质量与半径约束之间的现象学互补性，并凸显多信使观测在约束非线性非度规引力中的作用。

English: We investigate the hydrostatic equilibrium and global structure of neutron stars within symmetric teleparallel gravity, where gravitational interactions are mediated by the non-metricity scalar $Q$. Working within the metric-affine formulation, we adopt the regular, constant-$Q$ branch ($Q = Q_*$) of $f(Q)$ gravity, which preserves regularity at the stellar centre while maintaining explicit dependence on the non-linear functional form through $f(Q_*)$ and its derivatives. We propose three novel non-linear $f(Q)$ extensions: (i) a Born-Infeld-inspired model, (ii) a Hu--Sawicki analogue, and (iii) a Tsujikawa-inspired model. Incorporating state-of-the-art realistic unified equations of state, namely GPPVA(DD2) and SLy4, we numerically solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations and evaluate stellar stability via the Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov criterion. The Born-Infeld and Hu-Sawicki analogues smoothly recover the general relativistic limit as their control parameters increase, predicting stellar radii for low-mass objects ($M < 2.0\,M_\odot$) that match observational constraints from X-ray binaries and GW170817; however, their maximum masses remain capped below $2.43\,M_\odot$ (DD2) and $2.06\,M_\odot$ (SLy4). Conversely, the Tsujikawa-inspired model significantly stiffens the effective gravitational coupling, accommodating massive compact objects up to $\sim 3.36\,M_\odot$ and offering a viable physical origin for the $2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08}\,M_\odot$ secondary object in GW190814, albeit at the expense of overpredicting radii for typical low-mass neutron stars. These contrasting behaviours demonstrate a key phenomenological complementarity between maximum mass and radius bounds within the constant-$Q$ framework, highlighting the utility of multimessenger observations in constraining non-linear non-metricity gravity.

一句话导读：在f(Q)引力常Q分支中，用真实物态方程求解修正TOV方程，比较三种非线性模型对中子星质量、半径和稳定性的预言。

Improved constraints on higher-derivative effective field theory extensions of general relativity with GW230627_015337

Tao Zhu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：双黑洞引力波观测是强场区检验广义相对论（GR）的有力手段。在 GR 的有效场论（EFT）扩展中，高阶曲率算符会修改双星动力学，并对旋近相位引入修正。本文考虑两个宇称偶的三次曲率耦合和一个四次曲率耦合，其领头相位修正分别进入 5PN、6PN 和 8PN 阶。我们利用灵活的理论无关框架，将这些修正纳入 SEOBNRv5HM_ROM 波形的各个多极中，从而在分析中可使用高阶模和完整的旋近-并合-铃宕信号。我们首先对公共 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 目录中从 273 个母样本选出的 92 个双黑洞事件进行 Fisher 矩阵分析。GW230627_015337 对三个 EFT 耦合给出最紧的预报约束，因此被选作完整贝叶斯分析。后验分布与 GR 一致，三个耦合在 90% 可信度下均与零一致。相应特征长度尺度的单侧 90% 上限为 17.1、11.1 和 18.3 km。三个 EFT 模型相对 GR 的对数贝叶斯因子范围为 -5.49 到 -2.51，在所采用先验下支持 GR。这些界限在 10–20 km 量级探测高阶曲率长度尺度，数值上比代表性先前旋近和铃宕约束更紧，但应考虑模型和分析假设的差异。

English: Gravitational-wave (GW) observations of binary black holes provide a powerful probe of general relativity (GR) in the strong-field regime. In effective field theory (EFT) extensions of GR, higher-curvature operators modify the binary dynamics and introduce corrections to the inspiral phase. In this work, we consider two parity-even cubic-curvature couplings and one quartic-curvature coupling, whose leading phase corrections enter at 5PN, 6PN, and 8PN order, respectively. We incorporate these corrections into the individual multipoles of the \texttt{SEOBNRv5HM\_ROM} waveform using the flexible theory-independent framework, allowing higher-order modes and the full inspiral-merger-ringdown signal to be used in the analysis. We first perform a Fisher-matrix analysis of 92 binary-black-hole events selected from a parent sample of 273 events in the public LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA catalogs. GW230627\_015337 provides the tightest forecast constraints on all three EFT couplings and is therefore selected for a full Bayesian analysis. The posterior distributions are consistent with GR, with all three couplings consistent with zero at 90\% credibility. The corresponding one-sided 90\% upper limits on the characteristic length scales are \(17.1\), \(11.1\), and \(18.3\,\mathrm{km}\). The log Bayes factors of the three EFT models relative to GR range from \(-5.49\) to \(-2.51\), favoring GR under the adopted priors. These bounds probe higher-curvature length scales at the level of \(10\)--\(20\,\mathrm{km}\) and are numerically tighter than representative previous inspiral and ringdown constraints, although differences in the models and analysis assumptions should be taken into account.

一句话导读：用 GW230627_015337 对 GR 的高阶曲率 EFT 耦合做全贝叶斯分析，结果与 GR 一致并给出 10–20 km 级长度尺度上限。

相关度：high — 论文直接检验广义相对论并约束高阶曲率 EFT，属于用户标注的经典引力/广义相对论支线；但不涉及全息。

论视界面积定律检验的解释

On the Interpretation of Tests of the Horizon Area Law

Selma Vangstein, Christopher J. Moore · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：本文研究引力波对视界面积定律的检验。尽管这些检验为广义相对论提供了显著的一致性检验，但它们依赖假设广义相对论的模型，因此其解释本质上依赖于模型。我们通过合并玻色星的模拟给出一个具体例子，表明奇异致密天体可以模仿合并黑洞，并在没有事件视界的情况下以高达约92%的置信度通过面积定律检验。

English: This Letter investigates gravitational-wave tests of the horizon area law. Although they provide a striking consistency check of general relativity (GR), these tests rely on models that assume GR, making their interpretation inherently model dependent. We show with a specific example---simulations of merging boson stars---that exotic compact objects can mimic merging black holes and pass an area-law test at a confidence as high as $\sim 92\%$ despite not even having event horizons.

一句话导读：合并玻色星模拟表明，无事件视界的奇异致密天体可模仿黑洞并以高置信度通过视界面积定律引力波检验，揭示此类检验的模型依赖性。

利用暗标准汽笛对引力波摩擦的高斯过程重构

A gaussian-process reconstruction of gravitational-wave friction from dark standard sirens

Michele Mancarella, Viola De Renzis, Alessandro Agapito · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-28

中文摘要：标准汽笛提供了宇宙距离-红移关系的直接探针，因而可强有力地检验引力波在宇宙学尺度上是否按广义相对论预言传播。在广义相对论的许多扩展中，引力波传播被反常摩擦项修正，改变振幅演化，并导致引力波光度距离不同于电磁对应体。本文从暗标准汽笛出发，对反常摩擦进行非参数重构。我们用高斯过程重构编码在摩擦函数 α_M(z) 中的红移依赖，并通过积分得到相应的引力波与电磁光度距离比 Ξ(z)，显式保留局域摩擦修正与其对观测距离累积效应之间的关系，同时强制引力波光度距离单调且可逆。我们将方法应用于 GWTC-5.0 目录，联合推断源族群、修改传播和背景宇宙学参数。未发现偏离广义相对论的证据，在所探测红移范围内 α_M=0 和 Ξ=1 与后验一致。结果在 GP 核、平滑度和振幅先验、分辨率方案及似然处理变化下稳定。我们进一步引入函数空间诊断，用于比较灵活重构与参数化重构，包括先验校准、先验到后验收缩、传播-族群简并的常见汇总以及主成分分析。这些工具明确了哪些特征由数据约束、哪些由函数空间先验施加，为可解释的引力波传播非参数检验提供框架。

English: Standard sirens provide a direct probe of the cosmic distance-redshift relation and therefore a powerful test of whether gravitational waves (GWs) propagate as predicted by general relativity on cosmological scales. In many extensions of general relativity, GW propagation is modified by an anomalous friction term, which alters the amplitude evolution and leads to a GW luminosity distance that differs from its electromagnetic counterpart. In this work, we develop a non-parametric reconstruction of this anomalous friction from dark standard sirens. We reconstruct its redshift dependence, encoded in the friction function $\alpha_M(z)$, with a Gaussian process (GP) and derive the corresponding GW-to-EM luminosity-distance ratio $\Xi(z)$ by integration, explicitly retaining the relation between the local friction modification and its accumulated effect on the observed distance, while enforcing a monotonic and invertible GW luminosity distance. We apply the method to the GWTC-5.0 catalog, jointly inferring the source population, modified propagation, and background cosmological parameters. We find no evidence for departures from GR, with $\alpha_M=0$ and $\Xi=1$ consistent with the posterior over the redshift range probed by the catalog. The result is stable under variations of the GP kernel, smoothness and amplitude priors, resolution prescription, and likelihood treatment. We further introduce function-space diagnostics for comparing flexible and parametric reconstructions, including prior calibration, prior-to-posterior contraction, common summaries of propagation-population degeneracies, and principal-component analysis. These tools make explicit which features are informed by the data and which are imposed by the function-space prior, providing a framework for interpretable non-parametric tests of gravitational-wave propagation.

一句话导读：用高斯过程从暗标准汽笛重构引力波传播摩擦函数，并在 GWTC-5.0 中未发现偏离广义相对论的证据。

相关度：low — 该文研究宇宙学尺度上的引力波传播与修改引力检验，不属于 AdS/CFT 或全息框架；仅与经典引力/广义相对论标签有间接关联。

Taub-NUT 作为带挠率的引力双荷子

Taub-NUT as gravitational dyon with torsion

Dmitri Gal'tsov, Rostom Karsanov · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们证明 Taub-NUT 度规的 Levi-Civita 联络在 Misner 弦上奇异，并产生含 delta 函数平方的 Einstein 张量。引入挠率可改进这一点，使 Einstein 张量可解释为具有负可变张力的宇宙弦；Misner 弦中的 Komar 流由挠率产生，因此挠率决定渐近 Komar 荷。于是 Taub-NUT 度规表现为由两束自旋流体支撑的孤子。

English: We show that the Levi-Civita connection for the Taub-NUT metric is singular on Misner strings and generates an Einstein tensor containing the squares of the delta function. This can be improved by introducing torsion, in which case the Einstein tensor may be interpreted as that of a cosmic string with negative variable tension. Komar flows in Misner strings are generated by torsion, which is therefore responsible for the asymptotic Komar charges. The Taub-NUT metric then appears as a soliton supported by two spin-fluid beams.

一句话导读：通过引入挠率正则化 Misner 弦奇异性，将 Taub-NUT 解释为带宇宙弦/自旋流体支撑的引力双荷子孤子。

相关度：medium — 论文主要研究 Taub-NUT 精确解、挠率与 Misner 弦，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；但不涉及全息、量子信息或其余全息凝聚态支线，因此总体相关性为中等。

关于环面 ALE 与 ALF 引力瞬子的存在性

On the existence of toric ALE and ALF gravitational instantons

Hari K. Kunduri, James Lucietti · math.DG, gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们建立了渐近局部欧氏（ALE）和渐近局部平坦（ALF）引力瞬子的存在性与唯一性结果。特别地，我们证明对每一个容许的杆结构，存在唯一的、Ricci 平坦的、环面 ALE 和 ALF 引力瞬子，其光滑至多可能有锥奇点。我们还给出一个初等证明：任何环面 ALE 或 ALF 自对偶瞬子都是多 Eguchi-Hanson 或多 Taub-NUT 解。

English: We establish existence and uniqueness results for asymptotically locally Euclidean (ALE) and asymptotically locally flat (ALF) gravitational instantons. In particular, we prove the existence of a unique, Ricci-flat, toric ALE and ALF gravitational instanton, for every admissible rod structure, that is smooth up to possible conical singularites. We also give an elementary proof that any toric ALE or ALF self-dual instanton is a multi-Eguchi-Hanson or multi-Taub-NUT solution.

一句话导读：证明每类容许杆结构对应唯一 Ricci 平坦环面 ALE/ALF 引力瞬子，并将环面自对偶瞬子分类为多 Eguchi-Hanson 或多 Taub-NUT 解。

第三体对双中子星潮汐相互作用的影响

Impact of a third body on binary neutron star tidal interactions

Meet Khatri, Ankur Renduchintala, Sayak Datta, Sajal Mukherjee · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：为模拟致密双星并合，通常假设双星在孤立环境中演化。本文放宽这一假设，引入一个遥远的第三体，并研究第三体如何影响双星演化。作者以微扰方式处理该问题，研究第三体存在时双星中的潮汐相互作用；对控制轨道运动的方程以及双星分量四极矩的演化方程引入适当修正，并计算辐射能量与累积相位亏损。结果表明，对于极端质量比旋近，这些效应不显著；但对于中等质量比旋近等双星，这些效应更为相关，在某些情形下累积相位亏损可达 O(1) 弧度。

English: To model a compact binary coalescence, it is commonly assumed that the binary evolves in isolation. In the present work, we relax this assumption by introducing a distant third body and investigate how the third body would affect the binary evolution. We treat this problem perturbatively and study tidal interaction in the binary due to the third body's presence. We introduce appropriate modifications to the equations governing the orbital motions and the evolution equations of the binary component's quadrupole moment. We compute the radiated energy and accumulated dephasing for the binary. Our findings indicate that for extreme-mass-ratio inspirals, these effects would not be significant. However, for binaries such as intermediate-mass-ratio inspirals, these effects are more relevant, and in some scenarios the accumulated dephasing can reach up to $\mathcal{O}(1)$ radians.

一句话导读：研究遥远第三体对双中子星潮汐相互作用、轨道演化与累积相位亏损的微扰影响。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力与致密双星天体物理，涉及潮汐和轨道演化，可归入经典引力支线；但与全息对偶无直接关系。

中文摘要：我们利用Advanced LIGO O4a数据集并结合此前的O1、O2和O3（LIGO-Virgo）数据，搜索早期宇宙各种过程产生的引力波背景信号。未探测到信号使我们可以对基础物理给出强约束。我们由O1-O4a数据得到引力波背景能量密度上限，用以约束早期宇宙中多种可能过程的参数：一阶相变、宇宙弦、畴壁、硬状态方程、轴子暴胀、二阶标量扰动、原初黑洞双星和宇称破坏。分析中还考虑了宇宙中致密（黑洞和中子星）双星并合产生的天体物理背景。我们讨论所获参数约束对各类宇宙学和高能物理模型的意义，并结论LIGO-Virgo数据已对众多早期宇宙情景给出显著约束。

English: We search for gravitational-wave background signals produced by various early Universe processes in the Advanced LIGO O4a dataset, combined with the data from the earlier O1, O2, and O3 (LIGO-Virgo) runs. The absence of detectable signals enables powerful constraints on fundamental physics. We derive gravitational-wave background energy density upper limits from the O1-O4a data to constrain parameters associated with various possible processes in the early Universe: first-order phase transitions, cosmic strings, domain walls, stiff equation of state, axion inflation, second-order scalar perturbations, primordial black hole binaries, and parity violation. In our analyses, the presence of an astrophysical background produced by compact (black hole and neutron star) binary coalescences throughout the Universe is also considered. We address the implications for various cosmological and high energy physics models based on the obtained parameter constraints. We conclude that LIGO-Virgo data already yield significant constraints on numerous early Universe scenarios.

English: We develop a unified thermodynamic and mechanical framework for causal-diamond horizons in Minkowski spacetime. These results show that a coherent horizon-law structure can arise within a causal diamond, a fundamental building block of the causal structure of Minkowski spacetime. 中文摘要：本文研究包裹 $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ 的 M2 膜在 $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ 中的量子化，该构型对偶于 ABJM 理论中的 $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈。此前经典作用量与单圈贡献已被证明可重现规范理论局域化结果；本文将分析推广到两圈阶。在适配的静态与 $\kappa$-对称规范下，世界体作用量不含三阶相互作用顶点，因此两圈修正完全由四阶相互作用决定，并且明显不存在对数紫外发散。作者发现玻色子与费米子贡献组合成一个完全平方 ${\mathscr X}^2$，其中 ${\mathscr X}$ 是玻色子与费米子三维格林函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 $\mathscr X$ 需要固定无质量费米子模的 $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ 边界量子化；在保持超对称所选择的边界条件下，$\mathscr X$ 消失，因此完整两圈修正为零。该结果与将 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于固定 $(N,k)$ 局域化预言的 large-$N$ 展开不相容；相反，它与近期提出的将半经典 M2 膜配分函数匹配到规范理论巨正则系综的提案精确一致，在该系综中 Wilson 圈期望值在微扰意义上单圈精确。两圈修正的消失因此为这一巨正则识别提供了非平凡检验。

English: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. 中文摘要：本文研究超对称伽利略杨-米尔斯（SGYM）的量子动力学，重点考察具有经典标度对称性的三维情形。该理论被认为描述 IIA 型非相对论弦理论中 D2 膜的世界体积理论，并可作为最大超对称（相对论）杨-米尔斯理论的非相对论极限得到。与相对论情形不同，我们发现 SGYM 只在库仑分支上具有微扰动力学激发。我们证明，在三维情形中，经典标度对称性在一圈层次由于对数发散而被破坏，且这些发散无法通过现有耦合的重整化吸收；因此 SGYM 是不可重整化的。然而，我们论证，通过引入额外的边缘形变，原耦合可以被重整化并使理论成为渐近自由的。最后，我们提出三维 SGYM 流向一个强耦合的非相对论 M2 膜理论。

English: We study the quantum dynamics of supersymmetric Galilean Yang-Mills (SGYM), with a focus on three dimensions where there is a classical scale symmetry. This is believed to be the worldvolume theory describing D2-branes within type IIA non-relativistic string theory and arises as a non-relativistic limit of maximally supersymmetric (relativistic) Yang-Mills. Unlike the relativistic case, we find that SGYM only admits perturbative dynamical excitations on the Coulomb branch. We show that in three dimensions the classical scale symmetry is broken at one-loop due to logarithmic divergences which cannot be absorbed by renormalization of existing couplings. As such we find that SGYM is non-renormalizable. However, we argue that by including additional marginal deformations the original coupling can be renormalized and rendered asymptotically free. Finally, we propose that three-dimensional SGYM flows to a strongly coupled non-relativistic M2-brane theory.

一句话导读：研究三维超对称伽利略杨-米尔斯的单圈标度反常、不可重整化性及通过边缘形变实现渐近自由并流向非相对论 M2 膜理论的可能性。

dS_4 晚期边界上的离散系列规范场

A discrete series gauge field at the late-time boundary of $dS_4$

Manizheh Botshekananfard, Elif B\"u\c{s}ra G\"uraks{\i}n, Vasileios A. Letsios, Gizem \c{S}eng\"or · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文研究四维 de Sitter 时空平面片上的自由 Maxwell 场。作者回顾了 Bunch-Davies 真空中的体正则量子化，并通过单粒子态在无穷小 dS 变换下的变换性质给出表示论视角。取晚期极限后，识别出标度维 Δ=1（领头）和 Δ=2（次领头）的两个晚期算符。作者引入在 dS 群 SO(4,1) 下不变、受 CFT 启发的内积，用于晚期算符作用于 Bunch-Davies 真空所产生的态。文中说明与光子相关的 SO(4,1) 酉离散系列表示如何由这两个算符共同提供，并与 AdS 上 Δ=1 算符对应非归一化模式的情形相对照。作者还说明 SO(4,1) 的相应离散系列表示如何分解为螺旋度 +1 和 -1 两个表示的直和，这是利用光子场强自对偶与反自对偶部分的 dS 不变性实现的。展望中，作者受近期关于 dS_4 高自旋引力微观描述（三维共形规范场起核心作用）的提议启发，探讨 Δ=1 晚期算符与三维共形自旋-1 规范场之间可能联系。

English: We study the free Maxwell field on the planar patch of four-dimensional de Sitter spacetime ($dS_4$). We review its bulk canonical quantization in the Bunch-Davies vacuum, and we give a representation-theoretic viewpoint by studying the transformation properties of single-particle states under infinitesimal dS transformations. By taking the late-time limit, we identify two late-time operators with scaling dimensions $\Delta=1$ (leading) and $\Delta=2$ (subleading). We introduce CFT-inspired inner products invariant under the dS group ($SO(4,1)$) for states created by late-time operators acting on the Bunch-Davies vacuum. We explain how the unitary discrete series representations of $SO(4,1)$ associated with the photon are furnished by both operators, in contrast with the Maxwell field on $AdS$ where the $\Delta=1$ operator corresponds to a non-normalizable mode. We also explain how the corresponding discrete series representations of $SO(4,1)$ split into a direct sum of representations corresponding to two helicities $+1$ and $-1$. This is achieved by taking advantage of the dS invariance of the self-dual and anti-self-dual sectors of the photon field strength. In our outlook, we draw inspiration from a recent proposal for the microscopic description of $dS_4$ higher-spin gravity where conformal gauge fields in 3 dimensions play a central role, and we investigate a possible connection of the $\Delta=1$ late-time operator with a conformal spin-1 gauge field in 3 dimensions.

一句话导读：研究 dS_4 中自由 Maxwell 场的晚期边界算符及其 SO(4,1) 离散系列表示，并探讨与三维共形规范场的可能联系。

二维有效膨胀引力中的黑洞热力学与KK光子量子修正

Black hole thermodynamics and KK photon quantum corrections in 2D effective dilaton gravity

Yoshihiko Abe, Tetsutaro Higaki, Yu Miyauchi · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们利用四维Einstein-Maxwell理论维数约化得到的二维有效理论研究黑洞热力学。对于球对称带电黑洞，所得膨胀引力具有非线性势，能够重现四维AdS黑洞的半经典相结构，包括Hawking-Page相变以及小/大Reissner-Nordström-AdS黑洞相变。这表明，在取近视界和近极端极限之前，该二维理论捕捉到了超出Jackiw-Teitelboim引力范围的非极端热力学。我们还把内部球面上的电磁Kaluza-Klein模式纳入，并将其积掉以推导单圈有效膨胀引力。在导数展开的领头阶，这些修正表现为黑洞熵和膨胀势中有效电荷参数的常数移动。因此，在此领头局域近似内，半经典相结构不会被定性改变。

English: We study black hole thermodynamics using a two-dimensional effective theory obtained by dimensional reduction of four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory. For spherically symmetric charged black holes, the resulting dilaton gravity has a nonlinear potential that reproduces the semiclassical phase structure of four-dimensional AdS black holes, including the Hawking--Page transition and the small/large Reissner--Nordstr\"{o}m--AdS black hole transition. This shows that the two-dimensional theory before taking the near-horizon and near-extremal limits captures non-extremal thermodynamics beyond the Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity regime. We also include electromagnetic Kaluza--Klein modes on the internal sphere and integrate them out to derive the one-loop effective dilaton gravity. At leading order in the derivative expansion, these corrections appear as constant shifts in the black hole entropy and in the effective charge parameter of the dilaton potential. Therefore, the semiclassical phase structure is not qualitatively modified within this leading local approximation.

一句话导读：将四维Einstein-Maxwell球对称黑洞约化为二维膨胀引力，并计算KK光子单圈修正对黑洞热力学与相结构的影响。

Twirled 完美张量网络：计算协变的全息张量网络

Twirled Perfect Tensor Networks: Computationally covariant holographic tensor networks

Gurbir Arora, Matthew Headrick, Albion Lawrence, Martin Sasieta, Brian Swingle, Connor Wolfe · hep-th, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们定义了一类新的张量网络，其动机来自黑洞内部局域张量网络模型中的 Python's Lunch 猜想（PLC）。我们从以下观察出发：对于具有短程关联的扩展黑膜态，PLC 预言的复杂度低于一般短程关联态的上界。我们认为 PLC 对建模引力的相关张量网络的精细结构作了隐含假设，使其成为非一般的。我们在 python's lunch 的随机张量网络模型中明确展示了这一点：指数复杂度通常并不由 PLC 指数控制。我们将与 PLC 的差异追溯到随机张量网络缺乏“计算协变性”：虽然 PLC 的动机是在遵循某些基本规则时能够将空间任意分解为低复杂度单元，但我们表明随机张量网络一般不具有这一性质。我们提出另一类由我们称为“twirled perfect tensors”构建的张量网络，它确实满足计算协变性，并且复杂度被 PLC 值所界定。我们仍然发现来自局域后选择的离散限制，而这在引力中似乎不存在。此外，我们表明这类张量网络结合了完美张量网络和随机张量网络的可取全息特征，例如，它对任意边界子区域服从格点 Ryu-Takayanagi 公式。尽管受全息启发，这些张量网络提供了一个灵活的框架，可能在量子引力之外也有应用。

English: We define a novel class of tensor networks motivated by the Python's Lunch Conjecture (PLC) in local tensor network models of the black hole interior. We start from the observation that, for extended black brane states with short-range correlations, the PLC predicts a complexity that is smaller than the upper bound for generic short-range correlated states. We argue that the PLC makes implicit assumptions about the fine structure of the relevant tensor networks modeling gravity that render them non-generic. We demonstrate this explicitly in random tensor network models of the python's lunch, where the exponential complexity is not generally controlled by the PLC exponent. We trace the difference with the PLC to a lack of "computational covariance" in random tensor networks: while the PLC is motivated by an ability to arbitrarily decompose space into low-complexity units provided certain basic rules are followed, we show that random tensor networks do not generically have this property. We propose another class of tensor networks built from what we call "twirled perfect tensors" that do satisfy the computational covariance property and have a complexity bounded by the PLC value. We still find a discrete limitation from local postselection that appears to be absent in gravity. Moreover, we show that this class of tensor networks combines desirable holographic features of perfect tensor networks and random tensor networks, for example, it obeys a lattice Ryu-Takayanagi formula for arbitrary boundary subregions. Though motivated by holography, these tensor networks provide a flexible framework with potential applications beyond quantum gravity.

一句话导读：提出 twirled perfect tensor networks，以满足计算协变性并给出受 Python's Lunch 猜想界定的复杂度，同时具有格点 RT 公式等全息特征。

体相移与奇点

Bulk Phase Shift and Singularity

Yueke Jia, Manuela Kulaxizi · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：固定碰撞参数下，轻粒子被黑洞高能散射由 eikonal 相位描述，该相位编码相应的时间延迟与角偏转。这种体相移可全息解释为 CFT 中标量算符在 Regge 极限下的热动量空间两点函数。在小碰撞参数处，相移获得虚部，表示非弹性散射，使时间延迟与偏转成为复值并模糊其解释。然而在全息 CFT 中，这些量也可从位置空间热关联子的所谓 bulk-cone 奇点中提取。将这一分析推广到小碰撞参数，我们发现位置空间关联子恰在一条零测地线从黑洞奇点反射并到达对侧边界时出现奇点。这通过位置空间关联子的奇点，为体时间延迟与角偏转提供了更稳健的识别。

English: High-energy scattering of a light particle off a black hole at fixed impact parameter is described by an eikonal phase, which encodes the resulting time delay and angular deflection. This bulk phase shift admits a holographic interpretation as of the thermal momentum-space two-point function of a scalar operator in the CFT in the Regge limit. At small impact parameter, the phase shift acquires an imaginary part signaling inelastic scattering, obscuring the interpretation of time delay and deflection which become complex-valued. However, in a holographic CFT these quantities can also be extracted from the so called bulk-cone singularities of the position space thermal correlator. Extending this analysis to small impact parameters, we find that the position-space correlator develops a singularity precisely when a null geodesic reflects off the black hole singularity and reaches the opposite boundary. This provides a more robust identification of bulk time delay and angular deflection through singularities of position-space correlators.

一句话导读：通过位置空间热关联子的 bulk-cone 奇点，在小碰撞参数下更稳健地提取黑洞散射的体时间延迟与角偏转。
