类时纠缠熵与重整化群流不可逆性

Timelike Entanglement Entropy and Renormalization Group Flow Irreversibility

Dimitrios Giataganas · hep-th, cond-mat.stat-mech, cond-mat.str-el · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们研究基于类时纠缠熵的全息 c-定理，并表明类时 c-函数能够刻画不可逆的重整化群（RG）流。我们证明类时 c-函数适用于相对论与非相对论量子物质，包括破缺旋转对称性的向列相，并且在明确的几何条件下沿全息各向异性 RG 流保持单调，从而通过了一些最严格的一致性检验。我们推导了一般均匀各向异性几何中复合类时 c-函数的精确流动，并建立绝热流的 c-定理。在考察的所有标度背景类别中，与零能条件及热力学稳定性一致，单调性条件普遍约化为对跑动几何有效维度的约束。我们进一步仅由类时纠缠熵的虚部构造第二个 c-函数，并在局部有效维度条件下证明其单调性，而不要求绝热性。对于庞加莱不变流，该条件直接由零能条件推出。此外，我们给出类时 c-函数变化率的几何上界，它限制了有效自由度被粗粒化的速度。我们的结果表明，刻画非相对论流中的 RG 不可逆性需要本质上对时间方向敏感的观测量。因此，全息 c-定理的适用范围被推广到高度非平凡的 RG 流，并指向一种新的全息 RG 动力学信息论诊断。

English: We study holographic $c$-theorems based on timelike entanglement entropy and show that timelike $c$-functions capture irreversible renormalization group (RG) flow. We demonstrate that timelike $c$-functions are applicable to both relativistic and nonrelativistic quantum matter in nematic phases with broken rotational symmetry, and that they remain monotonic along holographic anisotropic RG flows under explicit geometric conditions, thereby passing some of the most stringent consistency tests. We derive the exact flow of the composite timelike $c$-function in general homogeneous anisotropic geometries and establish the $c$-theorem for adiabatic flows. Across all classes of scaling backgrounds examined, consistent with the null energy condition and thermodynamic stability, the monotonicity condition universally reduces to a constraint on a running geometric effective dimension. We further construct a second $c$-function purely from the imaginary part of the timelike entanglement entropy and prove its monotonicity under the local effective-dimension condition, without requiring adiabaticity. For Poincar\'e-invariant flows, this condition follows directly from the null energy condition. Moreover, we identify a geometric upper bound on the rate of change of the timelike $c$-functions, which constrains how rapidly effective degrees of freedom can be coarse-grained. Our results suggest that capturing RG irreversibility in nonrelativistic flows requires observables that are intrinsically sensitive to the temporal direction. The applicability of holographic $c$-theorems is thus extended to highly nontrivial RG flows and points toward a new information-theoretic diagnostic of holographic RG dynamics.

一句话导读：基于类时纠缠熵构造全息 c-函数，证明其沿各向异性 RG 流单调，并把不可逆性归结为对跑动有效维度的约束。

中文摘要：研究带电黑洞双星在旋近阶段的动力学及其引力波辐射。在后牛顿框架内，结合有效场论与经典方法，推导至二阶（2PN）的保守与耗散动力学。计算NNLO保守拉格朗日量、谐和规范与Lorenz规范下的领头阶耗散效应，并给出运动方程、质心变换以及ADM型坐标中的拉格朗日量与哈密顿量。还得到束缚能、准圆轨道近星点进动和无束缚轨道散射角的规范不变表达式。结果扩展了先前分析，并与近期后闵可夫斯基结果完全一致。

English: We study the dynamics of electrically charged black-hole binaries and their gravitational-wave emission during the inspiral phase. Within the post-Newtonian framework, we derive the conservative and dissipative dynamics up to second order (2PN), combining Effective Field Theory and classical methods. We compute the NNLO conservative Lagrangian, LO dissipative effects in harmonic and Lorenz gauges, and provide the equations of motion, center-of-mass transformations, and the Lagrangian/Hamiltonian in ADM-type coordinates. We also obtain gauge-invariant expressions for the binding energy, periastron advance in quasi-circular orbits, and the scattering angle in unbound orbits. Our results extend previous analyses and are fully consistent with recent post-Minkowskian findings.

全息类时c函数

Holographic Timelike c-function

Dimitrios Giataganas · hep-th, cond-mat.stat-mech · v3 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：在庞加莱不变理论中，沿重整化群（RG）流积分掉高能自由度由单调c函数刻画，全息c函数已利用纠缠熵构造。然而，在洛伦兹不变性破缺的理论中，这些构造通常失效，既反映纠缠RG单调性的破坏，也反映其在刻画非相对论RG流本质特征方面的局限性。由于许多量子多体系统缺乏洛伦兹不变性，找到一个能刻画这些流中有效自由度减少的量很重要。本文证明，最近引入的全息类时纠缠熵自然给出一个适用于所有这些理论的新c函数，且其变化率满足几何上界。作者进一步在具有Lifshitz和hyperscaling破坏不动点的理论中证明该c函数的存在，并表明在满足零能条件、热力学稳定性以及流的显式几何条件时，它满足预期的RG单调性。

English: The integration of high-energy degrees of freedom along the renormalization group (RG) flow in Poincar\'e-invariant theories is captured by a monotonic c-function. For such theories, holographic c-functions have been constructed using entanglement entropy. However, in theories with broken Lorentz invariance, these constructions generally fail, reflecting both the violation of entanglement RG monotonicity and its limitations in capturing essential features of nonrelativistic RG flows. Since many quantum many-body systems lack Lorentz invariance, it is important to identify a quantity that captures the decrease of effective degrees of freedom along such flows. We show that the recently introduced holographic timelike entanglement entropy naturally gives rise to a new c-function applicable to all such theories, which moreover obeys a geometric upper bound on its rate of change. We further demonstrate the existence of this c-function in theories with Lifshitz and hyperscaling-violating fixed points, showing that, provided the null energy condition, thermodynamic stability and explicit geometric conditions on the flow are satisfied, it obeys the expected RG monotonicity.

中文摘要：我们通过将Schwarzschild外部与它的最小几何变形解拼接，构造反射不对称薄壳虫洞；两者共享相同质量和红移函数，因此不对称性完全由引力解耦部分承载。变形侧是由标量场耦合非线性电动力学所源的黑洞，取实标量分支。我们证明壳与体的总径向零能量满足精确恒等式，并在变形足够强时变为正。跨壳动量通量等于体的径向零能量密度，保留它可得到闭式线性稳定性条件。我们证明，采用常规壳响应时稳定性要求喉部体违反径向零能量条件；而变形扩大了稳定域，并将转变半径移入光子球内。对于基于Kerr的稳态延拓，结条件可在自旋中精确求解，从而确定角动量如何在壳与体之间分配，以及壳在何处表现为旋转流体。自由进动模型给出了喉部引力波信号的估计。

English: We construct reflection-asymmetric thin-shell wormholes by joining a Schwarzschild exterior to its minimal geometric deformation, which shares the same mass and redshift function, so that the asymmetry is carried entirely by the gravitational-decoupling sector. The deformed side is a black hole sourced by a scalar field coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics, in its branch with a real scalar. We show that the total radial null energy of shell and bulk obeys an exact identity and becomes positive for a sufficiently strong deformation. The momentum flux across the shell equals the radial null-energy density of the bulk, and retaining it yields the linear stability condition in closed form. We prove that stability with a conventional shell response requires the bulk to violate the radial null energy condition at the throat; the deformation instead enlarges the stable domain and moves the transition radius inside the photon sphere. For a stationary extension built on Kerr, the junction is solved exactly in the spin, which fixes how the angular momentum is shared between shell and bulk and where the shell behaves as a rotating fluid. A free-precession model provides an estimate of the gravitational-wave signal of the throat.

中文摘要：在明确且具有物理动机的假设下，我们识别出一种从局域到全局的热力学机制，用以组织若干此前互不关联的黑洞不等式。我们首先聚焦渐近平直、静态、球对称黑洞，为多种类 Penrose 不等式提供统一的热力学视角。我们还讨论在渐近 Schwarzschild anti-de Sitter 黑洞/膜中的推广。在全息背景下，这些界意味着对偶场论中归一化热力学量的单调行为。值得注意的是，一个核心的积分不等式可在一般静态平面对称渐近 Schwarzschild AdS 黑洞膜的零能量条件（NEC）下直接建立。我们的目的不是声称对所提出的局域界给出完全一般的证明，而是揭示连接局域热力学约束与全局几何不等式的统一结构视角。在本文考虑的类型之外建立局域界仍是开放问题。

English: Under explicit and physically motivated assumptions, we identify a local-to-global thermodynamic mechanism that organizes several previously disconnected inequalities on black holes. We also discuss the generalizations in asymptotically Schwarzschild anti-de Sitter black holes/branes. In holographic settings, these bounds imply monotonic behavior of normalized thermodynamic quantities in the dual field theory. Notably, one central integrated inequality can be established directly under the NEC in general static planar symmetric asymptotically Schwarzschild anti-de Sitter black branes. Our purpose is not to claim a fully general proof of the proposed local bounds, but to expose a unified structural perspective connecting local thermodynamic constraints to global geometric inequalities. Establishing the local bounds beyond the classes considered here remains an open problem.

Exact spinning wormholes in five dimensions from Toda integrability

中文摘要：本文构造了五维 Einstein-phantom-scalar 系统的一个新精确解，描述连接两个渐近平直区域的旋转虫洞，是等角动量 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的旋转推广。在 cohomogeneity-one 拟设下，径向方程化为可积的 A1⊕A2 Toda 系统，并可得到闭式一般局部解。利用该可积结构可解析施加正则性与渐近平直条件，从而选出由质量、等角动量和标量荷刻画的 3 参数解族。所得时空测地完备、无视界、稳定因果且无曲率奇点。Toda 结构还用于证明虫洞喉的唯一性，并给出固定喉面积下角动量的尖锐上界。文章还证明存在唯一一个相对于在一个渐近端不旋转的静止参考系的能层，而另一端相对于该参考系旋转。在适当标度极限下，标量场消失，解趋近于等角动量极端 Myers-Perry 黑洞的外部区域。

English: We construct a new exact solution to the five-dimensional Einstein-phantom-scalar system that describes a rotating wormhole connecting two asymptotically flat regions. The solution represents a rotating generalization of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole with equal angular momenta. Under the cohomogeneity-one ansatz, we demonstrate that the radial equations reduce to an integrable $A_1\oplus A_2$ Toda system, from which the general local solution can be obtained in closed form. This integrable structure enables us to implement the regularity and asymptotic-flatness conditions analytically, thereby singling out a three-parameter family of solutions characterized by the mass, the equal angular momenta, and the scalar charge. The resulting spacetimes are geodesically complete, horizonless and stably causal, and contain no curvature singularities. The Toda structure further allows us to prove the uniqueness of the wormhole throat and to derive a sharp upper bound on the angular momentum for a fixed throat area. We also establish the existence and uniqueness of an ergosurface with respect to the stationary frame that is nonrotating at one asymptotic end, while the opposite end rotates relative to this frame. In a suitable scaling limit, the scalar field vanishes and the solution approaches the exterior region of the extremal Myers-Perry black hole with equal angular momenta.

带对数修正的带电黑洞的大质量标量拟正规模与准束缚态

Massive Scalar Quasinormal Modes and Quasibound States of Charged Black Holes with Logarithmic corrections

Prosenjit Paul, Rickmoy Samanta · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文研究黑洞度规中的长程变形如何影响中性最小耦合大质量标量场的振荡、囚禁与衰减。所考虑的模型是非线性电动力学产生的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的对数变形，它是 Einstein 引力的精确解并具有有限完成；同一几何也出现在唯象完美流体暗物质模型中。作者分析描述弛豫的拟正规模（QNM）和描述带小视界吸收的囚禁模式的准束缚态（QBS）。结果表明，小标量质量使势垒外移、升高并降低其曲率，一阶 WKB 预言在固定有限多极子和泛音下阻尼减弱。随后用六阶 WKB、全局匹配、适配对数几何的广义 Leaver 方法以及时域演化进行比较，各方法在其有效范围内给出一致的 QNM 估计；全局匹配与 Leaver 对 QBS 也高度一致。进一步的解析估计显示，局部 Padé 近似给出的束缚能误差约 0.04%，而领头 Gamow 隧穿把阻尼低估约 25%。在所采样的 QBS 中，增大标量质量或非线性耦合会增强束缚，但因更强的视界吸收而缩短寿命。最后，通过适当的视界正则化和共同的复径向围道，作者用合适的相对论双线性框架证明了一对独立计算的 QNM-QBS 的正交性。

English: We study how long-range deformations in a black-hole metric affect the oscillation, trapping, and decay of a neutral, minimally coupled massive scalar field. We choose a logarithmic deformation of Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics. It provides an exact solution of Einstein gravity and admits a finite completion. The same geometry also arises in a phenomenological perfect-fluid dark-matter model. In this setup, we analyze both quasinormal modes (QNMs), which describe relaxation, and quasibound states (QBSs), which describe trapped modes with small horizon absorption. We first show that a small scalar mass moves the potential barrier outward, raises it, and reduces its curvature. First-order WKB then predicts weaker damping at every fixed finite multipole and overtone. We then compare several approaches, namely sixth-order WKB, global matching, a generalized Leaver method (adapted to the logarithmic geometry) and time-domain evolution. All methods yield consistent QNM estimates within their ranges of validity. Global matching and Leaver also agree closely for QBSs. Further analytic estimates with a reference trapped state show that a local Pad\'e approximation gives a binding-energy error of about $0.04\%$, while leading Gamow tunnelling underestimates damping by about $25\%$. Across the sampled QBSs, increasing the scalar mass or nonlinear coupling strengthens binding but shortens the lifetime through greater horizon absorption. Finally, using an appropriate horizon regularization and a common complex radial contour, we demonstrate orthogonality of an independently computed QNM-QBS pair using a suitable relativistic bilinear framework.

Einstein-bumblebee 引力中的声学 Schwarzschild 类黑洞及类比霍金辐射

Acoustic Schwarzschild-like black hole and analogous Hawking radiation in Einstein-bumblebee gravity

Chikun Ding, Yuebing Zhou, Yu Shi, Yuehua Xiao, Jiliang Jing · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们利用 Schwarzschild 类时空背景下的 Gross-Pitaevskii 理论，在 Einstein-bumblebee 理论中导出声学 Schwarzschild 类黑洞，并研究其类比霍金辐射。该黑洞具有两类事件视界：一类是引力视界 r_h=2M（黑洞视界），另一类是由调节参数 ξ 和洛伦兹破坏耦合常数 ℓ 决定的内、外声学视界 2M<r_ac-≤4M、r_ac≥4M（dumb hole 视界）。相应的霍金温度 T_h 只依赖于 ℓ，而 T_ac 依赖于 ℓ 和 ξ。dumb hole 温度 T_ac 有最大值 T_acm=T_h/8。考虑从 dumb hole 辐射的标量粒子时，我们发现低频下灰体因子随调节参数 ξ 增大，但随 ℓ 减小；高频下其趋于 1。其能量发射率类似于普朗克黑体谱，并在给定峰值频率 ω_m 处有最大值。能量发射率也随 ξ 增大，但随 ℓ 减小。这种相反的依赖关系是最具实验价值的特点，可直接与真实天体物理黑洞的观测进行比对。

English: We derive an acoustic Schwarzschild-like black hole and study its analogous Hawking radiation in Einstein-bumblebee theory by using Gross-Pitaevskii theory in the background of Schwarzschild-like spacetime. This black hole have two kinds of event horizons: one is the gravitational horizon $r_h=2M$(black hole horizon), the others are the internal and external acoustic horizons $2M<r_{ac-}\leq4M,\;r_{ac}\geq4M$(dumb hole horizon) which depend on the tuning parameter $\xi$ and Lorentz violation coupling constant $\ell$. The corresponding Hawking temperature $T_h$ depends only on $\ell$, however $T_{ac}$ depends on $\ell$ and $\xi$. The dumb hole temperature $T_{ac}$ has a maximum $T_{acm}=T_h/8$. When considering the scalar particles radiating from the dumb hole, we find that in low frequency, the grey-body factor increases with the tuning parameter $\xi$, but decreases with $\ell$. In the high frequency, it approaches to $1$. Its energy emission rate is similar to the Planck's black spectrum where there has a maximum at a given peak frequency $\omega_m$. The energy emission rate also increases with the tuning parameter $\xi$, but decreases with $\ell$. This opposite dependence relationship is the most experimentally valuable feature and can directly benchmark against observations of real astrophysical black holes.

双宇宙体积归一化引力的理论与宇宙学

Theory and Cosmology of Biverse Volume-Normalized Gravity

Siqing Yu · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本论文阐述双宇宙体积归一化引力，这是一种新的经典与量子引力理论框架，为宇宙学常数问题（粒子物理预言的真空能量密度与宇宙学数据暗示值之间约60个数量级的差异）提供了不同寻常的解决方案。文献中存在两个有趣想法：1）使用“体积归一化”作用量泛函，即粒子标准模型与广义相对论的通常作用量除以时空体积，由 Tseytlin 首先提出；2）通过给引力子赋予无鬼大质量势来动态产生真空能量密度。然而二者各有问题：Tseytlin 的尝试受量子圈发散困扰，而大质量引力理论有来源可疑的第二度规张量以及量子强耦合问题。受这两个想法以及弦论中的 AdS/CFT 对应启发，双宇宙体积归一化引力扩展 Tseytlin 的想法，将我们的 (3+1) 维宇宙置于 (4+1) 维体空间的边界上。这一新改编在我们宇宙与另一宇宙时空体积比趋于零的极限下控制大的量子引力圈。无鬼大质量引力随后可无缝纳入：其原本模糊的第二度规张量自然表现为体度规在边界上的拉回，其强耦合问题也得到解决。双宇宙体积归一化引力还与所有已检验的粒子宇宙学模型和宇宙演化一致，并非平凡地预言我们宇宙的张量标量比恰好为零。

English: This dissertation expounds the biverse volume-normalized gravity, a novel theoretical framework of classical and quantum gravity that provides an unusual solution to the cosmological constant problem, the 60-degree-of-magnitude discrepancy between the value of the vacuum energy density in our universe predicted by particle physics and that implied by cosmological data. In the literature, there exist two interesting ideas: 1) to use the "volume-normalized" action functional, the usual action of the particle Standard Model and general relativity but divided by the spacetime volume, first proposed by Tseytlin; 2) to generate the vacuum energy density dynamically by assigning a ghost-free massive potential to the graviton. However, each has a problem: Tseytlin's attempt suffers from diverging quantum loops and the massive gravity theory has a second metric tensor with questionable origin and the quantum strong coupling problem. Inspired by these two ideas, as well as the AdS/CFT correspondence in string theory, the biverse volume-normalized gravity extends Tseytlin's idea by placing our (3+1)-dimensional universe on the boundary of a (4+1)-dimensional bulk space. This new adaptation controls the large quantum gravity loops in the limit of vanishing ratio of the spacetime volume of our universe to that of the other universe. The ghost-free massive gravity can then be seamlessly incorporated, not only that its otherwise nebulous second metric tensor appears naturally as the pullback of the bulk metric on the boundary, but its strong coupling problem also solved. The biverse volume-normalized gravity is also consistent with all tested models of particle cosmology and the evolution of the universe, and nontrivially predicts that the tensor-to-scalar ratio of our universe is exactly zero.

世界线 EFT 被积函数的图算法

Graph-Based Algorithms for Worldline EFT Integrands

Gregor K\"alin, Jungwon Lim · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文提出以图为中心的算法，用于构造和表示世界线有效场论（WEFT）被积函数，将圈图被积函数的拓扑结构与代数结构分离为图-分子对。图编码传播子、世界线源/汇顶点、动量路由、i0 prescription 和固有时依赖，分子只携带最小代数与张量内容。为在固定 post-Minkowskian 阶构造被积函数，作者提出广义 Berends-Giele 构造以减少昂贵的张量收缩；并讨论通过世界线传播子“序列化”和“selfie”子图部分分式恒等式进行化简与规范化，得到最小规范拓扑基。文章还表明图-分子表示自然推广积分族及扇区概念，适用于 IBP 约化：传播子不限于单一主标号，每个扇区有自身最小独立标量积，构成过完备全局族；这可利用扇区对称性减少所需积分扇区并独立优化传播子标号。算法实现在 Rust crate FeynRIR 中，目前可高效计算 WEFT 有效作用量变分、世界线运动方程及（含辐射反作用的）冲量的被积函数。

English: We present novel graph-centered algorithms for the construction and representation of worldline effective field theory (WEFT) integrands that separate the topological and algebraic structure of loop integrands into independent graph-numerator pairs. In this representation, the graph encodes all propagators, worldline source and sink vertices, momentum routing, i0 prescriptions, and proper-time dependence, while the numerator carries only the minimal algebraic, tensorial content. To construct integrands at fixed post-Minkowskian order we propose a generalized Berends-Giele construction that minimizes the number of expensive tensor contraction operations. We also discuss simplification and canonicalization strategies through "serialization" of worldline propagators and the application of "selfie"-subdiagram partial-fraction identities, yielding a minimal canonical topology basis. We further show that the graph-numerator representation naturally generalizes the notion of an integral family and its sectors, relevant for integration-by-parts (IBP) reduction: propagators are not constrained to a single master labeling, and each sector carries its own minimal set of independent scalar products, completing into an overcomplete global family. This setup minimizes the total number of required integral sectors through an optimal use of sector symmetries and enables independent optimization of propagator labeling for IBP reductions. The algorithms are implemented in the Rust crate FeynRIR, which is currently able to efficiently compute integrands for the variation of the effective WEFT action, the equations of motion for the worldlines and the (radiation-reacted) impulse.

一句话导读：提出图-分子表示与算法，用于高效构造世界线 EFT 被积函数并服务 post-Minkowskian 经典引力计算。

Exact lattice bosonization of the double-scaled $c=1$ matrix model

Adwait Gaikwad, Gautam Mandal, Ajay Mohan · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：在最近由我们中两人发表的一篇论文中已经表明，矩阵量子力学（等价于非相对论费米子模型）的纠缠熵可以自然地解释为用格距约为 1/N 的格点玻色子对费米子理论进行精确玻色化（N 为矩阵秩，等于费米子数）。这种格点玻色子理论与以费米子密度 ρ(λ) 表述的“集体变量”理论的格点化版本不同；事实上，它更接近费米子的 Wigner 分布。本文针对 c=1 双标度矩阵模型进一步发展这一联系。尽管 N 变为无穷，双标度理论由一个位于有限且非均匀格距（量级约为 g_s(x) l_s，其中 g_s(x)=g_s cosech^2(x/l_s) 是位置依赖的弦耦合）上的玻色子描述。我们显式从格点玻色子导出 c=1 纠缠熵以及费米子密度的一点和两点函数。结果是显式有限的，而集体变量理论被表明给出发散答案。我们的结果提示：虽然诸如纠缠熵和 ⟨ρ(λ)⟩ 这样的局域可观测量由唯一的短距离尺度 g_s(x) l_s 刻画，但诸如每个亏格上的 S 矩阵这样的渐近可观测量由短距离尺度 l_s 刻画。我们展示这是如何产生的，并讨论其与 D0 膜物理的可能解释。

English: In a recent paper by two of us, it has been shown that entanglement entropy (EE) of matrix quantum mechanics (or, equivalently, of a non-relativistic fermion model) has a natural interpretation in terms of an exact bosonization of the fermion theory in terms of a lattice boson with lattice spacing $\sim 1/N$ (where $N$ is the rank of the matrix, equal to the number of fermions). The theory of this lattice boson is distinct from a latticized version of the "collective variable'' theory which is formulated in terms of the fermion density $\rho(\lambda)$ ("collective variable''); it is, in fact, more closely related to the Wigner distribution of the fermions. In this paper, we develop this connection further for the $c=1$ double scaled matrix model. Even though $N$ becomes infinite, the double scaled theory is described by a boson on a finite and non-uniform lattice spacing, of order $\sim g_s(x) l_s$ (where $g_s(x) \equiv g_s {\rm cosech}^2(x/l_s)$ is a position dependent string coupling). We explicitly derive the $c=1$ EE, as well as the one and two-point functions of fermion density from the lattice boson. The results are explicitly finite, unlike the collective variable theory which is shown to yield divergent answers. Our results suggest that while local observables such as the EE and $\langle \rho(\lambda) \rangle$, are characterized by a unique short distance scale $g_s(x) l_s$, the asymptotic observables such as the S-matrix at every genus are characterized by a short distance scale $l_s$. We show how this arises and discuss a possible interpretation in terms of D0 brane physics.

一句话导读：在 c=1 双标度矩阵模型中构造精确格点玻色化，得到有限纠缠熵与密度关联函数。

中文摘要：作为Ryu-Takayanagi公式的结果，AdS量子引力中的静态半经典态共享一组可表述为纠缠熵线性不等式的特殊性质。这些性质有多普遍？当我们离开RT的适用区域，即经典Einstein引力中的静态态时，它们是否仍然成立？它们是否甚至对某些非全息态也成立？我们将引出这些问题并综述已知答案。

English: As a consequence of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula, static semiclassical states in AdS quantum gravity share a set of special properties expressible as linear inequalities on their entanglement entropies. How general are these properties? Do they still hold when we move away from the regime of validity of RT, i.e. static states in classical Einstein gravity? Do they perhaps hold even for some class of non-holographic states? We will motivate these questions and review what's known about the answers.

自由标量作为三维共形场论的热包络

The Free Scalar as a Thermal Envelope for Three-Dimensional CFTs

Christopher P. Herzog, Andreas Stergiou · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：作者猜想每个幺正三维共形场论都满足 c_S/C_T ≤ 16πζ(3)，其中 s = c_S T^2 是热熵密度，C_T 是应力张量两点系数，自由标量取等号。并进一步猜想：在 S^1×H^2 上，经 C_T 归一化的双曲热容对所有 T≥(2πR)^{-1} 都被自由标量的值从上界约束。在共形温度附近，对于从高温侧光滑且模哈密顿量没有边界项的理论，热容界可由共形对撞机正定性推出。作者在自由理论、相互作用大 N 理论以及全息理论中检验了这些猜想，并指出三维 Ising 与 O(N) 模型的蒙特卡洛数据也满足平直空间中的界。

English: We conjecture that every unitary three-dimensional conformal field theory obeys $c_S/C_T\leq16\pi\zeta(3)$, where $s=c_ST^2$ is the thermal entropy density and $C_T$ the stress-tensor two-point coefficient, with equality for free scalars. We embed this in a stronger conjecture: on $S^1\times H^2$, the $C_T$-normalized hyperbolic heat capacity is bounded above by that of the free scalar for all $T\geq(2\pi R)^{-1}$. Near the conformal temperature, for theories smooth from the high-temperature side and without boundary terms in the modular Hamiltonian, the heat-capacity bound follows from conformal-collider positivity. We test the conjectures in free, interacting large-$N$, and holographic theories. Monte Carlo data for the three-dimensional Ising and $O(N)$ models also obey the flat-space bound.

用于模拟天体物理源时空变异的四维高斯随机场生成器

A Four-Dimensional Gaussian Random Field Generator for Modeling Spatiotemporal Variability in Astrophysical Sources

Alejandro C\'ardenas-Avenda\~no, Diego Rubiera-Garcia, Frederic H. Vincent · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：半解析黑洞电影模型需要发射流处方与时间依赖的源变异性。现有方案常局限于赤道发射或定常源。本文提出统一模型：首先将赤道比角动量剖面提升到柱面，令四速度极向分量为零，用时空点处完整 Kerr 度规归一化，构造离赤道、非测地的 Kerr 流体旋转律，并保留恢复类测地 plunging 处方的选项；其次将该速度作为四维非均匀、各向异性 Matérn-like 高斯随机场的吸积盘平流场，并通过单一复合相关张量参数化环面状盘与中心喷流。结果为相对论研究提供可直接实现的时变厚盘与盘-喷流发射方案。

English: Semi-analytic models of black-hole movies require both an emitting flow prescription and a time-dependent source variability. Existing prescriptions are often limited to either equatorial emission or time-independent sources. In this work we present a unified model for these two ingredients. First, we prescribe an off-equatorial, nongeodesic Kerr fluid rotation law by lifting an equatorial specific-angular-momentum profile to cylindrical surfaces, setting the polar component of the four-velocity to zero, normalizing the flow with the full Kerr metric at the spacetime point, and retaining the option to recover a geodesic-like plunging prescription when needed. Second, we use this velocity as the disk advection field in a four-dimensional inhomogeneous, anisotropic Mat\'ern-like Gaussian random field. We provide a parametrized model for a torus-like disk and a central jet through a single composite correlation tensor. The resulting effective model is an implementation-ready prescription for time-dependent thick-disk and disk-jet emission for relativistic studies.

一句话导读：用 Kerr 流体旋转律驱动四维非均匀各向异性高斯随机场，为黑洞电影中的时变厚盘与盘-喷流发射提供可实现的半解析处方。

利用MeerKAT PTA和SKA-PTA预测探测引力子质量

Probing Graviton Mass with MeerKAT PTA and SKA-PTA Forecasts

Zhi-Chao Zhao, Sai Wang · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本研究利用MeerKAT脉冲星计时阵列（MPTA）4.5年数据发布给出引力子质量限制，并对即将到来的平方公里阵列PTA（SKA-PTA）进行预测。通过建模大质量引力子的修正色散关系及相应张量关联函数，我们在三种噪声配置下对角关联测量进行贝叶斯推断。引力子质量的90%可信上限为 m_g < (2.10–2.58)×10^{-23} eV/c^2。纳入单极和偶极贡献不会显著改变这些界限，表明限制由四极张量关联驱动。所有结果与广义相对论完全一致。对于SKA-PTA，我们预测在10年观测基线下达 m_g ~ 10^{-24} eV/c^2，在50年基线下达 m_g ~ 10^{-25} eV/c^2，相比当前限制有数量级改进。本工作展示了当前和未来PTA观测在纳赫兹频段检验引力基本方面的能力。

English: In this study, we derive constraints on the graviton mass using the 4.5-year data release from the MeerKAT Pulsar Timing Array (MPTA) and provide forecasts for the upcoming Square Kilometre Array PTA (SKA-PTA). By modeling the modified dispersion relation and the corresponding tensor correlation function for massive gravitons, we perform Bayesian inference on the angular-correlation measurements under three noise configurations. Our 90\% credible upper limits on the graviton mass span $m_g < (2.10$-$2.58) \times 10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$. Including monopolar and dipolar contributions does not significantly alter these bounds, confirming that the constraints are driven by the quadrupolar tensor correlation. All results remain fully consistent with general relativity. For SKA-PTA, we forecast sensitivities down to $m_g \sim 10^{-24}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$ with a 10-year observing baseline and $m_g \sim 10^{-25}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$ with a 50-year observing baseline, representing order-of-magnitude improvements over current limits. This work demonstrates the power of current and future PTA observations to test fundamental aspects of gravity in the nanohertz band.

一句话导读：用MeerKAT PTA数据限制引力子质量并预测SKA-PTA可达灵敏度，结果与广义相对论一致。

由地壳晶格压力支撑的中子星“山”的数值计算

Numerical calculations of neutron star mountains supported by crustal lattice pressure

T. J. Hutchins, D. I. Jones · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：低质量X射线双星中的中子星可能通过引力波辐射设定自转频率，其机制之一是热梯度驱动弹性应变形成质量不对称，即“山”。本文在一个统一框架内自洽计算温度不对称、地壳晶格压力扰动和质量不对称，并首次采用Brussels-Montreal核能量密度泛函BSk19、BSk20、BSk21给出的真实状态方程，以热力学一致的方式描述吸积中子星各区域。结果表明这些“山”太小，不足以决定LMXB的自转平衡，并估计了其产生的引力波辐射水平。

English: Gravitational waves may set the spin frequencies of neutron stars in low-mass X-ray binaries (LMXBs). One mechanism for facilitating such emission is the formation of a mass asymmetry - or `mountain' - supported by elastic strains driven by thermal gradients. Most studies have focused either on the origin of the elastic strains or the temperature asymmetry in isolation, and have not considered the entire formation process. In previous work, we showed that anisotropic heat transport in magnetised accreting neutron stars can source a significant temperature asymmetry, and made rough estimates that suggested temperature-induced perturbations in the pressure supplied by the crustal lattice may be competitive with the widely known model of temperature-induced capture-layer shifts. In this paper we carry out detailed calculations to properly explore this scenario. We self-consistently calculate the temperature asymmetries, the perturbations in crustal lattice pressure, and the mass asymmetries within a single framework. For the first time, we make use of the set of realistic equations of state from the Brussels-Montreal nuclear energy-density functionals BSk19, BSk20, and BSk21 which describe all regions of accreting neutron stars in a thermodynamically consistent, unified way. We find these mountains are too small to dictate the spin-equilibrium of LMXBs, and estimate the level of gravitational wave emission they produce.

一句话导读：用统一框架和BSk真实状态方程数值计算地壳晶格压力支撑的中子星“山”，发现其不足以主导LMXB自转平衡。

强场引力波透镜效应：基于光线追踪到达时间面

Strong-Field Gravitational-Wave Lensing from Ray-Traced Arrival-Time Surfaces

Luka Vujeva, Jo\~ao S. Santos, Brian C. Seymour · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：摘要讨论引力波透镜的衍射积分形式在源接近黑洞强引力区时失效。作者利用零测地线满足 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程，提出一种不依赖薄透镜近似构造时间延迟面并直接求解衍射积分的新形式，用于获得强场低频修正。对位于 10M 的静止源，与相对论波散射模型比较，峰值放大率和第一衍射条纹分别达到 6.5% 和 0.3% 的一致性；在弱场 10^4M 源下与点质量透镜振幅一致性小于 1%，但高频峰值间出现明显退相位。该框架可在约 6M 到无穷远的源之间进行插值，用于计算超越几何光学的强场透镜效应。

English: The diffraction integral formalism has been greatly successful in describing gravitational wave lensing effects in scenarios where the wavelength of the signal is comparable to the characteristic length scale of the lens, known as the wave optics regime. However, the assumptions required to construct its integrand break down as the source approaches the strong gravity region of a black hole lens. In particular, we are interested in the lensed signal from a binary (the source) near a massive black hole (the lens). We present a new formalism for obtaining low frequency corrections to sources being lensed in the strong field regime of gravity by leveraging the fact that null geodesics obey the Hamilton--Jacobi equations. In doing so, we are able to construct a time delay surface without relying on the thin lens approximation, and solve the diffraction integral for the resulting surface directly. For a stationary source at $10M$, deep in the strong field regime, when comparing the results with a relativistic wave scattering model, we find $6.5\%$ and $0.3\%$ agreement in the peak amplification and first diffractive fringe, respectively. Furthermore, we find a $< 1\%$ agreement with the amplitude of the point mass lens with a source at $10^4 M$ in the weak field, but noticeable dephasing between the peaks of the amplification function at higher frequencies. This work allows for clean interpolation between otherwise separate regimes, valid for sources from $\sim 6M \to \infty$. It provides a transparent, physically motivated framework for computing beyond-geometric optics lensing effects in the strong field regime.

一句话导读：提出基于零测地线 Hamilton-Jacobi 的光线追踪到达时间面方法，直接求解衍射积分以描述强场引力波透镜效应。

全波光学中的强场引力透镜

Strong Field Gravitational Lensing in Full Wave Optics

Jo\~ao S. Santos, Luka Vujeva · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：致密双星可能在大质量黑洞附近演化，其引力波携带环境特征。我们研究大质量伴星对这些信号的强透镜效应，该情形违背几何光学和薄透镜的标准假设。利用微扰框架，我们计算正面和侧面双星（包括自旋透镜）的全波光学放大因子。在侧面配置中，即使透镜不自旋，峰值放大也不发生在源—透镜—观测者完美对齐时；这是恒星级双星各向异性相干四极辐射破坏系统轴对称性的结果。限制在光轴附近的赤道面后，我们发现放大因子的频率依赖性在所有研究配置中具有普适性，并深入波光学区域。与强场光线追踪计算比较，Schwarzschild黑洞透镜正面双星在约10%水平一致；在对称性较低的侧面情形，仅角峰移和条纹间距达到该精度。对于Kerr透镜，在修正参考系拖曳效应后，正面放大因子可由其Schwarzschild对应物以约10%精度描述。点质量透镜则无法重现这些特征，这可能对采用点质量透镜进行强场大质量黑洞透镜预测产生重要影响。

English: Compact binaries evolving in the vicinity of massive black holes may be commonplace in the Universe, and their gravitational waves carry signatures of their environment. We study the strong lensing of these signals by the massive companion, a configuration that violates the standard assumptions of the lensing literature: geometric optics and thin lenses. Using a perturbative framework, we compute the full wave optics amplification factors for face-on and edge-on binaries, including spinning lenses. In the edge-on configuration, peak amplification does not occur at perfect source--lens--observer alignment, even for a non-spinning lens. This is a consequence of the anisotropic, coherent quadrupolar emission of the stellar-mass binary breaking the axisymmetry of the system. Restricting to the equatorial plane near the optical axis, we then find that the frequency dependence of the amplification factor is universal across every configuration studied, persisting deep into the wave optics regime. Comparing against a strong-field ray tracing calculation, we find agreement at the $\sim10\%$ level for a face-on binary lensed by a Schwarzschild black hole. In the less symmetric edge-on case only the angular peak shift and fringe spacing is reproduced to this accuracy. For a Kerr lens, the face-on amplification factor is described by its Schwarzschild counterpart to the same $\sim 10 \%$ accuracy once the effect of frame dragging is corrected for. A point mass lens, by contrast, fails to reproduce the features of the system, which may have strong implications for forecasts that adopt it for lensing by massive black holes in the strong field.

3+1维数值相对论中的双Ellis-Bronnikov虫洞：并合、飞掠与引力波

Binary Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes in 3+1 numerical relativity: mergers, fly-bys and gravitational waves

Nikita M. Shirokov, Ilya Nachevsky · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们给出据我们所知首个虫洞双星的三维数值相对论演化：由幻影标量场支撑、能量密度处处非正的大质量Ellis-Bronnikov虫洞对。我们构造单喉和双喉、静止及带轨道角动量的约束满足初始数据，并用自适应网格加密演化。孤立喉不稳定：依小扰动符号坍缩为黑洞或膨胀，速率与线性扰动理论预言在1.9%内相符。两个静止喉在标量荷同号时相斥、反号时相吸，强度比接近标量力律预言，因此只有反号对并合。正面碰撞在两个喉仍张开时于二者周围形成共同视界；视界吸收标量场后面积损失28%，并趋近该对质量的Schwarzschild半径。飞掠对不形成视界，两个喉均膨胀。每次相遇发射短引力波暴和能量相当且为负的标量偶极波。孤立坍缩喉以所形成黑洞的准正规频率振铃。即使初始扰动很小，没有喉能存活超过几个轨道周期，因此这些双星不会旋近。结果限于一个幻影标量模型、等质量、单一喉致密度和无自旋。

English: We present what are, to our knowledge, the first three-dimensional numerical-relativity evolutions of wormhole binaries: pairs of massive Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes held open by a phantom scalar field, whose energy density is nowhere positive. We construct constraint-satisfying initial data for single throats and for pairs, at rest and with orbital momentum, and evolve them with adaptive mesh refinement. An isolated throat is unstable: depending on the sign of a small perturbation, it collapses to a black hole or inflates, at the rate that linear perturbation theory predicts to within 1.9%. Two throats at rest repel when their scalar charges have the same sign and attract when the signs are opposite, with a strength ratio close to the scalar force law's prediction, so only opposite-signed pairs merge. A head-on collision forms a common horizon around both throats while they are still open. The horizon then loses 28% of its area as it absorbs the scalar field, and approaches the Schwarzschild radius of the pair's mass. Pairs that fly past each other form no horizon, and both throats inflate. Every encounter emits a short burst of gravitational waves and a scalar dipole wave of comparable, negative energy. An isolated collapsing throat rings at the quasinormal frequency of the black hole it becomes. No throat survives more than a few orbital periods, even when its initial perturbation is tiny, so these binaries do not inspiral. The results hold for one phantom-scalar model, equal masses, a single throat compactness and no spin.

English: We present NRHJSur3dq8, a family of numerical-relativity surrogates for non-eccentric aligned-spin binary-black-hole waveforms inspired by an action-angle parameterization. 中文摘要：我们考察Kerr时空中类时世界线的Frenet-Serret (FS)曲率κ和第一挠率τ1，主要关注非Killing赤道轨迹。由于这些量是世界线标量，同一曲线的坐标变换不能消除发散。我们通过将单条世界线在五个坐标图之间变换并验证其不变量一致（包括一个离赤道测试）来证明这一点，并说明在两个坐标图中重复使用切矢相同的坐标分量通常描述不同曲线。对于非单位切矢v且S=g(v,v)，我们导出恒等式 κ^2 = Q^2/S^3 - (q·q)/S^2，其中q=∇_v v、Q=q·v。当Q趋于非零极限且q·q保持有限时，曲线趋近零端点时曲率按|Q0| S^{-3/2}标度。在S'非零的附加条件下，我们得到τ1极限值的闭合表达式。我们用两个Kerr-Schild螺旋的精确符号计算验证这些结果，其中一个自旋参数a大于质量M、不存在事件视界。对于Killing观察者，我们导出κ和τ1的闭合表达式，并表明二者在光面上奇异。最后，我们区分FS挠率（度量相对于加速度方向的转动）与用正则参考系定义的陀螺仪转动率。对于测地线坠落，相对于主零标架的转动率在穿越视界时保持有限，而相对于Carter平面轴的转动率与Marck进动率一致。我们的分析主要集中于赤道例子；双零坐标中的数值比较留待未来工作。

English: We examine the Frenet-Serret (FS) curvature kappa and first torsion tau_1 of timelike worldlines in Kerr spacetime, focusing mainly on non-Killing equatorial trajectories. Since these quantities are scalars associated with a worldline, a coordinate transformation cannot remove a divergence for the same curve. We demonstrate this by transforming a single worldline between five coordinate charts and verifying agreement of its invariants, including in an off-equatorial test. We also show why reusing the same coordinate components of the tangent vector in two charts generally describes different curves. For a non-unit tangent v with norm S = g(v,v), we derive the identity kappa squared = Q squared / S cubed - (q dot q) / S squared, where q = nabla_v v and Q = q dot v. When Q approaches a nonzero limit and q dot q remains finite, the curvature scales as |Q_0| S to the power -3/2 as the curve approaches a null endpoint. Under the additional condition that S' is nonzero, we obtain a closed expression for the limiting value of tau_1. We verify these results using exact symbolic calculations for two Kerr-Schild spirals, including one with spin parameter a greater than the mass M, for which no event horizon exists. For Killing observers, we derive closed-form expressions for kappa and tau_1 and show that both become singular at light surfaces. Finally, we distinguish FS torsion, which measures rotation relative to the acceleration direction, from gyroscope rotation rates defined using regular reference frames. For a geodesic plunge, the rotation rate relative to the principal-null frame remains finite across the horizon, while the rate relative to the Carter-plane axis agrees with Marck's precession rate. Our analysis focuses mainly on equatorial examples; a numerical comparison in double-null coordinates is left for future work.

Tianyou Ren, Jing-Ya Zhao, Xiaomei Liu, Rong-Jia Yang · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们研究了嵌入Dehnen型暗物质晕中的静态球对称正则黑洞的阴影、类时测地线结构以及薄吸积盘辐射性质。利用EHT对M87*和Sgr A*的观测，在1σ和2σ置信水平约束晕尺度参数a。基于Page--Thorne模型和反向光线追踪方法，计算不同视角下的局部辐射通量、红移因子分布和观测通量图像。我们进一步通过评估ISCO半径和盘通量分布，将Dehnen正则黑洞与Einasto和Hayward正则黑洞进行比较。结果表明，增大a会减小ISCO半径、扩大有效辐射面积，并放大直接像和次级像的多普勒不对称性。与Einasto和Hayward模型相比，Dehnen黑洞表现出最强的ISCO收缩和最明显的左右亮度不对称性，而Einasto模型对其尺度参数几乎不敏感，Hayward黑洞仅表现出轻微依赖。这些发现表明，具有不同正则化机制的正则黑洞可通过其吸积盘图像加以区分，为未来高分辨率观测检验暗物质晕模型提供了潜在工具。

English: We study the shadow, timelike geodesic structure, and thin accretion disk radiation properties of a static spherically symmetric regular black hole embedded in a Dehnen-type dark matter halo. Using the EHT observations of M87* and Sgr A*, we constrain the halo scale parameter $a$ at $1\sigma$ and $2\sigma$ levels. Based on the Page--Thorne model and a backward ray-tracing method, we compute the local radiative flux, redshift factor distribution, and observed flux images for different viewing angles. We further compare the Dehnen regular black hole with the Einasto and Hayward regular black holes by evaluating their ISCO radii and disk flux profiles. The results show that increasing $a$ reduces the ISCO radius, enlarges the effective radiation area, and amplifies the Doppler asymmetry of both direct and secondary images. Compared with the Einasto and Hayward models, the Dehnen black hole exhibits the strongest ISCO contraction and the most pronounced left-right brightness asymmetry, while the Einasto model is nearly insensitive to its scale parameter and the Hayward black hole shows only a mild dependence. These findings demonstrate that regular black holes with different regularisation mechanisms can be distinguished by their accretion disk images, providing a potential tool for testing dark-matter halo models with future high-resolution observations.

一句话导读：用EHT约束和薄盘光线追踪研究Dehnen暗物质晕中正则黑洞的阴影与吸积盘辐射，并比较不同正则化模型。

引力光偏折：几何方法与非线性电动力学

Gravitational Light Deflection: Geometrical Methods and Nonlinear Electrodynamics

Partha Pratim Basumallick, Saheb Das, Bhaswati Mandal, Subhadip Sau · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：引力透镜是时空曲率最直接的观测表现之一，也是探测致密天体的一种有力手段。本文对弯曲时空中的光线偏折进行了综合分析，首先介绍引力透镜的基本方面以及光偏折的牛顿近似。随后通过透镜方程、透镜势以及利用弯曲时空中有效折射率对费马原理的几何解释，发展相对论性的透镜表述。接着研究静态球对称几何中的光子轨迹与光偏折，并详细讨论 Kerr 时空赤道面内的光子运动，导出最近接近距离和控制光子轨道的临界参数的解析表达式。此外，利用 Rindler-Ishak 方法以及光学几何中的 Gauss-Bonnet 定理考察偏折角。最后，将分析推广到轴对称时空，使用 OIA 与 GW-OIA 形式体系，为计算静态与旋转引力场中的光偏折提供统一的几何框架。该综述还考察非线性电动力学（NED），区分引力背景的变化与电磁波特征传播的变化。文中用代表性模型将这些效应与有限距离偏折、偏振依赖的光学可观测量以及弱偏折与强场捕获之间的比较联系起来。

English: Gravitational lensing constitutes one of the most direct observational manifestations of spacetime curvature and provides a powerful probe of compact astrophysical objects. In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of the bending of light in curved spacetime, beginning with the fundamental aspects of gravitational lensing and the Newtonian approximation to light deflection. The relativistic formulation of lensing is then developed through the lens equation, lensing potential, and a geometrical interpretation of Fermat's principle using an effective refractive index in curved spacetime. Photon trajectories and light deflection are subsequently investigated in static, spherically symmetric geometries, followed by a detailed study of photon motion in the equatorial plane of the Kerr spacetime. Analytical expressions for the closest approach distance and critical parameters governing photon orbits are derived. Furthermore, the bending angle is examined using the Rindler-Ishak method and the Gauss-Bonnet theorem within the optical geometry. Finally, the analysis is extended to axisymmetric spacetimes using the OIA and GW-OIA formalisms, providing a unified geometrical framework for computing light deflection in both static and rotating gravitational fields. The review also examines nonlinear electrodynamics (NED), distinguishing changes in the gravitational background from changes in the characteristic propagation of electromagnetic waves. Representative models are used to relate these effects to finite-distance deflection, polarization-dependent optical observables, and comparisons between weak bending and strong-field capture.

一句话导读：综述弯曲时空中引力光偏折的几何方法，并讨论非线性电动力学对光传播的影响。

计算Lorenz规范下引力自力时的点粒子极限有效源方法

The point-particle-limit effective-source approach for computing gravitational self-force in the Lorenz gauge

Chao Zhang, Yungui Gong, Xuchen Lu, Wenting Zhou · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：传统有效源方法受复杂解析表达式和固有的光滑性限制，导致高计算成本和实现复杂。为克服这些限制，我们引入点粒子极限有效源方法，将有效源尺寸解析地取为零，从而把问题转化为由局部奇异场支配的、在粒子位置处推迟度规场的良定义跳跃条件。该表述自然适配间断Galerkin格式，其容纳解间断的固有能力使得跳跃条件可被高精度施加。我们将传统有效源方法和点粒子极限有效源方法应用于计算围绕Schwarzschild黑洞圆轨道运动点粒子的时域引力度规扰动和Lorenz规范下的引力自力。数值结果比较显示点粒子极限有效源方法的显著优势，验证了其正确性和效率，从而为计算一般测地轨道或长时间自洽轨道演化建立了数值基础。

English: The traditional effective-source method is hampered by complex analytical expressions and the inherent smoothness limit, which incur high computational costs and complicate implementation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the point-particle-limit effective source method, which analytically takes the size of the effective source to zero, thereby transforming the problem into a well-defined jump condition of retarded metric field at the particle position governed by the local singular field. This formulation naturally pairs with a discontinuous Galerkin scheme, whose inherent capacity for accommodating solution discontinuities enables highly accurate enforcement of the jump conditions. We apply both the traditional and point-particle-limit effective source method to calculate the time-domain gravitational metric perturbation and gravitational self-force in the Lorenz gauge on a point particle in a circular orbit around a Schwarzschild black hole. The comparison of numerical results shows the excellent advantage of the point-particle-limit effective source method, which validates the correctness and efficiency of the point-particle-limit effective source method and thereby establishes a numerical foundation for computing generic geodesic orbits or long-time self-consistent orbital evolution.

一句话导读：提出点粒子极限有效源方法并结合间断Galerkin格式，高效计算Lorenz规范下Schwarzschild时域引力自力。

f(Q,L_m) 引力中的宇宙学暴胀

Cosmological Inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_{m})$ Gravity

Maryam Shiravand, Saeed Fakhry, Javad T. Firouzjaee, Ali Tizfahm · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：宇宙学暴胀提供了宇宙早期加速膨胀的标准描述，但广义相对论（GR）的不足促使人们寻找替代引力框架。本文研究对称远平行表述下构造的 f(Q,L_m) 引力中的暴胀，其中非度规标量 Q 与物质拉格朗日量 L_m 非最小耦合。我们考虑具有幂律势的暴胀子标量场，并表明在该框架中，暴胀动力学由标量场与物质-几何耦合产生的有效几何部分之间的相互作用决定。标量场提供物质源，而修改后的 f(Q,L_m) 结构改变背景演化和暴胀观测量。在慢滚近似下，我们推导线性与非线性耦合模型的标量谱指数 n_s 和张量-标量比 r 的表达式。线性模型 f(Q,L_m)=-αQ+2L_m+β 被视为类 GR 的基准极限，而非线性模型 f(Q,L_m)=-αQ+(2L_m)^2+β 捕捉该理论真正修改的效应。我们发现，对于正 α 和 β，线性模型与最新的 Planck 2018 和 BICEP/Keck（BK18）联合限制一致（95% CL 下 r<0.036），而非线性模型在参数为负时更受青睐，其预言大多集中在 68% 置信水平内。这些结果表明，非线性物质-几何耦合可导致不同的暴胀行为，并可能改善二次势（n=2）与观测的兼容性，而该势在标准 GR 暴胀情景中受到强烈不利。

English: Cosmological inflation provides the standard description of the early accelerated expansion of the Universe, but the shortcomings of General Relativity (GR) motivate the search for alternative gravitational frameworks. In this paper, we study inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ gravity, constructed in the symmetric teleparallel formulation, where the non-metricity scalar $Q$ couples non-minimally to the matter Lagrangian $\mathcal{L}_m$. We consider an inflaton scalar field with a power-law potential and show that, in this framework, the inflationary dynamics is governed by the interplay between the scalar field and the effective geometric sector generated by the matter-geometry coupling. Thus, the scalar field supplies the matter source, while the modified $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ structure alters the background evolution and the inflationary observables. Within the slow-roll approximation, we derive the expressions of the scalar spectral index $n_s$ and the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ for both linear and nonlinear coupling models. The linear model, $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=-\alpha Q+2\mathcal{L}_m+\beta$, is treated as a benchmark GR-like limit, whereas the nonlinear model, $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=-\alpha Q+(2\mathcal{L}_m)^2+\beta$, captures the genuinely modified effects of the theory. We find that the linear model remains consistent with the latest joint Planck 2018 and BICEP/Keck (BK18) constraints ($r < 0.036$ at $95\%$ CL) for positive $\alpha$ and $\beta$, while the nonlinear model is favored for negative values of these parameters and yields predictions largely concentrated within the $68\%$ confidence level. These results indicate that the nonlinear matter-geometry coupling can lead to distinct inflationary behavior and may improve the observational compatibility of the quadratic potential $(n=2)$, which is strongly disfavored in the standard GR-based inflationary scenario.

一句话导读：研究 f(Q,L_m) 对称远平行引力中幂律势暴胀的慢滚预言，并用 Planck 2018 与 BK18 数据约束线性及非线性耦合模型。

Sgr A* 周围中子星轨道进动的潮汐贡献

Tidal contributions to neutron star orbital precession around Sgr $A^*$

H Lalrinfela, P. C. Lalremruati, Zodinmawia, N Malsawmtluangi · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们研究 Sgr A* 超大质量黑洞周围中子星轨道进动的潮汐贡献，并用 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程描述恒星位形。我们考察潮汐进动对恒星致密度、近星点距离和四极潮汐 Love 数 k2 的依赖，并将其量级与广义相对论轨道进动进行比较。计算得到的潮汐角偏移随近星点距离增大而显著减小，并且在所考虑的恒星位形中随致密度增大而减小；较大的 Love 数会增强潮汐贡献。这种行为反映了潮汐进动对恒星半径与近星点距离之比 (R/rp)^5 的强依赖。尽管在更近距离交会时潮汐效应会增强，但预测的潮汐偏移仍然极小，在所示参数范围内约为 3.5×10^-18 μas。潮汐进动与广义相对论进动之比约为 10^-33 至 10^-28，表明相对论进动占绝对主导。我们的结果表明，在所采用模型的假设下，通过 Sgr A* 周围的轨道进动直接探测中子星潮汐贡献将异常困难。

English: We investigate tidal contributions to the orbital precession of neutron stars around the supermassive black hole Sgr A*, using stellar configurations described by the Tolman - Oppenheimer - Volkoff equations. We examine the dependence of tidal precession on stellar compactness, pericentre distance, and the quadrupolar tidal Love number $k_2$, and compare its magnitude with general relativistic orbital precession. The calculated tidal angular shift decreases strongly with increasing pericentre distance and, for the stellar configurations considered, with increasing compactness. Larger Love numbers enhance the tidal contribution. This behaviour reflects the strong dependence of tidal precession on the stellar-radius-to-pericentre-distance ratio, $(R/r_p)^5$. Despite the enhancement during closer encounters, the predicted tidal shifts remain extremely small, reaching approximately $3.5 \times 10^{-18},\mu as$ within the displayed parameter range. The ratio of tidal to general relativistic precession spans approximately $10^{-33}$ - $10^{-28}$, indicating that relativistic precession overwhelmingly dominates. Our results suggest that direct detection of the neutron-star tidal contribution through orbital precession around Sgr A* would be exceptionally challenging under the assumptions of the adopted model.

一句话导读：计算表明 Sgr A* 周围中子星轨道的潮汐进动远小于广义相对论进动，直接探测极为困难。

中子星磁解锁产生的力矩滞后与引力波抹散

Torque lags from magnetic unlocking in neutron stars and gravitational-wave smearing

Arthur G. Suvorov, Armen Sedrakian · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：在典型的中子星磁流体平衡扭曲环面模型中，环向场局限于极向场线闭合的区域。由于恒星表面施加的自转减慢力矩未必能有效传递到这些磁解锁区域，环向区或磁空腔可能比电磁制动部分转得更快。因此，由相关非共转四极矩产生的连续引力辐射可能以高于极向区的频率发出，程度取决于控制角动量输运的扩散微观物理。耗散过程可抑制长寿命滞后，我们估计相关时标及其对微观物理的敏感性。我们表明，图案速度不同于观测自转的四极矩分量会在有限频带内被移动或抹散。单模板或窄带上限因此只约束落在搜索频率窗内的四极矩贡献，而不一定是全频积分的四极矩。用简单模型，我们量化有限观测窗内的这种谱再分布，并讨论其对连续波搜索的意义。

English: In canonical twisted-torus models of hydromagnetic equilibrium in neutron stars, the toroidal field is confined to regions where the poloidal field lines are closed. As spindown torques applied at the stellar surface need not be communicated efficiently to such magnetically-unlocked regions, toroidal zones or magnetic voids may rotate faster than the electromagnetically braked part of the star. Continuous gravitational radiation from the associated non-corotating quadrupole may therefore be emitted at higher frequencies than poloidal ones to a degree that depends on the diffusive microphysics controlling angular momentum transport. Dissipative processes can suppress long-lived lags, and we estimate the relevant timescales and their sensitivity to microphysics. Nevertheless, we show that a quadrupole component whose pattern speed differs from the observed spin is shifted, or smeared, over a finite frequency band. Single-template or narrowband upper limits therefore constrain only the quadrupole contribution lying inside the searched frequency window, not necessarily the full frequency-integrated quadrupole. Using simple models, we quantify this spectral redistribution over finite observation windows and discuss its implications for continuous-wave searches.

一句话导读：磁解锁区可非共转并改变连续引力波四极矩频谱，窄带搜索只覆盖有限频带内的贡献。

广义相对论处理下的暗物质相空间分布：基于广义相对论的 Eddington 反演

Dark Matter phase space distribution under a fully relativistic treatment. Eddington inversion according to general relativity

Jaime Hoefken Zink, Pellegrino Piantadosi · hep-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文将 Eddington 反演推广为完全相对论版本，用以从暗物质密度剖面重建其相空间分布函数。作者把暗物质视为静态球对称时空中的有效完美流体，利用 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程确定引力背景，并推导出以无穷远处守恒粒子能量为变量的 Abel 型反演。结果表明，该表达式在弱场非相对论极限下回到经典 Eddington 反演；作者还研究有限边界贡献可能引入的非物理发散，并给出正则化方案。将该方法应用于由广义 Navarro-Frenk-White 晕和 Sagittarius A* 周围 Gondolo-Silk 暗物质尖峰组成的银河系模型（忽略重子贡献）时，相对论与非相对论速度分布在远离银心处一致，但在约 10^{-5} pc 量级开始不同；更靠近黑洞处，相对论峰值速度可达牛顿预测的约两倍。最后，作者导出适用于任意环境速度分布的中子星暗物质捕获一般表达式；在 Sagittarius A* 附近，相对论捕获因子比 Maxwell-Boltzmann 预测小近一个量级，而牛顿 Eddington 结果可高估约两倍。这些结果说明强引力场中相对论相空间重建对暗物质现象学很重要。

English: We develop a fully relativistic extension of Eddington inversion to reconstruct the phase-space distribution function of dark matter from its density profile. Treating dark matter as an effective perfect fluid in a static, spherically symmetric spacetime, we use the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations to determine the gravitational background and derive an Abel-type inversion that yields the distribution function in terms of the conserved particle energy measured at infinity. We show that the resulting expression recovers the classical Eddington inversion in the weak-field, nonrelativistic limit. We also investigate the finite-boundary contribution, which can introduce an unphysical divergence, and present a regularization procedure that removes it. We apply our method to a Milky Way model consisting of a generalized Navarro-Frenk-White halo and a Gondolo-Silk dark-matter spike around Sagittarius A$^*$, neglecting baryonic contributions. The relativistic and Newtonian velocity distributions agree at radii far from the Galactic center but begin to differ at distances of order $10^{-5}\,\mathrm{pc}$. Closer to the black hole, the relativistic peak speed can reach approximately twice the Newtonian prediction. Finally, we derive a general expression for dark-matter capture by neutron stars that accommodates arbitrary ambient velocity distributions. Near Sagittarius A$^*$, the relativistic capture factor is nearly an order of magnitude smaller than the Maxwell-Boltzmann prediction, while the Newtonian Eddington result can overestimate it by a factor of approximately two. These results demonstrate the importance of relativistic phase-space reconstruction for dark-matter phenomenology in strong gravitational fields.

双中子星的非线性潮汐

Nonlinear Tides of Binary Neutron Stars

Guangzhou Guo, Zhen Pan · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：非线性潮汐会耦合恒星振荡，并改变旋近双星产生的引力波信号。我们给出旋近中子星双星中非线性潮汐的流体力学模拟，并在模式耦合模型内推导出潮汐强度二阶的准解析四极基模频率移动。两种方法在微扰区域一致，但在更强潮汐场下出现分歧，此时微扰论失效。在旋近后期，等质量双星的非线性潮汐使基模频率降低约10%，并在线性潮汐响应之外增加量级为O(1)弧度的引力波相位移动。这些效应使非线性潮汐成为下一代引力波探测器的有希望目标。

English: Nonlinear tides couple stellar oscillations and reshape the gravitational wave (GW) signal from inspiralling binaries. We present hydrodynamic simulations of nonlinear tides in inspiralling neutron-star binaries and, within a mode-coupling model, derive a semi-analytic quadrupolar fundamental mode-frequency shift through second order in the tidal strength. The two approaches agree in the perturbative regime, but diverge at stronger tidal fields, where perturbation theory breaks down. In the late inspiral, nonlinear tides reduce the fundamental-mode frequency by ${\sim}10\%$ for equal-mass binaries and add a GW phase shift of $\mathcal{O}(1)$ radian beyond the linear tidal response. These effects make nonlinear tides a promising target for next-generation GW detectors.

脉冲星-黑洞双星中引力诱导的偏振角旋转

Gravitationally Induced Polarization-Angle Rotation in Pulsar-Black Hole Binaries

Jyotijwal Debnath, Amodio Carleo, Delphine Perrodin, Pratik Tarafdar · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：射电脉冲星发出高度偏振辐射，其偏振性质常用旋转矢量模型（RVM）描述。本文研究在假想的脉冲星-黑洞双星中，引力光线偏折与平行移动对脉冲星偏振剖面的影响。我们将RVM与零测地线数值积分结合，计算光子轨迹上的偏振方向，并建模观测偏振位置角（PPA）随轨道相位的变化。我们考虑非旋转与旋转黑洞伴星，并纳入相对论自旋-轨道耦合引起的轨道几何演化。对非旋转黑洞，观测偏振方向的变化来自引力光线偏折导致的几何位移；对旋转黑洞，参考系拖曳引入额外几何位移，而平行移动产生相对于所选参考构造测量的额外偏振旋转。我们研究这些偏振变化对双星参数和脉冲星自旋取向的依赖。发现引力光线偏折可显著扭曲特征S形PPA剖面，尤其在上合附近，并可使所考虑的超大质量黑洞系统的整体变化方向反转。相对论自旋-轨道演化也影响偏振剖面的轨道相位依赖，尤其在超大质量黑洞系统中。结果表明，相对论光子传播可同时改变脉冲星偏振剖面的形状和相位依赖，并可能在此类系统被发现时用于探测脉冲星-黑洞双星的几何。

English: Radio pulsars emit highly polarized radiation whose polarization properties are commonly described by the Rotating Vector Model (RVM). In this work, we investigate the effects of gravitational light bending and parallel transport on the polarization profile of a pulsar in a hypothetical binary system with a black hole (BH) companion. We combine the RVM with numerical integration of null geodesics to calculate the polarization direction along the photon trajectory and model the orbital-phase-dependent variation of the observed polarization position angle (PPA). We consider both non-spinning and spinning black hole companions and include the evolution of the orbital geometry due to relativistic spin-orbit coupling. For a non-spinning black hole, the change in the observed polarization direction arises from the geometric shift associated with gravitational light bending. For a spinning black hole, frame dragging introduces an additional geometric shift, while parallel transport produces an additional polarization rotation measured relative to our chosen reference construction. We investigate the dependence of these polarization changes on the binary parameters and the orientation of the pulsar spin. We find that gravitational light bending can significantly distort the characteristic S-shaped PPA profile, particularly near superior conjunction, and can reverse its overall sense of variation for the supermassive black hole system considered here. Relativistic spin-orbit evolution also affects the orbital-phase dependence of the polarization profile, particularly in the supermassive black hole system. These results show that relativistic photon propagation can modify both the shape and the phase dependence of pulsar polarization profiles and may provide a useful probe of the geometry of pulsar-BH binaries when such systems are discovered.

Bahromjon Shokirov, Tursunali Xamidov, Chen Zhou, Sanjar Shaymatov, Chengxun Yuan · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文研究浸没在均匀磁场中的五维旋转Myers-Perry黑洞赤道面上带电粒子的周期轨道，并计算这些轨道在极端质量比旋进中发出的引力波，所有结果均与均匀磁场中的Kerr黑洞比较。研究发现，带电粒子在五维黑洞中束缚得弱得多：其最内稳定圆轨道能量接近1，为0.95--0.99，而Kerr黑洞为0.78--0.94，势阱深度也小数倍；因此五维黑洞的周期轨道更靠近分界线。磁场可使轨道方位角频率小于径向频率，并在远离黑洞处产生回环。作者使用数值kludge方法计算了10倍太阳质量致密天体绕10^6倍太阳质量黑洞运行时的引力波形。在相同磁场下，五维信号周期更长、频率更低，振幅约小18%。当磁参数βM=0.02时，最强谱线位于7.9 mHz，而Kerr黑洞为9.9 mHz。辐射反作用估计表明，在外部磁场存在时周期轨道可存活不到一小时至数天；在此期间，LISA对五维旋转黑洞的信噪比为7--31，而Kerr黑洞约为15--54。

English: We study periodic orbits of charged particles in the equatorial plane of a five-dimensional ($D=5$) rotating Myers--Perry black hole (BH) immersed in a uniform magnetic field, and the gravitational waves emitted by these orbits in an extreme mass-ratio inspiral. All results are compared with the Kerr BH in the uniform magnetic field. We find that a charged particle is much more weakly bound to the $D=5$ dimensional BH, i.e. its energy at the innermost stable circular orbit is close to unity, $0.95$--$0.99$, compared with $0.78$--$0.94$ for the Kerr BH, and the depth of the potential well is several times smaller. As a result, the periodic orbits of the $D=5$ dimensional BH lie much closer to the separatrix. The magnetic field can make the azimuthal frequency of the orbit smaller than the radial one and produces loops in the orbits far from the BH. Using the numerical kludge method, we compute the gravitational waveforms for a compact object of $10M_\odot$ orbiting a BH of $10^6M_\odot$. At the same magnetic field, the $D=5$ dimensional signal has a longer period, lower frequencies, and an amplitude smaller by about $18\%$. We show that for the magnetic parameter $\beta M=0.02$ the strongest spectral line is at $7.9$\,mHz, compared with $9.9$\,mHz for the Kerr BH. An estimate of the radiation reaction shows that the periodic orbits survive from less than an hour to a few days in the presence of an external magnetic field. Over these lifetimes, the signal-to-noise ratio for LISA is $7$--$31$ for the rotating BH in $D=5$ dimensions, compared to the Kerr BH where it is about $15$--$54$.

Yu-Peng E, Hai-Long Jia, Chun-Chun Zhu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们研究了 f(R,T)=R+αT 引力中厚膜的张量扰动与准正规模（QNMs）。从背景厚膜解出发，我们推导了引力扰动的类薛定谔方程并构造相应的有效势。该有效势呈现双势垒结构，其性质依赖于模型参数。我们分析了透射谱，发现共振峰与准正规模实部吻合良好。参数 b 和 α 主要分别控制势垒的宽度和高度。我们使用时域演化和直接积分方法提取 QNMs，低阶模式结果一致。由于更强的阻尼和数值污染，高阶泛音越来越难以提取。我们的结果表明，f(R,T) 修正会显著影响有效势和准正规模谱，为修改引力在膜世界扰动中留下可能印记。

English: We study tensor perturbations and quasinormal modes (QNMs) of thick branes in $f(R,T)=R+\alpha T$ gravity. Starting from the background thick brane solutions, we derive the Schr\"odinger-like equation for gravitational perturbations and construct the corresponding effective potential. The effective potential exhibits a double-barrier structure whose properties depend on the model parameters. We analyze transmission spectra and find good agreement between resonance peaks and the real parts of the quasinormal frequencies. The parameters $b$ and $\alpha$ mainly control the width and height of the potential barriers, respectively. QNMs are extracted using both time-domain evolution and direct integration methods, showing consistent results for low-lying modes. Higher overtones become increasingly difficult to extract due to stronger damping and numerical contamination. Our results indicate that $f(R,T)$ corrections significantly affect both the effective potential and the quasinormal spectrum, providing a possible imprint of modified gravity in braneworld perturbations.

中文摘要：我们证明了本文所考虑的全Kerr实现及其所有连通覆盖时空的C^0-不可延拓性。该结果在正质量且非零转动下成立，涵盖亚极端、极端和超极端情形。奇异环处的阻碍由固定端点因果同伦类中无界的固有时表述。它在每个正连续共形重标度下以及Kerr因果锥的连续加宽下持续存在，且无需任何全局因果性假设。我们给出了固定坐标范数下对稳态和轴对称扰动的尖锐界，并描述了在环附近遇到任意大曲率的完整类时测地线。

English: We prove the $C^0$-inextendibility of the full Kerr realizations considered in this paper and all their connected covering spacetimes. The result holds for positive mass and nonzero rotation in the subextremal, extremal, and overextremal regimes. The obstruction at the singular ring is expressed by unbounded proper time in a fixed-endpoint causal homotopy class. It persists under every positive continuous conformal rescaling and under continuous widening of the Kerr causal cones, without any global causality assumption. We give sharp bounds in a fixed coordinate norm for stationary and axisymmetric perturbations and describe complete timelike geodesics that encounter arbitrarily large curvature near the ring.

中文摘要：本文构造在圆作用下不变、并满足带正宇宙学常数的静态爱因斯坦方程的平滑黎曼度规与标量势。底流形是一个球体挖去两个不相交开球所得的区域；势（失效函数）在内部为正、在边界为零，形成三个非退化视界。两个内边界的面积由两个黑洞质量参数控制。两个内视界半径分别随各自质量参数线性缩放，参考中心间距按总质量的立方根缩放；这些尺度以不同速率足够小，而宇宙学尺度固定。主要分析难点是在收缩视界附近、中心之间以及外部区域同时控制线性化方程与非线性余项。作者用加权 Hölder 估计控制逆的增长，并证明将 Kottler 环套与 de Sitter 空间拼接的近似误差足以闭合压缩论证。具体而言，作者求解一个带两个障碍张量的约化椭圆爱因斯坦方程，通过改变两个轴向位置消除其系数，并利用收缩 Bianchi 恒等式及辅助 Killing 向量的能量估计使投影消失。最后，对固定宇宙学常数，两个边界分量之一的內禀度规足以确定一个内部单连通、边界梯度非零的静态解，直至等距和势乘以正常数。

English: We construct smooth Riemannian metrics and scalar potentials that are invariant under a circle action and satisfy the static Einstein equations with positive cosmological constant. The underlying compact three-manifold is a ball with two disjoint open balls removed. The potential (or lapse function) is positive in the interior and vanishes at the boundary, consisting of three non-degenerate horizons. The areas of the two inner boundary components are controlled by two arbitrary parameters, namely the masses of the black holes, which are taken to be sufficiently small and comparable. Each inner horizon radius scales linearly with the individual mass parameters, while the separation of their reference centers scales as the cube root of the total mass. These two scales are assumed to be sufficiently small at different rates, whereas the cosmological length remains fixed. The main analytical challenge is to control the linearized equation and the nonlinear remainder simultaneously near the shrinking horizons, between the centers and in the outer region. Weighted H\"older estimates quantify the growth of the inverse and show that the error of an approximation joining Kottler collars to de Sitter space is small enough to close a contraction argument. Namely, we solve a reduced elliptic Einstein equation that is endowed with two obstruction tensors; varying the two axial positions removes their coefficients. The contracted Bianchi identity and an energy estimate for an auxiliary vector field (Killing field) introduced by the projection to vanish. Finally, for a fixed cosmological constant, the intrinsic metric of one of the two boundary components is sufficient to determine a static solution with simply connected interior and non-vanishing boundary gradient, up to isometry and multiplication of the potential by a positive constant.

English: We investigate how a local geometric critical point of the odd-parity Proca potential relates to the global quasibound spectrum in Schwarzschild spacetime. After normalization by $\mu^2$, the axial potential $V_{\rm ax}=(1-2M/r)[\ell(\ell+1)/r^2+\mu^2]$ has the same radial form as the timelike-geodesic effective potential. Its outer minimum and inner maximum merge at $r=6M$, the Schwarzschild innermost stable circular orbit, when $(M\mu_c)^2=\ell(\ell+1)/12$. With $\delta=1-(M\mu)^2/(M\mu_c)^2$, we derive exact fold scalings: stationary-point separation $\propto\delta^{1/2}$, barrier--well depth $\propto\delta^{3/2}$, and curvature magnitudes $\propto\delta^{1/2}$. Continued-fraction calculations for the first three axial quasibound branches with $\ell=1,2,3$, cross-checked for selected modes by independent Riccati shooting, show regular frequency continuation across the threshold and approximately linear near-critical behavior. At fixed radius the radial operator is affine in $\delta$, supporting a conditional simple-root analytic interpretation. The main result is the explicit distinction between geometric potential criticality and spectral degeneracy for the branches examined.

English: We discuss Einstein equations with a non-conserved energy-momentum $T^{\mu\nu}$. The energy-momentum tensor $\tilde{T}^{\mu\nu}$ on the right hand side of Einstein equations is expressed in the form $8\pi GT^{\mu\nu}-g^{\mu\nu}\Lambda+\Sigma^{\mu\nu}$ where $G$ is the Newton constant, $\Lambda$ is the cosmological term and $T^{\mu\nu}$ is the energy-momentum of an ideal fluid. The remaining part $\Sigma^{\mu\nu}$ describes the viscosity and a heat flow. We discuss space-time-dependent Newton ``constant" $G$ and the cosmological term $\Lambda$. The covariant conservation law for $\tilde{T}^{\mu\nu}$ imposes a relation between the energy-momentum (non)conservation and the variation of $G$ and $\Lambda$. The covariant derivative $\nabla_{\mu}T^{\mu\nu}$ can be related to the first law of thermodynamics and expressed by the temperature $T$ and the entropy $S$. The energy-momentum non-conservation in our models is a consequence of a diffusion of its constituting particles. We describe a gas of diffusing massive particles in a homogeneous isotropic space-time as a system with a time-dependent linear barotropic equation of state $P_{t}=w_{t}\rho_{t}$ with $0<w_{t}\leq \frac{1}{3}$. The gas of massive diffusing particles in an expanding universe tends in a limit of infinite time to the gas of diffusing massless particles. We obtain results on the energy density, entropy and phase space dstribution in a soluble model of massless relativistic particles in a spatially flat expanding universe.

Topological analysis of novel charged-AdS black hole solutions embedded in dark matter halos with quintessence field

Muhammad Yasir, Hafiza Bushra Mujahid, Faisal Javed, Shahid Qaisar · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文研究在存在NGC 4649型暗物质晕及周围精质场时，带电反德西特（AdS）黑洞的性质。我们从修改的Einstein场方程出发，纳入电荷、宇宙学常数、暗物质分布以及由变状态方程描述的精质场效应，构造相应的黑洞解。我们通过度规函数和视界结构分析所得时空几何，表明暗物质晕增强引力吸引，而精质场提供排斥贡献并显著改变时空的渐近行为。此外，我们结合Duan-φ映射拓扑理论与广义自由能方法研究热力学性质，从而一致地考察黑洞系统的拓扑结构、临界行为和稳定性条件。我们还研究相对于ω_q参考值的分数偏移，并观察到ω_q的变化会产生系统性变化，这突显了精质场在决定黑洞系统相结构和临界行为中的重要作用。

English: In this work, we investigate the properties of a charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole in the presence of a NGC 4649-type dark matter halo and a surrounding quintessence field. Starting from the modified Einstein field equations (EFEs), we construct the corresponding black hole solutions by incorporating the effects of electric charge, cosmological constant, dark matter distribution, and quintessence characterized by a variable equation of state. We analyze the resulting spacetime geometry through the metric function and horizon structure, showing that the dark matter halo strengthens the gravitational attraction, whereas the quintessence field provides a repulsive contribution that substantially alters the asymptotic behavior of the spacetime. Furthermore, the thermodynamic properties are investigated by applying the Duan-\(\phi\)-mapping topological theory together with the generalized free energy method. This framework allows us to examine the topological structure, critical behavior, and stability conditions of the black hole system in a consistent manner. We further study the fractional shifts relative to the reference value of \(\omega_q\) and observe that variations in \(\omega_q\) produce systematic changes which highlight the important role of the quintessence field in determining the phase structure and critical behavior of the black hole system.

一句话导读：该工作构造了嵌入NGC 4649型暗物质晕与精质场中的带电AdS黑洞解，并用Duan-φ映射拓扑理论和广义自由能方法分析其热力学、临界行为与稳定性。

相关度：medium — 论文主要属于经典引力框架下的黑洞解与黑洞热力学研究，涉及相变和临界行为，与“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关；虽处AdS背景，但摘要未涉及全息对偶或CFT字典。

利用天琴从随机引力波背景预报强透镜双黑洞事件率

Forecasting Strongly Lensed Binary Black Hole Rates from the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background with TianQin

Zheng-Cheng Liang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：毫赫兹随机引力波背景（SGWB）为恒星质量双黑洞（BBH）及其宇宙学并合历史提供了族群层面的探针。我们建立了一个仅使用天琴的框架，将SGWB给出的BBH族群约束传播到地面引力波探测器可探测的强透镜BBH并合预报中。该框架区分至少探测到一个像的透镜事件与两个像均被探测并成功关联的透镜系统。利用一年的模拟观测，我们推断BBH族群，并将所得后验通过带有像级选择的星系尺度透镜模型传播。对于所采用的系统放大率阈值 μ_sys ≥ 2，至少探测到一个像的透镜事件率中位数为 R_event^det=5.50×10^-4 yr^-1，而成功关联的双像透镜系统率中位数为 R_sys^det=2.54×10^-4 yr^-1；可探测系统比例中位数为 F_sys^det=3.35×10^-4。与仅先验传播相比，合并的16--84百分位宽度在事件率上减少6.5%，在系统率上减少6.4%，在系统比例上减少4.0%。我们的工作建立了毫赫兹SGWB推断与地面引力波观测的强透镜BBH并合预报之间的定量联系。

English: The millihertz stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) provides a population-level probe of stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) and their cosmic merger history. We develop a framework using TianQin alone to propagate SGWB-informed BBH population constraints into forecasts of strongly lensed BBH mergers detectable by ground-based gravitational-wave detectors. The framework distinguishes between lensed events with at least one detected image and lens systems in which both images are detected and successfully associated. Using a one-year mock observation, we infer the BBH population and propagate the resulting posterior through a galaxy-scale lensing model with image-level selection. For the adopted system-magnification threshold, \(\mu_{\rm sys}\ge 2\), the median predicted rate of lensed events with at least one detected image is \(R_{\rm event}^{\rm det}=5.50\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\), while the median rate of associated two-image lens systems is \(R_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=2.54\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\); the median detectable system fraction is \(\mathcal{F}_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=3.35\times10^{-4}\). Compared with the prior-only propagation, the pooled 16th--84th percentile widths decrease by 6.5\% for the event rate, 6.4\% for the system rate, and 4.0\% for the system fraction. Our work establishes a quantitative link between millihertz SGWB inference and forecasts of strongly lensed BBH mergers for ground-based gravitational-wave observations.

一句话导读：用天琴的SGWB族群推断预报地面探测器可探测的强透镜双黑洞事件率。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力/引力波天体物理与宇宙学，涉及强透镜双黑洞和SGWB预报；不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子信息。与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关，但非全息研究主线。

振铃双荷黑洞的引力波与 Einstein-Bumblebee-Maxwell 引力中的参数估计

Gravitational Waves from Ringing Dyonic Black Holes and Estimation of Parameters in Einstein-Bumblebee-Maxwell Gravity

Sikha Gogoi, Umananda Dev Goswami · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：本文在 Einstein-bumblebee-Maxwell 引力理论框架下，研究双荷 Reissner-Nordström 型黑洞在标量和引力扰动下的准正规模频率，采用六阶 Padé 平均 WKB 近似方法计算。作者分析了振荡频率和阻尼率对自由模型参数的依赖，并通过标量与引力扰动的时间演化验证 QNM 谱、从铃宕信号中提取主导 QNM。进一步使用 Fisher 分析方法，针对未来引力波探测器 LISA 估计黑洞参数；结果表明，对于质量约 10^6–10^8 倍太阳质量且红移较低的超大质量黑洞，QNM 信号信噪比较高；对于光度距离 3 Gpc 的代表性源，质量不小于 10^6 倍太阳质量时，探测器参考系中的黑洞质量和洛伦兹破坏参数可得到较好限制。

English: In this work, we investigate the quasinormal mode (QNM) frequencies of dyonic Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN)-like black holes associated with scalar and gravitational perturbations in the framework of Einstein-bumblebee-Maxwell gravity theory. The QNMs are calculated using the 6th-order Pad\'e averaged WKB approximation method. We analyse the dependence of oscillation frequencies and damping rate of the BHs for the free model parameters. To further verify the QNM spectrum, we study the time evolution of both the scalar and gravitational perturbations around the BHs and extract the dominant QNM from the resulting ringdown signal. Moreover, we try to estimate the BH parameters using Fisher analysis method for the future gravitational wave detector named Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). We found that for supermassive BHs with mass around $10^6$ -- $10^8 M_\odot$ and at lower redshifts, the signal-to-noise ratio for the detection of a QNM signal by the LISA is high. Further, for a representative source at a luminosity distance of $3$ Gpc, the BH mass at the detector reference frame and the Lorentz violating parameter are well constrained for supermassive BHs with mass $\ge 10^6.$

一句话导读：在 Einstein-bumblebee-Maxwell 引力中计算双荷黑洞 QNM，并评估 LISA 对黑洞质量和洛伦兹破坏参数的约束能力。

相关度：medium — 论文研究修改引力中黑洞准正规模与引力波参数估计，属于经典引力/QNM支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

精确的脉冲星计时阵列似然：用于引力波背景的更好低秩协方差

Accurate pulsar timing array likelihoods: better low-rank covariance for gravitational wave background

Heling Deng, Ken D. Olum, Rutger van Haasteren · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：在脉冲星计时阵列分析中，描述引力波背景的随机过程通常用离散频率、间隔约0.1 yr^{-1}的傅里叶基建模，其傅里叶域协方差为对角，并由相应频率的功率谱密度决定。尽管这种降秩建模显著加速似然评估并在许多情形下提供良好近似，但它对小于约0.1 yr^{-1}尺度的谱特征不敏感，可能导致参数推断有偏。我们通过最大化在从真实模型似然抽取的实现集合上平均的对数似然，引入一种更好的低频过程低秩协方差构造。在该方法中，基域协方差矩阵对整个模型谱敏感，且通常非对角。使用两个模拟数据集，我们证明相比传统傅里叶对角模型，似然精度提高且谱特征恢复更忠实。基准测试表明新模型计算成本与传统方法相当。

English: In pulsar timing array analyses, the stochastic process describing the gravitational wave background is typically modeled using a Fourier basis at discrete frequencies with an interval $\sim 0.1~\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, with a diagonal Fourier-domain covariance determined by the power spectral density at the corresponding frequencies. Although this rank-reduced modeling significantly accelerates likelihood evaluation and provides a good approximation in many scenarios, it can lead to biased parameter inference because it is insensitive to spectral features on scales smaller than $\sim 0.1~\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. We introduce a better construction of the low-rank covariance for low-frequency processes by maximizing the log-likelihood averaged over an ensemble of realizations drawn from the true model likelihood. In this approach, the basis-domain covariance matrix is sensitive to the entire model spectrum and is generally non-diagonal. Using two mock datasets, we demonstrate improved likelihood accuracy and more faithful recovery of spectral features compared to the conventional Fourier-diagonal model. Benchmark tests show that this new model requires a computational cost comparable to that of the conventional approach.

一句话导读：提出更精确的脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景低秩协方差建模方法。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力波背景的数据分析与似然建模，与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；不涉及全息、量子引力或用户重点的全息凝聚态等方向。

中子星—原初黑洞双星：动力学潮汐、共振锁定与引力波

Neutron Star--Primordial Black Hole Binaries: Dynamical Tides, Resonance Locking, and Gravitational Waves

Isaac Legred, Nicol\'as Yunes · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：中子星与质量低得多的原初黑洞的轨道演化，可能与典型致密双星显著不同。类似于太阳系巨行星—卫星系统中的动力学潮汐，可根据轨道构型加速旋近或诱导向外旋出。我们展示当中子星模式与轨道保持共振锁定时，引力波辐射如何介导这一演化。这些效应可能在脉冲星计时或引力波中留下可观测印记。

English: The orbital evolution of a neutron star and a much lower-mass primordial black hole can differ strikingly from that of typical compact binaries. Dynamical tides, analogous to those in the Solar System's giant planet-moon systems, can accelerate inspiral or induce outspiral, depending on the orbital configuration. We show how gravitational-wave emission mediates this evolution when neutron star modes remain locked in resonance with the orbit. These effects may leave observable signatures in pulsar timing or gravitational waves.

一句话导读：研究中子星—原初黑洞双星中动力学潮汐与共振锁定对轨道演化和引力波/脉冲星计时信号的影响。

非线性电动力学对旋转黑洞弦准正规模式的影响

Impact of nonlinear electrodynamics on quasinormal modes of rotating black strings

F. S. Mirekhtiary, I. Sakalli · gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：研究由负指数幂-Maxwell场产生的旋转反de Sitter黑洞弦的无质量标量扰动。电荷以 -Q r^p 进入度规函数，其中 p=2/(1-2s)；s=-1/2 时给出线性项和代数视界。由于旋转可视为静态弦的局域助推，旋转谱可由静态谱在频率依赖动量下精确得到。用Horowitz-Hubeny级数、Chebyshev配置和时间演化计算谱，每种方法在两套独立代码中实现，并与平面Schwarzschild-AdS极限核对。电荷有两种作用：在约化电荷 \hat q_c=0.72626 处，最弱阻尼的一对模式在虚轴上相遇，因此更强带电的弦无振荡衰减；在分支端点谱为精确超几何形式。大横向动量下，模式到光锥的距离按 k^{1/(1-4s)} 增长，替代中性膜的 k^{-1/5} 规律。旋转将例外点延续为电荷-旋转平面中的一条线，增加纯阻尼轴对称模式塔，且从不产生超辐射增长。此前用于该几何的近视界估计遗漏了所有这些效应。

English: We study massless scalar perturbations of rotating anti-de Sitter black strings sourced by a power-Maxwell field with negative exponent $s$. The charge enters the metric function as $-Qr^{p}$ with $p=2/(1-2s)$, and the case $s=-1/2$ gives a linear term with an algebraic horizon. Since rotation is a local boost of the static string, the rotating spectrum follows exactly from the static one evaluated at a frequency-dependent momentum. We compute the spectrum with the Horowitz-Hubeny series, Chebyshev collocation and time-domain evolution, each implemented in two independent codes and checked against the planar Schwarzschild-AdS limit. The charge acts in two ways. At the reduced charge $\hat q_c=0.72626$ the least damped pair of modes meets on the imaginary axis, so more strongly charged strings ring down without oscillation, and at the endpoint of the branch the spectrum is exactly hypergeometric. At large transverse momentum the distance of the modes from the light cone grows as $k^{1/(1-4s)}$, replacing the $k^{-1/5}$ law of the neutral brane. Rotation continues the exceptional point into a line in the plane of charge and rotation, adds a purely damped axisymmetric tower, and never produces superradiant growth. A near-horizon estimate used earlier for this geometry misses all of these effects.

一句话导读：研究功率-Maxwell非线性电动力学对旋转AdS黑洞弦标量准正规模式的影响，发现电荷可导致模式合并、纯阻尼与光锥间距新标度。

相关度：medium — 论文研究AdS黑洞弦的标量准正规模式，属于经典引力中的非线性电动力学效应，直接涉及用户重点的QNM与非线性演化，但未讨论全息对偶或凝聚态、探针膜等支线。

来自非局域状态方程的黑洞：视界几何、奇点结构与热力学

Black holes from a nonlocal equation of state: horizon geometry, singularity structure and thermodynamics

Hishan Farf\'an-Bachiloglu, C. R. Muniz, Francisco Tello-Ortiz · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：我们证明，各向异性流体的非局域状态方程可化为关于包围物质的线性方程，并在静态球对称 Kerr-Schild 几何中唯一选出 Yukawa 型密度分布。所得中性解具有有限程毛，在远距离被指数屏蔽，渐近质量是其唯一守恒荷，并给出精确的视界分类：无视界构型、类 Schwarzschild 黑洞、含 Cauchy 视界的双视界几何，以及质量和半径可闭式给出的极端构型。我们证明在整个双视界区间内，内表面重力的量值超过外视界。中心质量消失时，几何在静态支逼近整体单极子，在非静态支逼近 Kantowski-Sachs 型区域。奇点满足 Králak 强曲率判据，并在类空支沿非径向测地线为 Tipler 强奇点。中心质量消失时，尽管 Ricci 标量和 Kretschmann 标量平方根在原点发散，它们关于不变时空体积局部可积。非局域闭合关系的幂律推广给出用不完全 gamma 函数表示的解，在奇异核心与具有 de Sitter 核心的正规黑洞之间插值，且无需引入非线性电动力学。我们得到闭式表面重力、扩展第一定律恒等式和 Smarr 关系，并利用 Lambert 函数下支定位热容发散。最后，热力学拓扑区分出含一个缺陷的类 Schwarzschild 区间与含两个相反绕数缺陷的极端区间，这些缺陷在最大 Hawking 温度处合并。

English: We show that a nonlocal equation of state for an anisotropic fluid reduces to a linear equation for the enclosed matter and uniquely selects a Yukawa-type density profile in a static, spherically symmetric Kerr--Schild geometry. The resulting neutral solution has finite-range hair, exponentially screened at large distances, with the asymptotic mass as its only conserved charge, and admits an exact horizon classification: horizonless configurations, Schwarzschild-like black holes, two-horizon geometries with a Cauchy horizon, and an extremal configuration whose mass and radius are obtained in closed form. We prove that the magnitude of the inner surface gravity exceeds that of the outer horizon throughout the two-horizon regime. When the central mass vanishes, the geometry approaches a global monopole in the static branch and a Kantowski--Sachs-type region in the nonstatic branch. The singularity satisfies Kr\'olak's strong-curvature criterion and is Tipler-strong along non-radial geodesics in the spacelike branch. For vanishing central mass, the Ricci scalar and the square root of the Kretschmann scalar are locally integrable with respect to the invariant spacetime volume, despite diverging at the origin. A power-law generalization of the nonlocal closure yields solutions expressed through incomplete gamma functions, interpolating between the singular core and a regular black hole with a de~Sitter core, without invoking nonlinear electrodynamics. We obtain closed-form surface gravities, an extended first-law identity and a Smarr relation, and locate the heat-capacity divergence using the lower branch of the Lambert function. Finally, thermodynamic topology distinguishes a Schwarzschild-like regime with one defect from an extremal regime with two opposite-winding defects that merge at the maximum Hawking temperature.

一句话导读：在 Kerr-Schild 时空中由非局域状态方程导出 Yukawa 型毛状黑洞，并给出视界分类、奇点判据与闭式热力学关系。

相关度：high — 论文研究非局域状态方程构建的静态球对称黑洞精确解、视界分类、奇点结构和热力学，属于经典引力/广义相对论及黑洞热力学支线，不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶。
