含玻色暗物质混合态方程的超致密孪生星

Ultra-compact twin stars with hybrid equations of state from bosonic dark matter

Ishfaq Ahmad Rather, Sarah Louisa Pitz, J\"urgen Schaffner-Bielich · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph, nucl-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-27

中文摘要：研究了具有强一阶相变到夸克物质、并额外包含自相互作用玻色暗物质流体的致密星性质。我们发现，引入暗物质相对于朴素单流体判据改变了质量-半径构型的稳定性。对于质量相近而半径不同的致密星构型，即所谓孪生星，暗物质的存在消除了强子分支与混合分支之间的不稳定段，使向夸克物质相变开始后的稳定质量-半径序列变得连续。我们还发现稳定的超致密天体，定义为总致密度 C=M_tot/R_grav ≥ 1/3。观察到两类不同的超致密天体：暗物质晕类 f_DM ≳ 0.9，以及暗物质核类 f_DM ≲ 0.02。两类可由正常物质的表面红移区分：暗物质核类达到 z=0.734–0.808，暗物质晕类极端值为 z=2–3.468，从而可用红移区分两类。此外，暗物质晕类超致密天体的高红移可作为暗物质信号，因为其红移超过 Buchdahl 极限 z=2。最后，我们发现“终极孪生星”的混合星解：质量相近且可见半径相似，但暗物质含量不同，导致不同的潮汐形变和表面红移。未来对半径和质量超出允许中子星范围的超致密中子星进行 X 射线和引力测量，可借此探测暗物质的存在与性质，以及到夸克物质的一阶相变。

English: The properties of compact stars with a strong first-order phase transition to quark matter and with an additional fluid of self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM) are studied. We find that the inclusion of DM changes the stability of mass-radius configurations relative to the naive one-fluid criterion. For compact star configurations with similar masses and different radii, so-called twin stars, the presence of DM removes the unstable segment between the hadronic and the hybrid branch, so that the stable mass-radius sequence becomes continuous after the onset of the phase transition to quark matter. We furthermore find stable ultra-compact objects (UCOs), defined by a total compactness $C = M_\text{tot}/R_\text{grav} \ge 1/3$. We observe two distinct classes of UCOs: a DM-halo class with $f_\text{DM} \gtrsim 0.9$, and a DM-core class at $f_\text{DM} \lesssim 0.02$. The two classes can be separated by the surface redshift of the normal matter, which reaches $z = 0.734 - 0.808$ for the DM-core and extreme values of $z = 2 - 3.468$ for the DM-halo class, allowing us to use their redshift as a way to disentangle the two classes. Furthermore, the high redshift of the DM-halo UCOs could serve as a signal of DM since their redshift exceeds the Buchdahl limit of $z = 2$. Finally, we find hybrid star solutions of ``ultimate twins" with similar masses and visible radii, but different dark matter content, leading to different tidal deformabilities and surface redshifts. 中文摘要：我们评估经电磁证认的超大质量黑洞双星候选体是否位于引力波振幅分布中罕见的高振幅尾部。利用拟合NANOGrav 15年数据的超大质量黑洞双星族群模型，我们发现3C 66B和Mrk 501可能从引力波背景中突出，因而是个体源搜索的有希望目标。此外，我们表明个体探测可以检验双星硬化机制，因为具有强环境硬化的模型预测，可个体分辨的双星丰度高于纯引力波驱动模型。应用相同的族群拟合并考虑未分辨族群的混淆噪声，我们预测平方公里阵列天文台（SKAO）将分辨出数十个个体双星，其中3C 66B可被稳健探测。

Amitesh Singh, Nathan K. Johnson-McDaniel, Anuradha Gupta, Khun Sang Phukon · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：为了描述一般的束缚双黑洞系统，需要考虑轨道偏心率和黑洞自旋矢量与轨道角动量的错位。双黑洞在形成时往往具有不可忽略的偏心率，动力学相互作用也可能在引力波探测器频段内产生具有不可忽略偏心率的双星。每个黑洞自旋矢量与双星轨道角动量之间的夹角（自旋倾角）在形成时也携带形成通道的信息。引力波天文学中推断的自旋倾角通常是双星处于引力波探测器频段时的倾角，因此需要将双星反向演化以计算形成时的倾角。对于某些双星，无限轨道角动量形式极限下的倾角（无穷远倾角）可作为形成时倾角的近似。此外，完全轨道平均演化到形成时在许多情况下计算上不可行，而用于计算无穷远倾角的混合演化则可行。我们因此将公开的 tilts_at_infinity 代码推广到偏心、自旋进动双星，以计算无穷远倾角。该代码采用混合后牛顿演化：先对较高频率进行轨道平均演化，再过渡到进动平均演化以计算无穷远倾角。我们发现准圆情形使用的过渡频率在偏心情形下仍给出可接受的小误差，并表明偏心率和混合演化对许多双星的无穷远倾角都有显著影响。我们还给出了在偏心情形下无穷远倾角是否是形成时倾角良好近似的例子。

English: To describe a general bound binary black hole system, we need to consider orbital eccentricity and the misalignment of black holes' spin vectors with respect to the orbital angular momentum. Binary black holes often have a non-negligible eccentricity at formation, and dynamical interactions could produce binaries with non-negligible eccentricity in the bands of gravitational-wave (GW) detectors. The angle between each black hole's spin vector and the binary's orbital angular momentum (referred to as the spin tilt) at formation also carries information about the formation channel. The spin tilts inferred in GW astronomy are usually those when the binary is in the band of a GW detector. Therefore, it is necessary to evolve the binary back in time to compute the tilts at formation. For certain binaries, the tilts in the formal limit of infinite orbital angular momentum, also known as tilts at infinity, could be a useful approximation to those at formation. Additionally, full orbit-averaged evolution to formation could be computationally infeasible in many situations, while the hybrid evolution we use to compute the tilts at infinity would be feasible. We thus generalize the publicly available tilts_at_infinity code to compute the tilts at infinity for eccentric, spin-precessing binaries. This code employs hybrid post-Newtonian evolution, starting with orbit-averaged evolution for higher frequencies and then transitioning to precession-averaged evolution to compute the tilts at infinity. We find that the transition frequency used in the quasicircular case still gives acceptably small errors in the eccentric case, and show that eccentricity and hybrid evolution both have a significant effect on the tilts at infinity for many binaries. We also give examples of cases where the tilts at infinity are and are not a good approximation to the tilts at formation in the eccentric case. (Abridged)

English: I apply and extend the formalism of osculating orbits of Damour et al. (2004) and Lynch et al. (2026) to eccentric effective one body (EOB) models, in order to obtain an efficient yet accurate description of the inspiral-to-plunge dynamics of tidal, spinning compact binaries, including precessing ones by twisting the otherwise planar motion. The method is recast in terms of equinoctial orbital elements, to circumvent singularities associated with the zero-eccentricity limit. While the formalism is general and can be applied to any EOB model, I focus here on the TEOBResumS-Dal\'i family and demonstrate how this technique speeds up waveform generation without significantly compromising the accuracy of the model. 中文摘要：视界的能量流和角动量流是黑洞动力学中的关键强场效应，可编码黑洞本质的直接信息。本文对 Kerr 黑洞赤道测地线上试验粒子产生的这些流进行数值研究，覆盖圆轨道、偏心轨道和双曲轨道，并扫描广泛轨道参数与黑洞自旋。我们复现了圆轨道的已知结果，并在偏心与双曲轨道中发现更丰富的现象：瞬时流可出现多峰和变号，表明轨道动力学与视界扰动之间存在复杂相互作用。随后将这些结果与现有后牛顿解析表达式比较，探索重求和策略以改善其相对数值数据的表现。特别地，我们提出视界流的因子化重求和表示，对束缚构型的能量流和角动量流，在 ≳83% 情形下将超辐射区间起始频率预测到 10% 以内；但高能开放轨道仍是挑战。该表示按构造精确退化为圆轨道极限，且不依赖于其余解析项的微扰阶数。对于峰值流和轨道平均流，解析模型在大间距和低偏心率下达到可接受精度（相对误差约 10% 或更低），但在强场区域可出现约 O(100%) 的偏差，说明需要改进通量处方并进一步研究。

English: Horizon fluxes of energy and angular momentum are a key strong-field effect in the dynamics of black holes, encoding direct information about their nature. In this work, we present a numerical study of these fluxes for a test particle orbiting a Kerr black hole on equatorial geodesics, covering circular, eccentric, and hyperbolic trajectories across a wide range of orbital parameters and black hole spins. We reproduce known results for circular orbits and uncover a richer phenomenology for eccentric and hyperbolic ones: the instantaneous fluxes can exhibit multiple peaks and sign changes, indicating a complex interplay between orbital dynamics and horizon perturbation. We then compare these results against existing analytical post-Newtonian expressions, exploring resummation strategies to improve their performance against numerical data. In particular, we propose a factorized and resummed representation of the horizon fluxes that predicts the onset frequency of the superradiant regime to within $10\%$ for $\gtrsim 83\%$ for both the energy and angular momentum fluxes of bound configurations; high-energy open orbits however remain a challenge. This representation exactly reduces to the circular limit by construction, independently of the perturbative order of the remaining analytical terms. For peak and orbit-averaged fluxes, the analytical models achieve acceptable accuracy -- with relative errors at the $10\%$ level or below -- at large separations and low eccentricities. However, they can exhibit deviations of $\sim \mathcal{O}(100\%)$ in the strong-field regime, motivating the need for improved flux prescriptions and further investigations.

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列很快将能够分辨出在纳赫兹频率上对随机引力波背景贡献最大的超大质量黑洞双星。虽然几十年的观测通常不足以看到这些双星的频率演化，但所谓的脉冲星项提供了窥视过去的窗口，可以帮助我们描绘这些双星在数万年尺度上的频率演化。测量这种长期频率演化可以让我们寻找由各种环境效应导致的偏离真空双星演化的迹象。我们发展了一种 Fisher 矩阵方法，用来计算以这种方式随时间跟踪频率的精度，并在具有30年基线的现实近未来脉冲星计时阵列上演示其用途。我们发现，对于我们考虑的圆轨道双星，环绕双星盘的二维流体动力学模拟所预测的环境效应不太可能被探测到，但在某些情况下，如果忽略它们，可能会导致啁啾质量恢复出现偏差。我们还展示了该方法如何检验纯引力波驱动旋近中广义相对论预测的轨道演化，并对由幂律硬化模型描述的额外一般环境效应给出上限。

English: Pulsar timing arrays will soon be able to resolve the loudest supermassive black hole binaries contributing to the stochastic gravitational wave background at nanohertz frequencies. While the few decades of observations are typically not enough to see these binaries evolve in frequency, the so-called pulsar terms offer a glimpse into the past and can help us map out the frequency evolution of these binaries over tens of thousands of years. Measuring this long-term frequency evolution can allow us to look for deviations from a vacuum binary evolution due to various environmental effects. We develop a Fisher-matrix approach to calculate how precisely the frequency can be tracked over time in this manner, and demonstrate its use on a realistic near-future pulsar timing array with a 30-year baseline. We find that the environmental effects predicted by 2-dimensional hydrodynamic simulations of circumbinary disks are unlikely to be detectable in the circular binaries we considered, however, in some cases they might result in biased chirp mass recovery if ignored. We also demonstrate how this approach allows one to test the orbital evolution predicted by general relativity in a purely gravitational-wave driven inspiral, and to put upper limits on additional generic environmental effects described by a power-law hardening model.

Jaume de Haro, Emilio Elizalde · physics.hist-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：本文从操作性和动力学原理出发重构广义相对论，而非以时空几何为起点。作者将有质量自由粒子的“conatus”等同于其沿驻定固有时世界线运动的自然倾向，并将引力解释为物质改变局部固有时速率的“potentia”。通过要求伽利略自由落体精确成立，确定弱场静态不变量；再对静态解作洛伦兹变换并对源元推迟贡献进行因果叠加，得到运动源的引力场，其线性化场方程与谐和规范下的广义相对论一致。最后，结合能量动量守恒与二阶场方程要求，在所述假设和 Lovelock 定理下得到唯一的协变完成，即爱因斯坦场方程。几何并非预先假设，而是作为基于固有时、惯性和自由落体的操作动力学之最终数学综合而出现。

English: Classical natural philosophy sought the natural law governing the motion of free bodies long before daring to construct the appropriate mathematical formalism. Following this longstanding methodological perspective, in the present work General Relativity is reconstructed from operational and dynamical principles, rather than taking spacetime geometry as its starting point. The \textit{conatus} of a massive free particle is identified with its natural tendency to follow a worldline of stationary proper time, which, under the appropriate local conditions, corresponds to a maximum of its proper time, whereas gravitation is interpreted as the \textit{potentia} of matter to modify the local rate of proper time. By requiring the exact validity of Galilean free fall, the weak-field static invariant is determined. The gravitational field of moving sources is subsequently obtained by Lorentz-transforming the elementary static solution and causally superposing the retarded contributions of infinitesimal source elements. The resulting linearized field equations coincide with those of General Relativity in the harmonic gauge. Finally, imposing general energy-momentum conservation together with the requirement of second-order field equations yields--- within the class of theories satisfying the stated assumptions and by virtue of Lovelock's theorem---the unique covariant completion represented by Einstein's field equations. Within this construction, geometry is not postulated from the outset; instead, it emerges as the final mathematical synthesis of operational dynamics based on proper time, inertia, and free fall.

一句话导读：从固有时、惯性与自由落体的操作动力学原理出发，重构线性化引力并经由 Lovelock 定理唯一完成到爱因斯坦场方程。

English: X-ray quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) were reported for 19 different observations of the atoll source 4U 1728- 34. Three of them reveal triplets of QPOs: a lower and a upper kHz QPOs and a low-frequency QPO. Even though they are discernible only after averaging we assume them to be simultaneous. We apply a separate model (formula) for each of the three frequencies of the observed QPOs and compose a system which contains three algebraic equations for the three unknown parameters - the mass and the specific angular momentum of the central neutron star, and the radius of the orbit of orgin of the given triplet of QPOs, which allows us to find the numerical values of the later. Error propagation formulas are applied for the obtaining of interval estimates of the parameters of the star. This is done through implicit function differentiation. The calculations are repeated with several different models for the kHz QPOs.

Linear Stability and a Turning Point Principle for Barotropic Liquid Stars with a Free Boundary in General Relativity

Zeming Hao, Jianchao Xu · math.AP, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：我们研究描述被真空包围的液态星的 Einstein-Euler 系统球对称、渐近平坦稳态的线性稳定性。状态方程具有正表面密度、正因果声速以及渐近线性的高密度极限。我们构造平衡态族，并推导带有 Robin 边界条件的线性化方程。线性化算子具有离散实谱，其负 Morse 指数等于增长模式数。我们证明，中心红移较大的稳态周围的线性化算子存在增长模式，而中心红移较小的稳态不存在此类增长模式。平衡态族的参数导数给出线性化方程的一个正则内部零解，其边界缺陷是总质量参数导数的非零倍数。这给出转折点原理：核恰好在质量临界点处为一维，且穿越特征值的符号由质量-半径曲线的弯曲决定。

English: We study the linear stability of spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat steady states of the Einstein-Euler system describing a liquid star surrounded by vacuum. The equation of state has positive surface density, positive causal sound speed, and an asymptotically linear high-density limit. We construct the equilibrium family and derive the linearized equation with a Robin boundary condition. The linearized operator has discrete real spectrum, and its negative Morse index equals the number of growing modes. We prove that the linearized operator around steady states with large central redshift admits a growing mode, while such growing modes do not exist for steady states with small central redshift. A parameter derivative of the equilibrium family provides a regular interior zero solution of the linearized equation, whose boundary defect is a nonzero multiple of the parameter derivative of the total mass. This gives a turning point principle: the kernel is one-dimensional precisely at mass critical points, and the sign of the crossing eigenvalue is determined by the bending of the mass-radius curve.

一句话导读：证明 Einstein-Euler 液态星稳态的线性稳定性与质量-半径曲线转折点相关，并给出大中心红移下增长模式的存在性。

L. Herrera, A. Di prisco · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

English: In this study we analyze the effects produced by the sudden appearance of a time-like Killing vector (TKV), on the evolution of radiating geodesic fluids. This is achieved by resorting to the concept of asymmetry factor which allows the instantaneous appearance of a given symmetry for a given value of the time-like coordinate. All relevant physical variables are analyzed in detail showing the imprints of the emergence of TKV at some point of the evolution. The main lesson that can be extracted from the obtained results is that the sudden appearance of a TKV, even for an infinitesimal period of time, drastically changes the subsequent evolution of the system. Of particular relevance is the appearance of a thermal effect linking the asymmetry factor and the relaxation time. The potential applications of these results, on the study of gravitational collapse, are discussed at the end of the paper.

相对论塑性

Relativistic Plasticity

Joshua (Tom), Cadogan, Nils Andersson, Ian Hawke, Thomas Celora · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：中子星的弹性壳层长期以来被认为是中子星物理诸多相关方面的关键因素。然而，当前最先进的弹性理论局限于微扰范围，并未考虑永久塑性形变，而后者应当与脉冲星glitch、磁星耀发以及引力波的连续辐射有关。塑性在历史上一直是一个难以建模的现象——即使在牛顿力学框架下也是如此。这主要归因于其耗散性质以及为一致再现观测现象所需的多尺度方法。本文通过利用耗散流体变分建模的最新进展来应对第一个挑战，将相对论弹性理论扩展至包含塑性现象。所得理论具有与现代牛顿形式体系相同的自由度，同时现在与广义相对论相容。随后使用热力学第二定律在相对论框架下引入塑性理论的屈服准则。

English: The elastic crust of a neutron star has long been established as a key player in relevant aspects of neutron star physics. However, the state-of-the-art theory of elasticity is restricted to the perturbative domain and does not account for permanent plastic deformations which should be relevant for pulsar glitches, magnetar flares, and the continuous emission of gravitational waves. Plasticity, however, is a historically challenging phenomenon to model - even in the Newtonian regime. This is owed mainly to its dissipative character and the multiscale methods required to consistently reproduce observed phenomena. In this work, we address this first challenge by making use of recent developments in the variational modelling of dissipative fluids to extend the theory of relativistic elasticity to include plastic phenomenology. The resulting theory possesses the same freedoms as the modern Newtonian formalism, while now being compatible with general relativity. The second law of thermodynamics is then used to introduce the yield criterion of plasticity theory in the relativistic setting.

一句话导读：将相对论弹性理论扩展至包含塑性现象，并利用热力学第二定律给出相对论屈服准则。

中文摘要：原初引力波可用来探测暴胀，但其解释依赖于它们此后的演化。在畴壁主导时期，冻结的壁网络保留非零的剪切响应，可能改变原初引力波在超视界尺度上的演化。作者从成壁标量场出发，在薄壁、准静态极限下推导出有效张量质量项以及与冻结壁几何相关的源项。二者共同驱动超视界张量扰动趋向由该网络设定的位形；该位形同时携带继承的原初形变和网络内禀随机结构。作者进一步推导这些贡献如何进入张量传递函数和功率谱，从而把超视界张量演化与微观壁响应以及网络冻结时建立的几何联系起来。

English: Primordial gravitational waves probe inflation, but their interpretation depends on their subsequent evolution. During domain-wall domination, a frozen wall network retains a nonzero shear response that can modify the superhorizon evolution of primordial gravitational waves. Starting from the wall-forming scalar field, we derive an effective tensor mass term and a source associated with the frozen wall geometry in the thin-wall, quasistatic limit. Together they drive superhorizon tensor perturbations toward a configuration set by the network. This configuration carries both any inherited primordial deformation and the network's intrinsic random structure. We derive how these contributions enter the tensor transfer and power spectrum. The resulting description connects superhorizon tensor evolution to the microscopic wall response and the geometry established as the network freezes.

Finite-distance effects and scalar suppression in massive gravity

Chris Choi, Tina Kahniashvili, Barnab\'as P\'oczos · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）通过计时残差的角交叉相关探测随机引力波背景。对于广义相对论中的引力波背景，预期的重叠约化函数（ORF）由 Hellings-Downs 相关给出。本文研究非零引力子质量如何通过大质量色散关系以及额外的矢量与标量极化修正这一预言，并产生修正后的有效 ORF。在大质量极限下，有限距离的脉冲星项在角度平均后仍保留，并以依赖脉冲星的因子乘上三个极化扇区的相关，从而增强、抑制或反转这些相关。作者采用张量地球-地球归一化以保留连续的有限距离效应。在无质量极限下，矢量 ORF 消失，标量 ORF 趋近于有限的呼吸模式。文中提出唯象方案 Ω_S/Ω_T=A_S(m_g/ω)^{n_S}，其中 A_S 为标量幅度参数，n_S>0 为抑制指数。这些结果为未来 PTA 对大质量引力的分析提供了统一框架。

English: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) probe the stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background through the angular cross-correlations of timing residuals. For a GW background in general relativity (GR), the expected overlap reduction function (ORF) is given by the Hellings--Downs (HD) correlation. We investigate how a nonzero graviton mass modifies this prediction through a massive dispersion relation and additional vector and scalar polarizations, producing a modified effective ORF. In the massive limit, the finite-distance pulsar terms survive angular averaging, multiplying the correlations of all three polarization sectors by a pulsar-dependent factor that can enhance, suppress, or reverse them. We adopt a tensor Earth--Earth normalization that preserves the continuous finite-distance effect. In the massless limit, we find that the vector ORF vanishes and the scalar ORF approaches a finite breathing mode. We propose the phenomenological prescription $\Omega_S/\Omega_T=A_S(m_g/\omega)^{n_S}$, with scalar amplitude parameter $A_S$ and suppression index $n_S>0$. These results provide a consistent framework for future PTA analyses of massive gravity.

分离形式下 Bianchi 模型的规范不变标架

Gauge Invariant Frames of Bianchi Models in Separated Form

Dave B. H. Verweg, Robbert W. Scholtens · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：Bianchi 时空通常写成分离形式：度规系数只依赖宇宙时，空间依赖由不变余标架承载，从而使几何量和 Einstein 方程化为含时系统。但观测者和引力波适配规范常混合时间与空间，均匀性虽保留，可分离性却不再显式。作者仅利用空间 Killing 代数给出分离标架的规范不变重构：由 [ξ_a,X_i]=0 构造不变空间标架并对偶得到 e_i，使度规在任意规范下取 g=γ_{μν}(t)e^μe^ν。文中证明该构造的微分同胚协变性，并在 Bianchi II 例子中展示计算优势；该框架恢复 Jantzen 意义下的规范适配构造，且在任意 Diff(M) 规范变换下稳定，适用于引力波 Bianchi 模型及近期关注的精确解，并给出 Bianchi VII 型例子。

English: Bianchi spacetimes are usually written in separated form: metric coefficients depend only on cosmic time, while spatial dependence is carried by an invariant coframe. In this representation, geometric quantities and the Einstein equations reduce to a time-dependent system. In practice, however, observer- and gravitational-wave-adapted gauges mix time and space (e.g., from integrability-adapted to synchronous comoving coordinates). Homogeneity is preserved, but separability is no longer manifest, which complicates computation. To address this, we give a gauge-invariant reconstruction of separated frames using only the spatial Killing algebra. Given a basis $\{\xi_a\}$, we construct an invariant spatial frame $\{X_i\}$ from $[\xi_a,X_i]=0$, then dualize to $\{e_i\}$. The metric then takes the canonical form $g=\gamma_{\mu\nu}(t) e^\mu e^\nu$ in any gauge. We prove diffeomorphism covariance of the construction, and demonstrate computational gain in a Bianchi II example. The framework recovers canonical adapted-gauge constructions (in the sense of Jantzen) while remaining stable under arbitrary $\operatorname{Diff}(M)$ gauge transformations, and is directly suited to gravitational-wave Bianchi models and related exact solutions of recent interest of which we give a example of the Bianchi VII type.

一句话导读：用空间 Killing 代数规范不变地重构 Bianchi 分离标架，使 Einstein 方程在任意规范下保持显式分离形式。

Gravitational waves from inclined orbits around Kerr black holes

Yi-Han Huang, Sen Guo, Yu Liang, Lin Wen, Kai Lin · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：一般倾斜轨道上的极端质量比旋近为强场引力提供了关键动力学探针，因为它们能独特地打破赤道面轨道固有的严重参数简并。为分离精确的转动特征，作者将周期轨道框架推广到Kerr时空中的三维倾斜轨迹，重点研究r-θ轨道共振。通过将测地线运动映射到以Mino时间参数化的共进动空间框架，计算辐射的四极波形，并用保持圆性的辐射反作用演化局部动力学。结果表明，参考系拖曳会在近星点诱导瞬态动力学倾斜，从而将辐射直接分裂为精确的五梳谱结构。当在单个相干时间内分辨该共振结构时，无量纲自旋的统计误差可降至σ_a≈10^-2，较赤道基线最多改善两个数量级。由于静态球对称时空中任何束缚轨道最多产生三个频率梳，探测到该五梳层级可建立严格的、模型无关的零检验，以排除球对称几何。

English: Extreme mass ratio inspirals on generic inclined orbits provide a critical dynamical probe of strong field gravity, as they uniquely break the severe parameter degeneracies inherent to planar equatorial trajectories. To isolate the exact rotational signatures, we extend the periodic-orbit framework to three-dimensional inclined trajectories in the Kerr spacetime, specifically focusing on the $r$--$\theta$ orbital resonances. By mapping the geodesic motion into a co-precessing spatial framework parameterized by Mino time, we compute the emitted quadrupole waveforms and evolve the local dynamics using circularity-preserving radiation reaction. It is demonstrated that frame-dragging induces a transient dynamical tilt at periastron, which directly splits the emitted radiation into an exact five-comb spectral architecture. When this resonant structure is resolved over a single coherence time, the statistical error on the dimensionless spin is reduced to $\sigma_a \approx 10^{-2}$, improving upon the equatorial baseline by up to two orders of magnitude. Because any bound orbit in a static, spherically symmetric spacetime generates a maximum of three frequency combs, the detection of this five-comb hierarchy establishes a rigorous, model-independent null test to strictly exclude spherical geometries.

English: Motivated by the recent rebuttal of black hole--dark matter solutions based on velocity-matching, we reconstruct the spacetime by treating the dark matter halo density directly as an energy-density source in the Einstein field equations. We obtain an exact static, spherically symmetric black hole solution and investigate the effects of the halo on its geometry, optical properties, quasinormal modes, and thermodynamics. Using null geodesics, we show that the halo modifies photon trajectories, shifts the circular photon orbit, and enlarges the photon sphere and apparent shadow. The Lyapunov exponent of the unstable null orbit further determines the eikonal quasinormal modes, yielding explicit halo-induced corrections to their oscillation and damping rates. We also compute the mass, Hawking temperature, entropy, heat capacity, and Gibbs free energy to characterize the thermodynamic stability and phase structure. We find that the dark matter halo enlarges the domain of thermodynamic stability and introduces nontrivial phase behavior absent in the Schwarzschild case, demonstrating that astrophysical dark matter environments can leave potentially observable imprints on black hole observables.

English: We present an exact solution to the Einstein-Maxwell equations that describes a static black hole coexisting with anisotropic matter immersed in an external magnetic field, obtained via the Harrison transformation. Our findings reveal that an increase in the anisotropic matter parameter systematically suppresses the local chaotic behavior, as indicated by a reduction in the Lyapunov exponent. Conversely, variations in the external magnetic field lead to qualitative changes in global chaotic behavior. This is analyzed through Poincar\'e sections, which demonstrate transitions between regular and chaotic trajectories resulting from the nonlinear gravitational-magnetic interactions. These factors play distinct yet complementary roles in shaping chaotic particle dynamics around black holes. This study would offer a new theoretical framework for exploring nonintegrable particle motion within magnetized black hole spacetimes.

Cardy 随机矩阵理论

Cardy random matrix theory

Marco Ambrosini, Alexandre Belin, Jan de Boer, Julian Sonner · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：我们构建并研究一个“Cardy 随机矩阵模型”：在最大无知规定下，其唯一输入是 S-模不变性约束。我们通过对固定宽度能量窗进行粗粒化来正则化该约束，并得到单个随机矩阵的势，其本征值扮演二维 CFT 原初场标度维数的角色。该势在黑洞阈值以上的能隙之上将粗粒化态密度驱动到 Cardy 分布。我们进行蒙特卡洛模拟以确认这一行为，发现粗粒化态密度吻合良好，同时揭示近邻本征值服从 GUE 统计。我们确定了这些现象出现的标度极限。在此极限下，模型实现尺度层级：在由窗口大小给出的宏观尺度，占据数被冻结，bootstrap 约束刚性固定谱为 Cardy 分布；在介观尺度（窗口内部），Vandermonde 排斥像随机矩阵理论中那样重新排列本征值；只有在平均能级间距的微观尺度，单个能级才被分辨。因此，我们的随机矩阵模型显示出由粗粒化窗口能量宽度倒数设定的有效 Thouless 时间。该模型为在计算机上求解与三维量子引力对偶的矩阵/张量模型迈出第一步。

English: We construct and study a ``Cardy random matrix model'': a random matrix theory whose only input, in a maximal-ignorance prescription, is the constraint of $\mathbb{S}$-modular invariance. We regularize this constraint by coarse-graining over energy windows of fixed width, and obtain a potential for a single random matrix whose eigenvalues play the role of the scaling dimensions of primaries in a 2d CFT. The potential drives the coarse-grained density of states to the Cardy profile above a gap at the black hole threshold. We perform Monte Carlo simulations to confirm this behavior and find good agreement for the coarse-grained density of states, while at the same time revealing GUE statistics for nearby eigenvalues. We identify the scaling limit in which these phenomena emerge. In this limit, the model realizes a hierarchy of scales: at the macroscopic scale given by the window size, the occupations are frozen and the bootstrap constraint rigidly fixes the spectrum to the Cardy profile, while at the mesoscopic scale (inside a window) the Vandermonde repulsion rearranges the eigenvalues as in a random matrix theory. It is only at the microscopic scale of the mean level spacing that the individual levels are resolved. Accordingly, our random matrix model displays an effective Thouless time, set by the inverse energy width of the coarse-graining window. Our model provides a first step towards solving the matrix/tensor model dual to 3D quantum gravity on a computer.

一句话导读：构建受 S-模不变性约束的 Cardy 随机矩阵模型，并用蒙特卡洛展示粗粒化态密度趋于 Cardy 分布及 GUE 统计。

线性化爱因斯坦方程的一阶结构：常曲率背景

First-Order Structure of the Linearised Einstein Equations: Constant-Curvature Backgrounds

Kirill Krasnov, Adam Shaw · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：Teukolsky 的解耦方程和 Wald 的度规重构伴随方法由二阶算符构成：线性化爱因斯坦算符 G、曲率提取算符 T、解耦算符 O 和重构算符 S^*，满足 SG=OT。作者证明，在四维非零 Lambda 的常曲率背景上，所有这些算符都通过单一中间变量——自旋联络自对偶部分的扰动——分解为一阶映射。还证明非零 Lambda 时度规扰动本身可由联络扰动经一阶映射得到。因此联络给出线性化引力的完整描述，四阶恒等式 SG=OT 可由单一二阶恒等式复合得到。利用共形平坦性选择 Hertz 势映射，使共形重标度后势逐分量满足平坦波方程。由此得到新的重构方案：势由曲率 psi 源化，而 psi 满足解耦的源方程；给定曲率通过二阶而非四阶方程达到，修正项对应力-能量张量是局域代数的。代价是必须确定完整曲率而非单一分量，且重构度规的实性成为条件；作者论证该条件对推迟解成立。以 de Sitter 空间中静态点质量为例，得到实度规扰动，与线性化 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 在微分同胚意义下一致。作者将这些结果视为 Kerr 上一阶 Teukolsky-Wald 框架的概念验证。

English: Teukolsky's decoupled equations and Wald's adjoint method of metric reconstruction are built from second-order operators: the linearised Einstein operator G, the curvature-extraction operator T, the decoupled operator O and the reconstruction operator S^*, related by SG=OT. We show that on four-dimensional constant-curvature backgrounds with non-zero Lambda all of these operators factor into first-order maps through a single intermediate variable: the perturbation of the self-dual half of the spin connection. We also show that for non-zero Lambda the metric perturbation is itself obtained from the connection perturbation by a first-order map. The connection therefore gives a complete description of linearised gravity, and the fourth-order identity SG=OT follows by composition from a single second-order identity. Using conformal flatness, we choose the Hertz-potential map so that, after a conformal rescaling, the potential obeys the flat wave equation component by component. This leads to a new reconstruction scheme, in which the potential is sourced by the curvature psi, which in turn obeys a decoupled sourced equation. A prescribed curvature is then reached by a second-order rather than a fourth-order equation, and the corrector is local and algebraic in the stress-energy tensor. The price is that the full curvature, rather than a single component, must be determined, and that the reality of the reconstructed metric becomes a condition, which we argue holds for retarded solutions. We illustrate the scheme for a static point mass in de Sitter space, where it gives a real metric perturbation that agrees with linearised Schwarzschild-de Sitter up to a diffeomorphism. We view these results as a proof of concept for a first-order Teukolsky-Wald framework on Kerr.

一句话导读：证明常曲率背景上线性化爱因斯坦/Teukolsky-Wald 算符可通过自旋联络自对偶部分扰动统一为一阶映射，并给出新的曲率源重构方案。

广义相对论中宇宙学暴胀的随机动力学

Stochastic dynamics of cosmological inflation in general relativity

Yoann L. Launay · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：暴胀理论加上量子真空涨落是解释宇宙大尺度不均匀性关联的主要范式。当涉及强非线性和非微扰效应时，粒子物理方法失效，留下大量无法检验的暴胀图景。Starobinsky 随机暴胀原则上可以在哈勃半径小于波长后经典地、非线性地处理暴胀不均匀性，但它从未在完整广义相对论中表述过，这正是本论文的动机。利用非平衡量子场论的 Keldysh 形式，作者首先发展了使用经典计算和数值模拟检验暴胀相互作用的有效性判据，并解析地发现可以在准 de Sitter 时空中从略低于哈勃尺度提取双谱。随后，作者首次给出数值相对论暴胀模拟中非均匀初始条件约束的解析解，并用其探索非微扰区域。主要贡献是得到广义相对论中完整暴胀场方程组的随机方程：该描述包含完整的非线性与反作用演化，具有小规范变换不变性，并且摆脱了历史上无梯度 separate universe 近似等假设。作者在 BSSN 数值相对论形式中实现了这些方程，通过约束满足验证了它们在慢滚和超慢滚情形下的正确性，并初步考察了永恒暴胀。最后，作者将粗粒化方法推广到广义相对论和单场暴胀之外，提供了一个旨在作为早期宇宙“数值粒子对撞机”的唯象框架。

English: The theory of Inflation, supplemented by fluctuations of the quantum vacuum, is the leading paradigm to explain the correlations of inhomogeneities at very large distances in the Universe. Particle physics methods fail when strong non-linearity and non-perturbativity are involved, leaving a whole landscape of untestable scenarios of inflation. Starobinsky's stochastic inflation can in principle treat inflationary inhomogeneities nonlinearly and classically as the Hubble radius becomes smaller than their wavelengths, but it was never formulated in full general relativity, which motivates this thesis. Using the Keldysh formalism of nonequilibrium quantum field theory, we first develop a validity criterion for the use of classical computations, and thus simulations, to probe inflationary interactions, finding analytically that the bispectrum can be extracted from slightly sub-Hubble scales in quasi-de Sitter spacetimes. We then provide the first analytical solutions to the constraints for inhomogeneous initial conditions of numerical relativity simulations of inflation, and use them to explore its nonperturbative regime. Our main contribution is to obtain stochastic equations for the full set of inflaton equations in general relativity: this description incorporates the full nonlinear and backreacting evolution, is small-gauge-invariant, and is free of historical assumptions such as the gradient-free separate universe approximation. We implement these equations in the BSSN formulation of numerical relativity, demonstrating their correctness in slow-roll and ultra slow-roll scenarios via the satisfaction of the constraints, with a first look at eternal inflation. Finally, we extend our coarse-graining methods beyond General Relativity and single-field inflation, offering a phenomenological framework with the ambition of serving as a numerical particle collider for the early universe.

在宇宙微波背景中探测宇宙学畴壁的前景

Prospects of Detecting Cosmological Domain Walls in the Cosmic Microwave Background

Berkin G\"urb\"uz, Robert Brandenberger, Yitian Sun · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：拓扑缺陷是自发破缺对称性场论的普遍预言，畴壁是离散对称性破缺留下的二维缺陷，也是最简单的一类。本文研究暗的、仅通过引力相互作用的畴壁在宇宙微波背景（CMB）中的印记，考虑低对称性破缺能标 η 使畴壁避开 Zel'dovich 过闭合界限但仍具有宇宙学相关性。平面畴壁对物质的相对论性排斥会形成一个由过密壳层包围的空洞，我们解析计算了畴壁与视线对齐及任意倾斜时的光子偏折场。该偏折在温度天图上留下相干、强非高斯的畸变，具有由相对论位移尺度决定的双峰结构，以及当面朝向时消失的倾角依赖。由于这些信号是局域且各向异性的，两点统计量难以捕捉；因此我们用匹配畴壁几何的 curvelet/小波分解分析，并用基于模拟的推断，训练 Neural Posterior Estimator (NPE) 恢复散射红移 z、能标 η 和倾角 θ，训练 Neural Ratio Estimator (NRE) 评估用于定限的似然比检验统计量。将这些方法作为类南极望远镜（SPT）巡天的灵敏度预报，我们发现 curvelet 和小波统计阈值在可及红移范围内落在共同的 η ~ 10–100 MeV 区间。神经比值灵敏度曲线利用完整天图形态，在 z ≳ 20 时达到低 1.3–1.9 倍的 η，或约 2–7 倍的畴壁张力，基本达到每个分辨率元噪声下限。

English: Topological defects are a generic prediction of field theories with spontaneously broken symmetries, and domain walls, the two-dimensional defects left by a broken discrete symmetry, are among the simplest. We study the imprint of dark, purely gravitationally interacting domain walls on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB), in the regime where a low symmetry-breaking scale $\eta$ allows the walls to evade the Zel'dovich overclosure bound while remaining cosmologically relevant. The relativistic repulsion of matter by a planar wall carves out an evacuated void bounded by an overdense shell, and we compute the resulting photon deflection field analytically for walls both aligned with and arbitrarily inclined to the line of sight. The deflection stamps coherent, strongly non-Gaussian distortions onto the temperature sky, with a characteristic two-peak structure set by the relativistic displacement scale and an inclination dependence that vanishes for face-on walls. Because these signatures are localised and anisotropic, they are poorly captured by two-point statistics; we therefore analyse them with a curvelet/wavelet decomposition matched to the wall's geometry, and with simulation-based inference, training a Neural Posterior Estimator (NPE) to recover the scattering redshift $z$, energy scale $\eta$, and inclination $\theta$, and a Neural Ratio Estimator (NRE) to evaluate the likelihood-ratio test statistic for limit-setting. Casting these methods as sensitivity forecasts for a South Pole Telescope-like (SPT) survey, we find that the curvelet and wavelet statistical thresholds populate a common $\eta \sim 10-100$ MeV band over the accessible redshift range. The neural-ratio sensitivity curve, which exploits the full map morphology, reaches a factor 1.3-1.9 lower in $\eta$ at $z \gtrsim 20$, or $\sim 2-7$ in the wall tension, landing essentially on the per-resolution-element noise floor.

Horizon entropy does not by itself determine a force between black holes

Zhi-Wei Wang, Samuel L. Braunstein · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：Bekenstein-Hawking 定律确定视界总熵；膜图像、全息图像和熵力图像则进一步追踪构型变化时单个视界元的熵。我们证明，这一步需要视界几何并未提供的结构。对于以 λ 标记的一族视界，用切向场 v^A 重新标记视界点会使温度加权熵变 ∫T∂_λ(dS) 精确移动 -∫v^A D_A T dS，因此只有当温度均匀时视界数据才能决定该量。我们在精确 Brill-Lindquist 数据中的两个黑洞上检验这一点。固定物理质量时，每个视界面积在五个相对量级内与间距无关；此前报道的低阶平衡力来自固定裸参数而非固定物理质量。用非均匀 Noether 荷温度对面积重新分配加权，会给出一个候选排斥力，等于 (ν/8)(GM/r12)^3 倍牛顿吸引力（总质量 M、对称质量比 ν、坐标间距 r12）。若把它当作静态相互作用，会使圆轨道束缚能的第三后牛顿系数移动 5ν/48，与广义相对论冲突。上述恒等式解决了该冲突。到第四后牛顿阶，该候选完全位于面积分布的偶极项中；伴随场的均匀部分以标签的 Möbius 变换生成该偶极项，而它在面积平衡的共形标架中消失，在该标架中泛函从第五阶开始，且其系数仍可被进一步重新标记改变。该数据的边缘捕获管和后牛顿双星的潮汐形变视界都提供了识别，但在候选所需的阶数上不输运偶极项。

English: The Bekenstein-Hawking law fixes the total entropy of a horizon. Membrane, holographic, and entropic-force pictures go further and follow the entropy of individual horizon elements as a configuration changes. We show that this step needs structure that the horizon geometry does not supply. Along a family of horizons labeled by $\lambda$, a relabeling of horizon points by a tangential field $v^A$ shifts the temperature-weighted entropy variation $\int T\partial_\lambda(dS)$ exactly by $-\int v^AD_AT dS$, so the horizon data determine it only when the temperature is uniform. We test this on two black holes in exact Brill-Lindquist data. At fixed physical masses each horizon area is independent of the separation through five relative orders; the low-order equilibrium force reported earlier comes from holding the bare parameters fixed instead. Weighting the redistribution of area by the nonuniform Noether-charge temperature gives a candidate repulsion equal to $(\nu/8)(GM/r_{12})^3$ times the Newtonian attraction, for total mass $M$, symmetric mass ratio $\nu$, and coordinate separation $r_{12}$. As a static interaction it would shift the third post-Newtonian coefficient of the circular-orbit binding energy by $5\nu/48$, in conflict with general relativity. The identity resolves the conflict. Through fourth post-Newtonian order the candidate lies entirely in the dipole of the area distribution, which the uniform part of the companion's field generates as a M\"obius map of the labels, and which vanishes in the area-balanced conformal frame, where the functional begins at fifth order with a coefficient that a further relabeling can still change. The marginally trapped tube of the data and the tidally deformed horizon of a post-Newtonian binary, both of which do supply an identification, transport no dipole at the order the candidate requires.

一句话导读：视界几何不足以定义单个视界元的熵变，因此由熵重分配导出的黑洞间熵力并非由 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵唯一决定；精确 Brill-Lindquist 与后牛顿分析显示先前候选力来自参数固定或标号选择。

中文摘要：近热平衡时，流体中的横向动量密度在小 $k$ 下按 $\omega(k) \sim - i {\cal D} k^2$ 扩散，其中扩散系数 ${\cal D}$ 正比于剪切黏度。对于具有经典引力全息对偶的场论，剪切模频率 $\omega(k)$ 在大虚波矢下趋近光锥。作者发展了 WKB 方法来研究这一极限。对于 AdS$_{p+2}$ 中的黑膜，他们确定了剪切模频率 $\omega(k)$ 大 $k$ 渐近展开的领头项。在 AdS$_5$ 情形，他们计算了该级数的多项，并用重求和技术将结果解析延拓到小 $k$。他们发现强证据表明 $\omega(k)$ 在 $k=0$ 处解析且在该处为零，这意味着大 $k$ 物理中编码了流体力学。取 $\omega(k)$ 大 $k$ 展开的 10 项，给出的 ${\cal D}$ 精度优于 $0.5\%$。

English: Near thermal equilibrium, the transverse momentum density in a fluid diffuses according to $\omega(k) \sim - i {\cal D} k^2$ at small $k$, where the diffusion coefficient ${\cal D}$ is proportional to the shear viscosity. In field theories with a holographic dual description in terms of classical gravity, the shear-mode frequency $\omega(k)$ approaches the light cone at large imaginary wave vector. We develop a WKB approach to study this limit. For black branes in AdS$_{p+2}$, we determine the leading terms of the asymptotic large-$k$ expansion of the shear-mode frequency $\omega(k)$. In the case of AdS$_{5}$, we compute a large number of terms of this series and use resummation techniques to analytically continue the result to small $k$. We find strong evidence that $\omega(k)$ is analytic at $k=0$ and vanishes there, which amounts to the existence of hydrodynamics encoded in the large-$k$ physics. Taking 10 terms in the large-$k$ expansion of $\omega(k)$ gives an answer for ${\cal D}$ which is accurate to better than $0.5\%$.

一句话导读：用 WKB 和复光锥大 $k$ 展开研究 AdS 黑膜剪切模，并通过重求和提取剪切黏度。

非单态与矩阵量子力学的相图

Non-singlets and the phase diagram of Matrix Quantum Mechanics

Igor R. Klebanov, Henry W. Lin, Pavel Meshcheriakov, Jessica Yeh · hep-th, cond-mat.stat-mech, cond-mat.str-el, math.OC · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：在无限 N 极限下，单个 N×N 厄米矩阵的量子力学在四阶耦合常数 g 取特殊负值 g_* 时定义二维弦论。本文研究该矩阵量子力学（MQM）的热力学，并将 SU(N) 对称性视为整体对称性。关键的是，非单态——处于 SU(N) 非平凡表示中的态——实现了离散世界面上的涡旋效应。该随机格点模型具有低温 c=1 相和高温 c=0 相，二者由 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）相变分隔。我们给出了耦合—温度平面中的相图，其中由从 g_*<g<0 延伸的临界稳定曲线 T_c(g) 分隔。我们通过非微扰矩阵 bootstrap 以及低温和高温微扰论研究了这条曲线，并解释了热不稳定性：在低温下，热激发的非单态反作用于矩阵本征值的费米海，使其溢出；在高温下，理论由沿热圆进行维数约化得到的有效矩阵积分描述，零模本征值分布在临界耦合处失稳。我们猜想 BKT 相变发生在临界曲线上的特殊点，并估计其位置。最后，我们转向规则方格点并研究受 MQM 启发的 Villain 模型，其中链接因子是圆上的一维传播子；我们通过 Monte Carlo 模拟给出了该模型中的 BKT 相变。

English: The quantum mechanics of one $N\times N$ Hermitian matrix in the infinite $N$ limit is well known to define a two-dimensional string theory when the quartic coupling constant $g$ is tuned to a special negative value $g_*$. We study the thermodynamics of this Matrix Quantum Mechanics (MQM), treating the SU$(N)$ symmetry as a global symmetry. Crucially, the non-singlets, i.e. states in non-trivial representations of SU$(N)$, implement the effects of vortices on the discretized worldsheets. This random lattice model has the low-temperature $c=1$ and high-temperature $c=0$ phases, with the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition separating them. We map out the phase diagram in the coupling--temperature plane, which is separated by the critical stability curve $T_c(g)$ extending from $g_*< g <0$. We study this curve using the non-perturbative matrix bootstrap and low- and high-temperature perturbation theory, which explain the thermal instability. At low temperatures, thermally excited non-singlets backreact on the Fermi sea of matrix eigenvalues, causing it to spill over. At high temperatures, the theory is described by an effective matrix integral obtained by dimensional reduction on the thermal circle; the eigenvalue distribution of the zero mode becomes unstable at the critical coupling. We conjecture that the BKT transition occurs at a special point on the critical curve and estimate its position. Finally, we switch to the regular square lattice and study the MQM-inspired Villain model, where the link factor is the one-dimensional propagator on a circle. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we map out the BKT transition in this model.

一句话导读：将 SU(N) 整体对称性与非单态纳入矩阵量子力学，研究其热力学相图、临界稳定曲线及 BKT 相变。

Kok Hong Thong · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：我们从 CFT$_d$ 的配对 Casimir 导出一个圆柱：在零中心动量时，它只依赖于相对伸缩和旋转。相对坐标径向量子化随后把交换族标签编码为圆柱能量。对于处于可归一且稳定范围的 melonic CFT$_d$，约化梯子求和是刚性 AdS$_{d+1}$ 中单个自由标量场的 Robin 边界到边界传播子，其共形边界为圆柱。Robin 边界条件和体正则性（或宇称）决定边界数据的全息径向延拓。全局 AdS 中非零 Robin 边界系数破坏 $2d$ 个 AdS 生成元，但标量的边界传播子仍编码 melonic 梯子的共形数据。我们针对 Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev 模型和无无序的 $d=2$ 长程 Amit--Roginsky melonic 模型展示了该对应，它们分别对应 AdS$_2$ 和 AdS$_3$ 中的单个自由局域标量。

English: We derive a cylinder from the pair Casimir of a CFT$_d$: at zero centre momentum it depends only on relative dilations and rotations. Relative-coordinate radial quantisation then encodes exchanged family labels as cylinder energies. For a melonic CFT$_d$ in the normalisable and stable range, the reduced ladder sum is the Robin boundary-to-boundary propagator of a single free scalar field in rigid AdS$_{d+1}$, with the cylinder as its conformal boundary. The Robin boundary condition and bulk regularity (or parity) determine the holographic radial extension of the boundary data. A nonzero Robin boundary coefficient in global AdS breaks $2d$ AdS generators, yet the scalar's boundary propagator still encodes the conformal data of the melonic ladder. We demonstrate the correspondence for the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev and the $d=2$ disorder-free long-range Amit--Roginsky melonic models, which correspond to a single free local scalar in AdS$_2$ and AdS$_3$, respectively.

一句话导读：Melonic CFT 的梯子求和可全息描述为刚性 AdS 中单个自由标量场的 Robin 传播子，并以 SYK 和长程 Amit-Roginsky 模型为例。

中文摘要：本文研究非稳态反德西特（adS）黑洞的热力学及其规范-引力对偶。为模拟非平衡过程，采用含时 Vaidya-adS 度规描述零质量流体坍缩及对偶场论随后的热化。我们引入自由能的有效版本，作为动力学设置中的准局域探针。通过分析该量的演化，表明当最终黑洞质量超过 Hawking-Page 温度所确定的极限时会发生一阶相变。进一步证明，最终态仅在质量远大于 adS 半径时趋近 N=4 超对称 Yang-Mills 的热行为。最后利用全息重整化计算边界能量-动量张量，并将所得能量密度与强耦合极限比较，表明对偶描述为强耦合规范理论的平衡与非平衡热力学提供了一致框架。

English: This work investigates the thermodynamics of non-stationary anti-de Sitter (adS) black holes and their gauge-gravity duals. To model a non-equilibrium process, we employ a time-dependent Vaidya-adS metric to describe the collapse of a null fluid and the subsequent thermalization of the dual field theory. We introduce an effective version of free energy as a quasilocal probe to be used in a dynamical setup. By analyzing how this quantity evolves, we show that a first-order phase transition occurs when the final black-hole mass exceeds the limit established by the Hawking-Page temperature. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the final state only approaches the thermal behavior of the N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory for mass states much larger than the adS radius. Finally, we compute the boundary energy-momentum tensor using holographic renormalization and compare the resulting energy density with the strong-coupling limit. This demonstrates that the dual description provides a consistent framework for both the equilibrium and non-equilibrium thermodynamics of strongly coupled gauge theories.

中文摘要：黑洞奇点可通过热边界两点关联函数探测。存在反弹测地线时，大 N 下边界关联函数在 t_c 附近呈 G(t,0)∝(t-t_c)^{-2Δ+b_t}。作者证明额外幂次 b_t 由奇点附近 Kasner 指数决定，并对 AdS_{d+1} 平面黑膜给出 b_t=(d-1)max((p_i-p_t)/(1-p_t),1/2)。将该公式与 Čeplak 和 Valach 的数值比较：在 g_tt g_rr=-1 时重现其关系；在 g_tt g_rr≠-1 时与其多数数据相符且拟合更好。还给出 Kasner 指数已知但 b_t 未计算情形的预测。

English: The black hole singularity can be probed by the thermal boundary two-point correlator. When there is a bouncing geodesic, the boundary correlator reveals the singular behavior $G(t, \vec{x}=0) \propto (t-t_c)^{-2\Delta+b_t}$ at large $N$. We show that the additional power $b_t$ is determined by the Kasner exponents near the singularity: for planar black branes in AdS$_{d+1}$, we derive the formula $b_t=(d-1) \max \left(\frac{p_i-p_t}{1-p_t} , \frac12 \right)$, where $p_t$ and $p_i$ are the exponents of the time and spatial directions. We compare our formula with the numerical values of \v{C}eplak and Valach. It reproduces their relation for black branes with $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$. For $g_{tt}g_{rr}\neq-1$, where no formula had been found, our formula agrees with most of their data and fits them much better than their relation. We also give predictions for $b_t$ in theories where the Kasner exponents are known, but $b_t$ has not been computed.

Sudhanva Joshi, Sunil Kumar Mishra · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-26

中文摘要：Rényi 熵不等式曾被提议用于加强 AdS 空间中热力学稳定黑洞并合的面积定理界。更强的界依赖于联合初态，而质量和温度只固定其局域热边缘态。本文在正则双黑洞描述中量化这一区别：局限于稀有能量涨落的关联可以保持两个热态完全不变，并使迹距离与互信息趋于零，却仍能在半经典领头阶改变联合 Rényi 熵。作者确定了在所有正 Rényi 阶直至 1 的范围内一致成立、与受控趋近统计独立相容的最小熵。对于等质量 Schwarzschild-AdS4 黑洞，所得的优化正则质量约束在半经典领头阶回到面积界。该约化只涉及推断界所需的信息，并不产生更轻的可达遗迹或动力学不稳定性；更强的并合约束需要控制超出单黑洞热力学的初始关联。

English: R\'enyi entropy inequalities have been proposed to strengthen the area-theorem bound on mergers of thermodynamically stable black holes in Anti de Sitter (AdS) space. The stronger bounds depend on the joint initial state, whereas masses and temperatures fix only its local thermal marginals. We quantify this distinction inside the canonical two-hole description. Correlations confined to rare energy fluctuations can leave both thermal states exactly intact and drive the trace distance and mutual information to zero, yet still change the joint R\'enyi entropy at leading semiclassical order. We determine the smallest entropy compatible with a controlled approach to statistical independence, uniformly over all positive R\'enyi orders up to one. For equal Schwarzschild--AdS$_4$ holes, the resulting optimized canonical mass constraint reduces to the area bound at leading semiclassical order. The reduction concerns only the information needed to infer a bound; it does not produce a lighter attainable remnant or a dynamical instability. Stronger merger constraints therefore require control of the initial correlations beyond single black hole thermodynamics.

Xun-Jie Xu, Yong Xu, Qiqin Yin · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：核心坍缩超新星可以是高频引力波的强源，因为核心的极端温度和密度允许大量引力子被热产生。我们给出核心坍缩超新星热引力波谱的首次系统计算。通过评估主导发射通道——包括电子和质子的光致产生（γ e−→h e−，γ p→h p）以及引力轫致辐射（e−p→e−p h，e−e−→e−e−h）——我们发现核心坍缩超新星产生的总热引力波光度为1.27×10^26 W，比太阳大约高18个数量级。热引力波谱峰值在O(0.1 GeV)能量处，将已知引力波源的预测谱扩展到前所未有的高频区。我们的结果为高频前沿提供了一个基准热引力波谱。

English: Core-collapse supernovae can be powerful sources of high-frequency gravitational waves (GWs) as the extreme temperatures and densities in the core allow a considerable number of gravitons to be produced thermally. We present the first systematic calculation of the thermal GW spectrum of a core-collapse supernova. By evaluating the dominant emission channels---including electron and proton photoproduction ($\gamma e^{-}\to he^{-}$, $\gamma p\to h\,p$) and gravitational bremsstrahlung ($e^{-}p\to e^{-}p\,h$, $e^{-}e^{-}\to e^{-}e^{-}h$)---we find that a core-collapse supernova generates a total thermal GW luminosity of $1.27\times10^{26}$ W, approximately 18 orders of magnitude larger than that of the Sun. The thermal GW spectrum peaks at energies of $\mathcal{O}(0.1\,{\rm GeV})$, extending the predicted spectrum of known GW sources to an unprecedented high-frequency regime. Our results provide a benchmark thermal GW spectrum at the high-frequency frontier.

来自纠缠 SO(3) 宇宙弦网络的引力波

Gravitational Waves From an Entangled SO(3) Cosmic String Network

Mu-Chun Chen, Cameron Moffett-Smith · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：诸如 A4 的离散非阿贝尔对称性被广泛用于轻子味模型，以解释中微子质量层级及其大混合。如果这样的对称性来自连续群的自发破缺，就可能形成宇宙弦。我们研究 SO(3)→A4 的破缺，其中弦由非阿贝尔群 π1(SO(3)/A4)≅T′（二元四面体群）分类。由于弦通量不对易，碰撞的弦可能重联、相互穿过，或由通量可属于不同弦网络的桥连接。我们直接从群结构推导这些结果的概率；在网络模型中它们通常被当作自由参数。将其纳入多网络速度依赖单尺度模型后，我们发现与相同张力的阿贝尔 U(1) 弦相比，网络关联长度减小、能量密度增加。由此产生的随机引力波背景最多增强近三个数量级，表明 π1 的代数结构会直接印刻在引力波谱上。

English: Discrete non-Abelian symmetries such as $\mathrm{A_4}$ are widely used in models of lepton flavor to explain neutrino mass hierarchy and their large mixing. If such a symmetry arises from the spontaneous breaking of a continuous group, cosmic strings can form. We study the breaking $\mathrm{SO}(3)\to \mathrm{A_4}$, for which the strings are classified by the non-Abelian group $\pi_1(\mathrm{SO}(3)/\mathrm{A_4})\cong \mathrm{T}'$, the binary tetrahedral group. Because the string fluxes do not commute, colliding strings may reconnect, pass through each other, or become joined by a bridge whose flux can belong to a different string network. We derive the probabilities of these outcomes directly from the group structure; in network models they are usually treated as free parameters. Including them in a multi-network velocity-dependent one-scale model, we find that the correlation length of the networks decreases and their energy density increases relative to Abelian $\mathrm{U}(1)$ strings of the same tension. The resulting stochastic gravitational-wave background is enhanced by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, showing that the algebraic structure of $\pi_1$ leaves a direct imprint on the gravitational-wave spectrum.

用于引力波数据分析的Hankel低秩矩阵近似

Hankel low-rank matrix approximation for gravitational-wave data analysis

Nicholas Geissler, Vladimir Strokov, Christian K\"ummerle, Sergey Kushnarev, Emanuele Berti · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：下一代引力波探测器（如LISA）将观测到大量重叠信号。将这些信号从仪器噪声以及彼此之间分离出来，是显著的数据分析挑战。我们探索一种基于将时间序列嵌入Hankel矩阵的去噪技术：n个（阻尼）正弦波的叠加对应一个秩为2n的矩阵。因此，信号提取问题被转化为结构化低秩近似问题。使用面向引力波应用的合成数据，我们基准测试了三种基于Hankel的算法：ESPRIT、Cadzow迭代和迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）。测试场景包括孤立和多分量单色信号、频率相近源的区分，以及黑洞准正规模（QNM）的恢复。三种算法均达到与Fisher矩阵下界一致的近最优性能，表现为失配随信噪比呈平方反比缩放。此外，对数值相对论波形的概念验证应用验证了这些算法从铃宕信号中提取QNM频率的能力。因此，Hankel低秩近似为引力波时间序列预处理提供了一种透明且计算高效的途径。

English: Next-generation gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, such as the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), will observe vast numbers of overlapping signals. Disentangling these signals from instrumental noise and from one another constitutes a significant data analysis challenge. We explore a denoising technique based on embedding time series into Hankel matrices: a superposition of $n$ (damped) sinusoids corresponds to a matrix of rank $2n$. Thus, the problem of signal extraction is reduced to a structured low-rank approximation problem. Using synthetic data tailored to GW applications, we benchmark three Hankel-based algorithms: ESPRIT, Cadzow iterations, and iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS). Our test scenarios include isolated and multi-component monochromatic signals, the resolution of sources with closely spaced frequencies, and the recovery of black hole quasinormal modes (QNM). All three algorithms achieve near-optimal performance consistent with Fisher matrix bounds, evidenced by an inverse-square scaling of the mismatch with the signal-to-noise ratio. Furthermore, a proof-of-concept application to numerical relativity waveforms validates the ability of these algorithms to extract QNM frequencies from ringdown signals. Hankel low-rank approximation therefore offers a transparent, computationally efficient avenue for preprocessing GW time series.

众包超辐射轴子的引力波

Crowdsourcing Gravitational Waves from Superradiant Axions

Sebastian A. R. Ellis, Orion Ning, Nicholas L. Rodd, Jan Sch\"utte-Engel · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：黑洞超辐射是探测超轻轴子的有力手段。若自然界存在质量约 10^-12 eV 的玻色子，仅真空涨落就会在旋转恒星级黑洞周围高效产生该粒子，形成会抽走黑洞自旋并衰变产生近单色引力波的“引力原子”。已有超辐射限制主要来自少数已识别黑洞的自旋测量。本文改为详细研究群体级效应：银河系一亿个黑洞产生的引力波，以及全宇宙轴子云产生的随机信号。我们研究黑洞性质中广泛系统误差的影响，并计算 LIGO 以及未来 Einstein Telescope、Cosmic Explorer 和高频 Magnetic Weber Bar 的预期轴子灵敏度。我们表明 LIGO 可稳健探测约 10^-13 eV 到 4×10^-12 eV 的轴子质量。若黑洞群体延伸到略低于 5 M⊙——LIGO 旋进观测有所暗示——LIGO 将接近 10^-11 eV。在同一假设下，未来高频探测器可推得更高，在最乐观情形下可能超过 10^-10 eV，接近轴子暗物质搜索预期灵敏度所覆盖的最低质量。

English: Black hole superradiance is a powerful probe of ultralight axions. If nature contains a boson with a mass of order $10^{-12}\,$eV, $\textit{mere vacuum fluctuations}$ will lead to its efficient production around spinning stellar mass black holes, forming a gravitational atom that both drains the black hole spin and decays to produce near-monochromatic gravitational waves. Existing superradiance constraints derive primarily from spin measurements of a handful of identified black holes. Here we instead present a detailed study of the population level effect: gravitational waves arising from both the 100 million black holes in the Milky Way and the stochastic signal from axion clouds throughout the universe. We study the impact of a broad range of systematic uncertainties on the black hole properties and compute the projected axion sensitivity for LIGO, as well as the future instruments Einstein Telescope, Cosmic Explorer, and a high-frequency Magnetic Weber Bar. We demonstrate that LIGO can robustly probe axion masses from roughly $10^{-13}\,$eV to $4 \times 10^{-12}\,$eV. If the black hole population extends to masses slightly below $5\,M_{\odot}$ - as hinted for by LIGO inspiral observations - LIGO would approach $10^{-11}\,$eV. Under that same assumption we show that a future high-frequency detector could push considerably higher, potentially beyond $10^{-10}\,$eV in the most optimistic scenarios, reaching towards the lowest masses within the projected sensitivity of axion dark matter searches.

一句话导读：研究银河系及宇宙中超辐射轴子云群体产生的引力波信号，并给出 LIGO、ET、CE 和高频探测器对轴子质量的探测预期。

Jun-Xi Shi, Zhen-Tao He, Tingyuan Jiang, Yu Tian, Dan-Dan Yuan, Hongbao Zhang · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：对双星引力波进行准正规模滤波后剩余的波形（常称直接波）近期引发讨论。残余波形的解析模型涉及多层近似，而滤波对建模的影响仍不清楚。本文考察这些模型中的近似误差、适用范围及滤波作用。发现所考察的点粒子模型与滤波后的双黑洞波形存在明显差异。基于驻相近似的解析粒子模板对(ℓ,m)=(2,2)多极表现尚可，但对(4,4)有显著局限。尽管滤波器是全通，仍实质影响建模结果。在Schwarzschild背景上的解析计算进一步表明，具有高斯初始数据的真空扰动经滤波后也可呈现类直接波波形，其形态取决于初始数据相对光球的位置。

English: The waveform left after quasinormal modes filtering of binary gravitational waveforms, often called the direct wave, has recently attracted considerable debate. Analytic models of this residual waveform involve several levels of approximation, while the effects of filtering on the modeling remain unclear. These issues require further investigation. In this paper, we examine the approximation errors, limits of applicability, and role of filtering in these models. We find that the point-particle models examined here show notable discrepancies with the filtered Binary-black-hole waveforms. Analytic particle templates based on the stationary-phase approximation perform reasonably well for the \((\ell,m)=(2,2)\) multipole, but exhibit substantial limitations for the \((4,4)\). Although the filter is all-pass, it substantially affects the modeling results. Our analytic calculations on a Schwarzschild background further show that vacuum perturbations with Gaussian initial data can also exhibit direct-wave-like waveforms after filtering, with their morphology depending on the location of the initial data relative to the light ring.

用近恒等平均变换构建高效偏心与准圆有效单体波形

Efficient Eccentric and Quasicircular Effective-One-Body Waveforms via Near-Identity Averaging Transformations

Philip Lynch, Alessandra Buonanno, Aldo Gamboa, Maarten van de Meent · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：下一代引力波探测器如 LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者需要精确高效的长寿命偏心黑洞双星信号模型。此前工作通过将无自旋偏心有效单体动力学改写为密切轨道根数并施加近恒等平均变换来移除 inspiral 阶段快速轨道时间尺度结构，降低了演化成本；但以偏心率和相对论近点角为参数的描述在圆轨道极限下奇异，无法覆盖准圆双星和偏心 inspiral 晚期，且由平均动力学生成波形的成本限制了整体加速（1.5–8 倍）。本文用偏心率矢量的笛卡尔分量替代偏心率和相对论近点角，使平均方程对所有偏心率 0≤e<1 均正则；并将波形模式分解为径向谐波，其系数作为平均变量的函数列表，从而在输出时间网格上以每采样固定成本直接组装波形。作者在地面探测器可观测的双星参数空间（现包括圆轨道）对照完整有效单体演化进行了验证。在第二后绝热阶，波形中位失配约 10^{-8}，最大失配为 1.1×10^{-5}；相对串行 EOB 波形，单核加速 3–100 倍，八核最高可达约 300 倍。作者计划未来将这些技术用于最先进的 SEOBNR 模型。

English: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors, such as LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer, will require accurate and efficient models of long-lived, eccentric black-hole binary signals. In previous work, we reduced the cost of evolving nonspinning eccentric effective-one-body dynamics by recasting the equations of motion in terms of osculating orbital elements and applying near-identity averaging transformations to remove the fast orbital-timescale structure during the inspiral. However, the parametrization in terms of the eccentricity and relativistic anomaly becomes singular in the circular-orbit limit, excluding quasicircular binaries and the late stages of eccentric inspirals. Moreover, the cost of generating the waveform from the averaged dynamics limited the overall speed-up to a factor of $1.5-8$. In this work, we replace the eccentricity and relativistic anomaly by the Cartesian components of the eccentricity vector, in which the averaged equations are regular for all eccentricities $0 \leq e < 1$. We also decompose the waveform modes into radial harmonics whose coefficients are tabulated as functions of the averaged variables, so that the waveform is assembled directly on the output time grid at a fixed cost per sample. We validate the method against the full effective-one-body evolution across the parameter space of binaries observable by ground-based detectors, now including circular orbits. At second postadiabatic order, the waveforms reach median mismatches of $\sim 10^{-8}$ with a maximum of $1.1 \times 10^{-5}$, while achieving speed-ups of $3-100 \times$ on a single core or up to $300 \times$ on eight cores against the serial EOB waveform. Given the speed-ups demonstrated here, we plan to apply these techniques to state-of-the-art SEOBNR models in future work.

一句话导读：用偏心率矢量笛卡尔分量与径向谐波分解，使平均 EOB 波形同时覆盖偏心与准圆轨道，并以高精度获得最高约 300 倍加速。

Pseudo-spectral methods in gravitational lensing: Spin precession in loop quantum black hole spacetimes

Xiankai Pang, Xiao-Kan Guo · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：引力透镜通常被视为初值问题：给定非束缚轨道的瞄准参数，计算偏折角。本文主张反向视角：对于给定的偏折角，通过空间无穷远处的两个边界条件选择轨道，使透镜问题成为良定的两点边值问题，其中瞄准参数充当非线性本征值。我们证明基于 Chebyshev 配点的伪谱方法能以适中计算成本精确求解该边值问题，并且控制粒子自旋进动的平行移动方程在同一网格上化为单个线性系统。作为具体应用，我们计算大质量粒子在两个圈量子引力黑洞时空（协变有效度规和自对偶圈量子黑洞）中背向散射时的自旋进动。我们发现量子修正对慢速粒子最显著，而在超相对论极限下总能恢复普适的自旋翻转。翻转本身是普适的，但趋近它的速率不是：cosξ 对粒子速度的导数在 v=1 处依赖于两个时空的量子参数。该框架不限于所研究的模型，适用于任何静态球对称时空。

English: Gravitational lensing is usually treated as an initial value problem: for a given impact parameter of an unbound orbit, one computes the resulting deflection angle. In this paper we advocate the inverse point of view. For a prescribed deflection angle, the orbit is selected by two boundary conditions at spatial infinity, so that the lensing problem becomes a well-defined two-point boundary value problem, with the impact parameter playing the role of a nonlinear eigenvalue. We show that pseudo-spectral methods based on Chebyshev collocation solve this boundary value problem accurately at modest computational cost, and that the parallel transport equations governing the spin precession of the particle reduce to a single linear system on the same grid. As a concrete application, we compute the spin precession of massive particles in backward scattering off two black hole spacetimes from loop quantum gravity, the covariant effective metric and the self-dual loop quantum black hole. We find that the quantum corrections are most pronounced for slowly moving particles, while in the ultra-relativistic limit the universal spin flip is always recovered. The flip itself is universal, but the rate at which it is approached is not. The derivative of $\cos\xi$ with respect to the particle speed at $v=1$ depends on the quantum parameters of both spacetimes. The framework is not restricted to the models studied here and applies to any static, spherically symmetric spacetime.

一句话导读：用 Chebyshev 伪谱法把引力透镜重述为两点边值问题，并计算圈量子黑洞时空中大质量粒子的自旋进动。

通过近恒等平均变换实现高效偏心有效单体动力学

Efficient Eccentric Effective-One-Body Dynamics via Near-Identity Averaging Transformations

Philip Lynch, Alessandra Buonanno, Aldo Gamboa, Maarten van de Meent · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：下一代引力波探测器（如 LISA、Einstein Telescope 和 Cosmic Explorer）需要准确且高效地模拟长寿命黑洞双星信号，包括具有显著偏心率的系统。偏心有效单体模型的一个挑战是，在旋近阶段解析快速振荡的轨道动力学成本很高，尤其对于低质量和大质量比系统。本文通过将无自旋偏心有效单体运动方程改写为密切轨道根数，并应用近恒等平均变换，在旋近阶段消除快速轨道时标结构。该过程中的每一阶都将振荡行为抑制一个轨道时标与辐射反作用时标之比的因子。得到的平均动力学在辐射反作用时标上演化，然后系统被映射回完整的 EOB 动力学以完成最终进入 plunge 的过渡。这将旋近动力学的成本降低最多两个数量级，消除了长波形的主要瓶颈。整体波形生成加速为 1.5–8 倍，这推动发展更高效的波形生成方法。作者还通过在中等到大偏心率的大范围参数空间中比较平均动力学与完整 EOB 动力学生成的波形，验证了方法的准确性。将平均过程推进到次次领头阶对于准确模拟可比质量双星是必要的，得到的不匹配度 ≤ 8.05×10^-5。这些结果确立了近恒等平均作为高效偏心 EOB 旋近的实用途径，并为进一步扩展到低偏心率和自旋波形模型提供了基础。

English: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors, such as LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer, will require accurate and efficient models of long-lived black hole binary signals, including those with significant eccentricity. A challenge for eccentric effective-one-body models is the cost of resolving rapidly oscillating orbital dynamics over the inspiral, particularly for low-mass and large-mass-ratio systems. We address this by recasting the nonspinning eccentric effective-one-body equations of motion in terms of osculating orbital elements and then applying near-identity averaging transformations to eliminate the fast orbital-timescale structure during the inspiral. Each order in this procedure suppresses the oscillatory behavior by one factor of the ratio of orbital to radiation-reaction timescales. The resulting averaged dynamics are evolved on the radiation-reaction timescale, and then the system is mapped back to the full EOB dynamics for the final transition to plunge. This reduces the cost of the inspiral dynamics by up to two orders of magnitude, eliminating this as the primary bottleneck for long waveforms. The overall waveform-generation speedup spans $1.5 - 8 \times$, motivating the development of more efficient waveform-generation methods. We also validate the accuracy of the method by comparing waveforms generated from the averaged and full effective-one-body dynamics across a broad region of parameter space for moderate to large eccentricities. Carrying out this averaging procedure to next-to-next-to-leading order is needed to accurately model comparable-mass binaries, yielding mismatches $\leq 8.05 \times 10^{-5}$. These results establish near-identity averaging as a practical route to efficient eccentric effective-one-body inspirals, and provide a foundation for further extensions to low-eccentricity and spinning waveform models.

一句话导读：用近恒等平均变换加速偏心有效单体旋近动力学，将旋近计算成本最多降低两个数量级，并验证波形精度。

动态时空中的光子球

Photon spheres in dynamical spacetimes

David D\'iaz-Guerra, \'Angel Rinc\'on, Diego Rubiera-Garcia · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：表征光子区域——即充满不稳定束缚零测地线的时空区域——对于理解辐射在足够致密天体（如黑洞）附近的行为至关重要。然而，已有研究通常集中于稳态时空，遗漏了坍缩、吸积或蒸发黑洞等有趣的理论与现象学场景，以及某些玻色星模型中的含时构型。本文提出一种新的协变方法来描述动态球对称时空中的辐射，从而在非静态时空中给出光子面及其动力学的普遍描述，并在静态极限下恢复已知表达式、澄清其含义。我们进一步通过恒星坍缩以及吸积/蒸发模型等动态场景示例说明结果，并讨论这些场景中尚存的开放问题。

English: The characterization of the photon region -- i.e. the region of space-time filled with unstable bound null geodesics -- is critical to understand the behavior of radiation near a compact-enough object, such as black holes. However, its study has been typically focused on stationary space-times that leave outside interesting theoretical and phenomenological scenarios such as collapsing, accreting, or evaporating black holes, besides time-dependent configurations such as those found in some boson star models. In this work, we present a novel covariant approach to describe radiation in dynamical spherical space-times. This allows a general description of photon surfaces and their dynamics in non-static space-times, recovering well known expressions in the static limit and clarifying their meanings. Furthermore, we illustrate our results via several examples of dynamical scenarios in stellar collapse and accreting/evaporating models, and discuss the open caveats regarding such scenarios.

一句话导读：提出动态球对称时空中光子面与光子球动力学的协变描述，并应用于恒星坍缩及吸积/蒸发场景。

精确1+3协变辐射层级中CMB透镜的标架协变性

Frame covariance of CMBR lensing in the exact 1+3 covariant radiation hierarchy

Tim Gebbie · astro-ph, gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：精确的1+3协变玻尔兹曼层级中，宇宙微波背景的加速度、剪切和涡旋耦合具有随多极数ℓ线性增长的系数。我们证明它们都是光子刘维尔方程中像差算符的多极形式；在改变标架时，该算符按沿光线洛伦兹助推的生成元平移。因此，ℓ到ℓ±1的加速度耦合和ℓ到ℓ±2的剪切耦合是同一算符的标架协变描述，通过代数、逐点的方向重标号相联系。固定发射者和观察者标架后，观测天空在每一ℓ上都与中间标架无关。我们在1+3协变且规范不变的变量中推导此结果，而无需构造二阶规范不变变量。O(ε²ℓ)内容即已知在度规变量中的引力透镜。围绕FLRW背景线性化会移除这些耦合，因而需从测地线方程重新引入透镜。保持标架任意使标架协变性显式，并将观察者像差置于同一算符中。在牛顿标架中，我们计算偏转的两部分：等效原理贡献通过像差进入，空间曲率贡献来自扰动空间切片上的自由传播并约化为同一算符。透镜效率来自方向导数。角功率谱贡献是势的四次方：若偏转与源统计独立，则在谱相对偏转尺度光滑处，两个携带ℓ²的四阶项抵消，透镜只重分配功率而不增加系综方差。

English: The exact $1+3$ covariant Boltzmann hierarchy for the cosmic microwave background contains acceleration, shear and vorticity couplings whose coefficients grow linearly in $\ell$. We show that all are the multipole form of the aberration operator in the photon Liouville equation. Under a change of threading, this operator shifts by the along-ray generator of a Lorentz boost. The acceleration coupling of $\ell$ to $\ell\pm1$ and the shear coupling of $\ell$ to $\ell\pm2$ are therefore frame-covariant descriptions of the same operator, related by an algebraic, pointwise relabelling of direction. With emitter and observer frames fixed, the observed sky is independent of the intermediate threading at every $\ell$. We derive this in $1+3$ covariant and gauge-invariant variables without constructing second-order gauge-invariant variables. The $O(\epsilon^2\ell)$ content is gravitational lensing, as known in metric variables. Linearisation about a Friedmann--Lema\^{i}tre--Robertson--Walker background removes these couplings, requiring lensing to be reinstated from the geodesic equation. Keeping the threading arbitrary makes frame covariance explicit and places observer aberration in the same operator. In the Newtonian threading we compute both halves of the deflection: the equivalence-principle contribution enters through aberration, while the spatial-curvature contribution arises from free streaming on perturbed spatial sections and reduces to the same operator. The lensing efficiency follows from the direction derivative. The angular-power-spectrum contribution is quartic in the potential: for a deflection statistically independent of the source, the two fourth-order terms carrying $\ell^2$ cancel where the spectrum is smooth on the deflection scale, and lensing redistributes power without adding ensemble variance.

一句话导读：证明CMB透镜在1+3协变玻尔兹曼层级中源于像差算符，并展示其对中间标架的协变性。

引力波衍射图像揭示天体对象的结构

Gravitational Wave Diffractive Images Reveal the Structure of Astrophysical Objects

Han Gil Choi, Sunghoon Jung, Volodymyr Takhistov · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：散射图案可编码延展天体的结构，正如带电粒子被原子核散射所展示的那样。引力波衍射为探测原本不可见的质量分布提供了类似手段。在线性透镜势阶，作者推导了引力透镜化引力波波形中中心衍射像贡献与投影透镜密度傅里叶变换之间的关系；对于有限质量透镜，该贡献表现为点质量Born振幅乘以归一化质量形状因子，类似核散射中的情形。随着致密双星并合源引力波频率演化，信号在不同空间尺度上采样该形状因子，并通过与主像的干涉留下透镜结构印记。利用完整数值波光学计算，作者量化了对延展暗物质天体、被暗物质晕包裹的原初黑洞以及黑洞周围超轻玻色子超辐射云的观测能力。对所考虑源族群，下一代探测器五年观测可区分延展透镜与点质量，探测暗物质分数低至约10^{-5}，并区分晕包裹原初黑洞与匹配的裸黑洞，探测原初黑洞暗物质分数低至约10^{-6}；在足够近的源-透镜构型下，标量超辐射云可在玻色子质量约10^{-17}-10^{-12} eV时产生可区分的衍射特征。这些结果为表征延展暗物质与致密天体天体物理环境提供了框架。

English: Scattering patterns encode the structure of extended objects, as demonstrated by charged particle scattering on atomic nuclei. Gravitational wave (GW) diffraction offers an analogous probe of otherwise invisible mass distributions. At linear order in the lens potential we derive expressions relating the central diffractive image contribution to a gravitationally lensed GW waveform to the Fourier transform of the projected lens density. For finite mass lenses this contribution takes the form of a point mass Born amplitude multiplied by a normalized mass form factor, analogous to that in nuclear scattering. As the frequency of GWs from a merging compact binary source evolves the signal samples this form factor across spatial scales, imprinting lens structure through interference with the primary image. Using full numerical wave optics calculations we quantify the observational reach for extended dark matter objects, primordial black holes halo-dressed by dark matter halos and superradiance clouds of ultralight bosons around black holes. For the considered source populations, five year observations with next generation detectors can distinguish extended lenses from point masses, probing dark matter fractions down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-5})$, and halo-dressed primordial black holes from matched bare black holes, probing primordial black hole dark matter fractions down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-6})$. For sufficiently close source-lens configurations, scalar superradiance clouds can produce distinguishable diffraction signatures for boson masses of approximately $10^{-17}-10^{-12}~\mathrm{eV}$. These results provide a framework for characterizing extended dark matter and compact object astrophysical environments.

一句话导读：利用引力波衍射的波光学信号与质量形状因子，探测延展暗物质、晕包裹原初黑洞和超辐射云等天体结构。

用于桌面 kHz 引力波探测的多特斯拉磁场中超导 LC 谐振器

A superconducting LC resonator in a multi-tesla magnetic field for tabletop kHz gravitational-wave detection

D. Ahn, C. Braggio, G. Carugno, D. D'Agostino, R. Di Vora, P. Falferi, A. Ortolan, G. Ruoso, M. L. Ruggiero · hep-ex, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：我们提出一种浸没在磁场中的超导电感-电容（LC）谐振器概念，用于 kHz 频段引力波探测。在长波极限下，静态磁场中的引力波会诱导振荡磁场扰动，其大小与施加于谐振器的静磁场和引力波应变成正比。我们表明，超导拾取电路可将该扰动转换为磁通信号，并由基于 SQUID 或量子极限放大器链读出。受共振质量探测器启发，我们建立三环耦合电路模型，并推导等效应变噪声谱，包括热噪声、SQUID 反作用和测量不精确度。原型测量显示品质因数 Q≃5×10^5，而 Q=10^7 被视为未来开发目标。在假定磁通耦合和理想化量子极限 SQUID 噪声模型下，优化电路在 1–20 kHz 范围内、100 Hz 带宽内给出约 10^-21 Hz^-1/2 的投影应变灵敏度。增加有效高场体积并改进量子极限读出可进一步提升灵敏度。这种紧凑、可调探测器概念可补充干涉引力波搜索，并激发对高频天体物理源的探索。

English: We present a concept for a superconducting inductance--capacitance (LC) resonator immersed in a magnetic field for gravitational-wave detection in the kHz band. In the long-wavelength limit, a gravitational wave in a static magnetic field induces an oscillating magnetic-field perturbation proportional to the static magnetic field applied to the resonator and to the gravitational-wave strain. We show that a superconducting pickup circuit can convert this perturbation into a flux signal read out by a superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID)-based or quantum-limited amplifier chain. Inspired by resonant-mass detectors, we develop a three-loop coupled-circuit model and derive the equivalent strain-noise spectrum, including thermal noise, SQUID backaction, and measurement imprecision. Prototype measurements demonstrate a quality factor of $Q\simeq 5\times 10^5$, while $Q=10^7$ is considered as a future development target. Under the assumed flux coupling and an idealized quantum-limited SQUID noise model, optimized circuits yield projected strain sensitivities of order $10^{-21}\,\mathrm{Hz}^{-1/2}$ over $100\,\mathrm{Hz}$ bands in the $1$--$20\,\mathrm{kHz}$ range. Increasing the active high-field volume and improving quantum-limited readout could enable further sensitivity gains. This compact, tunable detector concept could complement interferometric gravitational-wave searches and motivate investigations of high-frequency astrophysical sources.

一句话导读：提出一种置于多特斯拉磁场中的超导 LC 谐振器方案，用于桌面 kHz 引力波探测并给出噪声与灵敏度预估。

利用引力波暗汽笛与21厘米强度映射进行宇宙学推断：LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA与MeerKAT及SKAO的预测

Cosmological Inference with Gravitational-Wave Dark Sirens and 21-cm Intensity Mapping: Forecasts for LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA with MeerKAT and SKAO

Dounia Nanadoumgar-Lacroze, Konstantin Leyde, Steven Cunnington, Tessa Baker, Ian Harrison, Ulyana Dupletsa, Simone Mastrogiovanni, Riccardo Murgia, Tommaso Ronconi, Matteo Schulz, Marta Spinelli · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：引力波与21厘米强度映射正成为互补的宇宙学探针：引力波提供直接的光度距离测量，而中性氢强度映射在红移空间追踪物质分布，两者协同有望精确测量哈勃常数。我们在标准汽笛框架下，使用LVK O5灵敏度下一年观测所预期的约150个信噪比大于12的模拟引力波探测事件，进行联合宇宙学与种群分析，并将这些事件与MeerKLASS和SKA-Mid的模拟中性氢强度映射结合，研究引力波和强度映射两方面的观测限制如何影响H0约束。我们发现引力波参数测量不确定性是宇宙学约束的主要限制；若忽略该不确定性，加入中性氢信息可实现亚百分比的H0约束。我们还发现中性氢巡天的观测效应会削弱约束，但仍比不使用中性氢信息的光谱汽笛结果更紧。即使计入中性氢强度映射的观测限制，相对于光谱汽笛结果，加入中性氢信息使H0不确定度分别降低61%（MeerKLASS）和53%（SKA-Mid）。由于结果基于单一实现，应考虑实现间涨落的可能影响。波束卷积最严重地削弱约束；仪器噪声可在后验中引入多峰性，并可能使推断参数产生偏差；结果对前景清理不足和过度清理敏感；部分天区覆盖影响相对较小。在最现实情景下，同时计入引力波和中性氢强度映射限制，MeerKLASS和SKA-Mid的H0精度估计分别为10%和15%。

English: Gravitational waves (GWs) and 21-cm intensity mapping (IM) are emerging as complementary cosmological probes: GWs provide direct luminosity-distance measurements, while neutral-hydrogen (HI) IM traces the matter distribution in redshift space. Their synergy offers a promising avenue for precise measurements of the Hubble constant. Within a standard-siren framework, we perform a joint cosmological and population analysis using $\mathcal{O}(150)$ mock GW detections with SNR > 12, as projected for one year of observations at LVK O5 sensitivity. We combine these with mock HI intensity maps from MeerKLASS and SKA-Mid, and study how observational limitations in both the GW and IM data affect the $H_0$ constraints. We find that uncertainty in GW parameter measurements is a dominant limitation on the cosmological constraints. Neglecting this uncertainty, the inclusion of HI information enables sub-percent constraints on $H_0$. We also find that observational effects in the HI surveys weaken the constraints, although they remain tighter than those obtained without HI information (spectral sirens). Despite accounting for HI IM observational limitations, including HI information reduces the $H_0$ uncertainty relative to the spectral-siren results by 61% for MeerKLASS and 53% for SKA-Mid. Because our results are based on a single realisation, they should be interpreted in light of possible realisation-to-realisation variability. Beam convolution most severely weakens the constraints. Instrumental noise can induce multimodality in the posterior, potentially biasing the inferred parameters. The results are sensitive to foreground under-cleaning and over-cleaning. Partial sky coverage has a relatively small impact. In the most realistic scenario, which accounts for both GW and HI IM limitations, we obtain $H_0$ precision estimates of 10% and 15% for MeerKLASS and SKA-Mid, respectively.

中文摘要：中子星核心中的强一阶相变可能对天体物理可观测量产生深远影响，但其存在仍是一个开放问题。由于大多数中子星在双星系统中形成，它们预计会经历长期吸积，逐渐增加中心密度，并可能触发这种相变。此前研究提示，这可能产生可观测的多信使信号。受此前景驱动，我们生成了一组新的强子-夸克物质状态方程，涵盖不同强度的一阶相变，并纳入了夸克相中的中微子吸收不透明度。随后，我们对经历吸积诱导相变的中子星进行了广义相对论辐射流体力学模拟。与先前发现相反，我们的结果表明，对于所考虑的模型，这些系统不会产生无束缚抛射物，这使得吸积诱导相变不太可能成为可观测电磁暂现源的来源。然而，我们发现相变伴随强烈中微子发射，对于所考虑的最强相变，峰值光度达到约10^52 erg/s。为便于未来数值研究，我们公开了本工作使用的状态方程系列和中微子不透明度，从而能够系统探索相变强度的作用。

English: Strong first-order phase transitions in the cores of neutron stars (NSs) can have profound implications for astrophysical observables, however, their existence remains an open question. Since most NSs form in binary systems, they are expected to experience prolonged episodes of mass accretion that gradually increase their central density and can potentially trigger such a transition. This might, in turn, generate observable multi-messenger signals, as suggested by previous studies. Motivated by this prospect, we generate a new set of equations of state for hadron--quark matter with first-order phase transitions of various strengths, including neutrino absorption opacities in the quark phase as well. We then perform general-relativistic radiation hydrodynamics simulations of NSs undergoing accretion-induced phase transitions. In contrast to previous findings, our results indicate that these systems do not produce unbound ejecta for the models considered, making accretion-induced phase transitions unlikely sources of observable electromagnetic transients. However, we find that transitions are accompanied by intense neutrino emission, with peak luminosities reaching $\sim10^{52}~\mathrm{erg/s}$ for the strongest transition considered. To facilitate future numerical studies, we make the family of equations of state and neutrino opacities used in this work publicly available, enabling the systematic exploration of the role of the phase transition strength.

English: The source PSR J0901-4046 shows a very long rotational period, of $\approx 75.88$ s. In fact, its long period suggests that it could be a white dwarf. We examine the properties of the source and compare the outcomes under the hypotheses of the source being a highly magnetized white dwarf (B-WD) and neutron star. We find that assuming it to be a B-WD with a surface field $\sim 10^{10}$ G explains many properties, including its storage/rotational energy, explaining luminosity. On the contrary, the neutron star-based idea, particularly if examined under the conventional spin down mechanism, requires an unusually high surface magnetic field $\gtrsim 10^{14}$ G, even exceeding $10^{16}$ G, depending on the obliquity angle and emission mechanism. The source also sits very close to AR Sco, a white dwarf pulsar, in the period and period-derivative plane. We suggest that the source is a B-WD. Along with AR Sco, it being a B-WD constrains the death line model. B-WD hypothesis alleviates the necessity of an unusually high magnetic field hindering pair production for PSR J0901-4046 under the neutron star hypothesis. We argue that some rotation-powered pulsars with extreme properties may possibly be white dwarfs rather than neutron stars.
