具有交叉物态的混合星

Hybrid Stars with a Crossover Equation of State

G. A. Tsalis, Ch. C. Moustakidis · nucl-th, astro-ph.SR · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：超致密核物质中是否发生相变仍是核物理的开放问题，尤其是从纯强子物质到假定退禁闭夸克物质的转变备受关注。除基础意义外，该转变对致密天体物理（包括中子星、夸克星和混合星）有重要影响。传统方法采用 Maxwell 和 Gibbs 构造，二者已被广泛研究和应用。本工作关注第三种替代方案，即通过所谓切换函数实现从强子物质到夸克物质的平滑过渡。具体而言，本文有两个主要目标：第一，系统研究对称能对与向夸克物质转变相关的转变密度和化学势的影响；第二，尝试对刻画切换函数的两个参数进行物理约束和参数化，使强子到夸克物质的转变不仅是连续的，而且符合相关物理要求。主要结论是，在适当选择上述参数时，该唯象模型更具物理动机，可作为研究混合致密天体结构与性质的有用工具。此外，该方法能够灵活预测超出标准中子星理论范围的致密天体性质，例如近来在观测研究中受到关注的相对低质量和小半径天体。

English: The possible occurrence of a phase transition in superdense nuclear matter remains an open problem in nuclear physics. In particular, the transition from purely hadronic matter to the hypothesized deconfined quark matter is a subject of considerable interest. Beyond its fundamental significance, this transition has important implications for the physics of compact objects, including neutron stars, quark stars, and hybrid stars. The conventional approaches to this problem involve the Maxwell and Gibbs constructions, both of which have been extensively studied and applied. In the present study, we focus on a third, alternative approach based on a smooth transition from hadronic to quark matter through the so-called switching function. More specifically, the present work focuses on two main objectives. The first is to systematically investigate the influence of the symmetry energy on the transition densities and chemical potentials associated with the transition to quark matter. Subsequently, we attempt to physically constrain and parametrize the two parameters characterizing the switching function, ensuring that the transition from hadronic to quark matter is not merely continuous but also consistent with relevant physical requirements. The main conclusion is that, with an appropriate choice of the aforementioned parameters, the phenomenological model becomes more physically motivated and can serve as a useful tool for investigating the structure and properties of hybrid compact objects. Moreover, this approach offers the flexibility to predict the properties of compact objects that lie beyond the scope of standard neutron-star theory, such as objects characterized by relatively low masses and small radii, which have recently attracted considerable attention in observational studies.

一句话导读：用切换函数实现强子到夸克物质平滑过渡的交叉物态，并研究对称能影响与混合星性质。

A conformal reduction for the X-ADM mass

Stephen McCormick · math.DG, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：X-ADM 质量是 Mantegazza 与 Oronzio 最近为渐近平坦流形引入的 ADM 质量推广，他们在三维且满足某拓扑条件下证明了该量的正质量定理。本文在所有维度 n≥3 且无拓扑限制下证明带刚性的 X-正质量定理。为此，先证明 X-正质量定理中出现的标量曲率条件蕴含度量为正 Yamabe 型；随后证明给定度量的 X-ADM 质量等于其共形类中标量平坦代表度量的 ADM 质量加上一个显式非负项。由此，X-正质量定理可由标准正质量定理推出。作为推论，得到所有维度中广义相对论的黎曼质量-电荷不等式，而此前仅对自旋流形成立。最后，给出带边界流形的 X-正质量定理版本。

English: The X-ADM mass is a generalisation of the ADM mass for asymptotically flat manifolds, recently introduced by Mantegazza and Oronzio [arXiv:2602.11372], who proved a positive mass theorem for this quantity in dimension $3$ under a certain topological condition. In this article, we prove the X-positive mass theorem with rigidity in all dimensions $n\geq3$ without any topological restrictions. To this end, we first prove that the scalar curvature condition appearing in the X-positive mass theorem implies the metric is of positive Yamabe type. We then show that the X-ADM mass of the given metric is equal to the ADM mass of a scalar-flat representative in its conformal class plus a term that is explicitly non-negative. From this, the X-positive mass theorem follows from the standard positive mass theorem. As a corollary, we obtain the Riemannian mass--charge inequality of general relativity in all dimensions, which was previously only known for spin manifolds. Finally, we give a version of the X-positive mass theorem for a manifold with boundary.

一句话导读：通过共形约化在所有维度且无拓扑限制下证明带刚性的 X-正质量定理，并得到黎曼质量-电荷不等式。

中文摘要：近期研究表明，尽管前往最近黑洞的星际任务仍高度推测性且极具挑战，但在未来数十年内并非完全不可行。鉴于此类任务可能耗时约一百年并需要大量财力和人力投入，必须评估它能否以可预见的未来太阳系观测站无法达到的程度研究黑洞并检验广义相对论。在第一篇论文中，作者假设具备航天器减速能力，并初步研究了轨道探测器如何检验该致密天体的性质。在这第二篇论文中，作者研究如何在不减速航天器的情况下，利用飞掠探测器检验黑洞。

English: Recently, we demonstrated that while an interstellar mission to the nearest black hole remains highly speculative and extraordinarily challenging, it is not entirely implausible within the coming decades. Given that such a mission would likely take about a hundred years and require substantial financial and human investment, it is essential to assess whether it could investigate black holes and test General Relativity to a degree that cannot be achieved by Solar System observatories for the foreseeable future. In Paper I, we assumed the capability to decelerate the spacecraft and presented a preliminary study of how orbiting probes could test the nature of the compact object. In this second paper, we study how the black hole can be tested without decelerating the spacecraft, using flyby probes.

面向致密双星并合引力波的深度学习搜索

Deep Learning Search for Gravitational Waves from Compact Binary Coalescence

Lorenzo Mobilia, Tito Dal Canton, Gianluca Maria Guidi · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v3 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：引力波搜索依赖于匹配滤波、相干分析以及近年来基于机器学习的流程等多种方法。对于致密双星并合——其信号来源于致密天体的相对论动力学——匹配滤波仍是核心要素，但随着下一代干涉仪（如爱因斯坦望远镜）所需的数据量和参数空间覆盖范围增加，其计算成本将大幅上升。因此，发展能够在保持探测性能的同时降低计算负担的补充策略十分必要。我们研究了一种将匹配滤波思想与卷积神经网络相结合的混合方法，从而在不依赖通常的χ²剔除检验的情况下实现高效信号搜索。利用包含注入信号的高斯噪声、瞬态噪声以及模板库未涵盖的物理效应（如偏心率、进动和高阶模式）的模拟数据集，我们表明：在信号所含物理未在模板库中体现或数据受到毛刺影响的所有情形下，该方法达到与标准匹配滤波搜索相当或更好的探测效率，同时提供更节省资源的流程。反之，分析也揭示出，在纯高斯噪声中对标准BNS/BBH搜索存在一定的探测能力损失。这些结果表明，深度学习辅助搜索可以支撑未来探测器时代的可持续引力波数据分析。

English: Gravitational-wave searches rely on a combination of methods, including matched filtering, coherent analyses, and more recent machine-learning-based pipelines. For compact binary coalescences --- where signals originate from the relativistic dynamics of compact objects --- matched filtering remains a central element, but its computational cost will increase substantially with the data volumes and parameter-space coverage required by next-generation interferometers such as the Einstein Telescope. Developing complementary strategies that reduce computational load while preserving detection performance is therefore essential. We investigate a hybrid approach that combines matched-filtering concepts with Convolutional Neural Networks, enabling efficient signal searches without relying on the usual $\chi^2$ rejection test. Using simulated data sets that include injected signals in Gaussian noise, transient noise, and physical effects not represented in the template bank --- such as eccentricity, precession and higher-order modes --- we show that the method achieves a detection efficiency comparable to or better than a standard matched-filtering search while offering a more resource-efficient pipeline in all the cases where the physics included in the signals were not represented in the template bank or when glitches were affecting the data. Conversely, the analysis also reveals some loss of detection capability for standard BNS/BBH searches in pure Gaussian noise. These results indicate that deep-learning-assisted searches can support sustainable gravitational-wave data analysis in future detector eras.

一句话导读：该文提出匹配滤波与卷积神经网络结合的混合搜索方法，以更低计算成本探测致密双星并合引力波，并在非模板物理与毛刺场景中保持或提升效率。

持久的mEMRIs：活动星系核盘中多个黑洞极端质量比旋近的信号

Lasting mEMRIs: Signatures of Multiple Black Hole Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals from AGN discs

Jordan W. N. Moncrieff, Evgeni Grishin, Fiona H. Panther, Alessandro A. Trani · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：活动星系核盘中的恒星级黑洞相遇会自然形成黑洞对的平均运动共振。当引力波辐射超过气体力矩时，这些平均运动共振可在靠近中心超大质量黑洞处被破坏。我们推导出一个仅依赖恒星级黑洞质量比和共振指数的简单条件，用来判断一对处于平均运动共振的恒星级黑洞能否保持完整，并作为多重极端质量比旋近（mEMRIs）在LISA波段被探测到。我们首次给出处于平均运动共振、共同迁移的一对恒星级黑洞的引力波应变信号，包括与单个EMRI轨道会合相关的额外引力波谐波。其频率演化和相应啁啾质量与不同质量的孤立EMRI存在简并。然而，mEMRI的质量比被共振阶数量子化，并大于真实质量比；若能从单个应变振幅推断真实恒星级黑洞质量比，则可打破该简并。我们认为，若盘驱动的EMRI能被LISA探测到，mEMRIs应当常见，在本地宇宙（z≲0.2）中约为每年10个，这凸显了未来LISA数据分析中建模mEMRI系统的必要性。

English: Encounters of stellar-mass black holes (sBH) in active galactic nuclei discs naturally form mean-motion resonances of sBH pairs. These mean-motion resonances can be broken close to the central supermassive black hole when gravitational-wave emission dominates over gas torques. We derive a simple condition that depends only on the sBH mass ratio and the resonance index for which a pair of sBH in a mean-motion resonance will remain intact and can be detectable as a multiple Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals (mEMRIs) in the LISA band. We present for the first time the gravitational-wave strain signatures of a pair of co-migrating sBH in mean-motion resonance, including additional gravitational-wave harmonics associated with orbital conjunctions of the individual EMRIs. The frequency evolution and the associated chirp mass is degenerate with isolated EMRIs of different masses. However, the mEMRI mass ratio is quantised by the resonance order and is larger than the true mass ratio. The degeneracy can be broken if the true sBH mass ratio can be inferred from individual strain amplitudes. We argue that mEMRIs should be common if disc driven EMRIs are to be detected by LISA, with $\sim 10$ mEMRIs per year in the local universe ($z \lesssim 0.2$), highlighting the need to model mEMRI systems in future LISA data analysis.

一句话导读：研究活动星系核盘中成对恒星级黑洞的平均运动共振如何产生LISA可探测的多重极端质量比旋近引力波信号。

快速旋转中子星中r模非线性演化的广义相对论模拟

General Relativistic Simulations of the Nonlinear Evolution of r-modes in Rapidly Rotating Neutron Stars

Justin K. Yu, Andrew Melatos · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：旋转中子星中的r模是连续引力波的一个有希望来源，并可能增长或被激发到振幅 α≲1。我们对自转频率约 792 Hz 的快速旋转中子星中非线性 l=|m|=2 r模进行了广义相对论模拟，放松了 Cowling 近似和小 α 近似。恒星被理想化为无磁场、单组分、完美流体，并采用多方物态方程。对于初始振幅 α0=0.2，测得 r模频率为 1014 Hz；无量纲频率 κ≈0.7197 与线性微扰理论估计在 1.7% 以内一致。f_r-mode 随振幅二次增加，而在 0.2≤α0≤1.2 范围内改变 α0 的模拟中 κ 下降 3.4%。由 Newman-Penrose 标量计算出的引力波应变给出：当 α0=0.2 时，在 10 kpc 处 h_r-mode≈9.7×10^-22，与爱因斯坦四极矩公式在 35% 以内一致。我们还报告了模拟中观察到的非线性现象，例如较差自转、振幅衰减以及时空振荡中非线性模式耦合的迹象。

English: The r-modes in rotating neutron stars are a promising source of continuous gravitational waves, and may grow or be excited to amplitudes $\alpha\lesssim1$. We perform general relativistic simulations of nonlinear $l=|m|=2$ r-modes in a rapidly rotating neutron star with spin frequency $f_{spin}\approx792$ Hz, relaxing the Cowling and small-$\alpha$ approximations. The star is idealised as an unmagnetised, one-component, perfect fluid with a polytropic equation of state. The r-mode frequency is measured to be $f_{r-mode}=1014$ Hz for initial amplitude $\alpha_0=0.2$. The dimensionless frequency $\kappa\approx0.7197$ agrees with an estimate from linear perturbation theory to within 1.7%. $f_{r-mode}$ increases quadratically with amplitude, and $\kappa$ decreases by 3.4% across simulations where $\alpha_0$ is varied through the range $0.2\leq\alpha_0\leq1.2$. The gravitational wave strain calculated from the Newman-Penrose scalar implies $h_{r-mode}\approx9.7\times10^{-22}$ at $10$ kpc for $\alpha_0=0.2$, which agrees with Einstein's quadrupole formula to within 35%. We also report on nonlinear phenomena observed in our simulations, e.g. differential rotation, amplitude decay, and signatures of nonlinear mode coupling in the spacetime oscillations.

一句话导读：用广义相对论数值模拟研究快速旋转中子星中非线性r模的频率、引力波应变与非线性耦合现象。

中文摘要：本文研究手征引力波背景（GWB）的弱透镜效应，作为在宇宙微波背景中产生宇称奇关联的新机制。考虑光子偏折和偏振旋转，推导出相应的宇称奇 EB 和 TB 角功率谱。对代表性 GWB 能量密度谱，找到能很好拟合现有测量的参数选择。该机制为手征 GWB 提供潜在观测探针，而手征 GWB 可出现在广泛理论情景中。

English: We investigate weak lensing effects of a chiral gravitational wave background (GWB) as a new mechanism for generating parity-odd correlations in the cosmic microwave background (CMB). Accounting for both photon deflection and polarization rotation, we derive the resulting parity-odd EB and TB angular power spectra. For representative GWB energy density spectra, we find parameter choices that provide good fits to existing measurements. This mechanism provides a potential observational probe of chiral GWB, which can arise in a wide range of theoretical scenarios.

先验体积效应抬高脉冲星计时阵列中的引力波背景

Prior volume effect inflates the gravitational-wave background in pulsar timing arrays

Biwei Dai, Matias Zaldarriaga, Yacine Ali-Ha\"{\i}moud · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）已发现纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）的证据，其振幅超过基于超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）的大多数预言。利用 NANOGrav 15 年数据，我们表明这一超出部分的相当大比例来自先验体积效应。GWB 振幅主要受脉冲星自相关约束，其中 GWB 与每颗脉冲星的内禀红噪声简并。通过分解 GWB 后验，我们发现对标准对数均匀红噪声先验进行边缘化会引入一个偏爱更强 GWB 的先验体积项，将推断振幅拉高到最大似然估计以上超过 2σ。仅测量 GWB 的 Hellings-Downs（HD）交叉相关不足以抵消该体积项。轮廓似然、仅交叉相关估计量，以及对功率均匀或由脉冲星族群信息给出的先验，都能避免或减弱这一效应，并将振幅降低到与 SMBHB 一致。修正后的先验还给出更接近 SMBHB 预言的更陡 GWB 谱，增强 HD 相关的证据，并削弱对新物理源优于 SMBHB 的偏好。

English: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have found evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background (GWB) whose amplitude exceeds most predictions based on supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs). Using NANOGrav 15-year data, we show that a substantial part of this excess arises from a prior volume effect. The GWB amplitude is constrained mainly by the pulsars' auto-correlations, where the GWB is degenerate with each pulsar's intrinsic red noise. By decomposing the GWB posterior, we find that marginalizing over the standard log-uniform red-noise priors introduces a prior volume term that favors a stronger GWB, pulling the inferred amplitude more than $2\sigma$ above the maximum-likelihood estimate. The Hellings-Downs (HD) cross-correlations, which measure the GWB alone, are not strong enough to counter the volume term. The profile likelihood, a cross-correlation-only estimator, and priors that are uniform in power or informed by the pulsar population all avoid or reduce this effect and lower the amplitude into agreement with SMBHBs. The revised priors also yield a steeper GWB spectrum closer to the SMBHB predictions, strengthen the evidence for HD correlations, and weaken the preference for new-physics sources over SMBHBs.

一句话导读：利用 NANOGrav 15 年数据表明，GWB 振幅相对 SMBHB 预言的超出部分主要源于红噪声先验体积效应；修正先验后振幅回到与 SMBHB 一致的范围。

并合致密双星的后绝热有效单体波形

Post-adiabatic effective-one-body waveforms for coalescing compact binaries

Rossella Gamba · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文将 Damour 等（2004）和 Lynch 等（2026）的密切轨道形式应用并推广到偏心有效单体（EOB）模型，以高效且准确地描述潮汐、自旋致密双星从旋近到 plunging 的动力学，并通过扭转原本平面运动来包含进动情形。方法改用 equinoctial 轨道根数，以避免零偏心率极限相关的奇点。该形式具有通用性，可应用于任何 EOB 模型；本文聚焦 TEOBResumS-Dalí 家族，并展示该技术如何加速波形生成而不显著牺牲模型精度。对超过 10^4 个双中子星（BNS）和同样数量的双黑洞（BBH），初始偏心率在 20 Hz 时最高达 0.6，相对于该模型优化版本的中位加速约为 BNS 2.6 倍、BBH 1.5 倍，与完整数值解的失配始终低于 5×10^-7。单个系统的最大加速可达约 7 倍，出现在低偏心率（e0≲0.1）的轻 BBH（M≲8 M⊙）中。绝对而言，生成 BNS 波形的中位时间约为 0.5 秒，99.7% 的系统低于一秒；对于长信号，该模型比先前版本最多快约 26 倍。将该方法用于 e→0 极限下的初始条件计算时，引入辐射反作用效应可使模型输入偏心率与规范不变波形偏心率一致到初始值约 7×10^-8。除时域应用外，同一构造还通过多谐波驻相近似给出偏心致密双星的频域 EOB 波形。

English: I apply and extend the formalism of osculating orbits of Damour et al. (2004) and Lynch et al. (2026) to eccentric effective one body (EOB) models, in order to obtain an efficient yet accurate description of the inspiral-to-plunge dynamics of tidal, spinning compact binaries, including precessing ones by twisting the otherwise planar motion. The method is recast in terms of equinoctial orbital elements, to circumvent singularities associated with the zero-eccentricity limit. While the formalism is general and can be applied to any EOB model, I focus here on the TEOBResumS-Dal\'i family and demonstrate how this technique speeds up waveform generation without significantly compromising the accuracy of the model. Over $10^4$ binary neutron stars (BNSs) and as many binary black holes (BBHs) with initial eccentricities up to $0.6$ at $20$ Hz, the median speedup against an optimized version of the model is $\sim 2.6$ for BNSs and $\sim 1.5$ for BBHs, with mismatches against the full numerical solution always below $5 \times 10^{-7}$. English: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors, such as LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer, will require accurate and efficient models of long-lived, eccentric black-hole binary signals. However, the parametrization in terms of the eccentricity and relativistic anomaly becomes singular in the circular-orbit limit, excluding quasicircular binaries and the late stages of eccentric inspirals. Moreover, the cost of generating the waveform from the averaged dynamics limited the overall speed-up to a factor of $1.5-8$. Benefiting from our customized adaptive step-size strategy for geodesic integration, SpinOctopus achieves an impressive processing efficiency of $\sim 800$ rays per second per thread on an Intel Core i7-14700 platform when simulating geometrically thick accretion disk images. Furthermore, the code provides transparent interfaces, allowing users to seamlessly modify the geometric and kinematic properties of the light sources. Additional capabilities, such as simulating Fe K${\alpha}$ fluorescent line profiles and geometrically thick tilted accretion disk images, will be introduced in future releases of the framework.

How general relativity stacks up: Testing gravity by coherently combining gravitational-wave observations

Lachlan Passenger, Nir Guttman, Paul D. Lasky, Eric Thrane · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：引力波天文学的核心任务之一是在高曲率、高速度区域检验广义相对论。本文提出一个框架，用于相干组合多个引力波测量，从而在族群层面检验超越广义相对论的物理。作者假设偏离广义相对论的效应在并合附近最强、随双星总质量平滑变化，并且在 ℓ=|m|=2 模式中最显著。将该框架应用于 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第五次引力波瞬变星表中的 28 个高信噪比双黑洞并合事件，未发现偏离广义相对论的证据。该框架可展示偏离如何随系统总质量变化，并被认为有助于区分波形系统误差与真实的广义相对论违反。

English: A core mission of gravitational-wave astronomy is to test general relativity (GR) in the high-curvature, high-velocity regime. The field has already seen significant progress in this space, though a remaining challenge is how to combine data from a population of binary mergers. This can both boost the significance of potential GR violations, and develop a phenomenological picture of how deviations manifest in different mergers. We propose a framework to coherently combine gravitational-wave measurements to build a population-level test of physics beyond GR. We assume that deviations from GR are (i) strongest near the merger, (ii) vary smoothly with the total mass of the binary, and (iii) are most prominent in the $\ell=|m|=2$ mode. While these assumptions do not describe every possible deviation of GR, they provide us with a plausible starting point upon which a more general framework can be built. We apply our framework to 28 high signal-to-noise ratio binary black hole mergers from LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA's Fifth Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog, finding no evidence for deviations from GR. Our framework allows one to show how deviations could vary as a function of total mass of the system. We argue that such a reconstruction can be used to convincingly distinguish between systematic waveform errors and genuine GR violations.

一句话导读：提出一种族群层面相干组合引力波观测的框架，并用 28 个高信噪比双黑洞并合事件检验广义相对论，未发现偏离证据。

Vegh–dRGT 大质量引力中的虫洞：零能量透明性定理、视界阻碍与精确各向同性解

Wormholes in Vegh--dRGT massive gravity: a null-energy transparency theorem, horizon obstruction, and exact isotropic solutions

Sudan Hansraj, Ayan Banerjee · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文研究在具有空间退化 Vegh 参考度规的 de Rham–Gabadadze–Tolley (dRGT) 大质量引力中的静态球对称虫洞。大质量引力子所携带的有效流体对 flare-out 条件所约束的密度与径向压强组合没有贡献，因此沿径向光线的零能量条件对其不可见。该结论适用于整个退化参考度规类、全部四种相互作用势以及任意静态球对称几何；同一性质也使 Vegh 选择成为唯一自洽的选择。于是物质本身必须在每个喉部违反零能量条件，与广义相对论情形完全一致；这纠正了大质量引力虫洞文献中反复出现的一个断言。随后我们确定喉部可以位于何处。各向同性压强的虫洞分为两族：一族位于该理论自身真空的宇宙学视界之外，没有静态外部，在广义相对论中为空，并由引力子耦合开启；另一族位于该视界之内，需要陡峭下降的红移。我们给出两族的精确完美流体解。在第二族中，引力子项可将喉部张力转化为普通压强。一个薄壳闭合该构型，其表面应力和奇异物质含量以闭合形式给出。这些壳层在径向不稳定，喉部附近的光线形成不稳定圆轨道。

English: We study static, spherically symmetric wormholes in deRham--Gabadadze--Tolley massive gravity with the spatially degenerate Vegh reference metric. The effective fluid carried by the massive graviton contributes nothing to the combination of density and radial pressure that the flare-out condition constrains, so it is invisible to the null energy condition along radial light rays. This holds for the whole degenerate class of reference metrics, for all four interaction potentials, and for any static spherically symmetric geometry; the same property singles out the Vegh choice as the only consistent one. The matter alone must therefore violate the null energy condition at every throat, exactly as in general relativity. This corrects a claim repeated across the massive-gravity wormhole literature. We then determine where throats may sit. Wormholes with isotropic pressure fall into two families. One lies beyond the cosmological horizon of the theory's own vacuum and has no static exterior; it is empty in general relativity and is switched on by the graviton coupling. The other lies inside that horizon and needs a steeply falling redshift. We give exact perfect-fluid solutions for both. In the second family the graviton term can turn the tension at the throat into ordinary pressure. A thin shell closes the configuration, and its surface stresses and its exotic-matter content follow in closed form. The shells are radially unstable, and light rays near the throat trace an unstable circular orbit.

一句话导读：证明在 Vegh–dRGT 大质量引力中引力子有效流体对径向零能量条件透明，虫洞喉部仍须由物质违反 NEC，并给出两类精确各向同性虫洞解及薄壳稳定性分析。

Einstein--Maxwell--scalar 场引力的调和分支：精确解与正则性

Harmonic branches of Einstein--Maxwell--scalar field gravity: exact solutions and regularity

Leonel Bixano, Tonatiuh Matos · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文将黑洞视界和虫洞喉与 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton 引力的调和分支几何联系起来。在统一的 Ernst 框架中，先求解调和方程再固定空间调和函数，然后联合重构度规、Maxwell 四势和标量场。守恒测地线能量固定子午 Weyl 求积，初始测地线数据对应渐近荷。选择 Schwarzschild 调和函数时，正则非极端视界固定归一化 H=1 及相关物质场正则性要求。这重现 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordstrom 族（含 NUT 扩展）、Gibbons-Maeda 解、dyonic string 和 Kaluza-Klein 解，并保留更一般分支。若标量部分延拓到 phantom 符号，则得到互补的扁椭球构造：光滑延拓选择 H=-1 并产生有质量和超静态的 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞。通过与真空环几何比较，说明全局延拓的进一步重要性。这些结果给出重构解中电荷关系和正则性约束的统一黑洞--虫洞几何解读。

English: We relate black-hole horizons and wormhole throats to the geometry of the harmonic branches of Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton gravity. In the unified Ernst framework, we first solve the harmonic equations prior to fixing the spatial harmonic, and then jointly reconstruct the metric, Maxwell four-potential, and scalar field. The conserved geodesic energy fixes the meridional Weyl quadrature, whereas the initial geodesic data capture the asymptotic charges. Choosing the Schwarzschild harmonic function, regular nonextremal horizons fix the normalization \(H=1\) along with the associated matter-field regularity requirements. This reproduces the Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordstrom families (including the NUT extension), the Gibbons-Maeda solution, and the dyonic string and Kaluza--Klein solutions, while also preserving their more general branches. If the scalar sector is continued to the phantom sign, one obtains a complementary oblate construction: smooth continuation selects \(H=-1\) and produces the massive and ultrastatic Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes. By comparing with the vacuum ring geometry, we make clear the further importance of the global extension. Altogether, these findings offer a unified black-hole--wormhole geometric reading of the charge relations and regularity constraints for the reconstructed solutions.

一句话导读：在 Ernst 框架下构造 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton 引力的调和分支精确解，并统一描述黑洞与虫洞的正则性及电荷关系。

加速与超加速黑洞上的场：稳定性、准正规模、灰体因子与强宇宙监督

Fields on accelerating and super accelerating black holes: stability, quasinormal modes, greybody factors and strong cosmic censorship

Francisco Silva · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文研究无质量标量场、狄拉克场和麦克斯韦场在由 C-metric 描述的加速与超加速黑洞时空中的传播。超加速区域最近才被识别，仍 largely 未被探索。作者研究这些背景的线性稳定性和模式稳定性，并在若干时空极限下给出准正规模谱与灰体因子的解析表达式，对准正规模家族进行分类，特别关注超加速区域中出现的新家族。文章还通过 Christodoulou 的 β 判据研究强宇宙监督，发现参数空间中可能存在违反该猜想的区域，包括超加速区域；这些违反可能出现在无质量标量场和麦克斯韦场情形，而狄拉克场保持该猜想。

English: We investigate the propagation of massless scalar, Dirac, and Maxwell fields on accelerating and super accelerating black hole spacetimes described by the C-metric. The latter regime has only recently been identified and remains largely unexplored. We study the linear and mode stability of these backgrounds and derive analytical expressions for the quasinormal mode spectra and greybody factors in various spacetime limits. We classify the quasinormal mode families, paying particular attention to new families arising in the super accelerating regime. We also investigate strong cosmic censorship through Christodoulou's $\beta$ criterion, finding regions of parameter space where it may be violated, including in the super accelerating regime. These violations are possible for massless scalar and Maxwell fields, whereas Dirac fields preserve the conjecture.

一句话导读：研究 C-metric 加速与超加速黑洞中标量、狄拉克和麦克斯韦场的稳定性、准正规模、灰体因子及强宇宙监督。

标量-张量引力中具有反德西特核心的非线性电动力学规则磁黑洞：无鬼构造与轴向稳定性

Regular magnetic black holes with anti-de Sitter cores in scalar-tensor gravity with nonlinear electrodynamics: ghost-free construction and axial stability

Rustam Ibadov, Najibullokhon Shukurullokhon · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：我们在爱因斯坦框架的标量-张量引力中构造静态、渐近平坦的规则黑洞，其源为与磁非线性电动力学耦合的规范标量场。通过给定密度和标量剖面，我们重构度规、标量-光子耦合和势。规则性要求质量函数在中心消失，从而固定ADM质量，并要求密度的中心r^2增长由标量梯度能平衡。这些解具有由负势支持的AdS核心和近似Reissner-Nordström外部；无鬼条件将磁荷限制在一个于有限核心深度处闭合的窗口内。轴向扰动约化为对称的双通道主系统，其正定势保证模式稳定性；谱方法和时域方法得到的准正规模频率一致。中心附近的角Laplacian不稳定性可隐藏在内视界之后，这排除了无地平线解。

English: We construct static, asymptotically flat regular black holes in Einstein-frame scalar--tensor gravity, sourced by a canonical scalar coupled to magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics. Prescribing the density and scalar profiles, we reconstruct the metric, the scalar--photon coupling and the potential. Regularity requires the mass function to vanish at the centre, which fixes the ADM mass, and the central $r^2$ growth of the density to be balanced by the scalar gradient energy. The solutions have an anti-de Sitter core supported by a negative potential and a nearly Reissner--Nordstr\"om exterior; the no-ghost condition confines the magnetic charge to a window that closes at a finite core depth. Axial perturbations reduce to a symmetric two-channel master system whose positive-definite potential guarantees mode stability; spectral and time-domain quasinormal frequencies agree. An angular Laplacian instability near the centre can be hidden behind the inner horizon, which excludes horizonless solutions.

一句话导读：构造渐近平坦、AdS核心的规则磁黑洞，给出无鬼条件并证明轴向QNM稳定性。

B_(s)→D_(s) 衰变半轻子形状因子与 Isgur–Wise 函数的全息计算

Holographic Calculation of Semileptonic Form Factors and the Isgur--Wise Function for $B_{(s)}\to D_{(s)}$ Decays

Miguel Angel Martin Contreras, Alfredo Vega · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们在软墙模型（SWM）和非二次软墙模型（NQSWM）中分析半轻子衰变 B→Dℓν̄ℓ 和 B_s→D_sℓν̄ℓ。通过体波函数的重叠积分提取 Isgur–Wise 函数，并用重轻介子谱固定模型参数。我们在零反冲处施加重夸克对称性，并讨论与无质量体矢量场对偶的电弱流不守恒这一表观悖论。我们认为，由夸克质量导致的味道对称性显式破缺所引起的不守恒不会产生反常维度，因此体场保持无质量，而不守恒性编码在独立的边界耦合 g_+ 和 g_- 中。我们对分支比的预言与 LHCb 的 B_s→D_s 衰变数据吻合良好；轻子味普适性比值 R(D) 和 R(D_s) 与标准模型及格点 QCD 预言一致。我们发现全息模型在零反冲附近重现 Isgur–Wise 函数的普适性，而在最大反冲处的偏差表明需要更完整地处理高阶 1/m_Q 修正。

English: We present a holographic analysis of the semileptonic decays $B \to D \ell \bar{\nu}_\ell$ and $B_s \to D_s \ell \bar{\nu}_\ell$ within the Softwall Model (SWM) and the Non-Quadratic Softwall Model (NQSWM). We extract the Isgur-Wise function from the overlap integral of bulk wavefunctions, with model parameters fixed by the heavy-light meson spectra. We impose Heavy Quark Symmetry (HQS) at zero recoil and address the apparent paradox of a non-conserved electroweak current dual to a massless bulk vector field. We argue that the non-conservation, arising from explicit flavor-- symmetry breaking by quark masses, does not generate an anomalous dimension. Hence the bulk field remains massless, and the non-conservation is \emph{encoded} in the independent boundary couplings $g_+$ and $g_-$. Our predictions for the branching fractions are in good agreement with LHCb data for $B_s \to D_s$ decays. The lepton-flavor universality ratios $R(D)$ and $R(D_s)$ are consistent with Standard Model and lattice QCD predictions. We find that the holographic models reproduce the universality of the Isgur-Wise function near zero recoil, while discrepancies at maximum recoil suggest that a more complete treatment of higher-order $1/m_Q$ corrections is needed.

一句话导读：在软墙全息模型中由体波函数重叠计算 B_(s)→D_(s) 半轻子形状因子与 Isgur–Wise 函数，并与 LHCb 及轻子味普适性数据比较。

经典软对数定理中领头阶 G 下大质量粒子轨迹的对数修正

Logarithmic corrections to massive particle trajectories for the classical soft log theorems at leading order in $G$

T. H. Nadai · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文研究大质量粒子渐近轨迹的对数修正，这些修正进入四维引力散射中零无穷处辐射场软对数部分的计算。作者首先分离出进入粒子运动方程的度规部分，表明非线性源只能通过双曲面上的齐次模影响该部分；与所提出的软塔匹配后，这些模除第一模外均消失，而第一模在领头阶 G 下不能影响轨迹系数。随后通过在粒子世界线上反演物质能量动量张量，并利用 Legendre 多项式，得到领头阶 G 下以及各对数阶的轨迹系数；前两个系数重现了 G 阶和 G^2 阶的已知结果。

English: We study the logarithmic corrections to the asymptotic trajectories of massive particles. These corrections enter the calculation of the soft-log sector of the radiative field at null infinity in four-dimensional gravitational scattering. We first isolate the part of the metric which enters the particle equations of motion. We show that the nonlinear source can only affect this sector through homogeneous modes on the hyperboloid, and that matching to the proposed soft tower implies that these modes vanish, except for the first mode. We show that this mode cannot affect the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$. We then invert the matter energy-momentum tensor on the particle worldlines to obtain the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$ and at every logarithmic order using Legendre polynomials. The first two coefficients reproduce the known results at orders $G$ and $G^2$.

一句话导读：研究四维引力散射中大质量粒子轨迹的软对数修正，并在领头阶 G 下系统给出轨迹系数。

Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin 电磁场中的 Reissner-Nordström 解

Reissner-Nordstrom in the Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin electromagnetic field

Marco Astorino · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文给出嵌入 Bertotti-Robinson 磁场中的磁性 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞，并以它为种子，通过 Ernst 方程的 Harrison 变换生成 Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin 磁场中的 Reissner-Nordström 度规。文中讨论了推广真空 hairy type I Schwarzschild 解的特殊情形，并通过显式微分同胚展示不同形式 Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson 解之间的局域等价性。

English: The magnetic Reissner-Nordstrom black hole embedded into the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field is presented. Then it is used, as a seed, to generate, through the Harrison transformation of the Ersnt's equations, the Reissner-Nordstrom metric in the Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin magnetic field. Special cases generalising, the vacuum hairy type I Schwarzschild solution is discussed. The local equivalence between various forms of the Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson is shown by exhibiting the explicit diffeomorphism.

一句话导读：通过 Ernst 方程的 Harrison 变换构造嵌入 Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin 磁场的 Reissner-Nordström 精确解，并讨论相关 Schwarzschild 特例与局域等价性。

高阶曲率有效理论中偏振相关光子传播、准正规模与引力透镜

Polarization-Dependent Photon Propagation, Quasinormal Modes, and Gravitational Lensing in Higher-Curvature Effective Theories

Takamasa Kanai · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们在有效场论框架下研究高阶曲率修正对光子传播的影响及其在强引力场中的观测后果。考虑静态球对称时空中光子轨迹的偏振相关修正，聚焦于 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞背景。利用几何光学近似，我们推导支配光子传播的有效度规，并研究光子球产生的偏振相关移动。我们在 eikonal 极限下计算相应的准正规模并分析其偏振依赖性。进一步研究引力透镜，关注弱场和强场区域中偏折角的偏振相关修正。在强偏折区域，我们发现即使微扰小的 EFT 修正也会改变偏折角对数发散部分的系数，从而可能产生相对于无修正情形可观测的差异。这表明强引力透镜可能为小的高阶曲率修正提供灵敏探针。虽然直接从 QNM 频率提取 EFT 信息更为微妙，QNM 可能在未来研究中为引力透镜提供互补信息。我们的结果建立了一个通过偏振相关强场观测量探测高阶曲率效应的框架。

English: We investigate the impact of higher-curvature corrections on photon propagation within an effective field theory framework and their observational consequences in strong gravitational fields. We consider polarization-dependent modifications to photon trajectories in static and spherically symmetric spacetimes, focusing on Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole backgrounds. Using the geometrical optics approximation, we derive the effective metrics governing photon propagation and study the resulting polarization-dependent shifts of the photon sphere. We compute the corresponding quasinormal modes in the eikonal limit and analyze their polarization dependence. We further investigate gravitational lensing, focusing on polarization-dependent corrections to the deflection angle in both weak- and strong-field regimes. In the strong-deflection regime, we find that even perturbatively small EFT corrections modify the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent part of the deflection angle, resulting in a potentially observable difference from the uncorrected case. This suggests that strong gravitational lensing may provide a sensitive probe of small higher-curvature corrections. While extracting EFT information directly from QNM frequencies is more subtle, QNMs may provide complementary information to gravitational lensing in future studies. Our results establish a framework for probing higher-curvature effects through polarization-dependent strong-field observables.

一句话导读：研究高阶曲率 EFT 修正导致的偏振相关光子传播、光子球移动、QNM 与引力透镜偏折，并指出强透镜对数项可灵敏探测小修正。

Brown-York准局域能量中的能量守恒与宇宙学红移

Energy Conservation and Cosmological Redshift from the Brown-York Quasi-Local Energy

Bjoern S. Schmekel · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：能量在膨胀宇宙中是否守恒，仍是相对论宇宙学的核心概念问题之一。整体类时Killing矢量的缺失以及局域引力能量密度的缺乏，常导致人们认为宇宙学红移代表能量守恒的真正破坏。本文在Brown-York准局域能量及其相应平衡定律的框架内重新考虑该问题。对于FLRW时空中的共动球对称边界，我们证明对任意理想流体，通过边界的普通应力-能量通量恒为零，而未参照的Brown-York能量完全由于纯几何的边界贡献而演化。我们进一步证明，类时边界世界管具有自然的动力学参考几何。相应的参考减除去除了未参照Brown-York能量的普适背景贡献，并导致一种准局域能量，其领头非平凡项精确重现所包围的物质能量。对于辐射主导宇宙学，所得展开为 E_BY = H^2R^3/2 - H^4R^5/8 + O(R^7)，其中领头项恰好与导致宇宙学红移的所包围辐射能量一致。高阶贡献自然具有引力自能修正所预期的结构。这些结果表明，宇宙学红移可在完全准局域的守恒框架内理解。因此，光子的表观能量损失未必表明能量守恒的崩溃，而可能反映广义相对论中引力能量本质上的准局域特征。

English: The question whether energy is conserved in an expanding universe remains one of the central conceptual issues of relativistic cosmology. The absence of a global timelike Killing vector and the lack of a local gravitational energy density often lead to the conclusion that cosmological redshift represents a genuine violation of energy conservation. In this work we reconsider this problem within the framework of Brown-York quasi-local energy and its associated balance law. For comoving spherical boundaries in FLRW spacetimes we show that the ordinary stress-energy flux through the boundary vanishes identically for arbitrary perfect fluids, while the unreferenced Brown-York energy evolves entirely due to a purely geometrical boundary contribution. We further demonstrate that the timelike boundary world tube possesses a natural dynamical reference geometry. The corresponding reference subtraction removes the universal background contribution of the unreferenced Brown-York energy and leads to a quasi-local energy whose leading nontrivial term exactly reproduces the enclosed matter energy. For radiation dominated cosmologies, the resulting expansion is $E_{\rm BY} = H^2R^3 /2 - H^4R^5 / 8 + \mathcal{O}(R^7)$, where the leading term coincides precisely with the energy of the enclosed radiation responsible for cosmological redshift. Higher-order contributions naturally possess the structure expected for gravitational self-energy corrections. These results suggest that cosmological redshift can be understood within a fully quasi-local conservation framework. The apparent loss of photon energy therefore need not indicate a breakdown of energy conservation but may instead reflect the fundamentally quasi-local character of gravitational energy in general relativity.

由 Fredholm 行列式给出的大 Wilson 环

Giant Wilson loops from Fredholm determinants

Ludvig Chen, Victor Mishnyakov, Konstantin Zarembo · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中 large-k 的对称与反对称 Wilson 环。我们将其生成函数表示为 Fredholm 行列式，该行列式由 Hermite 核与一个编码表示的符号函数加权构成。利用核的可积结构，我们系统应用 Tracy-Widom 方法，推导出一组封闭的积分-微分方程。随后通过 WKB 拟设按 1/N 逐阶求解这些方程，同时保持符号函数一般。我们得到了生成函数领头阶与次领头阶贡献的闭式表达式。最后，针对这两种表示，我们进行 large-k 鞍点分析，并求出 Wilson 环的次领头阶贡献。我们的结果确认了此前观测到的与巨 Wilson 环的对偶 D-膜描述之间的差异。

English: We study large-k symmetric and antisymmetric Wilson loops in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory. We represent their generating functions as Fredholm determinants built from the Hermite kernel weighted by a symbol function that encodes the representation. Using the integrable structure of the kernel, we systematically apply the Tracy-Widom approach to derive a closed system of integro-differential equations. The equations are then solved order by order in 1/N by a WKB ansatz, while keeping the symbol function general. We find a closed-form expression for the leading and subleading order contributions to the generating functions. Finally, specializing to the two representations, we perform the large-k saddle-point analysis and find the subleading contribution to the Wilson loop. Our results confirm the previously observed discrepancies with the dual D-brane description of giant Wilson loops.

一句话导读：用 Fredholm 行列式与 Tracy-Widom/WKB 方法计算 N=4 SYM 中大对称/反对称 Wilson 环的 1/N 展开，并确认与对偶 D-膜描述的偏差。

双标度平面 N=4 SYM 与 Carroll 全息

Doubly-scaled planar $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM & Carroll Holography

Arjun Bagchi, Prateksh Dhivakar, Alok Laddha, Partha Paul · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：Okuda 和 Penedones（OP）在其开创性论文中提出了渐近平直时空全息的一个有趣方案。他们证明 AdS5×S5 中四点玻色树级弦振幅的平直空间极限对偶于四维 N=4 超 Yang-Mills（SYM）理论中四点关联函数的特定双重标度极限。本文表明所得边界关联函数可用于在未来零无穷上定义四维 Carrollian 共形场论（CFT）。这是通过将 SYM 中一组双标度关联函数映射到零无穷（渐近平直时空的共形边界）实现的。因此 Carroll CFT 在 N=4 SYM 的无穷 't Hooft 耦合极限中出现。我们将 OP 分析推广到更高点函数，并展示平直空间振幅的 Gram 条件如何约束 SYM 关联函数的双重标度极限。然后利用伸缩子弦振幅的软因子定理，在双重标度极限下为 N=4 SYM 的 (1/2)-BPS 部分写出递推关系。最后，我们表明这种双重标度极限的基本思想可作为一种工具包，通过非引力有效场论平直空间振幅的某些积分变换构建一类 Carrollian 关联函数，从而定义 Carrollian CFT。

English: In their seminal paper, Okuda and Penedones (OP) put forward an intriguing proposal towards holography in asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). They showed that the flat space limit of 4 point bosonic tree-level string amplitude in AdS$_{5}\, \times\, S^{5}$ is dual to a specific double scaling limit of 4 point correlator in four dimensional (4d) $\mathcal{N} = 4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theory. In this paper, we show that the resulting boundary correlators can be used to define a 4d Carrollian conformal field theory (CFT) on future null infinity. This is done by mapping the set of doubly scaled correlators in SYM to null infinity, the conformal boundary of AFS. A Carroll CFT thus emerges in the infinite 't Hooft coupling limit of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM. We extend the OP analysis to higher point functions and show how the Gram conditions on flat space amplitude put constraints on the double scaling limit of SYM correlators. We then use the soft factorization theorem for dilatonic string amplitude to write a recursion relation for the $({1}/{2})$-BPS sector of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM in the double scaling limit. Finally, we show that the essential ideas underlying such a double scaling limit can be used as a tool-kit to build a class of Carrollian correlators, and hence define a Carrollian CFT, via certain integral transforms of flat space amplitudes of non-gravitational effective field theories.

一句话导读：利用 N=4 SYM 关联函数的双重标度极限在未来零无穷上构造 Carrollian CFT，并推广平直空间全息字典。

Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中的魔术与虫洞

Magic and Wormholes in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model

Val\'erie Bettaque, Brian Swingle · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：任意量子态完全由一组完备厄米算符的期望值所指定。对于 Majorana 费米子系统（例如 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型），这组可观测量可取为所有可能的 Majorana 费米子算符串。热态中这些费米子串的期望值对指定 SYK 哈密顿量的微观耦合依赖不规则，我们利用路径积分技术直接在热力学极限下研究其统计性质。当底层 SYK 哈密顿量是混沌的时候，我们发现这些期望值可以很好地建模为零均值、方差可计算的实高斯随机变量。相反，对于 SYK 的可积变体，我们发现期望值实际上是非高斯的。然后我们利用这些结果研究 SYK 热态中的魔术度量，包括魔术的鲁棒性和稳定子 Rényi 熵。我们还表明，在混沌情形且足够低的温度下，这些结果可以由对偶引力计算定量重现。在这个对偶引力模型中，给定微观算符串的方差与一个由对应于该算符串的大质量粒子所稳定的虫洞几何相关。因此，我们的结果提供了一个具体且定量的场景，用于研究随机性、虫洞和闭合宇宙之间的关系，以及量子魔术的全息对偶。

English: Any quantum state is fully specified by the expectation values of a complete set of Hermitian operators. For a system of Majorana fermions, such as the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, this set of observables can be taken to be all possible strings of Majorana fermion operators. The expectation values of these fermion strings in a thermal state depend erratically on the microscopic couplings that specify the SYK Hamiltonian, and we study their statistical properties directly in the thermodynamic limit using path integral techniques. When the underlying SYK Hamiltonian is chaotic, we find that these expectation values are well-modeled as real Gaussian random variables with zero mean and a variance that we compute. In contrast, for the integrable variant of SYK, we find that the expectation values are actually non-Gaussian. We then use these results to study measures of magic in the SYK thermal state, including the robustness of magic and the stabilizer R\'enyi entropy. We also show that our results can be quantitatively reproduced with a dual gravity calculation in the chaotic case at sufficiently low temperature. In this dual gravity model the variance of a given microscopic operator string is related to a wormhole geometry stabilized by a massive particle which is dual to the operator string. Our results thus provide a concrete and quantitative setting in which to study the relationship between randomness, wormholes and closed universes, as well as a holographic dual of quantum magic.

一句话导读：在 SYK 模型中利用路径积分研究 Majorana 算符串期望值的统计性质，并用于量子魔术度量，发现混沌情形下可由虫洞引力对偶定量重现。

大码中的 JLMS 公式与近似量子纠错

The JLMS formula in a large code with approximate error correction

Xi Dong, Donald Marolf, Pratik Rath · hep-th, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：规范/引力对偶常被描述为量子纠错码。然而，如 JLMS 公式所示，具有互补恢复（因而纠缠楔重构）的精确量子纠错只在 G→0 极限出现。因此，控制误差项的精确论证集中于所谓“小码”：当 G→0 时，它们只描述给定经典解附近的微扰激发。此类设定限制很强，尤其禁止讨论会改变经典背景的模块流，从而无法考虑由半经典体态在一阶模块参数下产生的模块流。相反，我们提出一个单一的体理论“大码”，可容纳此类流，并在 G→0 极限包含与不同经典背景相关联的态的叠加。该大码由满足近似 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式的小码组装而成。在此扩展设定中，我们阐明体与边界模块哈密顿量之间（近似）JLMS 关系的含义，并在适当态类中量化其有效性。

English: Gauge/gravity duality is often described as a quantum error correcting code. However, as seen in the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula, exact quantum error correction with complementary recovery (and thus entanglement wedge reconstruction) emerges only in the limit $G \to 0$. As a result, precise arguments controlling error terms have focused on what we call `small' codes which, as $G \to 0$, describe only perturbative excitations near a given classical solution. Such settings are quite restrictive and, in particular, they prohibit discussion of any modular flow that would change the classical background. As a result, they forbid consideration of modular flows generated by semiclassical bulk states at order-one modular parameters. In contrast, we present a single `large' code for the bulk theory that can accommodate such flows and, in particular, in the $G \to 0$ limit includes superpositions of states associated with distinct classical backgrounds. This large code is assembled from small codes that each satisfy an approximate Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula. In this extended setting we clarify the meaning of the (approximate) JLMS relation between bulk and boundary modular Hamiltonians and quantify its validity in an appropriate class of states.

一句话导读：提出由小码组装的大码，将近似 JLMS 关系推广到包含不同经典背景叠加的体态。

中文摘要：本文基于无质量标量场研究高维 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 黑洞中的准正规模（QNM）与灰体因子（GBF）的对应关系。分析集中于内、外和宇宙学视界彼此接近的近超冷族 QNM。在几何极限条件下，对固定角量子数与维度，QNM 的首阶 WKB 项占主导，无需采用 eikonal 极限；相应的 GBF 也保留两个参数的显式形式。作者进一步证明 GBF 的半透射频率及其导数与零测地线相关，可用角频率和 Lyapunov 指数表述，并给出任意维度下的关系。文章还研究了 Nariai 极限下以及视界分离的近超冷几何中 QNM 的高阶修正。

Under the geometric limit condition, the leading-order Wentzel--Kramers--Brillouin term of the QNM is dominant for fixed angular quantum numbers and dimensionality without imposing the eikonal limit. Particularly, the corresponding GBFs also retain the explicit form of both parameters. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the half-transmission frequency of the GBF and its derivative are related to null geodesics, in terms of aspects such as the angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent, with the use of both parameters. We provide their relationships in arbitrary dimensionality. Furthermore, the higher-order corrections to the QNMs are investigated at the Nariai limit and in the near-ultracold geometry with separated horizons.

中文摘要：研究四维拓扑反 de Sitter 黑洞，其源为 ModMax 电动力学及其符号反转版本。通过区分场强振幅与守恒位移通量来固定电荷归一化、势和第一定律。对球面、平面和双曲视界分类精确极端根；特别地，双曲 ModMax 支没有上限电荷判别界，并包含有限电荷零质量点。还导出不稳定的球面零测地圆轨道，并针对明确指定的带电标量探针计算近视界 AdS2 Breitenlohner–Freedman 指数。作者强调这些是经典诊断而非 WGC 判决：模型未指定带电粒子谱、紫外完成或全局微扰问题；固定耦合的 AdS 数据无法定量检验距离猜想和 de Sitter 猜想。

English: We study four-dimensional topological anti-de Sitter black holes sourced by ModMax electrodynamics and its sign-reversed counterpart. Distinguishing the field-strength amplitude from the conserved displacement flux fixes the charge normalization, potential, and first law. We classify the exact extremal roots for spherical, planar, and hyperbolic horizons; in particular, the hyperbolic ModMax branch has no upper-charge discriminant bound and contains a finite-charge zero-mass point. We also derive the unstable spherical null circular orbit and evaluate the local near-horizon AdS$_2$ Breitenlohner--Freedman index for an explicitly specified charged-scalar probe. These are classical diagnostics, not a WGC verdict: the model does not specify a charged-particle spectrum, an ultraviolet completion, or the global perturbation problem. The distance and de Sitter conjectures cannot be quantitatively tested with the fixed-coupling AdS data considered here.

Francisco S. N. Lobo · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：修改引力中的能量条件通常施加在混合物理物质与额外引力自由度的“有效”应力张量上，这会掩盖哪一扇区真正控制零测地线聚焦、视界多重性和陷阱区域消失。我们在球对称下发展一种几何优先的方案。对于一对归一化的未来指向径向零矢量，两个纵向 Ricci 投影和一个独立横向 Einstein 投影满足精确的面积加权输运定律。由此得到陷阱持续定理：在非退化未来外边际球之后，只要入射纵向与横向收敛通道保持非负，正则入射生成元不能离开陷阱区域。在度规 f(R) 引力中，F≡df/dR>0，我们基于局域 Wald 密度变量 Fr^2 构造熵分辨的层级。纵向熵聚焦定律中标量子二阶导数精确抵消，只留下非正标量梯度平方与物理物质投影；独立横向熵输运定律中所有标量子导数项抵消。因此熵陷阱由物理物质条件 T_nn≥0 和代数混合阈值控制，而非虚构有效流体。所得层级清晰分离物质正性、几何聚焦、边际面恢复与引力熵演化，并指出正则内视界、喉和陷阱到反陷阱转变所需的精确局域反转。

English: Energy conditions in modified gravity are commonly imposed on an ''effective'' stress tensor that mixes physical matter with additional gravitational degrees of freedom, obscuring which sector actually controls null focusing, horizon multiplicity, and the disappearance of trapped regions. We develop a geometry-first alternative in spherical symmetry. For a normalized pair of future-directed radial null vectors, twolongitudinal Ricci projections and one independent transverse Einstein projection obey exact area-weighted transport laws. These imply a trapping-persistence theorem: after a nondegenerate future-outer marginal sphere, a regular ingoing generator cannot exit the trapped region while the ingoing longitudinal and transverse convergence channels remain nonnegative. In metric $f(R)$ gravity, with $F\equiv df/dR>0$, we then construct an entropy-resolved hierarchy based on the local Wald-density variable $Fr^2$. In the longitudinal entropy-focusing law, the scalaron second derivative cancels exactly, leaving a nonpositive scalar-gradient square together with the physical matter projection; in the independent transverse entropy-transport law, all scalaron derivative terms cancel. Entropy trapping is consequently governed by the physical matter condition $T_{nn}\geq 0$ and an algebraic mixed threshold rather than by a fictitious effective fluid. The resulting hierarchy cleanly separates matter positivity, geometric focusing, marginal-surface recovery, and gravitational-entropy evolution, and identifies the precise local reversals required for regular inner horizons, throats, and trapped-to-antitrapped transitions.

一句话导读：在球对称 f(R) 修改引力中给出基于 Ricci/Einstein 投影输运律的陷阱持续定理，并证明熵聚焦由物理物质与标量梯度而非有效流体控制。

中文摘要：本文研究精确带电 Einstein–Born–Infeld（BI）几何与领头阶 Euler–Heisenberg 型（EH）近似中带电大质量 Dirac 场的准束缚态，两者在弱场极限下一致。作者比较固定无穷远处质量或固定外视界半径的两类族，并考察若干场电荷与能级。径向方程从视界向外和从大半径向内积分后进行匹配。所得频率表明非线性项效应同时依赖电动力学理论和所选比较方式。对于基本同号电荷模式，固定质量时两种理论中实频的小变化符号相反，而固定视界半径时两者都向上。沿任一比较族，非线性项增大时基本模式衰减更慢；但最窄能级在固定质量时衰减更快、固定视界半径时衰减更慢。非线性项减小时两种理论的谱相互接近。文中还追踪若干更高能级，其衰变宽度和响应依赖态及比较族。非线性系数被作为有效参数使用，并未与 QED 微观耦合匹配。

English: We study quasi-bound states of a charged massive Dirac field in the exact electrically charged Einstein--Born--Infeld (BI) geometry and in a leading-order Euler--Heisenberg-type (EH) approximation. The two descriptions agree in the weak-field limit. We compare families in which either the mass measured at infinity or the outer-horizon radius is held fixed, and examine several field charges and levels. We integrate the radial equations outward from the horizon and inward from large radius, then match the solutions. The resulting frequencies show that the effect of the nonlinear terms depends on both the electrodynamic theory and the chosen comparison. For the fundamental like-charge mode, the small change in its real frequency has opposite signs in the two theories when the mass is fixed, whereas it is upward in both when the horizon radius is fixed. The fundamental mode decays more slowly as the nonlinear term grows along either family. The narrowest level, however, decays more rapidly when the mass is fixed and more slowly when the horizon radius is fixed. The spectra of the two theories approach one another as the nonlinear term is reduced. We also follow several higher levels; their decay widths and their response depend on the state and on the family used for comparison. The nonlinear coefficient is used as an effective parameter and is not matched to the microscopic coupling in quantum electrodynamics (QED).

一句话导读：比较 BI 与 EH 型带电黑洞几何中带电 Dirac 准束缚谱对模型和参数比较路径的依赖。

中文摘要：论文检验Mashhoon束缚态方法中出现的倒置Regge-Wheeler与Zerilli势是否等谱。作者首次直接计算倒置Zerilli势的束缚态谱，发现尽管Chandrasekhar证明原势具有相同QNM谱，其倒置对应物却具有不同束缚态谱；势反转还破坏Glampedakis等人用于简化等谱性证明的一阶Darboux关系。两势之间的连续插值显示内部能量移动显著大于端点，暗示存在抵消以抑制端点谱分裂，且即使趋近eikonal极限也需二阶微扰贡献。两种谱仍表现出源于三玻色子系统的Efimov物理的渐近几何标度，该标度也适用于具有相同领头尾部行为的其他倒置势，包括本文研究的标量场情形。结果对近期基于数值束缚态高精度计算QNM的方法提出疑问。

English: Are the inverted Regge-Wheeler and Zerilli potentials arising in Mashhoon's bound-state approach to black-hole quasinormal modes isospectral? Extending previous numerical and analytical studies of the inverted Regge-Wheeler potential, we present the first direct computation of the bound-state spectrum of the inverted Zerilli potential. Although Chandrasekhar proved that the original potentials have identical quasinormal-mode spectra, we show that their inverted counterparts have distinct bound-state spectra. We also demonstrate that potential inversion destroys their first-order Darboux relation, used by Glampedakis et al. to provide a simpler proof of isospectrality. A continuous interpolation between the potentials reveals substantially larger energy shifts in the interior than at the endpoints, indicating cancellations that suppress the endpoint spectral splitting. Explaining this behavior requires second-order perturbative contributions, even towards the eikonal limit. Despite these differences, both spectra exhibit asymptotic geometric scaling characteristic of Efimov physics, first discovered in three-boson systems. This scaling also applies to other inverted potentials with the same leading tail, including the scalar-field case studied here. Beyond their theoretical implications, our results raise questions for recently developed methods that compute quasinormal modes with high precision from numerical bound states.

一句话导读：证明倒置的Regge-Wheeler与Zerilli势不再等谱，并发现其束缚态谱呈Efimov型几何标度。

English: We establish recursive integration-by-parts identities that symbolically reduce the inhomogeneous solutions of the Regge-Wheeler-Zerilli equation to a small set of master integrals, yielding the nonlinear response kernels of Schwarzschild black holes at arbitrary perturbative order. We further derive a closed ODE system that enables rapid, accurate, and stable numerical evaluation of these master integrals. Universal Structure of Horizon Formation in Generic Binary Black Hole Mergers

Yu-Cun Xie, Vaishak Prasad · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文推导一般双黑洞并合中首个共同表观视界的局部结构。该事件处于完全非线性区域，超出后牛顿旋进和稳态黑洞微扰的标准适用范围，却具有普适描述。我们不假设对称性，证明边缘外陷俘面的稳定性算符在形成时必须失去可逆性；最外层稳定性进一步表明消失本征值是主本征值且本征函数严格为正。Lyapunov-Schmidt 约化给出平方根分支分离和共同线性漂移，从而在线性阶得到倾斜抛物线。共同视界位于光滑边缘外陷俘管上，并与形成切片相切；邻近后续切片以内外分支与之相交，分支间距按 (t-t_*)^{1/2} 标度。沿零模有非零一阶响应的视界量继承平方根分离和共同线性项。我们在三个双黑洞模拟中检验，包括偏心、进动、不等质量系统；世界管几何和准局域标量均遵循预测标度。计入次阶项后，自由指数拟合将表面几何和准局域泛函恢复至 1/2，误差在 0.5% 内，诊断对形成时间一致到 5e-5 M。视界剪切与引力波 news 的相关性提示共同视界形成可能在并合波形的短段留下特征。

English: We derive the local structure of the first common apparent horizon in a generic binary-black-hole merger. This event occurs in the fully nonlinear regime, outside the standard regimes of post-Newtonian inspiral theory and perturbations of a stationary black hole, yet it admits a universal description. Without assuming symmetry, we show that the stability operator of the marginally outer trapped surface must lose invertibility at formation. Outermost stability then implies that the vanishing eigenvalue is the principal one, with a strictly positive eigenfunction. Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction yields square-root branch separation with a shared linear drift. Together these terms give a tilted parabola through linear order in time. The common horizon lies on a smooth marginally outer trapped tube tangent to the formation slice, and nearby later slices intersect it in outer and inner branches whose separation scales as $(t-t_*)^{1/2}$. Horizon quantities with a nonzero first response along the zero mode inherit the square-root separation and a shared linear term. We test these predictions in three binary black hole simulations, including an eccentric, precessing, unequal-mass system. In all three, the worldtube geometry and quasilocal scalars follow the predicted scaling. With the next-order term included, free-exponent fits to the surface geometry and quasilocal functionals recover $1/2$ to within half a percent, and diagnostics agree on the formation time within $5\times10^{-5}M$. The correlation between horizon shear and gravitational-wave news suggests that common horizon formation could have a signature in a short segment of the merger waveform.

一句话导读：证明一般双黑洞并合中共同视界形成具有平方根普适结构并在数值模拟中验证。

Causality violation in the holographic approach to N=4 SYM theory at finite 't Hooft coupling

Alex Buchel, Pavel Kovtun · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：在 AdS/CFT 对应中，大但有限的 't Hooft 耦合下 N=4 超对称 Yang-Mills 理论中能量-动量张量的关联函数，可通过超引力的高阶导数修正来研究。我们表明，通常使用的全息关联函数 prescription——将运动方程截断到 (α')^3 阶——意味着平面极限下 N=4 SYM 理论的热平衡态在任意大的有限 't Hooft 耦合下是动力学不稳定的。该不稳定性反映了将微扰导出的方程当作非微扰方程处理所带来的非物理因果性破坏，类似于五维 Gauss-Bonnet 引力中 AdS 黑膜的失稳。虽然处理超引力 O(α')^3 修正的其他全息 prescription 可能缓解截断引入的病态，但任何 O(α')^3 prescription 所得结果的有效范围都必须限于对 N=4 SYM 可观测量的 O(α')^3 效应作严格微扰处理。

English: In the AdS/CFT correspondence, correlation functions of the energy-momentum tensor in N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory at large but finite 't Hooft coupling can be studied using higher-derivative corrections to supergravity. We show that the commonly used holographic prescription for correlation functions which is obtained by truncating the equations of motion at order $(\alpha')^3$ implies that the thermal equilibrium state of N=4 SYM theory in the planar limit is dynamically unstable at arbitrarily large finite 't Hooft coupling. The instability is a reflection of the unphysical causality violation brought about by treating perturbatively-derived equations as if they were non-perturbative, analogous to the instability of AdS black branes in five-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet gravity. While other holographic prescriptions for treating the $O(\alpha'^3)$ corrections to supergravity may alleviate the pathology introduced by the truncation, the validity regime of the results obtained by any prescription at $O(\alpha'^3)$ must be limited to the strict perturbative treatment of the $O(\alpha'^3)$ effects on N=4 SYM observables.

一句话导读：指出在 O(α'^3) 高阶导数修正中截断运动方程并按非微扰方式使用，会导致 N=4 SYM 热态动力学不稳定，根源是非物理的因果性破坏。

F. T. Brandt, Augusto C. B. Carvalho · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文研究如何由微分同胚不变性对应的Noether恒等式重构一阶引力作用量。独立场为逆变度规密度的对称扰动 φ^{μν} 和迹调整联络 G^λ_{μν}，其变换规律给定。对于这些场的局域多项式作用量，引力耦合为唯一有量纲常数且每个额外场携带其一幂次，利用作为特殊微分同胚的标度变换证明在任意 d>2 维作用量至多截止到三阶，唯一可能的三次项为无导数 φGG 顶点。将所得 Lorentz 协变拟设的核在张量基中展开，对 d≥4 得到31个系数。一般微分同胚的 Noether 恒等式按场逐阶展开给出线性系统，消去 φφ 核并将剩余系数确定到整体归一化，从而恢复 Goldberg-Palatini 作用量。由于联络可精确消去，这也固定了完整的二阶作用量及其无限多个引力子顶点。该构造无需选择能量动量张量，从而避免自耦合方法中的歧义。附录给出核基、恒等式与解，符号计算公开可用。

English: We investigate the reconstruction of the first-order gravitational action from the Noether identities associated with diffeomorphism invariance. The independent fields are a symmetric perturbation $\phi^{\mu\nu}$ of the contravariant metric density and a trace-adjusted connection $G^{\lambda}{}_{\mu\nu}$, whose transformation laws are prescribed. For a local action polynomial in these fields, with the gravitational coupling as its only dimensionful constant and each additional field carrying one power of it, a dilatation, which is a particular diffeomorphism, shows that in any dimension $d>2$ the action terminates at most at cubic order, its only possible cubic term being a derivative-free $\phi GG$ vertex. Expanding the kernels of the resulting Lorentz-covariant ansatz in tensor bases gives 31 coefficients for $d\geq 4$. The Noether identities with general diffeomorphisms, expanded order by order in the fields, yield a linear system that eliminates the $\phi\phi$ kernel and determines the remaining coefficients up to an overall normalization, recovering the Goldberg-Palatini action. Since the connection can be eliminated exactly, this also fixes the complete second-order action, with its infinite set of graviton vertices. The construction requires no choice of energy-momentum tensor, the source of ambiguity in the self-coupling approach. The kernel bases, the identities and the solution are given in appendices, and the symbolic computations are publicly available.

从破缺共形规范对称性出发的全息重构

Holographic Reconstruction from Broken Conformal Gauge Symmetry

Takeshi Fukuyama · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文从“引力是共形规范对称性破缺相”的视角研究 AdS4/CFT3 中的体-边界结构，并强调 Euler 与 Pontryagin 示性类的关键区别。规范理论形式的引力作用包含 Euler 扇区，其全导数表示给出同时依赖内蕴和外曲率的边界形式；这与 Pontryagin 下降至三维引力 Chern-Simons 泛函不同，后者度规变分给出 Cotton 张量并对应 de Haro 研究的混合边界条件。作者对渐近 AdS4 时空中的 Euler 边界形式做 Fefferman-Graham 展开，发现可归一化系数 g_(3)ij 不线性贡献有限 Euler 边界项：其来自三次外曲率扇区的贡献因 Tr g_(3)=0 而消失，含 g_(3) 的曲率-外曲率项在共形边界处也消失。直接的 Codazzi 分析进一步表明，Cotton 张量出现在渐近混合曲率中，但在标准 Dirichlet 数据下其通过切向联络边界变分的贡献消失。这表明存在两类不同的体-边界结构：全局/拓扑的 Euler 关系与局域的 Pontryagin-Cotton 关系；作者区分了运动学上的 Cotton 出现与有限 Cotton 边界响应，并讨论其对全息重构的启示。

English: We investigate bulk--boundary structures in $\AdS_4/\CFT_3$ from the viewpoint of gravity as a broken phase of conformal gauge symmetry. A crucial distinction is made between the Euler and Pontryagin characteristic classes. The gauge-theoretic gravitational action contains an Euler sector, whose total-derivative representation gives a boundary form depending on both intrinsic and extrinsic geometry. This structure is different from the Pontryagin descent to the three-dimensional gravitational Chern--Simons functional, whose metric variation gives the Cotton tensor and underlies the mixed boundary conditions studied by de Haro. We perform a Fefferman--Graham expansion of the Euler boundary form in asymptotically $\AdS_4$ spacetime. The normalizable coefficient $g_{(3)ij}$ does not contribute linearly to the finite Euler boundary term: its contribution from the cubic extrinsic- curvature sector vanishes by $\mathrm{Tr}\,g_{(3)}=0$, while curvature-- extrinsic-curvature terms containing $g_{(3)}$ vanish at the conformal boundary. A direct Codazzi analysis additionally shows that the Cotton tensor appears in the asymptotic mixed curvature but its contribution through the tangential-connection boundary variation vanishes for standard Dirichlet data. This indicates two distinct types of bulk--boundary structure: a global/topological Euler relation and a local Pontryagin--Cotton relation. We distinguish this kinematic Cotton appearance from a finite Cotton boundary response and discuss the implications for holographic reconstruction.

中文摘要：我们利用 Einstein 引力、Maxwell 场和带电标量的普通作用量，构造了渐近反德西特时空中包含德西特核心的无视界、处处正则孤子。该对象是自引力规范 Q-ball，其假真空内部充当正有效宇宙学常数，产生内禀德西特区域，并通过薄壁连接到带电的渐近 AdS 外部。我们强调两个一般要求：标量必须处于近假真空（类慢滚）区域；在薄壁极限下，外部被驱动到 extremal Reissner-Nordström-AdS 轨迹，此时薄壁趋近共同的可能视界。由于该解是静态球对称的，它可能对应对偶 CFT 的半经典电荷 Q 态，从而在全息理论中近似实现德西特空间。我们还讨论了自由涨落，其中德西特核心模式表现为该态上参数上低能激发；讨论了体重构；并讨论了近极端区域，其中有限 N 效应预期会截断形式上的经典 throat，并用相互作用的近 throat 扇区替代其独立的自由场模式。

English: We construct horizonless, everywhere-regular solitons containing a de~Sitter core inside an asymptotically anti--de~Sitter spacetime, using an ordinary action of Einstein gravity, a Maxwell field, and a charged scalar. The object is a gravitating gauged $Q$-ball whose false-vacuum interior acts as a positive effective cosmological constant, sourcing an inner de~Sitter region joined through a thin wall to a charged, asymptotically AdS exterior. Two general requirements are emphasized: the scalar must lie in a near-false-vacuum (slow-roll--like) regime, and the exterior is driven to the extremal Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS locus in the thin-wall limit, in which the wall approaches the common would-be horizon. Since the solution is static and spherically symmetric, it may correspond to a semiclassical charge-$Q$ state of the dual CFT, realizing de~Sitter space approximately within a holographic theory. We also discuss free fluctuations whose de~Sitter--core modes appear as parametrically low-lying excitations above the state, bulk reconstruction, and the near-extremal regime, where finite-${\mathcal N}$ effects are expected to cut off the formal classical throat and replace its independent free-field modes by an interacting near-throat sector.

Mapping AdS$_4$ quantum gravity via the Bethe Ansatz formula

Cheng Peng, Xuao Zhang, Ziruo Zhang · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：3d ADHM 理论的拓扑扭曲指数可写成由量子环面 gl1 构造的 XXZ 型模型 Bethe Ansatz 方程（BAEs）解的求和。借助一种新数值算法，作者求解了 N≤21 时全部 p(N) 个物理解，其中 p(N) 为 N 的整数分拆数。对这些解的普查发现，除已知对偶于双荷黑洞的“1-cut”解（规范 holonomy 沿复平面中一条曲线分布）外，还有对偶于黑洞与 M2 膜组合构型的“dressed” 1-cut 解、对偶于黑洞 Z_m orbifold 的 m-cut 解、在 1-cut 与 3-cut 解之间插值的离散解族，以及在每个 N 值下出现的其他奇异解。插值解的自由能不能与任何已知体解的在壳作用量匹配。1、2、3-cut 解和插值解都具有良定义的大 N 极限，其规范 holonomy 的领头阶分布可解析计算。作者在可能时用高精度数值将各解对指数的贡献拟合到 1/N 展开的各阶，并提取领头非微扰修正；这些修正除例外情况外，分别与体空间中的等变局域化结果和包裹 M2 膜的作用量相匹配。

English: The topologically twisted index of 3d ADHM theory can be written as a sum over solutions to the Bethe Ansatz Equations (BAEs) of the XXZ-type model constructed from quantum toroidal $\mathfrak{g}\mathfrak{l}_1$. Via a novel numerical algorithm, we solve for all $p(N)$ physical solutions at $N\leq 21$, where $p(N)$ denotes the number of integer partitions of $N$. Surveying these solutions, we find that in addition to the known "1-cut" solution dual to dyonic black holes, where the gauge holonomies are distributed along a single curve in the complex plane, there are "dressed" 1-cut solutions dual to combined configurations of the black hole and M2-branes, $m$-cut solutions dual to $\mathbb{Z}_m$ orbifolds of the black hole, a discrete family of solutions interpolating between the 1-cut and 3-cut solutions, together with other exotic solutions, at each value of $N$. The free energy of the interpolating solutions cannot be matched with the on-shell action of any known bulk solution. The $1,2,3$-cut solutions and interpolating solutions all have a well-defined large $N$ limit, and their leading order distribution of gauge holonomies can be computed analytically. Whenever possible, we fit the contributions of the solutions to the index to all orders in the $1/N$ expansion with high-precision numerics, and extract the leading non-perturbative correction. With exceptions, these are matched with the results of equivariant localization in the bulk, and the action of wrapped M2-branes respectively.

English: We present and study supersymmetric warped ${\rm AdS}_2 \times {\rm M}_7 \times I$ solutions of Type IIA supergravity, where M$_7$ is a weak G$_2$ holonomy manifold. In the case of zero Romans mass, Branch 1 uplifts to eleven dimensions to ${\rm AdS}_4 \times {\rm M}_7$ whereas Branch 2 uplifts to warped ${\rm AdS}_3 \times {\rm M}_7 \times I$ with OM2-plane type of singularities.

中文摘要：引力路径积分近年来有许多应用。以超对称指数为例——它提供了对引力路径积分最受控的检验之一——我们论证，即使在这一受控情形中，朴素的引力路径积分也无法在低阶之外给出自洽结果。然而，借助弦论性输入（例如紫外截断的选择和正确路径积分变量的选择），无需进行完整的弦论计算便可走得更远。我们还讨论了：即使从超引力理论出发且事先不偏向弦论，我们在多大程度上会被引向弦标度的紫外截断。本文是对大多已发表结果的综述，但澄清了若干细节。

English: Gravitational path integral has had many applications in recent years. Using the example of supersymmetric index, which provides one of the most controlled tests of gravitational path integral, we argue that even in this controlled case, naive gravitational path integral cannot produce consistent results beyond low orders. However one can go further using stringy inputs, e.g. the choice of UV cut-off and the choice of correct path integration variable, without having to do full fledged string calculation. We also discuss to what extent we are led to string scale UV cut-off even if we begin with a supergravity theory without an a priori bias towards string theory. This is a review of mostly published results, but we clarify several details.

一句话导读：综述指出朴素引力路径积分在超对称指数中仅低阶可靠，需借助弦论性紫外输入才能自洽延展。

中文摘要：从中子星并合引力波观测推断的无量纲潮汐形变性 Λ，迄今主要用于限制约两倍核饱和密度附近的致密物质压强，使得核心物态方程（EOS）在很大程度上无法通过旋近阶段的引力波观测触及。本文表明，利用以标度内禀变量表述的无量纲恒星结构与潮汐响应方程进行微扰分析，无需假定具体 EOS 模型，即可通过 Λ 直接探测一个基本的中心 EOS 参数。我们发现 Λ 与中心 EOS 参数 X≡P_c/ε_c（P_c 和 ε_c 分别为中心压强与能量密度）之间存在显著的不依赖 EOS 的标度关系，并用一系列物理可行的 EOS 进行了验证。将该关系应用于 GW170817 等事件推断的潮汐形变性，可直接确定 X。采用此前建立的有效上界 X≲0.381，我们推断稳定质量—半径序列上最大质量中子星的严格下界 Λ_TOV≳9.1^{+0.5}_{-0.5}，定量表明即使最紧致的稳定中子星也明显区别于黑洞（Λ_BH=0）。这些结果揭示了旋近阶段潮汐形变性与中心 EOS 参数 X 之间此前未被认识的联系，在强引力区建立了引力波可观测量与超致密物质微观物理之间的直接纽带。该标度关系使旋近阶段潮汐形变性成为中心 EOS 参数 X 及中子星核心关键性质的直接且基本不依赖模型的探针。

English: The dimensionless tidal deformability, $\Lambda$, of neutron stars (NSs), inferred from gravitational-wave (GW) observations, has thus far been used primarily to constrain the pressure of dense matter near twice nuclear saturation density, leaving the core equation of state (EOS) largely inaccessible to inspiral-phase GW observations. We show that a fundamental central EOS parameter can be probed directly through $\Lambda$ using a perturbative analysis of the dimensionless stellar-structure and tidal-response equations formulated in terms of scaled intrinsic variables, without invoking any specific EOS model. We uncover a remarkable EOS-insensitive scaling relation between $\Lambda$ and the central EOS parameter $\rm{X}\equiv P_{\rm c}/\varepsilon_{\rm c}$, where $P_{\rm c}$ and $\varepsilon_{\rm c}$ denote the central pressure and energy density, respectively. The relation is validated against a broad ensemble of physically viable EOSs. Applying it to tidal deformabilities inferred from events such as GW170817 enables a direct determination of $\rm{X}$. By adopting the previously established effective upper bound $\rm{X}\lesssim0.381$, we infer a tight lower bound, $\Lambda_{\rm{TOV}}\gtrsim9.1^{+0.5}_{-0.5}$, for maximum-mass NSs along stable mass-radius sequences, quantitatively demonstrating that even the most compact stable NSs remain distinctly separated from black holes, for which $\Lambda_{\rm{BH}}=0$. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized connection between inspiral-phase tidal deformability and the central EOS parameter $\rm{X}$, establishing a direct link between GW observables and the microphysics of ultradense matter in the strong-gravity regime. The resulting scaling establishes inspiral-phase tidal deformability as a direct and largely model-insensitive probe of the central EOS parameter $\rm{X}$, and hence of key properties of NS cores.

Fabio Buffoli · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：研究质量随时间减小的旋转黑洞（入射 Kerr-Vaidya 度规）中的单粒子 Penrose 能量提取，并在衰变处施加严格四动量守恒。证明局域效率受瞬时 Kerr 值限制，给出协变界并回到视界处的 Bardeen-Press-Teukolsky 极限；在固定自旋参数下导出精确输运律 dE/dτ = -(dm/dt)(r/Σ)p_r^2，使每一条类时测地线在黑洞质量损失时获得能量。净能量增益分解为局域 Penrose 项和两个输运项，并针对两种质量损失律数值计算其随自旋和质量损失率的变化。固定自旋参数时，只有当质量损失率低于由趋近极端性给出的临界率 α_crit(a)=(M-a)/Δv 才可能提取；固定 a/m 时不存在此边界。输运律可推广到 Kerr-Newman-Vaidya 族，且动力学重要区域远超出天体物理质量损失率。

English: We study single-particle Penrose extraction from a rotating black hole whose mass decreases in time, described by the ingoing Kerr-Vaidya metric, imposing exact four-momentum conservation at the decay. We prove that the local efficiency is bounded by the instantaneous Kerr value, through a covariant bound that reduces to the Bardeen-Press-Teukolsky limit at the horizon, and we derive an exact transport law, dE/dtau = -dm/dt (r/Sigma) p_r^2 for fixed spin parameter, by which every timelike geodesic gains energy while the hole loses mass. The net energy gain therefore splits into a local Penrose term and two transport terms, which we compute numerically as functions of spin and mass-loss rate for two mass-loss laws. With fixed spin parameter, extraction is possible only below a critical rate alpha_crit(a) = (M-a)/Delta v, set by the approach of the hole to extremality; with fixed a/m no such boundary exists. The transport law extends to the Kerr-Newman-Vaidya family, and the regime where the dynamics matter is shown to lie far outside astrophysical mass-loss rates.

Gravitational-wave responses and noise correlations in geometric time-delay interferometry

Rui Luo, Pan-Pan Wang, Lin-Lin Yang, Xin-Lei Zhao, Cheng-Gang Shao · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：空间引力波观测将探测毫赫兹频段大质量黑洞的形成与增长以及致密双星的演化。我们利用六个往返和六个非往返双链路块建立时延干涉测量的几何链路表示。从单程多普勒响应出发，推导基本块响应及一个字典，将45种已知第二代组合表示为这些块和残余单程测量的形式。代表性Michelson和Relay观测量具有紧凑形式，并据此在固定等臂星座下得到解析天平均张量响应。我们还推导块噪声协方差，保留共享测量流块之间的交叉谱；所得噪声谱与直接单程组装一致。我们将该形式用于等臂LISA仪器模型中的窄带致密双星信号。在Relay示例中，忽略共享链路交叉谱会改变低频噪声标度，并在1 mHz和3 mHz将振幅或距离的条件Fisher不确定度高估10.71倍和3.37倍。

English: Space-based gravitational-wave observations will probe the formation and growth of massive black holes and the evolution of compact binaries in the millihertz band. We develop a geometric-link representation of time-delay interferometry using six round-trip and six non-round-trip two-link blocks. Starting from the one-way Doppler response, we derive the elementary block responses and a dictionary that expresses 45 known second-generation combinations in terms of these blocks and residual one-way measurements. Representative Michelson and Relay observables admit compact forms, from which analytical sky-averaged tensor responses are obtained for a fixed, equal-arm constellation. We also derive the noise covariance of the blocks, retaining cross-spectra between blocks that share measurement streams. The resulting noise spectra agree with direct one-way assembly. We apply this formulation to a narrowband compact-binary signal in an equal-arm LISA instrument model. For the Relay example, neglecting the shared-link cross-spectrum changes the low-frequency noise scaling and overestimates the conditional Fisher uncertainties in amplitude or distance by factors of 10.71 at 1~mHz and 3.37 at 3~mHz.

探测双中子星中的潮汐共振

Detecting Tidal Resonances in Binary Neutron Stars

Fabian Gittins, Harsh Narola, Thibeau Wouters, Peter T. H. Pang, Tanja Hinderer, Chris Van Den Broeck · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：当双中子星因引力波辐射而旋近时，上升的潮汐频率会共振激发振动模式。这些振荡可作为探测恒星内部结构的星震学探针，但引力波干涉仪能否测量它们仍有待确定。本文首次对爱因斯坦望远镜探测潮汐共振的能力进行完整贝叶斯研究。我们模拟一年观测并分析最响亮的200个信号。我们发现爱因斯坦望远镜能够识别共振模式，并对有利事件中低至 ΔΦ≈0.03 的引力波相位偏移敏感。我们进一步表明，忽略共振会使推断的潮汐形变率产生偏差。这些结果确立了潮汐共振作为未来探测器星震学可测量途径的地位。

English: As a binary neutron star inspirals due to the emission of gravitational waves, the rising tidal frequency resonantly excites vibrational modes. These oscillations are seismological probes of the rich stellar interior, yet it remains to be established whether gravitational-wave interferometers can measure them. Here, we present the first fully Bayesian study of the capability of the Einstein Telescope to detect tidal resonances. We simulate one year of observations and analyse the 200 loudest signals. We find that the Einstein Telescope can identify resonant modes and is sensitive to gravitational-wave phase shifts as small as $\Delta \Phi \approx 0.03$ for favourable events. We further show that neglecting resonances can bias the inferred tidal deformabilities. These results establish tidal resonances as a measurable route for asteroseismology with future detectors.

一句话导读：首次贝叶斯评估爱因斯坦望远镜探测双中子星潮汐共振及相位偏移的能力。

NED 变形旋转黑洞通过 Comisso-Asenjo 重联过程的能量提取

Energy extraction from NED-deformed rotating black holes via the Comisso-Asenjo reconnection process

Marco Figliolia (Universita degli Studi di Salerno, Fisciano, Italy), Gaetano Lambiase (Universita degli Studi di Salerno, Fisciano, Italy, INFN Sezione di Napoli, Gruppo Collegato di Salerno, Italy), Ali \"Ovg\"un (Eastern Mediterranean University, Famagusta, Turkiye), R. C. Pantig (Mapua University, Manila, Philippines) · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文研究广义相对论耦合非线性电动力学（NED）中的旋转黑洞，聚焦含变形参数 g 的轴对称解。在球形种子度规上，用 Gauss-Bonnet 方法计算弱场透镜以及阴影半径，并在对 Sgr A* 环尺寸施加约 10% 的保守容差下给出与自旋无关的约束 g/M ≲ 1.26。在 eikonal 区域推导了解析的准正规模偏移（对 g 为偶），并得到与阴影约束一致的独立上限。对旋转几何，给出 ZAMO 标量的闭式表达、视界与能层结构，并分析赤道测地线（光子轨道与 ISCO）。随后在 ZAMO 框架中构造 Comisso-Asenjo 重联通道，确定负能窗口，并对允许半径积分提取功率；由对 Kerr 功率的可容忍偏离定义自旋相关的提取上限 g_δ(a|σ0,ξ)。综合 QNM/阴影上限与能量提取上限，可在 (a/M,g/M) 平面中显著收窄 g/M 的允许区域；即使采用简化的单层赤道设置，这两类互补探针已能对 NED 变形给出有信息量的限制，并可由现有数据及未来视界尺度与 ringdown 观测检验。

English: We study rotating black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics (NED), focusing on an axisymmetric solution with deformation parameter $g$. On the spherical seed, weak-field lensing via the Gauss-Bonnet method and the shadow radius yield a spin-insensitive bound by enforcing a conservative $\sim 10\%$ tolerance on the Sgr A* ring size, namely $g/M \lesssim 1.26$. In the eikonal regime we derive analytic quasinormal-mode shifts, even in $g$, and obtain an independent ceiling consistent with the shadow constraint. For the rotating geometry, we provide closed-form ZAMO scalars, chart horizons and the ergoregion, and analyze equatorial geodesics (photon orbits and ISCO). We then formulate the Comisso-Asenjo reconnection channel in the ZAMO frame, identify the negative-energy window, and integrate the extracted power over the allowed radii; from the tolerated fractional departure from the Kerr power we define a spin-dependent extraction bound $g_\delta(a\mid\sigma_0,\xi)$. Taken together, the QNM/shadow ceiling and the extraction bound appreciably narrow the admissible region for $g/M$ in the $(a/M,g/M)$ plane, so even within our deliberately simplified, single-layer equatorial setup, the two complementary probes already provide informative constraints on NED deformations, testable with present data and upcoming horizon-scale and ringdown campaigns.

一句话导读：研究 NED 变形旋转黑洞的阴影/QNM 与 Comisso-Asenjo 重联能量提取，并联合限制变形参数。

支持近黑洞自引力薄壳的双荷黑洞

Dyonic black holes supporting nearly-black self-gravitating thin shells

Shahar Hod · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：近期研究表明，准拓扑非线性电动力学中的双荷黑洞时空可具有 dg_{tt}(r)/dr=0 的离散径向区域，在其中可静态支撑无自重的球对称测试薄壳（Dyson 壳）。本文证明，该双荷时空也可具有 d[r·g_{tt}(r)]/dr→0^+ 的径向区域，在其中可静态支撑接近形成黑洞的自引力薄壳；并证明这些近黑洞 Dyson 壳的离散半径具有普适性，不依赖中心双荷致密天体的质量。

English: It has recently been revealed that dyonic black-hole spacetimes of a quasitopological non-linear electrodynamic field theory may be characterized by discrete radial regions with the property $dg_{tt}(r)/dr=0$ in which spherically symmetric massive {\it test} shells (Dyson shells with negligible self-gravity) can be supported in static equilibrium states. In the present paper we prove that the dyonic spacetimes of the non-linear electrodynamic field theory may also be characterized by the presence of radial regions with the dimensionless property $d[r\cdot g_{tt}(r)]/dr\to0^+$ in which massive {\it self-gravitating} thin shells that are on the verge of becoming black holes can be supported in static equilibrium states. Intriguingly, it is proved that the discrete radii of these self-gravitating nearly-black Dyson shells are universal in the sense that they are independent of the masses of the central supporting dyonic compact objects.

一句话导读：证明准拓扑非线性电动力学双荷黑洞可静态支撑接近黑洞极限的自引力薄壳，且壳半径与中心质量无关。

指数远平行引力中的自洽哈勃膨胀：与最新观测的对照

Self-consistent Hubble expansion in exponential teleparallel gravity: confrontation with recent observations

K. S. Kavya, T. Vinutha, B. Revathi, Kazuharu Bamba · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们利用最新宇宙学观测重构指数远平行引力中的哈勃膨胀历史，包括观测哈勃数据（OHD）、暗能量光谱仪数据释放2（DESI DR2）的重子声学振荡（BAO）测量、引力波标准汽笛数据，以及Pantheon Plus和SH0ES的Ia型超新星汇编。我们通过基于约化χ²、赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）的统计分析，明确证明指数远平行引力可以与当前宇宙学观测一致。此外，我们通过分析动力学演化、稳定性条件和线性物质扰动，表明该指数远平行引力模型在宇宙学上是可行的。

English: We reconstruct the Hubble expansion history in exponential teleparallel gravity using recent cosmological observations, including Observational Hubble Data (OHD), the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 2 (DESI DR2) baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements, gravitational-wave (GW) standard-siren data, and the Pantheon Plus and SH0ES Type Ia supernova compilations. We explicitly demonstrate that exponential teleparallel gravity can be consistent with current cosmological observations through statistical analyses based on the reduced $\chi^2$, Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC). In addition, we show that the present model of exponential teleparallel gravity can be viable cosmologically by analysing the dynamical evolution, stability conditions, and linear matter perturbations.

一句话导读：用最新宇宙学观测检验指数远平行引力模型，并分析其动力学稳定性和线性物质扰动可行性。

玻色暗物质混合中子星中的引力同步

Gravitational synchronization in bosonic dark matter admixed neutron stars

Claudio Lazarte, Nicolas Sanchis-Gual, Jos\'e A. Font · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：尽管暗物质搜寻是现代天体物理与高能物理的核心焦点，中子星可为研究暗物质与重子物质相互作用提供天然实验室。本文将暗物质建模为超轻玻色场，其可吸积到中子星上并通过引力束缚形成复合天体。利用球对称下的长期数值相对论模拟，我们提取并分析费米子-玻色子星的径向振荡模式频谱。模拟表明，无论状态方程如何，费米子与玻色子组分通过引力耦合实现同步，从而丰富其振荡谱。这种同步导致新的多态标量构型，并重塑中子星径向模式的层级结构。我们进一步提出一种流程，用于计算新主导模式值随玻色质量的变化，并讨论同步机制如何推广到球对称之外，及其对中子星物理和引力波天文学的意义。

English: While the search for dark matter remains a central focus of modern astrophysics and high-energy physics, neutron stars could provide natural laboratories in which the interaction between dark matter and baryonic matter can be studied. In this work we model dark matter as an ultralight bosonic field, which can accrete onto the neutron star and form a composite object bound through gravity. Using long-term, numerical relativity simulations in spherical symmetry, we extract and analyze the frequency spectra of the radial oscillation modes of fermion-boson stars. Our simulations reveal that the fermionic and bosonic components synchronize through gravitational coupling regardless of the equation of state, enriching their oscillation spectrum. This synchronization leads to new multi-state scalar configurations and reshapes the hierarchy of the neutron-star radial modes. We further propose a procedure to compute the values of the new dominant modes as a function of the bosonic mass, and discuss how the synchronization mechanism extends beyond spherical symmetry, together with its implications for neutron-star physics and gravitational-wave astronomy.

一句话导读：球对称数值相对论模拟显示，混合玻色暗物质的中子星中费米子与玻色子组分通过引力耦合同步径向振荡，产生新标量构型并改变径向模式层级。
