arXiv 摘要 · PDF

热 AdS 两点函数与圈诱导的有效单点顶点

Thermal AdS two-point functions and loop induced effective one-point vertices

Astha Kakkar · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们研究热 AdS_{d+1} 中由 Witten 图给出的热两点函数，其共形边界为 S_β^1 × R^{d-1}，目标是建立热 CFT 数据与微扰体动力学之间的联系。我们分析由体三次 φφχ 相互作用产生的一圈蝌蚪图和 bench 图，对 bench 图区分不同的相对热绕数扇区，并将分析扩展到含和不含导数相互作用的四阶标量接触图。我们还分析自旋交换热两点函数。利用体传播子的分裂表示和镜像法，我们将热 Witten 图重组为标准 AdS 积分，并获得谱表示和镜像求和表示，使关联函数的 KMS 周期性显式呈现。此外，我们展示由重合点热体-体传播子圈约化产生的体中标量和自旋场可能的依赖位置的有效单点顶点，从而允许从有效局域体相互作用重构蝌蚪型图。然而 bench 图保留内禀双局域结构。我们进一步研究这些热关联函数中编码的热单点系数和微扰 OPE 数据，包括与反常维数相关的贡献。最后，我们考察它们与热色散关系的关系，以及那些不能仅由不连续性数据确定的贡献的作用。我们的结果为探索热 CFT 关联函数的解析结构及其与热共形 bootstrap 的联系提供了一组显式的体构造。

English: We present a study of thermal two-point functions from Witten diagrams in thermal AdS$_{d+1}$, defined with the conformal boundary $S_\beta^1 \times \mathbb{R}^{d-1}$, with an aim to establish a connection between thermal CFT data and perturbative bulk dynamics. We analyze one-loop tadpole and bench diagrams arising from the cubic $\phi\phi\chi$ interaction in the bulk, segregating the different relative thermal winding sectors for the bench, and also extend the analysis to include quartic scalar contact diagrams with and without derivative interactions. We also analyze the spinning exchange thermal two-point function. Utilizing the split representation of bulk propagators and the method of images we reorganize the thermal Witten diagrams into the standard AdS integrals and obtain spectral and image-sum representations that make KMS periodicity of the correlators manifest. Additionally, we show possible position dependent effective one-point vertices of scalar and spinning fields in the bulk arising from the reduction of the coincident- point thermal bulk to bulk propagator loop, allowing tadpole-type diagrams to be reconstructed from effective local bulk interactions. The bench diagram however retains an intrinsically bi-local structure. We further investigate the thermal one-point coefficients and perturbative OPE data encoded in these thermal correlators, including contributions associated with anomalous dimensions. Finally, we examine their relation to thermal dispersion relations and the role of contributions that are not determined by discontinuity data alone. Our results provide a set of explicit bulk constructions for exploring the analytic structure of thermal CFT correlators and their connection to the thermal conformal bootstrap.

一句话导读：用热 AdS 中的 Witten 图系统构造热 CFT 两点函数、圈诱导有效单点顶点，并提取热 OPE 与谱数据。

相关度：medium — 属于 AdS/CFT 与热 CFT 微扰计算的技术性工作，与全息对偶基础字典相关；但未直接涉及所列重点标签中的全息超流超导、p 波序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

来自 Fredholm 行列式的巨 Wilson 圈

Giant Wilson loops from Fredholm determinants

Ludvig Chen, Victor Mishnyakov, Konstantin Zarembo · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中大 k 的对称与反对称 Wilson 圈。我们将其生成函数表示为 Fredholm 行列式，这些行列式由 Hermite 核构造，并带有编码表示的符号函数权重。利用该核的可积结构，我们系统地应用 Tracy-Widom 方法，推导出一个闭合的积分-微分方程组。随后通过 WKB 拟设按 1/N 逐阶求解这些方程，同时保持符号函数一般。我们得到了生成函数领头阶与次领头阶贡献的闭合表达式。最后，针对这两个表示，我们进行大 k 鞍点分析，并得到 Wilson 圈的次领头阶贡献。我们的结果确认了此前观察到的与巨 Wilson 圈对偶 D-brane 描述之间的差异。

English: We study large-k symmetric and antisymmetric Wilson loops in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory. We represent their generating functions as Fredholm determinants built from the Hermite kernel weighted by a symbol function that encodes the representation. Using the integrable structure of the kernel, we systematically apply the Tracy-Widom approach to derive a closed system of integro-differential equations. The equations are then solved order by order in 1/N by a WKB ansatz, while keeping the symbol function general. We find a closed-form expression for the leading and subleading order contributions to the generating functions. Finally, specializing to the two representations, we perform the large-k saddle-point analysis and find the subleading contribution to the Wilson loop. Our results confirm the previously observed discrepancies with the dual D-brane description of giant Wilson loops.

一句话导读：用 Fredholm 行列式与 Tracy-Widom/WKB 方法计算 N=4 SYM 中大 k 对称/反对称 Wilson 圈生成函数的 1/N 修正，并确认与对偶 D-brane 描述的差异。

相关度：low — 该文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典中的 Wilson 圈/D-brane 对偶计算，但与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力等重点支线均无直接重合。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

N=4 SYM 中的黑洞上同调

Black hole cohomologies in N=4 SYM

Seunggyu Kim, Jehyun Lee, Siyul Lee, Jaewon Song · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们系统研究了规范群为 SU(N)（N=2,3,4）的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯（SYM）理论的 BPS 上同调，主要聚焦于 BMN 扇区。我们发现 N>2 时存在非 Coulomb 引力子上同调。对于 N>2，BMN 扇区中最轻的黑洞上同调总是携带非平凡 R 荷，并对应于膜融合型。因此，无毛的“核心”黑洞反而“更重”。我们还发现，N=3 中的一族膜融合上同调在首个量子阶不会被消除。在固定电荷扇区，引力子在电荷共轭下具有确定的宇称。在我们已检验的能级范围内，每一个黑洞上同调要么与引力子宇称相反，要么被量子修正消除。我们猜想，在同一电荷扇区中，黑洞上同调总是具有与引力子相反的宇称。

English: We systematically investigate BPS cohomologies of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM) theory with gauge group SU$(N)$ with $N=2, 3, 4$, focusing primarily on the BMN sector. We find non-Coulomb graviton cohomologies for $N>2$. For $N>2$, the lightest black hole cohomology in the BMN sector always carries non-trivial $R$-charge and corresponds to the brane-fused type. Therefore, the `core' black holes without hair are `heavier'. We also find that a family of brane-fused cohomologies in $N=3$ is not lifted at the first quantum order. At a fixed charge sector, gravitons carry definite parity under charge conjugation. Up to the levels we have tested, every black hole cohomology either has opposite parity to that of gravitons or is lifted by quantum corrections. We conjecture that black hole cohomologies always carry parity opposite to gravitons in the same charge sector.

一句话导读：系统研究 N=4 SYM 中 BMN 扇区的 BPS 黑洞上同调，发现 N>2 的非 Coulomb 引力子上同调、最轻黑洞上同调带 R 荷且为膜融合型，并提出黑洞上同调宇称与引力子相反的猜想。

相关度：medium — 属于 AdS/CFT 与黑洞量子引力方向的 BPS 态/上同调研究，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、QNM 与非线性演化、经典引力等具体重点标签。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

稳态时空的线性稳定性矩阵与 Lyapunov 指数

Linear stability matrix and Lyapunov exponents for stationary spacetime

Xu Ye, Shao-Wen Wei · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：Lyapunov 指数刻画相空间中邻近轨道的平均收敛或发散速率，因此为动力学稳定性提供了有用判据。在本工作中，我们建立了一个分析稳态时空中 Lyapunov 指数的一般框架，并将先前研究推广到圆轨道之外。对于由 g_{\mu\nu}(r,\theta) 描述的一般稳态时空，我们证明与线性微扰相关的相空间由 (r,p_r,\theta,p_\theta) 张成，相应的线性稳定性矩阵秩为四。当时空容许一个秩-2 Killing 张量时，线性稳定性矩阵可化为块对角形式，从而可以解析地得到 Lyapunov 指数。通过施加适当的约束条件，该形式进一步给出圆轨道和球面轨道的线性稳定性矩阵和 Lyapunov 指数。我们通过若干代表性例子说明该方法的有效性，包括（反）谐振子、平面 Kepler 运动以及 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 时空中的粒子运动。这些结果为研究经典和相对论动力学系统中粒子轨道的稳定性性质提供了一个统一框架。

English: Lyapunov exponents characterize the average rate at which nearby trajectories in phase space converge or diverge and therefore provide a useful criterion for dynamical stability. In this work, we develop a general framework for analyzing Lyapunov exponents in stationary spacetimes and extend previous studies beyond circular orbits. For a generic stationary spacetime described by $g_{\mu\nu}(r,\theta)$, we show that the phase space relevant to linear perturbations is spanned by $(r,p_r,\theta,p_\theta)$ and the corresponding linear stability matrix has rank four. When the spacetime admits a rank-2 Killing tensor, the linear stability matrix can be reduced to a block-diagonal form, allowing the Lyapunov exponents to be obtained analytically. By imposing the appropriate constraint conditions, the formalism further yields the linear stability matrices and Lyapunov exponents for circular and spherical orbits. The validity of the method is illustrated by several representative examples, including the (inverted) harmonic oscillator, planar Kepler motion, and particle motion in Schwarzschild and Kerr spacetimes. These results provide a unified framework for investigating the stability properties of particle orbits in both classical and relativistic dynamical systems.

一句话导读：为稳态时空中的粒子轨道建立基于四维线性稳定性矩阵的 Lyapunov 指数统一框架，并涵盖圆轨道/球面轨道及 Schwarzschild、Kerr 等例子。

相关度：high — 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究稳态时空中粒子轨道稳定性与 Lyapunov 指数，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”高度吻合；不涉及全息。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

共形场论中测量的互信息

Mutual Information of Measurement in Conformal Field Theories

Israel Klich, Ravisankar Rajagopal, Diana Vaman · hep-th, cond-mat.stat-mech, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：局部算符在两个空间区域之间的测量互信息刻画了：给定一个区域的测量结果时，另一个区域测量结果不确定性的减少。我们研究共形场论中测量的 Rényi-Shannon 互信息。对大 N CFT 中标量原初算符及其后代，在区间相邻或相距很远两个极端极限下进行了显式计算。结果只依赖于交比和被测量算符的标度维度 Δ，与纠缠互信息有显著相似性。对于相邻区间，我们发现对 (Δ-1/2)^2 的惊人二次依赖。这种依赖表面上似乎违反信息处理不等式，我们对此进行了讨论并解决。我们还给出测量互信息的全息解释。

English: The mutual information of measurement of a local operator between two spatial regions characterizes the reduction in the uncertainty of measurement outcomes in one region given the outcome in the other. We study the R\'enyi-Shannon mutual information of measurement in conformal field theories (CFTs). Explicit calculations for scalar primaries and descendants in large $N$ CFTs are performed in the two extreme limits of the intervals being adjacent or largely separated. The results depend on only the cross ratio and the scaling dimension $\Delta$ of the operator being measured, with striking similarities to the mutual information of entanglement. We find a surprising quadratic dependence as $(\Delta-1/2)^2$ for adjacent intervals. This dependence superficially seems to violate the information processing inequality, which we discuss and resolve. We also offer a holographic interpretation of the mutual information of measurement.

一句话导读：研究共形场论中测量的 Rényi-Shannon 互信息，发现其依赖标度维度 Δ，并与纠缠互信息相似。

English: Gravitational perturbations of rotating black holes in higher dimensions generally obey coupled partial differential equations. The physical radial problem is a $2\times2$ first-order system, equivalent to a single second-order equation. This gives a separation of the sector containing both the bar-mode and axisymmetric ultraspinning instabilities. Using only ordinary differential equations, we compute the bar-mode quasinormal spectrum in $d=5,6,7$ and find instability onsets at $a/r_+=0.90498$ and $0.83228$ in $d=6,7$. We also compute the growing axisymmetric modes and their onset rotations in $d=6,\ldots,9$. The construction shows how separability can survive the coupling between gravitational polarisations.

中文摘要：不能：无论是围绕恒星和致密天体形成的引力原子发生玻色新星，还是星系暗物质晕中形成的玻色星发生玻色新星，都不能。我们假设全部暗物质由具有吸引自相互作用的超轻玻色子组成，这些玻色子可被天体引力势捕获，或凝聚成自引力位形。当这些系统在玻色新星中坍缩时，其部分质量会转化为逃逸出星系的相对论辐射。我们给出单个天体可抛射质量的上限，并在银河系和其他类型星系的现实模型中对之求和。对于引力原子，在现实恒星族群和恒星演化下，银河系恒星最多耗尽其晕的 ε^GA_⋆ ≃ 3×10^-9，而在其他星系中这种泵浦也同样可忽略。中心黑洞 Sgr A* 可达到 ε^GA ∼ 10^-3，但这仅对应于超暗矮星系所不偏好的玻色子质量，并且超出微扰处理的有效范围，此时只有关于暗物质通量的几何上限可用。对于从晕的其余部分吸积的玻色星，它们最多辐射约 3×10^-5 的银河系晕，以及类似 DF2 星系的 0.1%。

English: No: neither through the bosenovae of gravitational atoms formed around stars and compact objects, nor through those of boson stars formed in the galactic dark-matter halo. We assume that all the dark matter consists of ultralight bosons with attractive self-interactions, which can be captured in the gravitational potential of astrophysical objects or condense into self-gravitating configurations. When these systems collapse in a bosenova, part of their mass is turned into relativistic radiation that escapes the galaxy. We bound the mass that a single object can eject and sum it over realistic models of the Milky Way and of other types of galaxies. For gravitational atoms, with realistic stellar populations and stellar evolution, the stars of the Milky Way deplete at most $\epsilon^{\rm GA}_\star\simeq3\times10^{-9}$ of its halo, and the pump is equally negligible in other galaxies. The central black hole, Sgr A$^*$, could reach $\epsilon^{\rm GA}\sim10^{-3}$, but only for a boson mass disfavoured by ultrafaint dwarf galaxies and beyond the validity of the perturbative treatment, where only a geometric bound on the dark matter flux is available. For boson stars feeding on the rest of the halo, these would radiate at most $\sim3\times10^{-5}$ of the Milky-Way halo and $0.1\%$ of a DF2-like one.

一句话导读：该工作表明，在现实参数下，恒星/致密天体周围的引力原子和晕中玻色星的玻色新星都只能耗尽星系暗物质晕的极小部分，无法显著消耗星系暗物质。

By employing the self-interacting fermionic dark matter model, we investigate the effects of dark matter parameters including the particle mass, self-interaction strength, and mass fraction of dark matter on the properties of DANSs. Our results indicate that the joint constraints from the observation of XTE J1814-338 and the astrophysical limits on the dark matter self-interaction cross section derived from observations of different colliding galaxy clusters can provide effective constraints on the particle mass of dark matter. Specifically, to simultaneously satisfy the small radius of XTE J1814-338 and the self-interaction limit, the particle mass of self-interacting fermionic dark matter is constrained to the range from sub-GeV to a few GeV.

Jia-Jie Jiang, Han Tang, Danning Li, Lang Yu · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们在软墙 AdS/QCD 框架下重新研究 ρ 介子的热性质。通过神经网络辅助的反演过程，利用格点 QCD 的屏蔽质量数据校准伸缩子背景。使用该校准背景，计算时间矢量谱函数和最低矢量准正规模。随后从相应的复准正规模频率中提取极点质量 m_pole(T) 和热宽度 Γ(T)。采用准正规模频率实部消失 ω_Re(T_d)=0 作为介子解离判据，估计 T_d≈168 MeV。温度升高时热宽度增大，谱函数从窄的 Breit-Wigner 型共振峰演化为输运峰，证实 QNM 预言：极点质量消失伴随输运峰出现，使准粒子峰难以识别。对色散关系的数值提取表明，传播子可由有限温度简单极点形式描述，具有动量依赖的热宽度，由扩散系数 D(T) 和有效传播速度 u(T) 表征，其温度依赖也被提取。该形式修正了屏蔽质量与极点质量之间的通常关系。这些结果可为热强子介质有效研究提供参考。

English: The thermal properties of the \(\rho\) meson are revisited within the soft-wall AdS/QCD framework. The dilaton background is calibrated against lattice QCD screening-mass data through a neural-network-assisted inverse procedure. Using this calibrated background, we compute the temporal vector spectral function and the lowest vector quasi-normal modes. The pole mass \(m_{\mathrm{pole}}(T)\) and thermal width \(\Gamma(T)\) are then extracted from the corresponding complex quasi-normal mode frequencies. Adopting the vanishing real part of the quasi-normal mode frequency, \(\omega_{\mathrm{Re}}(T_d)=0\), as a criterion for meson dissociation, we estimate \(T_d\approx168\,\mathrm{MeV}\). As the temperature increases, the thermal width grows, and the spectral function evolves from a narrow Breit-Wigner-like resonance peak into a transport peak, confirming the QNM prediction that the vanishing of the pole mass is accompanied by the emergence of a transport peak and making it difficult to identify a quasiparticle peak. A numerical extraction of the dispersion relation shows that the propagator can be described by a finite-temperature simple-pole form with momentum-dependent thermal width, characterized by a diffusion coefficient \(D(T)\) and an effective propagation speed \(u(T)\), whose temperature dependences are also extracted. This form modifies the usual relation between the screening and pole masses. These results may provide a useful reference for effective studies of the hot hadronic medium.

J. P. Carlomagno, G. A. Contrera, A. G. Grunfeld, G. Lugones · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：对于强子中子星和自束缚奇异星，其整体性质之间已确立普适的、不依赖状态方程（EOS）的关系。我们询问类似关系是否适用于混合星的夸克核心，以及能否从星体表面约束核心。我们用带排斥矢量相互作用的三味 MIT 袋模型描述夸克物质，并通过 Maxwell 构造与强子 DD2 状态方程匹配，扫描整个 $(B^{1/4},G_V)$ 平面，得到 1112 个最大质量高于 $2\,M_\odot$ 的混合星 EOS，大致兼容当前多信使约束。对每个稳定位形，我们分别计算星体表面和夸克核心边界处的质量、半径、转动惯量和潮汐形变。整体量遵循强子星的关系——$I$--Love 关系在 $0.5\%$ 以内——而核心量遵循自束缚奇异星的关系，中位偏差为 $6$--$9\%$。我们通过将核心结构按其致密度作幂级数展开来解释后者：在一阶近似下，核心质量、重子质量、转动惯量和潮汐形变仅依赖于致密度以及强子—夸克界面的性质，主要是转变压强与夸克能量密度之比 $\xi=p_{\rm tr}/\varepsilon_+$。奇异星关系是该族在 $\xi\to0$ 时的成员，对其偏离度量了 $\xi$。所有位形的核心质量分数和半径分数遵循星体的归一化质量分布，并且没有任何整体可观测量允许推断核心大小。近乎消失的核心主导可行参数空间，而可观大小的核心需要低袋常数和强矢量耦合。

English: Universal, equation-of-state (EOS) insensitive relations among the global properties of compact stars are well established for hadronic neutron stars and for self-bound strange stars. We ask whether analogous relations hold for the quark core of a hybrid star, and whether the core can be constrained from the surface. Describing quark matter with the three-flavor MIT bag model with repulsive vector interactions, matched to the hadronic DD2 EOS through a Maxwell construction, we scan the full $(B^{1/4},G_V)$ plane and obtain 1112 hybrid EOSs with maximum masses above $2\,M_\odot$, broadly compatible with current multimessenger constraints. For every stable configuration we evaluate the mass, radius, moment of inertia, and tidal deformability both at the stellar surface and at the boundary of the quark core. Global quantities follow the relations of hadronic stars---the $I$--Love relation to within $0.5\%$---while core quantities follow those of self-bound strange stars with median deviations of $6$--$9\%$. We explain the latter by expanding the structure of the core in powers of its compactness: to first order, the core mass, baryon mass, moment of inertia, and tidal deformability depend only on the compactness and on the properties of the hadron--quark interface, chiefly the ratio $\xi=p_{\rm tr}/\varepsilon_+$ of transition pressure to quark energy density. The strange-star relations are the $\xi\to0$ member of this family, and the deviations from them measure $\xi$. The fractional core mass and radius of all configurations follow the normalized mass profile of the star, and no global observable allows the core size to be inferred. Evanescent cores dominate the viable parameter space, while sizable cores require low bag constants and strong vector couplings.

一句话导读：系统扫描三味 MIT 袋模型参数空间，发现混合星整体性质仍满足强子星普适关系，而夸克核心性质可用致密度和界面参数 $\xi$ 统一描述。

类轴子粒子媒介暗物质的中子星星震学

Asteroseismology of Neutron Stars with Axion-Like Particle Mediated Dark Matter

Pinku Routaray, Rudra N. Sahoo, Bharat Kuma, M. Bhuyan · nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们考察暗物质对中子星可观测量的影响。暗物质通过类轴子粒子（ALP）与核子发生相互作用，暗物质混合中子星（DNS）在相对论平均场（RMF）形式下建模。暗物质对中子星的影响由两个参数刻画：暗物质费米动量 q_f 和暗物质质量 m_χ。通过改变这两个参数，我们研究中子星的质量、半径和潮汐形变如何改变。进一步，我们通过径向振荡分析研究 ALP 媒介暗物质如何影响中子星稳定性。此外，通过计算 DNS 中的基频模式频率研究非径向振荡，并分析 ALP 媒介暗物质如何改变其行为。

English: We examine the impacts of dark matter (DM) on the observables of the neutron star (NS). The interaction of DM with nucleons intermediate by axion-like particles (ALPs), and the DM-admixed NS (DNS) is formulated in the framework of the relativistic mean field (RMF) formalism. The effects of the DM on the NS are characterized by two parameters: DM Fermi momentum ($q_f$) and DM mass ($m_\chi$). By varying these two parameters, we investigate how the NS's mass, radius, and tidal deformability are altered. Furthermore, we study how the ALP-mediated DM impacts the stability of the NS through the analysis of radial oscillations. In addition, the nonradial oscillation has been investigated by calculating its fundamental mode frequency in the DNS and analyzed how the ALP-mediated DM modifies its behavior.

一句话导读：在相对论平均场框架下研究 ALP 媒介暗物质对中子星质量、半径、潮汐形变及径向/非径向振荡的影响。

低温 QCD 相图与热孪星的禁闭密度泛函方法

Confining density functional approach to the QCD phase diagram at low temperatures and thermal twin stars

David Blaschke, Oleksii Ivanytskyi · nucl-th, astro-ph.SR, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们提出一种基于密度泛函的温稠密核物质状态方程，其中包含向去禁闭夸克物质的转变，可用于超新星爆炸与中子星并合模拟，也可用于 Q-ball 的宇宙学演化。对于夸克物质状态方程，我们采用最近发展的禁闭密度泛函方法，而核物质由 DD2 类的相对论密度泛函模型描述。相变通过固定每重子熵的 Maxwell 构造获得。我们讨论两个杂化状态方程模型下等熵杂化星的 TOV 方程解：不含色超导的 DDf-SFM 和含色超导的 DD2-χCDF。我们发现，在有限温度下，当每重子熵超过临界值时，DDf-SFM 模型可能出现不连续第三家族分支序列（“热孪星”），而在色超导模型和 T=0 时则不存在。我们讨论该临界每重子熵与 T=0 时 Seidov 引力不稳定性判据的关系，发现后者是一个很好的指引。我们建议，热孪星的存在可被视为太阳金属度大质量蓝超巨星核心坍缩超新星可爆炸性的指示，从而作为杂化状态方程模型可靠性的新判据。按此论证，强色超导应被排除，而具有中等双夸克配对的模型能否满足热孪星约束仍有待证明。对于对称物质，我们将所得杂化状态方程与 Danielewicz 等人的流约束比较，发现去禁闭起始密度对色超导存在与否敏感。

English: We present a density functional-based equation of state for warm, dense nuclear matter with a transition to deconfined quark matter for applications to simulations of supernova explosions and neutron star mergers, but also for the cosmological evolution of Q-balls. For the quark matter equation of state, we employ a recently developed confining density functional approach while nuclear matter is described within a relativistic density functional model of the DD2 class. The phase transition is obtained by a Maxwell construction at constant entropy per baryon. We discuss the solutions of TOV equations for isentropic hybrid stars for two hybrid equation of state models: DDf-SFM without and DD2-$\chi$CDF with color superconductivity. We find that at finite temperatures above a critical value of entropy per baryon sequences of disconnected third family branches ("thermal twin stars") may appear for the DDf-SFM model, while they are absent for the color superconducting model and at $T=0$. We discuss the relation of this critical entropy per baryon to the Seidov criterion of gravitational instability for $T=0$ and find that it is a good guide. We suggest that the presence of thermal twin stars may be regarded as an indicator for the core-collapse supernova explodability of massive blue supergiant stars with solar metallicity and thus serve as a new criterion for the reliability of hybrid equation of state models. By this argument, strong color superconductivity shall be excluded and it remains to be shown whether models with moderate diquark pairing could fulfill the thermal twin constraint. For the case of symmetric matter, we compare the resulting hybrid EOS with the flow constraint by Danielewicz et al. and find a a sensitivity of the onset density for deconfinement to the presence or absence of color superconductivity.

一句话导读：用禁闭密度泛函构建杂化星状态方程并求解 TOV，发现有限温度下可能出现热孪星，并以此约束色超导和杂化状态方程模型。

相关度：medium — 非全息研究，但涉及 TOV、杂化星/中子星以及 QCD 一级相变、热孪星，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“相变/气泡成核/引力热力学”支线；与全息方法无直接关系。

在宇宙学扰动中识别停滞

Spotting Stasis in Cosmological Perturbations

Keith R. Dienes, Lucien Heurtier, Daniel Hoover, Fei Huang, Anna Paulsen, Brooks Thomas · astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：正如近期若干论文所讨论的，宇宙学停滞是一种现象：尽管宇宙在膨胀，多种具有不同状态方程的能量组分的丰度可在较长时间内保持恒定。停滞现象最引人注目的方面之一是，它可以产生宇宙学时期，其中宇宙的有效状态方程参数 <w> 恒定，但不同于物质、辐射、真空能等对应的标准值。实际上，在这样一个停滞时期，宇宙能量密度的空间平均演化方式，与宇宙由状态方程参数等于 <w> 的完美流体主导时的演化方式完全相同。然而，我们将证明，这种等价性在能量密度扰动层面被打破。为说明这一点，我们考虑一个包含物质和辐射的停滞时期，并证明在该停滞背景中，具有极小能量密度的旁观者物质组分的密度扰动表现出幂律增长，且该增长持续整个停滞时期。这种增长可能在较小尺度上导致显著的结构增强。这种增强不仅本身有趣，也可能提供一种观测上区分停滞时期与完美流体主导时期的方法——即使两种情况下宇宙具有相同的状态方程。

English: As discussed in a number of recent papers, cosmological stasis is a phenomenon wherein the abundances of multiple cosmological energy components with different equations of state remain constant for an extended period despite the expansion of the universe. One of the most intriguing aspects of the stasis phenomenon is that it can give rise to cosmological epochs in which the effective equation-of-state parameter $\langle w \rangle$ for the universe is constant, but differs from the canonical values associated with matter, radiation, vacuum energy, etc. Indeed, during such a stasis epoch, the spatial average of the energy density of the universe evolves in precisely the same manner as it would have evolved if the universe were instead dominated by a perfect fluid with an equation-of-state parameter equal to $\langle w \rangle$. However, as we shall demonstrate, this equivalence is broken at the level of the perturbations of the energy density. To illustrate this point, we consider a stasis epoch involving matter and radiation and demonstrate that within this stasis background the density perturbations associated with a spectator matter component with exceedingly small energy density exhibit a power-law growth that persists across the entire duration of the stasis epoch. This growth can potentially lead to significant enhancements of structure at small scales. Such enhancements are not only interesting in their own right, but may also provide a way of observationally distinguishing between a stasis epoch and an epoch of perfect-fluid domination -- even if the universe has the same equation of state in both cases.

一句话导读：在物质-辐射停滞背景中，旁观者物质的密度扰动呈持续幂律增长，破坏了完美流体等效性，并可增强小尺度结构。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典宇宙学/广义相对论中的扰动演化，涉及经典引力支线，但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或量子引力；与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关，与其他全息支线无关。

全息模型中对(2+1)味QCD相变的系统性贝叶斯研究

Systematic Bayesian investigation of the (2+1)-flavor QCD phase transition in a holographic model

Liqiang Zhu, Xun Chen, Kai Zhou, Hanzhong Zhang, Mei Huang, Enke Wang · hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：本研究通过将 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 框架与零化学势下的格点 QCD 数据（熵、声速平方和重子数磁化率）结合，构建了一个贝叶斯全息 QCD 模型，并系统纳入了格点 QCD 结果的误差估计。利用贝叶斯推断框架，我们首先精确校准了模型参数，随后全面研究了(2+1)味 QCD 在零和有限化学势下的热力学性质，最后给出了 QCD 相图中临界终点(CEP)位置的预测。结果表明，在最大后验(MAP)估计下，CEP 位于 (T, μ)_MAP = (0.119, 0.615) GeV。此外，我们给出了 CEP 在 68% 和 95% 置信水平(CL)下的预测区域，分别为 (T, μ)_68%CL = (0.1176--0.1204, 0.59--0.63) GeV 和 (T, μ)_95%CL = (0.1172--0.1206, 0.58--0.63) GeV。与其他理论模型预测的详细比较验证了我们方法的稳健性和预测能力。这项工作不仅为全息建模建立了一个新的分析框架，也为极端条件下强相互作用物质相变提供了有价值的理论见解。

English: In this study, we construct a bayesian holographic QCD model by integrating the Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) framework with lattice quantum chromodynamics (QCD) data at zero chemical potential, specifically entropy, the square of the speed of sound, and baryon number susceptibilities, while systematically incorporating error estimates from the lattice QCD (LQCD) results. Leveraging a bayesian inference framework, we first achieve a precise calibration of the model parameters, then perform a comprehensive investigation into the thermodynamic properties of \((2+1)\)-flavor QCD at both zero and finite chemical potentials, and finally provide a prediction for the location of the critical end point (CEP) in the QCD phase diagram. Our results indicate that, under the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation, the CEP is located at $(T, \mu)_{\mathrm{MAP}} = (0.119, 0.615)\mathrm{GeV}$. Furthermore, we provide the predicted regions for the CEP at $68\%$ and $95\%$ confidence levels (CL), yielding $(T, \mu)_{68\% \mathrm{CL}} = (0.1176\text{--}0.1204,0.59\text{--}0.63)\mathrm{GeV}$ and $(T, \mu)_{95\% \mathrm{CL}} = (0.1172\text{--}0.1206,0.58\text{--}0.63)\mathrm{GeV}$, respectively. A thorough comparison with predictions from other theoretical models validates the robustness and predictive power of our approach. This work not only establishes a novel analytical framework for holographic modeling but also provides valuable theoretical insights into the phase transitions of strongly interacting matter under extreme conditions.

一句话导读：用 EMD 全息模型结合格点 QCD 数据做贝叶斯校准，预测(2+1)味 QCD 临界终点位置。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究强相互作用物质相变和 QCD 临界终点，与用户重点标签“相变与气泡成核”高度相关。

味分辨 QCD 等离子体中的全息轻夸克喷注淬火

Holographic light quark jet quenching in flavor resolved QCD plasmas

Huwei Zhu, Ke Ma, Zi-qiang Zhang · hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在一个经机器学习校准的爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-伸缩子背景上，使用全息下落弦框架研究夸克-胶子等离子体中的轻夸克能量损失，并考察三种味组态：纯胶子、二味 QCD 以及包含奇异性的完整 QCD。停止距离由零测地线计算，作为约化温度 T/Tc 和重子化学势 μ 的函数。对于 T/Tc>1.03，积分停止距离的味排序稳定为 Nf=2+1>Nf=2>Nf=0，对应淬火层级 Nf=0>Nf=2>Nf=2+1。这与在约化温度框架下由射击弦 dE/dx 得到的味排序一致，从而在同一全息背景内为局域和积分观测量提供了交叉检验。在 T/Tc≈1 附近，由于 A(z) 中 a 项与 b 项的相互影响以及三个体系不同的 Tc 值，行为更为复杂。有限重子化学势单调地缩短停止距离并增强淬火，在 QCD 临界端点附近敏感性增强，与 RHIC 束流能量扫描测量的预期一致。我们讨论了高温 T/Tc 下味排序的几何起源，以及对重离子输运模拟的可能推广。

English: We study light quark energy loss in a quark-gluon plasma using the holographic falling-string framework on a machine-learning-calibrated Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton background for three flavor configurations: pure glue, two-flavor QCD, and full QCD with strangeness. Stopping distances are computed from null geodesics as functions of reduced temperature $T/T_c$ and baryon chemical potential $\mu$. For $T/T_c>1.03$, the flavor ordering of the integrated stopping distance stabilizes to $N_f=2+1>N_f=2>N_f=0$, corresponding to the quenching hierarchy $N_f=0>N_f=2>N_f=2+1$. This agrees with the flavor ordering obtained from the shooting-string $dE/dx$ when both are expressed in the reduced-temperature framework, providing a cross-check between local and integrated observables within the same holographic background. Near $T/T_c\simeq1$, the behavior is more complex due to the interplay between the $a$ and $b$ terms in $A(z)$ and the different $T_c$ values of the three systems. Finite baryon chemical potential monotonically shortens stopping distances and enhances quenching, with enhanced sensitivity near the QCD critical endpoint, consistent with expectations from RHIC beam energy scan measurements. We discuss the geometric origin of the high-$T/T_c$ flavor ordering and possible extensions to heavy-ion transport simulations.

一句话导读：用机器学习校准的 EMd 全息背景结合下落/射击弦，研究味分辨 QCD 等离子体中轻夸克喷注淬火及停止距离随温度和重子化学势的变化。

基于全息QCD的2+1味系统临界端点的贝叶斯推断

Bayesian Inference of the Critical Endpoint in 2+1-Flavor System from Holographic QCD

Liqiang Zhu, Xun Chen, Kai Zhou, Hanzhong Zhang, Mei Huang · hep-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们提出了一个贝叶斯全息模型，通过整合零化学势下格点QCD的状态方程和重子数磁化率构建。该模型纳入了来自格点数据的误差估计。利用该模型，我们系统研究了2+1味QCD系统的热力学性质。使用贝叶斯推断，我们对模型参数进行了精确校准，并在最大后验（MAP）估计下确定临界端点（CEP）位置为 $(T^{c},\mu_{B}^{c})=(0.0859\;\mathrm{GeV},0.742\;\mathrm{GeV})$。此外，我们预测了68%和95%置信水平下的CEP位置，分别为 $(T^{c},\; \mu_{B}^{c})_{68\%}$=$(0.0820\text{--}0.0889, 0.71\text{--}0.77)\;\mathrm{GeV}$ 和 $(T^{c},\; \mu_{B}^{c})_{95\%}$=$(0.0816\text{--}0.0898,\; 0.71\text{--}0.79)\;\mathrm{GeV}$。此外，为验证方法的可靠性和预测能力，我们将预测与其他理论模型提出的可能CEP位置进行了全面比较。这项工作不仅为全息建模建立了新的贝叶斯框架，也为探索极端条件下强相互作用物质的相变提供了有价值的见解和理论支持。

English: We present a Bayesian holographic model constructed by integrating the equation of state and baryon number susceptibility at zero chemical potential from lattice QCD. The model incorporates error estimates derived from lattice data. With this model, we systematically investigate the thermodynamic properties of the 2+1-flavor QCD system. Using Bayesian Inference, we perform precise calibration of the model parameters and determined the critical endpoint (CEP) position under the maximum a posterior (MAP) estimation to be $(T^{c},\mu_{B}^{c})=(0.0859\;\mathrm{GeV},0.742\;\mathrm{GeV})$. Additionally, we predict the CEP positions within 68\% and 95\% confidence levels, yielding $(T^{c},\; \mu_{B}^{c})_{68\%}$=$(0.0820\text{--}0.0889, 0.71\text{--}0.77)\;\mathrm{GeV}$ and $(T^{c},\; \mu_{B}^{c})_{95\%}$=$(0.0816\text{--}0.0898,\; 0.71\text{--}0.79)\;\mathrm{GeV}$, respectively. Moreover, to validate the reliability and predictive power of our approach, we conduct a comprehensive comparison between our predictions and potential CEP locations proposed by other theoretical models. This work not only establishes a novel Bayesian framework for holographic modeling but also provides valuable insights and theoretical support for exploring phase transitions in strongly-interacting matter under extreme conditions.

一句话导读：用贝叶斯校准全息QCD模型，给出2+1味QCD临界端点的MAP位置及置信区间。

基于多密度约束的弱相互作用暗物质混合中子星模型的贝叶斯探索

Bayesian exploration of weakly interacting models of dark matter admixed neutron stars based on multi-density constraints

Payaswinee Arvikar, Prashant Thakur, Sarmistha Banik · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在单流体近似下，对中子星中 Higgs 门户、中子衰变和类轴子粒子（ALP）介导的暗物质进行了统一的贝叶斯分析。使用共同的强子物质相对论平均场描述，我们结合了有限核与重离子碰撞数据、手征有效场论、NICER 对四颗脉冲星的测量以及 GW170817。各个暗部门参数仍然确定得很弱，而核偏斜度的模型依赖移动揭示了推断出的强子状态方程对假设暗物质机制的敏感性。三种情形给出显著重叠的质量-半径和潮汐形变预测，最大质量中位数接近 2.1 M_sun。对于 1.4 M_sun 恒星，Higgs 门户模型预测比中子衰变和 ALP 模型更高的 f 模频率和更短的阻尼时间，尽管其可信区域重叠。与三个经过一致重分析的双流体模型比较，给出中子衰变最大的贝叶斯证据：在所采用先验下，其相对于 Higgs 门户和双流体替代模型的 Bayes 因子约为 24–37，但相对于 ALP 仅为 2.2。这一排序涉及完整暗物质模型，并不确立对任一流体描述的一般偏好，也不构成存在暗成分本身的证据。改进的核约束和未来的引力波星震学可以提供互补信息，以分离强子和暗部门贡献。

English: We present a unified Bayesian analysis of Higgs-portal, neutron-decay, and axion-like-particle (ALP)-mediated dark matter in neutron stars within the single-fluid approximation. Using a common relativistic mean-field description of hadronic matter, we combine finite-nucleus and heavy-ion collision data, chiral effective field theory, NICER measurements of four pulsars, and GW170817. The individual dark-sector parameters remain weakly determined, while model-dependent shifts in nuclear skewness reveal the sensitivity of the inferred hadronic equation of state to the assumed dark-matter mechanism. The three scenarios yield substantially overlapping mass-radius and tidal-deformability predictions, with median maximum masses near $2.1\,M_\odot$. For $1.4\,M_\odot$ stars, the Higgs-portal model predicts higher $f$-mode frequencies and shorter damping times than the neutron-decay and ALP models, although their credible regions overlap. Comparison with three consistently reanalysed two-fluid models gives the largest Bayesian evidence to neutron decay: under the adopted priors, its Bayes factors relative to the Higgs-portal and two-fluid alternatives are approximately $24$-$37$, but only $2.2$ relative to ALP. This ranking concerns complete dark-matter models and does not establish a general preference for either fluid description or evidence for a dark component itself. Improved nuclear constraints and future gravitational-wave asteroseismology could provide complementary information to disentangle the hadronic and dark-sector contributions.

一句话导读：用贝叶斯方法比较三种弱相互作用暗物质混合中子星模型，并结合多密度与引力波约束检验状态方程和 f 模预言。

带辅助规范场的扩展黑洞热力学中的热力学体积

Thermodynamic Volumes of Extended Black Hole Thermodynamics with Auxiliary Gauge Fields

Zili Mou, Yu Tian, Hongbao Zhang · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：通过将 Iyer-Wald 形式体系应用于引力系统的修正拉格朗日形式，其中原拉格朗日形式中出现的耦合常数（如宇宙学常数）通过引入相应的辅助规范场而被提升为动力学标量场，我们推导了扩展黑洞热力学的第一定律；其中，作为耦合常数的共轭热力学变量，所得热力学体积不依赖于辅助规范场，且与此前直接通过变分耦合常数得到的结果完全相同。此外，进一步表明这些体积也可用辅助规范场表示，并可在黑洞视界上求值，从而验证了先前文献提出的方案。

English: By applying the Iyer-Wald formalism to the modified Lagrangian form for the gravitational system, where the coupling constants appearing in the original Lagrangian form, such as the cosmological constant, are promoted to the dynamical scalar fields by introducing the corresponding auxiliary gauge fields, we derive the first law of the extended black hole thermodynamics, where the resulting thermodynamic volumes as the conjugate thermodynamic variables to the coupling constants are nevertheless independent of the auxiliary gauge fields and exactly the same as those obtained before via varying the coupling constants by brute force. In addition, it is further shown that such volumes can also be expressed in terms of the auxiliary gauge fields and evaluated on the black hole horizon, validating the proposal made in the previous literature.

一句话导读：用 Iyer-Wald 形式与辅助规范场推导扩展黑洞热力学第一定律，证明热力学体积与辅助场无关且可在视界上表示。

English: We determine the quadrupolar logarithmic tidal response of electrically charged Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg black holes from the coupled static odd-parity gravitational and electromagnetic equations. At first order in the Euler-Heisenberg coupling $a$, a direct asymptotic recursion gives the canonical running matrix $C_{\rm can}^{\rm EH}=(9aQ^2/10)\left(\begin{smallmatrix}0&-Q\\-Q&M\end{smallmatrix}\right)$, defined as the coefficients multiplying the canonical source vector in the $r^{-2}\log(r_0/r)$ term. The resulting local coefficients retain the full dependence on the subextremal ratio $\frac{Q}{M}$ at this perturbative order. The two quartic invariants partially cancel in both nonzero channels, while the action-normalized fields make gravitoelectromagnetic reciprocity explicit. The local extremal limit of the running matrix reproduces the corresponding two-invariant effective-field-theory result after convention conversion. Allowing independent quartic couplings further shows that identical electric background geometries can have different axial running matrices and yields algebraic inverse relations within the specified two-operator model. The calculation determines local logarithmic running within minimally coupled quartic electrodynamics; the finite horizon-matched response requires an additional global matching calculation.

English: Within the Hatta-Yang holographic graviton-dilaton amplitude for near-threshold $J/\psi$ photoproduction, we identify exact dilaton-null spin-projection channels in the Gottfried--Jackson basis. 自力 EFT 中冲击波散射产生的引力辐射

Gravitational Radiation from Shockwave Scattering in the Self-Force EFT

Emanuele Rosi · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在自力有效场论（EFT）中研究两个无自旋物体的高能碰撞，其中取一个物体为无质量且高能，从而产生引力冲击波（GSW）背景。GSW 受到第二个物体的微扰；第二个物体可以无质量或有质量，分别满足 $E_2/E_1\ll1$ 或 $m_2/E_1\ll1$。尽管冲击波的自力展开依赖于参考系，我们自由选择一个使该 EFT 展现其威力的参考系，得到在牛顿常数所有阶上有效的结果，并使潜在的重新求和模式变得明显。具体而言，我们将展开推进到 1SF 阶，并证明所谓反冲算符在光锥规范中到所有阶都为零。我们得到冲击波背景上的精确引力子传播子，与先前结果一致，并用它计算动量空间中 1SF 阶的在壳波形，专门针对无质量-无质量碰撞。该波形计算到后闵可夫斯基（即弱场）展开的所有阶。在跨普朗克区域，其重新求和形式被证明给出紫外有限的辐射能量角谱。

English: We investigate the high-energy collision of two spinless bodies within the Self-Force Effective Field Theory (EFT), taking one of them to be massless and highly energetic, such that it generates a gravitational shockwave (GSW) background. The GSW is perturbed by the second body, either massless or massive, satisfying respectively $E_2/E_1\ll1$ or $m_2/E_1\ll1$. Although the Self-Force expansion for shockwaves is frame-dependent, we freely choose a frame in which this EFT manifests its power, obtaining results valid to all orders in Newton's constant that make the underlying resummation patterns evident. Specifically, we push the expansion to 1SF order and prove the all-order vanishing of the so-called recoil operators in light-cone gauge. We obtain the exact graviton propagator on the shockwave background, matching previous results, and use it to compute the on-shell waveform at 1SF order in momentum space, specialising to the massless-massless collision. The waveform is computed to all orders in the Post-Minkowskian, or weak-field, expansion. In the trans-Planckian regime, its resummed form is proved to yield a UV-finite angular spectrum of radiated energy.

一句话导读：在自力 EFT 框架下计算冲击波背景上的引力辐射波形，推进到 1SF 阶并给出后闵可夫斯基全阶重求和，证明跨普朗克角谱紫外有限。

Disformal 映射：分类与奇异动力学

Disformal Maps: Classification and Singular Dynamics

Mohammad Ali Gorji, Pavel Jirou\v{s}ek, Alexander Vikman, Masahide Yamaguchi · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在不对引力系统场内容作假设的情况下，考虑四维洛伦兹流形上度规的一般 disformal 变换 g_{\mu\nu}=C h_{\mu\nu}+D t_{\mu\nu}。利用 Cayley-Hamilton 定理，我们导出逆 disformal 度规的显式公式。采用 Hawking-Ellis 分类，我们根据可能的 Jordan 块结构将 disformal 变换分为 I、II、III、IV 四类。进一步由本征值识别 Segre 子类。我们导出 t_{\mu\nu} 的 Cayley-Hamilton 次数、其 Hawking-Ellis 类型与其 Segre 子类之间的显式关系，从而仅由次数限制可能的类型。在某些情形下，甚至无需进行完整 Jordan 分解即可确定类型。对于奇异变换，当新的动力学自由度出现时，我们得到其对应的 mimetic 能量-动量张量 T^\star_{\mu\nu} 的形式。在多项式部分，对于 I 型，t_{\mu\nu} 与 T^\star_{\mu\nu} 的 Hawking-Ellis 类型总是一致。对于 II 型和 III 型，二者可以不同；而 IV 型一般保持，但当复本征值对映射为重复实本征值时，可退化为 I 型。这使得可以直接从 t_{\mu\nu} 的 Hawking-Ellis 类型推断 T^\star_{\mu\nu} 的物理性质。我们将该框架应用于标量场和规范场。我们发现一个新的纯 disformal 标量-规范场族，给出无旋完美流体，包括具有任意常数状态方程参数的正压流体。两个标量场可实现全部四种类型以及从 II 型和 IV 型到 I 型的约化。该框架适用于对不同场内容下可逆与不可逆 disformal 变换的运动学和动力学研究。

English: Being agnostic about the field content of a gravitational system, we consider a general disformal transformation of the metric, $g_{\mu\nu}=C h_{\mu\nu}+D t_{\mu\nu}$, on a four-dimensional Lorentzian manifold. Using the Cayley-Hamilton theorem, we derive an explicit formula for the inverse disformed metric. Implementing the Hawking-Ellis classification, we categorize disformal transformations into four types: Type I, II, III, and IV, based on possible Jordan block structures. We further identify the Segre subclasses from the eigenvalues. We derive explicit relations between the Cayley-Hamilton degree of $t_{\mu\nu}$, its Hawking-Ellis type, and its Segre subclass, restricting the possible types from the degree alone. In some cases, the type can be determined without even performing a full Jordan decomposition. For singular transformations, when new dynamical degrees of freedom emerge, we obtain the form of their corresponding mimetic energy-momentum tensor $T^\star_{\mu\nu}$. Within the polynomial sector, the Hawking-Ellis types of $t_{\mu\nu}$ and $T^\star_{\mu\nu}$ always coincide for Type I. For Types II and III it can differ, while Type IV is preserved generically but can reduce to Type I when the complex pair is mapped to a repeated real eigenvalue. This makes it possible to infer physical properties of $T^\star_{\mu\nu}$ directly from the Hawking-Ellis type of $t_{\mu\nu}$. We apply our setup to scalar and gauge fields. We find a new pure-disformal scalar-gauge family yielding irrotational perfect fluids, including barotropic fluids with an arbitrary constant equation-of-state parameter. Two scalar fields realize all four types and the reductions from Types II and IV to Type I. This framework applies to the kinematical and dynamical study of invertible and non-invertible disformal transformations with different field content.

一句话导读：利用 Hawking-Ellis 分类系统分类一般 disformal 度规变换，并分析奇异变换中新自由度的有效能量-动量张量及其在标量/规范场中的实现。

Kuang-Hung Chou · quant-ph, cond-mat.stat-mech, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在一维临界性中，纠缠熵通常遵循 Calabrese-Cardy 标度。然而，在本文研究的非厄米临界自由费米子系统中，我们发现了一个额外的与区间无关的贡献 S_res=log(ΔL)，它使熵在有限尺寸尺度以下仍对能隙敏感，Δ<1/L。我们将该项称为残余熵。为了理解其红外起源，我们考察了环上的有限深度非酉连续多尺度纠缠重正化（MERA）。在奇异末层之前终止临界 RG 线路会留下一个两格点红外态。我们直接从其关联矩阵计算该态的熵，并重现了相同的 log(ΔL) 依赖关系。涌现的 de Sitter 几何提供了一种互补的几何解释：与不同边界区间相关的极值曲线延伸到共同的红外端点，这暗示保留在那里的纠缠如何能对它们的熵做出同等贡献。

English: Entanglement entropy at one-dimensional criticality typically follows the Calabrese--Cardy scaling. In the non-Hermitian critical free-fermion systems studied here, however, we find an additional interval-independent contribution $S_{\rm res}=\log(\Delta L)$, which allows the entropy to remain sensitive to energy gaps below the finite-size scale, $\Delta<1/L$. We refer to this term as the residual entropy. To understand its infrared origin, we examine finite-depth non-unitary continuous multiscale entanglement renormalization on a ring. Terminating the critical RG circuit before its singular final layer leaves a two-site infrared state. We calculate the entropy of this state directly from its correlation matrix and recover the same \(\log(\Delta L)\) dependence. The emergent de Sitter geometry provides a complementary geometric interpretation: extremal curves associated with different boundary intervals extend to a common infrared endpoint, suggesting how the entanglement retained there can contribute equally to their entropies.

一句话导读：在非厄米临界自由费米子中，纠缠熵出现与区间无关的残余项 log(ΔL)，并可由终止的 MERA 与 de Sitter RT 极值曲线共同解释。

中文摘要：受近期基于速度匹配对黑洞—暗物质解的驳斥的启发，我们通过将暗物质晕密度直接作为爱因斯坦场方程中的能量密度源来重构时空。我们得到一个精确的静态球对称黑洞解，并研究晕对其几何、光学性质、准正规模与热力学的影响。利用零测地线，我们表明晕会修改光子轨迹、移动圆光子轨道并增大光子球与表观阴影。不稳定零轨道的 Lyapunov 指数进一步决定 eikonal 准正规模，给出晕诱导的振荡与阻尼率显式修正。我们还计算质量、霍金温度、熵、热容与吉布斯自由能以刻画热力学稳定性与相结构。我们发现暗物质晕扩大了热力学稳定域，并引入 Schwarzschild 情形所没有的非平凡相行为，表明天体物理暗物质环境可在黑洞可观测量上留下潜在可观测印记。

English: Motivated by the recent rebuttal of black hole--dark matter solutions based on velocity-matching, we reconstruct the spacetime by treating the dark matter halo density directly as an energy-density source in the Einstein field equations. We obtain an exact static, spherically symmetric black hole solution and investigate the effects of the halo on its geometry, optical properties, quasinormal modes, and thermodynamics. Using null geodesics, we show that the halo modifies photon trajectories, shifts the circular photon orbit, and enlarges the photon sphere and apparent shadow. The Lyapunov exponent of the unstable null orbit further determines the eikonal quasinormal modes, yielding explicit halo-induced corrections to their oscillation and damping rates. We also compute the mass, Hawking temperature, entropy, heat capacity, and Gibbs free energy to characterize the thermodynamic stability and phase structure. We find that the dark matter halo enlarges the domain of thermodynamic stability and introduces nontrivial phase behavior absent in the Schwarzschild case, demonstrating that astrophysical dark matter environments can leave potentially observable imprints on black hole observables.

一句话导读：将暗物质晕密度作为爱因斯坦方程源，构造精确静态球对称黑洞解并研究其光线追踪、eikonal QNM 与热力学效应。

Binary Black Hole Coalescence and the Dynamics of Scalar Hair in Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar Theory

Jean Pierre D\'iaz, P. A. Gonz\'alez, Eleftherios Papantonopoulos, Yerko V\'asquez · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们使用数值相对论研究 Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar (EMS) 理论中带电双黑洞的正面并合。双黑洞由带电穿刺初始数据构建，代表两个浸没在纯动能标量扰动中的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞：标量场初始为零，而其共轭动量提供不稳定性的一小种子。我们演化耦合的引力、电磁与标量部分，并监测表观视界、辐射以及视界上的标量场。模拟表明，非最小电磁-标量耦合可以在单个黑洞初始无标量毛发时动态触发标量毛发生长。随后的演化依赖于耦合参数 α0 和残余黑洞的荷质比。对于弱耦合，或当并合后电荷抵消抑制电磁源时，标量场被辐射掉或被最终视界吸收，系统动态去标量化。对于足够强的耦合且残余电荷非零，标量场保持有限，最终黑洞趋近标量化位形。对于具有相等荷质比 q1=q2=0.1 的双星，我们的模拟识别出 1900<α0<2000 之间的过渡区域，将去标量化与标量化残余分开。并合还激发标量辐射，其时间剖面在碰撞非线性阶段与主导引力波模式定性相关。这些结果为 EMS 理论中的标量化/去标量化转变提供了双星实现，并表明标量毛发的命运由标量耦合与残余黑洞电荷含量之间的相互作用控制。

English: We investigate the head-on coalescence of charged binary black holes in Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar (EMS) theory using numerical relativity. The binaries are built from charged puncture initial data representing two Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes immersed in a purely kinetic scalar perturbation: the scalar field initially vanishes, while its conjugate momentum provides a small seed for the instability. We evolve the coupled gravitational, electromagnetic, and scalar sectors and monitor the apparent horizons, the emitted radiation, and the scalar field on the horizons. Our simulations show that the nonminimal electromagnetic-scalar coupling can dynamically trigger the growth of scalar hair even when the individual black holes are initially scalar-free. The subsequent evolution depends on the coupling parameter $\alpha_0$ and on the charge-to-mass ratio of the remnant. For weak coupling, or when charge cancellation suppresses the electromagnetic source after the merger, the scalar field is radiated away or absorbed by the final horizon, and the system dynamically descalarizes. For sufficiently strong coupling and nonzero remnant charge, the scalar field remains finite, and the final black hole approaches a scalarized configuration. For binaries with equal charge-to-mass ratios, $q_1=q_2=0.1$, our simulations identify a transition region between $1900<\alpha_0<2000$, that separates descalarized and scalarized remnants. The coalescence also excites scalar radiation whose time profile is qualitatively correlated with the dominant gravitational-wave mode during the nonlinear stage of the collision. These results provide a binary realization of scalarization/descalarization transitions in EMS theory and show that the fate of scalar hair is controlled by the interplay between the scalar coupling and the charge content of the remnant.

一句话导读：用数值相对论研究带电双黑洞并合时，Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar 理论中标量毛发因电磁-标量非最小耦合被动态激发或脱去，并受耦合强度和剩余电荷控制。

曲率空间中慢滚暴胀与指数势的解析结果

Analytic results for slow-roll curved-space inflation and exponential potentials

Dimitrios Tsimpis, Govind Venugopal · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们推导了标量和张量原初功率谱的解析模板，用于描述在存在空间曲率时从动能主导过渡到慢滚暴胀的宇宙学。我们的结果扩展了近期文献中的工作，特别使我们能够以解析方式恢复标量和张量的倾斜。我们在此框架下重新审视曲率辅助的单指数模型。在开放宇宙情形中，此类模型的相空间自然包含从动能主导阶段开始、随后进入参数可控的准 de Sitter 阶段的宇宙学。然而，它们不适合这些模板框架，因为其第二 Hubble 慢滚参数在准 de Sitter 阶段仍为量级 1。

English: We derive analytic templates for the scalar and tensor primordial power spectra describing cosmologies that transition from kinetic dominance to slow-roll inflation in the presence of spatial curvature. Our results extend recent works in the literature, allowing us, in particular, to recover the scalar and tensor tilts analytically. We revisit the case of curvature-assisted single-exponential models in light of this framework. In the case of an open universe, the phase space of such models naturally includes cosmologies that start out in a kinetic-dominance regime followed by a parametrically controlled quasi-de Sitter phase. However, they do not fit in the framework of the templates, as their second Hubble slow-roll parameter remains of order one in the quasi-de Sitter regime.

一句话导读：推导含空间曲率时由动能主导过渡到慢滚暴胀的标量/张量原初功率谱解析模板，并指出曲率辅助单指数模型因第二慢滚参数不为小量而落在模板之外。

度规的近视界形变与黑洞不稳定性

Near-Horizon Deformation of Metric and the Black Hole Instability

Shi-Jie Ma, Zhan-Feng Mai, Run-Qiu Yang · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：近期时域分析表明，黑洞稳定性可能对局域近视界几何形变敏感，但其背后的谱机制仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们在时域验证该模型的不稳定性之后，于频域框架内系统研究了静态局域非正扰动下的准正规模谱。我们发现这类形变通常会诱导出一个新的纯虚模式。当形变靠近视界时，该模式的虚部增大并最终进入复频率上半平面，标志着黑洞不稳定性的出现。数值结果揭示了不稳定临界距离与形变强度之间的清晰标度关系。我们进一步在频域中给出严格证明。这些结果表明，长尺度下黑洞稳定性对近视界度规局域形变具有条件敏感性，并建立了一个统一谱框架来理解其诱导的不稳定性。

English: Recent time-domain analyses suggest that black hole stability may be sensitive to localized near-horizon geometric deformations, while the underlying spectral mechanism remain unclear. In this work, after verifying the instability of the model in the time domain, we systematically investigate quasi-normal mode spectra under static localized non-positive perturbations within a frequency-domain framework. We find that such deformations generically induce a new purely imaginary mode. As the deformation approaches the horizon, the imaginary part of this mode increases and eventually enters the upper half complex-frequency plane, signaling the onset of black hole instability. Numerical results reveal clear scaling relations between the critical distance for instability and the deformation strength. We further derive rigorous proofs for our discoveries in frequency domain. These results demonstrate that black hole stability under long scale is conditionally sensitive to localized deformation of metric near the horizon and establish a unified spectral framework for understanding their induced instabilities.

一句话导读：局域近视界度规形变可在频域诱导纯虚准正规模，并在足够靠近视界时使黑洞失稳。

相关度：medium — 直接涉及黑洞准正规模、稳定性与经典引力扰动，匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，但未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

单极子袋的引力性质

Gravitational Properties of the Monopole Bag

Yu Komiya, Fumihiro Takayama · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：轴子宇宙学构成了一类在早期宇宙中具有现象学上丰富对称性破缺的模型。当此类背景中存在单极子时，轴子剖面可能被形变；可以构造由一个位于闭合轴子畴壁内部的中心单极子组成的“单极子袋”态。我们考虑该复合缺陷的引力性质，并提出对于不同的输入参数存在无视界解和类黑洞静态解。对于后一情形，我们将结果作为构建一种新的双荷正则黑洞的第一步给出，因为单极子袋有潜力通过轴子 Chern-Simons 项的奇异电磁性质来规避通常的奇异性引力坍缩并保持非平凡轴子剖面。

English: Axionic cosmologies constitute a class of models with phenomenologically rich symmetry breaking in the early universe. In the case where monopoles are present in such a background, the axion profile may be deformed; it is possible to construct a ``monopole bag" state composed of a central monopole within a closed axion domain wall. We consider the gravitational properties of this composite defect, and propose that there exist both a horizonless and a black hole-like static solution for different input parameters. For the latter case, we present our results as a first step towards a new construction of a dyonic regular black hole, given the monopole bag's potential ability to evade the usual singular gravitational collapse and retain a non-trivial axionic profile by the exotic electromagnetic properties of an axionic Chern-Simons term.

一句话导读：研究了闭合轴子畴壁包裹中心单极子所形成的复合缺陷的引力性质，发现无视界与类黑洞静态解，并将其作为构建双荷正则黑洞的第一步。

在高阶曲率引力中将潮汐形变（Wilson）系数匹配到黑洞 Love 数

Matching Tidal Deformability (Wilson) Coefficients to Black Hole Love Numbers in Higher-Curvature Gravity

Luohan Wang, Luis Lehner, Mait\'a Micol, Riccardo Sturani · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们给出了在高阶曲率引力有效场论描述中，潮汐形变系数（潮汐 Love 数）与 Wilson 系数之间的一致映射。本文聚焦于非旋转黑洞的静态响应与相应 Wilson 系数之间的联系，后者决定引力波信号中的潮汐印记。我们分析了一组对照情形，以识别系统计算和匹配程序所需的关键要素。在此过程中，我们指出了将广义相对论中标准匹配方法应用于高阶曲率引力理论时现有结果的不足。作为显式演示，我们计算了立方引力理论中的相关系数。我们的发现弥合了广义相对论 EFT 扩展中潮汐 Love 数与 Wilson 系数之间对应关系的一个重要空白，此前这一空白尚未被充分探索。

English: We present a consistent mapping between tidal deformability coefficients (tidal Love numbers) and Wilson coefficients in effective field theory (EFT) descriptions of higher-curvature theories of gravity. In this work, we focus on the connection between the static response of a non-spinning black hole and the corresponding Wilson coefficient governing tidal imprints in gravitational-wave signals. We analyze a set of control cases to identify the key ingredients required for a systematic computation and matching procedure. In doing so, we highlight shortcomings in existing results that rely on the standard matching approach used in General Relativity when applied to higher-curvature gravity theories. As an explicit demonstration, we compute the relevant coefficients for cubic gravity theories. Our findings bridge an important gap in the correspondence between tidal Love numbers and Wilson coefficients in EFT extensions of General Relativity, which had not been thoroughly explored previously.

一句话导读：该工作建立了高阶曲率引力 EFT 中黑洞潮汐 Love 数与 Wilson 系数之间的匹配，并指出将 GR 标准匹配方法直接推广时的不足。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞潮汐 Love 数，并在高阶曲率 EFT 下与 Wilson 系数匹配，属于用户列出的‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点方向。

通过四点关联器寻找脉冲星计时阵列中的非高斯性

Looking for non-gaussianity in Pulsar Timing Arrays through the four point correlator

Adrien Kuntz, Clemente Smarra, Massimo Vaglio · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列最近报告了随机引力波背景的强证据。在标准分析中，它通过依赖于脉冲星的傅里叶系数建模，并假定服从高斯统计，因此信号完全由两点函数表征。然而，如果该背景来自有限数量的旋进超大质量黑洞双星，则可能出现非高斯特征，使得确定高阶关联器变得必要。在本工作中，我们计算了四个任意脉冲星位置下随机引力波背景傅里叶系数的完整四点关联器，并确认它是非高斯性的首要探针。结果分为高斯贡献（正比于两点函数的平方）和真正非高斯的连通分量，其非平凡角依赖将 Hellings and Downs 关联推广到四颗脉冲星。该角结构仅依赖于天线方向图函数乘积的平均值，因此预计与背景的具体物理起源无关。我们进一步提出通过推导一个微扰地考虑非高斯效应的边缘化似然，将四点关联器纳入参数估计流程。我们的结果为在脉冲星计时阵列数据中寻找非高斯特征提供了理论框架，为更完整地刻画引力波背景开辟了道路。

English: Pulsar Timing Arrays have recently reported strong evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. In standard analyses, it is modeled through pulsar-dependent Fourier coefficients assumed to follow gaussian statistics, so that the signal is fully characterized by its two-point function. However, if the background arises from a finite population of inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries, non-gaussian features may emerge, making the determination of higher-order correlators essential. In this work, we compute the complete four-point correlator of the stochastic gravitational wave background Fourier coefficients for four arbitrary pulsar positions, identifying it as the leading probe of non-gaussianity. The result separates into a gaussian contribution, proportional to the square of the two-point function, and a genuinely non-gaussian connected component, whose non-trivial angular dependence generalizes the Hellings and Downs correlation to four pulsars. This angular structure depends only on averages of products of antenna pattern functions, and is therefore expected to be independent of the specific physical origin of the background. We further propose to incorporate the four-point correlator into the parameter-estimation pipeline by deriving a marginalized likelihood that perturbatively accounts for non-gaussian effects. Our results provide the theoretical framework to search for non-gaussian features in pulsar timing array data, opening the way to a more complete characterization of gravitational-wave backgrounds.

一句话导读：计算随机引力波背景的四点关联器并给出边缘化似然，为脉冲星计时阵列中搜寻非高斯性提供理论框架。

有限温度下含超子致密物质的多体效应

Many-body effects on dense matter with hyperons at finite temperature

Rafael B\'an Jacobsen, Ricardo Luciano Sonego Farias, Veronica Dexheimer · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在这项工作中，我们首次将多体力（MBF）模型推广到有限温度。MBF 模型在相对论量子强子动力学形式体系中描述核物质，并通过核相互作用耦合常数的场依赖性来考虑多体力。假设核物质电荷中性、β 平衡，且由重子八重态、电子、μ 子和中微子组成，我们研究了模型中控制多体力的参数、三种不同的超子耦合方案（此处也首次引入 MBF 模型）以及温度效应，以描述核物质的基本性质，包括声速、压缩率和绝热指数。我们还通过求解零温和有限温度下的 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，研究中子星和原中子星的质量-半径关系，包括每重子熵和轻子分数固定的情形。我们发现，不同的超子耦合方案在不同程度上软化状态方程，需要不同程度的多体作用力效应来重现观测，尽管这些效应从不为零。我们结果的多维表格已可在 CompOSE 仓库获取，可供天体物理模拟使用。

English: In this work, we present the first extension of the Many-Body Forces (MBF) Model to finite temperature. The MBF Model describes nuclear matter in a relativistic quantum hadrodynamics formalism that takes many-body forces into account through a field dependence of the nuclear interaction coupling constants. Assuming nuclear matter to be charge neutral, beta-equilibrated, and populated by the baryon octet, electrons, muons, and neutrinos, we explore the parameter of the model that controls many-body forces, three different hyperon coupling schemes (also introduced here for the first time in the MBF Model), and temperature effects to describe basic properties of nuclear matter, including the speed of sound, compressibility, and adiabatic index. We also investigate the mass-radius relation of neutron and protoneutron stars by solving the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations at zero and finite temperature, including scenarios with fixed entropy per baryon and lepton fraction. We find that different hyperon coupling schemes soften the equation of state to different degrees, requiring different degrees of many-body force effects to reproduce observations, although they are never zero. Multidimensional tables with our results are available in the CompOSE repository, ready to be used in astrophysical simulations.

一句话导读：首次将 MBF 模型推广到有限温度，考察超子耦合、多体效应与温度对致密物质状态方程及中子星/原中子星质量-半径关系的影响。

幽灵机制——早期物质主导时期对标量诱导引力波的增强

The poltergeist mechanism - Enhancement of scalar-induced gravitational waves with early matter-dominated era -

Keisuke Inomata, Kazunori Kohri, Takahiro Terada · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：由原初密度扰动诱导的引力波为宇宙热历史提供了强有力的探针，其中可能包括由动机充分的粒子物理模型所预言的早期物质主导（eMD）时期。当宇宙从eMD时期突然过渡到有压时期（如辐射或动能主导时期）时，诱导引力波可以显著增强。这种增强源于eMD期间密度扰动的增长以及它们在压时期中的快速振荡。该现象被称为poltergeist机制。在这篇综述中，我们解释poltergeist机制的本质，并探讨可能发生这种增强的具体场景。

English: Gravitational waves induced by primordial density perturbations provide a powerful probe of the Universe's thermal history, which may include an early matter-dominated (eMD) era predicted by well-motivated particle-physics models. The induced GWs can be significantly enhanced when the Universe undergoes a sudden transition from an eMD era to an era with pressure, such as a radiation or kination era. This enhancement arises from the growth of density perturbations during the eMD era and their rapid oscillations during the era with pressure. This phenomenon is called the poltergeist mechanism. In this review, we explain the essence of the poltergeist mechanism and explore concrete scenarios in which such an enhancement can occur.

一句话导读：综述：早期物质主导到有压时期的突然转变可通过poltergeist机制显著增强标量诱导引力波。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

动态背景上热环境中的引力扰动集体性质

Collective Properties of Gravitational Perturbations in Thermal Environments on a Dynamical Background

Atsuhisa Ota · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-ph, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：热等离子体会修饰软规范场，使其成为具有等离子体频率隙和朗道阻尼的集体模式。本文追问热辐射等离子体是否对引力扰动产生类似效应。对引力而言，热软标度与哈勃速率重合，因此任何这类能隙都位于视界尺度，此时背景膨胀不可忽略。我们用共形标量描述辐射，并直接在平坦 FLRW 背景上计算其对度规扰动的线性响应。我们利用微分同胚 Ward 恒等式检验该响应。绝热色散关系给出一个有隙集体模式，ω_p² = 8ℋ²/5，其中 ℋ 是共形哈勃速率。然而其频率虚部由背景膨胀主导，并不代表朗道阻尼。在辐射背景中，张量模满足一个实时积分微分方程，可重现 Weinberg 对引力波的阻尼。尽管存在能隙，推迟响应的初始时间边界仍使超视界模在再进入视界前保持冻结。早期分析中发现的超视界增长，源于丢弃推迟响应的记忆以及使用了违反 Ward 恒等式的局域平衡态规定。更一般地，Ward 恒等式禁止超出无碰撞核的任何局域态响应。

English: A thermal plasma dresses soft gauge fields, turning them into collective modes with a plasmon gap and Landau damping. In this paper, we ask whether a thermal radiation plasma does the same to gravitational perturbations. For gravity, the thermal soft scale coincides with the Hubble rate. Any such gap therefore lies at the horizon scale, where the expansion of the background cannot be neglected. We model radiation by a conformal scalar and compute its linear response to metric perturbations directly on a flat FLRW background. We test this response against the diffeomorphism Ward identities. The adiabatic dispersion relation yields a gapped collective mode with $\omega_p^2 = 8\mathcal{H}^2/5$, where $\mathcal{H}$ is the conformal Hubble rate. The imaginary part of its frequency, however, is dominated by the background expansion and does not represent Landau damping. In the radiation background, the tensor modes obey a real-time integro-differential equation that reproduces Weinberg's damping of gravitational waves. The initial-time boundary of the retarded response keeps superhorizon modes frozen until horizon reentry despite the gap. The superhorizon growth found in earlier analyses arises from discarding the memory of the retarded response and from a local-equilibrium state prescription that violates the Ward identities. More generally, the Ward identities forbid any local state response beyond the collisionless kernel.

English: We argue that BF theory with $SO(d+1,1)$ gauge group provides a SymTFT ''skeleton'' for building AdS$_{d+1}$/CFT$_d$ pairs via gluing consistency as the bootstrap principle, loosely analogous to how compact Chern-Simons theory is a TQFT skeleton for rational CFTs. The bootstrap is formulated as presentation independence of physical amplitudes within a universal, defect-closed BF sewing calculus, which includes Wilson lines, codimension-two monodromy defects, and their junctions. The flat BF connection encodes the conformal geometry of the boundary, while Wilson-line path integrals construct candidate quantum-gravity microstates and charge sectors. When the bootstrapped spectrum has a stress tensor, Ward identities naturally connect it to the $B$-field, a relation we call generalized simplicity. In large-$N$, large-gap regimes admitting a gravitational EFT, this motivates the introduction of an effective notion of the $B$-field. In the Einstein limit, this becomes the ''simplicity'' relation used in spin-foam models. Conventional spin-foam models try to obtain gravity by constraining BF theory. We suggest instead that BF theory is the Platonic sewing skeleton, from which theories are to be bootstrapped. Despite the topological nature of the skeleton, perturbative local bulk fields can emerge via Wilson-towers of multi-trace primaries, reproducing their one-loop determinants. We note that the BF Fourier kernel is a suggestive higher-dimensional analogue of the modular-$S$ structure. Because the bulk gluing principle in itself does not require a boundary description, the framework is conceptually broader than AdS/CFT. We sketch how de Sitter space may fit into this picture, with a natural role for observers. Our approach elevates gluing consistency to a universal bulk principle underlying theories of quantum gravity.

English: This work presents a unified inflationary and late-time cosmology, developed within Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity coupled to three scalar fields, governed by a single potential and coupling function throughout cosmic history. Permitting the Gauss-Bonnet coupling to depend on the field content, rather than assigning it arbitrarily, produces a two-phase inflationary scenario: the higher-curvature term initially drives expansion and later becomes a subdominant. The initial super-inflationary stage ends dynamically when the geometrically induced stabilization of the waterfall field fails, at a field value determined by the combination $(n-1)Q$. Coherent oscillations of the waterfall condensate serve as the initial radiation source, replacing conventional reheating and establishing the thermal bath necessary for the subsequent warm phase. Utilizing a two-stage dissipation mechanism with $\Gamma_\phi\propto T^3$, the scalar and tensor spectra are derived while retaining Gauss-Bonnet contributions, demonstrating that the growth of inflaton fluctuations is regulated by the shear viscosity of the bath, which is essential for model viability. A quartic potential, previously excluded in the cold scenario, becomes viable, with $n_s$ within the Planck $1\sigma$ band and $r$ suppressed. Agreement with the spectral index is generic, while internal consistency confines the model to a narrow band in $(n-1)Q$. Finally, the release of the third scalar near matter-radiation equality transforms a very small mass scale into a very large coupling by a logic inverse to the seesaw mechanism. At late times, the inflaton persists as dark energy.

English: We develop a cohomological framework for entanglement entropy that unifies information theory, operator algebras, and noncommutative geometry. The framework accommodates Type III von Neumann algebras, where no local density matrix exists, and leads to a holographic proposal: a subspace of H^1_ent is conjecturally dual to linearized modular Hamiltonian perturbations of the bulk entanglement wedge. Gravitational wave signatures from area metric gravity

Bianca Dittrich · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：面积度规理论已在若干量子引力方案中被提出作为有效描述：作为有效自旋泡沫的连续极限、作为弦论的有效描述，以及在全息语境中。面积度规作用量允许非拓扑的宇称破坏项，这为观测确定 Barbero-Immirzi 参数提供了可能。我们考虑洛伦兹号差下线性化面积度规理论的平移对称版本，它特别出现在自旋泡沫和修正 Plebanski 理论中，并避免了引力子扇区中的鬼场和快子不稳定性。我们讨论该理论的类引力波解，并通过分析其与电磁学的耦合，推导出引力波探测器中的信号。在此类干涉仪中使用偏振光原则上可以测量面积度规导致的双折射。对于伴随引力波的非长度激发，这种双折射结果与 Barbero-Immirzi 参数无关；该参数反而编码在有质量非长度波的极化结构中，在那里它旋转诱导双折射的轴。假设面积度规中的普朗克质量非长度激发，所得信号仍然极其微弱。

English: Area metric theories have been proposed as effective descriptions in a number of quantum gravity approaches: as continuum limit of effective spin foams, as an effective description for string theory and in the context of holography. Area metric actions allow for non-topological parity violating terms, which opens the possibility of observationally determining the Barbero-Immirzi parameter. We consider the shift symmetric version of linearized area metric theory in Lorentzian signature, which arises in particular from spin foams and modified Plebanski theory, and avoids ghost and tachyonic instabilities in the graviton sector. We discuss the gravitational wave like solutions of this theory and through an analysis of the coupling to electro-magnetism, deduce the signals in gravitational wave detectors. Using polarized light in such interferometers allows in principle to measure area metric induced birefringence. For the non-length excitations that accompany a gravitational wave this birefringence turns out to be independent of the Barbero-Immirzi parameter; the parameter is instead encoded in the polarization structure of the massive non-length waves, where it rotates the axes of the induced birefringence. Assuming Planck massive non-length excitations in the area metric the resulting signals are however extremely weak.

一句话导读：在线性化面积度规引力中，引力波与电磁场耦合会产生双折射；Barbero-Immirzi 参数编码在有质量非长度激发的极化中，但预期探测器信号极弱。

相关度：medium — 摘要核心是面积度规修改引力中的线性化引力波传播、电磁耦合与双折射，属于经典/修改引力与引力波现象学；仅提及全息作为理论动机，未进行 AdS/CFT 全息计算。

全息复杂度作为 AdS/BCFT 中边界熵的探针

Holographic Complexity as a Probe of Boundary Entropy in AdS/BCFT

Fabiano F. Santos · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究拓扑量子场论中熟悉的缝合操作如何为半经典 AdS/BCFT 路径积分提供一个有用的组织框架。我们的目的不是将 AdS/BCFT 等同于拓扑场论：体几何、世界末端膜以及 on-shell 作用量本质上仍依赖于度规。相反，我们使用 TQFT 的态制备、取向反转和粘合语言，将界面数据与局部几何贡献分开。对于 AdS3/BCFT2，我们回顾欧几里得 on-shell 作用量和 Ryu--Takayanagi 处方如何在全息重整化后重现 Affleck--Ludwig 边界熵 log g。然后我们在存在世界末端膜的情况下表述 Complexity=Action 计算，仔细区分体、膜、接头和零边界贡献。我们强调，相对 Wheeler--DeWitt 作用量中的有限项依赖于调节器匹配的选择和零边界抵消项方案，除非它们的方案独立性被明确建立。最后，我们将几何构造推广到平面 BTZ 背景，并从 Neumann 边界条件推导膜嵌入。所得框架阐明了全息复杂度的哪些方面对边界条件敏感，以及哪些方面在被解释为普适边界数据之前需要进一步的重整化输入。

English: We investigate how the sewing operations familiar from topological quantum field theory provide a useful organizational framework for semiclassical AdS/BCFT path integrals. Our purpose is not to identify AdS/BCFT with a topological field theory: the bulk geometry, the end-of-the-world brane, and the on-shell action remain intrinsically metric-dependent. Rather, we use the TQFT language of state preparation, orientation reversal, and gluing to separate interface data from local geometric contributions. For AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, we review how the Euclidean on-shell action and the Ryu--Takayanagi prescription reproduce the Affleck--Ludwig boundary entropy $\log g$ after holographic renormalization. We then formulate the Complexity=Action calculation in the presence of an end-of-the-world brane, carefully distinguishing bulk, brane, joint, and null-boundary contributions. We emphasize that finite terms in a relative Wheeler--DeWitt action depend on the choice of regulator matching and on the null-boundary counterterm scheme unless their scheme independence is established explicitly. Finally, we extend the geometric construction to a planar BTZ background and derive the brane embedding from the Neumann boundary condition. The resulting framework clarifies which aspects of holographic complexity are sensitive to boundary conditions and which require further renormalization input before they can be interpreted as universal boundary data.

一句话导读：本文用 TQFT 缝合框架组织 AdS/BCFT 半经典路径积分，并在世界末端膜存在时讨论 Complexity=Action 对边界熵和重整化方案的依赖。

相关度：low — 与给定重点标签无直接匹配；论文属全息复杂度与 AdS/BCFT 基础方法，侧重边界熵、重整化方案和世界末端膜，而非全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜或经典引力现象。

AdS$_3$-Vaidya 中的全息多体纠缠动力学

Holographic multipartite entanglement dynamics in AdS$_3$-Vaidya

Xin-Xiang Ju, Ya-Wen Sun, Yang Zhao, Hao-Ran Zhou · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中全局淬火后的全息热化过程中，多体纠缠如何被动力学地重组。我们首先使用 $n$ 分信息 $(-1)^n I_n$ 来探测全息构型中的集体多体纠缠；在这些构型中，完整的 $n$ 区域纠缠楔是连通的，而所有涉及更少子区域的纠缠楔是断开的，从而排除更少子区域的贡献。随着系统趋近晚期局域热态，多体纠缠的空间范围先扩展后收缩。涉及不同数量子区域的纠缠在可比较的早期时间尺度上发展，而涉及更多子区域的纠缠弛豫得更慢，揭示出从较短到较长空间距离的瞬态传播。我们进一步计算 Markov gap 和真正的三分 multi-entropy，作为三分纠缠的互补探针。Markov gap 在局域热化之后仍可保持增强，而真正的三分 multi-entropy 经历非单调演化，并对本工作考虑的相邻三分划分返回到其真空值。这些结果表明，全局淬火在空间尺度上重新分配纠缠并重组其多体结构。

English: We study how multipartite entanglement is dynamically reorganized during holographic thermalization following a global quench in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$. We first use the $n$-partite information $(-1)^n I_n$ to probe collective multipartite entanglement in holographic configurations where the full $n$-region entanglement wedge is connected while all fewer-party ones are disconnected, thereby excluding fewer-party contributions. The spatial range of multipartite entanglement first expands and then contracts as the system approaches its late-time locally thermal state. Entanglement involving different numbers of parties develops on comparable early-time scales, while the entanglement that involves more parties relaxes more slowly, revealing a transient propagation from shorter to longer spatial distances. We further compute the Markov gap and the genuine tripartite multi-entropy as complementary probes of tripartite entanglement. The Markov gap can remain enhanced after local thermalization, whereas the genuine tripartite multi-entropy undergoes a nonmonotonic evolution and returns to its vacuum value for the adjacent tripartition considered in this work. These results show that a global quench redistributes the entanglement across spatial scales and reorganizes its multipartite structure.

一句话导读：在 AdS$_3$-Vaidya 全局淬火热化中，多体纠缠的空间范围先扩张后收缩，且涉及更多子区域的纠缠弛豫更慢；Markov gap 与三分 multi-entropy 提供互补诊断。

相关度：medium — 论文属于 AdS/CFT 中纠缠/量子信息与全息热化主线，与全息纠缠结构直接相关；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力等具体支线。

局部减除与重整化群单调性：精确的缺陷流与球面流

Local subtractions and renormalization-group monotonicity: exact defect and sphere flows

Francesco Scardino · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们询问：在固定重整化方案中，量子场论的球面自由能在减除其局部抵消项之后，何时会沿重整化群（RG）流单调递减。抵消项固定了减除多项式的必需零点，但仅谱数据的正性并不能决定单调性。对于高斯行列式，一个重标度后的积分热迹的完全单调性就足够了。该条件证明了每个球面 S^p, p≥2 上 Robin 边界流的单调性。一个相关恒等式证明奇数球面 S^d, d≥3 上大质量 Dirac 场的单调性。反之，在所述端点与衰减假设下，从下方趋近红外值排除了每一种保持端点的有限多项式减除。对于这里考虑的双迹族，由球面表面缺陷上的 O^2 驱动，并在大 N 领头阶由 S^3 上的 O^2 驱动，单调减除存在当且仅当 O 的维数分别至少为 1/2 和 (3 - sqrt(37/13))/2。低于这些阈值没有减除是单调的，尽管谱仍为正。相同的行列式描述了 AdS_3 和 AdS_4 中自由大质量标量的双迹边界流，其中这些分类可以照搬。最后，在接触项固定后，从三维共形场论流向有能隙相的流的领头红外球面系数，正比于非负应力张量谱矩之差。在大质量临界 O(N) 模型中，该差值在领头阶消失，并在 N^0 阶为负。

English: We ask when the sphere free energy of a quantum field theory, after subtraction of its local counterterms in a fixed renormalization prescription, decreases monotonically along the renormalization-group (RG) flow. The counterterms fix the required zeros of the subtraction polynomial, but positivity of the spectral data alone does not determine monotonicity. For Gaussian determinants, complete monotonicity of a rescaled integrated heat trace is sufficient. This condition proves monotonicity for Robin boundary flows on every sphere $S^p$, $p\ge2$. A related identity proves monotonicity for massive Dirac fields on odd spheres $S^d$, $d\ge3$. Conversely, under the stated endpoint and decay assumptions, an approach to the infrared value from below excludes every endpoint-preserving finite polynomial subtraction. For the double-trace families considered here, driven by $\mathcal O^2$ on spherical surface defects and, at leading order in large $N$, on $S^3$, a monotone subtraction exists exactly when the dimension of $\mathcal O$ is at least $1/2$ and $(3-\sqrt{37/13})/2$, respectively. Below these thresholds no subtraction is monotone, although the spectra remain positive. The same determinants describe double-trace boundary flows of a free massive scalar in AdS$_3$ and AdS$_4$, where the classifications carry over. Finally, with contact terms fixed, the leading infrared sphere coefficient of a flow from a three-dimensional conformal field theory to a gapped phase is proportional to a difference of nonnegative stress-tensor spectral moments. In the massive critical $O(N)$ model this difference vanishes at leading order and is negative at order $N^0$.

一句话导读：通过局部抵消项减除考察球面自由能沿 RG 流的单调性，精确分类了缺陷和球面双迹流，并联系 AdS 边界双迹流与 O(N) 模型。

Quiver 理论的解耦极限与极端 C 度规的角谱

Decoupling Limit of Quiver Theories and the Angular Spectra of Extreme C-metrics

Peng Yang, Kilar Zhang · hep-th, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究极端带电 C 度规的角本征值问题。从非极端角方程的约束五点 Fuchsian 描述出发，通过在对偶的四维 N=2 SU(2)×SU(2) 线性 quiver 规范理论中解耦一个超多重态得到其极端极限。我们推导参数字典和重整化 Matone 关系，并通过显式坐标变换将物理极限 Q→M 与 quiver 解耦联系起来。正则端点条件给出代数量子化条件。由截断的瞬子预势得到的本征值在近极端和较大加速度下与独立的角谱进行检验。轴对称扇区恢复已知的精确谱。

English: We investigate the angular eigenvalue problem of the extreme charged C-metric. Starting from a constrained five-point Fuchsian description of the non-extremal angular equation, we obtain its extreme limit by decoupling a hypermultiplet in the dual four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$, $\mathrm{SU(2)}\times \mathrm{SU(2)}$ linear quiver gauge theory. We derive the parameter dictionary and renormalized Matone relations, and connect the physical limit $Q\to M$ to the quiver decoupling by an explicit coordinate transformation. Regular endpoint conditions give an algebraic quantization condition. Eigenvalues obtained from the truncated instanton prepotential are tested against independent angular spectra near extremality and at larger acceleration. The axisymmetric sector recovers the known exact spectrum.

一句话导读：通过 N=2 quiver 解耦求解极端带电 C 度规的角本征值谱并建立参数字典。

联系光滑视界延拓、极点跳越与 SL(2,R) 最低权结构的视界-边界字典

A Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary Linking Smooth Horizon Continuation, Pole-Skipping, and $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ Lowest-Weight Structure

Yoon-Seok Choun, Ki-Seok Kim · hep-th · v5 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究 JT/AdS2 黑洞背景中标量场的极点跳越。先前工作建立了局域机制：在极点跳越点，近视界递推关系退化，并留下一个额外正规展开系数未定。我们以这种局域退化为起点，追踪两个在 AdS 边界归一化的独立解，分别记为 R1 和 R2，对应源支和响应支。令 \widehat A 和 \widehat B 表示去掉共同奇异因子后的源系数和响应系数，并令 \chi_\mu 表示普适入射视界因子。我们发现 \[ \widehat A=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_2}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty, \qquad \widehat B=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_1}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty . \] 因此，源零点和响应零点分别对应去掉入射因子后两个边界归一化解的视界光滑性。在整数共振处，局域正规解包含一个额外系数 a_N。在 JT/AdS2 模型中，非共振入射解的延拓固定 a_N=0，从而在共振处选出唯一推迟值，尽管参数空间中的无限制趋近仍路径依赖。在极点跳越格点的端点，响应支是背景 SL(2,R) 对称性的最低权态。一个静态全息超导例子进一步表明，如果两个边界支线性相关，同时的视界光滑性并不充分。因此，双支极点-零点相交要求 \[ W[R_1,R_2]\neq0. \] 这些结果将已知的局域视界退化与边界支及共振视界解空间之间的整体关系区分开来。

English: We study pole-skipping for a scalar field in the JT/AdS$_2$ black-hole background. Previous work established the local mechanism: at a pole-skipping point, a near-horizon recurrence relation becomes degenerate and an additional regular expansion coefficient is left undetermined. We take this local degeneracy as the starting point and track two independent solutions normalized at the AdS boundary, denoted by $R_1$ and $R_2$ for the source and response branches, respectively. Let $\widehat A$ and $\widehat B$ denote the source and response coefficients after their common singular factor is removed, and let $\chi_\mu$ denote the universal ingoing horizon factor. We find \[ \widehat A=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_2}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty, \qquad \widehat B=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_1}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty . \] Thus the source and response zeros correspond separately to horizon smoothness of the two boundary-normalized solutions after the ingoing factor is removed. At integer resonance the local regular solution contains an additional coefficient $a_N$. In the JT/AdS$_2$ model, continuation of the nonresonant ingoing solution fixes $a_N=0$ and thereby selects a unique retarded value at resonance, although unrestricted approaches in parameter space remain path dependent. At the endpoint of the pole-skipping lattice, the response branch is a lowest-weight state of the background $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ symmetry. A static holographic-superconductor example further shows that simultaneous horizon smoothness is insufficient if the two boundary branches are linearly dependent. A two-branch pole-zero intersection therefore requires \[ W[R_1,R_2]\neq0. \] These results distinguish the known local horizon degeneracy from the global relation between boundary branches and the resonant horizon solution space.

一句话导读：在 JT/AdS2 黑洞中，极点跳越的源/响应零点对应去入射因子后边界归一化解的光滑性；共振需非零 Wronskian，端点响应支为 SL(2,R) 最低权态。

八维爱因斯坦引力的共形重整化

Conformal Renormalisation of 8D Einstein Gravity

Giorgos Anastasiou, Ignacio J. Araya, Nicolas Boulanger, Rodrigo Olea, Davide Rovere · hep-th, gr-qc, math.DG · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们证明，八维中的全息重整化（HR）被编码在唯一一个允许具有常负曲率的爱因斯坦扇区的共形引力理论中。我们明确地将 HR 与拓扑正规化（TR）联系起来；后者规定在 Einstein-Hilbert 拉氏密度中加入 Euler 项，并取一个精确系数，以确保所得密度是反 de Sitter（AdS）曲率的多项式。该多项式仍然是渐近发散的。我们发现，上述八维中唯一的共形引力作用量再现了该多项式，并附带额外的边界项，这些边界项抵消了作用量中的发散项。我们猜想，在任意偶数维中，HR 等价于用负宇宙学常数对 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量做共形完备化，再加上由 TR 规定的固定耦合的 Euler 项。

English: We show that Holographic Renormalisation (HR) in eight dimensions is encoded in the unique conformal gravity theory that admits an Einstein sector with constant negative curvature. We explicitly relate HR to Topological Regularisation (TR), where the latter prescribes to add the Euler term to the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian density, with a precise coefficient so as to ensure that the resulting density is polynomial in the anti de Sitter (AdS) curvature. The polynomial is still asymptotically divergent. We find that the aforementioned, unique conformal gravity action in 8D, reproduces the polynomial, together with extra boundary terms that cancel the divergent terms in the action. We conjecture that, in arbitrary even dimension, HR is equivalent to conformally completing the Einstein-Hilbert action with negative cosmological constant, plus the Euler term with fixed coupling prescribed by TR.

一句话导读：八维全息重整化可由唯一共形引力作用量编码，并与引入 Euler 项的拓扑正规化等价；作者猜想该等价性推广到任意偶数维。

O(G^4) 的引力波散射：Murua 构造与椭圆函数

Gravitational wave scattering at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$: Murua construction and elliptics

Yilber Fabian Bautista, Mathias Driesse, Kays Haddad, Gustav Uhre Jakobsen · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们使用世界线量子场论形式，计算了引力波被无自旋点粒子散射的振幅至牛顿常数四阶。对主积分的分解引入 Murua 系数，使我们能够完全绕过将散射振幅转换为 Magnusian 所需的割线减除；后者在分波空间中直接对应散射相移。在此阶次，该过程的动量空间首次出现椭圆函数。为了与黑洞微扰论给出的相移比较，我们提出一种解析方法，可将新的椭圆扇区投影到任意分波阶 ℓ，并验证 Magnusian 与相移的等价性。这表明点粒子世界线量子场论在 O(G^4) 以内准确描述 Schwarzschild 黑洞。

English: We compute the amplitude for the scattering of a gravitational wave off of a spinless point particle at fourth order in Newton's constant, using the worldline quantum field theory formalism. A decomposition of our master integrals incorporating Murua coefficients allows us to entirely bypass the cut subtraction needed to convert the scattering amplitude into the Magnusian, the latter mapping directly onto the scattering phase shift in partial wave space. Elliptic functions appear in momentum space for the first time for this process at this order. To compare to the phase shift from black hole perturbation theory, we present an analytical method for performing the partial wave projection of the new elliptic sector to any partial wave order $\ell$, and verify the equivalence of the Magnusian and the phase shift. This demonstrates that point-particle worldline quantum field theory accurately describes Schwarzschild black holes up to $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$.
