中文摘要：我们研究了重夸克观测量，即静态夸克间势、热自由能和跑动耦合，在五维渐近反德西特（AdS）且平移对称性破缺的时空中。Einstein-Maxwell-axion（EMa）几何包含两个独立标度：控制有限重子密度的化学势 μ，以及控制动量弛豫的平移对称性破缺参数 β。利用有限温度和零温度下的高精度数值计算，我们表明两个标度都会削弱色相互作用并促进强耦合夸克胶子等离子体中的夸克偶素解离，尽管其底层机制不同。化学势主导色屏蔽，并强烈修改重夸克势和跑动耦合，而 β 主要改变等离子体熵，因此给出热自由能的主要修正。在零温度下，热贡献消失，重整化自由能约化为受介质修正的静态势，其形式近似库仑型。在所有温度下，有限重子密度对夸克-反夸克（Q\bar{Q}）对束缚的压制都比动量弛豫强得多。我们提取色屏蔽长度和解离标度，并讨论对重离子碰撞中夸克偶素产生的意义。这些结果表明，静态色相互作用和热力学观测量由不同的介质标度控制，这为稠密耗散等离子体中的重夸克探针提供了一个统一图像。

English: We study heavy quark observables, namely the static interquark potential, the thermal free energy, and the running coupling, in a five dimensional asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime with broken translational symmetry. The Einstein-Maxwell-axion (EMa) geometry contains two independent scales: the chemical potential $\mu$, which controls finite baryon density, and the translational symmetry breaking parameter $\beta$, which controls momentum relaxation. Using high precision numerical calculations at finite temperature and at zero temperature, we show that both scales weaken color interactions and promote quarkonium dissociation in a strongly coupled quark gluon plasma, although the underlying mechanisms differ. The chemical potential dominates color screening and strongly modifies the heavy quark potential and running coupling, whereas $\beta$ mainly changes the plasma entropy and therefore gives the leading correction to the thermal free energy. At zero temperature, thermal contributions vanish and the renormalized free energy reduces to a static potential modified by the medium, with an approximately Coulombic form. At all temperatures, a finite baryon density suppresses the binding of quark antiquark ($Q\bar{Q}$) pairs much more strongly than momentum relaxation. We extract the color screening length and dissociation scale, and discuss implications for quarkonium production in heavy ion collisions. These results show that static color interactions and thermodynamic observables are controlled by different medium scales, which offers a unified picture of heavy quark probes in dense dissipative plasmas.

The AdS boundary conditions (in any dimension) require us to impose Dirichlet boundary conditions on the standard Euclidean axion $\chi_E$. Fixing its asymptotic values on two boundary spheres to $\pm \chi_{E,\infty}$, we find such wormholes to be subdominant to a UV-sensitive endpoint contribution for $\chi_{E, \infty}$ near the real axis, and that (with our conventions) they become dominant only for $\chi_{E, \infty}$ near the negative imgainary axis. Furthermore, such wormholes are irrelevant to our computation for ${\rm Im} \chi_{E, \infty} >0$ (in the sense that the associated ascent contour fails to intersect the contour of integration). The relevance of the wormhole saddle for real positive $\chi_{E, \infty}$ is in fact a matter of choice, as the saddle then lies on a Stokes' line at which the relevant intersection number changes from zero to one.

中文摘要：我们为自旋网络引入一种受张量网络构造启发的富化纠缠结构，其中内部链接可以携带受控且离散的纠缠量。在自旋网络图景中，顶点对偶于单形（更一般地，对偶于多面体），链接对偶于它们的面。标准自旋网络粘合对应于沿一个面完全识别两个单形，由相应链接上的最大纠缠、规范不变的单态实现，而未粘合的面则对应于不携带纠缠的链接。在完全图上工作时，我们通过允许每条链接携带可变纠缠量，将这一二元选择提升为受控且可调的结构，在乘积态与完全纠缠单态之间插值。因此，附加链接变量不仅控制纠缠量，还控制内部链接处规范不变性被保持或破坏的程度，可解释为涌现的边缘模类自由度。在此框架内，自旋网络收缩定义了一个从链接纠缠数据到边界态的体-边界映射。借鉴随机张量网络中发展的技术，我们证明在合适的大自旋区域，该映射在期望值意义下是余等距的，即其伴随在平均意义上保持边界内积，至多相差整体标度因子。限制到由链接有效粘合或打开、并带有围绕此模式的小涨落的构型所定义的码子空间，该映射成为等距映射，修正项在大自旋极限下消失。这在自旋网络希尔伯特空间内给出了全息与纠错特征的离散且具有几何意义的实现。

English: We introduce an enriched entanglement structure for spin networks, inspired by tensor-network constructions, in which internal links can carry a controlled and discrete amount of entanglement. In the spin-network picture, vertices are dual to simplices (more generally, to polyhedra) and links are dual to their faces. Standard spin-network gluing corresponds to fully identifying two simplices along a face, implemented by a maximally entangled, gauge-invariant singlet state on the corresponding link, while unglued faces correspond to links carrying no entanglement. Working on a complete graph, we promote this binary choice to a controlled and tunable structure by allowing each link to carry a variable amount of entanglement, interpolating between product states and the fully entangled singlet. The additional link variables therefore control not only the amount of entanglement but also the extent to which gauge invariance at internal links is preserved or broken, admitting an interpretation in terms of emergent edge-mode-like degrees of freedom. Within this framework, spin-network contraction defines a bulk-to-boundary map from link-entanglement data to boundary states. Adapting techniques developed in random tensor networks, we show that in a suitable large-spin regime the map is a co-isometry in expectation value, meaning that its adjoint preserves boundary inner products on average, up to the overall scale. Restricting to a code subspace defined by configurations in which links are either effectively glued or open, with small fluctuations around this pattern, the map becomes an isometry up to corrections that vanish in the large-spin limit. This yields a discrete and geometrically meaningful realization of holographic and error-correcting features within the spin-network Hilbert space.

English: Motivated by the pseudo-entropy program, we study timelike subregion complexity within the holographic Complexity=Volume framework, extending previous spatial constructions to Lorentzian boundary intervals. For hyperbolic timelike regions in pure AdS, we compute the enclosed bulk volume and show that, despite the Lorentzian embedding, the resulting complexity is purely real under the stated volume prescription. We generalize the analysis to AdS black brane geometries, where the extremal-surface configurations considered may either remain outside the horizon or penetrate it, with the horizon-to-turning-point segment being timelike in the exterior case and spacelike in the interior case. In both configurations, the complexity exhibits the same leading UV-divergence structure as the spacelike case and receives no imaginary contribution when the horizon terms are combined with a common regulator. SymTFT 纠缠与全息（非）因子化

SymTFT Entanglement and Holographic (Non)-Factorization

Ethan Torres, Xingyang Yu · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：给定两个原本解耦且具有共同（有限）对称子范畴的 D 维共形场论（CFT），可以考虑其 (D+1) 维 SymTFT 的纠缠边界态。这大致对应于对两个 CFT 的张量积进行规范操作（gauging），我们称此现象为“SymTFT 纠缠”（简称“S-纠缠”）。当这些 CFT 具有半经典全息对偶时，S-纠缠将两个原本不相连的反德西特（AdS）时空中的体规范荷联系起来，我们在若干自顶向下的例子中强调这一点。我们表明，对此类 S-纠缠态取偏迹可得到一种在弦论中制备系综平均 CFT 的简洁方法。该系综平均与婴儿宇宙希尔伯特空间中由 α-态产生的平均一致，我们提出通过广义整体对称性对该希尔伯特空间作对称性增强的推广。我们定量说明这种由对称性支配的平均如何破坏全息因子化，并导致体整体对称性的涌现。我们还考虑永恒（双侧）AdS 黑洞几何；我们的 SymTFT 纠缠讨论意味着通常的热场二重态制备存在若干精细化。我们表明，可以将系统制备成总 CFT 数据不因子化为左右两份的方式。正如 Marolf 和 Wall 所预期，我们强调此类考虑对于定义永恒黑洞的规范荷是必要的，并且在某些情形下可意味着存在横跨虫洞的延展体对象，而它们不能表示为左右 CFT 算符的乘积。

English: Given two otherwise decoupled $D$-dimensional CFTs which possess a common (finite) symmetry subcategory, one can consider entangled boundary states of their $(D+1)$-dimensional SymTFTs. This roughly corresponds to performing a gauging of the tensor product of two CFTs, and we call this phenomena ``SymTFT entanglement" (or ``S-entanglement" for short). In the case when these CFTs have semiclassical holographic duals, the S-entanglement relates the bulk gauge charges between two otherwise disconnected AdS spacetimes as we highlight in several top-down examples. We show that taking partial traces of such S-entangled states leads to a streamlined approach to preparing ensemble-averaged CFTs in string theory. This ensemble averaging coincides with that generated by $\alpha$-states in the baby universe Hilbert space, and we propose a symmetry-enriched generalization of this Hilbert space via generalized global symmetries. We quantify how this symmetry-governed averaging violates holographic factorization and leads to the emergence of bulk global symmetries. We also consider the eternal (two-sided) AdS black hole geometries, where our SymTFT entanglement considerations imply that there exist refinements of the usual theromofield double state preparation of the system. We show that one may prepare the system in such a way that the total CFT data does not factorize into left and right copies. As anticipated by Marolf and Wall \cite{Marolf:2012xe}, we highlight that such considerations are necessary to define the gauge charges of eternal black holes, and in certain cases, can imply that there exist extended bulk objects stretching across the wormhole which cannot be expressed in terms of a product of left and right CFT operators.

Exact two-loop gravitational tail integrals and their ultraviolet-infrared structure

Gabriel Luz Almeida · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：当辐射从其源的质单极场散射两次时，会出现引力 tail-of-tail 修正。在多极有效场论中，贡献于此过程的两圈拓扑之一涉及真正耦合的圈动量，无法通过嵌套的一圈积分来计算。经过张量约化，这种非因子化结构导致一族特别困难的标量积分，且随着多极阶数升高，分子幂次无界。我们对整个相关整数分子域推导出精确闭式表达式，适用于一般维度，并通过一致的解析延拓相容 Feynman、推迟和超前 prescription。在 d=3+ε 附近，我们还得到至 O(ε) 的显式 Laurent 展开，保留了高阶辐射计算所需的次领头信息。虽然这些展开确定维度极点，但要识别其紫外（UV）或红外（IR）起源，需要另外分析动量区域。我们在整个积分域进行该分析，并直接应用于任意电、磁多极的耦合 tail-of-tail 发射图。由此，我们独立确定 UV 与 IR 留数，并显式验证完整的红外极点结构（包括双极点和单极点）与一圈引力 tail 的指数化一致。将硬动量区域直接算得的 UV 留数与其余图的已知贡献结合，可重现已建立的多极反常维度。

English: Gravitational tail-of-tail corrections arise when radiation scatters twice from the mass-monopole field of its source. In the multipolar effective field theory, one of the two-loop topologies contributing to this process involves genuinely coupled loop momenta, preventing its evaluation through nested one-loop integrations. After tensor reduction, this nonfactorizing structure leads to a particularly challenging family of scalar integrals with unbounded numerator powers as the multipole rank increases. We derive exact closed-form expressions for the entire relevant integer numerator domain, valid in generic dimension and accommodating Feynman, retarded, and advanced prescriptions through consistent analytic continuation. Near $d=3+\epsilon$, we also obtain explicit Laurent expansions through $O(\epsilon)$, retaining the subleading information needed in higher-order radiative calculations. While these expansions determine the dimensional poles, identifying their ultraviolet (UV) or infrared (IR) origin requires a separate analysis of momentum regions. We carry out this analysis throughout the integral domain and apply it directly to the coupled tail-of-tail emission diagram for arbitrary electric and magnetic multipoles. In this way, we independently determine the UV and IR residues, and explicitly verify that the complete infrared pole structure, including both double and simple poles, agrees with the exponentiation of the one-loop gravitational tail. The UV residues, calculated directly from hard-momentum regions, reproduce the established multipole anomalous dimensions when combined with the known contributions of the remaining diagrams.

English: Modifications of gravity beyond (vacuum) General Relativity have a subtle impact on the physics around black holes. Describing these effects across different observables is, however, a priori strongly model dependent. While effective descriptions of the geometry allow to efficiently capture deviations from benchmark predictions, they sometimes lack a clear passage towards (effective) new physics. Inspired by linear response theory, in this work I therefore propose a formalism that allows to calculate leading corrections of observables relative to the Schwarzschild black hole anywhere in space-time (outside of the horizon): the order of corrections is fixed through an eigenvalue $\mathcal{E}$ of the Einstein tensor, which is identified with an external energy momentum tensor that generates the deformation of the geometry. In this ways, $\mathcal{E}$ can be linked to effective physics models. Focusing on spherically symmetric and static black holes, I illustrate the approach at the hand of a number of observables in the vicinity of the horizon, such as characteristic quantities of particles moving around the black hole (e.g. the black hole shadow or the radius of the innermost stable circular orbit) or the spectrum of scalar quasi-normal modes. Reversing the logic, I argue that the knowledge of such observables provides non-trivial constraints on $\mathcal{E}$, which in turn grant insights into the effective physics in the vicinity of the black hole.

Where is the conformal coupling in Palatini gravity?

Alexandros Karam, Sotirios Karamitsos · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究无挠 Palatini 表述中、标量具有普通动能项时的共形耦合。调整曲率耦合不能恢复 Weyl 不变性：在独立且惰性的联络下，标量-曲率项本身是 Weyl 不变的，因此没有有限的曲率耦合可以抵消动能项的 Weyl 变分。这一点可通过在标量运动方程上计算能动张量迹来证明，该迹显式不依赖于 Palatini 耦合。消去联络后，我们构造了曲率耦合与等效度规理论有效耦合之间的映射，并表明即使约化动能系数为零，标量仍会传播。我们还表明，只有在重标度的无穷大耦合极限下，它才成为具有标度不变势的 Weyl 补偿子；在四维中，这与 Palatini R^2 引力直接相关。我们计算了一圈耦合跑动，发现在度规-曲率耦合 beta 函数中的共形移动会在固定度规-仿射背景上产生度规-曲率耦合，而独立曲率耦合则均匀跑动。此外，我们遵循另一种规定，即允许联络响应标量涨落，这导致不同的标量 Hessian，因此 beta 函数不同。尽管如此，我们发现，在正微扰四次耦合情况下，两种规定都通过原始耦合的不同极限，允许形式红外极限 (ξ_eff, λ_eff)→(1/6,0)。最后，我们注意到，从正引力分支出发的轨迹会在该终点之前的有限标度处遇到引力系数消失。

English: We study the conformal coupling in the torsion-free Palatini formulation with an ordinary scalar kinetic term. Tuning the curvature coupling cannot restore Weyl invariance in a Palatini theory with an ordinary scalar kinetic term because, for an independent and inert connection, the scalar-curvature term is separately Weyl-invariant, and no finite curvature coupling cancels the Weyl variation of the kinetic term. This can be demonstrated by evaluating the energy-momentum trace on the scalar equation of motion and noting that it is explicitly independent of the Palatini coupling. Eliminating the connection, we construct a map between the curvature coupling and the effective coupling for the equivalent metric theory, and demonstrate that the scalar continues to propagate even if the reduced kinetic coefficient vanishes. We also show that it becomes a Weyl compensator with a scale-invariant potential only in the rescaled infinite-coupling limit, which in four dimensions is directly related to Palatini ${\cal R}^2$ gravity. We calculate the running of the couplings at one loop, and we find that the conformal shift in the metric-curvature coupling's beta function generates a metric-curvature coupling on a fixed metric-affine background, whereas the independent-curvature coupling runs homogeneously. Furthermore, we follow an alternate prescription in which the connection is allowed to respond to the scalar fluctuations, which results in a different scalar Hessian and therefore different beta functions. Nonetheless, we find that both prescriptions admit the formal infrared limit $(\xi_{eff},\lambda_{eff})\to(1/6,0)$ through different limits of the original couplings in the case of positive perturbative quartics. Finally, we note that trajectories starting on the positive gravitational branch encounter a vanishing gravitational coefficient at a finite scale before this endpoint.

无校准 DESI DR2 BAO-超新星约束对距离对偶倾斜的敏感性

Sensitivity of calibration-free DESI DR2 BAO--supernova constraints to a distance-duality tilt

St\'ephane Fay, Mikel Artola, Leandros Perivolaropoulos · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：最近来自 DESI 重子声学振荡（BAO）的测量报告了对动力学暗能量的中等偏好，这对标准 ΛCDM 范式构成了挑战。然而，这种趋势也可能反映当前 BAO 与 Ia 型超新星（SN）数据所预言的哈勃图在形状与偏移之间的张力，而该张力可能暗示连接光度距离 D_L 与角直径距离 D_A 的宇宙距离对偶关系（CDDR）存在破缺。我们通过将对该关系的偏离参数化为 η(z) ≡ D_L / [(1+z)^2 D_A] = α(1+z)^ε 来探索这一可能性，并研究一旦允许 ε ≠ 0，对 Chevallier-Polarski-Linder（CPL）动力学暗能量的偏好会如何改变。使用 DESI DR2 与未校准 SN 数据（Pantheon+、DES-Dovekie、Union3 和 Union3.1），我们发现，在 ΛCDM 和 CPL 中允许 ε 自由变化，会使 CPL 相对于 ΛCDM 的偏好降低，其降低幅度大于加入空间曲率 Ω_k；只有 Union3.1 表现出可比程度的降低。我们还发现，这种偏好降低对替代的 η(z) 参数化是稳健的，并且对于 Pantheon+，在移除 BAO 示踪物或低红移截断后，η(z) 约束仍保持稳定；而对于 DES-Dovekie，一旦移除 z < 0.1 的 SN，该偏好便基本消失。在一项单独的校准分析中，示意性的 Planck 声视界与 SH0ES 绝对星等先验给出 α ≈ 0.942 ± 0.014，量化了在这些假设下的归一化失配。我们还将 CDDR 破缺映射到光子损失与变化 G 情景，结论是宇宙学约束远弱于对这些物理机制已有的约束。

English: Recent measurements from DESI baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) have reported a moderate preference for dynamical dark energy, challenging the standard $\Lambda$CDM paradigm. Nonetheless, such a trend could reflect a tension between the shape and the offset of the Hubble diagrams predicted by current BAO and Type Ia supernovae (SN) data, which may underpin a possible breakdown of the cosmic distance duality relation (CDDR) linking luminosity distances $D_{\rm L}$ and angular-diameter distances $D_{\rm A}$. We explore this possibility by parametrizing deviations from this relation as $\eta(z) \equiv D_{\rm L} / [{(1+z)}^2 D_{\rm A}] = \alpha{(1+z)}^\varepsilon$, and investigate how the preference for a Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL) dynamical dark energy is modified once $\varepsilon \!\neq\! 0$ is allowed. Using DESI DR2 and uncalibrated SN data (Pantheon$+$, DES-Dovekie, Union3, and Union3.1), we find that allowing $\varepsilon$ to vary freely in both $\Lambda$CDM and CPL reduces the CPL preference with respect to $\Lambda$CDM by a larger amount than the addition of spatial curvature $\Omega_k$; only Union3.1 exhibits comparable reductions. We also find that the preference reduction is robust to alternative $\eta(z)$ parametrizations, and that the $\eta(z)$ constraints remain stable under the removal of BAO tracers or low-redshift cutoffs for Pantheon$+$, whereas the DES-Dovekie preference largely disappears once $z < 0.1$ SN are removed. In a separate calibrated analysis, illustrative Planck sound-horizon and SH0ES absolute-magnitude priors give $\alpha \simeq 0.942 \pm 0.014$, quantifying the normalization mismatch under those assumptions. We also map the CDDR violation onto photon-loss and varying-$G$ scenarios, concluding that the cosmological constraints are much weaker than existing constraints on these physical mechanisms.

一句话导读：利用 DESI DR2 与未校准超新星数据检验距离对偶关系偏离如何削弱 CPL 动力学暗能量相对 ΛCDM 的偏好。

广义相对论中的非定常虫洞与物质源重构

Non-Stationary Wormholes and Matter Source Reconstruction in General Relativity

Geov\'a Alencar, Tiago Crispim, Roberta D\'arlla, Ricardo Landim · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究嵌入演化宇宙学背景中的广义相对论非定常虫洞几何。我们采用类似 Simpson-Visser 的时间坐标正则化，对 (n+1) 维 FLRW 度规的时间坐标进行处理，并结合均匀 Cuscuton 场，构造标度因子在原本会出现的初始奇点处保持有限且非零的宇宙学背景。随后考虑两种具体动力学虫洞几何：四维缺陷虫洞和拓扑荷 Perry-Mann 型虫洞。我们表明前者可由势为零的正则标量场支撑，而后者需要模仿物质扇区来支撑其空间结构，二者中 Cuscuton 均支配宇宙学演化。然后我们将分析推广到可分离非定常时空，并推导出一个强烈限制可容许物质源的标度条件。特别地，对最小耦合标量场和非线性电动力学场，该条件消除了静态重构方案中存在的函数自由度。我们表明，在此框架内，无法在同时满足所需光滑性和反射对称性条件的情况下获得规则、渐近平坦的虫洞几何。我们的结果既说明在规则宇宙学背景中构造特定非定常虫洞的可能性，也说明将此类构造推广到任意空间几何时出现的限制。

English: We investigate non-stationary wormhole geometries in General Relativity embedded in evolving cosmological backgrounds. We employ a Simpson-Visser-like regularization of the temporal coordinate of the $(n+1)$-dimensional FLRW metric, together with a homogeneous Cuscuton field, to construct cosmological backgrounds in which the scale factor remains finite and non-zero at the would-be initial singularity. We then consider two specific dynamical wormhole geometries: the four-dimensional defect wormhole and the topologically charged Perry-Mann type wormhole. We show that the former can be supported by a canonical scalar field with vanishing potential, while the latter requires a mimetic matter sector to support its spatial structure, with the Cuscuton governing the cosmological evolution in both cases. We subsequently generalize the analysis to a separable non-stationary spacetime and derive a scaling condition that strongly constrains the admissible matter sources. In particular, for minimally coupled scalar and nonlinear electrodynamics fields, this condition removes the functional freedom available in static reconstruction schemes. We show that, within this framework, regular, asymptotically flat wormhole geometries cannot be obtained while simultaneously satisfying the required smoothness and reflection symmetry conditions. Our results illustrate both the possibility of constructing specific non-stationary wormholes in regular cosmological backgrounds and the restrictions that arise when attempting to generalize such constructions to arbitrary spatial geometries.

一句话导读：在广义相对论中构造并限制嵌入规则宇宙学背景的非定常虫洞，并表明向任意空间几何推广会受到物质源标度条件的严格约束。

相关度：high — 论文主要研究广义相对论中的非定常虫洞、宇宙学背景嵌入与物质源重构，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

Einstein-aether 理论中的黑洞敏感度

Black hole sensitivity in Einstein--aether theory

Morgan Kidnew, Andrew Kovachik, Sergey Sibiryakov · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在 Einstein-aether 理论中数值求解了缓慢运动的 Schwarzschild 黑洞解。利用这些解，我们计算了敏感度参数，该参数在点粒子有效理论中描述黑洞与 aether 场的耦合。我们导出了敏感度对 Einstein-aether 参数依赖的简单解析近似。

English: We numerically find the solutions for slowly moving Schwarzschild black holes in Einstein--aether theory. We use these solutions to compute the sensitivity parameter which describes the coupling of the black hole to the aether field within point-particle effective theory. A simple analytic approximation for the dependence of the sensitivity on the Einstein--aether parameters is derived.

dS 中来自 EAdS 圈的晚期电屏蔽

Late-time electric screening in dS from EAdS loops

Ernesto Bianchi, Sacha Ployet, Charlotte Sleight, Massimo Taronna · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在 dS_{d+1} 上的标量 QED 中，对一般维数和标量质量，利用 in-in 形式的 EAdS 重构（arXiv:2007.09993），解析计算了单圈规范场两点函数。Dirichlet EAdS 规范场获得 Schwinger 型质量，其纵向模式由满足相反边界条件的带电标量复合而成，而 Neumann 模仍受规范不变性保护。在 dS 中，Dirichlet 修正为边界流诱导出反常维度 γ_J，并改变电场的晚期衰减。该体计算复现了 arXiv:2509.18888 的边界多重态重组结果。对 in-in 围道各分支求和给出延迟 dS 气泡核，从而与 Bros-Moschella 框架直接联系。我们建立一条谱 Cutkosky 规则，将该核在 Casimir 平面主系列割线上的不连续性表示为双粒子割，其中两条内标量线均在上壳。虽然完整气泡系数涉及一个 7F6 超几何函数，但该割线坍缩为 Gamma 函数的闭合乘积，并通过色散关系决定核的完整非局域部分。对同一割线作解析延拓可复现 γ_J 的完整单圈结果。在复 Casimir 平面中，圈修正后的 Dirichlet 光子表现为第二叶上的极点，因此自然可解释为一个 dS 共振或准正模，其频率在单圈阶发生移动。

English: We compute the one-loop gauge-field two-point functions analytically in scalar QED on dS$_{d+1}$ for general dimension and scalar mass, using the EAdS reformulation of the in-in formalism arXiv:2007.09993. The Dirichlet EAdS gauge field acquires a Schwinger-type mass, with its longitudinal mode supplied by a composite of charged scalars obeying opposite boundary conditions, while the Neumann mode remains protected by gauge invariance. In dS, the Dirichlet correction induces an anomalous dimension $\gamma_J$ for the boundary current and modifies the late-time falloff of the electric field. This bulk calculation reproduces the boundary multiplet-recombination result of arXiv:2509.18888. Summing over the in-in contour branches gives the retarded dS bubble kernel, making direct contact with the Bros-Moschella framework. We establish a spectral Cutkosky rule that expresses the discontinuity of this kernel across the principal-series cut in the Casimir plane in terms of a two-particle cut, with both internal scalar lines placed on shell. Although the full bubble coefficient involves a ${}_7F_6$ hypergeometric function, the cut collapses to a closed product of Gamma functions and determines the complete non-local part of the kernel through a dispersion relation. Analytic continuation of the same cut reproduces the complete one-loop result for $\gamma_J$. In the complex Casimir plane, the loop-corrected Dirichlet photon appears as a pole on the second sheet and is therefore naturally interpreted as a dS resonance, or quasinormal mode, whose frequency is shifted at one loop.

一句话导读：在 dS 标量 QED 中利用 EAdS/in-in 重构完成单圈规范场两点函数，Dirichlet 模给边界流带来反常维度并改变电场晚期行为，圈修正光子表现为 dS 准正模共振。

相关度：medium — 论文研究 dS 中单圈规范场两点函数、EAdS/in-in 重构、边界流反常维度以及圈修正光子的 dS 准正模/共振解释，与 dS 全息和 QNM 主题相关；但并非经典引力或凝聚态全息强关联方向。

虚部 HTEE：探测临界性与相干性

Imaginary HTEE: Probing Criticality and Coherence

M. Ali-Akbari, M. M. Daryaei Goki · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究了带电渐近 AdS5 黑洞背景中全息类时纠缠熵（HTEE）的虚部，该背景的对偶场论在化学势 μ 和温度 T 存在时表现出临界点。通过将 HTEE 的虚部等同于赝熵的虚部，我们推导出该量的解析表达式，并研究了它在稳定和不稳定热力学分支上的行为。我们发现，虚部 HTEE 在无电荷极限下消失，且完全由非零化学势诱导，标志着初态与末态之间量子相干性的出现。当无量纲比值 μ/T 趋近其临界值时，我们得到虚部 HTEE 导数的逆平方根型发散，并解析提取出临界指数 θ_I=1/2。我们进一步表明，同一指数支配固定化学势下的温度响应。我们的结果确立了 HTEE 的虚部作为强耦合系统中临界性的非局域量子信息探针，并意味着初态和末态在临界点处变得最大相干。

English: We study the imaginary part of the holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE) in a charged asymptotically AdS$_5$ black-hole background whose dual field theory exhibits a critical point in the presence of a chemical potential $\mu$ and temperature $T$. Identifying the imaginary part of the HTEE with the imaginary part of the pseudoentropy, we derive an analytical expression for this quantity and investigate its behavior on the stable and unstable thermodynamic branches. We find that the imaginary HTEE vanishes in the uncharged limit and is induced entirely by a nonzero chemical potential, signaling the emergence of quantum coherence between the initial and final states. As the dimensionless ratio $\mu/T$ approaches its critical value, we obtain an inverse-square-root divergence in the derivative of the imaginary HTEE and extract the critical exponent $\theta_I = 1/2$ analytically. We further show that the same exponent governs the temperature response at fixed chemical potential. Our results establish the imaginary part of the HTEE as a non-local quantum-information probe of criticality in strongly coupled systems, and they imply that the initial and final states become maximally coherent at the critical point.

一句话导读：在带电 AdS5 黑洞的全息对偶中，类时纠缠熵的虚部由化学势诱导，并在临界点以 θ_I=1/2 的指数发散，可作为量子相干性的非局域探针。

相关度：medium — 该文属于全息量子信息与临界性研究，涉及带电 AdS 黑洞、纠缠熵虚部和临界指数；与全息相变主题相关，但不直接匹配所列全息超导、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线标签。

从对称函数与自由费米子证明巨引力子展开

Giant Graviton Expansions from Symmetric Functions and Free Fermions

Min-xin Huang · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：巨引力子展开将超对称指标的有限秩修正表示为包裹 D3-膜指标。我们为四维 N=4 U(N) 超杨-米尔斯理论中两个先前提出的关系给出详细的代数证明。第一个是完整超共形指标的 Gaiotto-Lee 单和展开，通过 Hall-Littlewood 正交性和算子迹的初等计算证明。第二个是带味 Schur 指标的对称双和展开，通过分解其精确的自由费米子模式乘积证明。我们明确了膜指标的解析延拓，并逐项验证求和系数。这两个证明适用于不同的展开方案，并未建立 Imamura 的完整三类展开。我们讨论了该展开以及 Schur 指标模性质所引发的额外物理与数学问题。

English: Giant graviton expansions express finite-rank corrections to supersymmetric indices in terms of indices for wrapped D3-branes. We give detailed algebraic proofs of two previously proposed relations for four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ $U(N)$ super-Yang--Mills theory. The first is the Gaiotto--Lee single-sum expansion of the full superconformal index, proved by Hall--Littlewood orthogonality and an elementary calculation of operator traces. The second is the symmetric double-sum expansion of the flavored Schur index, proved by factorizing its exact free-fermion mode product. We specify the analytic continuation of the brane indices and justify the sums coefficient by coefficient. The two proofs apply to different expansion prescriptions and do not establish the full three-species expansion of Imamura. We discuss the additional physical and mathematical questions raised by that expansion and by the modular properties of the Schur index.

一句话导读：用对称函数与自由费米子方法证明 N=4 SYM 超共形指标和味 Schur 指标的巨引力子展开关系。

AdS2×S2 的几何与全息：迈向场论对偶

Geometry and holography of $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathrm{S}^2$: towards the field theory dual

Miroslava Mosso Rojas, Anayeli Ramirez · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们迈出识别超对称 AdS2×S2 解的超共形量子力学对偶的第一步。我们关注保持八个超荷的 AdS2×S2×CY2×Σ 型 Type IIB 解，其中 Σ 是由 (x1,x2) 参数化的二维空间，并读出其膜内容：D1-D5-NS5 相交，另有 D3 与 D7 flavour branes。我们提出其对偶 N=4 量子力学组织在 Σ 上的二维元胞格点上。也就是说，它由沿 x1 的线性 quiver 的拷贝组成，对应该类 U(1)-不变解；每个沿 x2 的区间有一个拷贝，其秩由相应元胞的 D1 和 D5 电荷给出。其中央荷在领头阶与全息结果一致。我们证明先前工作中构造的 massive Type IIA 超引力 AdS3×S2×CY2 解的 SL(2,R) 非阿贝尔 T-对偶族属于此类，AdS3×S3×CY2 的 SL(2,R)×SU(2) 非阿贝尔 T-对偶也属于此类，并详细计算二者。对二者我们提出引入额外 D3 和 D7 branes 的全局完成。沿 x2，我们将 stretched 在色 branes 与额外 D3/D7 branes 之间的基本弦解释为重子顶点。最后，我们将此提议从非阿贝尔 T-对偶推广到该类中定义函数在 x1 与 x2 中因子化的解，包括 AdS2 与 S2 因子具有相同 warp factor 的解。

English: We take a first step in identifying the superconformal quantum mechanics dual to supersymmetric AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ solutions. We focus on the Type IIB solutions of the form AdS$_2\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2\times\Sigma$ that preserve eight supercharges, with $\Sigma$ a two-dimensional space parametrised by $(x_1,x_2)$, and read off their brane content, a D1-D5-NS5 intersection with D3 and D7 flavour branes. We propose that their dual $\mathcal{N}=4$ quantum mechanics is organised over a two-dimensional lattice of cells in $\Sigma$. Namely, it consists of copies of the linear quiver along $x_1$ dual to the U(1)-invariant solutions of the class, one for each interval along $x_2$, with ranks given by the D1 and D5 charges of the corresponding cell. Its central charge agrees with the holographic one at leading order. We show that the family of SL$(2,\mathbb{R})$ non-Abelian T-duals of the AdS$_3\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2$ solutions of massive Type IIA supergravity, constructed in previous work, belongs to this class, as does the SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times$SU$(2)$ non-Abelian T-dual of AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$CY$_2$, and work both out in detail. For both we propose global completions that introduce additional D3 and D7 branes. Along $x_2$ we interpret the fundamental strings stretched between the colour branes and the additional D3 and D7 branes as baryon vertices. Finally, we extend this proposal from the non-Abelian T-duals to the solutions of the class whose defining functions factorise in $x_1$ and $x_2$, including those in which the AdS$_2$ and S$^2$ factors have the same warp factor.

一句话导读：本文提出超对称 AdS2×S2×CY2×Σ 型 IIB 解的候选 N=4 量子力学对偶，并用非阿贝尔 T-对偶与 D3/D7 flavour branes 给出具体实现。

4d 与 6d SCFT 中来自表面缺陷反常的超对称可观测量

Supersymmetric Observables from Surface Defect Anomalies in 4d and 6d SCFTs

Zi-Xiao Huang, Ma-Ke Yuan, Yang Zhou · hep-th, cond-mat.dis-nn, cond-mat.stat-mech, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究了半BPS表面缺陷对四维和六维SCFT中超对称Casimir能量以及超对称Rényi熵的普适对数项的贡献。利用缺陷反常多项式的等变积分及其到超对称Rényi背景的推广，我们得到这些可观测量用缺陷't Hooft反常表示的闭合表达式。对于四维N=4超Yang-Mills中保持横向旋转的Gukov-Witten缺陷，两个可观测量都依赖于单个R对称反常。对于六维N=(1,0)理论中的N=(0,4)缺陷，额外项来自引力反常。我们提供使用手征代数、五维局域化以及大N全息探针膜的互补检验，而局域手征费米子重现引力反常贡献。该框架也重现六维N=(2,0)理论中的Wilson面结果。

English: We study the contributions of half-BPS surface defects to supersymmetric Casimir energy and the universal logarithmic term of supersymmetric R\'enyi entropy in four- and six-dimensional SCFTs. Using equivariant integration of defect anomaly polynomials and its extension to supersymmetric R\'enyi backgrounds, we obtain closed expressions for these observables in terms of defect 't Hooft anomalies. For Gukov--Witten defects preserving transverse rotations in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = 4$ super Yang--Mills theories, both observables depend on a single R-symmetry anomaly. For $\mathcal{N} = (0, 4)$ defects in six-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = (1, 0)$ theories, additional terms arise from the gravitational anomaly. We provide complementary checks using chiral algebras, five-dimensional localization, and holographic probe branes at large $N$, while localized chiral fermions reproduce the gravitational-anomaly contributions. The framework also recovers Wilson-surface results in six-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = (2, 0)$ theories.

Pablo A. Cano, Marina David, Roberto Emparan, Stefano Trezzi · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在经典的四维渐近平坦广义相对论中，黑洞的静态 Love 数消失。我们研究近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞对最小耦合无质量标量的响应，在近地平 throat 的 Schwarzian 模式强烈涨落的能量尺度下如何改变。此时黑洞作为具有态谱的量子系统响应。其静态响应是一个极化率，由这些态之间的虚跃迁给出。对于 ℓ=0，静态 Love 数因标量的平移对称性而消失，但对于多极 ℓ≥1，静态 Love 数非零：自旋 ℓ 中间态的有限转动能破坏了导致经典结果的抵消。由于 throat 不再具有可供读出潮汐响应的经典几何，我们通过推迟格林函数来定义它，并在 r_+ω 领头阶计算其完整频率依赖。其保守部分需要重整化：近地平理论固定其对数项的系数，并由此产生任何局域项都无法消除的能量依赖，而其有限局域项是四维理论的匹配数据。耗散部分有限且与方案无关。对于 ℓ≥1，当能量低于转动间隙时它在低频消失，而在间隙阈值处对频率变为非解析，并产生晚期 t^{-3/2} 尾。

English: The static Love numbers of black holes vanish in classical, four-dimensional, asymptotically flat General Relativity. We study how this changes for the response of near-extremal Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes to a minimally coupled massless scalar, at energies where the Schwarzian mode of the near-horizon throat fluctuates strongly. The black hole then responds as a quantum system with a spectrum of states. Its static response is a polarizability, given by virtual transitions between them. For $\ell=0$ the static Love number vanishes, by the shift symmetry of the scalar, but for multipoles $\ell\geq1$ the static Love numbers are nonzero: the finite rotational energy of the spin-$\ell$ intermediate states spoils the cancellation responsible for the classical result. Since the throat no longer has a classical geometry from which to read off a tidal response, we define it through the retarded Green's function, and compute its full frequency dependence at leading order in $r_+\omega$. Its conservative part requires renormalization: the near-horizon theory fixes the coefficient of its logarithm, and with it a dependence on the energy that no local term can remove, while its finite local terms are matching data of the four-dimensional theory. The dissipative part is finite and scheme independent. For $\ell\geq1$, it vanishes at low frequencies when the energy is below the rotational gap, while at the gap threshold it becomes non-analytic in frequency and produces a late-time $t^{-3/2}$ tail.

一句话导读：近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞的静态 Love 数在量子近地平响应下不再全为零，ℓ≥1 由中间态转动能破坏经典抵消，耗散响应在转动间隙阈值产生晚期 t^{-3/2} 尾。

中文摘要：通过 Rindler 方法，我们研究 AdS3/CFT2 与平直3/CCFT2 中一般类时间隔的全息时间类纠缠熵（TEE）。TEE 是类时间隔的伪熵。在体时空中，TEE 的虚部来自一条类时测地线，但在 Rindler 图像中该测地线尚未被识别。经过 Rindler 变换到旋转 BTZ 黑洞后，两条类空极值曲线分别位于内视界和外视界上，交换 l_u ↔ ℓ l_φ 可将其中一条变为另一条。我们找到了类时极值曲线的几何意义：一条伸展于两个视界之间的测地线。其长度为 iπℓ，与间隔无关，并且单独产生虚部 iπc/6。我们在平直空间全息中遵循同样步骤，其中类空曲线位于宇宙学视界上，而类时曲线位于宇宙学视界与类时无穷远之间。评估平面上的 CCFT2 中类时间隔的全息 TEE，我们发现与柱面上的情形相反，实部与虚部相等。

English: Via the Rindler method, we study holographic timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) for a general timelike interval in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and flat$_3$/CCFT$_2$. The TEE is the pseudo entropy of a timelike interval. In the bulk, the imaginary part of the TEE comes from a timelike geodesic, but in the Rindler picture this geodesic has not been identified. After a Rindler transformation to a rotating BTZ black hole, the two spacelike extremal curves lie on the inner and outer horizons, and exchanging $l_u\leftrightarrow \ell l_\phi$ takes one to the other. We find the geometric meaning of the timelike extremal curve: a geodesic stretched between the two horizons. Its length, $i\pi\ell$, is independent of the interval, and it alone produces the imaginary part $i\pi c/6$. We follow the same procedure in flat space holography, where the spacelike curve sits on the cosmological horizon and the timelike curve lies between the cosmological horizon and timelike infinity. Evaluating the holographic TEE for a timelike interval in CCFT$_2$ on the plane, we find that, in contrast with the cylinder, the real and imaginary parts are equal.

中文摘要：类时纠缠熵为全息理论提供了有用探针，但迄今缺乏对其类时极值曲线构造背后模流的显式体实现。我们在 AdS3/CFT2 中构造与类空间隔和类时间隔相关的模流，并将该框架推广到 flat3/CCFT2。从边界对称生成元出发，我们显式推导边界模流并将其延拓到体内部，提供了一种将体模流与极值曲线及全息（类时）纠缠熵联系起来的系统程序。对于类空间隔，所得体模流确定极值曲线，其积分线元重现标准全息纠缠熵。随后我们推广到类时间隔，显式构造模流，其不动点重现给出全息类时纠缠熵的极值类空和类时曲线。据我们所知，这是首次显式构造与类时间隔类时极值曲线相关的模流。相同程序随后被应用于 flat3/CCFT2，得到全息（类时）纠缠熵。最后，我们表明本文所得平直空间结果可在平直空间极限下从 AdS3 对应结果恢复。

English: Timelike entanglement entropy provides a useful probe of holographic theoris, yet an explicit bulk realization of the modular flow underlying its timelike extremal curve construction has so far been lacking. Beginning with the boundary symmetry generators, we explicitly derive the boundary modular flows and extend them into the bulk, providing a systematic procedure that relates bulk modular flows to the extremal curves and holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. For spacelike intervals, the resulting bulk modular flows determine the extremal curves, whose integrated line elements reproduce the standard holographic entanglement entropy. We then generalize this approach to timelike intervals, explicitly constructing the modular flows whose fixed points reproduce the extremal spacelike and timelike curves which gives the holographic timelike entanglement entropy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction of the modular flow associated with a timelike extremal curve for a timelike interval. The same procedure is then carried over to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$, which give rise to the holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. Finally, we show that the flat space results obtained in this work can be recovered from their AdS$_3$ counterparts in the flat space limit.

中文摘要：黑洞内部对外部观察者不可见，但其几何可以进入线性微扰的高泛音谱。我们研究该谱如何在解析 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton 黑洞中编码度规与支撑物质信息。将中性旁观场以固定 UV 维度与伸缩子耦合，可在动量响应之外提供一个对物质敏感的通道。对于实端点类空连接，动量响应和质量标号依赖将度规指数与带符号的伸缩子斜率分开。在因果阈值附近，复端点控制谱族：质量剖面趋近共同值，产生一个共享的分式修正，而规则传播保留标号依赖。该机制在无内视界的临界情形下存在，并局部延续到类时内部。外部数值谱支持重构及主导复端点响应。局域标度和探针耦合设定候选响应，而波连接决定它们在外频谱中的印记。

This mechanism is present at criticality without an inner horizon and continues locally into timelike interiors. Exterior numerical spectra support the reconstruction and the leading complex-endpoint responses. Local scaling and probe coupling set the candidate responses, while wave connection determines their imprint on the exterior spectrum.

To do so, we consider an all-derivative order generalisation of the Schwinger-Keldysh EFT of hydrodynamics extended to a four-fold time contour required to capture OTOCs. A crucial ingredient of the construction is a local SL(2,R) symmetry, which has previously been suggested as a mechanism for scrambling. We also derive this exact EFT from the microscopic formulation of the maximally chaotic low-temperature limit of the SYK lattice, thereby determining all transport coefficients for this model. As a novel application, we compute the OTOC of energy currents, find that its exponential growth saturates the chaos bound, and match it to expectations based on a shockwave (or scramblon) effective description. Our work shows that the universality of hydrodynamics degrees of freedom extends beyond traditional time-ordered correlators to more complex observables such as OTOCs.

Microscopic entropy of regular BTZ black holes in 3d Lovelock gravity at all orders

Hikmet \"Oz\c{s}ahin · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们给出了三维Lovelock引力中黑洞半经典熵的微观推导，该理论包含无穷塔正则化Lovelock修正，并包括最近发现的正则BTZ黑洞。在迷你超空间形式中，我们证明约化作用量及其边界项可以以耦合生成函数的形式在所有阶上闭式得到。假设基态由静态黑洞通过双重Wick旋转得到的孤子描述，我们计算孤子质量，并在任意耦合下从不含中心荷的Cardy公式再现半经典熵。随后我们将迷你超空间扩展到稳态构型，计算由boost得到的旋转黑洞的质量和角动量，并验证有旋转时的Cardy公式。

English: We give a microscopic derivation of the semi-classical entropy of the black holes of 3d Lovelock gravity with an infinite tower of regularized Lovelock corrections, which include the regular BTZ black holes found recently. Working in the mini-superspace formalism, we show that the reduced action and its boundary term can be obtained in closed form at all orders in terms of the generating function of the couplings. Assuming the ground state is described by the soliton obtained from the static black hole by a double Wick rotation, we compute the soliton mass and reproduce the semi-classical entropy from the Cardy formula without central charges for arbitrary couplings. We then extend the mini-superspace to stationary configurations, compute the mass and the angular momentum of the rotating black holes obtained by a boost, and verify the Cardy formula in the presence of rotation.

一句话导读：在三维Lovelock引力全阶正则修正下，用孤子与Cardy公式微观再现正则BTZ黑洞半经典熵。

Plebanski 形式的面积度规引力：联络、曲率与动力学

Area metric gravity \`a la Plebanski: connection, curvature and dynamics

Bianca Dittrich · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：面积度规作为若干量子引力方法（包括弦论、全息和圈量子引力）在中间尺度上的有效描述而出现。最近已表明，面积度规作用量可以在线性化层面从修改的 Plebanski 框架导出。令人惊讶的是，这些作用量避免了有效长度动力学传播子中的额外极点，因此构成线性化 Einstein 引力的有趣形变。为了研究该性质是否在完整理论中持续存在，我们在此从修改的 Plebanski 作用量构造非线性面积度规动力学。我们提供不依赖微扰论的面积度规几何工具，并允许系统构造和研究一般非线性面积度规作用量：一种从面积度规提取长度度规的算法，以及一个由面积度规唯一确定的二形式联络，连同其曲率和曲率不变量。我们导出一阶和二阶版本中由修改 Plebanski 作用量给出的面积度规作用量。我们还发现面积度规作用量可以重新表述为 Poincaré 规范理论。我们确定有效长度度规作用量，其在平直背景上描述一个引力子以及一个带有由 Barbero–Immirzi 参数设定的宇称破坏耦合的大质量自旋二场。此外我们讨论宇宙学背景以及物质耦合的作用，它们共同为宇宙学应用开辟道路。

English: Area metrics arise as effective description at intermediate scales in a number of approaches to quantum gravity, including string theory, holography and loop quantum gravity. Recently, it has been shown that area metric actions can be derived from the modified Plebanski framework on the linearized level. Surprisingly these actions avoid extra poles in the propagator for the effective length dynamics, and hence constitute interesting deformations of linearized Einstein gravity. To be able to study whether this property persist for the full theory, we construct here non-linear area metric dynamics from modified Plebanski actions. We provide the geometric tools for area metrics that do not rely on perturbation theory and allow a systematic construction and study of general non-linear area metric actions: an algorithm that extracts a length metric from an area metric and a connection on two-forms that is uniquely determined by the area metric, together with its curvature and curvature invariants. We derive area metric actions from modified Plebanski actions in first and second order versions. We also find that area metric actions can be reformulated as Poincare gauge theories. We determine the effective length metric action, which on a flat background describes a graviton and a massive spin-two field with parity-violating couplings set by the Barbero--Immirzi parameter. Additionally we discuss cosmological backgrounds and the role of the matter coupling, which together open the way to cosmological applications.

一句话导读：从修改 Plebanski 作用量构建非线性面积度规引力，提供几何工具、一/二阶作用量及 Poincaré 规范理论表述，并在平直背景得到引力子与带宇称破坏耦合的大质量自旋二场。

N=2 超对称规范理论的若干方面及其在量子场论与引力中的应用

Aspects of $\mathcal{N}=2$ SUSY gauge theories and applications to Quantum Field Theory and Gravity

Andrea Cipriani · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：本论文研究将超对称规范理论中发展的技术应用于量子场论与引力中的物理问题，重点关注 Seiberg-Witten（SW）曲线及其量子版本。在回顾超对称的基本概念和 SW 曲线的推导之后，我们探讨其在这两个领域中的应用。在量子场论中，我们研究 Argyres-Douglas 理论在超对称模型模空间中的出现，重点关注极值关联函数。我们分析一个共形模型以计算其瞬子修正，发现与有效场论预言一致，并讨论其对 Argyres-Douglas 理论中类似可观测量的意义。在引力中，我们利用量子 SW 曲线及其与描述物理系统的微分方程的关系。我们确立了 fuzzball 提案中出现的 Topological Stars 在大质量带电标量扰动下的线性稳定性。我们还研究了带视界位形中的电荷超辐射，并推导了合流 Heun 函数的一种新超几何表示，其与 Schwarzschild 背景中的引力波传播相关。该结果给出了波形尾部贡献的一种新的重求和表达式，与数值数据高度一致。最后，在 SW 形式之外，我们开发了一种基于哈密顿神经网络的机器学习算法，以复现 fuzzball 几何中中性粒子的测地线。对于临界轨道，我们的方法在效率和精度上均优于标准数值积分器。

English: This thesis investigates the application of techniques developed in supersymmetric gauge theories to physical problems in Quantum Field Theory and Gravity, focusing on the Seiberg-Witten (SW) curve and its quantum version. After reviewing the essential concepts of Supersymmetry and the derivation of the SW curve, we explore its applications in both fields. In Quantum Field Theory, we investigate the emergence of Argyres-Douglas theories in the moduli space of supersymmetric models, focusing on extremal correlators. We analyze a conformal model to compute their instanton corrections, finding agreement with predictions from Effective Field Theory, and discuss the implications for analogous observables in Argyres-Douglas theories. In Gravity, we exploit the quantum SW curve and its relation to differential equations describing physical systems. We establish the linear stability of Topological Stars, arising in the fuzzball proposal, under massive charged scalar perturbations. We also investigate charge superradiance in configurations with a horizon and derive a novel hypergeometric representation of the confluent Heun function, relevant to gravitational-wave propagation in the Schwarzschild background. This result yields a new resummed expression for waveform tail contributions, in excellent agreement with numerical data. Finally, beyond the SW formalism, we develop a Machine Learning algorithm based on Hamiltonian Neural Networks to reproduce the geodesics of a neutral particle in a fuzzball geometry. For critical trajectories, our method outperforms standard numerical integrators in both efficiency and accuracy.

一句话导读：一篇结合 N=2 超对称规范理论、Seiberg-Witten/量子 SW 曲线、Argyres-Douglas 理论，以及 fuzzball/Topological Star 扰动、超辐射与引力波尾部波形的博士论文。

相关度：medium — 论文与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关，涉及 Schwarzschild 扰动、电荷超辐射、引力波尾部以及 fuzzball/Topological Star 稳定性；但摘要未显示 AdS/CFT 字典、全息凝聚态、全息 QCD 等核心全息内容，因此对全息主线相关性为中等。

Euler-Heisenberg-dilaton AdS 黑洞的相变与准正规模

Phase transitions and quasinormal modes of Euler-Heisenberg-dilaton AdS black holes

Yi-Qi Chen, De-Cheng Zou, Ming Zhang, Xufen Zhang, Bo Liu, Rui-Hong Yue · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：本文在扩展相空间中研究磁荷 Euler-Heisenberg-dilaton AdS 黑洞的相变和标量准正规模（QNM）。我们分类了 EH 耦合三种符号下的视界结构，并推导了压力与耦合变化时的扩展第一定律。对于负耦合，物理分支表现出范德瓦尔斯式小/大黑洞相变。利用改进的渐近迭代法，我们发现临界压力以下存在两条分离的 QNM 轨迹，而在临界点它们合并为一条连续曲线。GHS 极限以及本文考虑的正耦合不产生有限半径临界点。

English: In this paper, we study phase transitions and scalar quasinormal modes(QNMs) of magnetically charged Euler--Heisenberg-dilaton AdS black holes in the extended phase space. We classify the horizon structures for all three signs of the EH coupling and derive the extended first law when the pressure and coupling are varied. For negative coupling, the physical branch exhibits a Van der Waals-like small/large black-hole transition. Using the improved asymptotic iteration method, we find two separated QNM trajectories below the critical pressure, whereas they merge into one continuous curve at the critical point. The GHS limit and the positive couplings considered here do not produce a finite-radius critical point.

一句话导读：研究 Euler-Heisenberg-dilaton AdS 黑洞在扩展相空间中的相变及标量 QNM，临界点处两条 QNM 轨迹合并。

Holographic theory of non-invertible gravitational anomalies

Xiao-Gang Wen · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们回顾一种多体表述，将引力反常视为同一维度局域玻色格点量子系统无法实现完整低能数据的阻碍。在此表述中，反常理论可在有能隙的玻色格点体态的边界上实现，其拓扑序给出反常的一一分类。可逆体态重现传统反常流入；具有非平凡拓扑激发的体态给出非可逆推广。为描述反常的全息理论，我们解释唯一确定的拓扑序与多种拓扑量子场论之间的区别，并讨论边界到体态的映射。作为全息反常理论的应用，我们描述局域量子理论（如量子场论）之间的态射。这些态射由体态畴壁和可逆边界结构建，形成三明治图景。手征玻色子/费米子理论、Laughlin 边缘以及具有玻色或费米点状激发的 Z2 高阶规范理论边界，说明了输运系数、超选择扇区和凝聚数据中包含的关于非可逆反常的不同类型信息。特别地，费米子理论可视为具有特定非可逆引力反常的理论。这些例子还揭示出：对称性 ~ 引力反常 ~ 高一维的拓扑序。

English: We review a many-body formulation of gravitational anomalies as obstructions to realizing the complete low-energy data by a local {\it bosonic} lattice quantum system of the same dimension. In this formulation, an anomalous theory can be realized at the boundary of a gapped {\it bosonic} lattice bulk, whose topological order gives a one-to-one classification of the anomaly. An invertible bulk reproduces conventional anomaly inflow; a bulk with non-trivial topological excitations yields a non-invertible generalization. To describe the holographic theory of anomalies, we explain the distinction between uniquely defined topological order and many versions of topological quantum field theory and discuss the boundary-to-bulk map. As an application of the holographic theory of anomalies, we describe morphisms between local quantum theories (such as quantum field theories). These morphisms are built from a bulk domain wall and an invertible boundary junction, which give rise to a sandwich picture. Chiral boson/fermion theory, Laughlin edges, and boundaries of $\mathbb{Z}_2$ higher gauge theory with bosonic or fermionic point-like excitations illustrate the different kinds of information about non-invertible anomalies contained in transport coefficients, superselection sectors, and condensation data. In particular, a fermionic theory can be viewed as a theory with a particular non-invertible gravitational anomaly. Those examples also reveal that {\it symmetry $\sim$ gravitational anomaly $\sim$ topological order in one higher dimension}.

一句话导读：综述将引力反常视为边界全息障碍，并用高一维玻色拓扑序分类，包括非可逆推广与局域量子理论之间的态射。

带毛黑膜的带电形变：微扰解与热力学

Charged Deformation of a Hairy Black Brane: Perturbative Solution and Thermodynamics

Sangheon Yun · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究四维 Einstein-Maxwell-scalar 理论中的带电黑膜，其 Maxwell 耦合为 Z(φ)=e^{3φ/√7}，势能只在红外存在一个 AdS4 固定点。对于非零 hair 参数 α，标量在大半径处对数增长，几何不是渐近 AdS，因此全息字典是一个工作假设。在中性黑膜的尺度不变 multi-trace 边界条件下（给出共形热力学），我们在电荷的二阶展开，得到闭式的 Maxwell 场和磁化率，以及热力学、凝聚、非相干电导和累积量比 T^2χ4/χ2=6c(α)<0（对所有考虑的 α）。独立微扰计算和第一定律闭式在 4×10^{-6} 内一致；非线性解重现二阶结果到 1.2×10^{-5}，c 到 6×10^{-4}。在构造的范围内它们局部热力学稳定，且压力在零密度附近对 (μ_Q/T)^2 解析。在有限标量值处不存在规则极端视界，且精确有 ρ/s<√21/(2π)。极端极限是一个 AdS2×R^2 喉，其中标量在 AdS2 径向坐标 u 中按 ln ln(1/u) 增长；该界在那里饱和，极端值以 1/ln(μ_Q/T) 的幂次逼近。对标的源采用 Dirichlet 条件时，同样的解描述一个标度为 Λ 的非共形理论，其带电黑膜只存在于 T_max(μ_Q) 以下，T_max 从零密度处的 0.194Λ 降到 μ_Q=0.506Λ 处的零。这个边界是一个扩散不稳定性，在非零密度处电荷磁化率发散，且体粘滞在所有密度下违反 Buchel 界。满足大半径归一化条件的准正规模重现其流体力学。

English: We study electrically charged black branes in four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell-scalar theory with Maxwell coupling $Z(\phi)=e^{3\phi/\sqrt7}$, whose potential has an AdS$_4$ fixed point only in the infrared. For nonzero hair parameter $\alpha$ the scalar grows logarithmically at large radius and the geometry is not asymptotically AdS, so the holographic dictionary is a working assumption. With the scale-invariant multi-trace boundary condition of the neutral branes, giving conformal thermodynamics, we work to second order in the charge, obtaining the Maxwell field and susceptibility in closed form, plus the thermodynamics, condensate, incoherent conductivity and cumulant ratio $T^2\chi_4/\chi_2=6c(\alpha)<0$ for all $\alpha$ considered. Independent perturbative computations and first-law closed forms agree within $4\times10^{-6}$; nonlinear solutions reproduce second-order results to $1.2\times10^{-5}$ and $c$ to $6\times10^{-4}$. They are locally thermodynamically stable where constructed, and the pressure is analytic in $(\mu_Q/T)^2$ near zero density. No regular extremal horizon exists at finite scalar value, and $\rho/s<\sqrt{21}/(2\pi)$ exactly. The extremal limit is an AdS$_2\times\mathbb R^2$ throat where the scalar grows as $\ln\ln(1/u)$ in the AdS$_2$ radial coordinate $u$; the bound is saturated there, and extremal values are approached as powers of $1/\ln(\mu_Q/T)$. With a Dirichlet condition on the scalar source, the same solutions describe a non-conformal theory with scale $\Lambda$, whose charged branes exist only below $T_{\max}(\mu_Q)$, which falls from $0.194\Lambda$ at zero density to zero at $\mu_Q=0.506\Lambda$. This boundary is a diffusive instability where the charge susceptibility diverges at nonzero density, and the bulk viscosity violates Buchel's bound at all densities. Quasinormal modes with the normalizable large-radius condition reproduce its hydrodynamics.

A critical coupling for the magnetic instability of holographic SU(2) plasmas

Migael Strydom · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们表明引力可以消除具有 SU(2) 整体对称性的全息等离子体的线性磁不稳定性。在探针极限下，带电矢量玻色子在最低朗道能级中于临界磁场以上变成快子，并凝聚为涡旋晶格。在 AdS5 中的 Einstein-SU(2) Yang-Mills 理论中，我们精确地包含场的反作用，仅围绕 D'Hoker-Kraus 磁膜按凝聚展开。当耦合 α = κ^2/\hat g^2 趋近 α_* = 2/3 时，临界场发散；在此之上，正常相在任何场或温度下都没有线性带电不稳定性：我们在零温下证明这一点，并在有限温下通过数值方法确立。零温下，磁场从膜 AdS3 × R2 喉部最低朗道能级的质量中消去，该不稳定性是喉部 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界被破坏。起始温度在 α_* 处消失，并具有 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 类型的本质奇异性。对于 d=4、5、6 维的两导数 Einstein-Yang-Mills 对偶，正常相具有带电不稳定性当且仅当 C_J/C_T < 8/(d^2(d+1))，在 d=4 时为十分之一。当 α > α_L = 0.372 时，涡旋之间的引力吸引使均匀晶格不稳定，转变变为一级，因此 B_c 只是旋节线；在 α_* 以上是否仍有凝聚相仍留待解决。

English: We show that gravity can remove the linear magnetic instability of a holographic plasma with an $SU(2)$ global symmetry. In the probe limit, charged vector bosons become tachyonic in their lowest Landau level above a critical field and condense into a vortex lattice. In Einstein-$SU(2)$ Yang-Mills theory in AdS$_5$ we include the backreaction of the field exactly, expanding only in the condensate around the D'Hoker-Kraus magnetic brane. The critical field diverges as the coupling $\alpha = \kappa^2/\hat g^2$ approaches $\alpha_\star = 2/3$, above which the normal phase has no linear charged instability at any field or temperature: we show this at zero temperature and establish it numerically at finite temperature. At zero temperature the field cancels from the mass of the lowest Landau level in the brane's AdS$_3 \times \mathbb{R}^2$ throat, and the instability is a violation of the throat's Breitenlohner-Freedman bound. The onset temperature vanishes at $\alpha_\star$ with an essential singularity of Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless type. For two-derivative Einstein-Yang-Mills duals in $d = 4$, 5 and 6 dimensions the normal phase has a charged instability if and only if $C_J/C_T < 8/(d^2(d+1))$, one tenth in $d = 4$. Above $\alpha_L = 0.372$ the gravitational attraction between vortices makes the uniform lattice unstable and the transition first order, so $B_c$ is only a spinodal; whether a condensed phase survives above $\alpha_\star$ is left open.

一句话导读：在 AdS5 Einstein-SU(2) Yang-Mills 中，精确反作用显示当耦合 α 超过 2/3 时全息 SU(2) 等离子体的磁不稳定性被引力消除，且涡旋晶格在 α_L≈0.372 以上变为一级转变。

Bondi Four-Momentum Balance in Quantum NSF Classical matching, DKL supermomentum, and quantum energy redistribution

Carlos Kozameh, Gerardo DEpaola · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们推导了零曲面表述（NSF）辐射相空间中过去与未来零无穷之间的 Bondi 四动量平衡。空间无穷处的 Weyl 匹配，加上端点 News 消失，给出 Bondi 质量 aspect 的对跖连续性。其平移投影不依赖于红外剪切项，并作为 Lorentz 四维矢量变换。Bondi 演化将入射和出射 News 通量与类时端点动量联系起来；在 Dominguez--Kozameh--Ludvigsen 辐射扇区中这些动量消失，通量相等。在共同辐射 Fock 域上，幺正共轭输运通量可观测量。采用其经典平衡作为额外量子条件，得到排他性四动量守恒。我们也在不施加该条件时计算出射能量期望。对于入射能量本征态，第二生成元对易子对角消失，留下由三次生成元决定的二阶系数。直接正则收缩分离出与所有四个外腿相关的贡献。对于等能量质心制备，轴向旋转协变性迫使角积分交换系数在 Part I 的有限螺旋度投影规定下消失。因此连通能量缺陷到二阶消失。完整期望（包括旁观者）和更高阶平衡仍待解决。

English: We derive Bondi four-momentum balance between past and future null infinity in the radiative phase space of the null-surface formulation (NSF). Weyl matching at spatial infinity, together with vanishing endpoint News, gives antipodal continuity of the Bondi mass aspect. Its translation projection is independent of the infrared shear term and transforms as a Lorentz four-vector. Bondi evolution relates the incoming and outgoing News fluxes to the timelike endpoint momenta; in the Dominguez--Kozameh--Ludvigsen radiative sector these momenta vanish and the fluxes are equal. On a common radiative Fock domain, unitary conjugation transports the flux observables. Adopting their classical balance as an additional quantum condition yields exclusive four-momentum conservation. We also calculate the outgoing energy expectation without imposing that condition. For an incoming energy eigenstate, the second-generator commutator vanishes diagonally, leaving a second-order coefficient determined by the cubic generator. Direct canonical contractions isolate the contribution connected to all four external legs. For the equal-energy center-of-mass preparation, axial rotational covariance forces the angularly integrated exchange coefficient to vanish under the finite helicity-projection prescription of Part~I. The connected energy defect therefore vanishes through second order. The full expectation (including spectators) and higher-order balance remain open.

用于 N=2* 全息的物理信息神经网络

PINNs for N=2* holography

Alex Buchel · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：全息理论能否从其状态方程重建？我们在 Pilch-Warner 模型的玻色质量扇区中使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）研究这一问题。我们首先用一个解析解验证 PINN 方法，该解析解编码了共形状态方程的高温领头修正。随后，我们利用热力学、紫外渐近、Ward 恒等式和视界正则性重建非线性黑膜几何与标量势。体 Einstein-标量方程的独立解表明，用训练后的 PINN 准确复现热力学并不能保证准确重建标量势。对高温状态方程的高精度知识会约束体标量势中的非线性相互作用。将三次耦合固定到其精确 PW 值（由该高温提取所激励），与仅约束体标量质量相比，可使重建的标量自相互作用最大采样误差降低约 15 倍。进一步加入规范理论等离子体体粘滞的知识后，该误差再降低约 13 倍，独立前向解在 0.09% 以内复现体粘滞。

English: Can a holographic theory be reconstructed from its equation of state? We investigate this question using physics-informed neural networks in the bosonic-mass sector of the Pilch--Warner model. We first validate the PINN approach against an analytic solution encoding the leading high-temperature corrections to the conformal equation of state. We then reconstruct nonlinear black-brane geometries and the scalar potential using thermodynamics, ultraviolet asymptotics, Ward identities, and horizon regularity. Independent solutions of the bulk Einstein-scalar equations demonstrate that accurately reproducing thermodynamics with a trained PINN does not guarantee an accurate reconstruction of the scalar potential. High-precision knowledge of the high-temperature equation of state constrains nonlinear interactions in the bulk scalar potential. Fixing the cubic coupling to its exact PW value, motivated by this high-temperature extraction, reduces the maximum sampled error in the reconstructed scalar self-interactions by a factor of $\sim 15$ compared with constraining only the bulk scalar mass. Adding knowledge of the bulk viscosity of the gauge theory plasma further reduces this error by an additional factor of $\sim 13$, with independent forward solutions reproducing the bulk viscosity within $0.09\%$.

非最小耦合厚膜的特征模式

Characteristic Modes of Non-minimally Coupled Thick Branes

Jing-Xin Gong, Heng Guo, Yong-Tao Lu, Xin-Yi Pan · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ex · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：特征模式提供了关于引力系统内在性质和动力学响应的重要信息。在本工作中，我们研究具有非最小耦合体标量场的厚膜的特征模式。考虑了两个代表性的厚膜解，分别对应单扭结标量构型和具有内部结构的形变扭结构型。通过分析张量扰动方程，我们首先考察两个膜模型中引力子零模的局域化。对于这两个膜模型，引力子零模都局域在膜上。在 ξ=1/7 的单扭结膜中没有发现明显的共振 Kaluza--Klein (KK) 模。对于形变膜，我们研究 ξ=0.99 时的共振 KK 模，发现增加形变参数 k 会导致更多共振模以及寿命更长的第一共振。然后我们在频域和时域中分别计算两个膜模型的准正规模式 (QNM)。由独立方法得到的准正规频率 (QNF) 在低阶 overtone 上符合得很好。共振 KK 模的质量和衰减率分别与相应 QNF 的实部和虚部大小密切吻合。

English: Characteristic modes provide important information about the intrinsic properties and dynamical response of gravitational systems. In this work, we investigate characteristic modes of thick branes with a non-minimally coupled bulk scalar field. Two representative thick brane solutions are considered, corresponding to a single-kink scalar configuration and a deformed kink configuration with internal structure, respectively. By analyzing the tensor perturbation equations, we first examine the localization of the graviton zero mode in the two brane models. For both brane models, the graviton zero mode is localized on the brane. No pronounced resonant Kaluza--Klein (KK) modes are found for the single-kink brane at $\xi=1/7$. For the deformed brane, we investigate the resonant KK modes at $\xi=0.99$, finding that increasing the deformation parameter $k$ leads to more resonant modes and a longer-lived first resonance. We then calculate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of both brane models independently in the frequency and time domains. The quasinormal frequencies (QNFs) obtained by the independent methods agree well for the low overtones. The masses and decay rates of the resonant KK modes agree closely with the real parts and the magnitudes of the imaginary parts of the corresponding QNFs, respectively.

一句话导读：分析非最小耦合厚膜中引力子零模局域化、共振 KK 模与 QNM，发现形变参数增加会增强共振，且 KK 模与 QNM 特征吻合。

G2 通量紧化的三维真空

Three-dimensional vacua of $G_2$ flux compactifications

Aravind Aikot, Julian Choi, Timm Wrase · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究了来自 IIA 型、IIB 型/I 型以及杂优弦在具有 G2 结构空间上紧化得到的三维 N=1 有效理论的超对称真空。超势齐次性和物理标量度规给出了普适的真空关系和轴子稳定化限制，而无需指定完整的模空间度规。我们用对偶二维共形场论中相应算符的标度维度 Δ 来表示 AdS3 标量质量。在大质量 IIA 型 AdS3 真空中，我们得到界限 Δ_max ≥ (20+4√67)/7 ≈ 7.5，以及无挠支上 B2 轴子的精确维度 Δ_b=6。IIB 型/I 型和杂优 AdS3 真空包含一个普适的体积-伸缩子模，Δ_{φs}=4。在单态-挠率 IIB 型支上，我们也得到体积-伸缩子模 Δ_{φs}=20/7 和 Δ_b=16/7。在保留的经典闭弦理论中，每个超对称 Minkowski 真空都具有精确的体积-伸缩子平坦方向。我们刻画了满足 tadpole 约束和轴子识别后物理的大通量极限，并识别了各向同性尺度分离的挠率阻碍。

English: We study supersymmetric vacua of three-dimensional $\mathcal N=1$ effective theories from type IIA, type IIB/type I, and heterotic compactifications on $G_2$-structure spaces. Superpotential homogeneity and the physical scalar metric yield universal vacuum relations and axion stabilization constraints without specifying the full moduli-space metric. We express AdS$_3$ scalar masses through $\Delta$, the scaling dimension of the corresponding operator in the dual two-dimensional conformal field theory. In massive type IIA AdS$_3$ vacua, we derive the bound $\Delta_{\max}\geq(20+4\sqrt{67})/7\approx 7.5$ and an exact dimension $\Delta_b=6$ for $B_2$ axions on the torsion-free branch. Type IIB type I and heterotic AdS$_3$ vacua contain a universal volume-dilaton mode with $\Delta_{\phi s}=4$. On the singlet-torsion type IIB branch, we also obtain the volume-dilaton mode with $\Delta_{\phi s}=20/7$ and $\Delta_b=16/7$. Every supersymmetric Minkowski vacuum in the retained classical closed-string theories possesses an exact volume-dilaton flat direction. We characterize physical large-flux limits after tadpole constraints and axionic identifications, and identify torsion obstructions to isotropic scale separation.

一句话导读：G2 结构紧化的三维 N=1 超对称真空，并给出 AdS3/CFT2 标度维度及模稳定化约束。

de Sitter 空间可观测量代数上的半经典态与时间反演对称性

Semiclassical state on algebra of observables for de Sitter space and time reversal symmetry

Muxin Han, Yichen Hu · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在 de Sitter 静态补丁全息中，将体量子场与观察者的动力学时钟耦合，会得到规范不变可观测量的 type II₁ von Neumann 代数 M_+。然而，该代数上唯一的迹态无法重现半经典体关联函数。我们通过引入一族重钟态（表示具有沉重惯性的观察者参考系）来解决此问题。我们证明，在重钟极限下，规范不变的 dress 可观测量的 n 点关联函数重现 de Sitter 时空上的体量子场关联函数。此外，我们研究广义观察者 Hamiltonian H_obs=|π|，它同时包含正向运行（π ≥ 0）和反向运行（π < 0）的时钟。所得规范不变可观测量的 von Neumann 代数 M 仍是 type II₁ factor，并同构于 M_+ ⊗ M_2(C)，其中 M_2(C) 是在两种时钟取向之间变换的 2×2 复矩阵代数。时间反演对称性在此设置中由一个交换两种时钟取向的反酉算符实现，从而得到规范不变且时间反演不变可观测量的 type II₁ von Neumann 代数 F。我们将重钟态构造推广到 M 和 F，表明在重钟态中计算的 n 点关联函数与相应的半经典体关联函数匹配。最后，通过将 Einstein 引力与 Brown-Kuchař dust 场耦合，我们在 G → 0 极限下沿观察者世界线做微扰约化，推导出观察者 Hamiltonian H_obs=|π|。这为本文发展的观察者模型提供了场论基础。

English: In de Sitter static patch holography, coupling bulk quantum fields to an observer's dynamical clock yields a type II$_1$ von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{M}_+$ of gauge-invariant observables. However, the unique tracial state on this algebra fails to reproduce semiclassical bulk correlation functions. We resolve this issue by introducing a family of heavy-clock states, representing an observer reference frame with heavy inertia. We prove that in the heavy-clock limit, $n$-point correlation functions of gauge-invariant dressed observables reproduce the bulk quantum field correlation functions on de Sitter spacetime. Furthermore, we investigate a generalized observer Hamiltonian $\widehat{H}_{\rm obs}=|\widehat{\pi}|$ that incorporates both forward-running ($\pi\geq 0$) and backward-running ($\pi <0$) clocks. The resulting von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{M}$ of gauge-invariant observables remains a type~II$_1$ factor and is isomorphic to $\mathcal{M}_+\otimes M_2(\mathbb{C})$, where $M_2(\mathbb{C})$ is the algebra of $2\times2$ complex matrices transforming between the two clock orientations. Time-reversal symmetry is implemented in this setting as an anti-unitary operator that exchanges the two clock orientations, yielding a type~II$_1$ von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{F}$ of gauge-invariant, time-reversal-invariant observables. We generalize the heavy-clock state construction to both $\mathcal{M}$ and $\mathcal{F}$, showing that $n$-point correlation functions calculated in heavy-clock states match the corresponding semiclassical bulk correlation functions. Finally, by coupling Einstein gravity to the Brown--Kucha\v{r} dust field, we derive the observer Hamiltonian $\widehat{H}_{\rm obs}=|\widehat{\pi}|$ from a perturbative reduction along the observer's worldline in the $G \to 0$ limit. This provides a field-theoretic foundation for the observer model developed in this work.

一句话导读：通过引入重钟态和时间反演对称性，解决了 dS 静态补丁全息中 type II₁ 代数迹态无法重现半经典关联函数的问题，并从 Einstein-dust 推导出 |π| 观察者 Hamiltonian。

格子模拟中一阶相变的标量扰动与诱导引力波

Scalar Perturbations and Induced Gravitational Waves from First-Order Phase Transitions in Lattice Simulations

Yuan-Jie Li, Jing Liu, Zhuan Ning, Xiang-Xi Zeng, Zong-Kuan Guo · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：宇宙学一阶相变可以通过非均匀量子隧穿产生曲率扰动，此前已在超视界尺度上研究过。在这项工作中，我们首次进行了包含标量度规扰动和辐射扰动的三维格子模拟，覆盖了从气泡壁尺度到超视界尺度的范围。我们获得了精确的标量扰动功率谱和能量密度扰动的概率密度函数。此外，我们模拟了一阶相变期间每个源产生的引力波能谱，包括标量场本身、标量度规扰动以及辐射的能量密度和速度扰动。对于引力波，在超视界尺度上，其他源的贡献可以超过标量场贡献的 1/3。此外，我们比较了不同相变强度和速率值对结果的影响。本文为旨在通过引力波和曲率扰动探测或约束一阶相变的研究提供了更精确的数值结果。

English: Cosmological first-order phase transitions can generate curvature perturbations through inhomogeneous quantum tunneling, as studied previously on superhorizon scales. In this work, we for the first time conduct three-dimensional lattice simulations that incorporate scalar metric perturbations and radiation perturbations, covering a range from bubble wall scales to super-horizon scales. We obtain the precise scalar perturbation power spectrum and the probability density function of energy density perturbations. Furthermore, we simulate the gravitational-wave energy spectra generated by each source during the first-order phase transition, including the scalar field itself, scalar metric perturbations, and the energy density and velocity perturbations of radiation. For gravitational waves, the contribution from other sources can exceed $1/3$ of that from the scalar field at superhorizon scales. Additionally, we compare the effects of different values of the transition strength and rate on the results. This paper provides more accurate numerical results for research aimed at detecting or constraining first-order phase transitions via gravitational waves and curvature perturbations.

一句话导读：通过三维格子模拟研究一阶相变产生的标量扰动与诱导引力波，给出精确功率谱和能谱。

中子星中缓慢而强烈的相变能否缓解主要的致密星观测张力？

Can a slow and strong phase transition in neutron stars relieve major compact-star observation tensions?

Chen Zhang · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph, nucl-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：近期若干反常致密星观测以互补方式挑战传统中子星解释：HESS J1731--347 和 XTE J1814--338 倾向于低质量下异常小的半径，而 GW190814 的次天体在基于 GW170817 的最大质量推断下对普通中子星而言显得过于重。我们考察具有强一阶强子-夸克相变的中子星能否通过延展的稳定混合支缓解这些张力——当相变转换慢于径向振荡时会出现这类混合支——同时仍与 GW170817 和 NICER 约束一致。使用分段多方指数（PP）基准，并辅以独立的声速（CS）参数化比较，我们在对强子支和混合支进行一般参数扫描后发现两个可行情景。情景 1 实现一次性解决方案：同一物态方程具有纯强子支，同时兼容 GW190814 量级的质量和 HESS J1731--347，而其缓慢稳定混合支可达到 XTE J1814--338。情景 2 保留 GW190814 量级的强子支，但在非常不同的相变强度区间，通过缓慢稳定混合支达到 XTE J1814--338 和 HESS J1731--347。

English: Recent anomalous compact-star observations challenge the conventional neutron-star interpretation in complementary ways: HESS J1731--347 and XTE J1814--338 favor unusually small radii at low mass, while the secondary component of GW190814 appears too massive for an ordinary neutron star under GW170817-based maximum-mass inferences. We examine whether neutron stars with a strong first-order hadron-quark phase transition can address these tensions via the extended stable hybrid branches that arise when the phase conversion is slow compared to radial oscillations, while remaining consistent with GW170817 and NICER constraints. Using a piecewise-polytropic (PP) benchmark, supplemented by an independent speed-of-sound (CS) parametrization comparison, we find two viable scenarios after a general parameter scan over both the hadronic and hybrid branches. Scenario 1 realizes an all-at-once solution: the same equation of state has a pure hadronic branch compatible with both the GW190814-scale mass and HESS J1731--347, while its slow stable hybrid branch reaches XTE J1814--338. Scenario 2 retains the GW190814-scale hadronic branch but reaches XTE J1814--338 and HESS J1731--347 on slow stable hybrid branches in very different transition-strength regimes.

一句话导读：研究表明，中子星中相对径向振荡缓慢的强一阶强子-夸克相变所产生的稳定混合支，可能在满足 GW170817/NICER 约束的同时缓解小半径与高质量致密星观测张力。

学习黑洞毛发何时可观测：物理可识别性、泛化与观测互补性

Learning When Black Hole Hair Is Observable: Physical Identifiability, Generalization, and Observable Complementarity

Ariadna Uxue Palomino Ylla · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：高插值精度并不能证明物理参数是可识别的。我们在一个受控的 Kiselev 黑洞基准中研究这一区别，使用经过验证的类时发射器和三维零测地线打靶计算。精确的 k=0 边界提供了一个解析已知的零对照，因为时空退化为 Schwarzschild 且不依赖于 w_q。Ringdown 对形变振幅 k 有信息，而光子几何提供了一个独立的响应方向，可解决大部分 w_q 简并。相对于仅用 ringdown，ringdown 加光子几何使最小奇异值的中位逐点增益为 4.54 倍，并使 Jacobian 条件数改善 2.28 倍。在分组物理插值中，可识别 w_q 的归一化平均绝对误差从 0.309 降至 0.087。随机划分更乐观，而方向外推则显著更难，split-conformal 覆盖率在分布偏移下退化。一个非学习的最近模型逆方法表明，该增益不限于所测试的学习架构。均匀的 161 相位审计给出典型归一化预测偏移 9.48×10^{-4}，而针对性的 321 相位审计解决了剩余前向特征比较。然而，冻结的 HGB 和随机森林尾部偏移超过了预设稳健性阈值。因此，物理观测量的互补性得到支持，但逆估计器的稳健性仍是有条件的。这是一个理论可识别性基准，不是观测约束。

English: High interpolation accuracy does not establish that physical parameters are identifiable. We study this distinction in a controlled Kiselev black hole benchmark with a validated timelike-emitter and three-dimensional null-geodesic shooting calculation. The exact $k=0$ boundary provides an analytically known null control because the spacetime becomes Schwarzschild and independent of $w_q$. Ringdown is informative for the deformation amplitude $k$, while photon geometry supplies an independent response direction that resolves much of the $w_q$ degeneracy. Relative to ringdown alone, ringdown plus photon geometry gives a median pointwise $4.54\times$ gain in minimum singular value and a $2.28\times$ improvement in Jacobian condition number. In grouped physical interpolation, identifiable-$w_q$ normalized mean absolute error decreases from 0.309 to 0.087. Random splitting is more optimistic, while directional extrapolation is substantially harder and split-conformal coverage degrades under distribution shift. A non-learned nearest-model inverse shows that the gain is not confined to the tested learned architectures. A uniform 161-phase audit gives a typical normalized prediction shift of $9.48\times10^{-4}$, while a targeted 321-phase audit resolves the remaining forward-feature comparisons. However, frozen HGB and random-forest tail shifts exceed prespecified robustness thresholds. Thus, physical observable complementarity is supported, but inverse-estimator robustness remains conditional. This is a theoretical identifiability benchmark, not an observational constraint.

一句话导读：在 Kiselev 黑洞基准中，ringdown 与光子几何结合可提升形变参数与 w_q 的可识别性，但逆估计器稳健性仍是有条件的。

二次 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac 引力中的引力波传播：条件性张量扇区分析

Gravitational-Wave Propagation in Quadratic Einstein--Cartan--Dirac Gravity: A Conditional Tensor-Sector Analysis

Zhi-Fu Gao, Biao-Peng Li, Na Wang, Hui Wang, Guo-Qiang Jin, Zhoujian Cao, Luiz C. Garcia de Andrade · gr-qc, hep-ex, nucl-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究了在一个指定的、具有宇称偶二次挠率不变量 ζ T_{λμν}T^{λμν} 的一阶 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac 理论中，领头张量传播。在正则代数分支上消去非动力学 Lorentz 联络后，得到一个度规描述，包含 Einstein–Hilbert 项、Dirac 作用量，以及一个依赖于 ζ 的轴–轴费米子接触相互作用。我们在显式的因子化平均场闭合下计算横向无迹（TT）Hessian，其中连通流 TT 响应为零、因子化流标量的第一阶和第二阶 TT 响应为零，且内禀 TT 各向异性应力为零。在这些强加条件下，领头二导数张量作用量具有 Q_T = M_Pl^2 和 c_T = 1，没有领头色散或传播引起的偏振分裂。这些条件并不来自单点轴流各向同性，并且当前计算并未从微观费米子态推导它们。因此结果是条件性的，并不建立一般的 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac no-go 定理。我们指出，要将结果推广到该闭合之外，必须计算连通流 TT 响应。已发表的 NANOGrav 总结仅用于检验与类 GR 预言的一致性；没有获得新的计时数据似然或对 ζ 的约束。

English: We study leading tensor propagation in a specified first-order Einstein--Cartan--Dirac theory with the parity-even quadratic torsion invariant $\zeta T_{\lambda\mu\nu}T^{\lambda\mu\nu}$. Eliminating the nondynamical Lorentz connection on the regular algebraic branch gives a metric description containing the Einstein--Hilbert term, the Dirac action, and a $\zeta$-dependent axial--axial fermion contact interaction. We evaluate the transverse-traceless (TT) Hessian under an explicit factorized mean-field closure, with vanishing connected-current TT response, vanishing first- and second-order TT response of the factorized current scalar, and zero intrinsic TT anisotropic stress. Under these imposed conditions, the leading two-derivative tensor action has $Q_T=M_{\rm Pl}^{2}$ and $c_T=1$, with no leading dispersion or propagation-induced polarization splitting. These conditions do not follow from isotropy of the one-point axial current, and the present calculation does not derive them from a microscopic fermionic state. The result is therefore conditional and does not establish a general Einstein--Cartan--Dirac no-go theorem. We identify the connected-current TT response that must be calculated to extend the result beyond this closure. Published NANOGrav summaries are used only to check consistency with the GR-like prediction; no new timing-data likelihood or constraint on $\zeta$ is obtained.

利用黑洞光子环检验范德瓦尔斯黑洞

Testing Van der Waals black holes using black hole photon rings

Chengzhen Li, Meirong Tang, Zhaoyi Xu · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：范德瓦尔斯黑洞（BH）是反德西特（AdS）时空中的一种非Kerr模型，表现出特征热力学相变。黑洞分子体积 b 和压强 P 等参数的物理有效性仍需观测检验。作为强引力场的灵敏探针，黑洞光子环直接携带时空几何信息，是模型检验的理想对象。根据与该黑洞相关的时空度规，本研究得到光子的零测地线方程和守恒量，通过有效势分析确定光子球条件和半径，考察光子环分类和辐射性质，并利用事件视界望远镜（EHT）测量对参数施加约束并模拟光学外观。结果表明，分子体积参数 b 显著调节光子球半径、光子环结构和光度。在特定区间内，模型与 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的 EHT 测量高度一致。该区间不仅满足能量条件（弱、强和主能量条件），还对应稳定的范德瓦尔斯型相变区域。此外，光子环可以区分范德瓦尔斯黑洞和史瓦西黑洞：由于小黑洞-大黑洞（SBH-LBH）相变和微观结构不连续性，范德瓦尔斯黑洞的光子环对参数 b 特别敏感，而史瓦西黑洞缺乏这些特征。这项工作利用光子环探测黑洞分子模型，将其微观结构、时空几何和观测特征联系起来，并提供了一种从观测推导黑洞微观物理的新途径。

English: The Van der Waals black hole (BH) is a non-Kerr model in Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime that exhibits characteristic thermodynamic phase transitions. Whether the physical validity of parameters such as the BH molecular volume $b$ and pressure $P$ is feasible still requires observational verification. As a sensitive probe of strong gravitational fields, the BH photon ring directly carries spacetime geometric information, making it an ideal object for model testing. In accordance with the spacetime metric associated with this BH, this study obtains the null geodesic equations for photons and conserved quantities, determines the photon sphere conditions and radii via effective potential analysis, investigates the photon ring classification and radiative properties, and employs measurements from the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) to place constraints on parameters and simulate the optical appearance. The results show that the molecular volume parameter $b$ significantly regulates the radius of the photon sphere radius, photon ring structure, and the luminosity. Within a specific interval, the model exhibits a high degree of agreement with the EHT measurements for M87* and Sgr A*. This interval not only satisfies the energy conditions (weak, strong, and dominant) but also corresponds to a stable Van der Waals-type phase transition region. Furthermore, the photon ring can distinguish between the Van der Waals BH and the Schwarzschild BH: due to the small-black-hole-large-black-hole (SBH-LBH) phase transition and microstructural discontinuities, the photon ring of the Van der Waals BH is particularly sensitive to the parameter $b$, whereas the Schwarzschild BH lacks these features. This work uses the photon ring to probe BH molecular models, linking its microstructure, spacetime geometry and observational signatures, and provides a new way to derive BH microphysics from observations.

一句话导读：用光子环和EHT观测约束AdS中范德瓦尔斯黑洞的微观参数，并将其与热力学相变和时空几何联系起来。

范德瓦尔斯黑洞的周期轨道

Periodic Orbits of Van der Waals Black Holes

Xuyao Gong, Zhaoyi Xu, Meirong Tang · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在渐近反德西特（AdS）时空中，若黑洞在扩展相空间中的热力学精确再现范德瓦尔斯流体，便构成一类独特的黑洞——范德瓦尔斯黑洞（VBHs）。我们求解了 VBHs 的类时测地线，编目其周期轨道，并计算沿这些轨道发出的引力波，以追踪热力学压强 P 与分子体积参数 b 如何塑造轨道动力学。通过数值积分测地线方程，得到最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的能量、角动量和半径，并绘制出束缚轨道族。为界定有效势保持良好行为的参数窗口，我们引入临界角动量 Ls。在轨道分类方案内，我们针对若干参数集计算对应于有理数 q 的能量，并展示所得轨道。沿这些轨道产生的波形在“Kludge”形式体系中生成，从而可以量化 b 对波振幅和周期的影响。轨道结构和引力波信号均对 b 高度敏感。VBHs 与 Schwarzschild-AdS（SAdS）黑洞的动力学行为显著不同，为通过引力波观测探测黑洞热力学提供了新视角。

English: Black holes in asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime whose extended-phase-space thermodynamics reproduces that of a van der Waals fluid exactly form a distinctive class, the van der Waals black holes (VBHs). The timelike geodesics of VBHs are solved, their periodic orbits are catalogued, and the gravitational waves emitted along them are computed, so as to trace how the thermodynamic pressure P and the molecular-volume parameter b shape the orbital dynamics. Integrating the geodesic equations numerically yields the energy, angular momentum and radius of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) and maps out the family of bound orbits. To delimit the parameter window in which the effective potential stays well behaved, we introduce a critical angular momentum Ls. Within the orbit-classification scheme, we compute the energies corresponding to rational q for several parameter sets and display the resulting orbits. The waveforms produced along these orbits are generated within the "Kludge" formalism, which makes it possible to quantify the imprint of b on the wave amplitude and on the period. Both the orbital architecture and the gravitational-wave signature turn out to be strongly sensitive to b. The dynamical behavior of VBHs and Schwarzschild-AdS (SAdS) black holes differs markedly, providing a new perspective for probing black hole thermodynamics via gravitational wave observations.

一句话导读：求解范德瓦尔斯黑洞的类时测地线与周期轨道，并用 Kludge 波形显示其对参数 b 的强敏感性。

Naoki Tsukamoto · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在通常的强偏折极限中，光子球附近外侧和内侧光线的偏折角呈对数发散，且光子球附近的光线可通过未来空间观测到的黑洞阴影探测。另一方面，我们表明，在 $Z_2$ 对称虫洞喉部光子球附近的光线，其偏折角按幂律而非对数发散；这里以 Event Horizon Telescope 合作组常研究的一类常用虫洞或简单虫洞为例。这是因为 $Z_2$ 对称虫洞在喉部有一个边缘不稳定的光子球，它具有既非通常也非简单、而是特殊的性质。我们研究了一类 $Z_2$ 对称虫洞中，在强偏折极限下喉部边缘不稳定光子球近似外侧和内侧光线的引力透镜。我们使用数值方法计算按幂律发散的偏折角，并将其应用于常用简单虫洞时空、Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞时空和 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹时空。我们的数值结果表明，在强偏折极限下，$Z_2$ 对称虫洞喉部边缘不稳定光子球附近光线偏折角具有普适性质，类似于由离开喉部的边缘不稳定光子球弯折的光线偏折角，但幂次不同。我们还用作者等人此前研究过的半解析方法，修正了 $Z_2$ 对称虫洞喉部边缘不稳定光子球近似外侧弯折光线的偏折角幂律发散项系数。

English: The deflection angles of rays diverge logarithmically near outside and inside of a photon sphere in usual strong deflection limits and the rays near the photon sphere could be detected by near-future space observations on black hole shadows. On the other hand, we show that the deflection angles of the rays near the photon sphere at a throat of a $Z_2$-symmetric wormhole, as an example among some commonly used types of wormholes or simple wormholes, which is often studied by the Event Horizon Telescope collaborations, diverge in power law but not logarithmically. This is because the $Z_2$-symmetric wormhole has a marginally unstable photon sphere at the throat and it has neither a common nor simple but special property. We investigate gravitational lensing of the rays nearly outside and inside of the marginally unstable photon sphere at the throat in a class of $Z_2$-symmetric wormholes in the strong deflection limits. We use a numerical method to calculate the deflection angles diverging in power law and we apply it to the commonly-used simple wormhole spacetime, a Damour-Solodukhin wormhole spacetime, and a Simpson-Visser black-bounce spacetime. Our numerical results imply universal property of the deflection angle of the rays near the marginally unstable photon sphere on $Z_2$-symmetric wormhole throat in the strong deflection limits as similar to the deflection angles of ray bent by a marginally unstable photon sphere off a throat in the strong deflection limits which have a different power. We also correct the coefficients of power-law divergent terms of the deflection angles of the rays bent nearly outside of the marginally unstable photon sphere at the $Z_2$-symmetric wormhole throat in a semi-analytic approach investigated by the author and others.
