New approach to the calculation of extreme-mass-ratio inspirals with a spinning secondary

Viktor Skoup\'y · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）是未来空间引力波探测器（如激光干涉空间天线）最有希望的一类源。为了充分发挥其科学潜力，用于参数估计的引力波模板必须对具有非零自旋的偏心进动双星系统进行高精度建模。本文引入一种实用且高效的框架，将次级自旋效应纳入完全通用、偏心且偏离赤道的EMRI，精确到后绝热第一阶。我们利用最近发现的Kerr时空中自旋体轨迹解析解，显著简化相应渐近引力波通量的计算。此外，得益于最近证明的通量平衡定律，我们展示了如何用渐近Teukolsky振幅和文献中已建立的纯测地函数来表达运动常数的变化率，包括Carter-Rüdiger常数。最后，我们展示了该框架在近球旋近情形下的表现，并数值证明相位的线性自旋部分与规范无关。本工作开发的代码的Wolfram Mathematica实现已在KerrSpinningFluxes包中公开。

English: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are among the most promising sources for future space-based gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, such as the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna. To fully leverage the scientific potential, the GW templates required for parameter estimation must be modeled with high accuracy for eccentric precessing binary systems with nonzero spins. This work introduces a practical and efficient framework for incorporating the effects of secondary spin in fully generic, eccentric, and off-equatorial EMRIs to the first postadiabatic order. We utilize recently found analytic solutions for the trajectories of spinning bodies in Kerr spacetime to significantly simplify the calculation of the corresponding asymptotic GW fluxes. Furthermore, thanks to the recently proven flux-balance laws, we show how to express the rates of change of the constants of motion, including the Carter-R\"udiger constant, using asymptotic Teukolsky amplitudes and purely geodesic functions that are already established in the literature. Finally, we show how this framework performs in the case of nearly spherical inspirals and numerically demonstrate that the linear-in-spin part of the phases is gauge independent. A Wolfram Mathematica implementation of the code developed in this work is publicly available in the KerrSpinningFluxes package.

一句话导读：提出一个将次级自旋纳入完全通用、偏心、非赤道EMRI的后绝热一阶框架，并用Kerr自旋轨迹解析解与通量平衡定律简化渐近Teukolsky通量及运动常数演化计算。

旋转 Kerr-Weyl 黑洞 Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton 吸积中的翻转激波与环面及其准周期变率

Flip-Flop Shocks and Tori in Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton Accretion onto Rotating Kerr-Weyl Black Holes and Their Quasi-Periodic Variability

Orhan Donmez, Imtiaz Khan, G. Mustafa · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们给出在 Weyl 共形引力中旋转黑洞（Kerr-Weyl 度规）上的 Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton 吸积的 GRHD 模拟。对自旋 a=0.9M 与 a=0.5M 及若干 Weyl 系数（通过有效曲率参数 k 进入）演化赤道流，并与相同设置的 Kerr 运行比较。在所考虑的 k 下，视界、ISCO 和测试粒子频率与 Kerr 相差至多约 2%。但曲率项按 k r^2 增长，并在吸积半径 R_acc 处起作用。流动由一个量 eta=|k|R_acc^3/M 控制，即在 R_acc 处曲率诱导加速度与牛顿加速度之比。当 eta<~0.03 时形成稳定激波锥，与 Kerr 不可区分。当 eta~0.2-0.3 时，类反德西特项将激波气体困在黑洞后方并驱动持续翻转振荡。当 eta>~1.6 时，锥被破坏并形成振荡环面。自旋只改变内部几个引力半径，不改变区域。在强偏离模型中，平均吸积率为 Kerr 值的 1.7-3 倍，均方根变化 20-60%，而 Kerr 型流动为 0.1-1%。功率谱显示全局 QPO，10 Msun 黑洞基频 2.9-4.8 Hz，谐波阶梯的 3:2 和 2:1 比值来自单个非正弦振荡而非共振。这些位于低频 QPO 波段，与测试粒子频率（~70-200 Hz）无关。它们按 f_0=xi f_K(R_acc) 缩放，稳定锥 xi~0.7-1.1，翻转与环面区域 xi~0.23-0.38。对于明亮银河源，强振荡可在数秒内探测到。所需 |k| 超过星系旋转曲线值 18-36 个数量级，因此若探测到激波驱动 QPO 将测量与 Kerr 的局域偏离，若不存在则可约束 |k|。

English: We present GRHD simulations of Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton accretion onto a rotating black hole in Weyl conformal gravity, described by the Kerr-Weyl metric. The equatorial flow is evolved for spins a=0.9M and a=0.5M and several Weyl coefficients, which enter through an effective curvature parameter k, and is compared with Kerr runs sharing the same setup. For the k considered, the horizon, ISCO and test-particle frequencies differ from Kerr by at most ~2%. However, the curvature term grows as kr^2 and acts at the accretion radius R_acc. The flow is controlled by one quantity, eta=|k|R_acc^3/M, the ratio of curvature-induced to Newtonian acceleration at R_acc. For eta<~0.03 a stable shock cone forms, indistinguishable from Kerr. For eta~0.2-0.3 the anti-de Sitter-like term traps shocked gas behind the black hole and drives persistent flip-flop oscillations. For eta>~1.6 the cone is destroyed and an oscillating torus forms. Spin modifies only the inner few gravitational radii and does not change the regime. In strongly deviating models the mean accretion rate is 1.7-3 times the Kerr value and varies by 20-60% rms, versus 0.1-1% in Kerr-like flows. The power spectra show global QPOs with fundamentals at 2.9-4.8 Hz for a 10 Msun black hole, with harmonic ladders whose 3:2 and 2:1 ratios come from one non-sinusoidal oscillation, not resonances. These lie in the low-frequency QPO band and are unrelated to test-particle frequencies (~70-200 Hz). They scale as f_0=xi f_K(R_acc), with xi~0.7-1.1 for stable cones and xi~0.23-0.38 for flip-flop and torus regimes. Strong oscillations would be detectable within seconds for a bright Galactic source. The required |k| exceeds galactic-rotation-curve values by 18-36 orders of magnitude, so a detected shock-driven QPO would measure a local deviation from Kerr, and its absence would constrain |k|.

一句话导读：Kerr-Weyl 黑洞 BHL 吸积的 GRHD 模拟表明，Weyl 曲率项可导致激波翻转和振荡环面，并产生与测试粒子频率无关的低频 QPO。

用拉格朗日神经网络学习史瓦西测地运动

Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks

Sukru Caglar, Sena Kalabalik, Abdullah Umut Hamzaogullari, Arkadas Ozakin · cs.LG, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）通过参数化标量拉格朗日量并利用欧拉-拉格朗日方程导出加速度，从轨迹数据中学习动力学，提供了一种变分归纳偏置，相比纯数据驱动模型提高了物理一致性。LNNs 最近已被推广到广义相对论情形，但史瓦西测地线仍是一个未解决的挑战。训练复杂相对论系统受到动力学多样性、数值不稳定性以及充分采样物理相关且多样轨道区域困难的阻碍。我们引入两项协同改进：一种解耦的位置-速度归一化方案，独立重标度每个坐标及其时间导数，并重新加权加速度目标以平衡所有通道的贡献；以及一种受最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）结构启发、能量约束的对数均匀采样数据生成策略。借助这些改进，我们的模型准确再现了近日点进动和相对论时间膨胀，在围绕中心质量完成多圈轨道后仍将能量和角动量守恒保持在百分之几以内，并能预测近场、中场和远场区域中的八种轨道场景的轨迹。这些结果表明，结合物理动机的归一化与采样后，LNNs 能够可靠地学习弯曲时空中的测地动力学。我们的工作也代表了首次成功在史瓦西测地线上训练 LNNs，并为复杂相对论系统的数据驱动建模提供了一个有前景的方向。

English: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. We introduce two coordinated improvements: a decoupled position--velocity normalization scheme that independently rescales each coordinate and its time derivatives, reweighting acceleration targets to balance contributions across all channels; and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy informed by the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) structure. With these improvements, our model accurately reproduces perihelion precession and relativistic time dilation, conserves energy and angular momentum to within a few percent even after completing multiple orbits around the central mass and predicts orbital trajectories across eight orbital scenarios in close, medium, and far-field regimes. These results establish that LNNs, augmented with physically motivated normalization and sampling, can reliably learn geodesic dynamics in curved spacetime. Our work also represents the first successful training of LNNs on Schwarzschild geodesics and offers a promising direction for data-driven modeling of complex relativistic systems.

一句话导读：该工作用改进归一化与采样的拉格朗日神经网络首次成功学习史瓦西时空中的测地线动力学。

论最大固有加速度时空中的动能概念

On the notion of kinetic energy in a spacetime of maximal proper acceleration

Ricardo Gallego Torrom\'e · physics.gen-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：本文表明，在最大固有加速度时空中，存在粒子减速同时动能增加的情形。为说明该效应，讨论了一个经典的一维类电腔方案。减速导致动能增加，这提示从能量观点看速度与加速度之间存在等价性。这种等价性以类似 Born 互易原理的形式表述，但建立在高阶 jet 时空几何框架中。我们还表明，该理论中存在一个动力学超光速扇区，适用于正质量点粒子，其特征是超光速速度以及大于最大固有加速度的固有加速度。因此，在经典层面，光速和最大固有加速度仅成为两个动力学扇区的分离条件。

English: It is shown in this work that in spacetimes of maximal proper acceleration there are situations where a particle decelerates and simultaneously increases its kinetic energy. To illustrate the effect, a classical $1$-dimensional electric cavity-like scheme is discussed. The gain in kinetic energy by deceleration suggests an equivalence between velocity and acceleration from the energetic point of view. Such an equivalence is stated in a form resembling Born reciprocity principle but formulated in the framework of higher order jet spacetime geometry. We also show the existence in the theory of a dynamical superluminal sector for point particles with positive mass and characterized by superluminal speed and a proper acceleration larger than the maximal proper acceleration. Therefore, the speed of light and the maximal proper acceleration become only {\it separation conditions} at the classical level of the two dynamical sectors.

一句话导读：在最大固有加速度时空中，粒子减速可增加动能，并出现类似 Born 互易原理的能量等价以及一个动力学超光速扇区。

内平移规范与Weyl规范理论中的局部引力能量

Internal translation gauging and local gravitational energy in Weyl gauge theory

Michael Hobson, Will Barker, Anthony Lasenby · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究了在Weyl规范理论中将平移作为内Stückelberg冗余引入所得到的局部引力源和荷。内T(4)不变的修饰余标架将平移势的源等同于已有的余标架变分导数，而不引入新动力学。我们推导了一个激发/源方程和平衡定律，其结构不依赖于宇称偶二次挠率族的本构参数。相对于指定的引力/物质划分和边界代表定义的引力自流，在其标架指标与余标架缩并后，给出一个在内规范因子下不变的密度；这种不变性既不建立通常的守恒，也不将该密度等同于外部平移Noether流。通过与协变常内方向缩并可得到面荷，并且我们分别推导了广义可约性的三部门Noether超势，及其通量守恒的渐近条件。在广义相对论的远平行等价（TEGR）中，激发约化为远平行超势，协变余标架--联络对给出Schwarzschild ADM能量；平直宇宙学和横向无迹波给出进一步检验。在偏离TEGR处，新广义相对论的一个精确解给出的荷，其与Kepler质量的分数差为后牛顿空间曲率参数偏离1的一半（在所采用的归一化下）；独立的Hamiltonian荷匹配仍待解决。最后，在固定参考归一化和预辛代表下，可积Hamiltonian荷在协变Lagrange边界项下保持不变。

English: We investigate the local gravitational source and charges obtained by introducing translations as an internal St\"uckelberg redundancy in Weyl gauge theory. The internal-$T(4)$-invariant dressed coframe identifies the source of the translational potential with the existing coframe variational derivative, without introducing new dynamics. We derive an excitation/source equation and balance law whose structure is independent of the constitutive parameters of the parity-even quadratic torsion family. The gravitational self-current, defined relative to a specified gravitational/matter split and boundary representative, gives a density invariant under the internal gauge factors once its frame index is contracted with the coframe; this invariance neither establishes ordinary conservation nor identifies the density with the external translation Noether current. A surface charge follows by contraction with a covariantly constant internal direction, and we separately derive the three-sector Noether superpotential of generalized reducibility, with the asymptotic conditions for conservation of its flux. At the teleparallel equivalent of general relativity (TEGR) the excitation reduces to the teleparallel superpotential and the covariant coframe--connection pair gives the Schwarzschild ADM energy; flat cosmology and transverse-traceless waves give further checks. Away from TEGR, an exact solution of New General Relativity gives a charge whose fractional difference from the Kepler mass is half the deviation of the post-Newtonian spatial-curvature parameter from unity, at the adopted normalisation; independent Hamiltonian charge matching remains open. Finally, the integrable Hamiltonian charge is invariant under covariant Lagrangian boundary terms at fixed reference normalisation and presymplectic representative.

3+1 数值相对论中的双 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞：并合、飞掠与引力波

Binary Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes in 3+1 numerical relativity: mergers, fly-bys and gravitational waves

Nikita M. Shirokov, Ilya Nachevsky · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们给出了（据我们所知）首批虫洞双星的三维数值相对论演化：由幽灵标量场撑开的两个大质量 Ellis-Bronnikov drainhole。每个喉部是一个不稳定不动点，其 e 折时间与 Gonz'alez-Guzm'an-Sarbach 线性率符合到 1.9% 以内。两个喉部遵循电荷符号规则：同号标量电荷相斥，异号相吸，测得吸引/排斥比为 1.462±0.022，而预测为 3/2，因此只有异号配对会并合。正碰会在两个仍张开的喉部周围形成一个共同的 MOTS，诞生时面积约为两者面积之和。随后视界在吞入幽灵场时损失 28% 面积，到 t=100 时位于该双星质量对应的 Schwarzschild 半径的 1.4% 以内，且仍在收缩。飞掠配对不形成视界，两个口都会膨胀，最接近捕获的那个口辐射出测得最多的引力波能量。一个孤立坍缩的喉部会把它被注入的四极矩以爆发形式释放，并以它最终形成黑洞的 Schwarzschild 频率振铃；每次相遇都辐射自己的引力波爆发以及一个能量相当且符号为负的标量偶极。对任何合理扰动，一个喉部至多存活几个轨道周期，而负能量偶极会泵入而非耗散轨道，因此这些双星没有旋近。

English: We present what are, to our knowledge, the first 3D numerical-relativity evolutions of wormhole binaries: pairs of massive Ellis-Bronnikov drainholes held open by a ghost scalar field. Each throat is an unstable fixed point whose e-fold time matches the Gonz\'alez-Guzm\'an-Sarbach linear rate to within 1.9%. Two throats obey a charge-sign rule: like scalar charges repel and opposite charges attract, with a measured attraction-to-repulsion ratio of $1.462\pm0.022$ against the predicted 3/2, so only opposite-signed pairs merge. A head-on collision forms a common MOTS around both still-open throats, born with about their combined area. The horizon then loses 28% of its area as it swallows the phantom field, and by $t=100$ lies within 1.4% of the Schwarzschild radius of the pair's mass, still shrinking. Fly-by pairs form no horizon and both mouths inflate, the one nearest capture radiating the most gravitational-wave energy measured. A lone collapsing throat sheds its seeded quadrupole as a burst ringing at the Schwarzschild frequency of the black hole it becomes, and every encounter radiates its own burst of gravitational waves and a scalar dipole of comparable energy and negative sign. A throat survives at most a few orbital periods for any plausible perturbation, and the negative-energy dipole would pump rather than drain the orbit, so these binaries have no inspiral.

一句话导读：首次三维数值相对论模拟双 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞：电荷符号规则决定并合或飞掠，视界形成并伴随引力波与标量偶极辐射，且不存在旋近。

从引力波背景重建早期原初黑洞主导时期

Reconstructing Early Primordial Black Hole Domination from Gravitational-Wave Backgrounds

Daniel del-Corral, Angus Spalding · astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：质量低于 O(10^9) g 的原初黑洞（PBHs）占据参数空间中常规观测很大程度上无法触及的有趣区域。尽管它们在大爆炸核合成（BBN）之前就蒸发，这些 PBHs 可以自然地产生早期宇宙中的一段早期物质主导时期。原初引力波背景（GWB）提供了观察这一原本不可及区域的窗口，因为修改后的膨胀历史会留下与 PBH 主导开始和结束相关的特征谱特征。这些特征频率的位置可用于重建底层的 PBH 参数，特别是 PBH 质量。对于自由传播的 GWB，这些频率的位置还允许确定初始 PBH 丰度。我们推导出简单的数值关系，将这些特征频率直接映射到 PBH 质量和初始丰度。未来 GW 实验覆盖广阔的频率范围，提供对 PBH 质量从 BBN 下限 O(10^9) g 到下限 O(10) g 的敏感度。我们发现 NANOGrav 报告的纳赫兹信号，如果其起源是原初的，已经在探测 4–90 Mg 范围内的 PBH 质量。因此 GW 观测提供了接触当前实验无法触及的广大 PBH 参数空间的机会。

English: Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) with masses below $\mathcal{O}(10^9)$g occupy an interesting region of parameter space that is largely inaccessible to conventional observations. Despite evaporating before Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN), these PBHs can naturally generate a period of early matter domination in the early Universe. A primordial gravitational-wave background (GWB) provides a window onto this otherwise inaccessible regime, since the modified expansion history leaves a characteristic spectral feature associated with the onset and end of PBH domination. The locations of these characteristic frequencies can be used to reconstruct the underlying PBH parameters, in particular the PBH mass. For a freely propagating GWB, the location of these frequencies additionally allow the initial PBH abundance to be determined. We derive simple numerical relations that map these characteristic frequencies directly onto the PBH mass and initial abundance. Future GW experiments span a vast frequency range, providing sensitivity to PBH masses from the BBN bound of $\mathcal{O}(10^9)\,\mathrm{g}$ down to the lower bound of $\mathcal{O}(10)\,\mathrm{g}$. We find that the nanohertz signal reported by NANOGrav, if primordial in origin, is already probing PBH masses in the range $4$--$90\,\mathrm{Mg}$. GW observations therefore offer access to a vast region of PBH parameter space that is otherwise beyond the reach of current experiments.

一句话导读：用原初引力波背景的特征频率重建早期原初黑洞主导时期的黑洞质量和初始丰度。

质量间隙天体中的混杂星被 1.4 M⊙ 处的孪生星排除

Hybrid neutron stars among mass gap objects are excluded by twin stars at $1.4\,M_\odot$

Alexander Ayriyan, David Blaschke, Marcin Dubaj, Oleksandr Vitiuk, Adrian Wojcik · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph, nucl-th · v4 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究所谓质量间隙（2.5 < M/M⊙ < 5.0）中的致密天体能否是中子星或混杂星。使用带一阶解禁闭相变的通用混杂星状态方程，我们在 Seidov 型图中映射允许的参数空间，并将其与现代质量-半径约束相对照。我们发现，质量间隙中的混杂星要求解禁闭极早出现且夸克物质非常硬。然而，贝叶斯分析更青睐解禁闭发生在约 1.4 M⊙ 典型中子星质量附近、并具有质量孪生星的状态方程；如果这些孪生星得到确认，将排除混杂星作为观测到的质量间隙致密天体的候选者。

English: We investigate the question whether compact objects in the so-called mass gap ($2.5 < M/M_\odot < 5.0$) can be neutron stars or hybrid stars. Using a generic hybrid star equation of state with a first-order deconfinement transition, we map the allowed parameter space in a Seidov-type diagram and confront it with modern mass-radius constraints. We find that mass-gap hybrid stars require an extremely early onset of deconfinement and very stiff quark matter. The Bayesian analysis, however, favors equations of state with deconfinement at typical neutron-star masses around $1.4\,M_\odot$ with mass-twin stars that, if confirmed, would rule out hybrid stars as candidates for observed mass-gap compact objects.

一句话导读：质量间隙中的混杂星需要极早解禁闭和极硬夸克物质；贝叶斯质量-半径约束倾向于在约 1.4 M⊙ 出现质量孪生星，从而排除这类候选。

引力波回声作为二次曲率-物质耦合引力中奇异星最大质量探针

Gravitational wave echoes as probes of the maximum mass of strange stars in quadratic curvature-matter coupled gravity

Debadri Bhattacharjee, Pradip Kumar Chattopadhyay, Kazuharu Bamba · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：引力波天文学为探测奇异致密星提供了有力途径。近期对 GW170817 的分析报告了可能的后合并引力波回声，显著性为 4.2σ，主频约 72 Hz。此类回声可能来自具有光子球、能部分囚禁引力扰动的超致密遗迹。在广义相对论中，光子球形成要求恒星致密度介于三分之一至九分之四之间，这一条件很难由现实物态方程满足。本文在具有非最小物质耦合的二次曲率引力中研究这一可能性，考虑由 MIT 袋模型物态方程描述的奇异星。通过求解修正 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，我们得到质量-半径关系，并识别能够支持光子球与引力波回声的位形。修正 Buchdahl 极限允许更致密的恒星解，而光子球约束限制了可行参数空间。我们发现，增大袋常数会降低最大质量和回声时间，使回声频率移向 kHz 量级。回声约束给出了比流体静力学平衡更严格的最大质量-半径限制，暗示奇异星最大质量界需要修正。我们进一步计算临界碰撞参数和 eikonal 准正规模，展示修正引力参数如何系统改变光子球半径及相关观测特征。这些结果确立后合并奇异星作为潜在引力波回声源，并突出回声、光学阴影与 QNM 作为下一代探测器如 Einstein Telescope 和 Cosmic Explorer 检验修正引力的互补探针。

English: Gravitational wave astronomy provides a powerful avenue for probing exotic compact stars. Recent analyses of GW170817 have reported possible post-merger gravitational wave echoes with a significance of $4.2\sigma$ and a dominant frequency near $72,\text{Hz}$. Such echoes may arise from ultracompact remnants possessing photon spheres that partially trap gravitational perturbations. In general relativity, photon-sphere formation requires the stellar compactness to lie between one-third and four-ninths, a condition difficult to achieve with realistic equations of state. Here, we investigate this possibility in quadratic curvature gravity with non-minimal matter coupling, considering strange stars described by the MIT bag model equation of state. By solving the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations, we obtain mass-radius relations and identify configurations capable of supporting photon spheres and gravitational wave echoes. The modified Buchdahl limit permits more compact stellar solutions, while photon-sphere constraints restrict the viable parameter space. We find that increasing the bag constant reduces the maximum mass and echo time, shifting the echo frequency toward the kHz regime. The echo constraints impose more stringent maximum mass-radius limits than hydrostatic equilibrium, suggesting revised maximum mass bounds for strange stars. We further compute the critical impact parameter and eikonal quasi-normal modes, demonstrating how modified gravity parameters systematically alter the photon-sphere radius and associated observational signatures. These results establish post-merger strange stars as potential GW echo sources and highlight echoes, optical shadows, and QNMs as complementary probes of modified gravity for next-generation detectors such as the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer.

一句话导读：在二次曲率-物质耦合引力下，奇异星可支持光子球并产生后合并引力波回声，回声约束给出比静力学更严格的最大质量-半径界限。

广义第一定律与Smarr型关系：超越可加性与广延性

Generalized First Law and Smarr-type Relation: Beyond Additivity and Extensivity

Usman Zafar, Krishnakanta Bhattacharya, Kazuharu Bamba · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：本文发展了一个通用框架，用于在广泛的广义熵模型中推导4维静态球对称时空的黑洞热力学第一定律以及相应的Smarr型关系。此外，通过采用Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞的熵表示，我们确定了一个简洁的曲率泛函，该泛函仅依赖于这一表示及其导数。我们导出了一个一般平坦性条件，表明当熵Hessian度规正则且非退化时，齐次幂律变换与一个单独的对数分支都使RN黑洞的Ruppeiner几何保持平坦。另一方面，Rényi、Sharma-Mittal、Kaniadakis以及LQG启发的熵变形通常在正则热力学区域产生非零曲率，这表明RN黑洞的极值性本身并不要求曲率发散。

English: In this work, we develop a general framework for deriving the first law of black hole thermodynamics and the associated Smarr-type relation for 4-dimensional static spherically symmetric spacetimes within a broad class of generalized entropy models. In addition, by employing the entropy representation for the Reissner--Nordstr\"{o}m (RN) black hole, we determine a concise curvature functional that depends only on this representation and its derivatives. A general flatness condition is derived, demonstrating that when the entropy Hessian metric is regular and nondegenerate, both homogeneous power-law transformations and a separate logarithmic branch leave the RN black hole's Ruppeiner geometry flat. On the other hand, R\'{e}nyi, Sharma-Mittal, Kaniadakis, and LQG-inspired entropy deformations typically give rise to nonvanishing curvature in the regular thermodynamic regime, demonstrating that the extremality of the RN black hole does not by itself require a curvature divergence.

一句话导读：在广义熵框架下为静态球对称黑洞导出第一定律与Smarr型关系，并分析RN黑洞Ruppeiner曲率与平坦条件。

用 Class S 理论对 Swampland 界限进行压力测试

Stress-Testing Swampland Bounds with Class S Theories

Gabriel Fenati, Miguel Montero, Irene Valenzuela · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们利用 CFT 对偶，在 AdS$_5$ 引力时空中检验 CFT 的 Sharpened Distance Conjecture (SharpDC) 以及 Refined Distance Conjecture (RDC)。前者给出了共形流形中无穷远处变轻的态塔的指数质量衰减率的下界，后者则限制了在态塔指数行为出现之前可穿越的体场范围。我们证明，对于任意具有有限数目 $M$ 个规范因子且单圈 $\beta$ 函数为零的大 $N$ 拉氏量超对称规范理论，SharpDC 成立。我们还研究了它在大中心荷极限下是否普遍成立，发现并非如此：我们给出 Class S 理论中的具体例子，在 $M\rightarrow\infty$、$N$ 固定的极限下该猜想被违反，此时体内部几何的尺度远大于 AdS 曲率尺度。我们还检验了无穿刺 Class S 理论模空间在大 $N$ 极限下的 RDC，表明它等价于对亏格 $g$ 黎曼曲面模空间 Weil-Petersson 直径的一个精确上界。该上界与迄今所有数学文献一致，但尚未被证明。

English: We test the Sharpened Distance Conjecture (SharpDC) for CFTs, as well as the Refined Distance Conjecture (RDC), in AdS$_5$ gravitational spacetimes, using the CFT dual. The former provides a lower bound on the exponential mass decay rate of the tower of states becoming light at infinite distance in the conformal manifold, while the latter bounds the bulk field range that can be traversed before the exponential behaviour of the tower kicks in. We prove the SharpDC for any large $N$ Lagrangian supersymmetric gauge theory with a finite number $M$ of gauge factors and vanishing one-loop $\beta$-function. We also investigate whether it universally holds in the limits of large central charge, finding that it does not: We exhibit concrete examples in Class S theories where the conjecture is violated in the $M\rightarrow\infty$ limit with $N$ fixed, where the size of the bulk internal geometry is much larger than the AdS curvature scale. We also test the RDC in the moduli space of Class S theories without punctures in the large $N$ limit, showing that it amounts to a precise upper bound on the Weil-Petersson diameter of the moduli space of Riemann surfaces of genus $g$. This bound is consistent with all the mathematical literature up to date, but so far remains unproven.

一句话导读：在 AdS$_5$/CFT 对偶框架下检验 Swampland 距离猜想：证明一大类大 $N$ 规范理论中 SharpDC 成立，并在 Class S 理论的 $M\to\infty$ 极限找到违反，同时将 RDC 化为 Weil-Petersson 直径上界。

弯曲时空中的色-运动学对偶与双拷贝

Color-Kinematics Duality and the Double Copy in Curved Spacetimes

Mariana Carrillo Gonz\'alez · hep-th, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：双拷贝将引力数据与规范理论数据联系起来，最鲜明地体现为平直空间散射振幅的色-运动学对偶。本综述考察这一思想在超越渐近平直背景时能在多大程度上被表述。在回顾用于比较的平直空间要素之后，我们描述 AdS、dS 以及其他非平凡背景中边界关联函数和散射可观测量的弯曲空间构造。随后我们回顾经典和场论层面的映射，包括 Kerr-Schild、Weyl、Cotton、扭量和卷积双拷贝。另有一部分专门讨论自对偶部门。全文强调那些从平直空间保留下来的共同结构，以及曲率带来的阻碍。

English: The double copy relates gravitational data to gauge-theory data, most sharply through color-kinematics duality for flat-space scattering amplitudes. This review surveys the extent to which this idea can be formulated beyond asymptotically flat backgrounds. After recalling the flat-space ingredients needed for comparison, we describe curved-space constructions for boundary correlators and scattering observables in AdS, dS, and other non-trivial backgrounds. We then review classical and field-level maps, including Kerr--Schild, Weyl, Cotton, twistor, and convolutional double copies. A separate part is devoted to self-dual sectors. Throughout, we emphasize both the common structures that survive from flat space and the obstructions introduced by curvature.

一句话导读：综述色-运动学对偶与双拷贝在 AdS、dS 等弯曲时空中的推广，涵盖边界关联函数、散射及经典/场论映射。

强耦合下的能量-能量关联子

Energy-Energy Correlators at Strong Coupling

Max Jackson, Lecheng Ren, Bo Wang, Congkao Wen · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究平面极限的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中强 't Hooft 耦合 λ 下的能量-能量关联子（EEC）。我们考虑由任意维度 p 的半BPS算符产生的态中的 EEC，并从带有 Kaluza-Klein 外部态的 AdS Virasoro-Shapiro 振幅的世界面表示出发，确定相应的事件形状函数至 λ^{-3/2} 阶。对于 p=2，我们计算第二曲率修正，从而完成至 λ^{-2} 阶的 EEC；新贡献改善了与最近导出的中间耦合非微扰界的一致性。我们进一步发展了一种互补方法，从 AdS Virasoro-Shapiro 振幅低能展开的 Wilson 系数直接提取 EEC 的强耦合展开系数，并发现两种方法完全一致。

English: We study energy-energy correlators (EEC) in planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory at strong 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$. We consider the EEC in states created by half-BPS operators of arbitrary dimension $p$, and determine the corresponding event-shape function up to order $\lambda^{-3/2}$ from the worldsheet representation of the AdS Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude with Kaluza-Klein external states. For $p=2$ we compute the second curvature correction, which completes the EEC through order $\lambda^{-2}$; the new contribution improves the agreement with recently derived non-perturbative bounds at intermediate coupling. We further develop a complementary method in which the strong-coupling expansion coefficients of the EEC are extracted directly from the Wilson coefficients of low-energy expansion of the AdS Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude, and find the two approaches in perfect agreement.

一句话导读：在 N=4 SYM 强耦合下，利用 AdS Virasoro-Shapiro 振幅的世界面表示计算 EEC 至高阶，并给出互补的 Wilson 系数提取方法。

全局 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中的边界能量密度与零测地传播

Boundary Energy Density and Null Propagation in Global AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$

Shiki Yoshikawa · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究了全局 AdS$_3$ 中的体传播如何反映在对偶于柱面上的 CFT$_2$ 的边界能量密度中。全局几何的一个关键特征（在 Poincaré 补丁描述中不存在）是：从边界发射的零激发在 $\Delta\tau=\pi$ 后到达对跖边界点，并在 $\Delta\tau=2\pi$ 后返回原边界点。我们证明 CFT 能量密度通过两个沿边界光锥方向运动的手征峰重现这一序列，这两个峰在对跖点相遇，并在一个全局周期后返回原点。对于波包态，领头能量密度由两个沿边界光锥方向运动的手征峰组成；它们的相对权重编码了相应体零测地线的碰撞参数。对于由大共形维数算符并带欧几里得时间正则化构造的态（LCD 态），精确的柱面应力张量给出两个沿边界光锥方向运动的周期性手征脉冲。这些脉冲到达对跖点并返回原点，其全局时间与体中径向零测地线相同。因此，边界能量密度提供了一个随时间变化的边界剖面，反映了 AdS$_3$ 中零传播的特征全局性质。

English: We study how bulk propagation in global AdS$_3$ is reflected in boundary energy densities of the dual CFT$_2$ on the cylinder. A key feature of the global geometry, which is absent in the Poincar\'e-patch description, is that a null excitation emitted from the boundary reaches the antipodal boundary point after $\Delta\tau=\pi$ and returns to the original boundary point after $\Delta\tau=2\pi$. We show that the CFT energy density reproduces this sequence through two chiral peaks that move along the boundary light-cone directions, meet at the antipodal point, and return to the original point after one global period. For a wave-packet state, the leading energy density consists of two chiral peaks moving along the boundary light-cone directions; their relative weights encode the impact parameter of the corresponding bulk null ray. For a state constructed from an operator of large conformal dimension with a Euclidean time regulator (LCD state), the exact cylinder stress tensor gives two periodic chiral pulses moving along the boundary light-cone directions. These pulses reach the antipodal point and return to the original point at the same global times as the radial null geodesic in the bulk. Thus the boundary energy density provides a time-dependent boundary profile that reflects characteristic global features of null propagation in AdS$_3$.

一句话导读：全局 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中，边界能量密度的两个手征峰按体径向零测地线的全局时间到达对跖点并返回，反映零传播的全局特征。

用等变局域化探测黑洞

Probing black holes with equivariant localization

中文摘要：我们引入等变局域化作为一种计算超引力背景中探针膜作用量的方法。我们将其应用于 IIB 型超引力中的超对称探针 D3 膜，这些背景由环面 Sasaki-Einstein 空间上提升 Kerr-Newman-AdS5 黑洞得到。取决于它们缠绕的闭链，这些膜代表一大类四维 N=1 quiver 超共形场论超共形指标的非微扰修正或缺陷算符插入。所得作用量化为等变积分，并且可以完全由环面数据计算。

English: We introduce equivariant localization as a method for computing the action of probe branes in supergravity backgrounds. We apply it to supersymmetric probe D3-branes in type IIB supersymmetric spacetimes obtained by uplifting the Kerr-Newman-AdS$_5$ black hole on a toric Sasaki-Einstein space. Depending on the cycles they wrap, such branes represent non-perturbative corrections to or defect operator insertions in the superconformal index of a large family of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ quiver superconformal field theories. The resulting action reduces to equivariant integrals and can be evaluated entirely from toric data.

关于《费曼引力讲义》的一则注记

A Note on the Feynman Lectures on Gravitation

Satoshi Nakajima · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：遵循费曼的引力讲义，我们考虑平直时空中的引力（无质量自旋-2）场理论，并给出引力场的三阶和四阶拉格朗日密度。特别地，我们给出了三阶拉格朗日密度的详细计算。我们指出，费曼给出的三阶拉格朗日密度表达式并不是费曼所要求三阶拉格朗日密度必须满足的条件的一个解。然而，费曼的三阶拉格朗日密度给出了正确的近日点进动。

English: Following Feynman's lectures on gravitation, we consider the theory of the gravitational (massless spin-2) field in flat spacetime and present the third- and fourth-order Lagrangian densities for the gravitational field. In particular, we present detailed calculations for the third-order Lagrangian density. We point out that the expression for the third-order Lagrangian density which Feynman provided is not a solution of Feynman's condition that the third-order Lagrangian density must satisfy. However, Feynman's third-order Lagrangian density gives the correct perihelion shift.

一句话导读：重新审视费曼引力讲义中的高阶拉格朗日密度，指出其三阶表达式不满足费曼条件但仍给出正确近日点进动。

规范与引力理论的规则基与 Floquet 基：一种非微扰方法

Regular and Floquet bases for gauge and gravity theories: a non perturbative approach

Davide Fioravanti, Marco Rossi · hep-th, gr-qc, nlin.SI · v2 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：本文对 Heun 型方程（Heun 方程及其合流与退化形式）中的基变换给出物理解释，即从在两个奇异点衰减的解变换到 Floquet 解。这些连接关系中的一个关键要素是 Floquet 解在通过（非）正则奇异点时获得的相位。我们利用一种新颖的“kink 方法”，将解的量子动量计算为收敛级数，显式给出到所有阶。因此，通过逐项积分 Floquet 解，所获得的相位也可以显式地表示为级数。鉴于 Heun 方程及其合流描述了 Nekrasov-Shatashvili（NS）背景下的 N=2 超对称 Yang-Mills（SYM）理论（对应于 Seiberg-Witten 微分的量子化）以及黑洞扰动理论，可以在两个领域中建立检验和预言。具体而言，我们进行了关键验证，将所获得的相位与对偶规范周期 A_D 匹配。在引力方面，我们的显式且系统的结果与用于分析 Teukolsky 或 Regge-Wheeler 方程的标准方法一致。该过程为瞬子计算和引力计算提供了一种有效替代方案。最终，它标志着建立可积性与引力量之间字典的初步步骤。

English: This paper presents physical interpretations of the change of basis in Heun-type equations (Heun's and their confluences and reductions) from solutions decaying at two singular points to Floquet solutions. A crucial element in these connection relations is the phase acquired by Floquet solutions when transitioning between (ir)regular singularities. We exploit a novel `kink method' to compute the quantum momentum of the solutions as convergent series, explicitly at all orders. Consequently, by integrating the Floquet solutions term by term, the acquired phase can be explicitly derived as a series as well. Given that Heun equations and their confluences describe ${\cal N}=2$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills (SYM) theories in the Nekrasov-Shatashvili (NS) background (corresponding to the quantization of Seiberg-Witten differentials) as well as black hole perturbation theory, tests and predictions can be established in both domains. Specifically, we perform a critical verification matching the acquired phase with the dual gauge period, $A_D$. On the gravity side, our explicit and systematic results agree with standard methods used to analyse the Teukolsky or Regge-Wheeler equations. This procedure provides an effective alternative to instanton and gravity computations. Ultimately, it marks the initial steps toward establishing a dictionary between integrability and gravitational quantities.

一句话导读：用 kink 方法显式计算 Heun 方程的 Floquet 基变换相位，并联系 N=2 SYM 对偶周期与黑洞扰动方程。

Palatini Kalb-Ramond 引力中的一个精确转动黑洞解

An exact rotating black hole solution in Palatini Kalb-Ramond gravity

A. A. Ara\'{u}jo Filho · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们构造了零宇宙学常数的度规仿射 Kalb-Ramond 引力中的一个精确稳态轴对称真空构型。对度规、联络与反对称场分别变分，得到完整场方程以及物理几何与辅助几何之间的代数关系。一个 Kerr 辅助度规和一个具有固定正范数的闭合共转真空二形式确定物理度规。张量核包含视界生成元，并且对于不相等的形变因子，度规、独立联络和真空场在非极端物理 Killing 视界与有限半径转动轴处具有光滑延拓。我们得到一个显式充分区域，用于因果外部以及在固定非极角下的渐近局部平坦端。物理哈密顿量给出类时与零测地线方程、赤道有效势、圆轨道性质、径向稳定性与近日点进动。数值光子演化确定了正交观察者屏幕上的临界曲线。在固定归一化质量标度和自旋下，它的大小、形状与质心依赖于 ε = ξ2 b^2/[2(1+ξ1 b^2)]，在 ε = 0 时恢复 Kerr。几何观测探测这一组合，并在曲率耦合之间保留精确简并。与水星的静态赤道比较，在所述角度约定和质量设定下，给出 |2ε| 的条件敏感度为 2.30×10^-11。

English: We construct an exact stationary axisymmetric vacuum configuration in metric affine Kalb-Ramond gravity with zero cosmological constant. Independent variation of the metric, connection, and antisymmetric field yields the complete field equations and the algebraic relation between the physical and auxiliary geometries. A Kerr auxiliary metric and a closed corotating vacuum two form of fixed positive norm determine the physical metric. The tensor kernel contains the horizon generator, and the metrics, independent connection, and vacuum field share a smooth extension across the nonextremal physical Killing horizon and the rotation axes at finite radius for unequal deformation factors. We obtain an explicit sufficient domain for a causal exterior and an asymptotically locally flat end at fixed nonpolar angles. The physical Hamiltonian yields the timelike and null equations, equatorial effective potentials, circular orbit properties, radial stability, and perihelion advance. Numerical photon evolution determines the critical curve on an orthonormal observer screen. Its size, shape, and centroid depend on $\epsilon=\xi_2b^2/[2(1+\xi_1b^2)]$ at fixed normalized mass scale and spin, with Kerr recovered at $\epsilon=0$. Geometric observations probe this combination and retain an exact degeneracy between the curvature couplings. A static equatorial comparison with Mercury gives a conditional sensitivity of $2.30\times10^{-11}$ for $|2\epsilon|$ under the stated angular convention and mass setting.

一句话导读：在 Palatini Kalb-Ramond 引力中构造精确转动黑洞解，并分析其因果性、测地线、光子临界曲线与曲率耦合简并。

弛豫暗能量：组分动力学与宇宙加速的未来

Relaxation Dark Energy: Compositional Dynamics and the Future of Cosmic Acceleration

Gianmassimo Tasinato · astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：如果宇宙加速由正宇宙学常数驱动，宇宙将趋近永恒加速的 de Sitter 态，其在量子引力中的解释仍不明确。我们发展了一个框架，其中加速反而是暗部门向组分平衡弛豫的暂现阶段：物质与暗能量趋近于一个静止的密度比，最终像无压物质一样稀释。受线性响应理论和 Onsager 近平衡回归假设指导，我们通过一个衡量偏离平衡的组分变量来描述此演化。将常数分数弛豫扩展到完整背景演化，得到暗能量状态方程 w=w0 a^{-n}，其中 n 是每 e-fold 膨胀的弛豫率。此历史将早期暗能量压制、向上 phantom 穿越和密度极大值与无压标度未来联系起来。使用 DESI DR2 BAO 和 Planck 距离先验，以及有/无三种替代超新星汇编，我们发现相对于常数 w，非零弛豫有名义 2.6–3.6σ 偏好。组分框架还启发了线性扰动的本构规定，该规定在 phantom 穿越处保持正则。近平衡时，正则长波长组分扰动以背景速率领头阶弛豫，而小尺度涨落以阻尼声波传播。然而，我们证明对于分别守恒的物质和暗能量，逐点本构关系无法在其完整过去演化中维持一个正则、梯度稳定的负压分支。我们探索压力响应的修改及其与邻近均匀历史的相容性，识别将近平衡描述扩展到完整宇宙演化的要求。

English: If cosmic acceleration is driven by a positive cosmological constant, the universe approaches an eternally accelerating de Sitter state, whose interpretation in quantum gravity remains elusive. We develop a framework in which acceleration is instead a transient stage of dark-sector relaxation towards compositional equilibrium: matter and dark energy approach a stationary density ratio, eventually diluting like pressureless matter. Guided by linear response theory and Onsager's near-equilibrium regression hypothesis, we describe this evolution through a composition variable measuring departure from equilibrium. Extending constant fractional relaxation to the full background evolution yields the dark-energy equation of state $w=w_0a^{-n}$, where $n$ is the relaxation rate per e-fold of expansion. This history connects early dark-energy suppression, an upward phantom crossing and a density maximum to a pressureless scaling future. Using DESI DR2 BAO and Planck distance priors, with and without three alternative supernova compilations, we find a nominal $2.6$--$3.6\sigma$ preference for nonzero relaxation over constant $w$. The composition framework also motivates a constitutive prescription for linear perturbations that remains regular at phantom crossing. Near equilibrium, regular long-wavelength composition disturbances relax at the background rate to leading order, while small-scale fluctuations propagate as damped sound waves. We prove, however, that for separately conserved matter and dark energy, the pointwise constitutive relation cannot sustain a regular, gradient-stable negative-pressure branch throughout its full past evolution. We explore modifications of the pressure response and their consistency with neighbouring homogeneous histories, identifying requirements for extending the near-equilibrium description to the full cosmological evolution.

一句话导读：提出暗能量作为暗部门组分弛豫的模型，给出 w=w0 a^{-n}，并讨论 DESI/Planck/SNe 数据偏好及扰动稳定性限制。

引力学校：从运动到骚动

The School on Gravity: from motion to commotion

Vitor Cardoso, Jose Mar\'ia Ezquiaga, Julio Parra-Martinez, Laura Sberna, Gustavo J. Turiaci, Lieke van Son · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：理解引力相互作用是21世纪伟大的科学事业之一。2015年诺贝尔奖获奖的引力波发现，以及随后 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组的探测，标志着物理学和天体物理学革命性的一步，为探索宇宙打开了一个全新窗口。这些探测器的未来升级，以及 LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和射电与光学仪器等即将建成的设施，有望带来下一代科学家需要解读的其他突破性发现。引力学校（2026年6月22—26日，哥本哈根）旨在向具有广义相对论背景的青年科学家——研究生和高年级本科生——介绍引力波物理这一激动人心的新领域中广泛的基础主题。主题涵盖从运动理论，到量子物理带来的新挑战，再到黑洞天体物理和引力波探测器源建模。引力学校在尼尔斯·玻尔研究所传奇的A报告厅举行，邀请学生和讲师以在这同一房间展开的量子革命精神，挑战当前引力物理范式。这些讲义旨在将A报告厅中提出的那些新思想开放给更广泛的科学界。

English: Understanding the gravitational interaction is one of the great scientific endeavors of the 21st century. The Nobel Prize-winning discovery of gravitational waves in 2015, and subsequent detections by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration, have marked a revolutionary step forward in physics and astrophysics by opening an entirely new window for exploring the Universe. Future upgrades to these detectors, along with upcoming facilities such as LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and radio and optical instruments, promise other breakthrough discoveries that the next generation of scientists will need to interpret. The School on Gravity (22--26 June 2026, Copenhagen) aimed to introduce junior scientists--graduate students and advanced undergraduates with a background in general relativity--to a wide range of foundational topics in the exciting new field of gravitational-wave physics. Topics spanned from the theory of motion, to new challenges introduced by quantum physics, to the astrophysics of black holes and source modeling for gravitational-wave detectors. The School on Gravity took place at the legendary Auditorium A of the Niels Bohr Institute, inviting students and lecturers to challenge current paradigms in gravitational physics in the spirit of the quantum revolution that unfolded in this very room. These lecture notes aim at opening up those new ideas presented in Auditorium A to the rest of the scientific community.

一句话导读：哥本哈根引力学校讲义，概述引力波物理从运动理论、量子挑战到黑洞天体物理与源建模的基础主题。

黑洞磁层的电阻对齐

Resistive alignment of a black-hole magnetosphere

Ruben Lier, Oliver Porth · astro-ph.HE, hep-th, physics.plasm-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：最近的数值模拟表明，黑洞磁层会迅速演化至磁轴与自旋轴对齐，但该过程的物理起源仍不清楚。我们在电阻相对论磁流体力学框架下发展了这种对齐的解析理论。以慢自旋的 Blandford-Znajek 单极解作为外部磁场，我们将感应方程约化为电流片倾角的弛豫方程。分析表明，对齐源于 Blandford-Znajek 解中的二阶自旋效应与显式电阻耗散的共同作用。我们用多个自旋和电阻率的电阻 GRMHD 模拟检验了这一预言，并找到一个区域，其中测得的晚期长期衰减与解析预言定量一致。

English: Recent numerical simulations have shown that black-hole magnetospheres evolve rapidly toward alignment between the magnetic axis and spin axis but the physical origin of this process has remained unclear. We develop an analytic theory of this alignment within resistive relativistic magnetohydrodynamics. Taking the slow-spin Blandford-Znajek monopole solution as the exterior magnetic field, we reduce the induction equation to a relaxation equation for the current-sheet inclination angle. Our analysis shows that alignment results from second-order spin effects in the Blandford-Znajek solution combined with explicit resistive dissipation. We test this prediction using resistive-GRMHD simulations at several spins and resistivities and find a regime in which the measured late-time secular decay agrees quantitatively with the analytic prediction.

一句话导读：在电阻相对论磁流体力学中提出黑洞磁层磁轴-自旋轴对齐的解析理论，并用GRMHD模拟验证二阶自旋效应与电阻耗散的作用。

窄带宇宙磁场产生的随机引力波

Stochastic gravitational waves from narrow-band cosmological magnetic fields

Abdias Aires, Tatsuya Daniel · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们计算了由具有窄带功率谱的宇宙磁场产生的引力波谱。对于在一个共动波数 $k_c$ 处窄峰化的谱，我们发现引力波信号在 $2k_c$ 处达到峰值，并在此尺度处具有陡峭截断。我们将此结果应用于一个在复合时期前后运行的超轻暗物质磁成因模型，其中轴子-光子耦合通过参量共振产生螺旋磁场。我们确定了所产生的引力波进入脉冲星计时实验频率范围的条件。尽管对于足够大的耦合可以达到所需频率，但在物理允许的磁场能量密度下，相应的振幅低于实验灵敏度。我们将此结论推广到在其他时期运行的磁成因模型，估计 $T \simeq 160 \mathrm{MeV}$ 是一个假定为脉冲星计时阵列所暗示的随机引力波背景来源的磁成因过程的温度。我们对这类可行模型给出下界 $T \gtrsim 1$-$10 \mathrm{MeV}$。

English: We calculate the spectrum of gravitational waves generated by a cosmological magnetic field with a narrow-band power spectrum. For a spectrum narrowly peaked at a comoving wavenumber $k_c$, we find that the gravitational wave signal peaks at $2k_c$ and has a sharp cutoff at this scale. We apply this result to an ultralight dark matter model of magnetogenesis operating around recombination, in which an axion-photon coupling generates a helical magnetic field by parametric resonance. We determine the conditions for the resulting gravitational waves to enter the frequency range of pulsar timing experiments. Although the required frequency can be reached for sufficiently large coupling, the corresponding amplitude is below the experimental sensitivity for physically allowed energy densities of the magnetic field. We generalize this conclusion to models of magnetogenesis operating at other epochs, estimating as $T \simeq 160 \mathrm{MeV}$ the temperature of a magnetogenesis process assumed to be the source of the stochastic gravitational wave background suggested by pulsar timing arrays. We place the lower bound $T \gtrsim 1$-$10 \mathrm{MeV}$ on such viable models.

渐近以太失配与普适视界力学

Asymptotic AEther Misalignment and Universal-Horizon Mechanics

Walter Arata, Moustafa Ismail, Stefano Liberati, David Mattingly, Luke Martin, Giulio Neri · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：普适视界甚至能困住任意快的信号，为具有优选时间方向的理论中的黑洞热力学提供了检验。在 Einstein-aether 理论中，该方向由动力学场“以太”定义，而以太相对于无穷远处静止时间可以并不对齐。特别地，对于渐近反 de Sitter 黑洞，当存在这种以太渐近倾斜时，此前无法恢复黑洞力学第一定律。本文针对一个精确的静态球对称解族解决了该问题。我们利用协变相空间形式体系，将以太的渐近倾斜和衰减部分识别为边界源及其共轭响应。允许二者独立变化会阻碍定义产生时间平移的能量。固定其中任一量，或对它们施加关系，可恢复该能量；而外部改变边界数据会向第一定律引入功。固定源或固定其响应得到的能量通过 Legendre 变换相联系。在普适视界处，热量包括度规面积贡献和不可约的以太能量通量。所得平衡将无穷远处的功与视界热量分开，并解释了为何物理温度一般不能从黑洞质量中面积变分的系数推断出来。

English: Universal horizons trap even arbitrarily fast signals, providing a test of black-hole thermodynamics in theories with a preferred time direction. In Einstein--aether theory, this direction is defined by a dynamical field, the aether, that can remain non-aligned relative to stationary time at infinity. In particular, for asymptotically anti-de Sitter black holes, it was so far impossible to recover a first law of black-hole mechanics when such asymptotic tilt of the aether is present. Here, we resolve this issue for an exact family of static, spherically symmetric solutions. Using the covariant phase-space formalism, we identify the asymptotic tilt and the decaying part of the aether field as a boundary source and its conjugate response. Allowing both to vary independently obstructs the definition of an energy that generates time translations. Fixing either quantity, or imposing a relation between them, restores such an energy, while externally varying the boundary data introduces work into the first law. The energies obtained by fixing the source or its response are related by a Legendre transformation. At the universal horizon, heat includes both the metric area contribution and an irreducible aether energy flux. The resulting balance separates work at infinity from horizon heat and explains why the physical temperature cannot generally be inferred from the coefficient of an area variation in the black-hole mass.

一句话导读：在 Einstein-aether 理论中，针对渐近 AdS 黑洞的以太渐近倾斜，用协变相空间重建第一定律，并将普适视界热量分解为面积项与不可约以太能流。

A universal sector of $\mathcal{N}=1$ class $\mathcal{S}$ spectra

Ritabrata Bhattacharya, Abhay Katyal, Oscar Varela · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们确定了由 M5-膜包裹在紧致双曲 Riemann 面 Σ2 上产生的四维 N=1 class S 超共形场论中轻算子谱的一个普适部分。我们在 large N 下工作，分析对偶 Bah-Beem-Bobev-Wecht anti-de Sitter 背景附近、任意 twist 参数 z 的 Kaluza-Klein 涨落。为得到这些谱，我们通过施加合适的 z-依赖广义 G-结构，将最近导出的质量算子特殊化到在 Σ2 上为常数的模式。随后我们将所得本征态组织成具有确定味量子数的长和受保护 N=1 超多重态。随着 z 变化，谱中涌现出丰富模式，包括孤立多重态和无限多重态塔，我们对其作解析刻画。

English: We determine a universal sector of the spectrum of light operators in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ class $\mathcal{S}$ superconformal field theories arising from M5-branes wrapped on a compact hyperbolic Riemann surface $\Sigma_2$. We work at large $N$, analysing Kaluza--Klein fluctuations about the dual Bah--Beem--Bobev--Wecht anti-de Sitter backgrounds for general values of the twist parameter $z$. To obtain these spectra, we specialise recently derived mass operators to modes that are constant on $\Sigma_2$ by imposing a suitable $z$-dependent generalised $G$-structure. We then organise the resulting eigenstates into long and protected $\mathcal{N}=1$ supermultiplets with definite flavour quantum numbers. As $z$ varies, rich patterns emerge in the spectrum, including both isolated multiplets and infinite towers of multiplets, which we characterise analytically.

一句话导读：在 large N 下分析 M5-膜包裹双曲 Riemann 面所得 N=1 class S SCFT 对偶 AdS 背景的 Kaluza-Klein 涨落，给出轻算子谱的普适部分并组织为 N=1 超多重态。

相关度：low — 该文属于 AdS/CFT 基础谱学与 class S 对偶研究，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等具体方向。

部分维度约化下 JT 引力中的反射熵与岛屿

Reflected entropy and islands in JT gravity from partial dimensional reduction

Debarshi Basu, Himanshu Chourasiya · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究在 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力耦合非引力浴时，混合态关联如何跨越岛屿转变重新组织。利用双全息的部分维度约化实现，我们计算了真空以及永恒黑洞热场双态中相邻和不相交辐射区域的反射熵。反射熵探测纠缠楔的内部划分，因此能分辨普通 Page 曲线不可见的结构：即使并集的熵鞍点保持不变，其主导鞍点也可以改变；当纠缠楔断开时，它在领头阶消失。我们表明，低维反射熵-岛屿描述在动力学膜涨落的领头阶与高维缺陷-极值曲面图像一致。有限角度比较进一步提示在线性阶上岛屿与膜端点的投影协变识别。由此得到的类 Page 曲线和 Markov gap 为岛屿转变过程中纯化重组以及非马尔可夫、多体关联结构提供了几何探针。

English: We study how mixed-state correlations reorganize across island transitions in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity coupled to a non-gravitating bath. Using the partial-dimensional-reduction realization of double holography, we compute reflected entropy for adjacent and disjoint radiation regions in the vacuum and in the thermofield-double state of an eternal black hole. Reflected entropy probes the internal partition of the entanglement wedge and therefore resolves structure that is invisible to the ordinary Page curve: its dominant saddle can change even when the entropy saddle of the union remains fixed, and it vanishes at leading order when the entanglement wedge disconnects. We show that the lower-dimensional reflected-island description agrees, to leading order in the dynamical brane fluctuation, with the higher-dimensional defect-extremal-surface picture. The finite-angle comparison further suggests a projection-covariant identification of island and brane endpoints at linear order. The resulting Page-like curves and Markov gaps provide a geometric probe of the reorganization of the purification and of non-Markovian, multipartite correlation structure during island transitions.

一句话导读：利用部分维度约化在 JT 引力中计算反射熵，揭示岛屿转变时纠缠楔内部结构的重组，并与高维缺陷极值曲面图像一致。

相关度：medium — 属于 JT/AdS2 与黑洞信息、全息纠缠方向，涉及岛屿与反射熵；但未直接匹配所列重点标签（如全息超导、multi-trace、QNM 等）。

从 DSSYK 谱边缘得到 q-形变 Weil-Petersson 体积及超对称推广

$q$-deformed Weil-Petersson Volumes from the Spectral Edge of DSSYK and Supersymmetric Extensions

Wasif Ahmed, Joydeep Naskar, Krishan Saraswat · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：Do 与 Norbury 的 q-形变 Weil-Petersson 体积是 Okuyama 离散体积的最高次部分，后者由双标度 SYK（DSSYK）模型谱曲线上的拓扑递归定义。我们表明，同样的 q-形变体积可以从一个双标度矩阵模型得到，其圆盘密度通过放大 DSSYK 密度的软边缘得到。将相同步骤应用于 N=1 DSSYK 的硬边缘，我们得到候选的 q-形变 N=1 超 Weil-Petersson 体积。它们是固定次数的多项式，并在标度 q→1 极限下退化为 N=1 超 Weil-Petersson 体积。这些候选体积与 Do 和 Norbury 在 (arXiv:2510.12431) 中的 N=1 体积相差我们称为“无关”的贡献，这些贡献在标度 q→1 极限下恰好消失。这些结果共同表明，q-形变体积可以自然地与各种 DSSYK 模型的谱边缘相关联，并提供了一种在超对称情形下构造它们的直观方法。

English: The $q$-deformed Weil-Petersson volumes of Do and Norbury are the top-degree parts of Okuyama's discrete volumes, which are defined by topological recursion on the spectral curve of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We show that the same q-deformed volumes can be obtained from a double-scaled matrix model whose disk density is found by zooming in on the soft edges of the DSSYK density. Applying the same procedure to the hard edge of $\mathcal{N}=1$ DSSYK, we obtain candidate $q$-deformed $\mathcal{N}=1$ super Weil-Petersson volumes. They are polynomials of fixed degree, and they reduce to the $\mathcal{N}=1$ super Weil-Petersson volumes in a scaled $q\to1$ limit. These candidate volumes differ from the $\mathcal{N}=1$ volumes of Do and Norbury in (arXiv:2510.12431) up to what we call "irrelevant" contributions which exactly vanish in the scaled $q\to 1$ limit. Together, these results demonstrate how q-deformed volumes can be naturally associated to the spectral edges of various DSSYK models and provides an intuitive way to construct them in supersymmetric contexts.

一句话导读：通过 DSSYK 谱边缘构造 q-形变 Weil-Petersson 体积，并推广到 N=1 超对称情形。

全息超导体中的反常诱导输运

Anomaly induced transport in holographic superconductors

Ashis Tamang, Nishal Rai, Javier Esteban, Eugenio Megias · hep-th, cond-mat.supr-con, hep-ph, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究了表现出自发对称破缺的全息超导体的反常诱导输运性质。该全息模型包含矢量与轴矢量规范场、一个额外的非反常 U(1) 对称性，以及驱动相变的带电标量场。在探针极限下，我们针对两种可选的标量场量子化（对应标度维度 Δ=1 和 Δ=3 的算符，分别记为 O1 和 O2 理论）数值构造了超导背景。利用 Kubo 公式，我们计算了手征磁导率，并考察其对标量凝聚的响应。结果表明，自发对称破缺使反常诱导输运超出反常流范围，并显著影响非反常部门。值得注意的是，该效应在两种理论中都出现，表明对非反常部门的影响不依赖于所选量子化。将数值结果与 O_i→0 和 O_i→∞（i=1,2）的解析极限比较，显示两种理论中行为一致。

English: We investigate the anomaly-induced transport properties of a holographic superconductor exhibiting spontaneous symmetry breaking. The holographic model incorporates vector and axial gauge fields, an additional non-anomalous $U(1)$ symmetry, and a charged scalar field that drives the phase transition. Working in the probe limit, we numerically construct the superconducting background under two alternative scalar field quantizations, corresponding to operators with scaling dimensions $\Delta=1$ and $\Delta=3$ (denoted as the $O_1$ and $O_2$ theories, respectively). Using Kubo formulae, we compute the chiral magnetic conductivities and examine their response to the scalar condensate. Our findings demonstrate that spontaneous symmetry breaking allows anomaly-induced transport to extend beyond anomalous currents, significantly impacting the non-anomalous sector as well. Remarkably, this effect appears in both theories, indicating that the influence on the non-anomalous sector is independent of the chosen quantization. The comparison of our numerical results with the analytical limits for $O_i \to 0$ and $O_i \to \infty$ $(i=1,2)$ reveals consistent behavior across both theories.

一句话导读：在探针极限下研究含矢量/轴矢量规范场与带电标量的全息超导体，发现自发对称破缺使反常诱导输运影响非反常 U(1) 部门，且 O1/O2 两种量子化下行为一致。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究全息超导体的反常诱导输运、手征磁导率和标量凝聚，属于“全息超流超导”重点方向；探针极限、Kubo 公式及 O1/O2 量子化比较也与全息凝聚态研究密切相关。

N=2 超 Weil-Petersson 体积的离散类似物

A discrete analogue of $\mathscr{N}=2$ super Weil-Petersson volumes

Wasif Ahmed, Joydeep Naskar · hep-th, math-ph, math.AG, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们从 N=2 双标度 SYK 引入一个离散谱曲线，其拓扑递归定义了整数边界长度的拟多项式体积。该曲线有两个边缘理论：低边缘处的局部 N=2 理论和高边缘处的玻色理论。聚焦于局部 N=2 理论，我们计算其有限 q 体积，并独立地用弦方程检验前几个。在 q→1 连续极限下，这些体积恢复 Turiaci 和 Witten 的超 Weil-Petersson 体积。最后，我们在稳定标记曲线模空间上，用带间隙依赖 κ-类修饰的变形自旋类，给出这些局部体积的全亏格相交理论解释。

English: We introduce a discrete spectral curve from $\mathscr{N}=2$ double-scaled SYK whose topological recursion defines quasi-polynomial volumes in integer boundary lengths. The curve has two edge theories: a local $\mathscr{N}=2$ theory at the lower edge and a bosonic theory at the upper edge. Focusing on the local $\mathscr{N}=2$ theory, we compute its finite-$q$ volumes and independently check the first few using the string equation. In the $q\rightarrow 1$ continuum limit, these recover the super Weil-Petersson volumes of Turiaci and Witten. Finally, we give an all-genus intersection-theoretic interpretation of these local volumes on the moduli space of stable marked curves, in terms of a deformed spin class with a gap-dependent $\kappa$-class dressing.

一句话导读：从 N=2 双标度 SYK 的离散谱曲线出发，用拓扑递归定义离散超 Weil-Petersson 体积，并在连续极限回到已知超 Weil-Petersson 体积。

五维爱因斯坦-高斯-博内引力中黑弦的 Gregory-Laflamme 不稳定性

The Gregory-Laflamme Instability of five-dimensional Black Strings in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity

Pau Figueras, \'Aron D. Kov\'acs, Shunhui Yao · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们补充并扩展了最近关于五维时空中 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力下黑弦 Gregory-Laflamme 不稳定性非线性演化的研究。首先，我们研究 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中均匀黑弦的含时微扰，并确定增长率作为耦合常数的函数。我们发现，对于正 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合，黑弦比广义相对论中更不稳定：增长率更大，且更短波长的模式也不稳定。文章第二部分表明，当动力学在渐近平坦方向上限制为球对称时，Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 理论运动方程的双曲性由一个有效度规决定。当有效场论变得强耦合时（如黑弦 Gregory-Laflamme 不稳定性端点附近），该有效度规退化，Cauchy 演化崩溃。将该判据应用于均匀黑弦，我们发现对于任意正 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合，存在一个正则解的开集（包括最小厚度解），其有效度规在视界邻域内退化。因此我们论证，这些解不能通过 Cauchy 演化从弱耦合初值到达，且围绕它们的线性化方程解不能解释为邻近非线性演化的近似。我们用 Gregory-Laflamme 不稳定性的非线性模拟为这一图景提供了进一步证据。非线性模拟因 Tricomi 型或 Keldysh 型双曲性丧失而终止，具体类型取决于 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合的符号。

English: We complement and extend our recent study of the non-linear evolution of the Gregory-Laflamme instability of black strings in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity in five spacetime dimensions. First, we study time-dependent perturbations of uniform black strings in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet theory and determine the growth rates as a function of the coupling. We find that for positive Gauss-Bonnet couplings, the black strings are more unstable than in general relativity in the sense that the growth rates are larger and shorter wavelengths are unstable. In the second part of the paper we show that the hyperbolicity of the equation of motion of Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet theory is determined by an effective metric when the dynamics is restricted to spherical symmetry in the asymptotically flat directions. When the effective field theory becomes strongly coupled, as it happens near the endpoint of the Gregory-Laflamme instability of the black string, this effective metric becomes degenerate and the Cauchy evolution breaks down. Applying this criterion to uniform black strings, we find that for any positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling there is an open set of regular solutions (including the one of minimal thickness) on which the effective metric degenerates in a neighbourhood of the horizon. Therefore, we argue that these solutions cannot be attained from weakly coupled initial data by Cauchy evolution and the solutions of the linearized equations around them cannot be interpreted as approximations to nearby non-linear evolutions. We provide further evidence for this picture with non-linear simulations of the Gregory-Laflamme instability. The non-linear simulations terminate through a loss of hyperbolicity of the Tricomi or Keldysh type, depending on the sign of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling.

一句话导读：研究五维 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中黑弦 Gregory-Laflamme 不稳定性的微扰增长率与非线性演化，指出正耦合下有效度规退化导致 Cauchy 演化失效。

尺度分离 AdS3 中的 G2 解奇与回溯

G2 resolutions and backtracking in scale-separated AdS$_3$

Aviral Aggarwal, Fien Apers, Fotis Farakos · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究在 G2 orientifold 上的 massive IIA 超引力中具有完全模稳定的尺度分离 AdS3 模型。除构造新例子外，我们研究当 G2 环面 orbifold 的奇点被解奇后这些模型的性质。我们展示 blow-up 模可以通过 fluxes 稳定在一个保持尺度分离且处于超引力近似可控的参数区域。我们进一步展示，在奇异 orbifold 描述中表观的 orientifold 相交在这样的解奇空间上不存在。最后，我们用 flux backtracking 分析这类模型的膜对偶图像。我们强调这种分析中的若干有趣特征，例如某些模型中所得流动方程的有限区间解，以及膜模式理想的低能解耦。

English: We study scale-separated AdS$_3$ models with full moduli stabilization in massive IIA supergravity on G2 orientifolds. In addition to constructing new examples, we investigate the properties of these models once the singularities of the G2 toroidal orbifold are resolved. The blow-up moduli are shown to be stabilized using fluxes in a parametric regime that preserves scale separation and control under the supergravity approximation. We further show that the apparent orientifold intersections in the singular orbifold description do not exist on such resolved spaces. Finally, we analyze the brane dual picture of such models using flux backtracking. We highlight several interesting features from such analysis such as a finite interval solution of the resulting flow equations in some of the models and the desirable low-energy decoupling of brane modes.

一句话导读：在 massive IIA/G2 orientifold 中构造并研究完全模稳定的尺度分离 AdS3 模型及其解奇与膜对偶回溯。

精确 SU(N) Einstein-Skyrme 解的鲁棒性：黑洞、虫洞与宇宙学

Robustness of exact $SU(N)$ Einstein-Skyrme solutions: black holes, wormholes and cosmologies

Carla Henr\'iquez-Baez, Perla Medina, Pablo Rodr\'iguez, Aldo Vera · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：SU(2) Skyrme 模型在四维时空与广义相对论耦合时允许精确解。这里我们证明，相关引力构型，如黑洞、虫洞和宇宙学，在推广到具有任意味数的 SU(N) 时仍然稳健。我们表明，关键物理特征，如热力学性质、构型的重子数以及几何，主要由味数以及理论的耦合常数决定。具体而言：第一，我们证明物质含量的增加有利于球对称黑洞的局部热稳定性。第二，对于宇宙学解，我们解析地证明，随着强子物质含量增加，标度因子因增强的引力吸引而增长更慢，而膨胀率（由哈勃参数衡量）因更高的能量密度而增加。第三，我们发现可穿越虫洞解的喉部可以通过增加味数而扩大，因为保持喉部打开所需的能量密度并非无限增长，而是饱和于一个有限值。

English: The $SU(2)$ Skyrme model admits exact solutions when coupled to General Relativity in four spacetime dimensions. Here, we demonstrate that relevant gravitational configurations, such as black holes, wormholes, and cosmologies, are robust under the extension to $SU(N)$ with an arbitrary number of flavors. We show that key physical features, such as the thermodynamic properties, the baryon number of the configurations, and the geometry, are crucially determined by the number of flavors as well as the coupling constants of the theory. In particular: first, we prove that an increase in the matter content favors the local thermal stability of spherically symmetric black holes. Second, for cosmological solutions, we demonstrate analytically that as the hadronic matter content increases, the scale factor grows more slowly due to enhanced gravitational attraction, while the expansion rate (measured by the Hubble parameter) increases as a consequence of the higher energy density. Third, we find that the throat of traversable wormhole solutions can be enlarged by increasing the number of flavors, since the energy density required to keep the throat open does not grow indefinitely but rather saturates at a finite value.

一句话导读：将精确 SU(2) Einstein-Skyrme 解推广至 SU(N)，证明黑洞、虫洞和宇宙学构型对味数增加具有鲁棒性，并分析其热力学、重子数与几何变化。

禁闭背景中的全息 Krylov 复杂度：粒子、弦与标架

Holographic Krylov complexity in confining backgrounds: particle, string, and frames

Jasper Nongmaithem, Deepak Kumar Kar, Ayush Kumar, Shreeya Rajesh Parab, David Dudal, Subhash Mahapatra · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们研究描述禁闭相的 bottom-up 全息 QCD 模型中的全息 Krylov 复杂度，利用最近提出的对应关系：Krylov 复杂度的增长率与探针（如粒子和弦）在体时空中下落时的固有径向动量相对应。作为代表性的禁闭背景，我们考虑两个无视界几何，即伸缩子形变的 AdS-孤子和形变热 AdS 时空，二者均为 Einstein-dilaton 引力系统的解。我们发现，在 Einstein 标架中分析时，大质量粒子对应的 Krylov 复杂度在这两个背景中表现出定性不同的行为。在形变 AdS-孤子几何中，复杂度经历周期性振荡，振荡周期和振幅均依赖于模型参数。相反，在形变热 AdS 几何中，复杂度在晚期指数增长，并且不表现出振荡行为。然后我们研究弦标架中的弦动力学，发现 Krylov 复杂度在两个禁闭背景中都表现出振荡行为。这种行为被追溯到弦标架几何的深红外区出现了一个额外的转向点。受此观察启发，我们进一步分析弦标架中的大质量粒子动力学，发现两个禁闭背景中表现出定性相似的行为。我们的结果表明，禁闭全息系统的 Krylov 复杂度敏感地依赖于探针和标架的选择，同时在弦标架描述中揭示出两个禁闭几何之间更紧密的对应关系。

English: We investigate holographic Krylov complexity in bottom-up holographic QCD models describing the confined phase, using the recently proposed correspondence between the growth rate of Krylov complexity and the proper radial momentum of probes, such as particles and strings, falling in the bulk spacetime. As representative confining backgrounds, we consider two horizonless geometries, namely the dilaton-deformed AdS-soliton and the deformed thermal-AdS spacetime, both arising as solutions of an Einstein-dilaton gravity system. We find that the Krylov complexity associated with a massive particle exhibits qualitatively distinct behavior in these two backgrounds when analyzed in the Einstein frame. In the deformed AdS-soliton geometry, the complexity undergoes periodic oscillations, with both the oscillation period and amplitude depending on the parameters of the model. In contrast, in the deformed thermal-AdS geometry, the complexity grows exponentially at late times and does not display oscillatory behavior. We then investigate string dynamics in the string frame and find that the Krylov complexity exhibits oscillatory behavior in both confining backgrounds. This behavior is traced to the emergence of an additional turning point in the deep infrared of the string-frame geometry. Motivated by this observation, we further analyze massive-particle dynamics in the string frame, where we find qualitatively similar behavior in the two confining backgrounds. Our results demonstrate that the Krylov complexity of confined holographic systems depends sensitively on the choice of probe and frame, while also revealing a closer correspondence between the two confining geometries in the string-frame description.

一句话导读：在两类无视界禁闭全息背景中，Krylov 复杂度的行为敏感依赖探针（粒子/弦）与标架（Einstein/弦标架），弦标架下两者均呈振荡且更趋一致。

相关度：medium — 论文聚焦全息 QCD 禁闭背景中的 Krylov 复杂度，与‘畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀’中的 AdS-孤子背景有间接关联；但未直接涉及全息超导、p波、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 等其余重点支线。

关于量子统计关系与协变相空间哈密顿量

On the quantum statistical relation and the covariant phase space Hamiltonian

Jos\'e Luis V. Cerdeira, Tom\'as Ort\'in · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们展示了在部分场具有规范自由度的理论中如何构造协变相空间哈密顿量。为保证变分原理适定性及其在给定边界条件下精确规范不变性而对作用量添加的边界项，在这种构造中是必不可少的。同样的要素对于在 Gibbons 和 Hawking 的欧几里得量子引力方法框架中使用作用量也至关重要；我们展示了如何用具有这些性质的拉格朗日量构造的壳上作用量来表示协变相空间哈密顿量。我们使用该方案计算了若干理论的哈密顿量，其中一个包含 Chern--Simons 项，并表明在黑洞背景下，该哈密顿量直接给出量子统计关系，包括与非引力荷和化学势相关的项，符合预期。

English: We show how the covariant phase space Hamiltonian can be constructed in theories in which some of the fields have gauge freedoms. The addition to the action of boundary terms that guarantee the well-posedness of a variational principle and its exact gauge invariance for the prescribed boundary conditions turn out to be essential in this construction. The same ingredients are essential in the use of the action in the framework of Gibbons and Hawking's Euclidean approach to Quantum Gravity and we show how the on-shell action constructed with a Lagrangian with those properties can be expressed in terms of the covariant phase space Hamiltonian. We compute the Hamiltonian of several theories, one of which has Chern--Simons terms, using our prescription and show that, in black-hole backgrounds, the Hamiltonian gives directly the quantum statistical relation including terms related to non-gravitational charges and chemical potentials, as expected.

一句话导读：在含规范自由度的理论中构造协变相空间哈密顿量，并将其与欧几里得量子引力中的壳上作用量及黑洞量子统计关系联系起来。

广义相对论及其修改作为 GL(4) 对称性破缺的有效场论

General relativity and its modifications as effective field theories of $GL(4)$ breaking

Tommaso Viacava, Omar Zanusso · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们利用陪集方法和 Maurer-Cartan 形式，讨论广义相对论及其某些修改作为仿射一般线性群 GL(4) 对称性破缺的有效场论。虽然最终目标是将对称性破缺到 Lorentz 子群，但我们指出存在三种有趣的破缺级联：首先将仿射一般线性群破缺到包含 Lorentz 群的更大子群。在所有情形中，平移的破缺都会产生可解释为度规自由度的 Goldstone 模式。我们认为，不同破缺模式所产生的有效场论在导数展开的最低阶动力学等价，例如使用类 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量，但在超出领头阶时可能不同。

English: We discuss General Relativity and some of its modifications as effective field theories of the breaking of the affine general linear group using the coset approach and the Maurer-Cartan form. While the ultimate goal is to break the symmetry down to the Lorentz subgroup, we argue that there are three interesting breaking cascades in which the affine general linear group is first broken to a larger subgroup that contains the Lorentz group. In all cases, the breaking of translations always generates Goldstone modes that can be interpreted as metric degrees of freedom. We argue that the effective field theories that emerge as a result of the different breaking patterns are all dynamically equivalent at the lowest order of the derivative expansion, e.g., using Einstein-Hilbert-like actions, but can differ beyond the leading order.

一句话导读：把广义相对论及其修改表述为 GL(4) 对称性破缺的有效场论，并比较不同破缺级联在低阶的动力学等价性。

Codimension-Zero Holographic Complexity and Spectral Three-Point Correlators

Masamichi Miyaji, Shan-Ming Ruan, Shono Shibuya, Kazuyoshi Yano · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：全息复杂度被认为能够捕捉黑洞内部的线性增长，而量子修正最终会导致晚期饱和。我们在 complexity=anything 方案框架中，为与余维零体区域相关的全息复杂度度量发展了一种谱表述。相应的复杂度生成函数由态密度的三点关联函数支配，从而在体几何可观测量与非微扰欧几里得时空虫洞之间建立了直接联系。我们发现，余维零全息复杂度约化为两个余维一贡献之和，并表现出普适的时间演化：先经历指数级长的线性增长阶段，随后在 Heisenberg 时间饱和。晚期平台是谱能级排斥的直接结果，而能级排斥是量子混沌系统的普遍特征，因此为全息复杂度的饱和提供了普适机制。我们还发展了一种互补的算符解释：欧几里得虫洞修正使得固定复杂度态的半经典基变得过完备；构造完备正交归一基后，便得到定义良好的全息复杂度算符，它们重现相同的普适时间演化。我们的结果在量子引力中建立了黑洞内部、混沌谱统计与欧几里得虫洞之间的统一联系。

English: Holographic complexity is expected to capture the linear growth of black hole interiors, with quantum corrections ultimately leading to a late-time saturation. We develop a spectral formulation of holographic complexity measures associated with codimension-zero bulk regions in the framework of the complexity=anything proposal. The corresponding generating function of complexity is governed by three-point correlation functions of the density of states, establishing a direct connection between bulk geometric observables and nonperturbative Euclidean spacetime wormholes. We find that the codimension-zero holographic complexity reduces to the sum of two codimension-one contributions and exhibits a universal time evolution, characterized by an exponentially long regime of linear growth followed by saturation at the Heisenberg time. The late-time plateau is a direct result of the spectral level repulsion, a generic feature of quantum chaotic systems, thereby providing a universal mechanism for the saturation of holographic complexity. We also develop a complementary operator interpretation, in which Euclidean wormhole corrections render the semiclassical basis of fixed-complexity states overcomplete. Constructing a complete orthonormal basis then yields well-defined holographic complexity operators that reproduce the same universal time evolution. Our results establish a unified connection among black hole interiors, chaotic spectral statistics, and Euclidean wormholes in quantum gravity.

一句话导读：全息复杂度的谱表述通过态密度三点函数与欧几里得虫洞，给出黑洞内部复杂度线性增长并在 Heisenberg 时间饱和的普适机制。

Dongsu Bak, Chanju Kim, Sang-Heon Yi · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：我们将微扰 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力表述为带禁闭随机势的一维普通哈密顿量系综。领头阶轮廓重现圆盘态密度，而单个主场的连通累积量编码拓扑展开。在建立拓扑展开所需的累积量幂次计数后，我们证明这些累积量重现所有 genus-zero 多边界振幅 $\mathcal Z_{0,n}$。在更高 genus，我们证明可以逐阶一致地选择重整化方案，使得递归地施加单边界多项式性可重现微扰 JT 弦方程，并给出标准 JT 单边界振幅 $\mathcal Z_{g,1}$。该框架提供了一个自洽的有限-$S_0$ 量子动力学，具有离散谱和酉实时演化，而不仅仅是矩阵积分的改写。同样的禁闭动力学也支撑晚期饱和以及对我们此前工作中所示假想黑洞奇点的动力学规避。

English: We formulate perturbative Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity as an ensemble of ordinary one-dimensional Hamiltonians with a confining random potential. The leading profile reproduces the disk density of states, while connected cumulants of a single master field encode the topological expansion. After formulating the cumulant power counting required by the topological expansion, we show that the cumulants reproduce all genus-zero multi-boundary amplitudes $\mathcal Z_{0,n}$. At higher genus, we show that a renormalization scheme can be chosen consistently order by order so that imposing one-boundary polynomiality recursively reproduces the perturbative JT string equation and yields the standard JT one-boundary amplitudes $\mathcal Z_{g,1}$. The framework provides a self-contained finite-$S_0$ quantum dynamics with a discrete spectrum and unitary real time evolution, beyond a mere rewriting of the matrix integral. The same confining dynamics also underlies late-time saturation and the dynamical avoidance of the would-be black hole singularity, as shown in our earlier work.

一句话导读：将微扰 JT 引力实现为带禁闭随机势的一维量子力学系综，用累积量编码拓扑展开并重现 JT 弦方程与单边界振幅。

中文摘要：三维爱因斯坦引力没有局域自由度，但仍保留丰富的整体与黑洞物理。加入标量通常会破坏这一点。我们表明，三维 Horndeski 引力在非共形场重定义下的闭合性选择了一个平方根曲率相互作用。非线性分析发现正则分支上没有局域体模式，而独立的哈密顿分析在类时梯度分支上确认了该结果。这将无局域体动力学范式推广到纯爱因斯坦引力之外，并推动研究其边界与整体部门。

English: Three-dimensional Einstein gravity has no local degrees of freedom, yet retains rich global and black-hole physics. Adding a scalar normally spoils this. A nonlinear analysis finds no local bulk modes on regular branches, while an independent Hamiltonian analysis confirms the result on the timelike-gradient branch. This extends the no-local-bulk-dynamics paradigm beyond pure Einstein gravity and motivates studying its boundary and global sectors.

Adiabatic evolution of hadronic neutron stars

Domenico Logoteta, Francesco Zeno Constanzo, Ignazio Bombaci, Sebastiano Bernuzzi, Albino Perego, David Radice · astro-ph.HE, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-12

中文摘要：本文计算了静态和转动中子星的若干结构性质，同时考虑刚体转动和较差转动。为此，我们使用有限温度 β 稳定物态方程，它扩展了 Fortin 等人（2017）给出的零温强子物态方程。我们考虑了超子的形成以及中微子囚禁组分的存在。目标是深入理解核心坍缩超新星（CCSN）后形成原中子星（PNS）或双中子星并合（BNSM）遗迹的长期演化。物态方程在 Hartree 近似下由相对论平均场量子多体理论导出。耦合常数由超核与超核物质实验数据确定，以更好考虑超子单粒子势的不确定性。我们的物态方程模型再现了核子与超子组分下冷中子星和 PNS 的典型特征。特别地，它们与测量到的质量（PSR J0348+0432 的 2.01 M_sun 和 PSR J0740+6620 的 2.14 M_sun）以及 GW170817 给出的无量纲潮汐变形能力相容。热贡献随组分和转动状态不同而作用不同。最后，我们的演化方案提供了一种简单方式来解释 BNSM 遗迹或 CCSN 产生的 PNS 的长期演化，补充了无法覆盖完整演化时间尺度的动力学模拟。

English: In this paper we compute several structural properties of static and rotating neutron stars, considering both rigid and differential rotation. To this end, we use a finite-temperature beta-stable equation of state (EOS) extending the zero-temperature hadronic EOS derived by Fortin et al. (2017). We account for the formation of hyperons and the presence of a neutrino-trapped component. Our goal is to provide insights into the long-term evolution of a protoneutron star (PNS) formed after a core-collapse supernova (CCSN) or a remnant resulting from a binary neutron star merger (BNSM). The EOS is derived using a relativistic mean-field quantum many-body theory within the Hartree approximation. Coupling constants are determined using experimental data on hypernuclei and hypernuclear matter to better account for uncertainties in hyperon single-particle potentials. Our EOS models reproduce the typical features of cold neutron stars and PNSs for nucleonic and hyperonic compositions. In particular, they are consistent with measured masses (2.01 M_sun and 2.14 M_sun for PSR J0348+0432 and PSR J0740+6620) and dimensionless tidal deformabilities from GW170817. Thermal contributions act differently depending on composition and rotation state. Finally, our evolutionary scheme provides a simple way to interpret the long-term evolution of BNSM remnants or PNSs from CCSNe, complementing dynamical simulations unable to cover full evolutionary timescales.

一句话导读：用有限温度 β 稳定强子物态方程计算静态与转动中子星结构，并用于理解原中子星或双中子星并合遗迹的长期绝热演化。

DESI结果背后的引力感受率凹陷：用非局域引力的局域极限处理幽灵穿越

Gravitational-Susceptibility Dip Behind DESI's results: Addressing the Phantom Crossing by Local limit of Nonlocal Gravity

Aria Hemmatian, Yahya Mohammadi, Javad Tabatabaei, Shant Baghram · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：暗能量光谱仪（DESI）的第二次数据发布，基于超过一千四百万个星系和类星体，偏好一个状态方程是动态的暗能量组分。在描述该行为的最简单双参数描述，即 Chevallier-Polarski-Linder（CPL）参数化中，数据偏好象限 $w_0>-1$、$w_a<0$，这意味着状态方程在红移 $z\simeq0.4$ 处穿越幽灵分界 $w=-1$。我们表明，非局域引力的局域极限——一种由称为引力感受率 $S(x)$ 的标量函数支配的广义相对论远平行延伸——提供了一个自然的解释。在此模型中，不允许宇宙学常数；暗能量必然是动态的。观察者看到的幽灵穿越是由 $S(z)$ 的时间演化产生的有效现象。我们建立了一个对应关系：对于每一个状态方程为 $w(z)$ 的广义相对论暗能量模型，都对应一个修改的 TEGR 宇宙学，其 $w=-1$ 并具有合适的感受率 $S(z)$，在背景膨胀层面不可区分。我们构造了能重现 DESI 数据偏好的 CPL 行为的感受率函数，并用 Boltzmann 求解器程序将其与联合 CMB、BAO 和 SNe 数据进行比较。恢复出的感受率显示出特征性的低红移凹陷，深度 $\beta = -0.025 \pm 0.007$ 在 $z\simeq 0.4$ 处，其导数在一个等于幽灵穿越时期的红移处改变符号。

English: The second data release of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), based on more than fourteen million galaxies and quasars, prefers a dark energy component whose equation of state is dynamical. In the simplest two-parameter description of this behavior, the Chevallier--Polarski--Linder (CPL) parametrization, the data favor the quadrant $w_0>-1$, $w_a<0$, which implies that the equation of state crosses the phantom divide $w=-1$ at a redshift $z\simeq0.4$. We show that the local limit of nonlocal gravity, a teleparallel extension of general relativity governed by a scalar function called gravitational susceptibility $S(x)$, offers a natural explanation. In this model a cosmological constant is not allowed; dark energy is necessarily dynamical. The phantom crossing seen by an observer is an effective phenomenon generated by the time evolution of $S(z)$. We establish a correspondence: to every general-relativistic dark energy model with equation of state $w(z)$, there corresponds a modified TEGR cosmology with $w=-1$ and a suitable susceptibility $S(z)$ that are indistinguishable at the level of the background expansion. We construct the susceptibility functions that reproduce the CPL behavior favored by DESI data, and we confront the model with the combined CMB,BAO, and SNe data using Boltzmann solver codes. The recovered susceptibility displays a characteristic low-redshift dip with depth $\beta = -0.025 \pm 0.007$ at $z\simeq 0.4 $, and its derivative changes sign at a redshift equal to the phantom-crossing epoch.

一句话导读：非局域引力的局域极限用引力感受率 $S(z)$ 的时间演化解释 DESI 偏好的幽灵穿越，并拟合出 $z\approx0.4$ 的低红移凹陷。

Stable mass transfer in massive binaries leading to merging black holes

Xiao-Tian Xu, Norbert Langer, Jakub Klencki, Chen Wang, Xiang-Dong Li · astro-ph.SR, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：宇宙中绝大多数大质量双星系统显然不适合产生并合的双黑洞。然而，最近已识别出孤立大质量双星通向该目标的若干狭窄演化路径。由于此前对这些路径的建模高度简化和假设，结论迄今仍不明确。针对其中一条路径，即稳定质量转移通道，我们现在构建了详细的双星演化模型，包括内部较差自转以及恒星之间的质量和角动量转移，从零龄主序一直到黑洞形成，仅跳过快速的晚期燃烧阶段。这使我们能够追踪吸积质量组件的质量和化学结构演化，而该演化对反向质量转移阶段具有关键影响，使所得黑洞自旋和质量比自然落入在10–25太阳质量主黑洞质量范围内观测到的引力波源区域。由于该通道也已知有大量前身双星，我们得出结论：它很可能对观测到的引力波源族有贡献。

English: The vast majority of massive binary systems in the universe is evidently unsuited to produce merging binary black holes. However, several narrow evolutionary paths of isolated massive binaries towards this goal have recently been identified. Due to the high degree of simplification and assumptions applied in previous modelling of these paths, conclusions remained vague so far. For one of these paths, the stable mass transfer channel, we now construct detailed binary evolution models which include internal differential rotation as well as mass and angular momentum transfer between the stars, all the way from the zero-age main sequence to the formation of the black holes, only skipping the rapid late burning stages. This allows us to follow the mass and chemical structure evolution of the mass accreting component, which turns out to have a key influence on the phase of reverse mass transfer, that allows the obtained black hole spins and mass ratios to naturally fall into the regime observed for the gravitational-wave source in the 10--25$M_\odot$ primary black hole mass range. As for this channel, also a large number of progenitor binaries are known, we conclude that it likely contributes to the observed population of gravitational wave sources.

一句话导读：详细双星演化模型表明，稳定质量转移通道可产生与观测相符的黑洞自旋和质量比，并可能贡献引力波源族。

广义弦云包围黑洞的光学特征

Optical Signatures of Black Holes Surrounded by a Generalized Cloud of Strings

Marcos V. de S. Silva, Ednaldo L. B. Junior, Carlos F. S. Pereira, Diego S\'aez-Chill\'on G\'omez · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：本文研究由广义弦云包围的黑洞的光学特征，该时空由 Letelier--Alencar 度规描述。我们首先分析零测地线，表明弦参数相对于 Schwarzschild 值既可以增大也可以减小光子球半径与临界碰撞参数。由于该时空并非渐近平坦，临界碰撞参数并不直接等同于物理阴影半径；我们利用这一区别，从 Sgr A* 和 M87* 的阴影半径界限推导模型参数限制。在弱场情形，我们使用 Gauss--Bonnet 方法和零测地线方程的微扰展开计算光线偏折角，得到一致结果，其中除局部引力偏折外还包含来自渐近锥几何的贡献。我们还考察 Shapiro 时间延迟，并识别出与非 Minkowski 渐近背景相关的距离依赖贡献。最后，我们研究几何薄和光学薄吸积盘的光学外观，并通过反向光线追踪构造天球图像。传输函数和透镜图像显示，广义弦云以非均匀方式修改零测地线映射，而不是对 Schwarzschild 图像做简单缩放。特别地，阴影较小的构型仍可能产生主爱因斯坦环图像的外移，表明不同光学观测量探测该几何中光子传播的不同方面。

English: In this work, we investigate the optical signatures of black holes surrounded by a generalized cloud of strings, described by the Letelier--Alencar spacetime. We first analyze null geodesics, showing that the string parameters can either increase or decrease the photon sphere radius and the critical impact parameter relative to their Schwarzschild values. Since the spacetime is not asymptotically flat, the critical impact parameter does not directly coincide with the physical shadow radius. We use this distinction to derive constraints on the model parameters from the shadow radius bounds of Sgr A* and M87*. In the weak-field regime, we calculate the light deflection angle using both the Gauss--Bonnet method and a perturbative expansion of the null geodesic equations, obtaining consistent results that contain a contribution from the asymptotically conical geometry in addition to the local gravitational deflection. We also examine the Shapiro time delay and identify a distance dependent contribution associated with the non Minkowskian asymptotic background. Finally, we study the optical appearance of geometrically and optically thin accretion disks and construct celestial sphere images through backward ray tracing. The transfer functions and lensing images show that the generalized cloud of strings modifies the null geodesic mapping in a nonuniform manner rather than producing a simple rescaling of the Schwarzschild image. In particular, configurations with a smaller shadow may still produce an outward displacement of the main Einstein ring image, demonstrating that different optical observables probe distinct aspects of photon propagation in this geometry.

一句话导读：研究 Letelier-Alencar 广义弦云黑洞的零测地线、阴影、偏折、Shapiro 延迟与吸积盘透镜成像，属于经典引力光学特征分析。

自相互作用超辐射云产生的随机引力波背景

Stochastic gravitational-wave background from self-interacting superradiant clouds

Yin-Da Guo, Richard Brito, Chen Yuan · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：引力波（GW）观测为探测新基本场提供了强有力的手段。一个动机充分的源是黑洞（BH）-玻色子云系统：其中超轻标量场通过超辐射在旋转黑洞周围形成云，并发出长寿命、近单色的引力波。在本工作中，我们计算这类系统产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB），通过纳入标量自相互作用扩展了先前工作，并讨论其被下一代地面引力波探测器探测的可能性。我们发现，自相互作用可以压低 SGWB，从而放宽由零结果搜索推断出的现有 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 限制。具体而言，设计灵敏度下的 LIGO 探测器对衰减常数 f_s ≲ 3×10^17 GeV 的标量场产生的 SGWB 不敏感，且与标量场质量无关。展望未来，我们表明中等自相互作用的云仍能产生可被下一代探测器探测到的 SGWB。在保守假设下，对于衰减常数 f_s = 10^17 GeV，爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）将对约 [10^-13.0, 10^-11.8] eV 范围内的标量质量敏感，而宇宙探索者（CE）将对约 [10^-13.2, 10^-11.7] eV 范围内的标量质量敏感。我们还发现，ET 和 CE 仍能产生可探测 SGWB 的最小衰减常数分别约为 6×10^16 GeV 和 3×10^16 GeV。

English: Gravitational-wave (GW) observations offer a powerful probe of new fundamental fields. One well-motivated source is black hole (BH)--boson cloud systems, in which an ultralight scalar field forms a cloud around a rotating BH via superradiance and emits long-lived nearly monochromatic GWs. In this work, we compute the stochastic GW background (SGWB) from such systems, extending previous work by including scalar self-interactions, and discuss its detectability with next-generation ground-based GW detectors. We find that self-interactions can suppress the SGWB and thereby relax existing LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA constraints inferred from null searches. Namely, the LIGO detectors at design sensitivity are insensitive to a SGWB produced by scalar fields with a decay constant $f_\mathrm{s} \lesssim 3\times 10^{17}$ GeV, independently of the scalar field mass. Looking ahead, we show that a moderately self-interacting cloud can still produce a detectable SGWB with next-generation detectors. Under conservative assumptions, for a decay constant $f_\mathrm{s} = 10^{17}$ GeV, the Einstein Telescope (ET) will be sensitive to scalar masses in the range $\sim[10^{-13.0},10^{-11.8}]$ eV, while Cosmic Explorer (CE) will be sensitive to scalar masses in the range $\sim[10^{-13.2},10^{-11.7}]$ eV. We also find that the minimum decay constants that still yield a detectable SGWB for ET and CE are $f_\mathrm{s}\sim 6\times10^{16}\,$GeV and $\sim 3\times10^{16}\,$GeV, respectively.

一句话导读：该工作计算了包含标量自相互作用的黑洞-玻色子超辐射云所产生的随机引力波背景，并评估其被 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 及 ET/CE 探测的前景。
