用极端质量比旋近探测近区磁场

Probing near-zone magnetic fields with extreme mass-ratio inspirals

Jin-Lu Hu, Xin-Dong Du, Peng-Cheng Li, Tieguang Zi · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究弱近区磁场能否在极端质量比旋近（EMRI）波形中留下可观测印记。中心大质量黑洞用磁化 Schwarzschild（或 Ernst）解建模，次级致密天体视为沿赤道圆测地线运动的中性点粒子。我们计算了磁场对圆轨道量和最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的修正，然后使用一种混合的、源修正的 Regge--Wheeler--Zerilli 近似来演化旋近，其中 Schwarzschild 波传播势保持固定，而源在磁化轨道上计算。对于 M=10^6 M_sun、mu=10 M_sun 的基准系统，场强 B≈4×10^{-5} M^{-1}（对应 B_phys∼10^9 G）产生约 1.3 rad 的一年退相位，以及一个 LISA 噪声加权的失配；在相对到达时间和初始引力波相位上最大化后，一年时仍略高于所采用的可区分阈值。我们的结果表明 EMRI 原则上可以探测极强近区磁场，而大质量黑洞周围普通磁环境在当前近似下很可能太弱，无法产生可探测效应。

English: We investigate whether weak near-zone magnetic fields can leave observable imprints on extreme-mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) waveforms. The central massive black hole is modeled by the magnetized Schwarzschild, or Ernst, solution, and the secondary compact object is treated as a neutral point particle on equatorial circular geodesics. We compute the magnetic corrections to the circular-orbit quantities and the innermost stable circular orbit, and then evolve the inspiral using a hybrid, source-corrected Regge--Wheeler--Zerilli approximation, in which the Schwarzschild wave-propagation potentials are kept fixed while the source is evaluated on the magnetized orbit. For a fiducial system with \(M=10^6M_\odot\) and \(\mu=10M_\odot\), a field strength \(B\simeq 4\times10^{-5}M^{-1}\), corresponding to \(B_{\rm phys}\sim10^9\,{\rm G}\), produces a one-year dephasing of about \(1.3\) rad and \ccr{a LISA-noise-weighted mismatch which, after maximization over the relative arrival time and initial GW phase, remains slightly above the adopted distinguishability threshold at one year}. Our results suggest that EMRIs can in principle probe extremely strong near-zone magnetic fields, whereas ordinary magnetic environments around massive black holes are likely too weak to produce detectable effects within the present approximation.

一句话导读：磁化 Schwarzschild 背景下的 EMRI 波形计算表明，只有极强近区磁场才可能产生 LISA 可分辨的一年退相位。

在 n 维 Einstein 引力中，阴影半径下界比光子球半径下界更稳健

The shadow radius lower bound is more robust than the photon sphere radius lower bound in $n$-dimensional Einstein gravity

Jiaqi Fu, Yong Song · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：光子球和黑洞阴影是强场时空中两个密切相关的几何特征：光子球是由圆形零测地线叶层化的超曲面，而阴影边界由零测地线俘获的临界碰撞参数决定。对于 n 维（n≥4）Einstein 引力中带有各向异性物质的静态、球对称、渐近平直黑洞，我们推导阴影半径和光子球半径的下界，并比较其物质假设。假设辅助函数 Ξ(r) 在视界与所考虑的光子球之间满足 -ρ≤Ξ≤p_r 且 (r^2Ξ)'≥0，我们建立 r_γ≥[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}r_H，其中 r_H 是事件视界半径。将阴影半径写为 r_sh=[max_{r>r_H}U(r)]^{-1/2}，其中 U(r) 为零有效势，我们仅使用 ρ≥0 和 ρ+p_r≥0（二者均由弱能量条件 WEC 蕴含）得到 r_sh/r_H≥[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}sqrt((n-1)/(n-3))。该阴影下界无论光子球数量多少都成立，且不需要光子球下界证明中使用的额外物质条件。在这个意义上，阴影半径下界比光子球半径下界更稳健。一个满足 WEC 的四维构型具有单个外部光子球并遵守阴影下界，但违反光子球下界不等式，表明即使两个半径与同一光子球相关，这种区别仍然存在。两个下界均由 Schwarzschild--Tangherlini 解饱和。在附录 A 中，我们还在 WEC、强能量条件和适当的渐近衰减假设下推导了依赖于质量的上界。

English: The photon sphere and the black hole shadow are two closely related geometric features of strong-field spacetimes: the photon sphere is a hypersurface foliated by circular null geodesics, while the shadow boundary is determined by the critical impact parameter for null-geodesic capture. For static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat black holes in $n$-dimensional ($n\ge4$) Einstein gravity with anisotropic matter, we derive lower bounds on the shadow radius and the photon sphere radius and compare their matter assumptions. Assuming that an auxiliary function $\Xi(r)$ satisfies $-\rho\le\Xi\le p_r$ and $(r^2\Xi)'\ge0$ between the horizon and the photon sphere under consideration, we establish $r_\gamma\ge[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}r_H$, where $r_H$ is the event horizon radius. Writing the shadow radius as $r_{\mathrm{sh}}=[\max_{r>r_H}U(r)]^{-1/2}$, where $U(r)$ is the null effective potential, we obtain $r_{\mathrm{sh}}/r_H\ge[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}\sqrt{(n-1)/(n-3)}$ using only $\rho\ge0$ and $\rho+p_r\ge0$, both implied by the weak energy condition (WEC). This shadow bound holds irrespective of the number of photon spheres and does not require the additional matter conditions used in the photon sphere lower-bound proofs. In this sense, the lower bound on the shadow radius is more robust than that on the photon sphere radius. A four-dimensional configuration satisfying the WEC has a single exterior photon sphere and obeys the shadow bound while violating the photon sphere lower-bound inequality, demonstrating this distinction even when both radii are associated with the same photon sphere. Both lower bounds are saturated by the Schwarzschild--Tangherlini solution. In Appendix~A, we also derive the mass-dependent upper bounds under the WEC, the strong energy condition, and suitable asymptotic decay assumptions.

一句话导读：在 n 维 Einstein 引力中，仅需弱能量条件即可证明黑洞阴影半径下界，且该下界比光子球半径下界适用更广、更稳健。

用空间干涉仪探测引力波记忆的软信号

Probing soft signals of gravitational-wave memory with space-based interferometers

Yan Cao, Yong-Liang Ma, Yong Tang · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：引力波位移记忆是广义相对论的一个显著且普遍存在的预言，但尚未被探测到。与引力波形的振荡成分不同，位移记忆与软引力子相关，并提供了其母事件领先的低频可观测效应。类似的软信号也可能与速度记忆和积分位移记忆相关。软波形的简单、普适谱形为匹配滤波和参数估计提供了有效模板。本文研究未来空间激光干涉仪对此类软记忆信号的探测前景。作为现实例子，我们考察中等相对论性无自旋致密双星散射以及等质量、准圆、无进动黑洞并合的引力波红外谱特征。在这两种情况下，低频谱可用带有限频率修正的软位移记忆波形描述。使用所采用的仪器噪声模型，模拟贝叶斯参数估计分析表明，单个类LISA探测器对于匹配滤波信噪比约为10的信号，可以约束记忆幅度和到达时间。BBO第一阶段可以测量来自足够响的恒星级致密双星并合的零位移记忆。我们还评估了软位移记忆信号理想化随机背景的可探测性。这些结果确立了带记忆的引力波暴作为空间干涉仪的具体目标。

English: Gravitational-wave displacement memory is a remarkable, ubiquitous prediction of general relativity that has not yet been detected. Unlike the oscillatory components of gravitational waveforms, displacement memory is associated with soft gravitons and provides the leading low-frequency observable of its parent event. Analogous soft signals may also be associated with velocity and integrated-displacement memory. The simple, universal spectral shapes of soft waveforms provide effective templates for matched filtering and parameter estimation. In this paper, we investigate the detection prospects for such soft memory signals with future space-based laser interferometers. As realistic examples, we examine the infrared spectral features of gravitational waves from moderately relativistic nonspinning compact binary scattering and comparable-mass quasi-circular, nonprecessing black hole mergers. In both cases, the low-frequency spectrum can be described by a soft displacement-memory waveform with finite-frequency corrections. Using the adopted instrumental-noise models, simulated Bayesian parameter-estimation analyses show that a single LISA-like detector can constrain the memory amplitude and arrival time for signals with matched-filter signal-to-noise ratios of order 10. BBO Stage 1 could measure null displacement memory from sufficiently loud stellar-mass compact binary mergers. We also evaluate the detectability of an idealized stochastic background of soft displacement-memory signals. These results establish gravitational-wave bursts with memory as concrete targets for space-based interferometers.

一句话导读：评估空间激光干涉仪探测引力波位移记忆等软信号的前景，涵盖双星散射、黑洞并合与随机背景。

通过引力记忆约束超光速爱因斯坦-以太引力

Constraining superluminal Einstein-\AE{}ther gravity through gravitational memory

Lavinia Heisenberg, Benedetta Rosatello, Guangzi Xu, Jann Zosso · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：引力中的每一次辐射发射都包含一个非波状成分，会在其穿越的时空中留下固有距离的永久变化，这一现象称为引力位移记忆。基于最近发展的利用 Isaacson 引力波基本定义洞见的计算框架，我们计算了 Einstein-Aether 引力中领头阶的位移记忆公式。这是首次直接计算具有非平凡渐近矢量场值的度规理论中的引力记忆。我们发现，以快于张量辐射速度发射的标量和矢量以太波具有无保护的因果方向，可能先验地导致无界记忆积累。基于这些结果以及张量波光速传播的现有约束，我们推测 Einstein-Aether 引力的超光速参数空间被严格排除。

English: Every emission of radiation in gravity also includes a nonwavelike component that leaves a permanent change in proper distances of the spacetime it travels through. This phenomenon is known as gravitational displacement memory. Building up on a recently developed computation framework that harnesses Isaacson's insights on a fundamental definition of gravitational waves, we compute the leading displacement memory formula in Einstein-Aether gravity. Our analysis represents the first direct calculation of gravitational memory in a metric theory with nontrivial asymptotic vector field value. We find that an emission of scalar and vector aether waves at a propagation speed greater than the speed of tensor radiation features unprotected causal directions with a priori unbound memory build-up. Based on the results and the existing constraint of luminally propagating tensor waves, we conjecture a stringent exclusion of the superluminal parameter space of Einstein-Aether gravity.

一句话导读：在 Einstein-Aether 引力中计算引力位移记忆，并据此推测排除超光速参数空间。

黑洞耀发电影中的自相关：对 Kerr 的偏离

Autocorrelation in black hole flare movies: Departures from Kerr

Fang-Stars Wei, Zelin Zhang, Zhenyu Zhang, Bin Chen · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：黑洞电影中的自相关编码了引力透镜像之间的时间延迟和角分离，提供了一种检验时空几何的方法。利用参数化 Johannsen-Psaltis 度规中一个带有单一形变参数的轨道热点，我们研究透镜诱导的相关性区分偏离 Kerr 的能力。从光线追踪电影中，我们提取时间-角度自相关图中近似线性次级脊的斜率（k）和截距（b），作为未来可能的观测量。自旋和度规形变参数的变化在（k,b）平面中产生不同轨迹，使得当轨道半径、观测者倾角和轨道角速度给定时，这两个观测量能联合限制这两个参数。通过改变轨道角速度，我们构建了（k,b）平面中的 Kerr 参考区域，并发现对于某些具有负形变参数的低自旋构型，次级峰测得的斜率-截距对位于该参考区域之外。该特征出现在亚开普勒、开普勒和超开普勒运动中，表明来自黑洞耀发电影的次级脊测量有潜力区分非 Kerr 特征。

English: Autocorrelation in black hole movies encodes the time delays and angular separations between gravitationally lensed images, offering a means of testing the spacetime geometry. Using an orbiting hot spot in the parametrized Johannsen-Psaltis metric with a single deformation parameter, we investigate the ability of lensing-induced correlations to distinguish departures from Kerr. From ray-traced movies, we extract the slope (k) and intercept (b) of an approximately linear secondary ridge in the time-angle autocorrelation map as potential future observables. Variations in the spin and the metric deformation parameter produce distinctive trajectories in the (k,b) plane, allowing the two observables to jointly constrain both parameters when the orbital radius, observer inclination, and orbital angular velocity are specified. By varying the orbital angular velocity, we construct a Kerr reference region in the (k,b) plane, and we find that, for some low-spin configurations with negative deformation parameters, the measured slope-intercept pairs of the secondary peaks lie outside this reference region. This feature appears for sub-Keplerian, Keplerian, and super-Keplerian motion, indicating that secondary-ridge measurements from black hole flare movies have the potential to distinguish non-Kerr signatures.

一句话导读：通过光线追踪黑洞耀发电影中的自相关次级脊斜率与截距，探索 Johannsen-Psaltis 度规偏离 Kerr 的可观测性。

The Hawking and Penrose singularity theorems for low regularity Finsler spacetimes

Darius Er\"os, Ettore Minguzzi, Argam Ohanyan, Shin-ichi Ohta · math.DG, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们证明了混合水平/垂直正则性 $C^{(1,2)}$ 在加权 $C^1$ 情形下以及 $C^{(1,3)}$ 在无权情形下的 Lorentz-Finsler 结构的霍金与彭罗斯奇点定理。在此正则性下，测地线不必由初始条件唯一确定，并且（加权）Ricci 曲率必须按分布意义解释。我们的方法依赖于一个两阶段逼近程序：首先是一个保持齐性的卷积，这在更广泛的半黎曼-芬斯勒设定中具有独立意义；其次是一个按 Chruściel-Grant 方式、适应因果性的逼近。在 $C^1$ Lorentz 度规的特殊情形下，我们的结果将 Graf 的 $C^1$ 奇点定理推广到了 $C^1$ 加权情形。

English: We prove the Hawking and Penrose singularity theorems for Lorentz--Finsler structures of mixed horizontal/vertical regularity $C^{(1,2)}$ in the $C^1$ weighted case and $C^{(1,3)}$ in the unweighted case. At this regularity, geodesics need not be uniquely determined by their initial conditions, and the (weighted) Ricci curvature must be interpreted distributionally. Our approach relies on a two-stage approximation procedure: first, a homogeneity-preserving convolution, which is of independent interest in the broader semi-Riemann--Finsler setting, and second, a causality-adapted approximation \`a la Chru\'sciel--Grant. In the special case of $C^1$ Lorentzian metrics, our results extend the $C^1$ singularity theorems of Graf to the $C^1$ weighted case.

原初黑洞

Primordial black holes

V. I. Dokuchaev, Yu. N. Eroshenko, V. V. Nikulin, K. A. Postnov, S. G. Rubin, V. D. Stasenko · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：原初黑洞的形成最早由 Ya. B. Zel'dovich 与 I. D. Novikov 于 1966 年提出（该开创性文章的文本作为本综述的附录 II 给出），近年来受到越来越多关注。覆盖电磁波段的现代天文数据，连同引力波与宇宙中微子的观测，揭示出若干可能与在前恒星宇宙时期形成的原初黑洞有关的独特天体物理现象。本综述介绍各种原初黑洞形成模型，以及用天文与天体物理观测检验这些模型的方法。特别是，我们详细讨论了通过闭合畴壁塌缩以及通过与宇宙额外空间维度相关效应形成原初黑洞及其团簇的过程。

English: Primordial black holes, whose formation in the early Universe was first hypothesized by Ya.B.~Zel'dovich and I.D.~Novikov in 1966 (the text of this pioneering article is provided in Appendix II to this review), have attracted increasing attention in recent years. Modern astronomical data across the electromagnetic spectrum, together with observations of gravitational waves and cosmic neutrinos, have revealed a number of unique astrophysical phenomena that may be related to primordial black holes formed in the pre-stellar cosmological epoch. This review describes various models of primordial black hole formation, as well as methods for testing these models with astronomical and astrophysical observations. In particular, we discuss in detail the formation of primordial black holes and their clusters through the collapse of closed domain walls and through effects associated with extra spatial dimensions of the Universe.

English: In massive scalar-tensor gravity, a scalarized neutron star must shed its scalar hair as it collapses into a black hole. Using 3D simulations of a realistic rotating progenitor we show that dispersion stretches the emitted burst into a quasi-monochromatic signal in the kHz frequency range lasting $>10^4$ yr and amenable to continuous-wave methods. We find that detecting these signals in directed searches of supernova remnants without a central pulsar requires sensitivity depths of 233--762 $\rm{Hz^{-1/2}}$ with the A+-ET-CE detector network. We estimate up to $\sim3$ of these signals in transit at any observational epoch.

聆听视界：用 GW250114 探测近视界反射率

Listening to the Horizon: Probing Near-Horizon Reflectivity with GW250114

R. Prasad, Subhodeep Sarkar, Sudipta Sarkar · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：检验天体物理黑洞的视界性质是引力波天文学的核心目标之一。最近在 GW250114 中识别出的直接波（Direct Wave, DW）是一种即时的非准正规模成分，为近视界物理提供了新探针。尽管 DW 本身是否携带视界信息仍不清楚，我们表明它可用于对视界反射率进行一种新的零检验。如果残余天体是带有部分反射表面的奇异致密天体（ECO），向内坠落的辐射会被反射，并穿过引力势垒泄漏回来，产生延迟的 DW 回声，其振幅由表面反射率（|R_s|）决定。我们构造了相应的回声模板，以观测到的 DW 归一化，并在准正规模滤波后的数据中搜寻它。我们没有发现回声证据（ln B = -2.9），并得到 90% 可信上限 |R_s| < 0.06，对应于反射能量比例低于 0.4%，适用于从 0.1 M_f 到距假定视界一个普朗克长度的表面。因此，我们的方法将即时的铃宕信号转化为对视界反射率的直接检验。

English: Testing the horizon properties of astrophysical black holes is a central goal of gravitational-wave astronomy. The recently identified Direct Wave (DW), a prompt non-quasinormal component of GW250114, provides a new probe of near-horizon physics. While it remains unclear whether the DW itself carries horizon information, we show that it enables a novel null test of horizon reflectivity. If the remnant is an exotic compact object (ECO) with a partially reflecting surface, inward plunge radiation is reflected and leaks back through the gravitational potential barrier, producing a delayed DW echo whose amplitude is set by the surface reflectivity ($|\mathcal{R}_s|$). We construct the corresponding echo template, normalized by the observed DW, and search for it in quasinormal-mode-filtered data. We find no evidence for an echo ($\ln\mathcal{B}=-2.9$) and obtain the 90\% credible bound $|\mathcal{R}_s|<0.06$, corresponding to a reflected energy fraction below $0.4\%$, for surfaces from $0.1\, M_f$ to a Planck length from the would-be horizon. Our method thus turns the prompt ringdown signal into a direct test of horizon reflectivity.

一句话导读：利用 GW250114 的 Direct Wave 对黑洞视界反射率做零检验，未发现回声并给出反射率上限。

高度相对论性真空气泡碰撞引力波谱的成对代理模型

A Pairwise Surrogate for Gravitational-Wave Spectra from Highly Relativistic Vacuum Bubble Collisions

Malte Buschmann, Toby Opferkuch · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：真空一阶相变产生的引力波可探测相对论性气泡碰撞的非线性动力学。预测其谱需要解析包含许多气泡的体积内被洛伦兹收缩的标量气泡壁，这使得大助推情形对直接格子模拟而言昂贵得难以承受。我们发展了一个基于模拟的成对代理模型，将微观碰撞动力学与多气泡相变的几何分离。该模型利用对称性约化的 (1+1) 维标量场模拟来构建双气泡引力波谱库，包括碰撞后的非线性演化。这些谱与考虑其他气泡屏蔽的几何权重相结合。我们用完整的 (3+1) 维格子模拟检验了双气泡谱以及三气泡和多气泡系统重建谱。该代理模型不仅计算成本可低若干数量级，还能给出直接多气泡模拟实际无法触及的高度相对论性碰撞。这为研究谱的振幅和形状如何依赖碰撞助推和标量势提供了一条途径。

English: Gravitational waves from vacuum first-order phase transitions probe the nonlinear dynamics of relativistic bubble collisions. Predicting their spectrum requires resolving Lorentz-contracted scalar bubble walls throughout a volume containing many bubbles, making the large-boost regime prohibitively expensive for direct lattice simulations. We develop a simulation-based pairwise surrogate that separates the microscopic collision dynamics from the geometry of the multi-bubble transition. This utilizes symmetry-reduced $(1+1)$-dimensional scalar-field simulations to build a library of two-bubble gravitational-wave spectra, including the nonlinear post-collision evolution. These spectra are combined with geometric weights that account for screening by other bubbles. We test the two-bubble spectra and the reconstructed spectra of three- and many-bubble systems against full $(3+1)$-dimensional lattice simulations. Not only can the surrogate be orders of magnitude cheaper computationally, but it also provides access to highly relativistic collisions beyond the practical reach of direct many-bubble simulations. This provides a route to studying how the spectral amplitude and shape depend on the collision boost and scalar potential.

一句话导读：提出基于双气泡(1+1)维模拟的成对代理模型，低成本重建高助推真空气泡碰撞的引力波谱。

光环上光子的引力辐射：多极通量与对数发散

Gravitational radiation from a photon on the light ring: multipole fluxes and the logarithmic divergence

Enrico Barausse · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：无质量粒子在 Schwarzschild 或 Kerr 黑洞的圆形零测地线上，会在所有多极 ℓ 辐射引力波，其功率仅按 1/ℓ 衰减，因此总瞬时功率呈对数发散。我们以零应力-能量张量为源，从 Zerilli-Regge-Wheeler 与 Teukolsky 方程解析推导出该结果，并发现辐射到无穷远的功率与被视界吸收的功率均趋近 E_ℓ → g(a) κ E^2/(M^2 ℓ)，其中 E 为粒子能量，M 为黑洞质量，a 为其自旋，κ=0.063653，g(a) 为自旋因子；对任意自旋，我们得到闭式 g=27M^2(r_0-M)/[r_0^2(r_0+3M)]，其中 r_0 为 Kerr 光环半径。1/ℓ 行为有两个原因：光子与准正模式近共振，这阻止了大 ℓ 时任何指数压低；以及无质量粒子特有的源中相消，使每个多极的功率相对一般源减小一个因子 ℓ^2。领头阶下，一半辐射落入黑洞，我们计算了非旋转情形下这一均分的第一阶修正。同一分析描述在光环附近轨道上的有质量粒子，其中质量把 1/ℓ 规律变成指数截断。我们重现了 Breuer、Ruffini、Tiomno 与 Vishveshwara (1973) 对有质量粒子的测地同步辐射公式中的主导偶宇称项，但发现其奇宇称项小了四倍。所有结果均与数值解核对，在 Schwarzschild 中直到 ℓ=12800，在 Kerr 中直到 ℓ=800。

English: A massless particle on the circular null geodesic of a Schwarzschild or Kerr black hole radiates gravitational waves at all multipoles $\ell$ with a power that falls off only as $1/\ell$, so that the total instantaneous power is logarithmically divergent. We derive this result analytically from the Zerilli--Regge--Wheeler and Teukolsky equations with a null stress-energy tensor as source, and find that both the power radiated to infinity and the power absorbed by the horizon approach $\dot{E}_\ell\to g(a) \kappa E^2/(M^2\ell)$, where $E$ is the energy of the particle, $M$ the mass of the black hole and $a$ its spin, with $\kappa=0.063653$ and a spin factor $g(a)$, for which we obtain, for any spin, the closed form $g=27M^2(r_0-M)/[r_0^2(r_0+3M)]$ in terms of the radius $r_0$ of the Kerr light ring. The $1/\ell$ behavior has two causes: the near-resonance of the photon with the quasinormal modes, which prevents any exponential suppression at large $\ell$, and a cancellation in the source that is specific to massless particles, which reduces the power per multipole by a factor $\ell^2$ with respect to a generic source. At leading order half of the radiation falls into the black hole, and we compute the first correction to this equal split in the non-spinning case. The same analysis describes massive particles on orbits close to the light ring, where the mass turns the $1/\ell$ law into an exponential cut-off. We recover the dominant, even-parity term of the geodesic synchrotron radiation formulae for massive particles of Breuer, Ruffini, Tiomno and Vishveshwara (1973), but we find that their odd-parity term is too small by a factor of four. All results are checked against numerical solutions, up to $\ell=12800$ in Schwarzschild and $\ell=800$ in Kerr.

一句话导读：光子在黑洞光环上辐射引力波时，多极功率按 1/ℓ 衰减导致总功率对数发散；解析得到通量与自旋因子，并修正了 1973 年同步辐射公式的奇宇称项。

Testing General Relativity with Binary Lens Microlensing Events

Xinyang Jin, Shuo Cao, Xuanni Chen, Yalong Nan, Xuchen Tai, Shuxun Tian · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：爱因斯坦广义相对论（GR）在星系和太阳系尺度已被精确检验，但在极端弱引力场（无量纲牛顿势 Φ ∼ 10^-8）中仍约束不足。本文提出一种探测此类弱场引力并测量单位质量产生空间曲率的新方法。具体而言，双星微引力透镜事件提供了一个测量参数化后牛顿（PPN）参数 γ 的实验室：将微引力透镜推断的透镜质量 M_lens^GR 与干涉天体测量确定的动力学质量 M_dyn 相结合。此前对双星透镜的天体测量追踪受限于其暗弱和极小角分离（通常为几毫角秒）。GRAVITY+ 的部署缓解了这一限制，将仪器灵敏度和天体测量精度提升到前所未有的高度。基于对双星微引力透镜事件 ASASSN-22av 的天体测量模拟，我们直接以约 23% 的精度估计 γ。基于更多能够精确确定动力学/透镜质量的双星微引力透镜事件，这种极端弱场区制的 GR 检验还可进一步提高到约 3% 的精度。

English: Einstein's General Relativity (GR), which has been precisely tested on galaxy and solar system scales, is still poorly constrained in extremely weak gravitational fields (with dimensionless Newtonian potentials of $\Phi \sim 10^{-8}$). In this Letter, we propose a new method to probe such a weak-field regime of gravity and measure the spatial curvature generated per unit mass. Specifically, binary microlensing events provide a laboratory to measure the parameterized post-Newtonian (PPN) parameter ($\gamma$), by combining the lensing mass ($M_{\rm lens}^{\rm GR}$) inferred from microlensing with the dynamical mass ($M_{\rm dyn}$) determined from interferometric astrometry. Astrometric tracking of binary lenses was previously hindered by their faintness and minuscule angular separations (typically a few milliarcseconds). This limitation has been alleviated by the deployment of GRAVITY+, which pushes the instrument's sensitivity and astrometric precision to unprecedented heights. Based on astrometric simulations of the binary microlensing event ASASSN-22av, we directly estimate $\gamma$ at the precision of ~23%. Such test of GR in the extremely weak-field regime can be further improved to much higher precision (~3%), based on more binary microlensing events with precise determination of the dynamical/lens mass.

一句话导读：提出利用双星微引力透镜与干涉天体测量联合限制 PPN 参数 γ，从而在极端弱场中检验广义相对论。

Testing Extra-Dimensional Gravitational-Wave Polarizations with Compact-Binary Observations

Hai-Tian Wang, Dicong Liang, Lijing Shao, Yu-Xiao Liu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：超越四维广义相对论的理论中自然会出现额外空间维度，但直接观测证据仍然难以获得。引力波提供了一种独特探针：向可观测三维空间子空间的几何投影可能产生表观的张量、矢量和标量极化。我们考虑一个额外空间维度以及一个双模张量波拟设，其中投影后的极化分量是同一对底层广义相对论张量波形的固定线性组合。这些分量通过标准探测器天线模式进入测量应变。对五个致密双星事件的频域贝叶斯分析约束了两个旋转角，分别对应两种保持传播位于观测子空间内的非对易旋转排序。两个事件进一步分析了允许传播倾斜进入额外维度的四种排序。对于 GW250114，在所测试的旋转排序中，两角拟合的最大广义相对论分位数为 Q_GR 约 0.6%，三角拟合在边缘化第三个角后为 Q_marg_GR 约 4.6%。在整个事件样本中，广义相对论参考点在所有情况下都位于估计的 90% 最高后验密度区域内。

English: Extra spatial dimensions arise naturally in theories beyond four-dimensional general relativity (GR), but direct observational evidence remains elusive. Gravitational waves offer a distinctive probe: geometric projection onto the observable three-dimensional spatial subspace can produce apparent tensor, vector, and scalar polarizations. We consider one additional spatial dimension and a two-mode tensor-wave ansatz for which the projected polarization components are fixed linear combinations of the same two underlying GR tensor waveforms. These components enter the measured strain through the standard detector antenna patterns. A frequency-domain Bayesian analysis of five compact-binary events constrains two rotation angles for two noncommuting orderings of rotations that preserve propagation within the observed subspace. Two events are further analyzed for four orderings that allow propagation to tilt into the extra dimension. For GW250114, the maximum GR quantiles among the tested rotation orderings are $Q_{\mathrm{GR}}\simeq0.6\%$ for the two-angle fits and $Q^{\mathrm{marg}}_{\mathrm{GR}}\simeq4.6\%$ for the three-angle fits after marginalizing over the third angle. Across the full event sample, the GR reference point lies inside the estimated 90% highest-posterior-density region in every case.

一句话导读：对五个致密双星事件的贝叶斯分析约束额外维度导致的表观引力波极化，所有情形下广义相对论仍在90%后验区域内。

FLRW 兼容张量与修改引力中的完美流体普适性

FLRW-Compatible Tensors and Perfect-Fluid Universality in Modified Gravity

Cem Dalk{\i}rmaz, Yaghoub Heydarzade · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究在 $(D+1)$ 维、配备 Levi-Civita 联络的 Friedmann–Lemaître–Robertson–Walker 时空上的 FLRW 兼容张量场。我们证明，任何在空间均匀性和各向同性群下不变的协变 $N$ 阶张量场，当 $D>N$ 时，都可有限分解为由度规张量 $g_{\mu\nu}$ 和单位类时矢量 $u_\mu$ 构成的多项式，其标量系数仅依赖宇宙时。作为直接推论，在 FLRW 背景场方程的类 Einstein 重排中出现的任何二阶修正项，当 $D>2$ 时都具有有效完美流体形式。因此，该结果为 FLRW 背景上修改引力方程的完美流体结构提供了任意阶张量分类，补充了已有的二阶普适性结果。还讨论了在广义 Friedmann 方程和修改引力中测地线偏离方程的应用。

English: We study FLRW-compatible tensor fields on Friedmann--Lema\^itre--Robertson--Walker spacetimes in $(D+1)$ dimensions equipped with Levi-Civita connection. We prove that any covariant rank-$N$ tensor field invariant under the spatial homogeneity and isotropy group, with $D>N$, admits a finite decomposition into monomials constructed from the metric tensor $g_{\mu\nu}$ and the unit timelike vector $u_\mu$, with scalar coefficients depending only on cosmic time. As a direct consequence, any rank-two correction term appearing in an Einstein-like rearrangement of the FLRW background field equations has the effective perfect-fluid form for $D>2$. Thus, the result provides an arbitrary-rank tensorial classification underlying the perfect-fluid structure of modified gravity equations on FLRW backgrounds, complementing existing rank-two universality results. Applications to generalized Friedmann equations and to the geodesic deviation equation in modified gravity are also discussed.

一句话导读：证明 FLRW 上空间均匀各向同性不变张量可由度规与单位类时矢量分解，从而给出修改引力修正项完美流体形式的任意阶张量分类。

体-边界分解与精确理想流体星体分布

Bulk-boundary decompositions and exact perfect fluid stellar distributions

Sudan Hansraj, Christian G. Boehmer, Ndumiso Buthelezi · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：Ricci 标量按体项与边界项分解产生了 Böhmer 和 Jensko（BJ）提出的一类有趣引力场论。BJ 进一步给出了拉格朗日量中体项贡献的函数形式。就天体物理建模而言，边界项是非动力学的，整个理论仅由体项贡献构建。本文在共形静态度规背景下得到了恒星理想流体分布的场方程。由于体项函数的线性形式等价于 Einstein 理论，我们考察下一层次的复杂性，即纯二次情形。场方程比 Einstein 方程复杂得多。即使对其中一个几何势函数作简单选择，压强各向同性方程也显得难以处理。因此我们分析势函数与半径成反比的情形。该情形下得不到可行模型，于是我们假设各势函数之间存在正比关系。结果表明，可以构造出一个物理上合理的各向同性流体壳层，满足基本物理要求。最后我们研究等温流体，其中密度和压强均随半径平方反比变化。这导致流体行为可与相应的 Einstein 模型相比较。

English: The decomposition of the Ricci scalar in terms of bulk and boundary terms gives rise to an interesting gravitational field theory as proposed by B\"ohmer and Jensko (BJ). BJ went on to suggest functional forms of the bulk contributions in the Lagrangian. For the purposes of astrophysical modelling the boundary terms are non-dynamical and the entire theory is built from the bulk contribution only. The field equations for a stellar perfect fluid distribution are obtained against the background of a conformostatic metric. Since the linear form of the function of the bulk term is equivalent to Einstein we probe the next level of complexity namely the pure quadratic case. The field equations are substantially more complicated than Einstein's equations. The equation of pressure isotropy proves intractable even with simple choices of one of the geometric potential functions. Accordingly we analyse the case of the potentials varying inversely with the radius. Viable models do not arise in this case and so we postulate a proportional relationship between the potentials. It turns out that a physically reasonable shell of isotropic fluid may be constructed that satisfies elementary physical requirements. Finally we investigate the isothermal fluid where both density and pressure go as the inverse square law of the radius. This results in fluid behaviour that is comparable to that in the corresponding Einstein model.

一句话导读：在仅取体项贡献的二次 BJ 引力中，研究共形静态背景下的精确理想流体星体解，并构造出满足基本物理要求的各向同性流体壳层。

通过高阶像的干涉特征探测 Kerr 时空

Probing Kerr spacetime via interferometric signatures of higher-order images

Fabiano Feleppa, Fabio Aratore, Valerio Bozza, Lorenzo Albanese · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：黑洞不稳定光子区附近绕转的光子所产生的高阶像编码了时空几何信息，并留下可用长干涉基线观测的特征信号。我们针对缓慢旋转 Kerr 时空中的致密源，发展了对这些特征的解析描述。利用强偏折极限，我们推导了有限尺寸源在黑洞自旋线性阶下的复可见度函数。对于赤道面上的静态源，我们得到无量纲 Kerr 自旋参数与属于同一宇称序列的相继高阶像角位移之间的直接关系。随后，我们将该构造推广到在赤道圆轨道上运动的致密源，通过在每个像对应的推迟源位置处计算其贡献。参考系拖曳与源运动改变像的角位置，并在长基线可见度图案上留下不同印记。对于本文考虑的构型，这些效应在角方向上相反，因此最终结构由它们的竞争决定。我们的结果为识别黑洞自旋和源动力学在高阶像干涉特征中的印记提供了解析框架。

English: Higher-order images produced by photons that orbit close to the unstable photon region of a black hole encode information about the spacetime geometry and leave characteristic signatures accessible with long interferometric baselines. We develop an analytical description of these signatures for a compact source in the spacetime of a slowly rotating Kerr black hole. Using the strong deflection limit, we derive the complex visibility function for a source of finite size at linear order in the black-hole spin. For a static equatorial source, we obtain a direct relation between the dimensionless Kerr spin parameter and the angular displacement of successive higher-order images belonging to the same parity sequence. We then extend the construction to a compact source on a circular equatorial orbit by evaluating each image contribution at the corresponding retarded source position. Frame dragging and source motion modify the angular positions of the images and leave distinct imprints on the long-baseline visibility pattern. For the configuration considered here, these effects act in opposite angular directions, so that the resulting structure is determined by their competition. Our results provide an analytical framework for identifying the imprints of black-hole spin and source dynamics in the interferometric signatures of higher-order images.

一句话导读：用强偏折极限解析计算缓慢旋转 Kerr 时空中高阶像的干涉可见度，并提取自旋与源运动印记。

超相对论物质中的中微子振荡：论 Tolman VI 时空的作用

Neutrino oscillations inside ultrarelativistic matter: on the role of the Tolman VI spacetime

Daniele Gregoris · gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：虽然中微子在光子与超相对论等离子体中的传播，以及弯曲时空中的中微子振荡都已被广泛研究，但两者在自引力几何中的结合此前似乎未被考虑。本文将研究静态球对称时空中的中微子振荡，该时空由 Einstein 方程在超相对论物质支撑下自洽导出。借助测地运动与构型的几何对称性，我们解析计算中微子程函与自旋光学相位振荡。随后，我们将共振现象与中微子所穿越背景物质的物理解释联系起来，以区分引力效应与电弱效应。我们将考察纯引力场、纯物质场以及温度对中微子振荡的影响；解释为何结果不是坐标假象，并通过与热场论方法预言的渐近行为比较来验证启发式方法。我们提醒关注当 中微子击中曲率奇点时，自旋光学相移在味道转换概率中的重要性。理论上，我们审视几何对称性与构型物理特征的独立作用；天体物理上，我们定性地讨论恒星内部以及不同温度和密度条件下宇宙微波背景中的中微子振荡。我们的研究在 Tolman VI 度规背景下提出一种识别宇宙中裸奇点的观测方法：中微子将同时处于物理重叠、味道平衡和量子力学扰乱状态。

English: While both neutrino propagation in photons and ultrarelativistic plasmas and neutrino oscillations in curved spacetimes have been studied extensively, their combination in a self-gravitating geometry appears not to have been considered previously. In this paper, we will investigate neutrino oscillations inside a static spherically symmetric spacetime, derived self-consistently from Einstein's equations, supported by ultrarelativistic matter. By relying on the geodesic motion and geometrical symmetries of the configuration, we will compute analytically the neutrino eikonal and spinoptics phase oscillations. Next, we will relate resonance phenomena to the physical interpretation of the background material inside which neutrinos travel for disentangling gravitational versus electroweak effects. We will inspect the effects of the pure gravitational and pure matter fields, and of the temperature in the neutrino oscillations; we will explain why our results are not coordinate artifacts, and we will certify our heuristic method by comparing with the asymptotic behaviours predicted by thermal field theory approaches. We will raise awareness on the relevance of the spinoptics phase shift entering the flavor conversion probability, should the neutrinos hit a curvature singularity. Theoretically, we will scrutinize the separate roles of geometrical symmetries versus physical features of the configuration, while astrophysically we will qualitatively discuss neutrino oscillations inside stars and in the Cosmic Microwave Background at different temperature and density conditions. Our research puts forward, in the context of the Tolman VI metric, an observational method for identifying naked singularities in our Universe: neutrinos would simultaneously be physically overlapped, in flavor-equilibrium and quantum-mechanically scrambled.

一句话导读：在 Tolman VI 自引力超相对论物质背景中解析计算中微子振荡与自旋光学相位，并讨论其作为裸奇点观测探针的意义。

考虑探测器校准不确定性在黑洞铃宕分析中的影响

Accounting for detector calibration uncertainty in black-hole ringdown analysis

Rowina S. Nathan, Shingo Hido, Neil Lu, Mallika R. Sinha, Sizheng Ma, Ling Sun · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：探测器校准系统误差会使残余黑洞质量和自旋的测量产生偏差，若不加考虑，可能产生反对广义相对论的虚假证据。双黑洞并合产生的引力波信号中的铃宕阶段编码了残余黑洞的性质：在足够晚的时间，信号可由准正规模叠加很好地描述，每个模式的频率和阻尼时间仅由残余质量与自旋决定。本文提出两种互补方法来分析数据的铃宕部分，在存在不可忽略的探测器校准误差时估计残余质量与自旋，使用准正规模有理滤波器（QNMRF）。当校准误差被很好测量时，我们在进行标准分析前对应变应用最佳估计的校准校正；当误差未知时，我们改为联合采样残余质量、自旋和依赖于频率的校准误差，并对不确定性先验进行边缘化。通过将数值相对论波形 SXS:BBH:0305 注入有色探测器噪声，在全信号匹配滤波信噪比约 60、模拟校准误差为幅度 ±25% 和相位 ±25° 的情况下，对校准不确定性进行边缘化能在 90% 可信区间内恢复真实质量与自旋，而若忽略校准误差则估计值会有偏。我们将该方法应用于 GW250207，该事件被记录时 Hanford 探测器响应未被很好表征；仅使用铃宕部分，无论是通过校正最佳估计的校准误差，还是对宽泛的不确定性先验进行边缘化，我们都恢复了与旋进-并合-铃宕预言一致的残余黑洞参数。

English: Detector calibration systematics can bias measurements of a remnant black hole's mass and spin, producing spurious evidence against general relativity if unaccounted for. The ringdown phase in the gravitational-wave signal produced by a binary black-hole merger encodes the remnant properties: at sufficiently late times, the signal is well described by a superposition of quasinormal modes, each with a frequency and damping time set only by the remnant mass and spin. Here we present two complementary approaches for analyzing the ringdown portion of the data to estimate the remnant mass and spin in the presence of a nonnegligible detector calibration error, using the quasinormal-mode rational filter (QNMRF). With a well-measured error, we apply the best-estimated calibration correction to the strain before conducting the standard analysis; with an unknown error, we instead jointly sample the remnant mass, spin and the frequency-dependent calibration error, marginalizing over an uncertainty prior. By injecting the numerical-relativity waveform SXS:BBH:0305 into colored detector noise, at a full-signal matched-filter signal-to-noise ratio of $\sim60$ and with simulated calibration errors of $\pm25\%$ in magnitude and $\pm25^\circ$ in phase, marginalizing over the calibration uncertainty recovers the true mass and spin within the 90\% credible interval, whereas the estimated values are biased if the calibration errors are ignored. We apply the method to GW250207, an event recorded while the Hanford detector response was not well characterized, and recover a remnant consistent with the inspiral-merger-ringdown prediction using the ringdown portion alone, both by correcting for a best-estimated calibration error and by marginalizing over a broad uncertainty prior.

一句话导读：在黑洞铃宕分析中，校正或边缘化探测器校准误差可避免残余质量与自旋的偏差估计，并在 GW250207 上仅用铃宕段得到与并合全波形一致的残余参数。

非线性电动力学中双荷黑洞的观测特征

Observational Signatures of Dyonic Black Holes in Non-Linear Electrodynamics

Sobhan Kazempour, Sichun Sun, Zhiqing He, Chengye Yu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究了非线性电动力学（NLED）中静态、球对称双荷黑洞的薄盘吸积和发射谱的观测特征。与经典麦克斯韦理论中电磁对偶假设电荷相等不同，NLED中的耦合参数引入了一个新的引力势，并在强场区域修改了几何。我们还研究了圆轨道上粒子的运动学特征，例如其角速度、比能量和比角动量。发现NLED的修改导致ISCO半径收缩，使辐射谱热峰向更小半径移动，因此与标准史瓦西和Reissner-Nordström解相比，局部有效温度增加。此外，我们计算了零测地线轨道，以确定光子球和黑洞阴影的光学边缘。为了评估上述替代方案的观测有效性，我们通过事件视界望远镜（EHT）收集的关于人马座A*（Sgr A*）的地平线尺度角直径约束进行了χ²拟合优度检验。我们证明这些双荷NLED和纯磁模型都与实验数据有良好的统计一致性。

English: We study the observational features of thin-disk accretion and emission spectra for static, spherically symmetric dyonic black holes in non-linear electrodynamics (NLED). In contrast to classical Maxwell theory, where electromagnetic duality assumes equal charges, the coupling parameters in NLED introduce a new gravitational potential and modify the geometry in the strong-field regime. We also study the kinematic characteristics of particles on circular orbits, such as their angular velocity, specific energy, and specific angular momentum. It is found that modifications of NLED lead to a shrinkage of the ISCO radius, resulting in a shift of the radiation spectrum thermal maximum towards smaller radii and, consequently, an increase in the local effective temperature in comparison with the standard Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordstr\"om solutions. Additionally, we compute null-geodesic orbits to determine the optical edge of both the photon sphere and the black hole shadow. In order to assess the observational validity of the aforementioned alternatives, we carry out a $\chi^2$ goodness-of-fit test through the angular diameter constraints at the horizon scale collected by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) concerning Sagittarius A* ($\text{Sgr A}^*$). We prove that both these dyonic NLED and purely magnetic models have good statistical agreement with experimental data.

一句话导读：研究非线性电动力学双荷黑洞的薄盘谱、ISCO、光子球与阴影，并用EHT对Sgr A*的角直径约束做拟合检验。

伪复广义相对论有效真空扇区的本构几何

Constitutive Geometry of the Effective Vacuum Sector of Pseudo-Complex General Relativity

F. Weber, P. O. Hess, C. A. Zen Vasconcellos · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：修正引力理论中的有效真空扇区通常用各向异性应力-能量张量表示，即使其底层源是几何的而非物质的。这引出一个更广泛的问题：此类有效应力能否通过协变本构结构内在地刻画，而不是作为奇异流体进行唯象建模？我们在伪复广义相对论（pcGR）中处理这一问题；在该理论中，一个受约束的变分表述将有效真空源识别为几何起源，但并未唯一确定相应的几何约束扇区。对于静态伪复 Schwarzschild 解，我们证明有效真空张量自然分解为一个各向同性贡献和一个纯横向贡献，后者与垂直于类时和径向方向的二维子空间的内禀几何相关。该分解导致基于横向度规的本构表述。其无穷小形变唯一地分裂为迹和无迹剪切模式，而静态解只有各向同性横向响应。在局域本构变量类中——这些变量代数地依赖于横向度规，且其一阶变分生成迹投影算符并具有状态无关归一化——对数横向面积应变是最小标量本构坐标。

English: Effective vacuum sectors in modified theories of gravity are often represented by anisotropic stress-energy tensors, even when the underlying source is geometric rather than material. This raises a broader question: can such effective stresses be characterized intrinsically through a covariant constitutive structure, rather than modeled phenomenologically as exotic fluids? We address this question in pseudo-complex general relativity (pcGR), where a constrained variational formulation identifies the effective vacuum source as geometric in origin but does not uniquely determine the corresponding geometric constraint sector. For the static pseudo-complex Schwarzschild solution, we show that the effective vacuum tensor separates naturally into an isotropic contribution and a purely transverse contribution associated with the intrinsic geometry of the two-dimensional subspace orthogonal to the timelike and radial directions. This decomposition leads to a constitutive formulation based on the transverse metric. Its infinitesimal deformations split uniquely into trace and traceless shear modes, with the static solution having only an isotropic transverse response. Within the class of local constitutive variables that depend algebraically on the transverse metric and whose first variation generates the trace projector with stateindependent normalization, the logarithmic transverse area strain is the minimal scalar constitutive coordinate.

一句话导读：在伪复广义相对论中，将静态伪复 Schwarzschild 解的有效真空张量分解为各向同性与横向部分，并构造基于横向度规的本构几何，其中对数横向面积应变是最小标量本构坐标。

站点相关噪声配置对爱因斯坦望远镜低频科学的影响

Impact of site-dependent noise configurations on Einstein Telescope science at low frequency

Francesco Crescimbeni, Matteo Di Giovanni, Davide Rozza, Andrea Contu, Alessandro Cardini, Domenico D'Urso, Carlo Giunchi, Luca Naticchioni, Marco Olivieri, Mike Lindner, Andreas Rietbrock, Paolo Pani · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究了站点相关的牛顿噪声配置如何影响第三代引力波天文台爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）的科学性能。我们比较了基线三角形和2L探测器几何构型，臂长分别为10公里和15公里，在由Euregio Meuse-Rhine地区、Lausitz和撒丁岛测量构建的三种站点相关噪声情景下。所采用的灵敏度之间的差异主要集中在10赫兹以下，因此对依赖于轻天体早期旋进的科学案例，或特征频率位于低频波段的大质量系统影响最大。我们针对四个ET科学案例量化了这些效应：(1) 中等质量黑洞双星的探测与参数估计；(2) 基于早期旋进的广义相对论后牛顿检验；(3) 大质量残余黑洞的ringdown光谱学；(4) 双中子星并合的预警和天空定位能力。使用贝叶斯参数估计，我们发现改进的低频灵敏度能在所有四个案例中显著增强ET的科学性能。在此考虑的配置中，若两个L形干涉仪中至少一个达到与撒丁岛站点假设相当的噪声水平，则2L网络通常比三角形配置表现更好。相反，10赫兹以下灵敏度的强烈恶化会大幅降低，并在某些情形下抵消将臂长从10公里增加到15公里所预期的科学收益。这些结果凸显了站点选择和低频噪声缓解，与网络几何构型一起，对于充分实现ET在10赫兹以下这一很大程度上尚未探索频段的科学潜力至关重要。

English: We investigate how site-dependent Newtonian noise configurations affect the scientific performance of the Einstein Telescope (ET), a third-generation gravitational-wave observatory. We compare the baseline triangular and 2L detector geometries, with arm lengths of 10km and 15km, respectively, under three site-dependent noise scenarios constructed from measurements in the Euregio Meuse-Rhine region, Lausitz, and Sardinia. The differences among the adopted sensitivities are concentrated mainly below 10Hz and thus have the greatest impact on science cases that rely on the early inspiral of light objects, or on massive systems whose characteristic frequencies lie in the low-frequency band. We quantify these effects for four ET science cases: (1) detection and parameter estimation of intermediate-mass black-hole binaries; (2) post-Newtonian tests of General Relativity based on the early inspiral; (3) black-hole ringdown spectroscopy with massive remnants; and (4) early-warning and sky-localization capabilities for binary neutron-star mergers. Using Bayesian parameter estimation, we find that improved low-frequency sensitivity can significantly enhance ET's scientific performance across all four cases. Within the configurations considered here, a 2L network in which at least one of the two L-shaped interferometers attains a noise level comparable to that assumed for the Sardinian site generally provides better performance than the triangular configurations. Conversely, strong degradation of the sensitivity below 10Hz can substantially reduce, and in some regimes offset, the scientific gains expected from increasing the arm length from 10km to 15km. These results highlight the importance of site selection and low-frequency noise mitigation, alongside network geometry, for fully realizing ET's scientific potential in the largely unexplored frequency band below 10Hz.

一句话导读：评估站点相关牛顿噪声对爱因斯坦望远镜低频科学目标的影响，发现低频灵敏度改进可显著提升IMBH探测、后牛顿检验、ringdown光谱学和双中子星预警等科学案例，而低频噪声恶化可能抵消15公里臂长带来的收益。

三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的带电孤子--黑洞相变

Charged soliton--black hole phase transitions in three-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity

Cendikiawan Suryaatmadja, Robert Mann · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们通过在三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中对静态带电黑洞做双 Wick 转动，构造了一个磁孤子。我们在所选边界条件下匹配边界度规和 Maxwell 源，并计算重整化欧氏作用量之差。由于 Maxwell 势在无穷远处对数增长，所选取的有限 Maxwell 边界项同时改变了固定 Maxwell 源和重整化作用量。孤子和黑洞的电荷贡献在 ΔI^{(c_fin)} 中都以正号出现。对于巨正则边界条件 c_fin=1，黑洞支和孤子支可以以不同斜率相交。在下面考虑的示例中，满足响应条件的黑洞支终止于一个最高温度，共存曲线在两个相反的空间 Maxwell 源取值处具有一个 T→0^+ 端点。在非极端相交处，熵差为 S_b - S_s = S_b。对于这两个静态解，两个电流分量相等要求两个电荷都为零。

English: We construct a magnetic soliton by double Wick rotating the static electrically charged black hole in three-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity. We match the boundary metrics and Maxwell sources under the chosen boundary condition and compute the difference of the renormalized Euclidean actions. Because the Maxwell potential grows logarithmically at infinity, the chosen finite Maxwell boundary term changes both the fixed Maxwell source and the renormalized action. The charge contributions for both the soliton and the black hole appear with plus signs in $\Delta I^{(c_{\mathrm{fin}})}$. For the grand-canonical boundary condition $c_{\mathrm{fin}}=1$, the black-hole and soliton branches can cross with different slopes. For the example considered below, the black-hole branch satisfying the response conditions ends at a maximum temperature, and the coexistence curve has a $T\to0^+$ endpoint at two opposite values of the spatial Maxwell source. At a nonextremal crossing, the entropy difference is $S_b-S_s=S_b$. For these two static solutions, equality of both current components requires both charges to vanish.

一句话导读：在三维 EGB 引力中通过双 Wick 转动构造磁孤子，并研究其与带电黑洞在巨正则边界条件下的相变、作用量差与熵差。

含物质的准拓扑引力：修正双拷贝方法

Quasitopological Gravity with Matter: Modified Double-Copy Approach

Valeri P. Frolov · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们将最近提出的修正双拷贝形式推广到与物质耦合的准拓扑引力（QTG）。对于球对称位形，带有一大类物质源的 D 维弯曲时空中 QTG 场方程被映射为平坦 (D+1) 维时空中辅助非线性规范场的方程。支配该辅助场的非线性电动力学完全由指定 QTG 模型的生成函数 h(p) 决定，而相应的流由物质应力-能量张量决定。将辅助解限制到 D 维超平面并应用修正双拷贝规定，可得到求解 QTG 方程的 Kerr-Schild 度规。我们表明，麦克斯韦和非线性电动力学，以及一大类球对称 Yang-Mills 场，提供了与该构造相容的物理物质源。在不存在类光物质通量时，相应解拥有额外的 Killing 矢量。这意味着它们满足广义 Birkhoff 定理，而类光带电电流自然产生 Vaidya 型解。在 Einstein 极限 h(p)=p 下，辅助非线性电动力学约化为麦克斯韦理论。

English: We extend the recently proposed modified double-copy formalism to quasitopological gravity (QTG) coupled to matter. For spherically symmetric configurations, the QTG field equations in $D-$dimensional curved spacetime with a broad class of matter sources are mapped to equations for an auxiliary nonlinear gauge field in a flat $(D+1)$-dimensional spacetime. The nonlinear electrodynamics governing this auxiliary field is determined entirely by the generating function $h(p)$ that specifies the QTG model, while the corresponding current is determined by the matter stress-energy tensor. Restricting the auxiliary solution to a $D$-dimensional hyperplane and applying the modified double-copy prescription yields the Kerr--Schild metric solving the QTG equations. We show that Maxwell and nonlinear electrodynamics, as well as a broad class of spherically symmetric Yang--Mills fields, provide physical matter sources compatible with this construction. In the absence of null-matter fluxes, the corresponding solutions possess an additional Killing vector. This means that they satisfy a generalized Birkhoff theorem, whereas null charged currents naturally generate Vaidya-type solutions. In the Einstein limit, $h(p)=p$, the auxiliary nonlinear electrodynamics reduces to Maxwell theory.

一句话导读：该工作将修正双拷贝形式推广到含物质的准拓扑引力，并给出 Kerr-Schild、广义 Birkhoff 及 Vaidya 型解。

English: This note addresses a number of subtle issues pertaining to the long-standing problem of strong phonon-like fermion-boson coupling. Among the central topics are the customary Migdal-Eliashberg approximation in the pertinent Schwinger-Dyson gap equation and its solutions. The previously gained insight is assessed by contrasting it against the various (non-)supersymmetric variants of the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model. Also, some previously discussed (pseudo-)holographic aspects of fermion pairing in such models are commented upon.

从 Bertotti--Robinson 到真空：通过 Harrison 与反演对称性获得的广义相对论新精确解

From Bertotti--Robinson to Vacuum: New Exact Solutions in General Relativity via Harrison and Inversion Symmetries

Jos\'e Barrientos, Adolfo Cisterna, Amaro D\'iaz, Keanu M\"uller · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们构造了 Einstein 方程的新真空解，这些解由嵌入外部电磁背景的电真空构型生成。起点是加速 Bertotti--Robinson 黑洞，我们利用电真空的两个独立对称性：Melvin--Bonnor 型磁化与磁反演。在两种构造中，外部电磁场可以被移除，同时在度规中留下非平凡的引力反作用，从而得到新的 Petrov I 型加速真空时空。在静态、非加速极限下，磁化 Bertotti--Robinson--Schwarzschild 情形复现已知结果，而反演对称性给出一个真正新的真空构型，即 Schwarzschild--Levi--Civita 几何的双参数推广。这些构造为生成代数一般真空几何提供了系统方法，并说明电磁嵌入如何在广义相对论中诱导非平凡真空度规。我们分析了这些时空的主要几何性质。此外，我们还给出两个进一步结果：这些真空几何的稳态推广，以及将同样对称性应用于 Alekseev--García 黑洞种子得到的两类新静态真空构型。

English: We construct new vacuum solutions of the Einstein equations generated from electrovacuum configurations embedded in external electromagnetic backgrounds. Starting from accelerating Bertotti--Robinson black holes, we exploit two independent symmetries of the electrovacuum: a Melvin--Bonnor-type magnetization and a magnetic Inversion. In both constructions, the external electromagnetic field can be removed while still leaving a non-trivial gravitational backreaction in the metric, yielding new accelerating vacuum spacetimes of Petrov type I. In the static, non-accelerating limit, the magnetized Bertotti--Robinson--Schwarzschild case reproduces known results, while the Inversion symmetry produces a genuinely new vacuum configuration, a two-parameter extension of the Schwarzschild--Levi-Civita geometry. These constructions provide a systematic method for generating algebraically general vacuum geometries and illustrate how electromagnetic embeddings can induce non-trivial vacuum metrics in General Relativity. The main geometrical properties of these spacetimes are analyzed. Additionally, we present two further results: a stationary generalization of these vacuum geometries and two new static vacuum configurations obtained by applying the same symmetries to the Alekseev--Garc\'ia black hole seed.

一句话导读：利用电真空的磁化与磁反演对称性，从加速 Bertotti--Robinson 黑洞生成新的 Petrov I 型加速真空精确解，并给出稳态与静态推广。

超轻暗物质对致密双星并合的影响

Effect of ultralight dark matter on compact binary mergers

Kabir Chakravarti, Soham Acharya, Sumanta Chakraborty, Sudipta Sarkar · gr-qc, astro-ph.GA, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：不断增长的引力波事件目录使得对致密双星并合进行统计分析成为可能，通常用双星并合率密度来量化。该量可能受环境因素影响；因此，本文研究了暗物质环境对并合统计的影响。我们构建了一个包含偏心与近圆致密双星并合的基线天体物理模型，并通过引入超轻暗物质模型对其进行扩展：该暗物质通过吸积和动力学摩擦影响双星轨道演化。对双星前身星并合群体的分析表明，与基线模型相比，超轻暗物质能够在环境密度约 ≲10^4 GeV/cm^3 与偏心率约 0.5 的最优组合附近改变并合统计。与 GWTC-3 目录的引力波数据比较，为超轻暗物质在并合事件中的潜在观测特征提供了重要线索，并可能对星系中暗物质分布的存在性与密度给出限制。

English: The growing catalogue of gravitational wave events enables a statistical analysis of compact binary mergers, typically quantified by the binary merger rate density. This quantity can be influenced by ambient factors, following which, in this work we have investigated the impact of dark matter environment on the merger statistics. We construct a baseline astrophysical model of eccentric and quasi-circular compact binary mergers and extend it by incorporating a model of ultra light dark matter, which affects the orbital evolution of binaries through accretion and dynamical friction. Our analysis of the merged population of binary progenitors demonstrates that, compared to the baseline model, ULDM can potentially alter the merger statistics around an optimal combination of ambient density $\lesssim10^4 \textrm{GeV}/\textrm{cm}^{3}$ and eccentricity $\sim 0.5$. A comparison with the gravitational wave data from the GWTC-3 catalogue provides crucial insight into potential observational signatures of the ULDM in merger events, leading to possible constraints on the existence and density of dark matter distribution in galaxies.

一句话导读：超轻暗物质可通过吸积和动力学摩擦改变致密双星并合统计，并有望用 GWTC-3 数据限制星系暗物质分布。

Complexity study of the Hartle-Hawking state in JT gravity

Ritam Basu · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：Wigner 函数一般会取负值，其负性大小给出了在经典计算机上模拟量子态复杂度的一种操作上有意义的度量。本文研究 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力中 Hartle-Hawking 态的 Wigner 负性在时间演化下的增长。我们在引力长度基下、亏格为零、高温 β≪1 的条件下工作。主要解析结果很简单：在 β 领头阶，该态是一个最小不确定性的高斯波包，静止在 Liouville 墙的转折点；因此其 Wigner 函数为正，负性为 1+δ(β,t)，其中修正 δ 小于 β 的任意幂。我们证明 δ 是时间的偶函数，故在 t=0 无线性增长；并且波包从墙上反射后，其领头阶演化是一个 Clifford 剪切，不能改变负性。我们还数值研究了 Wigner 函数及其负性的时间演化。我们观察到，δ 在 t=0 以及整个反射过程中保持在 10^{-11} 以下，随后在几十个 β/π 的时间尺度内缓慢上升，并趋近一个与 δ∞(β)≃0.08 e^{-4.4/β}（0.25≤β≤1）一致的晚期值：温度越低，晚期负性越大。精确的存活振幅 Z(β+it)/Z(β) 将 spread complexity 确定到 t^4 阶，也确定了我们此前工作 (arXiv:2607.04065, arXiv:2607.17346) 中的种子归一化 Wigner 诊断量。我们认为这表明长度基非常适合描述亏格为零动力学的对偶半经典描述。对于高于零的亏格，长度基是过完备的，我们不对有限 e^{S_0} 作任何陈述。

English: The Wigner function, in general, takes on negative values, and the amount of negativity in the Wigner function gives an operationally meaningful measure of the complexity of simulating the quantum state on a classical computer. In this paper, we study the growth of Wigner negativity of the Hartle-Hawking state of Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity under time evolution. We work in the gravitational length basis, at genus zero, and at high temperature, $\beta \ll 1$. Our main analytic result is simple: to leading order in $\beta$ the state is a Gaussian wavepacket of minimum uncertainty, sitting at rest at the turning point of the Liouville wall. Its Wigner function is therefore positive, and the negativity is $1+\delta(\beta,t)$, where the correction $\delta$ is smaller than any power of $\beta$. We show that $\delta$ is an even function of time, so there is no linear growth at $t=0$, and that once the packet has reflected off the wall its leading-order evolution is a Clifford shear, which cannot change the negativity. We also numerically study the time evolution of the Wigner function and its negativity. We observe that $\delta$ stays below $10^{-11}$ at $t=0$ and through the reflection, then rises slowly over a few tens of $\beta/\pi$, and then approaches a late-time value consistent with $\delta_\infty(\beta) \simeq 0.08\, e^{-4.4/\beta}$ for $0.25 \le \beta \le 1$: the lower the temperature, the larger the late-time negativity. The exact survival amplitude $Z(\beta+it)/Z(\beta)$ fixes the spread complexity to order $t^4$, and it also fixes the seed-normalised Wigner diagnostic of our earlier work (arXiv:2607.04065, arXiv:2607.17346). We take this as evidence that the length basis is ideally suited for a dual, semi-classical description of the dynamics at genus zero. Beyond genus zero the length basis is overcomplete, and we make no statement about finite $e^{S_0}$.

一句话导读：在 JT 引力中，用 Wigner 负性研究 Hartle-Hawking 态的复杂度演化，发现高温下主要为最小不确定度高斯波包，负性修正极小且晚期随温度降低而增大。

AdS/CFT 平直极限中的希尔伯特空间. I. 有质量粒子

Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. I. Massive particles

Kevin Nguyen · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：AdS$_4$ 时空的平直极限在对称代数层面相应于 Inönü–Wigner 收缩 $\mathfrak{so}(2,3)\to\mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$。我们描述了任意整数自旋 $s$ 的有质量散射态希尔伯特空间如何从共形群的一元最低权表示 $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ 中涌现，所用的基是 Fronsdal 首先引入的‘赝动量’态。在 AdS 曲率半径 $\ell\to\infty$、固定 $m=\Delta/\ell$ 的极限下，这些态很好地约化为 Wigner 的动量本征态。一个简单的共形映射将该描述与径向量子化中熟悉的 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 共形场联系起来，其中单位球的内部和外部各自对应出射和入射动量。在收缩下并经过适当重标度，$\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ 上的内积收敛到 Wigner 有质量粒子的标准洛伦兹不变内积，因此整个过程中幺正性保持。向无质量粒子的收缩在此简要讨论，并将在后续文章中详细处理。

English: The flat limit of AdS$_4$ spacetime corresponds, at the level of the symmetry algebra, to the In\"on\"u--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$. We describe the emergence of the Hilbert space of massive scattering states of arbitrary integer spin $s$ from unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group, using a basis of `pseudo-momentum' states first introduced by Fronsdal. These states nicely reduce to Wigner's momentum eigenstates in the limit of infinite AdS curvature radius $\ell \to \infty$, at fixed $m=\Delta/\ell$. A simple conformal map relates this description to conformal fields in $\mathbb{R}^3$ familiar from radial quantization, with the interior and exterior of the unit ball respectively corresponding to outgoing and ingoing momenta. Under the contraction, and upon appropriate rescaling, the inner product on $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ converges to the standard Lorentz-invariant inner product of Wigner's massive particles, so that unitarity is preserved throughout. The contraction to massless particles is briefly discussed here, and will be treated in detail in a forthcoming paper.

一句话导读：从 AdS4 共形群最低权表示出发，在 Inönü–Wigner 平直极限下构造 Wigner 有质量粒子希尔伯特空间，并证明内积收敛与幺正性保持。

AdS4-Einstein-标量引力中平面黑洞上的微扰双标量毛发

Perturbative Double-Scalar Hair on Planar Black Holes in AdS$_{4}$-Einstein-Scalar Gravity

Sangheon Yun · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们在四维Einstein引力中构造了耦合两个标量的双标量毛发平面黑洞，其势来自十一维超引力的ABJM一致截断。从已知单标量毛发黑膜出发，我们在无量纲毛发参数ε中微扰地打开第二个标量φ_m（固定源时正比于λ_-T），并求解耦合Einstein-标量系统至ε^2阶。线性化φ_m剖面是精确超几何函数，不依赖于φ_p毛发；其视界正则分支总带有源，因此没有自发φ_m毛发。由于对偶算符为无关算符（Δ_-=4），二阶响应出现共振对数：凝聚随闭式系数跑动，该系数由三阶顶点固定。度规和φ_p反作用以闭式给出；对任意毛发，它对角化为两个Pöschl-Teller问题，并将φ_p修正与横向度规修正锁定，比例为6/√7。在AdS-Schwarzschild上，第一定律与全息重整化一致，给出解析状态方程：固定熵时 T/T0 -1 = -(5√3/8π)ε^2，c_s^2 = 1/2 - (5√3/8π)ε^2，且 η/s = 1/4π，ζ/η = 1/4 ε^2。然后加入截断中Z2奇的第三标量χ，其对偶维Δχ=5。在毛发背景上其线性方程是带表观奇点的Heun方程，由Clausen函数求解。二阶时χ必然源φ_m，但两种交叉耦合都不使任一凝聚跑动，这种相互非重整化来自单步共振恒等式和关系 2Δχ - Δ_- = 2d。

English: We construct a two-scalar hairy planar black hole in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to two scalars whose potential descends from the ABJM consistent truncation of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Starting from the known single-scalar hairy black brane, we switch on the second scalar $\phim$ perturbatively in its dimensionless hair parameter $\eps$, which at fixed source is proportional to $\lambda_{-}T$, and solve the coupled Einstein-scalar system to order $\eps^{2}$. The linearized $\phim$ profile is an exact hypergeometric function, independent of the $\pp$ hair, whose horizon-regular branch always carries a source, so there is no spontaneous $\phim$ hair. Because the dual operator is irrelevant ($\Delta_{-}=4$), the second-order response develops a resonant logarithm: the condensate runs with a closed-form coefficient fixed by the cubic vertex. The metric and $\pp$ back-reaction is obtained in closed form; for arbitrary hair it diagonalizes into two P\"oschl-Teller problems and locks the $\pp$ correction to the transverse metric correction with ratio $6/\sqrt7$. On AdS-Schwarzschild the first law and holographic renormalization agree and give an analytic equation of state, $T/T_{0}-1=-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{8\pi}\eps^{2}$ at fixed entropy and $c_{s}^{2}=\tfrac12-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{8\pi}\eps^{2}$, with $\eta/s=1/4\pi$ and $\zeta/\eta=\tfrac14\eps^{2}$. We then add the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$-odd third scalar $\chi$ of the truncation, dual to $\Delta_{\chi}=5$. On the hairy background its linear equation is a Heun equation with an apparent singularity, solved by a Clausen function. At second order $\chi$ necessarily sources $\phim$, yet neither cross-coupling makes either condensate run, a mutual non-renormalization that follows from a one-step resonance identity and the relation $2\Delta_{\chi}-\Delta_{-}=2d$.

一句话导读：在AdS4 Einstein-标量引力中微扰构造双标量毛发平面黑洞，并给出全息重整化、状态方程、输运系数及多标量相互非重整化结果。

Alexandre Belin, Suzanne Bintanja, Alessandra Gnecchi, Damian R. Musk, Kyriakos Papadodimas · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：D1D5 CFT 的 BPS 态表现出电荷集中难题，与 N=4 SYM 的情形类似但更简单。我们考虑 D1D5 CFT 中由超荷上同调产生的 1/4-BPS 算符的手征代数，以及由此得到的有理关联函数。利用交叉对称性和该手征代数，我们对一般耦合和有限中心荷下、远离电荷集中轨迹的一族 1/4-BPS 态的存在性给出了非微扰证明。我们进一步讨论这对 D1D5 CFT 中 BPS 混沌的可能含义，并在 orbifold 点计算了一个晚期 BPS 平台。

English: The D1D5 CFT exhibits a charge concentration puzzle for BPS states, similar to, but simpler than, that of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. We consider the chiral algebra of 1/4-BPS operators in the D1D5 CFT arising from a supercharge cohomology, and the resulting rational correlators. Using crossing symmetry and this chiral algebra, we establish a non-perturbative proof of the existence of a family of 1/4-BPS states away from the charge concentration locus for general coupling and finite central charge. We further discuss possible implications for BPS chaos in the D1D5 CFT and compute a late-time BPS plateau at the orbifold point.

一句话导读：利用 D1D5 CFT 的 1/4-BPS 手征代数非微扰证明远离电荷集中轨迹的 BPS 态，并探讨 BPS 混沌与晚期平台。

Linking defects via AdS/CFT holography

Varun Gupta · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：在本文中，我们讨论嵌入在一个 IIB 型超引力背景解中的一些超对称探针 D5 膜解，该背景解通过形变整体 AdS5×S5 时空得到。所关注的 D5 膜解具有非紧致世界体；当它与一个重叠的反 D5 膜解放在一起时，其组合对偶于边界 SYM 理论的一个余维一缺陷。如果我们把探针 D5 的轮廓更多地移向体时空边界，使其形成从边界悬挂下来的 U 形轮廓，则对偶缺陷变成一个 U(1) 0-形式整体对称性的拓扑对称缺陷。我们展示如何利用悬挂 D5 膜，通过让 SYM 理论中的重行列式算符穿过体时空中的对偶巨引力子 D3 膜，来全息测量这些算符的 U(1) 整体对称性荷。

English: In this article, we discuss some supersymmetric probe D5 brane solutions embedded in a type 2b supergravity background solution obtained by deforming the global $AdS_5 \times S^5$ spacetime. The D5 brane solution of interest has a non-compact worldvolume, and when it is placed alongside overlapping with an anti-$\overline{\text{D5}}$ solution, the combination is dual to a codimension-1 defect of the boundary $SYM$ theory. The dual defect becomes a topological symmetry defect of a $U(1)$ $0$-form global symmetry if we move the profile of the probe D5 more towards the boundary of the bulk spacetime, resulting in a U-shaped profile hanging from the boundary. We show how the hanging D5 brane can be used holographically to measure the $U(1)$ global symmetry charge of the heavy determinant operators in the SYM theory by moving them across dual giant graviton D3 branes in the bulk spacetime.

一句话导读：利用形变 AdS5×S5 中的探针 D5/反 D5 膜构造边界 SYM 的余维一缺陷，并借助悬挂 D5 膜与巨引力子 D3 膜测量重行列式算符的 U(1) 荷。

相关度：medium — 论文核心是 AdS/CFT 中探针 D5/反 D5 膜与缺陷构造，并涉及巨引力子，命中 D3-D5 探针膜标签；但不涉及 Floquet 驱动、超流超导或多分量序参量等其它重点支线。

在 AdS$_3$ 中闭合 $\Phi^4$ 的圈图

Dean Carmi, Riccardo Ciccone, Shimon Sukholuski · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们计算了 AdS$_3$ 中 $\Phi^4$ 理论所有双迹算符 $[\phi\phi]_{n,\ell}$ 的 CFT 数据的单圈修正，适用于任意 $n$、$\ell$ 以及标度维度 $\Delta_\phi>1$。在谱表示下，$t$ 道单圈气泡图被约化为由共形 $6j$ 符号修饰的谱积分乘积。谱积分以及随后的留数求和均解析完成，用高阶超几何函数给出了反常维度的有限闭式表达式。我们讨论结果的结构，包括其大自旋和高能行为，并表明反常维度对自旋完全单调。

English: We compute the one-loop correction to the CFT data of all double-trace operators $[\phi\phi]_{n,\ell}$ for a $\Phi^4$ theory in AdS$_3$, for arbitrary values of $n$, $\ell$, and of the scaling dimension $\Delta_\phi>1$. Working in the spectral representation, the $t$-channel one-loop bubble diagram is reduced to a product of spectral integrals dressed by the conformal $6j$ symbol. Both the spectral integrals and the subsequent sums over residues are performed analytically, yielding finite closed-form expressions for the anomalous dimensions in terms of higher hypergeometric functions. We discuss the structure of the results, including their large-spin and high-energy behaviors, and show that the anomalous dimensions are completely monotonic in spin.

一句话导读：计算 AdS$_3$ 中 $\Phi^4$ 理论所有双迹算符 CFT 数据的单圈修正，并解析给出反常维度的闭式表达式。

中文摘要：我们提出了四维线性化引力的首个显式洛伦兹协变且民主的表述，即平等对待由电磁对偶相联系的两个框架。众所周知，四维线性化引力属于四维共形代数 so(2,4) 的一类 singleton 表示。我们的关键洞察是将该代数视为 AdS5 的等距代数，并将无质量自旋-2 场实现为取值于 so(2,4) 的特定有限维表示的五维拓扑场的边缘模式。所需的四维作用量随后通过协变边界约化程序得到。

Our key insight is viewing this algebra as the isometry of $\text{AdS}_5$ and realising the massless spin-2 field as edge modes of a five-dimensional topological field taking values in a specific finite-dimensional representation of $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$. English: We study how entanglement entropy can be used to reconstruct a dual gravity description. For a two-dimensional thermal system, equal-time entanglement entropy determines the spatial part of a three-dimensional black-hole geometry within a given metric ansatz. For an undeformed conformal field theory, the same inverse problem can be solved analytically by the Abel transformation. For a relevant deformation, we work in three-dimensional Einstein gravity with one canonical scalar field whose profile is monotonic. The geometry reconstructed from the given entanglement entropy then allows us to determine the scalar profile and the part of the scalar potential sampled by the RG flow. It also determines the holographic $\beta$-function and $c$-function.

中文摘要：我们提出了一套形式化方法，用于计算在时间对称时刻下，引力时空中任意空间区域的纠缠熵。关键要素是对该区域嵌入整体时空的路径积分，可解释为与该区域相关的边缘模式的求和。我们认为，在牛顿常数领头阶下，这种纠缠熵可以解释为所有包围它的区域中的最小广义熵。这暗示了一种“陆地全息”的概念：空间中的区域可以编码更大的区域，这与标准全息不同，标准全息中宇宙边界天球上的自由度编码内部。

English: We develop a formalism for calculating the entanglement entropy of an arbitrary spatial region of a gravitating spacetime at a moment of time symmetry. This suggests a notion of ``terrestrial holography'' where regions of space can encode larger ones, in contrast to the standard form of holography, in which degrees of freedom on the celestial sphere at the boundary of the universe encode the interior.

高维中的涡旋时空：真空背景与黑洞

Swirling spacetimes in higher dimensions: Vacuum backgrounds and black holes

Jos\'e Barrientos, Adolfo Cisterna, Carlos Herdeiro, Konstantinos Pallikaris · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们利用降维理论中的隐藏对称性，在真空广义相对论中构造高维涡旋时空。直接采用陪集空间表述，我们在五维中沿两个独立轴向 Killing 矢量进行约化，得到一个 SL(3,R)/SO(3) sigma 模型，以及一个具有两个独立涡旋参数的真正五维背景。同一变换也生成双涡旋的 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 和 Myers-Perry 几何。新背景的一个显著特征是其多方向渐近结构。关联的径向-角度极限揭示了方向性曲率奇点，这些奇点在通常固定角的大半径极限中不可见。我们进一步展示能够以有限仿射参数到达此类奇异渐近端点的因果测地线。最后，我们描述这种构造到高维的最大轴向延拓：对于完全轴向约化到三维，五维是最大的；而六维允许一个额外的非平凡平移形变，更高维只贡献平坦旁观方向。

English: We construct higher-dimensional swirling spacetimes in vacuum General Relativity using the hidden symmetries of the dimensionally reduced theory. Working directly with the coset-space formulation, we perform in five dimensions a reduction along the two independent axial Killing vectors, obtaining an $SL(3,\mathbb{R})/SO(3)$ sigma model and a genuinely five-dimensional background with two independent swirling parameters. The same transformation yields doubly swirling Schwarzschild--Tangherlini and Myers--Perry geometries. A distinctive feature of the new background is its multidirectional asymptotic structure. Correlated radial-angular limits reveal directional curvature singularities that are invisible in the usual large-radius limit at fixed angle. We further exhibit causal geodesics that reach such singular asymptotic ends in finite affine parameter. Finally, we describe the maximally axial extension of this construction to higher dimensions: five dimensions are maximal for an entirely axial reduction to three dimensions, while six dimensions admit an additional nontrivial translational deformation, with further dimensions contributing only flat spectator directions.

一句话导读：利用降维隐藏对称性构造高维真空涡旋时空，给出双涡旋黑洞几何并揭示方向性渐近奇点与测地线性质。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究高维真空 Einstein 方程、隐藏对称性约化、经典黑洞解以及奇点和测地线，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

超越 Horndeski 引力中具有初级毛发的非互易黑洞：精确解与稳定性

Nonreciprocal black holes with primary hair in beyond Horndeski gravity: Exact solutions and stability

Sebastian Bahamonde, Theodoros Nakas, Simon Iteanu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们提出一种新的系统方法，用于在位移对称和 Z2 对称的超越 Horndeski 理论中构造精确、静态且渐近平直的黑洞解。与以往研究不同，我们的方法不依赖于限制性的互易条件 g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1，从而允许由两个独立度规函数描述的更一般几何。所得解空间包含两类定性不同的毛发，分别源自理论的不同分支。一个分支以 khronometric 毛发为特征，另一个分支则以真正的标量毛发为特征。在两者中，标量剖面都定义了一个非平庸的优选叶层化，但前者位移对称诺特流及相应传播自由度是平凡的，后者则是非零的。我们主要关注第二个分支，推导出若干不同的精确黑洞解族。一般来说，这些解是奇异的，并具有与独立标量荷相关的初级标量毛发。尽管如此，我们证明它们可以被正则化，从而得到规则黑洞或孤子组态，此时标量毛发变为次级。我们进一步通过分析轴向扇区和偶宇称扇区的单极（ℓ=0）模，在线性微扰下研究这些解的稳定性。对于具有标量毛发的代表性解，微扰分析给出了在所考虑模式下线稳定性的证据。

English: We develop a novel systematic method for constructing exact, static, and asymptotically flat black-hole solutions in shift-symmetric and $Z_2$-symmetric beyond Horndeski theories. In contrast to previous studies, our approach does not rely on the restrictive reciprocal condition $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$, allowing for more general geometries characterized by two independent metric functions. The resulting solution space contains two qualitatively distinct types of hair originating from different branches of the theory. One branch is characterized by khronometric hair, while the other by genuine scalar hair. In both, the scalar profile defines a nontrivial preferred foliation, but the shift-symmetry Noether current and the associated propagating degree of freedom are trivial for the former and nonvanishing for the latter. Focusing mainly on the second branch, we derive several distinct families of exact black-hole solutions. In general, these solutions are singular and exhibit primary scalar hair associated with an independent scalar charge. Nevertheless, we demonstrate that they can be regularized to yield regular black-hole or solitonic configurations, for which the scalar hair becomes secondary. We further investigate the stability properties of these solutions under linear perturbations by analyzing the axial sector and the monopole $(\ell=0)$ mode of the even-parity sector. For representative solutions with scalar hair, the perturbative analysis provides evidence for linear stability under the modes considered.

一句话导读：在超越 Horndeski 引力中不依赖互易条件构造出带初级标量毛发的精确渐近平直黑洞解，并分析其线性稳定性。

N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论大荷极限下的能量-能量关联函数

Energy-energy correlators in the large-charge limit of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory

Alessandro Georgoudis, Max Jackson, Congkao Wen · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论重态中的能量-能量关联函数（EEC），所处的大荷 't Hooft 极限为：重算符的维度 Δ（等价地，其 R-荷）趋于无穷，同时保持有效耦合 λ_Q ∝ g_YM^2 Δ 固定。在此极限下，相关的重-重-轻-轻四点关联函数已知到 λ_Q 的任意阶。对于某些类型的算符，微扰级数可以重求和，从而得到精确的有限耦合表达式。我们利用这些结果确定相应的 EEC，其动力学部分可由四点关联函数的双重不连续性提取。我们给出了有限有效耦合下的 EEC，并研究其作为 λ_Q 以及探测器之间角分离的函数在一般角度、共线极限和背对背极限下的物理行为。

English: We study the energy-energy correlator (EEC) in heavy states of four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory in the large-charge 't Hooft limit, in which the dimension $\Delta$ of the heavy operator (or, equivalently, its $R$-charge) is taken to infinity with the effective coupling $\lambda_Q \propto g_{\mathrm{YM}}^2\Delta$ held fixed. The relevant heavy-heavy-light-light four-point correlators are known to all orders in $\lambda_Q$ in this limit. For certain classes of operators, the perturbative series can be resummed to obtain exact finite-coupling expressions. We use these results to determine the corresponding EEC, whose dynamical part can be extracted from a double discontinuity of the four-point correlator. We determine the EEC at finite effective coupling and study its physical behavior as a function of $\lambda_Q$ and the angular separation between the detectors, both at generic angles and in the collinear and back-to-back limits.

一句话导读：在大荷 't Hooft 极限下研究 N=4 SYM 重态的能量-能量关联函数，并从重-重-轻-轻四点关联函数提取有限有效耦合下的 EEC 行为。

相关度：low — 该文属于 N=4 SYM/共形场论关联函数研究，但摘要未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子实验启发或探针膜等具体支线。

弹跳奇点的弦论消解

Stringy resolution of bouncing singularities

Ilija Buri\'c, Ivan Gusev, Andrei Parnachev · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究了近极端 NS5 膜的近视界几何，它允许用 SL(2,R)_k/U(1) coset 给出精确的世界面描述。在超引力极限下，解析延拓到时间域的反射振幅表现出与从黑洞奇点反弹的零测地线相关的奇点，类似于渐近 AdS 时空中边界关联子的反弹奇点。我们证明有限弦长效应使该振幅成为复时间的整函数，从而完全消解了反弹奇点。这种消解在 coset 能级的倒数展开中是非微扰的：该奇点在展开的每个有限阶都持续存在。

English: We study the near-horizon geometry of near-extremal NS5 branes, which admits an exact worldsheet description in terms of the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})_k/U(1)$ coset. In the supergravity limit, the analytically continued time-domain reflection amplitude exhibits a singularity associated with a null geodesic bouncing off the black-hole singularity, analogous to the bouncing singularities of boundary correlators in asymptotically AdS spacetimes. We show that finite-string-length effects render this amplitude an entire function of complex time, completely resolving the bouncing singularity. This resolution is nonperturbative in the inverse coset level: the singularity persists at every finite order in the expansion.

一句话导读：近极端 NS5 膜通过 SL(2,R)/U(1) coset 的世界面精确描述表明，有限弦长效应非微扰地消解了黑洞反弹奇点。

精确流体力学作用量的视界对称性

Horizon symmetries of exact hydrodynamic actions

Mike Blake, Arpit Das, Richard A. Davison · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们展示 AdS 黑洞的视界对称性如何在对偶能动张量动力学的流体力学作用量中实现。最近一种获得此类作用量的方法涉及选取视界边界条件，我们证明保持这些边界条件的微分同胚给出了相应流体力学作用量的对称性。利用该方法，我们获得了 JT 引力和 AdS3 引力中黑洞小振幅扰动的显式流体力学作用量，并显式证明了这些对称性的存在。对于一种自然的边界条件选择，所得作用量明显地实现了此前为最大混沌有效理论提出的规范对称性。

English: We demonstrate how horizon symmetries of AdS black holes are realised in the hydrodynamic actions for the dynamics of the dual stress tensor. A recent approach for obtaining such actions involves a choice of horizon boundary conditions, and we show that diffeomorphisms that preserve these give rise to symmetries of the corresponding hydrodynamic action. We obtain explicit hydrodynamic actions for small amplitude perturbations of black holes in JT and AdS$_3$ gravity using this approach and demonstrate explicitly the existence of these symmetries. For a natural choice of boundary conditions, the resulting actions manifestly realise gauge symmetries previously proposed for effective theories of maximal chaos.

一句话导读：从 AdS 黑洞视界边界条件与保持微分同胚导出精确流体力学作用量，并在 JT/AdS3 中实现最大混沌有效理论的规范对称性。

相关度：high — 与全息对偶、AdS 黑洞视界、流体力学作用量及最大混沌有效理论直接相关；涉及 JT/AdS3 和边界条件/微分同胚，贴合全息非平衡与混沌方向。

de Sitter JT 引力的概率测度

Probability measures for de Sitter JT gravity

Wilfried Buchmuller, Alexander Westphal · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：具有正宇宙学常数的 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力是研究从量子态中涌现出膨胀 de Sitter 宇宙的玩具模型。其密度矩阵是双喇叭振幅的叠加，而这些振幅是 Wheeler-DeWitt 方程的解。我们比较了此类混合态对经典膨胀宇宙的预言与无边界波函数的相应预言。与全息一致的、其半经典极限与 Schwarzian 边界涨落结果相符的双喇叭振幅，给出宇宙大小的平坦概率分布，与暴胀模型一致。这与无边界波函数所预言的对大宇宙的压低形成对比。

English: Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with positive cosmological constant is a toy model to study the emergence of expanding de Sitter universes from a quantum state. Its density matrix is a superposition of double-trumpet amplitudes which are solutions of a Wheeler-DeWitt equation. We compare predictions of such mixed states for classical expanding universes with the corresponding predictions of no-boundary wavefunctions. Double-trumpet amplitudes consistent with holography, whose semiclassical limit matches the result from Schwarzian boundary fluctuations, lead to a flat probability distribution for the size of the universe, consistent with models of inflation. This is in contrast to the suppression of large universes predicted by no-boundary wave functions.

一句话导读：在 de Sitter JT 引力中，比较双喇叭混合态与无边界波函数给出的宇宙大小概率分布，发现全息一致的双喇叭预言平坦分布而非大宇宙压低。

AdS/BCFT 中的多分纠缠几何

Multipartite Entanglement Geometry in AdS/BCFT

Debarshi Basu, Qiang Wen, Mingshuai Xu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：多分纠缠度量探测量子关联的组织方式如何超出成对熵所能推断的内容。我们研究在全息 BCFT 中物理边界如何重塑这种结构。世界末端膜为多分纠缠打开新的相对同调通道，使得连通的体 web 可以在不必与普通 Ryu--Takayanagi 转变重合的尺度上重组和因子化。在静态 AdS3/BCFT2 中，这产生特征性的多分相层级以及真正多熵对边界的非平凡依赖。在热场双态中，真正连通的 web 反而可以通过爱因斯坦--罗森桥支撑，导致不同于通常 Hartman--Maldacena 转变的增长、重连和饱和尺度。这些结果表明，多分纠缠不仅对极端曲面面积敏感，而且对存在边界时体纠缠结构被允许如何连接、分裂和终止敏感。

English: Multipartite entanglement measures probe how quantum correlations are organized beyond what can be inferred from pairwise entropies. We study how this structure is reshaped by a physical boundary in a holographic BCFT. The end-of-the-world brane opens new relative-homology channels for multipartite entanglement, allowing connected bulk webs to reorganize and factorize at scales that need not coincide with any ordinary Ryu--Takayanagi transition. In static AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, this produces a characteristic hierarchy of multipartite phases and a nontrivial dependence of genuine multi-entropy on the boundary. In the thermofield-double state, genuinely connected webs can instead be supported through the Einstein--Rosen bridge, leading to growth, reconnection and saturation scales distinct from the usual Hartman--Maldacena transitions. These results show that multipartite entanglement is sensitive not only to extremal-surface areas but also to how bulk entanglement structures are allowed to join, split and terminate in the presence of a boundary.

一句话导读：在 AdS/BCFT 中，边界膜改变多分纠缠的体同调通道，产生独立于普通 RT 转变的多分相层级和 TFD 中的新饱和尺度。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

从分级泊松几何看 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力

Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan Gravity from Graded Poisson Geometry

Johannes Moerland, Peter Schupp · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：利用分级泊松几何中的概念，我们建立了一个框架，可简洁地表述 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力等场论。我们证明 Einstein-Cartan 引力等价于一类 Palatini-Cartan 引力的变体，其中 vielbein 场被约束满足适当的对称关系，我们称之为受约束 vielbein 引力。为此，我们通过分级流形之间的微分同胚联系这些理论。随后我们展示如何通过去除对称性约束来得到完整的 Palatini-Cartan 理论。最后，我们说明该分级几何框架如何直接纳入受约束 vielbein 与 Palatini-Cartan 理论的最小 BV 扩张。

English: Using notions from graded Poisson geometry, we develop a framework that allows for concise formulations of field theories such as Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan gravity. We show that Einstein-Cartan gravity is equivalent to a variant of Palatini-Cartan gravity in which the vielbein fields are constrained to satisfy appropriate symmetry relations, which we refer to as constrained vielbein gravity. To that end, we relate these theories via a diffeomorphism of graded manifolds. We then show how to obtain the full Palatini-Cartan theory by removing the symmetry constraint. Finally, we show how our graded geometric framework allows for a direct incorporation of the minimal BV extension of the graded constrained vielbein and Palatini-Cartan theories.

一句话导读：用分级泊松几何统一表述 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力，并构造最小 BV 扩张。

极端黑洞模仿者：几何、稳定性与长延迟信号列

Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains

Sergey N. Solodukhin · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们提出一个作为极端黑洞无视界模仿者的时空。与先前研究的非退化视界黑洞模仿者不同——其几何为虫洞型，由两个渐近平坦区域通过极长喉部连接——极端黑洞的模仿者在一端具有单个渐近平坦区域，另一端为无限长喉部。在喉部区域，时空趋近直积几何 M_{1,1} × S^2，其中 M_{1,1} 为二维闵可夫斯基时空，S^2 为二维球面。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运。尽管在喉部的局部分析中出现 Aretakis 型模式，它们并不会导致模仿者的物理不稳定性。一个最初局域于喉部的标量扰动在晚期会产生具有特征间隔 t_delay ∼ 1/λ 的信号序列，其中 λ≪1 是形变参数。该时标在参数上大于非极端黑洞模仿者所特有的回声时间 t_echo ∼ ln(1/λ)。我们将此序列称为长延迟信号列。几何上，长延迟信号的周期性对应于 S^2 上的周期测地线。然后我们将构造推广到极端 Kerr。在此情形，喉部区域趋近于涉及 M_{1,1} 和二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何。相应信号预期形成准周期信号列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。我们还评论了对非极端黑洞虫洞型模仿者的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应下对幺正性的意义。

English: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$.
